jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, SkinMedica - Louisiana and Mississippi
jobs.description:
This role is field-based throughout Louisiana and Mississippi, with the expectation of being out in the field 5 days a week

The Strategic Account Manager (SAM) is responsible for representing the SkinMedica, DiamondGlow and Latisse brands and promote the product portfolio to targeted aesthetic customers within a designated geographical area. The focus will be on direct selling of products (physician dispensed skincare and skin resurfacing system) and executing pull through programs/events to patients. This is accomplished by utilizing and managing key resources and contributing with high performance selling teams to maximize coverage to targeted customers. The SAM provides technical product and procedure expertise, as well as, competitive product differentiation. Assigned sales goals are obtained through creative, consultative selling and implementation of the U.S. Sales/Marketing plan.

Responsibilities

• The SAM leverages Allergan Medical’s resources to enhance adoption of the SKM Portfolio which includes 1) non-surgical, non-invasive skin resurfacing equipment, 2) topical skincare consumables designed for the resurfacing device and 3) SkinMedica product portfolio. Must collaborate with Facial Aesthetics, Plastic Surgery, Coolsculpting, APC’s, Marketing, and other Allergan sales forces. Complies with required reports, requests, and compliance policies.
• Effectively manages field assets and resources to include, but not limited to, expense management, computer, and other allocated equipment.
• SALES RESULTS: Consistently achieves sales quota for skin care, consumables, and equipment. Proficient in sales execution component of marketing plans to include device placement and pull through product promotions (device, consumables and SkinMedica portfolio). Creates call plans across product portfolio. Demonstrates adaptability with multiple initiatives.
• Demonstrates effective selling skills (demonstrate DiamondGlow Treatments, educate customers on proper techniques for DiamondGlow Treatments, consultative sales approach to the customers' business, pre-call plans, Intro/credentialing, assessment of customer needs, handling objections, presentation delivery with visuals, closing, follow-up, etc.). Builds loyal relationships; high level customer interaction.
• Calls on and effectively manages time with new and existing customers to educate on new and current products. Works with customers toward business development by assessing and product needs, placing account orders, merchandising office, and supporting events for pull-through.
• Manages initiative execution across the portfolio balancing the device sale to drive skin care and consumable business. Demonstrates ability to assess territory metrics to develop and implement territory business plans; computer proficiency (excel, internet, PowerPoint); use of sales reporting tools; responds timely to corporate requests; balances work load demonstrating good organizational skills, and optimizes corporate resource and budget allocation. Provides product samples as necessary.
• Educates customers on device and product features and benefits through individual and group presentations/trainings. Conveys consistent differentiating messaging across portfolio; technical fluency across Allergan and competitive product portfolio. Demonstrates an expertise in discussing support studies/material, proficient with knowledge of the aesthetic market. Portrays strong business acumen.

Ability to understand marketing team's role and provide appropriate feedback to plan implementation. Ability to articulate strategy to RM and team members. Ability to understand how individual tactics support the overall strategic direction. Understands and adheres to compliance and travel/expense policies.
• Exemplifies integrity, flexibility, and adaptability. Ability to understand multiple perspectives of decisions beyond one territory. Is self-aware of interaction with customers, peers, etc. Demonstrates the ability to make sound decisions and uses good judgment. Is reliable and has a willingness to improve. Portrays a positive and productive attitude in working with counterparts toward collaboration supporting the portfolio of business.

• Bachelor's degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.
• Minimum of 3+ years of sales experience required with business to business to consumer (B2B2C) sales experience preferred.
• Aesthetics sales background or related experience with a skin care company highly desirable
• Valid driver’s license
• Analytical skills. Strong business acumen. Proven selling skills
• Analytical skills. Strong business acumen. Proven selling skills
• Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. Strong interpersonal skills. Strong contract/negotiating skills
• Financial/budgetary experience
• Ability to travel . Ability to lift 50 lbs.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Powertrain Controls Validation
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Senior Engineer, Powertrain Controls Validation

Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Engineer, Powertrain Controls Validation to support the development and validation of vehicle motion control and chassis-related control systems.
This is a highly technical, hands-on role spanning SIL, HIL, and vehicle-level validation. We are looking for an engineer with strong engineering fundamentals, deep understanding of control systems and vehicle behavior, and the ability to independently investigate complex problems from software behavior all the way to the vehicle.
The ideal candidate is a subject matter expert in powertrain, motion controls, or chassis controls who is comfortable working across simulation and physical test environments and has a strong ownership and can-do mindset.

Responsibilities:

• Own validation activities for powertrain, vehicle motion control, and chassis control systems across SIL, HIL, and vehicle environments.

• Develop validation strategies based on system requirements, control architecture, expected vehicle behavior, and failure modes.

• Validate control functionality across nominal, boundary, transient, degraded, and fault conditions.

• Investigate complex system-level issues and drive them toward root cause by connecting observed vehicle behavior to controls, software, calibration, network communication, sensors, and actuators.

• Work closely with Controls, Systems, Software, Calibration, Functional Safety, and Vehicle Engineering teams.

• Identify gaps in requirements, control behavior, interfaces, diagnostics, and validation coverage.

• Develop efficient and repeatable test methodologies while maintaining strong engineering judgment rather than relying exclusively on scripted testing.

• Support vehicle testing, issue reproduction, data collection, and technical debugging.

• Clearly communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations to engineering teams.

• Help improve the overall validation approach by bringing strong controls and vehicle-level engineering fundamentals to the team.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field is required. Master's degree or higher education is preferred.

• Strong fundamentals in control systems, vehicle dynamics, and automotive systems.

• 4+ years of experience validating embedded automotive control systems using SIL, HIL, vehicle testing, or a combination of these environments.

• Ability to interpret requirements, control logic, state machines, signal interfaces, and system architecture.

• Strong data-analysis and root-cause-debugging skills.

• Ability to understand the physical behavior behind the signals instead of relying solely on test results or automated PASS/FAIL criteria.

• Experience working with CAN and automotive communication signals.

• Ability to independently take an ambiguous technical problem, structure the investigation, collect the right data, and drive it toward resolution.

• Strong ownership, curiosity, and a can-do attitude.

Salary Range: The compensation range for this position is specific to the locations listed below and is the range Lucid reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; and other relevant business and organizational factors.

Base Pay Range (Annual)

$146,300—$201,190 USD

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

jobs.title: Design Advocate - Architect
jobs.description:
About Pirros

We are building Intelligence for design production and reshaping how architecture and engineering firms manage design details and project knowledge.

Pirros is an AI-powered project hub purpose-built for architects and engineers. Our platform helps AECO professionals - architects, engineers, contractors, and owners - streamline detail management, improve consistency, reduce errors, and accelerate project delivery.

We’re building the system of record for design production in a $12T+ industry that has long been underserved by modern software and workflows.



Why Join Pirros

 - Backed by leading investors including YC, Funders Club, PlanGrid, and Elephant

 - Profitable business with $7M+ ARR and growing 10% month-over-month

 - Closed a $17M Series A in 2025

 - 350+ firms actively using Pirros today, including some of the top AEC firms in the country

 - 120% net revenue retention

 - Founders come directly from the structural engineering industry

 - Competitive compensation package - salary, equity, unlimited PTO, and full benefits

 - High-trust, high-autonomy culture with experienced builders and operators

 - Opportunity to solve meaningful problems for the people designing the world around us
   
   

About the Role

The Design Advocate is a senior, highly cross-functional role for an experienced architect who deeply understands how AEC firms actually operate. From project delivery and coordination to content standards and BIM workflows.

This person sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, serving as Pirros’ in-house practitioner voice and strategic bridge between Product and GTM teams. Reporting directly to the CEO, the Design Advocate ensures that product innovation translates into customer value, sales enablement, and market credibility.

Today, one of Pirros’ biggest opportunities is improving the flow of information between R&D and GTM. Features ship without enough visibility, launches happen without polished enablement, and teams sometimes learn about changes too late. The Design Advocate is the structural fix and is embedded close enough to Product to understand what’s coming, while proactively ensuring Sales, Marketing, and CS are fully prepared before launches happen. This is not a traditional Product role or Marketing role. It is a senior individual contributor position focused on making Product, GTM, and customer-facing teams more aligned, informed, and effective.



What You’ll Own

Product Partnership & Customer Advocacy

 - Embed in product discovery and roadmap conversations as Pirros’ in-house AEC practitioner. Pressure-test ideas against real-world workflows, identify adoption risks early, and advocate for what customers actually need

 - Maintain visibility into upcoming launches and roadmap changes well ahead of broader GTM rollout

 - Feed customer and field insights directly back into Product discovery. Surface what’s resonating, where users are struggling, and what competitive pressure is emerging

GTM Enablement & Launch Readiness

 - Translate product updates and launches into actionable GTM enablement materials

 - Own pre-launch readiness checkpoints to ensure no major feature ships without appropriate positioning, enablement, communication, and internal preparedness

 - Serve as the technical and practitioner counterpart to Marketing by validating technical accuracy and strengthening messaging credibility

Sales & Customer Support

 - Act as a technical resource for Sales. supporting strategic customer conversations, participating in complex demos, and bringing senior architect credibility when needed

 - Partner with Customer Success to help field advanced workflow and product questions while routing valuable customer feedback back into Product and Engineering

 - Equip GTM teams proactively with the context and workflow expertise they need before issues arise in active deals

Industry Leadership & Market Intelligence

 - Represent Pirros externally as a practitioner voice through industry events, webinars, podcasts, AIA/Autodesk University participation, and customer roundtables

 - Deliver AIA-accredited continuing education programs as a high-trust GTM and brand-building channel (assuming licensure requirements are met)

 - Maintain and disseminate Pirros’ perspective on the evolving AEC landscape

Who You Are

 - Practiced architecture at a respected firm and understand what it feels like to deliver projects under real deadlines

 - Deep familiarity with Revit workflows, content standards, BIM coordination, and detail management challenges

 - Strong understanding of how architecture firms operate both operationally and commercially, including project delivery, profitability, staffing, scheduling, and interdisciplinary coordination

 - Exceptional communicator and equally comfortable building a demo, leading a webinar, writing a battlecard, or presenting to executives

 - Naturally proactive in sharing context and communicating without waiting to be asked

 - Highly collaborative and comfortable working across Product, Sales, Marketing, and CS without stepping on ownership boundaries

 - Thrive in ambiguity and excited to help build the bridge process while actively serving as the bridge

 - Able to hold your own with senior engineers, PMs, architects, executives, and enterprise customers alike

Nice to Have

 - AIA license

 - Experience managing BIM standards, content standards, or detail libraries at a mid-to-large architecture firm

 - Existing industry presence through speaking engagements, AU/AIA participation, podcasts, or thought leadership

 - Prior experience working closely with a software company (advisor, beta customer, customer council, or in-house)

 - Sales enablement tools, CRM systems, demo environments, or analytics tools
   
   

Pirros believes diverse perspectives and experiences make both our product and culture stronger. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Pirros is committed to fair and equitable compensation. Compensation packages are determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and performance, and include salary, equity, and benefits.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Access Strategy and Marketing
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Associate Director will lead the strategy, development, and execution of access marketing materials for the RevMed portfolio with a focus on pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC) or non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

This role will focus on developing the short to medium term non-clinical value proposition across payers, HCPs, organized customers (GPOs, IDNs, etc) and channel partners. The Associate Director will support post-launch monitoring and lead strategic and tactical planning for new launches. This role will tailor messaging to distinct customer segments and collaborate closely with Brand Marketing, National Account, Medical/HEOR, Regulatory, and Compliance partners. This role will require the ability to educate and influence internal stakeholders on Market Access strategy, key decisions, and implications.

This position is open to remote candidates, though preference will be given to candidates that can be based out of our headquarters in Redwood City, CA.

Responsibilities may include:

• Support the development and execution of access marketing strategies to align with brand and portfolio strategies.

• Develop value proposition messaging and materials for payers, PBMs, IDNs, GPOs, channel partners, and other managed care decisionmakers.

• Translate clinical, economic, and real-world evidence into compelling messages that communicate the portfolio’s value and address stakeholder evidence needs

• Develop and execute a customer insights plan and partner with National Accounts and field teams to gather insights, refine messaging, and develop materials.

• Execute compliant marketing tactics for GPOs and organized providers across relevant channels.

• Coordinate launch readiness activities across Market Access teams.

• Lead pull-through and training for materials and market access initiatives.

• Manage day-to-day agency projects, timelines, deliverables, and assigned budgets.

• Work with Brand Marketing, Regulatory, and Compliance to align materials with brand goals and compliance requirements.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor’s degree required with 6+ years of experience in Marketing, Product Planning, and/or Managed Care.

• Experience in new product launches, including tactical execution.

• Strong understanding of the access landscape across all market access stakeholders.

• Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize and effectively deliver results within established timelines.

• Ability to represent Revolution Medicines well: strong interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication.

• Ability to travel up to 25%.

Preferred Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in Marketing and/or Managed Care.

• Oral oncolytic product experience strongly preferred.

• Understanding of distribution models and patient support programs.

• Prior experience working with Compliance and Regulatory teams.

• Prior experience in customer-facing roles.

jobs.title: Territory Manager - Minnesota
jobs.description:
About Ceribell

Ceribell is a medical technology company focused on transforming the diagnosis and management of patients with serious neurological conditions. The Ceribell System is a novel, point-of-care electroencephalography (“EEG”) platform specifically designed to address the unmet needs of patients in the acute care setting, and is being used in hundreds of community hospitals, large academic facilities and major IDN's across the country. Our entire team is driven by a shared commitment to transforming the landscape of critical care through our rapid seizure detection technology, come join the movement!

Position Summary:

The Ceribell Territory Manager is responsible for partnering with key stakeholders across multiple departments (Emergency Department, ICU, Neurology, Hospital Administration) to educate on the prevalence and importance of non-convulsive seizures, build support, and drive the acquisition process. In your role as Territory Manager, you will be responsible for Ceribell's success in selling our technology and achieving revenue growth within your assigned territory. Providing superior customer relationship management while meeting or exceeding sales targets is your primary responsibility.

• Value Proposition Communication: Clearly communicate Ceribell’s value proposition to unlock new partnership opportunities and develop long-term relationships with key decision-makers within your territory.

• Pipeline Management: Collaborate with Leadership and Account Managers to develop and grow a strong pipeline of new business and launch partnerships that deliver continued business growth.

• Clinical Champion Development: Build and coach clinical champions within hospital departments, demonstrating success in advancing sales opportunities.

• Cold Calling Expertise: Utilize cold calling skills to engage potential clients in the hospital setting, not limited to clinics or physician offices.

• Coachability: Demonstrate the ability to receive and implement feedback, showing examples of prior roles where coaching was successfully integrated.

• Compliance: Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and Ceribell policies.

Qualifications:

• Experience: Minimum of 5+ years of medical device sales experience, preferably with a background in selling disruptive technologies into hospitals.

• Specialty Knowledge: Prior experience in Critical Care, Emergency Department, Cath Lab, Neuro, or Point of Care environments preferred.

• Complex Sales Management: Proven ability to manage a complex, hospital-based sales cycle effectively.

• Track Record: Demonstrated success with Return on Investment (ROI), Presidents Club (P-Club), and high sales rankings at current and former employers.

• Hunter Mentality: Demonstrates a hunter mentality with the ability to drive change through multiple stakeholders.

• Emotional Intelligence (EQ): High EQ, unselfish, and can demonstrate prior roles where coaching was received and applied effectively.

• Relationship Builder: Strong ability to build and maintain relationships across various hospital departments and specialties.

jobs.title: Southern California HMIS Opportunities (Los Angeles Area)
jobs.description:
Bitfocus seeks experienced, mission-driven professionals to help administer and operate Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) implementations in Southern California.

Communities can end homelessness. Doing so requires a coordinated system in which homelessness is prevented whenever possible and, when it isn't, is rare, brief, and one-time. A well-run HMIS makes that possible: it's where providers coordinate care and the single source of truth for client data. jobs.description:

Hyperbolic Labs is on a mission to democratize AI by breaking down the barriers to computing power with our Open-Access AI Cloud. By making better use of idle computing resources across the globe, we offer an innovative GPU marketplace and AI inference service that promise affordability and accessibility for all. As pioneers at the intersection of AI and open-source technology, we believe in an open future where AI innovation is limited only by imagination, not by access to resources. We're looking for forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for making AI universally accessible, secure, and affordable. Join us in building a platform that empowers innovators everywhere to turn their visionary AI projects into reality.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're scaling from roughly 30 to 70–100 people over the next 6–12 months, and most of those hires are engineers. As our Technical Recruiter, you'll own full-cycle searches for infrastructure, distributed systems, AI/ML and GPU cloud roles. You'll report to our Head of Talent and partner directly with founders and engineering leaders. This is a hands-on role: you'll spend most of your time sourcing, engaging and closing great technical talent, and you'll help shape the recruiting engine as we build it.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

jobs.title: Technology Support Specialist
jobs.description:
About Norm Ai
Norm Ai, the agentic law company, has a client base with a combined $30 trillion in assets under management.


Norm Ai pioneered Legal Engineering, the process that empowers lawyers to build and supervise domain-specific AI agents with Norm’s proprietary suite of no-code software tools. Norm Ai technology is deployed inside many of the largest and most consequential institutions in the world.


Norm Ai is also the technology behind Norm Law, LLP, a separate but affiliated AI-native law firm built for the era of agentic AI. Norm Law’s attorneys advise leading institutions across private funds, private equity, venture capital, real estate, registered funds, and financial regulation, using the same legal intelligence platform that powers Norm Ai’s products.

AI Fluency:
Norm Ai prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role:

The Technology Support Specialist at Norm Ai is a technical, internal-facing role within Norm Ai’s Core Technology Team. You will be a trusted, hands-on technology partner for Norm Ai employees, including affiliated companies such as the attorneys and staff of Norm Law, an affiliated AI-native law firm. This role will combine in-person technical support, onboarding, training, and customer service. It’s a key part of ensuring that our employees are operationally positioned to best deliver operational value to the company.

This is a white-glove role. You will work directly with partners and senior principals, often under deal pressure, and you will be the person they call by name. You report to the Chief Security Officer and work closely with the Core Technology team and other internal/external stakeholders. Support is your primary function, but the role sits at the intersection of service, training, and technology adoption, at a firm where the technology is the product.

You Will:

 - Deliver desk-side and remote support to Norm employees, across macOS and Windows environments, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams), Slack, iManage, conferencing, mobile devices, peripherals, and more.

 - Help extend support coverage as Norm grows, including colleagues in other offices and time zones.

 - 

Skills & Experience - Core:

 - 3 to 5+ years of end-user or desk-side technology support, including at least 2 years in a law firm or legal/professional services environment (service desk, site support, or applications support).

 - Hands-on experience with iManage Work (cloud preferred) and its Outlook and Word integrations; working knowledge of Litera Compare or a comparable document comparison tool.

 - Experience with device management (Intune and a macOS MDM), SSO and MFA, and basic identity and access administration.

 - Experience designing and delivering end-user training, both in groups and 1:1, and writing clear, concise documentation.

 - Comfortable working in a ticketing system against SLAs; experience with Linear, Jira, ServiceNow, or equivalent tools.

 - Genuine curiosity about AI tools and comfort using them in your own work. You can learn new, internally built applications quickly and teach them to others.

 - Security-minded: you understand confidentiality obligations and follow access and data-handling procedures without shortcuts.

jobs.title: Director of Electrical - Power Distribution
jobs.description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

You will build and lead the Power Distribution engineering organization within Valar Atomics’ Instrumentation, Control & Electrical (IC&E) organization, supporting the gigasite program and the sites that follow it. Your team will span power system planning and studies, substation and transmission design, and protection and relaying. You will work alongside reactor, power conversion, automation and controls, OT, nuclear safety, construction, and customer engineering teams in a hands-on environment where power system design directly determines reactor safety, plant availability, and customer uptime. The team values technical depth, disciplined documentation, and a safety-first culture.

The Role

Valar Atomics is seeking Directors of Electrical - Power Distribution to architect, engineer, and deliver the islanded power systems that carry electricity from hundreds of nuclear units per site to co-located customers. The role owns the electrical system from the generator terminals to the customer meter for microgrids scaling up to 20 GWe. That covers generator step-up transformers, collector and transmission systems, switchyards and substations, protection, and power system stability. There’s no utility grid behind these systems to absorb disturbances, so this role is responsible for making a fleet of reactors and large, dynamic customer loads behave as one stable, reliable power system.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and lead an in-house Power Distribution engineering organization, including hiring, organizational design, technical standards, and development of power systems, substation, transmission, and protection engineers.

• Own the electrical architecture of islanded multi-gigawatt microgrids from generator terminals to customer meter, including voltage levels, topology, redundancy, and expansion strategy as reactor units and customer loads come online in phases.

• Engineer generator step-up transformers, medium-voltage collector systems, HV/EHV switchyards, on-site transmission, and customer-facing substations through conceptual, preliminary, and detailed design.

• Own power system studies, including load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash (IEEE 1584), insulation coordination, harmonics, motor starting, and grounding (IEEE 80).

• Own grid stability for islanded operation, including transient and small-signal stability, frequency and voltage control, EMT studies, load rejection and large load-step response, unit trip and cascading-failure analysis, system restoration, and black start strategy.

• Own protection and relaying philosophy and design for generators, transformers, buses, lines, and feeders, including relay settings, coordination, special protection and load-shedding schemes, and protection testing and commissioning.

• Define and enforce power quality and reliability requirements at the customer interface, including availability targets, ride-through, voltage and frequency tolerances, harmonic limits, and the electrical portions of customer service agreements.

• Work with reactor and nuclear safety engineers on the interface between the microgrid and reactor auxiliary power, including loss-of-power transients, unit trip impacts, and the reliability of power to plant systems that are important to safety.

• Define functional requirements for generator controls, governors, excitation systems, and microgrid control and dispatch, and work with the automation and controls and OT teams that implement them.

• Coordinate with customer engineering teams on load characteristics, demand ramp rates, interconnection points, and phased load growth.

• Set the design basis and electrical equipment standards for repeatable deployment across sites, including standardized substation and switchyard designs that support rapid, serial construction.

• Develop equipment specifications and lead procurement strategy for long-lead power equipment, including large power transformers, HV breakers, GIS/AIS switchgear, and protective relaying; secure manufacturing capacity and manage supply chain risk.

• Support construction, testing, and energization, including commissioning plans, acceptance testing, and staged energization of a growing system.

• Own organizational budget, headcount plan, and engineering tools for the Power Distribution function.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering with a power systems focus.

• 15+ years of power systems engineering experience in utility, generation, transmission, or large industrial power systems, including 7+ years leading engineering teams.

• Deep expertise in power system analysis, including load flow, short circuit, protection coordination, and dynamic stability, with hands-on experience in tools such as ETAP, PSS/E, PSCAD, PowerFactory, or equivalent.

• Experience architecting and delivering HV/EHV substations, switchyards, and transmission or large collector systems from concept through energization.

• Strong command of protection and relaying philosophy, relay settings, and protection system design for generators, transformers, lines, and buses.

• Experience with large generation interconnection, generator controls, and frequency and voltage control behavior.

• Proven ability to build teams from the ground up, hire strong engineers, and deliver on aggressive schedules.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Professional Engineer (PE) license or eligibility.

• Experience designing islanded, weak-grid, or microgrid power systems, including low-inertia and high-load-step stability challenges.

• Experience serving large data center or other large dynamic loads, including power quality and ride-through requirements.

• Experience with EMT modeling of inverter-based resources or large power electronic loads.

• Experience with standardized, repeatable substation designs and serial deployment programs.

• Experience in startup or rapid-growth environments, ideally on the owner or developer side.

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary

• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company

• Comprehensive medical benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite

• Generous PPE stipend

• High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement

• Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders

• The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

Salary

$225,000—$290,000 USD

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT COMPA

Compa is a venture-backed AI startup revolutionizing the future of compensation! We're bringing AI-forward tools and human-centered engineering to make pay competitive and fair, for all. By offering a premier, live compensation data platform that delivers top-tier intelligence to enterprise teams, we enable the world's largest companies to make smart and fair decisions while staying competitive and compliant. In dynamic job markets during the rise of AI, companies need the best data to stay competitive!

Our force-multiplying team is powered by live data and thoughtful design, and our products have earned the trust of the world’s largest companies: NVIDIA, Stripe, DoorDash, OpenAI, Moderna, Workday, Ulta, Target, and more. 

Come build with us!


THE ROLE

As Enablement Lead, you will build the training program that turns every new and tenured seller into a world-class one: faster ramp, stronger skills, and a shared way of selling.

You will own onboarding, ongoing development, and certification, and build the manager capability that makes it stick. You will partner with sales leaders on a training roadmap for a fast-growing, AI-first go-to-market, and keep raising the bar on what good looks like.

Our product is increasingly AI-driven, including our AI agents layer, so this role is central to making sure every seller can explain that value with fluency and conviction as new capabilities ship. Success shows up in ramp time, win rate, pipeline quality, and forecast accuracy.




WHAT YOU’LL DO




ONBOARDING AND NEW-HIRE RAMP

 - Own the onboarding plan from day one through full quota, with clear milestones and certification before a rep carries a full number.

 - Design curriculum that covers market, competition, company, product, value proposition, sales process, methodology, tools, and skills.

 - Deliver through formats that work: online, classroom, peer group, flipped-classroom, and role-play.

 - Help run the annual sales kickoff and mid-year summit as training events, not announcements.


ONGOING SKILLS DEVELOPMENT AND CERTIFICATION

 - Build a continuous training calendar for Sales, Customer Success and Insights teams: discovery, business case and ROI, multi-threading, security and procurement, negotiation, and expansion.

 - Certify sellers on the skills that matter, using role-plays and call-recording reviews as the assessment, not just course completion.

 - Teach account planning for the largest enterprise accounts.

 - Use pipeline review themes and call reviews to decide what to teach next.

 - Leverage AI to deliver ongoing innovation and efficiencies for the organization.


MANAGER AND LEADER DEVELOPMENT

 - Teach front-line managers to coach: deal inspection, call review, and feedback using a shared scorecard.

 - Certify managers on the methodology first, so they can reinforce what reps learn.

 - Turn the forecast and pipeline review cadence into ongoing manager training.


SALES METHODOLOGY

 - Own the sales methodology as the one way the team qualifies, advances, and inspects deals, with a clear "why now" for every opportunity.

 - Build the methodology into stage exit criteria instead of running it as a separate system. Gate stage advancement on the smallest set of elements that matter, and score the rest without blocking.

 - Create an evidence-based deal scorecard for inspection, coaching, and pipeline rollups.


PIPELINE MANAGEMENT AND FORECASTING

 - Teach the pipeline standards: what counts as real pipeline, stage definitions, aging, and CRM hygiene, in partnership with RevOps.

 - Teach managers to forecast from deal evidence instead of rep confidence, with clear category definitions and a roll-up cadence.

 - Track forecast accuracy by rep, manager, and segment, and turn the gaps into coaching and training.


AI PRODUCT FLUENCY

 - Build and own the training strategy for our AI-driven roadmap, so sellers clearly and confidently articulate the value of the AI agents layer.

 - Keep messaging, positioning, and competitive differentiation in training current with Product Marketing and Product as capabilities ship.

 - Champion the use of AI-powered selling tools across the sales org, from call analysis and coaching to prospecting and deal intelligence, and partner with RevOps to ensure they're adopted and delivering measurable results.


PLAYBOOKS AND IN-THE-MOMENT SUPPORT

 - Leveraging AI to build playbooks, battlecards, and objection handling that reinforce what is taught, and keep them in the flow of work (CRM, chat, conversation intelligence).

 - Keep them current and trusted, so a rep finds the answer in seconds, not in a course.


MEASURING WHAT WORKS

 - Measure program effectiveness through new-hire ramp, certification results, skill assessments, participant and leader feedback, and retention.
   
   


WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You report to the Chief Revenue Officer and partner closely with:

 - Sales leaders and front-line managers, who reinforce everything you build.

 - Revenue operations, on stage definitions, CRM hygiene, and forecast tooling.

 - Product marketing, on messaging, battlecards, and launch enablement as new AI capabilities ship.

 - Customer success, on handoffs, expansion plays, and renewal playbooks.

 - Product, security, and legal, on the technical and compliance answers reps need mid-deal.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR




MINIMUM

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

 - 5+ years designing, developing, and delivering sales training, including leading a team or building the function from scratch.

 - Experience running onboarding and certification programs that shortened ramp time.

 - Working knowledge of MEDDPICC or a similar methodology, with a record of embedding it in stage criteria and coaching, not just teaching it.
   
   


AS A PLUS

 - 5+ years in B2B sales, sales leadership, or sales enablement, including software sales.

 - Experience building manager coaching programs and designing forecast and pipeline review processes.

 - Experience building AI tools to accelerate AE performance

 - Ability to build and facilitate online, classroom, peer group, flipped-classroom, and role-play training.

 - Fluency with an LMS, HubSpot or a comparable CRM, and conversation intelligence tools, plus comfort using data to decide what to teach.

 - Experience selling or enabling complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals with security and procurement review.

 - A strong facilitator and coach who earns credibility with senior reps and front-line managers.

 - Clear, concise writing: you can turn a messy deal into a one-page playbook.

 - Sound judgment on what belongs in a program versus what belongs in the flow of work.

Compa offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, PTO and parental leave, equity, company offsites, continuous education, commuter benefits and a flexible work environment.

Jensen Hughes is seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner to join our North America team. Candidates should ideally be based in the Mountain, Central or Eastern time zones and be available to collaborate during the hiring team’s core business hours.

The Talent Acquisition Partner will own the full recruiting process, from translating hiring requirements into targeted sourcing strategies to engaging and qualifying candidates, coordinating interviews, managing candidate communications, supporting offers, and facilitating successful placements.

• Coordinate interviews, manage candidate communications, support offers, and facilitate successful placements while continuing to develop qualified talent pipelines

Collaboration & Stakeholder Partnership

• Comply with applicable recruiting policies, data privacy requirements, and employment regulations

Qualifications

Required

• Experience recruiting and sourcing engineering, architecture, construction, consulting, or other technical professionals

• Demonstrated success identifying, engaging, and qualifying passive candidates for specialized or hard-to-fill positions

• Advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, AI-assisted search techniques, Boolean search, and alternative sourcing methods

• Experience building targeted sourcing strategies and managing candidate pipelines against defined hiring priorities

• Strong written and verbal communication, relationship-building, and candidate engagement skills

• Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced remote environment

• Experience using applicant tracking systems (preferably Greenhouse or similar) and maintaining complete, accurate candidate data

• Analytical approach to measuring sourcing effectiveness and adjusting strategy based on results

Preferred

• Familiarity with fire protection, mechanical, electrical, or related engineering disciplines

• Experience supporting geographically dispersed hiring teams and multiple business priorities

jobs.title: Facility Operator
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

 - Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

   .

jobs.title: Workplace Experience Specialist
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Manager, Financial Operations
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Maravai LifeSciences translates extraordinary science into everyday miracles, helping biotech, biopharma, and life sciences companies everywhere deliver novel vaccines, therapeutics, and diagnostics. We are global leaders in providing products and services within the fields of nucleic acid production and biologics safety testing to many of the world's leading biopharma, vaccine, diagnostics, and cell and gene therapy companies.

At Maravai, we believe that diverse perspectives are the foundation of innovation. Through an inclusive and equitableculture where every team member is inspired to bring their best selves to work, we cultivate an environment in which we can lead together, providing differentiated value to our customers, and enabling the miracles of science. For over 35 years, Maravai’s portfolio companies have served as a catalyst for innovative, lifesaving technology for humanity. Pioneering nucleotide research since its inception, we are now leading the way in the rapidly expanding mRNA market.

Your next role as a Miracle Maker

Maravai LifeSciences is seeking a #MiracleMaker to join our Accounting team as a Manager, Financial Operations. The Manager, Financial Operations oversees day-to-day payroll, accounts payable (AP), and accounts receivable (AR) operations, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial transactions. This role supervises assigned team members, coordinates with service providers, and ensures execution of established procedures and internal controls, including Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements. The Manager partners with Commercial, Operations, Human Resources, Accounting, Finance, Tax, Treasury, and other business stakeholders to resolve operational issues, maintain reliable records, and support month-end close. The position implements tactical process improvements and monitors service levels across payroll, AP, and AR.

How you will make an impact:

• Manages recurring payroll processing for a multi-state workforce of 4500+ employees using ADPa third party payroll HRIS system, including wages, bonuses, deductions, benefits, terminations, and leave-related transactions; supports global payroll coordination.

• Supervises and develops assigned payroll, AP, and AR personnel; allocates daily work, reviews results, provides training, and ensures transaction deadlines and service standards are met.

• Oversees AP processing, including invoice review, coding and approval workflows, vendor inquiries, payment preparation, and reconciliation of payable balances in coordination with Accounting and Treasury.

• Oversees AR activities, including customer set-up and credit checks, invoicing, cash application, aging review, collections follow-up, customer account reconciliations, and timely escalation of past-due or disputed balances.

• Reviews payroll reconciliations, payroll tax filings, W-2 reporting, retirement contributions, and payroll-related reporting; supports AP/AR reconciliations and month-end close deliverables.

• Ensures payroll, AP, and AR activities follow applicable regulations, established company policies, approval authorities, and SOX internal controls; maintains audit-ready documentation and supports audits.

• Resolves escalated employee, vendor, and customer transaction issues; coordinates with Operations, HR, Accounting, Tax, Finance, Treasury, and third-party providers to address discrepancies and operational needs.

• Maintains standard operating procedures, monitors transaction accuracy and timeliness, and implements practical workflow improvements.

• Establishes and monitors Key Performance Indicators across AR, AP, and Payroll operations.

• Works to improve processes through automation and simplification, while maintaining high quality and SOX controls.

• Perform other functions and duties as required.

The skills and experience that you will bring:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Minimum of 8 years of progressively responsible experience in accounting operations.

• Experience supervising or leading transaction-processing teams and coordinating recurring payroll, AP, and AR deadlines.

• Strong working knowledge of multi-state payroll regulations and payroll tax requirements, together with AP/AR transaction controls, reconciliations, and basic accounting principles.

• Experience with payroll and financial systems, invoice and payment workflows, customer receivables, reporting tools, and discrepancy resolution.

• Working knowledge of SOX internal controls, approval procedures, audit support, and month-end close processes.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel; strong analytical and organizational skills.

• Effective communication, discretion with confidential information, and sound operational judgment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in a publicly traded company, international payroll, and shared-services or multi-function finance operations.

• Knowledge of equity compensation, taxable fringe benefits, retirement plans, and benefit deductions.

• Experience with 401(k) audits, Form 5500, vendor payment controls, and AR aging or collections reporting.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $100,000 - $120,000.  In addition, highly competitive long-term incentives in the form of company equity, bonus participation and company sponsored benefits are provided as part of the total compensation package.  The salary offer will depend on multiple factors which may include the successful candidate's skills, experience and other qualifications, as well as the location of the role.

#LI-Onsite

The benefits of being a #MiracleMaker:

• You have the opportunity to be a part owner in Maravai through RSU grants and optional employee stock purchase plans.

• We offer comprehensive medical plans and HSA/FSA options.

• Fertility & family planning assistance.

• A variety of additional optional benefits and insurance options, including pet insurance.

• Retirement contributions.

Benefits may vary by region and employment type and do not apply to temporary employees or contractors. See a comprehensive list of benefits at our Benefits & growth site at https://www.maravai.com/careers/benefits-and-growth/

To view more opportunities to become a #MiracleMaker, visit our career site at  https://www.maravai.com/careers/

Maravai LifeSciences is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation, and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Click here to view Maravai LifeSciences Privacy Notice

HIRING SCAM ALERT

Recently, individuals impersonating Maravai LifeSciences Human Resources members have offered fraudulent interviews and job offers to unsuspecting candidates. To help protect you from these scam artists, please be aware that:

• Maravai LifeSciences will never interview a candidate over RingCentral, similar messaging apps or social media (e.g. Telegram, Google Hangouts, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, etc.)

• Maravai LifeSciences will never send a company check or ask an applicant to pay a fee or purchase at home work/training materials in connection with an application for employment.

• Maravai LifeSciences will never provide excess money to an applicant and ask the applicant to write a check for repayment.

If you have any doubt about a job offer or any other communication purporting to come from Maravai LifeSciences, please reach out to us directly at taops@maravai.com. If you believe you have been a victim of fraud, you can report this activity at: www.iC3.gov or www.stopfraud.gov.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Sr. SOC Physical Verification Engineer (Silicon Engineering)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. SOC PHYSICAL VERIFICATION ENGINEER (SILICON ENGINEERING)

At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.

We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering, ASIC implementation). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation silicon for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. These chips are enabling connectivity in places it has previously not been available, affordable or reliable. Your efforts will help deliver cutting-edge solutions that will expand the performance and capabilities of the Starlink network.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own and execute full-chip DRC, LVS, ESD, PERC and antenna signoff using industry standard tools like Calibre, ICV, or Pegasus

• Develop, maintain, and optimize physical verification flows for advanced node SoC’s.

• Interpret and implement foundry Design Rule Manuals (DRM) — translate rule updates into verified flow changes

• Debug and resolve complex DRC/LVS violations across hierarchical full-chip designs

• Perform ESD verification — validate protection strategies, current paths, and CDM/HBM compliance

• Drive tapeout readiness by coordinating signoff across block and top-level and Hard IP design teams

• Engage directly with foundry teams to resolve DRM ambiguities and waiver requests.

• Develop/modify design flows as needed to meet the overall design quality of results and chip integration requirements.Leverage AI agents to automate rule deck validation, violation triage, and signoff reporting workflows

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or computer science

• 5+ years of ASIC and/or physical design flow development experience in industry

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience and deep understanding of SOC top level physical design flows (floor-planning, I/O, bump & RDL planning, hard IP integration, partitioning, power/ground grid generation, pin assignment, DFT, partition hardening, special clock handling, feedthrough flows, special interface/interconnect planning and implementation)

• Experience in IP integration (e.g. memories, I/O’s, analog IPs, SerDes, DDR etc.)

• Deep expertise in DRC, LVS, PERC and ESD verification methodologies

• Hands-on proficiency with Calibre, ICV (IC Validator), or Pegasus

• Direct foundry DRM experience — able to read, interpret, and implement complex rule decks

• Experience at advanced nodes (4nm and below)

• Experience with large SOC designs (>10M gates) with frequencies in excess of 1GHZ

• Excellent scripting skills (csh/bash, Perl, Python TCL, Makefile etc.)

• Self-driven individual with a can-do attitude, and an ability to work in a dynamic group environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed to meet critical project milestones

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay range:
Physical Design Engineer/Senior: $175,000.00 - $280,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation & will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Exempt employees are eligible for 5 days of sick leave per year.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.location: Hybrid/San Francisco, CA & Palo Alto, CA
jobs.description:
Mavericks Wanted

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on

In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.

Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.

What You'll Do

We are building the operational and compliance backbone of our pricing and contracting function ahead of significant portfolio growth. We support a competitive in-market brand alongside a rare disease pipeline moving into launch, and each product entering the market brings a defined set of statutory obligations, government program enrollments and contract operations requirements — on external deadlines that do not move.

This is a new role, created to own that work end to end.

You will lead two managers covering commercial contract operations and government programs, hold accountability for government price reporting and state price transparency, own the policies and systems that govern this work, and manage the vendors who deliver calculation and processing. You will be the person who ensures a shifting launch date does not become a missed filing.

This is a hands-on leadership role in a lean function. You will build process as well as run it.

What you will own

Government pricing and price reporting

• Accountability for government price calculations and submissions across federal programs, including AMP, Best Price, Unit Rebate Amount, 340B ceiling price, non-FAMP, and ASP where applicable

• Class of trade review and assignment, and the eligibility determinations that flow from it

• Methodology approval, output validation and submission accuracy, with calculation performed by vendors under your oversight

• Government Price Impact Analysis supporting pricing and contracting decisions

• State price transparency reporting: new product introduction filings, advance notice requirements and annual reports across applicable jurisdictions

• Ownership of the reporting compliance calendar

Government programs

• Medicaid Drug Rebate Program administration, including state and managed care organization rebate operations, claims research, dispute resolution and reconciliation

• State Medicaid supplemental rebate agreements

• Medicare Part D Manufacturer Discount Program, TRICARE, and federal contract administration including FSS and VA/DoD

• Government program enrollment, NDC addition and contract addenda for each new product

Commercial contract operations

• Commercial and Medicare payer contract administration: contract set-up, membership and eligibility management, claims validation, formulary validation, chargeback and administrative fee processing

• Commercial rebate operations, including verification that contracted performance was delivered before rebates are paid

• Contract data stewardship and integrity across the contract management system, vendor feeds and financial systems

• Service to trading partners and payers on contract operations enquiries

Policy, compliance and audit

• Ownership of policies and standard operating procedures governing government pricing, price reporting and contract operations

• Audit readiness and support for internal audits and external customer audits

• Monitoring the evolving federal and state regulatory landscape, and driving operational readiness for new mandates ahead of effective dates

• Partnership with Legal and Compliance on reporting obligations and risk assessment

Financial reporting and systems

• Support for gross-to-net reporting, accruals, projections and budget inputs in partnership with Finance and with Pricing & Contracting Analytics

• Implementation and optimization of systems and processes to make contracting operations scalable, accurate and auditable

• Vendor management for government price calculation and rebate processing, including methodology sign-off, output validation, dispute resolution and service level performance

Launch operational readiness

• A tracked operational plan for each product entering the market, covering government program enrollment, federal contract addenda, state filings, contract system configuration and reporting set-up

Where You'll Work

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration 3x per week in our San Francisco Office.

Who You Are

Required

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred

• 8+ years in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with at least 5 in government pricing, contract operations or revenue management

• Working ownership of government price reporting — you have run or overseen AMP, Best Price and Unit Rebate Amount calculation and submission, and you understand where methodology decisions carry risk

• Medicaid Drug Rebate Program experience, including state rebate operations, claims research and dispute resolution

• Familiarity with state price transparency reporting requirements and their variation by jurisdiction

• Experience managing outsourced calculation or processing vendors, including holding them to methodology and accuracy

• Demonstrated people leadership — you have managed and developed staff

• Auditable accuracy and comfort with work that carries compliance consequence

Preferred

• Product launch experience, including government program enrollment and new product reporting obligations

• Rare disease, orphan or specialty portfolio experience, particularly limited distribution or specialty-pharmacy-only channels

• Experience with contract management and government pricing platforms, and with system implementation or migration

• Federal contracting experience — FSS, VA, DoD, TRICARE

• Experience building or restructuring an operations function rather than inheriting a mature one

• Experience supporting gross-to-net forecasting and accrual processes

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant - Oceanside, CA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the best experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

At VEG, we don’t just hire assistants—we grow future emergency rockstars. As an Emergency Veterinary Assistant, you’ll be in the heart of the action from day one, supporting your team, comforting pet parents, and learning the ropes in real time. You’ll be there for everything—the triage, the treatments, and the tail wags. You’re embarking on a path where careers start, grow, and thrive. Whether you’re on your way to becoming a credentialed technician or exploring where your passion can take you, we’ll say yes to your growth every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO*

• Be the first warm welcome and a steady support, triaging incoming patients and helping guide them toward care

• Assist with treatments, nursing care, and diagnostics, from bloodwork and imaging to catheter placement and oxygen support

• Work alongside our credentialed veterinary technicians and veterinarians to set up and monitor anesthesia and sedation cases

• Set up and manage IV fluids, blood transfusions, and medication administration

• Assist during every moment of care: outpatient or inpatient, exam room to treatment area

• Join patient rounds and stay close to the clinical picture to ensure continuity of care

• Learn how to perform CPR and become a RECOVER Certified Rescuer (training provided!)

• Grow into more advanced responsibilities, such as anesthesia support, ultrasound, and catheterization through guided training pathways

*As permitted by state law

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Enrolled in an AVMA-accredited veterinary technology program a plus

• 1+ years in a veterinary assistant role (emergency or specialty experience is a bonus!)

• Basic computer skills and an understanding of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital demands

• Ability to work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation: pay range is $20-$49 and based on a leveling system and experience, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, QPR training, and access to free therapy or counseling

• Depending on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave; up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.description:
About the Company

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. About the Job

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

That includes compute hardware, rack-level components, and supporting facility infrastructure. In this role, you will partner directly with engineers, program managers, and technical directors to define supply chain strategy, the supply chain roadmap for compute, and secure supply.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Responsibilities

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:
