jobs.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Performance Engineer
jobs.description:
XPENG is a leading smart technology company at the forefront of innovation, integrating advanced AI and autonomous driving technologies into its vehicles, including electric vehicles (EVs), electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, and robotics. With a strong focus on intelligent mobility, XPENG is dedicated to reshaping the future of transportation through cutting-edge R&D in AI, machine learning, and smart connectivity.

The Mission: We are building the next generation of end-to-end autonomous driving on physical AI foundation models — vision-language-action policies and world models — and the same training stack carries our robotics program. These training runs span thousands of accelerators and days of wall-clock — how fast we train them is how fast we learn. As a Senior Staff Machine Learning Performance Engineer, you will own that speed: working with the modeling teams on their hardest bottlenecks, setting the technical direction for performance, and turning one-off wins into defaults — including the agentic workflows that find the next round of them automatically.

Job Responsibilities:

• Training Performance at Scale: Own step time, scaling efficiency and long-run stability for foundation-model training across thousands of accelerators — from the data path to kernels, parallelism and communication.

• Cross-Team Technical Leadership: Work directly with the modeling, infrastructure, simulation, data-mining and robotics teams on their hardest bottlenecks, and set the performance direction those teams build against.

• Reusable by Design: Turn one-off wins into modular components that become defaults across most models and workloads, rather than a patch that helps a single job.

• Observability at Scale: Extend performance tooling and metric coverage across the stack, while keeping instrumentation overhead low enough to stay on for production jobs fleet-wide.

• Agentic Automation: Build agents that reproduce any job on demand, verify numerical parity and separate a real regression from run-to-run noise — so that most of the optimizations that land are found and fixed by AI rather than by hand.

Minimum Skill Requirements:

• Master's or PhD in CS, CE or EE, or equivalent practical experience, with 8+ years of industry experience, the majority of it in performance engineering.

• Hands-on experience optimizing GPU training or inference workloads in production, at multi-node scale.

• A track record of diagnosing performance problems in real production workloads and landing the fixes — often in systems owned by other teams — with the gain measured and verified in production.

• In-depth understanding of computer architecture and high-performance computing.

• Strong C++ and Python, with a solid command of data structures and algorithms.

Preferred Skill Requirements:

• Hands-on experience writing and tuning CUDA or Triton kernels.

• Fluent in PyTorch, with concrete insight into what makes PyTorch code fast or slow — graph breaks, host-side overhead, synchronization points and memory layout.

• Training at the scale of thousands of accelerators, including multi-node failure modes and long-running job stability.

• Building profiling, tracing or benchmarking infrastructure that other teams depend on — CUPTI, Perfetto, or equivalent.

• Using LLM agents to automate parts of an engineering workflow.

• Autonomous driving, robotics, or another domain with hard latency, power and memory constraints.

• Publications or open-source contributions in ML systems or performance.

What do we provide:

• A fun, supportive and engaging environment.

• Infrastructures and computational resources to support your work.

• Opportunity to work on cutting edge technologies with the top talents in the field.

• Opportunity to make a significant impact on the transportation revolution by the means of advancing autonomous driving.

• Competitive compensation package.

• Snacks, lunches, dinners, and fun activities.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $244,140, - $413,160, in addition to bonus, equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status or marital status or any other prescribed category set forth in federal or state regulations.

For more information about how we protect your information, we encourage you to review our Privacy Policy.

Our revolutionary QCT molecular counting technology enhances disease detection resolution by over a thousandfold using cell-free DNA,a breakthrough that has already transformed the lives of over half a million patients worldwide.

Our Impact

Unity Complete™ is the only non-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.
Unity Confirm™ enables non-invasive confirmation for high-risk screening results through the capture of intact circulating fetal cells using BillionToOne’s Fetal Cell Capture™ Technology.

Our Growth

From $0 to $400M+ annualized revenue run-rate in just 6 years. In 2025, we completed one of the most successful IPOs for a medical diagnostics company, building on nearly $400M in private funding,including our $130M Series D in 2024 and backed by world-class investors including Hummingbird, Adams Street Partners, Neuberger Berman, Baillie Gifford, and Premji Invest.

Our Recognition

jobs.title: Automation & Controls Engineer (Facilities)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

AUTOMATION & CONTROLS ENGINEER (FACILITIES)

As a member of the critical infrastructure team, you will design, build, and activate some of the world’s most technically advanced manufacturing facilities. As an automation & controls engineer, you will develop and build a great variety of automated solutions to aid in rapid R&D, production and critical asset management. The automation & control team designs, builds, and commissions complete control systems from the ground up. We are looking for talent with an amazing track record in developing, troubleshooting, and maintaining control systems for production and critical infrastructure. This position is based in Hawthorne, CA.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Participate in initial equipment conceptual development and carefully balance product specifications, process requirements, layout complexity, cost, and lead-time limits

• Lay out new industrial electrical control panels which are NFPA79/NEC/UL508A compliant, and create electrical, pneumatic and fluid schematics

• Simulate processes to inform design engineers of the conceptual viability of automation proposals (tools include ABB Robotstudio, Kuka Sim, and Siemens Process Simulate)

• Architect, write, and debug PLC code with an emphasis on generating code that is organized, structured, documented, maintainable, and reusable for manufacturing applications

• Generate aesthetically simple screens for complex machinery while providing sufficient feedback for troubleshooting

• Manage electrical cabinet builds, field wiring, pneumatic, and fluid plumbing

• Select and size electrical and electromechanical components such as servo motors and controllers

• Deploy automated processes and equipment into production

• Set, implement, and maintain schedules and budgets to ensure project completion

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline

• 1+ years of professional experience in the design and commissioning of automation and controls systems for industrial applications

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Knowledge in building automation systems for critical infrastructure

• Mechanical (HVAC) controls and wiring, Delta controls

• Process integration and electromechanical/mechatronic systems experience

• Electrical schematic CAD experience using EPlan

• C#, .NET, python and/or SQL experience

• PLC programming experience, preferably Siemens TIA Portal and Beckhoff TwinCat 3

• HMI and SCADA programming experience

• Field bus networks, serial communication and Ethernet communication

• Hands-on experience building and commissioning high quality electrical control panels and electro-mechanical systems

• Knowledge of NEC, NFPA 79, UL508A codes

• Exposure to a wide variety of production machinery, industrial sensors, and equipment (vision systems, dispense systems, temperature controllers, laser distance sensors & Nut-Runners, etc.)

• Excellent communication skills both written and verbal

• Experience in fast-paced iterative design and manufacturing environments

• Experience solving complex problems with little to no supervision on schedule as an individual or as a member of an integrated team

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed

• Must be willing to travel to other locations

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $160,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Developer Solutions Strategist
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX

About Cloudflare

At Cloudflare, our mission is bold yet simple: to help build a better Internet. Our global network handles trillions of requests each month, protecting and accelerating applications without added hardware, software, or code changes. Our Developer Platform, including Workers, Workers AI, R2, KV, Durable Objects, and Pages, empowers developers to build and deploy applications globally, faster than ever before.

About the Team

The Developer GTM organization is driving how we attract, inspire, and grow the next generation of builders. We are redefining what developer acquisition looks like in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to create new pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare, whether through ecosystem partnerships, high impact content, or creative field engagement.

We are builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the most exciting place for developers to build.

The Developer Solution Strategist (DSS) organization sits inside Developer GTM and partners tightly with Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, and DevRel. DSS connects developer activation to durable commercial outcomes: shaping usage into clear proposals, aligning pricing and packaging, enabling the field with repeatable plays, and feeding real-world signal back into product and go-to-market.

About the Role

We are hiring a Sr. Director, Developer Solution Strategists to lead an elite team of Solution Strategists aligned to their sales regions. You will set the global DSS strategy, standardize operating rhythms, and ensure consistent execution on activation → expansion → commercial structure.

This leader is equally fluent in developer workloads and commercial mechanics, can operate from strategy to hands-on deal guidance, and is energized by building a high-trust partnership with field leadership worldwide.

What You Will Do

• Own the global DSS strategy and operating model. Define goals, scorecards, and cadences for regional teams (usage activation, expansion, proposal velocity, win rate, disciplined discounting, sourced/influenced pipeline).

• Build and lead a high-performing, distributed org. Hire, develop, and coach Solution Strategists.

• Drive activation → expansion for priority workloads. Ensure teams use usage telemetry to identify “next-best actions,” expansion paths, and strategic accounts; publish a weekly global “usage radar.”

• Standardize commercial design. Maintain global proposal templates, commercial frameworks, and ROI/TCO narratives. Pricing and non-standard terms remain with Finance/Legal; DSS designs and shepherds.

• Run pipeline and deal reviews. Establish a global rhythm for opportunity triage, strategic deal reviews, and win/loss analysis; surface systemic blockers and drive resolution with Sales, Deal Desk, Security, and Legal.

• Enable the field at scale. Ship workload blueprints, playbooks, calculators, objection handling, and talk tracks; run monthly regional enablement with Sales leadership and measure adoption and lift.

• Align with Solution Architects and FDEs. Closely partner with your technical counterparts to run GTM motions in lock step with identified product-market fit.

• Close the loop with Product. Translate field insights into clear, quantified recommendations on positioning, packaging, limits, and roadmap; track impact ($) of changes.

• Partner with Programs. Support startups/accelerators and targeted campaigns with BDR/Marketing, with drive toward helping regions become increasingly self-sufficient.

• Forecasting & planning. Own DSS headcount planning, coverage models by segment/geo, and quarterly objectives; partner with RevOps for attribution and instrumentation.

• Culture & quality. Raise the bar on writing, narrative clarity, and executive communication; model Cloudflare’s values in every region.

Who You Are

• 10+ years in developer platforms, pre-sales/solutions, deal strategy, or commercial architecture; 4+ years leading managers across multiple regions/time zones.

• Proven ability to translate technical workloads into compelling commercial outcomes and navigate complex approvals with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Security.

• Builder’s mindset with strong operational chops: you design operating models, write crisp narratives, and drive cross-functional execution.

• Data-driven and fluent in product usage telemetry; comfortable with Sheets/SQL-level analysis to size opportunities and measure impact.

• Exceptional communicator—clear writer and presenter—from developer ICs to executive sponsors.

• Experience enabling large field organizations with playbooks, training, and tooling; passion for coaching managers and building bench strength

• Background in usage-based/consumption pricing and commit structures

• Experience with startup programs or digital-native segments

• Bonus points for former startup founders and builders of overlay programs focused on developer GTM

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

ABOUT OBSERVABLE SPACE

At Observable Space, we're redefining how humanity observes and connects with the universe. We're a vertically integrated, high-growth, space technology company building industry-leading precision optics platforms for Earth and in space. Our systems are trusted by thousands of customers, including NASA, JPL, SpaceX, Boeing, RTX, the US Space Force and the U.S. Department of War, leading research institutions and international partners.

We combine precision opto-mechanical hardware, embedded compute, cloud orchestration, and developer-friendly APIs into world class products at scale with in-house manufacturing. From advanced ground stations, on-orbit sensor suites, free space optical lasercom, to distributed compute platforms, we deliver the foundational systems enabling continuous, real-time navigation, observation, and communication in space.

Observable Space is backed by top-tier institutional investors including Lux Capital, Upfront Ventures, RTX Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners and Embedded Ventures. To learn more, visit observable.space http://observable.space.






ABOUT THE ROLE

Observable Space is seeking an experienced CNC Machinist / Programmer / Setup Specialist to join our advanced prototyping facility in Los Angeles. This is a hands-on role focused on programming, setting up, and operating CNC equipment to manufacture complex, high-precision components for advanced optical, aerospace, and mechanical systems.

Our facility supports rapid prototyping and low-volume manufacturing of challenging components using materials such as aluminum, titanium, stainless steel, specialty alloys, and glass. We are looking for a versatile machinist who can independently take a part from engineering drawing or CAD model through CAM programming, machine setup, machining, and final inspection.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical machining expertise with practical problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach to working with engineers. You will play an important role in improving manufacturability, developing machining processes, and supporting the transition of prototype designs into production.

This position offers a flexible work environment, with occasional evening or weekend availability required to support time-sensitive projects.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

CNC Programming, Setup & Machining

 - Program, set up, and operate multi-axis CNC milling machines, including 3-axis, 4-axis, and 5-axis equipment, as well as CNC lathes with live tooling.

 - Develop, modify, and optimize CNC programs using Mastercam, Fusion 360, or comparable CAM software.

 - Independently perform machine setups, including tooling selection, work offsets, fixture installation, tool probing, and program verification.

 - Interpret CAD models, engineering drawings, and GD&T requirements to manufacture precision components to specification.

 - Select appropriate cutting tools, machining strategies, speeds, and feeds based on material properties, part geometry, and tolerance requirements.

 - Perform first-article and in-process inspections using precision measuring instruments to ensure dimensional accuracy and quality.

 - Troubleshoot machining issues, optimize cycle times, and improve part quality and repeatability.

Prototyping & Manufacturing Development

 - Collaborate directly with mechanical, optical, and manufacturing engineers to evaluate designs and recommend improvements for manufacturability.

 - Develop machining strategies for complex geometries, tight-tolerance components, and challenging materials.

 - Design and fabricate custom fixtures, workholding solutions, jigs, and tooling for prototype and low-volume production.

 - Support rapid design iterations, engineering changes, and one-off component fabrication.

 - Contribute to the development and documentation of machining processes that can be transferred to our Michigan manufacturing facility.

 - Support additional fabrication processes, including wire EDM, waterjet cutting, laser cutting, and additive manufacturing, as needed.

Equipment, Quality & Shop Operations

 - Perform routine machine maintenance, troubleshooting, calibration, and equipment optimization.

 - Maintain accurate documentation of CNC programs, tooling, setups, machining parameters, and inspection results.

 - Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on machining efficiency, precision, safety, and process reliability.

 - Maintain an organized, safe, and efficient prototyping environment.

 - Occasionally assist with mechanical assembly, integration, and test fixture development.




BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years of hands-on CNC machining experience, including programming, machine setup, and operation in a precision machine shop or engineering prototyping environment.

 - Demonstrated ability to independently program, set up, and machine complex parts from CAD models and engineering drawings.

 - Proficiency with CAM software such as Mastercam, Fusion 360, or equivalent.

 - Strong experience with CNC milling, including multi-axis machining, tooling selection, work offsets, and workholding.

 - Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), and machining specifications.

 - Proficiency with precision inspection tools, including micrometers, calipers, height gauges, dial indicators, and other dimensional measuring equipment.

 - Working knowledge of CAD software such as SolidWorks or equivalent.

 - Experience machining aluminum, stainless steel, titanium, engineering plastics, and other common manufacturing materials.

 - Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to identify and resolve machining, tooling, and setup issues independently.

 - Ability to work closely with engineers in a fast-paced, iterative prototyping environment.

 - Willingness to occasionally support time-sensitive projects outside standard business hours.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Advanced experience with 5-axis CNC milling and CNC turning with live tooling.

 - Experience programming and machining complex, high-precision components with tight geometric tolerances.

 - Experience manufacturing components for aerospace, space systems, robotics, optics, or other precision hardware applications.

 - Strong knowledge of custom fixturing, workholding strategies, and machining process optimization.

 - Experience with prototype and low-volume, high-mix manufacturing environments.

 - Familiarity with wire EDM, waterjet cutting, laser cutting, and additive manufacturing.

 - Experience with precision metrology, CMM inspection, and first-article inspection processes.

 - Experience machining specialty alloys, difficult-to-machine materials, or components requiring specialized handling.

 - Familiarity with vacuum-compatible materials, machining practices, and cleanliness requirements.

 - Experience with general fabrication processes, including TIG welding, sheet metal fabrication, and mechanical assembly.

 - Ability to support basic finishing processes, including deburring, surface preparation, and spray finishing.

 - Experience developing machining procedures and transitioning prototype processes into repeatable production workflows.

 


WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Compensation – A salary package aligned with industry standards and your experience.

Equity Opportunities – Take part in our success with stock options.

Flexible Work Environment – Enjoy working from our office or in a hybrid work setup with the flexibility to work remotely part of the week. We require a minimum of 3 days per week in our office to support collaboration and team culture. (LA Office only)

Unlimited PTO (exempt only) – Take the time you need with our flexible, trust-based vacation policy, including paid holidays. We encourage everyone to rest, recharge, and take care of themselves.

Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% of the premium paid by the employer for employees.

Cutting-Edge Tools – Get access to the latest hardware and software you need to do your best work.

Mission-Driven Culture – Be part of a team working on meaningful challenges with real-world impact.

Inclusive Team – We foster a supportive and diverse workplace where all voices are valued.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Storage Systems (Agent Infra)
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

Storage decides how fast agent sandboxes start and how safely they share data. Agents need a filesystem that thousands of sandboxes mount at the same time, with strict isolation and the consistency agents need. Agent context is mostly small files, so the access patterns look very different from storage built for large files.

The Agent Infra team builds Agent Drive, the distributed filesystem that agent sandboxes mount over FUSE, and the storage underneath it. The work uses tiered caching, replication, content-addressed data, and Linux filesystem internals. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose sandboxes and Agent Drive filesystem are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes.

We are building a cloud, not just using one, so storage is designed for many tenants from day one. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs.

If you care about page cache coherency, FUSE, replication protocols, and content-addressable storage, we'd love to talk.



EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

 - Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/

 - Baseten Sandboxes documentation https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and implement core Agent Drive features: metadata replication, volume placement, garbage collection, and FUSE client behavior

 - Solve multi-attach correctness: cache coherency across many FUSE mounts of the same drive, dentry and inode invalidation, write ordering, and crash consistency

 - Optimize tail latency on read and write paths, including page cache strategy, writeback, prefetch, and metadata RPC batching

 - Build tenant isolation into the storage layer, including quota enforcement, blast-radius containment, and noisy-neighbor mitigation

 - Own the storage side of sandbox startup and resume performance

 - Build durable block storage for sandboxes alongside other Baseten storage teams

 - Build observability into every layer, drive storage incidents end to end, and turn each one into a permanent fix

 - Contribute upstream to the open-source storage projects we build on



REQUIREMENTS

 - Strong systems programming background in Go, Rust, and/or C/C++, with comfort reading kernel code

 - Deep understanding of Linux filesystem and storage internals: VFS, page cache, dentry and inode caches, FUSE, the block I/O stack, fsync semantics, and crash consistency

 - Hands-on experience building distributed storage systems, content-addressable storage, or large-scale caching infrastructure

 - Experience profiling I/O, memory, and RPC bottlenecks and optimizing tail latency in production

 - Ability to debug correctness bugs that only show up under concurrency or partial failure

 - You move fast and like owning a problem end to end on a small team



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with a distributed filesystem or object store such as JuiceFS, CephFS, or S3-compatible storage, or contributions to those projects

 - Knowledge of consensus and replication protocols (Raft, leader leases, quorum reads)

 - Experience with snapshot, clone, and copy-on-write filesystem features

 - Experience operating multi-tenant storage with hard isolation requirements

 - Familiarity with Linux performance tooling such as eBPF, io_uring, perf, ftrace, and blktrace



BENEFITS

jobs.title: Engineering Job
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TEAM BRINGING AUTONOMY TO THE BUILT WORLD


At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver them more predictably.

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the West, South, and Midwest.

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an exceptional Technical Artist to join our team building and scaling our robotics simulation environment. Simulation is a critical foundation for autonomy at Bedrock—it allows us to validate end-to-end systems, evaluate complex and unsafe scenarios, and run testing at massive scale.

Our autonomy stack is deeply machine-learning–driven, and closing the sim-to-real gap is a core focus of this role. The simulator must accurately represent a living, breathing construction site - real-world lighting, 3D content, and terrain deformation for digging and earthmoving - while remaining efficient enough to support thousands of runs. High-quality simulation directly accelerates robotics development, making this work central to our success.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the 3D content generation and curation pipeline for an autonomous construction simulator

 - Develop simulation systems that support ML-based autonomy, evaluation, and safety validation

 - Improve realism and performance to better reflect real-world behavior

 - Help guide our strategy in procedural scene generation and rendering techniques


WHO YOU ARE

Simulation spans many disciplines, and we don’t expect one person to do everything. Strong candidates typically bring:

 - A passion for large-scale, realistic simulation systems

 - Experience with advanced 3D simulation software

 - A hands-on mindset and enthusiasm for building core simulation content


QUALIFICATIONS

Required

 - Games or simulation background with minimum 4yrs working in real time 3D

 - Strong foundation in technical art: 3D modeling, texturing, rigging, animation, PBR materials, lighting, performance optimization

 - Hands-on experience with Unreal Engine, minimum 2yrs

Preferred

 - Robotics simulation experience

 - Experience with Isaac Sim or Omniverse

 - Experience with neural rendering techniques (Gaussian splats, NeRFs)

Bedrock Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
Since 2017, Flourish has been on a mission to help financial advisors evolve from holistic advice to holistic implementation to better serve their clients and grow their businesses. We focus on independent Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs), delivering financial products that advisors can’t easily access today through beautiful, scalable, and easy-to-use technology.

Today, we work with over 1,100 RIAs that collectively represent more than $2.6T in assets under management across two products: Flourish Cash and Flourish Lending. Headquartered in New York City, we are an independently-operating, wholly-owned subsidiary of MassMutual Life Insurance Company.

Read on if you are interested in joining a dynamic, highly-collaborative, rapidly-growing startup—backed by the support and stability of a Fortune 500 company.

About You

You are a highly strategic, data-driven, detail-oriented, and exceptionally organized accounting leader who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You anticipate needs, identify risks, and drive initiatives forward with minimal guidance. You bring financial discipline and clarity to operational execution and ensure the integrity of financial data across the organization.

You communicate effectively with cross-functional peers, auditors, and external stakeholders, and you know how to prioritize what truly warrants leadership attention. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day work and are always looking for ways to automate and streamline accounting processes. You are excited to join Flourish at a pivotal stage, and are motivated by the prospect of building a scalable accounting function.

About the Role

Flourish is transitioning to a standalone, PE-backed organization. This is a hands-on, execution-focused Controller role to lead accounting operations and ensure financial integrity during a critical stage of growth and product evolution.

As the Controller, you will report directly to the CFO and oversee accounting, financial reporting, broker-dealer regulatory reporting, audit, tax, and compliance, while strengthening financial operations and supporting scalable growth. You’ll manage a Staff Accountant and work closely with the Financial Planning and Analysis Manager, who also reports to the CFO.

Principal Responsibilities

• Lead comprehensive accounting operations, including close, reporting, controls, and GAAP financial statement preparation

• Own regulatory financial reporting for Flourish Financial LLC (our FINRA-member broker-dealer) and other regulated entities, including net capital computations, FOCUS filings, annual audited financial statements, and other SEC/FINRA requirements, either directly as FINOP or by managing outsourced FINOP and compliance partners

• Manage audit readiness and the external auditor relationship

• Oversee implementation of new accounting standards

• Own KPI integrity of financial reporting and underlying accounting data

• Manage cash flow visibility and working capital reporting

• Manage the third-party tax service provider and all compliance filings across jurisdictions

• Partner with the Financial Planning and Analysis Manager to ensure budget, forecasts, and management reporting tie to the accounting records, and with the CEO, CRO, and leadership on reporting alignment

• Identify, quantify, and communicate business risks and opportunities, considering financial, compliance, and operational risk

• Lead projects with accounting and reporting requirements from planning through implementation

• Support carve-out efforts, TSA exit, and standalone readiness

• Drive operational efficiency by building scalable accounting infrastructure and tooling as needed (coordinating with third-party implementation firms) and automating and streamlining the close, reconciliations, reporting, and other workflows

• Hire, lead, and develop a Staff Accountant, and scale the accounting team as the business grows

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, and a professional accounting qualification

• FINRA Series 27 (FINOP) license, or direct experience in a business that owns a broker-dealer (or similarly regulated entity), including working with outsourced partners (e.g., FINOP, compliance) to meet regulatory requirements

• 10+ years of accounting experience in a financial services or fintech environment strongly preferred

• 3+ years of management experience motivating and directing a team of professional staff, including remote teams

• Advanced knowledge of SEC regulations and GAAP, with experience preparing and reviewing external financial statements (including FOCUS or XBRL reporting)

• Due to the nature of this position, as part of the background check process, candidates must be able to pass a fingerprint background check to qualify as a fingerprinted person under FINRA. For roles requiring registration, additional regulatory screenings may apply, including a review of Form U5 disclosures and other relevant licensing information.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master of Accounting degree and CPA

• Experience working in a PE environment

• Demonstrated use of AI tools (e.g., LLMs and AI-enabled ERP, close and reconciliation tools) to automate processes and improve efficiency

• Independent and self-motivated, yet collaborative

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize and multitask; proactive, detail-oriented, and results-oriented

• Excellent critical thinking skills, using logic and reasoning to identify alternative solutions

• Ability to make accurate, independent decisions based on data

• Confident and positive executive presence and interpersonal skills

• Ability to understand the financial impact of decisions and balance them with business partner satisfaction

At Flourish, we focus on ensuring fair, equitable pay by providing competitive salaries, along with bonus and incentive opportunities and benefits for all employees.

Base Salary Range: $170,000 - $250,000 plus bonus

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. jobs.title: Senior Robotics Automation and Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Factory Automation and Controls Engineering team sits at the intersection of design, manufacturing, and automation. We're a small team of hands-on engineers exploring the edge of what's possible, turning raw ideas into technologies that could reshape the future of aerospace and beyond. We build everything from deployable sensor packages to large-scale automated robotic systems that directly enable production of Terran R. As a design group embedded in the Tooling organization, we work closely with our internal partners to understand their root problems, propose solutions, and deliver hardware that helps Relativity build faster, scale smarter, and work better.

We're at the forefront of Relativity's growing factory automation efforts, which are increasingly critical to scaling Terran R production at our current and future facilities. You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, field solutions, and see your work in action on the factory floor. We're not just designing tools and automated processes. We're defining how our rockets get built.

About the Role:

As a Robotics Automation & Controls Engineer, you'll help lead the technical direction of a growing team that's expanding automation across our manufacturing organization. Your projects will touch every corner of the factory, from improving the robotic systems already running in production to designing and building permanent infrastructure from the ground up. You'll partner with mechanical, manufacturing, and design engineers to create solutions tailored to a wide range of applications and processes.

Projects you might work on include:

• Designing and implementing robotic systems for welding, fabrication, material handling, and component inspection.

• Supporting existing robotic systems through production simulation, offline programming, and deployment

• Architecting factory automation solutions that improve speed, quality, reliability, and efficiency across our manufacturing processes

About You:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field

• 5+ years’ experience with programming Fanuc, Kuka, ABB or similar robotics control systems with motion planning, task allocation, and synchronization algorithms for multi-robot systems

• Demonstrated ability to design and implement industrial safety systems including risk assessments, job hazard analysis, and programming safety PLCs

• Demonstrated ability to identify and mitigate technical risks in complex systems

• Experience producing exceptional electrical and pneumatics schematics and work instructions

Nice to haves but not required:

• Working with factory SCADA and analytic software, such as Inductive Ignition or Grafana, to bring factory telemetry to your fingertips.

• Experience in writing PLC code; developing, activating, and troubleshooting PLCs (preferably Beckhoff, but Siemens and AB Rockwell is ok)

• Working with factory SCADA systems, such as Inductive Ignition, to bring factory telemetry to your fingertips.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Solace is hiring a Performance Creative Video Producer to own direct-response video for our YouTube, CTV, and Meta campaigns. Paid media is an eight-figure monthly program for us, and video is the one of biggest levers we have in it.

You’ll be cutting everything from six-second bumpers to 30-second spots to longer narrative ads, depending on what the channel and the test call for. You’ll sit in a channel pod with a creative strategist and a media buyer and look at the same performance data they do.

The goal is ads that lower CPA, not ads that look nice.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Creative concepts. Develop the angles, narratives, and visual approaches we test in video. Translate audience insight and performance data into original concepts, and help decide which ones are worth producing.

 - Creative direction. Set the look, pacing, tone, and voice of Solace video across channels. Establish how our ads feel on YouTube pre-roll versus a CTV spot versus a Meta placement, and build a visual language we can extend.

 - Key creative decisions. Own the hook, the retention beats, the proof, and the CTA on every ad. When data shows a drop-off, diagnose the cause and decide how to fix it.

 - Production volume. Own the production pipeline for a weekly slate of finished direct-response videos across YouTube, CTV, and Meta. This includes cutdowns and variants, each built to the right length, aspect ratio, and specs for its placement.

 - Generating assets. Use AI video, image, voice, and avatar tools to create scenes, presenters, product demos, b-roll, and transitions when we don’t have the footage.

 - Variants. Take a concept that’s working and spin it into a set of tests with different hooks, lengths, VO reads, visual treatments, and CTAs that can run at the same time.

 - Compliance. Work within Solace’s approved-claims library and review process. We’re in healthcare, so you need to know what’s cleared before it hits the timeline.

 - QA and organization. Captions, audio levels, color, safe zones, and platform specs are correct before anything ships. Generated assets get named and tagged so the library is usable by other people.

 - Communication. Written notes, timestamped feedback, and recorded walkthroughs so the pod can move without a meeting.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

We have a steady supply of video ads that perform. The work is on brand, compliant, and improving week over week because you’re paying attention to the data. Six months in, we have a real library of AI-generated assets with performance history behind them, and it exists because you built it.




WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

 - 2+ years editing direct-response video, including at least 2 years at an e-commerce or DTC brand or another shop producing performance ads at high volume.

 - A reel of paid ads with results attached. We want to see what scaled and hear what you learned from what didn’t.

 - Hands-on experience with current AI video and image tools, AI voice tools, and avatar or presenter tools. You should have opinions about which ones are worth using.

 - Expert in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. At least intermediate After Effects for motion graphics and compositing.

 - Familiarity with YouTube, CTV, and Meta video specs and placements.

 - Able to read creative performance data and turn it into edit decisions.

 - Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle several briefs at once without quality slipping.

 - A bias for action. You move fast, make sound decisions, and work well under tight timelines.

 - Nice to have: experience in healthcare or another regulated industry with a claims review process, or experience building a creative library from nothing.




WHO WE ARE

We’re a team of ambitious, mission-driven individuals working to make healthcare more human. At Solace, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to one of the fastest-growing healthcare startups in the U.S. — where your work has a direct, visible impact on people’s lives.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

jobs.title: Eye Care Specialists: Clinical Note Review for Diagnosis Extraction
jobs.description:
WHAT WE'RE RESEARCHING

We're running a paid study evaluating how accurately ICD-10 diagnosis codes and eye laterality can be extracted from clinical documentation. This work helps improve automated clinical coding systems by ensuring that extracted codes are fully supported by the underlying narrative text. Your expertise will provide the clinical verification needed to measure extraction quality.


HOW IT WORKS

You will work remotely to review a series of de-identified eye care clinical notes. For each note, you will evaluate whether the provided ICD-10 codes and eye laterality match the clinical evidence found in the text. You will flag discrepancies, missing information, or unsupported code assignments directly in our review platform. The project is fully asynchronous and runs from October 28 to November 2.


WHO THIS IS FOR

We are looking for professionals with deep experience in ophthalmology or optometry clinical documentation. We welcome certified medical coders specializing in eye care, practicing optometrists, ophthalmologists, and clinical documentation improvement specialists. Ideal candidates have a strong working knowledge of ICD-10 guidelines specifically regarding eye laterality and complex ocular diagnoses.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Read and interpret de-identified eye care clinical notes

 - Evaluate extracted ICD-10 diagnosis codes for clinical accuracy

 - Verify that eye laterality is correctly captured based on the text

 - Identify and flag unsupported or missing diagnostic codes


WHO SHOULD APPLY

 - Professional experience in eye care clinical documentation or medical coding

 - Strong working knowledge of ICD-10 diagnosis coding guidelines

 - Familiarity with optometry or ophthalmology terminology

 - Availability to complete asynchronous review tasks between October 28 and November 2

jobs.title: Associate Director, US Field Analytics, Lung
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Director, Analytics and Insights, the Associate Director, US Field Analytics, Lung will serve as a key analytics partner to Revolution Medicines’ field organization and Commercial leadership. This role combines strong hands-on analytical capabilities with strategic thinking and business partnership to improve field strategy, deployment, execution, and performance.

The Associate Director will support RevMed field teams broadly, leading analytics and insights across areas including segmentation and targeting, field performance measurement, dashboards and reporting, territory design and alignment, and resource optimization.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable working directly with complex data and partnering with senior business leaders by translating business questions into clear, actionable recommendations through rigorous analysis.

Field Analytics & Strategy

• Lead analytics supporting the design, deployment, and ongoing optimization of RevMed lung-related field teams, including field force sizing and structure, territory design and alignment, resource allocation, and geographic opportunity assessment.

• Develop and evolve lung customer and account segmentation, targeting, and prioritization approaches to support effective field engagement.

• Own field lung KPIs, performance measurement frameworks, dashboards, scorecards, and reporting, providing leadership with visibility into performance and opportunities at the national, area, region, territory, account, and customer levels.

• Conduct advanced and ad hoc analyses to identify business drivers, risks, and opportunities and inform decisions related to field strategy, customer engagement, deployment, and execution.

• Support launch readiness and post-launch optimization.

Analytics & Technical Leadership

• Serve as a hands-on analytical leader, independently accessing, integrating, analyzing, and interpreting complex commercial datasets using analytics languages (SQL/Python), Excel, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI.

• Develop scalable analytical solutions and automate recurring analyses and reporting where appropriate.

• Partner with IS teams to define data and analytical requirements and ensure field analytics solutions are accurate, reliable, scalable, and fit for purpose.

• Establish and maintain strong standards for field analytics, including metric definitions, methodologies, data quality, documentation, and governance.

Business Partnership & Execution

• Serve as a trusted analytics thought partner to field leaders and senior Commercialization stakeholders.

• Proactively identify emerging business questions and opportunities.

• Partner cross-functionally with Field Leadership, Sales Operations, US Analytics & Insights, Marketing, Omnichannel, IS, and Medical functions.

• Drive adoption and effective use of targeting, dashboards, metrics, and analytical tools through ongoing partnership, communication, and training with field teams and leaders.

• Manage multiple concurrent initiatives and external analytics partners as needed, delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or business-related discipline.

• 8+ years of progressive experience in commercial analytics, field analytics, sales analytics, commercial operations, or a related function within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare organizations.

• Demonstrated experience with field strategy and analytics, including segmentation and targeting, territory design/alignment, field performance measurement, dashboards/reporting, and resource optimization.

• Experience working with pharmaceutical commercial data, which may include claims, prescription, patient-level, account, distributor, specialty pharmacy, CRM, activity, and other third-party datasets.

• Proficient in technical analytics tools, including SQL and/or Python, Excel, and BI tools. Experience with alignment management software, and Veeva CRM preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for senior business leaders.

• Strong business acumen, communication, and presentation skills, with demonstrated ability to influence across functions and levels of an organization.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience supporting multiple field functions.

• Experience with field force sizing, territory optimization, geographic alignment, or resource allocation methodologies.

• Experience developing sophisticated customer/account segmentation and targeting approaches.

• Experience supporting commercial analytics from pre-launch through launch and post-launch optimization.

jobs.description:
About AppLovin

AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com.

To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.

About AppLovin’s Consumer Team

We are powering the next wave of consumer growth. Specializing in performance advertising, we help global brands and leading consumer apps across verticals such as e-commerce, fintech, meal delivery, ride hailing, video streaming and more achieve profitable growth by connecting them to over 1 billion daily users across thousands of the world’s top mobile games apps. This scale is driven by AppLovin Ads, AppLovin’s advertising platform, which enables businesses of all sizes to find their ideal customers and maximize ROI.

AppLovin’s global Consumer Team combines people from different backgrounds and perspectives, united by a shared ambition to always pursue excellence and win together in a fast-moving market.

About the Role

The Agency Partnerships team is a new, high-performing team within the Consumer Team that drives customer success by partnering with a wide range of agency partners. We are looking for an Agency Development Lead to build and own partnerships with independent agencies based in North America. This is a unique, zero-to-one opportunity to define how one of the world’s largest performance advertising platforms shows up, engages and grows with the independent agency community to establish AppLovin Ads as a core performance channel across their client rosters.

This is a highly visible, externally facing role for someone who thrives on building influential relationships and turning them into measurable revenue growth for clients, partners and AppLovin. You will focus on winning new agency partnerships and expanding AppLovin’s footprint within existing agency partners. You will build relationships with agency leadership and activate programs around co-marketing, technology integration, enablement and joint business planning, while developing a deep understanding of each agency’s business, media strategy and growth priorities. You will serve as a consultative, executive-level growth partner who earns trust with agency leadership and the client teams they represent. You will also work alongside dedicated Agency Success Managers on the Agency Partnerships team to support client onboarding, spend growth and retention.

Responsibilities

●    Own full-cycle sales opportunities across North American independent agency prospects and existing partners, building trusted relationships with senior agency leadership, pod leads and media buyers that lead to multi-client activation and durable revenue growth
●    Build and manage a strong pipeline of qualified agency partner opportunities through strategic account planning, targeted prospecting, executive referrals, inbound demand and industry events and conferences
●    Lead joint business planning conversations with agency partners to understand their client portfolio, commercial priorities, media planning process and practice areas where AppLovin Ads can play a role in driving their broader growth strategy
●    Partner closely with Agency Success Managers and cross-functional teams to ensure new agencies and their clients launch successfully on the platform
●    Expand agency partnerships by identifying and activating net-new clients within their roster, working alongside Agency Success Managers who own growth of clients already spending on the platform
●    Serve as the trusted primary point of contact, escalation point and thought leader for your agencies
●    Design and deliver scaled enablement programs, including trainings, workshops, certifications and roadshows, that build agency fluency in AppLovin Ads and in performance best practices for creative, measurement and campaign setup
●    Partner with the Consumer Business Development team to connect agency relationships to direct brand opportunities, ensuring a coordinated experience for both agency and brand partners
●    Drive co-marketing, thought leadership and case study programs with agency partners to establish AppLovin as the best full-funnel performance advertising channel opportunity in the market
●    Bring the voice of the agency to AppLovin by translating partner feedback, competitive intelligence and market trends into prioritized business cases that inform the product roadmap and agency offering
●    Represent AppLovin at industry events, agency summits and executive briefings
●    Mentor and develop Agency Partnerships team members, raise the bar on best practices and playbooks and help build the team as the channel grows

Basic Qualifications

●    10+ years of experience in digital advertising, with significant experience in agency development, agency sales or agency partnerships at a leading ad tech, paid social, search, e-commerce or technology company
●    A consistent track record of winning new agency business and expanding existing partnerships for performance-focused products and/or services
●    Deep understanding of agency operating models, economics and how media planning and channel decisions are made across independent agencies of all sizes
●    Established network of senior relationships across North American independent agencies
●    Executive presence and outstanding communication, storytelling, negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility from practitioner to C-suite
●    Strong prospecting and account-planning skills, with the judgment to prioritize the opportunities, relationships and actions most likely to create material growth
●    Analytical, data-driven operating style, with the ability to manage a high-volume, high-value portfolio of agency relationships
●    A builder mindset: you thrive in early-stage business settings, operate well with ambiguity and minimal direction and can stand up programs from scratch

Preferred Qualifications

●    BA/BS degree preferred
●    Direct agency management experience at a performance advertising platform such as a paid social, search, mobile or programmatic company
●    Experience structuring and negotiating commercial agreements, joint business plans or incentive programs with agency partners
●    Experience building scaled agency partnership, certification and training programs from an early stage
●    Agency-side experience in media planning, investment or performance marketing
●    Understanding of the mobile advertising ecosystem and performance advertising for e-commerce
●    Travel expected as and when possible

• 8+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare consulting, or analytics environments, including at least 4 years supporting US market access analytics or closely related payer, reimbursement, pricing, contracting, or patient access decisions.

• Demonstrated success supporting product launches and commercialization, preferably for oncology, specialty, or physician-administered products and in a pre-launch or rapidly scaling organization.

• Strong understanding of the US market access landscape, including commercial and government payers, pharmacy and medical benefit dynamics, formulary and medical policy, reimbursement, specialty distribution, provider and GPO dynamics, patient support services, and contracting economics.

• Hands-on experience with market access data such as payer coverage and policy, longitudinal patient claims, prescription and sales, hub and specialty pharmacy, distribution, rebate and contract performance, and account hierarchy data.

• Expertise in analytical problem solving, including KPI design, segmentation, opportunity assessment, scenario modeling, performance measurement, and the ability to translate an ambiguous business question into a rigorous analytical approach.

• Proficiency with business intelligence and analytical tools such as Tableau or Power BI and advanced Excel and PowerPoint; working knowledge of SQL and/or other analytical programming tools is strongly preferred.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to present concise, executive-ready narratives and drive decisions across senior and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Proven ability to lead through influence, manage multiple external vendors and workstreams, mentor colleagues, and deliver high-quality results within budget and established timelines.

• Strong business acumen and an entrepreneurial mindset, with comfort operating hands-on amid ambiguity in a smaller, rapidly growing company and a passion for helping cancer patients.

Preferred Skills:

• 10+ years of experience in patient-based forecasting with focus in Oncology.

• Experience with targeted oncolytics.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.

• Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information and influence decision-making at the executive level.

jobs.title: Support Engineer
jobs.description:
About Flex 

Flex was founded to solve a simple but costly problem: making it easy for health and wellness brands to accept HSA and FSA payments online. For years, most merchants lacked the infrastructure to process these payments at checkout, leaving customers to deal with frustrating reimbursement paperwork instead.

Our technology verifies product eligibility in real time, handles split payments for eligible and non-eligible items, and can even issue Letters of Medical Necessity during checkout. With $150 billion in annual HSA/FSA spending potential, we're giving brands the tools to unlock new revenue and making it easier for consumers to use the benefits they've earned.



About the Role 

We're hiring a Support Engineer to help scale our support function as we grow. You'll be joining a small but growing Support Engineering team embedded within Engineering, working at the intersection of customer-facing support and technical problem solving. This role blends hands-on merchant and customer support with real engineering work — building internal tooling, automating workflows, and partnering closely with the broader Engineering team to ship fixes and improve our systems.

This role is perfect for someone who loves solving problems, thrives in ambiguity, and is excited about building foundational support infrastructure at an early-stage startup.



What you'll do

 - Triage and respond to daily merchant and customer tickets via Slack and Pylon

 - Ensure we meet SLA targets and maintain a high bar for customer satisfaction

 - Deliver clear, thoughtful, and technically sound responses across internal and external communications

 - Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to unblock support issues and escalate bugs or system issues

 - Ensure the broader internal team has the tools and visibility they need to deliver a great customer experience

 - Partner with Engineering to test new product functionality, edge cases, and backend fixes before rollout

 - Build and maintain internal documentation for support workflows, product edge cases, and tooling tips

 - Help define and improve tagging, categorization, and data structure for tickets to power better reporting and insights over time

Who You Are

 - You have a foundational understanding of APIs, JSON, Postman, and Retool

 - You're curious, resourceful, and comfortable picking up technical tools on the fly

 - You have strong written communication skills and a customer-first mindset

 - You take initiative and thrive in fast-paced, scrappy environments

 - You're excited to wear many hats and aren't afraid to build something from scratch

Why Join Flex

 - Work directly with founders and leadership on high-impact initiatives

 - Equity compensation with competitive salary

 - Medical, dental, and vision plans

 - Unlimited PTO and sick days

 - Paid parental leave

 - Flexible, remote-first team with quarterly in-person meetups

You'll also help keep IT areas clean, organized, and audit-ready.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Fulfillment by Amazon - AI Native Finance Analytics & Controls
jobs.description:
Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA) Finance is seeking a Finance Manager who can do two things simultaneously: ensure the integrity of Amazon's largest seller fee revenue base AND turn that clean data foundation into profitability intelligence that drives fee strategy decisions.

This is not a traditional finance role — it's a hybrid that combines end-to-end FBA analytics and how we protect our fee revenue base, heavily powered by AI and automation,

You will own the connection between FBA fee revenue at the shipment level and operational costs across Amazon's fulfillment network — producing the fee-level P&L that tells leadership whether we're happy or sad with FBA economics and that our financial controls are working. You'll also own the GL reconciliation, revenue assurance, and quarterly inspection mechanisms that ensure those numbers are trustworthy. The controllership work is the foundation; the analytics work is the payoff.
This role sits at the intersection of all fee verticals, providing the consolidated profitability view that no single vertical can see alone. You'll partner across FP&A, Fee Strategy, Fee Technology, and Accounting.

The vision: Within 6 months, 80%+ of the controllership inspection work is automated through AI agents and intelligent workflows. Your time shifts from manual reconciliation to proactive anomaly detection, cross-fee profitability analysis, and producing the analytics that shape FBA's fee strategy.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end fee-level P&L: connect FBA revenue (by fee type, ASP band, size tier) to operational costs across the fulfillment network
- Build and maintain AI-powered variance decomposition and profitability reporting across fee activities (Supply Chain, Storage, Selling, Value Recovery)
- Perform key GL reconciliations to ensure complete, accurate, and timely financial reporting across multiple marketplaces
- Design and automate controllership inspection mechanisms — shifting from reactive audit to proactive, AI-driven anomaly detection
- Partner with Fee Strategy, Accounting, and Fee Technology teams to ensure fees are accurate, timely, and aligned with seller communication and internal strategy
- Deliver recurring revenue analytics with proactive signals for leadership; produce cross-fee margin analysis that informs fee strategy decisions
- Build AI agents and automated workflows targeting significant automation of routine controllership inspections — develop repeatable patterns the broader finance team can adopt
- Perform recurring and ad-hoc audits of fee revenues; manage seller transaction adjustments and revenue assurance
- Provide support for external/internal audit inquiries; act as subject matter expert for controllership and FBA profitability analytics

A day in the life
Your morning starts with an AI-generated anomaly report you built — replacing hours of manual reconciliation. You investigate a fee variance, trace it to a calculation edge case, and partner with Fee Tech to resolve it before close. By afternoon, you're building the monthly fee-level P&L, decomposing variances into rate and mix effects, and drafting the narrative for leadership. Between deep dives, you're refining automated workflows that turn weekly controllership checks from multi-hour manual pulls into minutes-with-exceptions. You hold both lenses — "are the numbers right?" and "what do they mean?" — which makes you the person leadership trusts for both.

About the team
You will be joining a high-performing, fast-paced Finance team whose mission is to be the trusted strategic advisor to the business, driving profitable growth and scale through innovation. Is a highly visible role within the finance team and requires a strong leader and open communicator. You will have direct impact on top and bottom lines with the ability to deliver improvements for our teams. You will be part of a growing, fast paced, and fun team. You will have ownership for the implementation of your work and you will see direct business improvements based on the results of your work.

Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications:
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience

- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
