jobs.title: Monteur (H/F)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

GE Vernova est une société mondiale du secteur de l’énergie s'appuyant sur plus de 130 ans d'expérience dans la résolution des défis mondiaux, contribuant à la transition énergétique en continuant à électrifier le monde tout en s'efforçant de le décarboner.

Sur son site situé à Villeurbanne (France), l’activité Grid Solutions conçoit, teste et fabrique des disjoncteurs haute tension destinés à ses clients nationaux et internationaux.

Pour accompagner un marché en forte croissance poussée par la transition énergétique et le développement des réseaux électrique bas carbone, la branche électrification de GE Vernova investi massivement dans le développement de nouvelles technologies et  nouveaux produits.
Le poste est rattaché au Centre de Recherche & Développement des appareillages haute-tension.

Il/elle intégrera une équipe d’ingénieurs et de techniciens dans le cadre d’un projet de développement visant à concevoir des produits à hautes performances pour étoffer notre catalogue de solutions et accéder à de nouveaux marchés liés à la transition énergétique en Europe et aux USA.

Job Description

Missions :

• Préparer et réaliser des opérations de montage et démontage des maquettes et des prototypes pour les équipes projets R&D du département
• Instrumenter les prototypes et participer à leur expertise après essais.

Principales Responsabilités

• Prendre connaissance du planning de travail et des consignes auprès du responsable atelier et des référents projets (techniciens, chefs de projets)
• Prendre connaissance du dossier de plans, et du cahier des charges
• Préparer son poste de travail, afin que les outils, élingues et consommables (gabarits de montage, graisse…) soient présents
• Contrôler son outillage, état de fonctionnement, validité
• Vérifier l’état général de propreté des pièces, aspirer, graisser les joints et les vis, assembler le matériel, serrer au couple, marquer les vis
• Gérer son stock de pièces (identification et lieu de stockage) et ses besoins pour les prochains montages.
• Organiser, sur consigne de l‘ingénieur, l’archivage des pièces et leur mise au rebut
• Participer au montage, au démontage et au décuvage des appareils
• Réaliser les opérations de gonflages et de récupération de fluides (azote, CO2, SF6, G3..)
• Respecter les procédures pour la réalisation des opérations
• S’assurer que les montages seront assemblés en conformité avec les règles qualité et EHS en vigueur
• Anticiper et alerter sur les risques du projet (Qualité, Délais, Coûts, …)
• Communiquer avec le responsable d’atelier et le technicien sur les aléas du quotidien et sur l’évolution de la charge/tâche
• Participer à la définition des besoins en matériel et en transport en vue de la réalisation d’essais en laboratoire extérieur
• Démonter et participer à l’expertise des appareils testés en hall de décuvage en applicants les règles de sécurité (tenue de protection et équipement individuel de filtration d’air).

Votre profil

Vous disposez d’une solide expérience en logistique industrielle, en manutention et en gestion de stocks.

À l’aise dans un environnement technique, vous savez travailler en autonomie, anticiper les besoins et coordonner plusieurs opérations simultanément.

Formation et compétences

• Formation en mécanique ou en montage industriel, de type CAP, BEP ou Bac professionnel
• Une première expérience dans un environnement d’exposition aux risques pressions est appréciée
• Bonnes connaissances en mécanique et notions de base en électricité
• Capacité à lire et comprendre des plans techniques
• Connaissance des outils de montage, de serrage au couple et des équipements de levage.
• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques de base.

Savoir-être

• Autonomie, rigueur et attention
• Esprit d'équipe
• Créativité et force de proposition
• Respect des règles et des consignes de sécurité dans l’établissement.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Location:

Pyeongtaek-NF Summit,KOR

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.

Role Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
• Use digital analytics for troubleshooting
• Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
• Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
• Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
• Fulfill additional duties, as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

• Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
• 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
• Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
• Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
• Basic mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
• Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
• Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
• Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols

Preferred Qualifications:

• 2–4 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field

Physical Requirements:
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.  Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Yes, 75% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

No

Job Title : 功能安全开发工程师

Job Responsibilities

本岗位是一个以嵌入式软件开发、功能安全机制实现和高质量软件交付为核心的功能安全软件开发岗位。负责在 Infineon TC397 安全 MCU 上完成功能安全架构与各类安全机制（看门狗、ECC、SMU、Lockstep、BIST 等）的软件实现，开发、集成并验证功能安全相关的底层软件（MCAL、OS、CDD 及安全库），并实现安全 MCU 与高算力计算平台（NVIDIA Orin / Thor）之间的安全协同软件及自动驾驶域控平台。

• 实现基于 Infineon TC397 的功能安全架构：将安全概念（Safety Concept）、技术安全需求（TSR）和软件安全需求（SSR）转化为可运行、可测试的 C 代码与配置，完成安全机制到软件模块的分配、实现与追溯。
• 实现并验证芯片级与系统级安全机制，包括：内部/外部看门狗（窗口看门狗、Q&A 模式）服务与监督逻辑、软件分区与内存保护、Flash/SRAM ECC 告警处理与错误记录、SMU 告警路由配置与反应处理、Lockstep 核比对异常处理与复位后恢复、上电/运行期 BIST（LBIST/MBIST）调度与结果判定等，并在目标硬件上验证每一项机制的有效性。
• 开发、集成并交付功能安全相关的底层软件：完成 Infineon MCAL / iLLD 驱动配置、安全扩展与寄存器回读校验，安全 RTOS 的分区、MPU 与时间保护配置，复杂设备驱动（CDD）编写，SafeTlib / 安全库集成与启动时序对接，保证底层软件在目标硬件上稳定运行。
• 实现安全 MCU 与 Orin / Thor 高算力平台之间的协作软件：心跳与存活监控、E2E 保护通信（CRC/Counter/Timeout）编解码库、跨平台故障上报与安全状态同步协议、安全降级与进入安全状态（Safe State）的决策与执行逻辑，并与 SoC 侧团队联调直至闭环。
• 对交付软件的质量负责：遵循 MISRA C 与项目编码规范编写代码，完成单元测试（语句/分支/MC/DC 覆盖达标）、静态分析零未论证缺陷、代码评审、集成测试与故障注入测试（FIT），输出测试报告与追溯矩阵，确保安全机制的诊断覆盖率（DC）与反应时间满足目标 ASIL 与 FTTI 要求。
• 参与 FMEA / FTA / DFA/FMEDA/MTTFd/DCavg分析，为软件安全机制提供检测范围、周期和验证证据，支持硬件指标（SPFM/LFM/PMHF/MTTFd等）计算。
• 与硬件、系统工程、Orin/Thor 平台软件、测试及质量团队紧密协作，推动功能安全要求在整车/整机层面的实现与验证闭环
• 支持功能安全合规审核及safety case所需底软功能安全相关设计文档准备

Qualifications:

l  计算机、软件工程、电子工程、自动化或相关专业，本科及以上学历。

l  3年以上嵌入式软件开发经验。

l  熟悉AUTOSAR AP/CP架构以及相应安全机制技术原理。

l  熟悉嵌入式 MCU 软件开发流程，具备等车规/工业级 MCU 平台开发经验。

l  扎实的嵌入式 C 编码能力：能够独立编写、调试并交付高质量的底层驱动与安全机制代码，熟练掌握 MISRA C:2012，熟悉多核、中断、DMA、内存保护、原子操作与确定性时序编程

l  熟悉 E2E 通信保护（CRC / 计数器 / 超时）、看门狗管理、程序流监控、时间监控等安全机制的软件实现，具备安全状态机与故障管理器的实现经验。

l  具备良好的代码质量意识和文档能力，能够输出有效的技术方案与评审材料。

Job Title ： 嵌入式网络安全开发工程师

岗位职责（Job Responsibilities）

面向 DCU（NVIDIA Orin / Thor，嵌入式 Linux）平台的网络安全功能实现岗位。在安全架构师给定的安全方案与需求下，负责 Secure Boot、设备证书与 mTLS 通信、ROS2 DDS Security、Linux 系统加固、OTA 签名校验、漏洞修复等具体安全功能的编码实现、集成、测试与交付，并输出配套的部署脚本、测试记录与使用文档

• 实现并集成设备安全通信mTLS，配合 Nginx / MQTT / HTTP 等服务完成双向认证接入，并完成握手失败、证书过期、吊销等异常路径处理与测试。
• 实现设备证书全生命周期的端侧功能：证书请求（CSR）生成、证书与私钥的安全存储（文件权限、TPM / 安全分区）、证书部署与更新脚本、过期检测与轮换逻辑，并编写对应的自动化测试。
• 在 Orin / Thor 平台上完成 Secure Boot 相关功能的实现与验证：按方案完成签名密钥配置、镜像 / 内核 / 设备树签名流程脚本化、Fuse 烧写步骤验证、启动链完整性测试，输出可重复执行的操作手册。
• 实现 ROS2 DDS Security 配置与集成：生成并部署 Identity / Permissions / Governance 文件，完成节点级访问控制配置，验证加密与认证对带宽、时延的影响并给出调优结果。
• 实现 Linux 系统安全加固项：用户与权限最小化、SSH 与服务配置收敛、防火墙（iptables / nftables）规则、安全基线脚本化检查，并在目标机上验证不影响业务功能。
• 实现 OTA 安全校验功能：升级包签名验证、完整性校验、版本防回滚检查的端侧代码，覆盖签名无效、包损坏、版本降级等负向用例。
• 编写并维护安全功能的单元测试、集成测试与部署脚本，输出测试报告、配置说明与故障排查文档；参与代码评审。
• 配合安全架构师、平台软件、测试与现场团队完成安全功能联调、问题定位与修复

任职要求（Required Qualifications）

• 扎实的 C / C++ 与 Python / Shell 编码能力，能够独立完成模块开发、调试与测试；熟悉 Git 与常规代码评审流程。
• 熟悉 Linux 系统基础：用户与权限模型、systemd 服务管理、网络配置、日志系统，
• 熟悉 OpenSSL 命令行与 API，理解 X.509 证书、CA 签发、证书链校验、具备 TLS / mTLS 实际集成经验。

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

職務概要（JOB PURPOSE）

エンジニアとして、HVAC（空調）システムおよび関連コンポーネントの設計・開発・評価・改善活動を担当していただきます。

本ポジションでは、新製品開発および現行製品の維持・改善活動において、サプライヤー、製造部門、品質部門、グローバルエンジニアリングチームと連携しながら、品質・性能・耐久性・コストの目標達成に向けた開発活動を推進していただきます。

職務内容（JOB DUTIES）

サプライヤーや社内関係部門と協力しながら、オペレータステーションに搭載されるHVACシステムおよび関連部品の開発を推進します。

主な業務内容は以下の通りです。

• HVACシステムおよび関連部品の要求仕様策定、設計、および開発
• サプライヤーと連携した製品開発、設計レビュー、および技術課題解決
• 性能・環境・耐久評価の計画、実施、および結果評価

• 関係部門と連携した新製品開発、品質向上、およびコスト低減活動

本ポジションでは、グローバルチームおよびサプライヤーと円滑に業務を推進するための高いコミュニケーション能力、調整能力、および技術的分析能力が求められます。

• 製品要求事項および技術仕様の策定経験

• 製品開発プロセスおよびサプライヤーとの協業経験

協調性・コミュニケーション能力（Collaboration and Communication）

• 部門横断チームおよびサプライヤーと協力しながら目標を達成する能力
• 優れたコミュニケーション能力および対人スキル
• サプライヤーとの技術協議や開発推進経験
• グローバル環境での業務経験または適応力

継続的な学習姿勢（Continuous Learning）

• HVAC技術およびオペレータステーション技術に対する継続的な学習意欲
• 変化する技術課題や事業ニーズへの柔軟な対応力
• 品質向上および継続改善への積極的な姿勢

• 勤務地：兵庫県明石市
• 原則として週5日出社勤務

JOB PURPOSE:

As an Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, validation, and continuous improvement of HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) systems and related components.

In this role, you will drive development activities for both new product introductions and current product enhancement initiatives. Working closely with suppliers, manufacturing, quality, and global engineering teams, you will be responsible for delivering solutions that meet quality, performance, durability, and cost objectives.

JOB DUTIES:

The incumbent will work closely with suppliers, customers, manufacturing teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to develop HVAC systems and related Operator Station components that meet Caterpillar requirements for performance, quality, durability, reliability, and cost.

This role requires strong technical and project management skills to drive component development activities from concept through production implementation. Major responsibilities include:

• Develop requirements, specifications, and designs for HVAC systems and related components.
• Collaborate with suppliers to support product development, design reviews, and technical issue resolution.
• Plan, execute, and evaluate performance, environmental, and durability validation activities.
• Investigate product quality issues, conduct root cause analysis, and drive corrective actions.
• Partner with manufacturing, purchasing, quality, validation, and global engineering teams to support new product development, quality improvement, and cost reduction initiatives.

This position requires strong communication, interpersonal, and analytical skills, along with the ability to effectively collaborate with global teams and suppliers.

Skill Descriptors:

Technical Expertise:

• Experience defining and managing product requirements and technical specifications.
• Strong skills in data analysis, performance evaluation, and engineering problem solving.
• Experience planning and executing component and system-level validation activities.
• Knowledge of product development processes and supplier collaboration.

Collaboration and Communication

• Ability to effectively collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional teams to achieve project objectives.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with internal and external stakeholders.
• Experience leading technical discussions and coordinating development activities with suppliers.
• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in global engineering environments.

Continuous Learning:

• Commitment to developing expertise in HVAC technologies and Operator Station systems.
• Adaptability to changing business priorities and technical challenges.
• Continuous improvement mindset focused on product quality and customer satisfaction.

• This position requires working onsite five days a week.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) is the world’s leading independent, end-to-end IT services company, helping clients harness the power of innovation to thrive on change. Created by the merger of CSC and the Enterprise Services business of Hewlett Packard Enterprise, DXC Technology serves nearly 6,000 private and public sector clients across 70 countries. The company’s technology independence, global talent and extensive partner alliance combine to deliver powerful next-generation IT services and solutions. DXC Technology is recognized among the best corporate citizens globally. For more information, visit www.dxc.technology

Associate Product Manager

OASIS Platform  ·  DXC Technology

About OASIS

OASIS is DXC’s internal agentic AI platform, built for our delivery workforce. It supports enterprise clients across Infrastructure, Workplace, BPS, Cybersecurity, and Applications. We compete with platforms like Glean, Moveworks, and IBM watsonx Orchestrate, and we’re staking out our own position as an agentic platform that knows where the user is.

About the team

You’ll join a small, cross-functional product team operating with startup energy inside a global company. PM coverage spans AI Assist, Client experience, and Knowledge. You’ll work across these areas, supporting senior PMs and gradually taking ownership of your own scope. You’ll report to the Director of Product Management and User Experience.

The role

We’re looking for an Associate Product Manager to grow into a full PM seat on the OASIS team. You’ll start by supporting our PMs across AI Assist, Client, and Knowledge. You’ll learn how product gets built on OASIS, sit in on user interviews, help turn research into specs, and take on more independent scope as you ramp up.

This is a role for someone early in their PM career who wants to learn fast in a team that ships. You won’t be running point on a vision document on day one, but you also won’t be sitting on the sidelines. The bar is real ownership, on a real product, with senior people around you to learn from.

What you’ll do

• Support PMs across discovery, definition, and delivery

• Sit in on user interviews and research sessions, then help synthesize what you heard into product decisions

• Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and Jira tickets engineers can build from

• Track release readiness and coordinate go-live activities

• Work with Engineering and Design from problem framing through ship

• Own a discrete area of the product within your first six months

About you

• You have 1 to 3 years of product, business analyst, consulting, technical, or operations experience

• You write clearly, especially in long form. Specs, briefs, and summaries come naturally to you.

• You have a bias toward action. You’d rather draft something rough and get it in front of a person than wait for the perfect version.

• You’re curious about how AI agents and platforms actually work, and how users actually use them

• You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You ask the obvious question rather than guess.

• You can hold the user problem and the engineering trade-off in your head at the same time

• You’re drawn to defining the problem, not just describing the solution

Nice to have

• Exposure to enterprise software, IT operations, or technical delivery environments

• Familiarity with Confluence, Jira, or similar tools

• Some background in design, engineering, or research

• Comfort sketching ideas quickly, including with AI tools like Lovable or v0

How we work

We’re a human-centered product team. No feature enters a sprint without a defined user problem. We move through Discover, Define, Design, and Deliver, with Confluence as the record and Jira as the work. The PM job here is to define the problem, not just ship a feature.

Trust, Transform & Thrive with a company whose mission is to lead our clients on their digital transformation journey. DXC Technology is recognized globally as a force multiplier, enabling clients to seize the opportunities presented by today's rapidly changing technologies.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.title: Intern – Coating Engineer - 2027 (M/F/D)
jobs.description:
Would you like the opportunity to work in a global energy company?

Do you enjoy taking on challenging projects?

Join our innovating Internship Program

The Baker Hughes Internship is designed to enable students either pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree or recently graduated to gain hands-on work experience as the foundation of their professional lives. Our internships will give you first-hand insights into the processes, systems, and practices that are aligned to ensure customer needs are met through flawless execution and the application of leading-edge technology.

Partner with the best

You’ll participate in focused training, team meetings, work on projects, and present your results. During your internship, you will be supported by a buddy and your manager who will ensure you have valuable learning experience. You can expect to receive coaching and mentoring to enable you to complete assignments and projects to develop your learning and skillset.

You will also have the opportunity to become familiar with the Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) and culture of Baker Hughes, as well as our strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.

As part of the Compatibility & Coating Solutions team, you will support hands-on laboratory activities focused on coatings and materials characterization. This internship offers practical experience in coating application and testing, microstructural characterization, evaluation of mechanical and corrosion performance, analysis of experimental results, and technical reporting.

As an intern, you'll be responsible for:

• Performing hands-on laboratory activities related to coatings and coating technologies.

• Supporting coating application and laboratory testing activities.

• Characterizing coating microstructure using microscopy and other appropriate laboratory techniques.

• Evaluating coating performance, including mechanical properties and corrosion behavior.

• Analyzing experimental results and preparing clear technical summaries and reports.

• Supporting activities across coating technologies, which may include thermal spray, plating, and other coating processes.

• Organizing test data and contributing to consistent, high-quality laboratory documentation.

• Operating in compliance with laboratory Quality, Safety, and HSE procedures.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

• Be currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science & Engineering, Chemistry/Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering with a materials focus, or a related field.

• Have maintained a GPA grade greater than or equal to 3.0 out of 4.0 or the equivalent in your country.

• Have an interest in coatings, materials characterization, and hands-on laboratory work.

• Demonstrate strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.

• Have good written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Show curiosity, motivation, and a hands-on approach to laboratory work.

• Be able to legally work in the country that you are applying in, without company sponsorship or time restriction.

Through this internship, you will have the opportunity to develop:

• Practical experience in coating application, testing, and characterization within an industrial materials laboratory.

• Hands-on experience in physical and mechanical characterization microscopy and chemical analysis techniques

• Understanding of relationships between coating microstructure, mechanical properties, and corrosion performance.

• Exposure to coating technologies, potentially including thermal spray, plating processes and aluminide diffusive coatings.

• Experience analyzing experimental results and preparing technical reports.

• Familiarity with industrial laboratory practices, quality standards, and HSE requirements.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone. In this role, we may be able to offer flexible working patterns. Talk to us about your desired working options when you apply.

Working with us

Working at Baker Hughes means being at the forefront of the energy transition. Our people are diverse, ambitious, and collaborative. We're on a mission to redefine the energy sector by unlocking the power of engineering, data, and science.

The fixed allowance for this position will be between this range: 600 - 1000 € gross monthly. The allowance will be established in accordance with criteria related to the candidate’s academic status and their distance from the workplace.

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Intern/ Trainee/Apprentice

At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for developing joint business strategies, leading commercial negotiations, and building high-value customer partnerships that position Elanco as the partner of choice in animal health.

• Strategic Joint Business Planning: Create, negotiate, and execute collaborative Joint Business Plans (JBPs) and commercial trading terms with key retail, corporate veterinary, and e-commerce partners to maximise net sales potential and category growth.
• Commercial & Promotional Excellence: Design, implement, and track margin-accretive promotional calendars aligned with marketing plans—monitoring both sell-in and sell-out/scan data while managing Gross-to-Net (GtN) effectively within budget.
• Category Growth & Portfolio Execution: Translate brand and category strategies into tailored customer growth initiatives, delivering high-impact commercial proposals, business reviews, and brand campaigns across partner networks.
• Cross-Functional & Field Alignment: Partner closely with Marketing, Regional Sales Managers, and Field Sales teams to ensure head-office customer initiatives are effectively executed through field call cycles and in-store merchandising.
• Demand Forecasting & Financial Governance: Deliver accurate sales and accrual forecasts for supply planning, while proactively managing trade spend budgets, claims, customer credits, and invoice reconciliations in line with Elanco governance standards.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related discipline (or equivalent level of relevant commercial experience)

• Experience managing major Australian pet retail chains, corporate veterinary buying groups, or e-commerce/omnichannel platforms.
• Strong financial acumen with demonstrated capability in Gross-to-Net (GtN) management, trade spend ROI, and demand forecasting.
• Advanced analytical capability with experience interpreting scan/sell-out data, category insights, and market trends to drive customer strategies.
• Deep understanding of the companion animal health market, pet specialty channels, or veterinary commercial dynamics12.
• Proficiency with commercial CRM platforms, ERP systems (e.g., SAP), and Microsoft Office suite (advanced Excel and PowerPoint).

As a Senior Manager, Game Production on VALORANT Maps, you will lead production planning and execution for a multidisciplinary pod building the map experience. • Drive planning and creation of product and feature roadmaps

• Hold teams accountable to predictable delivery of commitments

• Ensure strategic alignment between team work and VALORANT goals

• Ensure teams are structured, staffed and funded appropriately

jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
Since 2017, Flourish has been on a mission to help financial advisors evolve from holistic advice to holistic implementation to better serve their clients and grow their businesses. We focus on independent Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs), delivering financial products that advisors can’t easily access today through beautiful, scalable, and easy-to-use technology.

Today, we work with over 1,100 RIAs that collectively represent more than $2.6T in assets under management across two products: Flourish Cash and Flourish Lending. Headquartered in New York City, we are an independently-operating, wholly-owned subsidiary of MassMutual Life Insurance Company.

Read on if you are interested in joining a dynamic, highly-collaborative, rapidly-growing startup—backed by the support and stability of a Fortune 500 company.

About You

You are a highly strategic, data-obsessed, and analytical professional who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You anticipate needs, identify opportunities, and drive insights with minimal guidance. You excel at synthesizing complex information and communicating insights clearly. You have run budgeting and forecasting processes before, can own them independently, and actively use AI tools to work smarter and faster.

You partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and contribute to data-driven decision-making. You will have direct access to the CEO, CFO, and CRO, among other leaders, and can collaborate effectively with them. You are excited to join Flourish at a pivotal stage, and are motivated by the prospect of shaping its growth.

About the Role

Flourish is transitioning to a standalone, PE-backed organization. As an Financial Planning and Analysis Manager, you will report directly to the CFO and own financial planning and analysis, supporting strategic decision-making during a critical stage of growth and product evolution.

You’ll partner closely with finance leadership and cross-functional teams to deliver insights that drive performance and long-term value creation. This is a hands-on role for an experienced Financial Planning and Analysis Manager professional who can own the planning process from day one.

Principal Responsibilities

• Build and maintain the company’s integrated financial model and forward-looking forecasts

• Lead the annual budget, forecasting, and reforecasting processes, including monthly budget-vs-actual variance analysis

• Prepare board, investor, and leadership reporting packages

• Partner with business teams on performance analysis and support go-to-market and product analytics

• Partner with our PE sponsor on reporting and ad hoc analysis needs

• Partner with the Controller to ensure forecasts and management reporting tie to the accounting records

• Develop dashboards and business intelligence reporting

• Use AI tools to automate reporting, modeling, and analysis, and continually improve Financial Planning and Analysis efficiency

• Provide ad hoc analysis for strategic initiatives

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or CFA preferred

• 5+ years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in a hands-on Financial Planning and Analysis role owning budgeting, forecasting, and modeling

• Financial services, fintech, or PE-backed environment experience strongly preferred

• Due to the nature of this position, as part of the background check process, candidates must be able to pass a fingerprint background check to qualify as a fingerprinted person under FINRA. For roles requiring registration, additional regulatory screenings may apply, including a review of Form U5 disclosures and other relevant licensing information.

Preferred Qualifications

• Banking, PE, or consulting experience, ideally combined with in-house Financial Planning and Analysis experience

• Understanding of financial services business models (e.g., broker-dealer, lending, insurance) and FINRA reporting requirements

• FINRA Series 27 license

• Exposure to high-growth or data-driven environments

• Advanced financial modeling, analytical, and data interpretation skills; experience with Financial Planning and Analysis planning and BI/dashboard tools

• Demonstrated use of AI tools (e.g., LLMs and AI-enabled planning, BI and modeling tools) to automate processes and improve efficiency

• Ability to connect financial insights to business decisions, understand their financial impact, and balance that with business partner satisfaction

• Ability to make accurate, independent decisions based on data

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize and multitask; proactive, detail-oriented, and results-oriented

• Curious and collaborative team player

At Flourish, we focus on ensuring fair, equitable pay by providing competitive salaries, along with bonus and incentive opportunities and benefits for all employees.

Base Salary Range: $140,000 - $210,000 plus bonus

Disclosures:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, Financial Reporting
jobs.description:
About Stitch Fix, Inc.

Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we’re equally committed to building yours.  We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what’s possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential.

About the Role

The Financial Reporting team supports the accuracy, integrity, and transparency of Stitch Fix’s financial reporting and accounting processes. As a Senior Accountant, Financial Reporting, you will play a key hands-on role across external reporting, technical accounting, equity accounting, and certain general accounting activities.

You’ll partner closely with Accounting, Legal, Finance, Investor Relations, and external auditors to support accurate and timely reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP and SEC requirements. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and approaches their work with a focus on accuracy, continuous improvement, and adding value to the business.

What You’ll Do

• Prepare and support external filings and internal reporting, including Forms 10-Q, 10-K, and 8-K and earnings releases, drafting financial statements, footnotes, and supporting schedules in accordance with U.S. GAAP and SEC requirements and performing detailed tie-outs across reporting materials.

• Manage and support equity accounting under ASC 718, including monthly stock-based compensation journal entries, reconciliations, activity analysis, and related reporting.

• Research and analyze routine and emerging U.S. GAAP and SEC guidance, contribute to technical accounting memorandums, and support the implementation of new or evolving accounting requirements.

• Support external audits and SOX compliance by preparing documentation and audit schedules, responding to inquiries, maintaining internal control documentation, and partnering across teams to ensure reporting accuracy and financial integrity.

• Improve and automate financial reporting and accounting workflows by identifying process efficiencies and using tools such as Excel, Workiva, Oracle, Google Workspace, and emerging AI capabilities to enhance technical research, data analysis, reporting, and day-to-day productivity.

About You

This is what you’ll need to succeed in this role from day 1.

• You have 3+ years of progressive accounting experience, with experience in financial reporting and/or technical accounting, including required public accounting experience; Big Four experience is preferred.

• You have a strong foundation in U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements, with experience researching accounting guidance and contributing to technical accounting memorandums.

• You have general knowledge of stock-based compensation accounting under ASC 718 and experience supporting journal entries, reconciliations, or related accounting activities.

• You are highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate work within tight financial reporting deadlines.

• You have strong written and verbal communication skills and can translate complex accounting topics into clear, actionable information for different audiences.

• You are highly proficient in Microsoft Excel for data manipulation and complex analysis and are comfortable learning and applying new technologies, including AI and automation tools, to improve efficiency and outcomes.

• This position may require the ability to sit for extended periods of time, use a computer or other office equipment, and communicate effectively (verbal and written).

Nice to Have

• CPA license.

• Big Four public accounting experience.

• Experience with Workiva, Oracle, and/or Google Workspace.

• Experience supporting SEC filings, SOX compliance, external audits, or public-company financial reporting.

• Exposure to AI-enabled accounting, financial reporting, research, or workflow automation tools.

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description:
About the Role

Paraform is disrupting how companies hire — and we're looking for someone to help us hire the best people to do it. We're looking for an experienced, high-powered Recruiter who lives and breathes talent and is an expert working with early stage and high growth startups. You'll primarily be focused on sourcing top 1% talent to join the Paraform team, driving a culture of excellence, and supporting the company with everything else hiring-related as we rapidly scale.

You'll be hands-on sourcing, closing, and iterating on our process — while also laying the recruiting infrastructure that scales with us.



What You'll Do

 - Own full-cycle recruiting — from kickoff to close

 - Source proactively and build pipelines for hard-to-fill roles, with a bias toward finding non-obvious talent that others miss

 - Partner closely with hiring managers to deeply understand technical requirements, team dynamics, and what "great" actually looks like for each role

 - Define and continuously sharpen our interview process, scorecards, and candidate experience for technical hires

 - Build repeatable sourcing playbooks, calibration frameworks, and pipeline tracking that raise the bar over time

 - Serve as a genuine ambassador for Paraform's mission — you should be able to speak credibly about our product, our market, and why the best engineers should want to work here

 - Identify recruiting tooling, sourcing channels, and workflow improvements that increase quality and efficiency



What We're Looking For

 - 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally with 1+ year spent in-house at a high-growth, VC backed startup (Seed to Series C)

 - Proven track record closing strong candidates in a competitive market

 - Deep sourcing chops — you're not waiting on inbound; you know how to find people and get them interested

 - High ownership mentality and comfort operating without a playbook

 - Builder mindset — excited to create process and structure where there isn't any

 - Strong experience building and maintaining relationships with hiring managers and other key stakeholders

 - Familiarity with the recruiting industry or marketplace businesses is a plus (and genuinely interesting to us)


ABOUT PARAFORM

Paraform is the first end-to-end AI recruiting marketplace, modernizing one of the largest and most fragmented markets in the world: hiring. We connect companies with thousands of specialized recruiters and AI agents that work together to fill roles faster and more accurately.

We believe recruiting works best when human judgment is paired with AI that truly understands hiring. That's why we treat recruiters like entrepreneurs, not vendors, and build the financial, operational, and technical infrastructure that powers their success.

Industry leaders like Decagon, Palantir, Rippling, Abridge, and Hightouch hire through Paraform, and we grew revenue 8× last year. We're backed by Scale, Felicis, A*, BOND, Liquid 2, DST Global, and the founders of YouTube, Instacart, Canva, and more.

Our mission is to make hiring fast, reliable, and scalable for every company in the world. For more on where we're headed, read our company vision https://www.paraform.com/blog/the-talent-company.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Advanced Analytics & AI Enablement
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Director, US Commercial Analytics, the Associate Director, Advanced Analytics & AI Enablement will own the specialist predictive and causal methods that improve targeting, promotional investment, and commercial decisions across Revolution Medicines' portfolio. As RevMed prepares for overlapping launches across multiple cancers, many priority HCPs are likely to be relevant to more than one brand, making it essential to determine which customers to prioritize, for which brands, and at what level of investment.

This is a build role. You will establish patient identification and predictive targeting capability, stand up promotional-effectiveness and marketing-mix measurement, and define the model governance standards that keep methodological ownership inside RevMed. You will also partner on AI-enabled analytics products that move the organization toward trusted, self-service access to commercial data.

This role is ideal for a hands-on quantitative leader who wants to see models activated in real workflows. This position is based out of our headquarters in Redwood City, CA.

Responsibilities

• Patient identification and predictive targeting. Develop and validate patient identification and treatment-progression models using claims, lab, and EHR-derived data; build HCP opportunity, propensity, and affinity scores that inform field and omnichannel targeting across brands.

• Promotional effectiveness and investment optimization. Own marketing-mix modeling, execution, and interpretation, including budget and allocation scenarios that inform portfolio promotional investment decisions.

• Attribution, causal inference, and incrementality. Lead studies that quantify the true commercial impact of promotional activity, applying appropriate causal methods and clearly communicating assumptions and uncertainty.

• Segmentation and next-best-action methods. Develop segmentation, affinity, and next-best-action approaches that support cross-brand customer prioritization where target populations overlap.

• Model governance and lifecycle management. Establish validation standards, monitoring scorecards, and refresh cadences for deployed models; decide when a model should scale, be retrained, or be retired based on performance and business impact.

• AI enablement for analytics. Partner on AI-enabled analytics use cases, including conversational analytics on commercial dashboards; support metric certification and semantic consistency so AI-delivered answers rest on governed definitions.

• Activation and measurement. Partner with Brand Analytics on use-case definition and with Omnichannel Analytics on how model outputs are activated in journeys and triggers and how intervention success is measured.

• Collaboration. Partner day-to-day with other analytics leads for routine campaign reporting, field and access dashboards, and production data engineering owned by Information Systems.

• Technical self-sufficiency and reuse. Work hands-on in SQL and Python notebooks to query, prototype, and productionize analyses in a modern cloud data platform environment.

• Other duties as assigned including travel as needed.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor's degree in a Science, engineering, or business discipline required, with 6+ years of progressive experience applying advanced analytics in Pharma/Biotech or a comparable commercial environment.

• Demonstrated ownership of predictive modeling and causal methods, including propensity and prediction models, attribution, incrementality, and marketing-mix modeling.

• Deep knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial data assets, including claims, lab, prescription, HCP and account, CRM, and digital engagement data.

• Strong hands-on technical skills in Python or R and SQL, with experience working in cloud analytics environments such as Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable platforms.

• Experience taking models from concept through validation, activation, and monitoring in real business workflows.

• Ability to explain method choice, assumptions, and uncertainty to non-technical commercial leaders and influence decisions accordingly.

• Extensive secondary analytical skills required; ability to translate data and insights into actionable recommendations for business growth.

• Strong problem solver with experience leveraging a variety of research and analytical vendors, study designs, and building quality vendor partnerships.

• Genuine enthusiasm for hands-on technical work: writing SQL and Python in notebook environments, working directly in a modern cloud data platform, and building reusable, well-documented analytical assets.

• Demonstrated use of generative AI tools to accelerate analytical work, such as conversational analytics agents, notebook and code assistants, or comparable capabilities.

• Entrepreneurial mindset, with a tolerance for ambiguity, and a passion for helping cancer patients.

Preferred Skills:

• Advanced degree (MS, PhD, MBA, or equivalent) in statistics, data science, economics, engineering, or a related quantitative field, with 8+ years of progressive experience.

• Targeted oncology or specialty-therapeutics experience, particularly in biomarker-driven markets.

• Experience deploying next-best-action or decisioning frameworks in an omnichannel context.

• Familiarity with conversational analytics, semantic layers, or large language model-based analytics tooling.

• Experience with common commercial data and technology ecosystems such as IQVIA, Komodo, Veeva, Databricks, ThoughtSpot, or Power BI.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Critical Harm Operations
jobs.description:
About the Team

Critical Harm Operations sits within User Safety & Risk Operations and builds enforcement systems for Frontier Risk and Material Harm that are accurate, fast, defensible, and built to scale. We turn policy intent into operational readiness, review standards, quality systems, escalation paths, automation guardrails, and durable cross-functional operating models.

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional Program Manager to help build durable operating systems and run some of OpenAI’s most complex safety operations. The core need is a high-agency operator who can take an ambiguous problem, create the right structure, align cross-functional partners, and drive the work through execution.

This role will move across Critical Harm priorities as needs evolve. You may step into operationalizing national security or violent-activities workflows, support wellbeing and Frontier Risk initiatives, or help scale programs such as Trusted Access. Deep domain expertise is helpful but not required; the strongest candidates will learn quickly, exercise excellent judgment, and make complex programs move.

This Toronto-based role is currently remote and is expected to transition to an in-office arrangement by end of year.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead strategic operational builds across priority workflows from problem statement to implemented operating model, including scope, owners, milestones, risks, success measures, and execution cadence.

 - Translate policy, safety, technical, legal, and operational constraints into workflows, requirements, playbooks, escalation paths, and decision-making structures that teams can execute.

 - Coordinate with User Ops leadership, Product Policy, Integrity, Safety Systems, i2, Legal, Product, Engineering, Support, vendors, and other partners to resolve dependencies and keep critical work moving.

 - Move in and out of workflows as priorities shift—standing up new programs, stabilizing operations, improving handoffs, and transitioning durable ownership to the right team.

 - Use operational data and frontline signals to identify bottlenecks, quality gaps, capacity needs, ownership failures, and the highest-leverage interventions.

 - Drive high-priority escalations and cross-functional decisions to closure, ensuring the right context, accountable owners, clear next steps, and durable follow-up.

 - Create the mechanisms that make programs run well: roadmaps, decision logs, status updates, risk registers, operating reviews, and crisp executive communication.

 - Identify where AI tools, automation, lightweight systems, or simpler workflows can improve speed, consistency, and scale while preserving appropriate human judgment.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 8+ years of experience in program management, strategy and operations, product operations, technical program management, trust and safety, support operations, risk operations, implementation, or a related field.

 - Experience in cybersecurity, biosecurity, or related risk and safety operations is a plus

 - Have a track record of taking complex, ambiguous work from problem framing through launch and scaled operation.

 - Are unusually organized, sharp, and execution-focused; you can manage many moving pieces without losing the few decisions that matter most.

 - Build trust and drive alignment across teams without direct authority, while keeping ownership, accountability, and escalation paths clear.

 - Operate calmly and flexibly in a fast-moving environment, learn new domains quickly, and are comfortable handling high-severity or sensitive work.

 - Experience with vendor operations, QA programs, launch readiness, workflow automation, or AI-assisted operations.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Networking (Agent Infra)
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

Every agent on Baseten Sandboxes runs in its own microVM. Agents call models, reach tools and APIs, expose services, and more and more often talk to each other. Networking built into today's cloud providers was not designed for very large numbers of isolated machines that suspend, resume, and exchange data constantly.

The Agent Infra team builds its own networking stack for sandboxes, designed from the start for that scale. It runs in user space, with VPP (FD.io http://FD.io) as its main data plane technology, and is built from virtualized network functions (VNF/NFV): carrier-grade, low-latency packet processing designed for very large numbers of agents. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose sandboxes, storage, and networking are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes.

You'll build multi-tenant virtual private networking that connects each customer's agents and services privately and securely, using modern overlay technologies.

We are building a cloud, not just using one. We want engineers who expose the network as a programmable API and write the code, not operators who push router and switch configuration. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs.

This role is separate from Baseten's GPU-to-GPU networking. Here you'll own how sandboxes connect to each other, to Baseten services, to customer networks, and to the internet.

If you've built user-space data planes, virtualized network functions, or multi-tenant cloud networking and want to design one for agents, we'd love to talk.



EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

 - Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/

 - Securing the open frontier with NVIDIA OpenShell and Blaxel sandboxes https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-carbon/

 - Baseten Sandboxes documentation https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and build the user-space, VPP-based data plane that connects microVM sandboxes to each other, to Baseten services, and to the internet

 - Build multi-tenant virtual private networking and overlays (for example EVPN, GENEVE, VXLAN) across regions

 - Expose the network as a programmable API that the rest of the platform calls

 - Cut latency and raise connection scale for agent-to-agent and agent-to-service traffic

 - Build routing that sends each request to the nearest region and keeps connections working as sandboxes suspend and resume

 - Build secure ingress and egress for sandboxes, including firewalling, static egress IPs, and custom domains with managed TLS

 - Build L7 proxies for request inspection, filtering, secret injection, and auditing

 - Own per-sandbox addressing, including IPv6, and network isolation between tenants

 - Build observability for the packet path across guest, host, and network, and debug production issues end to end

 - Work closely with the compute, storage, GPU infrastructure, and datacenter teams



REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience with user-space packet processing (DPDK, VPP, or similar) or virtualized network functions (VNF/NFV)

 - Experience building multi-tenant networking in production (VXLAN, GENEVE, VRF)

 - Experience building a software-defined network, overlay network, or packet-processing data plane in production

 - You write production code: strong systems programming in Rust, Go, and/or C/C++. Network architects are welcome if they build, not only configure

 - Experience building cloud networking as the provider, not only consuming a cloud provider's network

 - Solid grounding in TCP/IP and routing

 - Experience building or operating proxies, load balancers, or L4/L7 gateways at scale

 - Experience debugging latency and throughput problems with packet captures, tracing, and profiling

 - You move fast and like owning a problem end to end on a small team



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with VPP / FD.io http://FD.io, our main networking technology

 - Experience with GENEVE or VXLAN overlays and EVPN

 - Linux kernel networking: eBPF/XDP, netfilter or nftables, network namespaces

 - Familiarity with virtual machine networking: virtio-net, vhost, TAP devices, or networking for Firecracker or Cloud Hypervisor

 - Experience running IPv6 at scale

 - Background in telecom user-plane or 5G core networking, or in low-latency trading networks

 - Experience with multi-region traffic routing, anycast, or BGP

 - Experience with TLS termination, DNS, and egress security controls



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

You will collaborate with experienced employment counsel on US and international employment issues, the employment aspects of mergers and acquisitions, and emerging questions about AI in the workplace. A central part of your work will be turning lessons from individual matters into practical policies, guidance, and approaches that work at scale. You will also own stakeholder relationships and manage counseling matters, exercising sound judgment and taking responsibility for outcomes. You will join a bright, collaborative team that values initiative and shared learning, with opportunities to learn from senior colleagues, deepen your expertise, and take on increasingly complex matters over time.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.



In this role, you will:

 - Collaborate with senior employment counsel and cross-functional partners on a broad range of US employment matters, including recruiting and hiring, performance management, employee conduct, leaves of absence, accommodations, and separations.

 -  Own designated stakeholder relationships and counseling matters, providing clear, practical advice and working independently while drawing on the team’s experience and judgment as appropriate.

 - Advise on international employment matters and support the employment aspects of mergers and acquisitions, including diligence and workforce integration, collaborating with local and specialist counsel as appropriate.

 -  Partner on strategic projects and emerging legal questions, including the use of AI in employment and workplace practices.

 - Translate legal developments and lessons from your work into useful guidance, training, brown bags, and office hours for stakeholders across the company.

Troveo indexes, enriches, and packages this high-quality data into formats ready for training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and agentic use cases. Backed by top investors, we’re a small, high-impact team solving one of the biggest bottlenecks in AI development.

You will own the full analytics data lifecycle, from ingestion and transformation to modeling, quality assurance, and timely delivery, while partnering closely with software engineers and business stakeholders.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Compute and Isolation
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

Every agent on Baseten Sandboxes gets its own microVM, where it writes and runs code, calls tools, and keeps state across long tasks. Agents pause and resume constantly, so the machine underneath has to start, stop, snapshot, fork, and resume fast, and keep every tenant isolated while it does. General-purpose virtualization was not built for that workload.

The Agent Infra team builds that layer. Sandboxes run in microVMs with custom Linux kernels on bare-metal servers we operate. You'll own how sandboxes start, stop, snapshot, fork, and resume, and how they perform on each host's CPU and memory, down to the hardware. You'll also own the guest and host side of each sandbox: its identity, how it attaches to different storage classes for performance or capabilities, and the virtual devices that connect it securely to the network. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose microVM sandboxes are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes.

We are building a cloud, not just using one. That means designing for many tenants from day one and thinking through what each decision means all the way down to the datacenter. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs.

If you've worked deep in KVM and Firecracker, Cloud Hypervisor, or QEMU and want to build the computers AI agents run on, we'd love to talk.



EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

 - Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/

 - Securing the open frontier with NVIDIA OpenShell and Blaxel sandboxes https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-carbon/

 - Baseten Sandboxes documentation https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the microVM lifecycle for agent sandboxes: start, stop, suspend, resume, snapshot, and fork

 - Build and tune the custom guest kernels sandboxes run on

 - Tune host CPU and memory configuration so sandboxes run fast and safely on each type of hardware we operate

 - Manage host-level resources and sandbox density on each machine

 - Own startup and resume performance end to end, from VM boot or snapshot restore to the first command

 - Own the guest and host side of each sandbox: its identity, how it attaches to storage, and the virtual devices that connect it to the network

 - Design isolation for multi-tenant workloads where the hypervisor is the security boundary

 - Debug virtualization and isolation issues at scale, from userspace through the kernel to the hardware

 - Contribute architecture decisions and code back to the open-source projects we build on



REQUIREMENTS

 - Hands-on experience with KVM, plus Firecracker, Cloud Hypervisor, or QEMU

 - Deep understanding of Linux internals: namespaces, cgroups, memory management, and the boot path

 - Experience building cloud infrastructure as the provider (multi-tenant compute that customers run on), not only running workloads on a cloud provider

 - Experience building multi-tenant infrastructure where isolation is a security boundary

 - Strong systems programming background in Rust and/or Go; C/C++ also welcome

 - Experience debugging performance and correctness problems across userspace and kernel boundaries

 - You move fast and like owning a problem end to end on a small team



NICE TO HAVE

jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, US Commercial Analytics, the Associate Director, Omnichannel Analytics will own the measurement strategy and optimization agenda for how Revolution Medicines engages healthcare professionals across channels. As RevMed scales from a single approved medicine to a multi-brand portfolio spanning pancreatic and lung cancers, customer engagement is increasingly orchestrated across field, email, media, web, and other channels, and the analytical logic connecting those channels to commercial outcomes needs a dedicated owner.

This is a rare opportunity to define and build an omnichannel measurement capability during live launches. You will build the KPI frameworks, trigger and journey effectiveness methods, and experimentation agenda that determine how, when, and through which channel RevMed reaches its customers, and you will present those recommendations directly to Brand, Marketing, and Commercial leadership.

This role is ideal for a hands-on analytics leader who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and is passionate about using data to drive meaningful impact. This position is based out of our headquarters in Redwood City, CA.

Responsibilities

• Omnichannel measurement strategy. Own and evolve the omnichannel and non-personal promotion (NPP) measurement roadmap across the portfolio, including measurement frameworks, KPI definitions, and standardized performance readouts aligned to brand and marketing decision cycles.

• Journey and trigger effectiveness. Own the analytical evaluation of trigger logic - eligibility, suppression, lookback windows, signal volume, and downstream field or digital action - and recommend changes to journey design based on relevance, timeliness, and measured impact.

jobs.title: Technical Project Lead, Data Privacy
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

We are building Protege to solve the biggest unmet need in AI — getting access to the right training data. The process today is time intensive, incredibly expensive, and often ends in failure. The Protege platform facilitates the secure, efficient, and privacy-centric exchange of AI training data.

Solving AI’s data problem is a generational opportunity. We’re backed by world-class investors and already powering partnerships with some of the most ambitious teams in AI. The company that succeeds will be one of the largest in AI — and in tech.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, high-trust team of builders who are obsessed with velocity and impact. Our culture is built for people who thrive on ambiguity, own outcomes, and want to shape the future of data and AI.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Healthcare data only becomes AI training data once patient privacy is protected to a standard an independent expert will certify, while keeping the clinical detail that makes it worth training on. Black out too little and patients are exposed. Black out too much and the data loses its value.



No single tool gets this right, because every dataset is different. A radiology report, a handwritten prior-authorization fax and a veterinarian's notes each fail in their own ways. So we've built a practice instead of a product. It combines off-the-shelf tools, custom rules, language models and human review, tunes the mix for each dataset, and proves the result with the kind of statistical validation an auditor would accept. It has cleared every recent independent review with zero failures.



You'll run it. You'll lead engagements from the first look at a new dataset to certified delivery, make the calls on what's safe to ship, and improve the method with every engagement.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead data privacy projects from first look to certified delivery: assess the data, write the policy, tune the pipeline, validate, and deliver.

 - Design and run the experiments that decide which layers a dataset needs, measuring recall, over-redaction and cost for each.

 - Run validation the way an auditor would: set the pass bar before you look, test on fresh held-out samples, report confidence bounds, and never fix the test set.

 - Turn every miss into a lasting fix (a rule, a model or prompt change, or a human-review step) and lock it in with a regression test.

 - Work directly with independent expert determiners: prepare evidence, answer methodology questions, and respond to findings.

 - Direct human reviewers on the hard cases and adjudicate their disagreements.

 - Evaluate new tools and models (open-source NER, vendor APIs, models that run inside a partner's own environment) against our benchmarks.

 - Write down what you learn so the next engagement starts ahead of the last one.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - 30 days: learn the method. You know the playbook and tooling, you've shadowed a live engagement, and you've delivered your first intake assessment of a new partner's data.

 - 60 days: share the load. You've co-led an engagement through validation, owned the experiment that set its pipeline, and added new rules with regression tests.

 - 90 days: own it. You've led an engagement end to end, including the evidence package for the expert reviewer, and you've evaluated a candidate model with a clear keep-or-drop recommendation.


WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

 - Minimum 2 years in data science, applied statistics, ML engineering, or quantitative research, working with real, messy data.

 - Solid statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, measurement design and inter-rater agreement. You can explain why a sample is big enough, and what it can't tell you.

 - Strong background, and experience using language models or AI coding tools to move fast.

 - Healthy skepticism. You verify claims before trusting them, including your own.

 - Clear writing for technical and non-technical readers, including external reviewers.

 - Authorization to work in the U.S. as a W2 employee (required for access to protected health information).



Nice to have

 - HIPAA de-identification experience (Safe Harbor or expert determination), or other privacy or healthcare data work

 - NER, OCR, clinical NLP or document processing

 - Working with auditors, regulators or external reviewers

 - Running annotation or labeling projects


PROTEGE VALUES

Pass the Loved Ones' Test. We act with integrity and do the right thing — especially when it's hard and no one is watching.

Always Find a Way. We are resourceful, resilient builders who solve hard problems and push through obstacles.

Go Fast and Grow Fast. Velocity matters. We move with urgency, learn quickly, and continuously improve as individuals and as a company.

Practice Kindness and Candor. We communicate directly and respectfully, building trust through honest feedback and genuine care for one another.

Deliver Together. We win as one team. Collaboration, accountability, and shared ownership drive our success.

Own the Outcome. Hone the Craft. We take pride in our work, sweat the details, and continuously raise the bar for excellence.

We believe robots should be the next chapter in making physical labor safer and more affordable. But, nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t have a single robot. Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, we do it all in-house: the robotics hardware, the machine learning, and the field deployment and service. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.
 
Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.
 
The Role
Tutor is hiring a Head of Technical Operations. This person owns manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field service, and robot operations, and reports to the CTO.

·         Honoring the inherent dignity of those we serve, affirming their capabilities and fostering their hope that a better life is possible. 
·         Building strong, caring and trauma-informed communities through the integration of housing, health care and supportive services. 
·         Advocating for social and racial equity, inclusion and diversity, and challenging the status quo in partnership with our workforce members and those we serve. 
·         Achieving excellence through continuous quality assurance, innovation and professional development. 
·         Using resources judiciously and effectively.
