jobs.title: Sales, Channel - National Partners
jobs.description:
The largest solution providers in the industry (WWT, CDW, Presidio, ePlus, Insight, SHI, Trace3 and others) are trusted by enterprises and public sector organizations to design, deploy, and manage their technology environments. These partners influence billions of dollars in technology decisions each year and are uniquely positioned to bring Meter's networking platform to the accounts that need it most.

Legacy networking vendors rely on fragmented hardware and software stacks that create operational complexity for both VAR sellers and their customers. Meter's full-stack, subscription-based networking solution aligns with how national VARs sell outcomes, and simplifies how organizations design, deploy, and operate their networks.

Your primary goal is to build high-performing partnerships across the national VAR landscape that drive consistent partner-sourced revenue. You will deepen Meter's presence within the sales, engineering, and services teams at our top VAR partners and turn that alignment into qualified pipeline and closed business.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

This role will be successful by driving incremental pipeline, deal registration activity, and substantial closed-won revenue through VAR-led opportunities, ultimately establishing Meter as a strategic networking partner across the national VAR community.

You'll quickly align with our Enterprise and Majors salesforce to identify where our top VAR partners are engaged with open opportunities or cover territories where they have a major presence. You'll build a consistent motion across partners rather than a one-off playbook, and develop a tiered approach that prioritizes the highest-potential relationships while maintaining broad coverage.

You'll deepen relationships with account teams, technical architects, and leadership at WWT, CDW, Presidio, ePlus, Insight, SHI, Trace3 and emerging partners, driving awareness, adoption, and credibility by articulating how Meter's unified hardware, software, and operations create superior results for enterprise customers.

Through these relationships, you will identify high-fit customers across each partner's book of business, create early success stories that demonstrate measurable outcomes, and build repeatable frameworks that allow each partnership to scale.

Over time, you will own the national VAR partner strategy and help drive the long-term roadmap for how Meter goes to market through the solution provider ecosystem.




WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

 - Partner closely with Meter's Enterprise and Major Account teams to manage VAR-sourced opportunities from qualification to close.

 - Support VAR sellers and technical architects during opportunity discovery, network design discussions, quoting, and deployment planning.

 - Deliver ongoing enablement sessions across partner regions and practices, focusing on how Meter solves operational and lifecycle challenges for enterprise customers.

 - Meet regularly with leadership, partner management, and engineering groups at each priority VAR to maintain alignment and uncover new opportunities.

 - Build and execute joint business plans with each major partner, including pipeline targets, enablement calendars, and co-marketing activities.

 - Participate in partner-hosted customer events, workshops, briefings, and technology center sessions to increase visibility and pipeline creation.

 - Collaborate with Partner Marketing and Partner Enablement on joint campaigns, training programs, and incentives that drive activity and engagement across the VAR landscape.

 - Track partner performance by account, forecast accurately, and remove operational blockers to ensure deals progress smoothly.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You have deep experience working across national VARs (WWT, CDW, Presidio, ePlus, Insight, SHI, Trace3 or similar) and understand both their seller-led and architect-led motions.

 - You have a strong track record of building partner-sourced revenue at scale across multiple, complex partner organizations simultaneously.

 - You know how to prioritize across a broad portfolio of relationships and can develop a tiered strategy that drives outsized results from the highest-potential partners without losing momentum elsewhere.

 - You are comfortable with technical concepts, can quickly learn networking fundamentals, and can communicate them clearly to both sales and engineering audiences.

 - You can build trust quickly with stakeholders at all levels and influence decisions through clear, credible communication.

 - You have a high sense of urgency and focus on activities that move opportunities forward.

 - You enjoy travel and value in-person relationship building as a core part of partner success.

 - You are comfortable in the ambiguity of early-stage go-to-market and can bring structure and repeatability to a fast-moving channel model.




WHY METER?

The internet runs the world. Every email you send, purchase you make, video call you join—it’s all packets flowing through networks. But those networks haven’t changed for decades. They’re brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.

We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground-up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale. Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, Reddit, rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.

Our bet with Meter is simple: we will all use the internet more than we do today. We believe we have the definitive networking stack in place to enable business to do so as seamlessly and reliably as any modern utility.




COMPENSATION

 - The estimated salary range for this role is $132,000 - $180,000.

 - Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Meter's equity plan.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Senior Product Managers at Blink are innovators, craftspeople and business thinkers. Your job as a Sr Product Manager is to take ownership over our hardest problems, envision and refine strategic solutions, and drive execution like an entrepreneur. You will collaborate closely with a talented, cross-functional team of engineers, designers, product managers, data scientists, marketers, and operators. Through these partnerships, you’ll grow our business, build our core platform, and - above all - make sure that our customers have access to the least expensive and highest satisfaction pharmacy experience on earth.

At Blink, we determine the specific focus of product roles through the interview process. Key potential areas of ownership include: our telemedicine platform; our home delivery experience; our growth team; our core cloud pharmacy platform; new product line development and strategic platforms. We’ll work with you to find the right fit. All PM roles include driving product strategy, roadmapping, rapid testing and research, release planning, experimentation and analysis. PMs are expected to become true experts in pharmacy systems - so that we can transform them. And they are expected to become experts in our customers - so that we can provide a truly unparalleled experience to them.

While this role is based in India, you will work on global products that require partnership with teams across regions. We are also aggressively growing our teams in India and this role will be one of our founding product based roles here.

About You

• Experienced - you have 6+ years as a product manager, either with strong consumer or deep platform experience.

• Proven Builder - you have delivered multiple successful and innovative products from ‘0 to 1 to n’. You can point directly to growth/engagement/success metrics on these products.

• Consumer-Obsessed - you always think first about the consumer, hunt for empathy, and do everything possible to give the customer the best possible experience.

• Analytical - you naturally break hard problems into their pieces, are deeply familiar with best-in-class experimentation practices, use key results to drive strategies, and basically just measure everything.

• Driven and Biased-to-Action - you can manage through complexity, lead with influence, make hard decisions, and persevere when things are challenging. You are hungry to win and you have the grit to make it happen.

• Collaborative and Communicative - you love being part of a diverse team, building consensus, and establishing credibility. You are a Class-A communicator: curious, thoughtful, clear, and (mostly) correct.

• Technical - an engineering background/skills are highly preferred for Product roles at Blink. You will work closely with engineering teams and will need to appreciate technical nuances of the solutions being built.

• BE/B Tech degree from top institution; MBA or Computer Science degree preferred but not mandatory.

Why Join Us:

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.

jobs.title: Content & Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
Content & Engagement Manager

Position: Full-Time

Location: Remote

OVERVIEW

Movement Strategy is seeking a Content & Engagement Manager to support content development, publishing, and community engagement within a Pod. In this role, you will help manage day-to-day social content execution, support audience engagement strategy, maintain brand voice consistency, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver cohesive social programs.

Reporting to a Senior Content & Engagement Manager or Associate Director of C&E, you bring strong platform instincts, attention to detail, and an enthusiasm for social culture. You will support content planning, calendar execution, real-time engagement, and publishing workflows that drive brand relevance and performance.

Content & Engagement Managers are the face and voice of today’s largest brands. They are social media experts, master storytellers, brand strategists, content producers, and publishers all in one. Applicants should be passionate about the digital-social landscape, always thinking about how people and brands can connect, and excited to join a team that fosters growth and creativity.

A BIT ABOUT US

Movement Strategy creates content and campaigns for the world’s most exciting brands. We win awards, make headlines, shatter engagement numbers and celebrate the journey along the way. It’s why companies like Netflix, Amazon, Spotify, and Intuit come to us again and again.

We’re fully remote with hubs in New York, Denver, and LA, and a presence all across the US. We believe collaboration is what takes our work from good to great, and at times, even to legendary status. We champion diverse opinions and creativity in every department, and provide professional development and learning opportunities with the goal of helping you discover your best work today, and learn how to make it even better in the future.

KEY FOCUS AREAS

Pod & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Support C&E needs within the Pod, collaborating with Account, Creative, Strategy, Project Management, Influencer, Paid Media, and Analytics partners.

• Participate in Pod rituals (standups, reviews, planning sessions) and provide updates on content status, timing, and engagement needs.

• Help maintain day-to-day clarity around content execution, publishing steps, and engagement tasks.

• Ensure C&E workflows integrate smoothly with Creative, Strategy, PM, and production partners.

• Support senior C&E team members by helping maintain documentation, content trackers, and team resources.

• Provide thoughtful feedback and collaborate with peers to deliver high-quality content.

• Contribute positively to team culture through organization, communication, and reliability.

Discipline Execution

• Execute Pod-specific workflows including publishing, content calendars, and community response frameworks.

• Maintain quality control for accuracy, tone, and brand alignment across assigned deliverables.

• Flag issues, risks, or platform considerations to senior C&E team members.

• Speak confidently to platform best practices, native trends, features, and updates across major platforms, and translate them into actionable recommendations for the brand.

• Develop POVs tailored to clients from start to finish, with support from senior C&E leadership.

Content & Calendar Management

• Manage day-to-day content calendars across assigned platforms.

• Build drafts, source assets, update links/docs, and ensure alignment to strategy and brand voice.

• Write and adapt copy in a brand’s voice across platforms, including TikTok + IG nuances.

• Support planning for seasonal, cultural, and reactive content moments.

• Collaborate with Creative partners by providing context, platform guidance, and executional needs.

• Support the creation of content briefs and collaborate with Creative, Strategy, and Data & Insights to ensure content is informed by performance, trends, and client objectives.

• Help plan key dates, cultural moments, and strategic beats within the content calendar.

• Monitor client approvals to prevent publishing delays and communicate timing updates to internal teams.

• Recommend adjustments to the calendar when approvals or production timelines shift.

Engagement Execution & Brand Stewardship

• Execute community management using approved brand voice guidelines and tone frameworks.

• Surface notable conversations, risks, and opportunities to senior C&E leads.

• Support development of community POVs and escalation documentation.

• Identify culturally relevant, real-time engagement opportunities and route for approval.

Social Reporting & Insights

• Pull data cutdowns, screenshots, examples, and qualitative observations for reporting.

• Help synthesize learnings with direction from senior C&E and Analytics partners.

QUALIFICATIONS + KEY FOCUS AREAS

• 3+ years experience in social content creation, community management, or publishing.

• Strong working knowledge of major platforms (IG, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, X).

• Experience supporting content calendars, drafting posts, monitoring comments, and executing publishing workflows.

• Strong writing skills and the ability to adopt brand voice consistently.

• Comfort collaborating across cross-functional teams.

• Familiarity with tools such as Asana, Airtable, Sprinklr, Dash Hudson, Canva, and Figma.

• A creative background is welcome (no formal requirements).

• Passionate about pop culture and social media trends; actively follows category trends, platform features, and breakthrough social campaigns.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills; ability to understand what works vs. what doesn’t.

• Experience preparing client-ready documents or communications.

• Ability to work flexible hours (weekends, holidays, early mornings/evenings) when needed for real-time culture.

IDEAL QUALITIES

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable.

• Strong communicator who can adapt tone quickly and accurately.

• Curious about social culture, eager to learn, and proactive in surfacing new ideas.

• A collaborative team player who contributes positively to Pod culture.

• Comfortable in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities.

• Treats the client’s business with care, ownership, and pride.

Benefits & Perks

Movement Strategy’s approach to the future of work: We embrace a remote culture and empower our employees to work wherever they feel most productive. To facilitate in-person collaboration, we have a partnership with WeWork which allows our employees to have a membership to any location nationwide.

As a leader in social advertising, we rely on the creativity of our people to deliver the best work for our clients. In return, we invest in our employees by offering them a diverse suite of benefits from best-in-class carriers, with enough choice and flexibility to keep our team and their families healthy and happy today and tomorrow.

• 100% employer contribution for health (base plan), vision, and dental

• 401K Retirement Plan with Company Match

• Short and Long Term Disability

• Life Insurance & AD&D

• Paid Parental Leave

• Fully-Remote Agency

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Take-As-You-Need Paid Time Off

• Take-As-You-Need Paid Mental Health Days

• 10 days minimum required off per year

• Company Paid Holidays

• Week-Long Winter Agency Closure

• Support for continued education

• New Business Referral Bonus

• Movement Journey Program - Stipend for personal growth

• Health and Wellness Program

• WeWork Membership

• Positive Impact and Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) Committees

• Employee Resource Groups

SALARY & COMPENSATION

In compliance with local and state law, we are disclosing the compensation for roles that will be performed in New York City, Colorado, and California. The range listed is just one component of Movement Strategy’s total compensation package for employees.  Individual compensation varies based on location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards.

A successful applicant’s actual base salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, skill sets, years of relevant experience, qualifications, and certifications or other professional licenses held. Movement Strategy prides itself on providing competitive salaries and actively works to ensure there is pay equity across the company.

Pay Range: $75,000 - $85,000 salary per year

Movement Strategy is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they check every single box. Movement Strategy is dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourages those from historically and systemically marginalized communities to apply.

We believe that what we put out into the world matters. And since we were founded on the principles of paving our own path, we take bold steps toward what we believe is the right direction. This means addressing the big stuff: the systems of inequality that impact some of us far more than others. As culture creators, we firmly believe we have a responsibility to our colleagues, clients, communities, and the industry to live up to the Movement’s name. We confront inequities head-on as they come, knowing that this work is never done and that we must keep the momentum.

jobs.title: Senior Contracts Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.




ABOUT YOUR ROLE

We are looking for a Contracts Manager or Sr. Contracts Manager to join Juniper Square. The successful candidate will partner closely with other department leaders with a focus on commercial contracting supporting our sales and go-to-market teams. We’re looking for a confident decision-maker with experience negotiating NDAs, SaaS EULAs, DPAs, Service Agreements, and SOWs. You should have excellent communication skills, be comfortable making decisions independently, and have experience reviewing, analyzing, and negotiating commercial agreements. Experience with both SaaS and Professional Services agreements is required.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Handle general contract inquiries and assist business development/sales teams with general questions regarding contract language, acceptable revisions, etc.

 - Review and negotiate contract changes requested by internal teams, vendors, and customers to ensure that contract activities are in full compliance with company requirements.

 - Perform due diligence review and oversight for new (and existing) third-party vendor services, including document coordination and analysis.

 - Enter, update, and report on data in our contract management tools.

 - Act as the central integration point for various company stakeholders in the contracting process.

 - This role will regularly interact with senior-level sales leaders, executives, and subject matter experts where business decisions impact legal risks.

 - Assist with contract processes in general, including form and playbook development, procedure and policy training, and support of our contract management workflows.

 - Perform other related duties as assigned.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - A Bachelor's degree or equivalent with ~5-12 years of experience negotiating complex software or software-as-a-service and consulting services contracts involving data rights, security, privacy, IP issues, and accurate SOWs.

 - Experience in-house within a technology company with a quarterly sales cycle.

 - You know business processes related to commercial contract practices in a sales-led environment and have experience improving them and training others on them.

 - Strong understanding of standard contract language and experience negotiating those terms.

 - Ability to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, and have strong attention to detail.

 - Ability to demonstrate creativity, critical thinking, initiative, and problem-solving skills.

 - Ability to manage multiple work streams and deliverables and coordinate across functional initiatives to meet deadlines.

 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving and fast-changing environment.

 - Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Ironclad) productively for day-to-day work: delegating recurring tasks, iterating through multi-turn prompts, and critically evaluating output.

 - Experience producing AI-powered work others reuse or run AI-enabled improvements with measurable outcomes.
   
   


BENEFITS

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $140,000 - $170,000 USD for Contracts Manager and $170,000 - $210,000 USD for Senior Contracts Manager. Actual title and base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.



Benefits include:

 - Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

 - Life insurance

 - Mental wellness coverage

 - Fertility and growing family support

 - Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

 - Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

 - Retirement saving plans

 - Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

 - Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Design and support custom NGS panel designs utilizing an existing design workflow to meet customers design goals (White Glove Service)

jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SIFT

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. Sift turns high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical systems. Teams use Sift to build and operate rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, defense platforms, and more.

Founded by former SpaceX engineers who built the tools behind Dragon and Starlink, Sift is building the data infrastructure to herald the AI era for physical systems.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Visual Designer to own and evolve Sift's external visual identity across our website, campaigns, sales materials, and product storytelling. You'll translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling visuals that help engineers and decision-makers understand our platform.



This is a hands-on role with significant creative ownership. You'll work closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, and leadership to build a consistent, recognizable brand while executing the day-to-day design work that supports our growth. You'll have agency support for larger projects, but you'll be the primary owner of Sift's visual design.



Our customers build rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, and other advanced hardware systems. We're looking for someone who is curious about this world, has exceptional visual craft, and can turn technical complexity into effective visual communication.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own the design and execution of Sift's external-facing materials, including website graphics, landing pages, campaigns, social content, presentations, and sales collateral.

 - Translate complex technical products and concepts into clear visual narratives, diagrams, illustrations, and product explainers.

 - Maintain and evolve Sift's visual identity, ensuring consistency and quality across digital, print, and presentation materials.

 - Develop scalable brand systems, templates, and reusable assets that enable the Marketing and Sales teams to move quickly without sacrificing quality.

 - Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Product to understand technical capabilities and communicate them effectively to engineering and business audiences.

 - Collaborate with external agencies and contractors on larger creative projects, providing direction and ensuring consistency with Sift's brand.

 - Own projects from initial concept through final production, balancing creative quality, business priorities, and deadlines.




REQUIRED SKILLS:

 - 3+ years of professional experience in visual, brand, or marketing design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality execution across multiple formats.

 - Experience designing for B2B technology companies, ideally including complex or technical products.

 - Strong visual design fundamentals, including typography, composition, color, layout, and information hierarchy.

 - Ability to translate abstract or technical concepts into clear, engaging visuals and compelling visual narratives.

 - Experience designing across multiple marketing channels, including websites, digital campaigns, presentations, and sales materials.

 - Proficiency in Figma and experience building reusable components, templates, and brand systems.

 - Ability to independently manage design projects from concept through production, with strong attention to detail and consistency.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain creative decisions, incorporate feedback, and work effectively with cross-functional teams.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience designing for developer tools, infrastructure software, aerospace, defense, robotics, or other technical industries.

 - Experience creating technical illustrations, product diagrams, data visualizations, or other complex visual explainers.

 - Motion design, animation, or video editing experience.

 - Experience with Webflow, Framer, HTML/CSS, or other web design and development tools.

 - Experience establishing or evolving a brand identity at an early-stage startup.

 - Experience using AI-assisted creative tools to explore concepts, generate assets, or accelerate design workflows.



Portfolio Required: Please include a link to your portfolio or relevant design work. Applications without visual work samples will not be considered.




LOCATION:

Sift’s headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA (Next to LAX). We collaborate in person twice a week in our Los Angeles or San Francisco office—on Mondays and Thursdays—and come together for a full week in LA once every quarter. We are open to relocating candidates to work from either office for the right candidate.

Salary range: $125,000 - $190,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.




ELIGIBILITY:

U.S. Person Required: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident (Green Card Holder), or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.

jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

Employment type:

• Full time

What you'll be working on:

• Managing a patient panel with a broad array of patient needs; conducting a mix of acute, chronic, and well visits

• Treating patients in-office or in testing centers as well as conducting occasional tele-health visits

• Continuous learning during weekly Clinical Rounds and through other modalities

• Ongoing collaboration with in-office teammates via daily huddles, as well as with virtual clinical teams

• Utilization of your specific clinical training and opportunities to perform in-office procedures

• Supervising one or more NP or PA colleagues

Education, licenses, and experiences required for this role:

• Enrolled in, or have completed, an accredited Internal or Family Medicine residency program

• Practiced at least 2 of the last 5 years in an outpatient primary care setting

• Board Certified in Internal or Family Medicine, or Board Eligible with plans to obtain board certification within 1 year of your One Medical start date

• State licensed in California, obtained before your One Medical start date

One Medical providers also demonstrate:

• A passion for human-centered primary care

• The ability to successfully communicate with and provide care to individuals of all backgrounds

• The ability to effectively use technology to deliver high quality care

• Clinical proficiency in evidence-based primary care

• The desire to be an integral part of a team dedicated to changing healthcare delivery

• An openness to feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into strengths and weaknesses

• The ability to confidently navigate uncertain situations with both patients and colleagues

• Readiness to adapt personal and interpersonal behavior to meet the needs of our patients

This is a full-time role based in San Francisco, CA.

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The base salary range for this role is $308,700 - $369,000 based on a full-time schedule. • Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

jobs.title: Facilities Coordinator
jobs.location: Elk Grove, CA, USA; Sacramento, CA, USA; San Bernardino, CA, USA
jobs.description:
This is a hybrid role that requires regular travel to WelbeHealth sites within your assigned region, typically 1–3 times per week, as well as travel to another region approximately once per month for a same-day visit.

WelbeHealth is a value-based healthcare organization that’s transforming the future of senior care by providing an all-inclusive care option to our most vulnerable senior population. We step in as the care provider and care planner that work to keep our participants within their communities, out of institutions, and cared for like family, all while receiving the healthcare and social services needed to thrive.

The Facilities Coordinator is the primary point of contact for all building shell and Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) related items, and will also assist with setup and coordination of the Emergency Management Professional Program (EMPP) processes and procedures. WelbeHealth’s market leaders and respective Facilities Coordinators work closely together for all maintenance tasks, requests, and logistics. The Facilities Coordinator is accountable for executing all required preventative maintenance programs, tracking, scheduling Fire, Life, and Safety (FLS) recurring inspections, and scheduling follow-up repairs as required. The Facilities Coordinator maintains an annual budget per site, tracks both expected and unexpected expenses, and is the primary subject matter expert of their sites’ equipment.

This role is different because the Facilities Coordinator at WelbeHealth:

• Owns facilities operations across multiple PACE sites, providing hands-on oversight of building systems, maintenance, preventative maintenance, FLS requirements, vendors, and facility-related projects across an assigned market

• Plays a direct role in keeping our PACE centers safe, operational, and ready to serve participants, balancing day-to-day facility needs with long-term planning, budgets, repairs, replacements, and small capital projects

We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:

• Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days

• 401K savings + match

• Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus

• And additional benefits!

On the day-to-day, you will:

• Assist the Facilities Manager with tactical planning for the department’s annual goals, objectives, and KPIs

• Support critical requests or tasks from local market leadership

• Provide administrative support for schedule management and budget trackers (e.g., Excel spreadsheets, Smartsheet, Procore, MS Project)

• Ensure appropriate follow-up with end users, onsite leadership, and vendors

• Provide direction to vendors, market staff, leadership, and service providers as required to ensure excellent work order resolution

• Coordinate facility preparation including but not limited to supply orders, equipment training, clinic set up, kitchen set up, market-specific vendor identification, and orientation

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer - Enterprise
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Our mission is to reinvent the way people learn, starting with language.

Learning a language can change a life by opening doors to new cultures, careers, and communities. Two billion people around the world are actively trying to learn a language, but the best way to learn (one-on-one tutoring) is hard to access at scale and hasn’t been meaningfully improved in decades. Speak is building a human-level, AI-powered tutor in your pocket: a conversation-first experience that lets learners actually speak, get instant feedback, and progress through carefully designed lessons. The result is a complete path from beginner to confident speaker across multiple languages.

Speak first launched in South Korea in 2019, where Speak has now become the number one language learning app, and we now serve learners across many markets and 15+ languages. Speak is one of the world’s leading AI companies, with over $150m raised in venture investment from OpenAI, Accel, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and more, with a distributed team across San Francisco, Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei, and Ljubljana.



About This Role

We’re looking for a senior full-stack engineer to serve as a hands-on technical contributor for Speak for Business, the pod building the enterprise layer of Speak. You’ll work across the B2B product surface — partner portals, reporting, B2B subscription mechanics, admin experiences, and learner features that require an enterprise touch. You’ll work primarily in TypeScript across Node.js and Postgres, partnering with engineers in adjacent pods where experiences cross team boundaries.

You’ll turn product requirements and business goals into clear technical designs, contribute hands-on across the stack, and help set a high bar for architecture, reliability, and code quality on a small, fast-moving team. Near-term work includes B2B onboarding flows, partner-facing reporting, subscription and billing mechanics, and enterprise-ready features that support our growing Sales and CS motion.

What You’ll Be Doing

 - Building and owning full-stack features across the Speak for Business product surface, including partner portals, admin dashboards, reporting, and B2B subscription workflows

 - Designing and implementing backend services, APIs, and data models that support multi-tenant enterprise use cases

 - Leading cross-functional integrations across authentication, entitlements, billing, CRM, and analytics

 - Partnering closely with product, design, sales, and customer success to define scope and deliver end-to-end outcomes

 - Setting a high quality bar for privacy, security, observability, data integrity, and safe rollouts

 - Contributing to an AI-native development workflow — reviewing plans and designs before implementation, creating strong verification loops, and shipping safely with AI-assisted tooling

 - Mentoring engineers and raising the team’s bar for technical judgment and ownership

What We’re Looking For

 - 6+ years of experience building production-scale web applications, with strong proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL databases (Postgres preferred)

 - Full-stack capability — comfortable across both frontend and backend, with solid database fundamentals

 - Experience with or strong interest in B2B SaaS, enterprise product surfaces, or multi-tenant systems

 - Strong product and business judgment, with the ability to translate enterprise requirements into pragmatic scope and durable technical foundations

 - Experience designing APIs and backend services, reasoning clearly about system boundaries, and working with relational data

 - Ability to work autonomously and adapt quickly on a small team with low meeting overhead and high ownership expectations

 - Excellent cross-functional communication and a collaborative working style

 - Excitement about AI-assisted development, paired with thoughtful verification and a high production-quality bar

 - Nice to have:
   
   - Experience with multi-tenant B2B SaaS, SSO/SAML, billing, invoicing, or entitlements
   
   - Familiarity with admin dashboards, reporting, or analytics integrations
   
   - Experience with B2B account models, roles, or provisioning
   
   - CRM or marketing technology integrations
   
   - Experience building for both consumer and B2B surfaces




WHY WORK AT SPEAK

 1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

 2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

 3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, Tokyo, and Taipei, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

 4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

Speak does not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing electrical systems in commercial, and industrial settings. The Electrician will work under the supervision of the Facility Manager and will play a key role in ensuring that electrical systems operate safely and efficiently.

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!

jobs.title: Production Technician, Avionics
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Manufacturing Production team is responsible for a wide range of activities that are crucial to the manufacturing process including operating equipment, assembling products, performing quality control checks, and maintaining a safe and efficient work environment.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Production Technician to join our rapidly growing team in Santa Ana, CA. In this role, you will be responsible for assembly, integration, and testing of mechanical and electrical components in a R&D environment. If you are someone who is a highly motivated team player, willing to support a fast paced environment and detail oriented self starter with minimal oversight, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Follow detailed blueprints, schematics, wiring diagrams, and CAD models to assemble electronic and electro-mechanical systems

• Use hand tools and power tools, including soldering equipment, to build and integrate components

• Combine subsystems into larger, functioning avionics systems and ensure proper communication between integrated components

• Maintain detailed records of assembly processes, test results, and issues encountered

• Follow safety and ESD protocols in the workplace

• Possibility for overtime and weekend shifts as needed

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 2–4 years of experience in an ESD environment performing electrical and/or electro-mechanical assemblies (aerospace or electronics industry preferred)

• Proficient with hand tools and test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, calipers, and specialized test boxes

• Able to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, schematics, and wiring diagrams

• Ability to effectively communicate (verbal and written) with engineering and production

• Ability to rapidly adapt in a high-paced, challenging work environment

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience working in an R&D setting

• Demonstrated experience with avionics build, integration, and test

• Perform validation and testing of electronic components using multimeters, oscilloscopes, network analyzers, and test racks

• Demonstrated skills in low-level programming, soldering, harnessing, conformal coating, and staking

• Electronic box assembly troubleshooting and writing detailed issue tickets for failures

• Running functional checkouts, tests, and diagnosing issues

• Testing and running RF systems

• Loading firmware onto integrated digital systems

• Running LabView scripts

• PCBA integration and troubleshooting

• Basic understanding of LEAN manufacturing principles

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Willing to travel 15%

• Willing to work assigned shift hours, overtime and weekends as needed. Estimated shift times: 1st shift: 7 AM - 3:30 PM; 2nd shift: 3 PM - 11:30 PM

• Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position

• Able to lift up to 25lbs. unassisted

US Hourly Range

Production Technician/Level 1: $25 - $33/hour
Production Technician/Level 2: $28 - $38/hour
Production Technician/Level 3: $33 - $43/hour

Your job level will be tailored to your individual qualifications, including your job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

jobs.title: IT Operations
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.




ABOUT BRAIN CO.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.




WHY NOW

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring an IT Engineer to manage IT and workplace operations at our San Francisco office. You’ll keep the office running and our team productive. That means managing AV and conferencing systems, office equipment and vendors, being the first stop for IT support, and handling daily systems access in Okta with the central Security & IT team. You’ll also make sure new hires are set up and ready to go when they start.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys a mix of helping people, managing systems and setting up physical spaces. You’ll work independently, own your area from start to finish, and partner with our infrastructure engineer on installs, network work and equipment purchases. As the company grows, there’s room to grow with it: launching new offices, taking a bigger part in endpoint security or identity management. This role will report to Sr. IT Manager.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Manage IT operations for our SF office: AV and conferencing systems, corporate network, office equipment, supplies, and the vendors behind them.

 - Be the first stop for IT help for SF-based employees: triage hardware and software issues, manage devices from setup to retirement, and keep people productive.

 - Run onboarding and offboarding end to end. Work with People/HR on timing, set up and remove systems access, and make sure every new hire’s laptop and accounts are ready before day one.

 - Make each new hire’s first day smooth and welcoming.

 - Manage daily systems access in Okta for SF staff: user setup, groups, MFA and access requests. Partner with the central Security & IT team on policy and escalations.

 - Lead physical installs such as AV setups and network drops, and buy the equipment the office needs. Work closely with the engineer who owns our core infrastructure.

 - As we grow, help launch new offices, take a bigger role in compliance work like SOC 2 access reviews, and potentially build and lead a small IT support team.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 5+ years in IT support, workplace operations or a similar hybrid role, and you’re comfortable switching between helping people and handling hardware.

 - You have hands-on Okta experience (or another identity provider) and can manage user setup, groups, MFA and access troubleshooting without a runbook.

 - You’ve set up and fixed AV and conferencing systems and general office IT hardware yourself.

 - You’ve run onboarding and offboarding before: devices ready, access in place, day one handled.

 - You have a strong customer-service instinct. You’re responsive and patient, and you explain technical issues clearly to non-technical colleagues.

 - You like working independently and owning a whole area, without a large, siloed enterprise IT team behind you.

 - You don’t need a desk-only role. Running cables, unboxing equipment and fixing a conference room are part of the job you enjoy.

 - You’re happy working from our SF office 3 days a week.

 - You use AI to improve your workflows and learn on the job.

 - Nice to have: experience with MDM tools (Jamf, Kandji/Iru, Intune, JumpCloud), and enough Terraform or scripting to work alongside our infrastructure engineer.




JOIN US

If you’re looking to make a big impact on how a growing team works every day, join us.




LOCATION

This role will be based out of our San Francisco HQ, the team operates on a hybrid model 3x/ week in person.


COMPENSATION

Competitive compensation including salary, equity, and performance incentives.

Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting  capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. The Quality and Compliance team at Domino helps teams deliver AI software and solutions with the quality, validation, and supporting evidence that enterprise customers need. We are building repeatable ways to bring these requirements into delivery early and make readiness clear across teams.

What we look for in this role

• Clear communication and customer partnership. You can align internal teams and customer reviewers on deliverables, incorporate feedback, and establish what acceptance requires. You communicate risks early, present practical options, and drive decisions through to completion.

• Proactive ownership. You address immediate delivery needs while improving the processes behind recurring problems. You can partner with release managers on readiness and provide backup release coordination when needed.

• We value all of you that believe improving is always possible At Domino Everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.




ABOUT BRAIN CO.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.




WHY NOW

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, IT to lead our day-to-day technology operations and build the systems that help our team move faster. You’ll combine hands-on technical work with people leadership, guiding a growing team of approximately five IT professionals supporting employees across San Francisco, New York, and additional locations as we scale.

Automation will be central to your work. You’ll identify repeated manual tasks, connect tools and systems, and build workflows that reduce overhead and improve the employee experience. You’ll also own operational priorities, lead incident response, and partner with Security to keep our environment reliable and secure.

This role calls for someone who takes ownership from identifying a problem through resolving it. You’ll bring sound judgment about where structure helps, keep processes appropriate for our stage, and stay close to the technical work as you develop the team.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead IT operations. Own day-to-day technology operations across employee devices, business applications, identity and access management, and workplace technology.

 - Build automation. Design and implement workflows that replace repeated manual tasks, streamline onboarding and offboarding, and improve how our tools and systems work together.

 - Set priorities and deliver outcomes. Balance employee needs, operational issues, and longer-term improvements, focusing the team on the work with the greatest impact.

 - Manage incidents and escalations. Drive issues through resolution, communicate clearly with employees and executives, and address root causes to prevent recurring problems.

 - Partner with Security. Implement and maintain patch management, access controls, and data protection practices that support our security and compliance requirements.

 - Develop the IT team. Manage a team of approximately five, providing coaching, clear expectations, and opportunities to grow while coordinating work across locations.

 - Build processes that scale. Create practical documentation and operating practices that improve consistency and reliability without adding unnecessary overhead.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You bring approximately seven or more years of relevant IT experience, including experience leading and developing a team.

 - You have a strong track record of building process automation, using AI, integrations, or workflow tools to reduce manual work and improve reliability.

 - You’re comfortable working hands-on across employee technology environments, including Mac, Microsoft tools, Okta, endpoint management, and SaaS administration.

 - You prioritize effectively, make decisions with incomplete information, and stay calm while managing incidents and competing demands.

 - You understand security and compliance fundamentals, including patch management, access controls, and data protection.

 - You solve problems independently, follow through on issues, and look beyond individual tickets to improve the underlying systems.

 - You communicate clearly with technical teams, employees, and executives, adapting your approach to the situation.

 - You thrive in an early-stage environment where priorities evolve and you can help shape how the function grows.

 - Experience managing distributed or global teams is a plus.


JOIN US

If you’re excited about building an IT function that helps a fast-moving team do its best work, we’d love to hear from you.


LOCATION

This role is based in San Francisco and requires working from the office at least three days per week.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Customer On-Site, you will serve as the main point of contact between Traba's workforce and our client's on-site leadership team. You'll provide dedicated operational oversight to drive service delivery and act as the face of Traba inside the facility — managing day-to-day worker support, coordinating onboarding and scheduling, and ensuring smooth communication between workers, site supervisors, and Traba's internal operations team.

This role requires professionalism and the ability to build strong relationships while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced warehouse / manufacturing environment.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Worker & Client Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with site supervisors and workers, ensuring both receive timely updates, feedback, and support. Serve as the primary relationship owner with supervisors and key points of contact at the facility.

 - On-Site Coordination: Facilitate worker onboarding, introductions, and first-day check-ins; coordinate interviews and start schedules for new hires (e.g., forklift operators). Oversee worker vetting, drug testing, and onboarding end-to-end.

 - Worker Support & Performance: Assist workers with clock-ins, pay questions, and performance feedback; manage worker performance on-site and escalate issues to internal teams as needed.

 - Communication & Reporting: Act as the bridge between the client site, Traba Ops, and Worker Support teams — communicating key updates, attendance issues, or staffing changes clearly and professionally.

 - Issue Resolution: Identify and flag worker performance concerns or site challenges early, working proactively to resolve them. Handle incident management and escalations.

 - Operational Execution: Support day-to-day site operations, ensuring adequate staffing coverage and a positive worker experience. Own shift and schedule management, and distribute and manage PPE.

 - Account Growth: Identify and drive wallet expansion opportunities within the account.


REQUIREMENTS

 - High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.

 - English required.

 - 1–2+ years of experience in operations or customer-facing environments, including but not limited to: staffing, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, food service, teaching, or on-site coordination.

 - Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills (email and in-person).

 - Professional demeanor and ability to represent Traba with both workers and client stakeholders.

 - Polished and presentable in a customer-facing environment.

 - Warm, friendly, and approachable, with the ability to coach workers and confidently enforce standards.

 - Organized, detail-oriented, and a proactive problem solver.

 - Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic warehouse environments.


COMPENSATION

Competitive hourly base pay plus performance-based incentives tied to attendance, shift completion, and overall account health.

The division is known for representing global brands including Delta Air Lines, General Motors, Lyft, LinkedIn among others, in the entertainment space, and leveraging UTA’s global intelligence, expertise and relationships to develop initiatives to help brands stand out, be relevant and grow.

 

In this role, you will be a master project manager supporting both your internal team and the external client SC Johnson. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of strategizing, identifying, contracting, and managing influencer/creator campaigns and identifying cultural trends known for creating game changing opportunities for our clients; we are a group of people who work hard as a team to continue building our reputation as visionaries in the industry. jobs.title: Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant - COTA
jobs.description:
Cortica is looking for a full time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join its growing multi-disciplinary team at our Carlsbad center in CA!

As a Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA), you’ll deliver high quality services to treat sensory integration, sensorimotor, motor, feeding and developmental disorders in children under the guidance of a licensed Occupational Therapist utilizing Cortica’s Whole Child Approach.

We are a rapidly growing healthcare company pioneering the most effective treatment methods for children with neurodevelopmental differences. Our mission is to design and deliver life-changing care – one child, one family, one community at a time. Ultimately, we envision a world that cultivates the full potential of every child. At Cortica, every team member is instrumental in helping us achieve our mission!

Our culture and values guide how we work and treat one another. Cortica celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive environment, seeking ideas and opinions from everyone on the team. We safeguard equal rights and respect for all individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, creed, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status or other applicable, legally protected characteristics. All Cortica employment decisions are made based on an individual’s qualifications and ability to successfully perform the job responsibilities.

What will you do?

• Provide individual, group, and co-treat therapy sessions as appropriate under the supervision of a licensed OT.

• Provide therapeutic services in-person in the clinic setting and via telehealth, as clinically appropriate.

• Accurately complete documentation in accordance with Cortica’s designated time frames

• Provide neurodiversity affirming interventions that are both play-based and goal-based.

• Facilitate functional and child-led experiences to target and achieve individualized goals.

• Utilize transdisciplinary care strategies and supports to help the individual engage in occupations and activities of daily living.

• Collaborate with the individual and family to understand their values, interests, and goals.

• Implement programming that considers all aspects of the child, inclusive of, but not limited to sensory, motor, cognitive, communicative, recreational, and social activities.

• Educate patients, families, team members, and caregivers on strategies and generalization activities that complement treatment.

• Attend and participate in transdisciplinary rounds, care collaboration meetings, collaborative workshops, site meetings, as well as discipline specific trainings.

• Follow Cortica crisis and emergency procedures, including de-escalation strategies, first aid strategies and mandated reporting.

• Utilize software and systems, including electronic medical record (EMR) systems and Microsoft Office products, to efficiently manage documentation, reporting, and communication tasks.

We’d love to hear from you if:

• You hold a current and unrestrictive license for Occupational Therapy Assistant in the state of practice.

• You have first aid/CPR training or the ability to obtain.

• You have a tuberculosis (TB) clearance.

• You can complete safety training within the first 90 days of employment.

Your Compensation & Benefits

Cortica cares deeply about the well-being of each member of our team, and we have created a passionate, caring, and growth-minded culture that helps teammates thrive! As a Cortica teammate, we’ll support your well-being through medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching and rapid vesting, paid holidays and wellness days, life insurance, disability insurance options, tuition reimbursements for professional development and continuing education, and referral bonuses. We value you and the experience you bring to your role, and are proud to provide you with a compensation and benefits package designed to enhance all aspects of your life.

The base pay range for this opening is $33.02/hr to $41.28/hr. According to your skill level, relevant experience, education level, and location, you will receive compensation that fits appropriately within the range.

jobs.title: VP, Global Revenue Architecture
jobs.location: Austin | Chicago | New York City | Salt Lake City | San Francisco
jobs.description:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

Gong's Revenue Architects (RAs) are the strategic post-sale partners who turn Gong's AI Operating System into measurable revenue outcomes for customers. Organized today across Enterprise, Enterprise Growth, Mid-Market, and the new Industry Expansion (IX) segment (currently focused on Financial Services and Healthcare), RA teams own adoption, value realization, and renewal and expansion across the full customer lifecycle. The function spans NAMER, EMEA, and APAC, and includes a dedicated VP plus a layer of regional and segment leaders.

This is a newly elevated global leadership role, created to unify strategy, execution, and accountability across all Revenue Architecture segments and regions. Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, the VP of Global Revenue Architecture will lead a multi-layered organization of roughly 45 people including a VP, a team of regional and segment leaders, and the individual-contributor RAs who sit closest to customers. You will set the global strategy for how Gong drives retention and expansion across Enterprise, Enterprise Growth, Mid-Market, and Industry Expansion, while building the leadership bench, operating rhythm, and cross-functional muscle needed to scale the function as a global, industry-aware growth engine.

The preferred location for this role is in one of Gong's current hubs: San Francisco, Austin, Lehi, Chicago, or NYC.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead across three regions: Own the performance, hiring, and development of a global organization of ~100 across NAMER, EMEA, and APAC, ensuring consistent standards while adapting for regional and market nuance.

• Set the global RA strategy: Define a single revenue transformation methodology; workflow architecture, adoption and change management, value realization, and renewal and expansion that scales consistently across Enterprise, Enterprise Growth, Mid-Market, and IX segments.

• Own the numbers: Hold end-to-end accountability for gross and net revenue retention, expansion, and customer value realization across the entire Revenue Architecture book, and build the forecasting and pipeline rigor to defend those numbers to the executive team.

• Scale Industry Expansion (IX): Guide the build-out of the IX segment currently Financial Services and Healthcare as a 'startup within a startup,' developing industry-specific playbooks, automation, and self-service strategies that improve customer health and reduce churn in these verticals.

• Build the leadership bench: Coach and develop all layers of regional and segment leaders beneath them; own succession planning and career pathing so the org can keep scaling without you in every room.

• Represent RA at the executive level: Act as an escalation point and strategic partner on the largest, highest-risk, and highest-opportunity accounts, engaging directly with customer C-suite and VP stakeholders alongside your leaders.

• Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Sales, Product, Support, Marketing, and other CCO-org peers to ensure Revenue Architecture strategy is embedded in the broader customer journey, and that RA insights shape product and GTM priorities

• Drive operating cadence: Establish the global rhythm of business in QBRs, forecasting, performance reviews, and org health check-ins that keeps a distributed, multi-region team aligned and accountable.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 15+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or revenue-facing leadership within B2B SaaS, including significant experience leading through multiple layers of management (leaders of leaders), not just individual contributors.

• A track record owning enterprise-scale retention and expansion targets (GRR/NRR) for a large, distributed post-sale organization

• Experience operating across multiple regions and time zones, with the judgment to balance global consistency against local market needs.

• Direct experience building or scaling a new segment, vertical, or 'startup within a startup' motion, ideally involving automation, self-service, or AI-driven customer workflows.

• Comfort owning relationships with customer C-suite and VP stakeholders on the highest-stakes accounts, with strong executive presence and negotiation skill.

• A data-driven, change-management mindset comfortable translating customer workflows into measurable business outcomes and using data to drive adoption.

• A collaborative leadership style that thrives in ambiguity and fast-paced, high-growth environments, and genuinely enjoys developing other leaders.

PERKS & BENEFITS

• We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs.

• Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle.

• Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching.

• 401(k) program to help you invest in your future.

• Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development.

• Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend.

• Paid parental leave to support you and your family.

• Company-wide recharge days each quarter.

• Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored.

Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

To review Gong's privacy policy, visit https://www.gong.io/gong-io-job-candidates-privacy-notice/ for more details.

jobs.title: Production Scheduler (Microelectronics)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PRODUCTION SCHEDULER (MICROELECTRONICS):
The Microelectronics team is looking for a Production Scheduler to identify, develop, and implement tactical and strategic schedules to enable production to set and achieve manufacturing targets. The ideal candidate will have a broad understanding of data analytics and manufacturing operations, with the desire and capability to take on new challenges to help enable our mission to revolutionize the aviation wireless internet experience worldwide.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Coordinate, maintain, communicate, and present critical path schedules and schedule narratives to both internal and external stakeholders

• Propose and drive solutions that enable production to overcome shortages and blockers

• Provide proactive schedule coordination across internal teams to ensure that schedules reflect reality, identify interdependencies, and that key deliverables will be completed on time

• Devise, maintain, and improve scheduling tools and processes that identify, analyze, and communicate potential constraints on a periodic basis

• Drive strategic corrective actions for part shortages driven by production and supply chain

• Support logistics actions for cross-site satellite shipments

• Maintain and correct ERP/MRP data

• Identify and support improvement opportunities for safety, production rate, product yield, quality, and cost

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 1+ years of professional manufacturing scheduling experience

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 4+ years of production management, integrated operations, or complex project ownership experience

• 2+ years of professional manufacturing scheduling or coordinating experience

• 2+ years of practical experience using ERP/MRP systems in a production environment

• Demonstrated ability to improve efficiency and operational effectiveness by thinking strategically and critically and building broad, cross-functional relationships

• Highly skilled at taking in large quantities of information and presenting it in a clear and concise manner, both verbally and in writing

• Ability to work with limited supervision to develop and manage program plans and schedule

• Experience creating and managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. PowerBI) and with data analysis in Excel, VBA, Python, and/or SQL

• Experience with sharing information and influencing others across organizational lines, internally and externally.

• Experience working in a highly demanding and fast paced environment

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

• Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted

• Must be able to stand for extended periods - 8 hours minimum

• Nominal hours are 1st shift: 7:00 AM -5:00 PM

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Level 2: $95,000.00 - $135,000.00

You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law.
