jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Conversion is the agentic marketing automation platform for modern enterprises such as Plaid, ClickHouse, Webflow, and Productboard. Our platform lets growth teams run their entire go-to-market motion in one place, from acquisition through retention, with AI agents doing the work that legacy tools like Marketo, HubSpot, and Pardot can't.

We've raised $28M+ from Abstract Ventures, True Ventures, and HOF Capital. The team is based in San Francisco and includes engineers, designers, and operators from Airbnb, Palantir, Pinterest, IMC, Shopify, LinkedIn, and Microsoft.

About the Role

Hey there! James here 👋, co-founder and CTO at Conversion. Just wanted to share my thoughts on the perfect candidate we're looking to join our engineering team.

First off, I want to stress the technical difficulty and scale of what we're building here at Conversion. The reason marketing automation platforms haven't seen a new player in decades is because building one is hard. Our platform needs to handle terabytes of data syncs per customer with the utmost reliability, coordinate complex workflows that automate mission critical go-to-market processes, handle form submissions that directly generate revenue for customers, and serve high delivering emails to millions of our customer's recipients.

Here's what we're looking for in an infrastructure engineer to join our core team:

 - Engineer multiplier: Your customers are all other engineers. The goal is to unlock and empower them to ship features faster and more reliably for our customers. The best infra work here is measured in how much leverage you give the rest of the team.

 - Pragmatic optimizer: Over-optimizing is a real thing. As a startup, our goal is to grow and build an amazing product that delivers value, not to needlessly upgrade our tech stack for the sake of it. Your job is to strike the line between the cost of infrastructure changes and the potential benefits. Everything's a tradeoff and we want to take the worthwhile ones.

 - Intellectually curious: Conversion engineers are the kind of people who get excited about a weird edge case and end up sending five Slack messages about it before lunch.

This role is in-person 5 days/week in San Francisco.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

 - Have 3+ years of experience building cloud infrastructure, dev tooling, and platform systems at fast-growing companies

 - Have shipped and operated systems that other engineers depend on, including CI/CD, observability, deploy tooling, or internal platforms

 - Have a startup mindset and want early ownership in a fast-paced environment

 - Have experience with our tech stack:
   
   - Go for backend services
   
   - Kafka, Temporal, PostgreSQL, Clickhouse, Terraform as foundational technologies
   
   - Kubernetes as the compute platform
     
     - ArgoCD, Grafana, VictoriaStack for logging and management
   
   - GCP for cloud hosting

You Might Be a Great Fit If You

 - Have built internal developer tools or platforms that meaningfully changed how a team shipped

 - Believe keeping things in good shape is paramount (security, reliability, organization)

 - Have worked at a Series A to C startup that scaled quickly

 - Have a strong track record of side projects, apps, or hackathons. Our engineers have built a live-streaming security system for their parents' new house, a database from scratch, a better Splitwise app, and hosted our Minecraft server, all while at Conversion

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2027) - Native SDK & Mobile Platforms
jobs.description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.



About the Role

This internship sits at the intersection of systems engineering, mobile application development, and applied research. You'll work directly with platform, research, and application engineers to turn new capabilities in spatial computing, localization, and computer vision into polished experiences for developers and end users — from shared C++ runtime code and native Swift/Kotlin SDKs to production-quality iOS and Android applications.

Depending on your interests and the projects underway, you may work deeper in the platform stack, closer to the application layer, or across both. You'll also use AI-assisted workflows to move quickly across platforms while maintaining high standards for native quality and user experience.



What You'll Do

 - Native & Cross-Platform Development — Build features in Swift, Kotlin, and C++, ranging from user-facing mobile experiences to the runtime and SDK capabilities that power them.

 - Research-to-Product Engineering — Help turn research prototypes in spatial computing, localization, and computer vision into production-quality SDK features and intuitive mobile application experiences.

 - Mobile Application Development — Build and refine native iOS and Android experiences that exercise new platform capabilities, solve real user problems, and help define how our technology should work in practice.

 - AI-Assisted Engineering — Use AI-assisted development workflows to implement, adapt, and maintain functionality across multiple native platforms without sacrificing platform-specific quality.

 - Cross-Boundary Debugging — Debug problems across the full stack, from shared C++ runtime behavior and native bindings through application logic, UI, device sensors, and real-world usage.

 - Quality, Performance & Tooling — Write automated tests, improve build and release tooling, investigate performance, and validate new capabilities through on-device testing and sensor playback.

 - Product & API Collaboration — Work with research, platform, design, and application engineers to shape APIs and user experiences that are stable, ergonomic, and useful across a growing range of devices and use cases.



What You'll Bring

 - Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

 - Demonstrated experience building software in C++, Swift, Kotlin, or another native or systems language through coursework, personal projects, research, or prior internships.

 - Strong interest in native mobile development, SDKs, libraries, and developer-facing platforms with an appreciation for performance, API design, and platform-specific behavior.

 - Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems, debug across platform boundaries, and turn ambiguous technical problems into working, maintainable solutions.

 - Strong engineering instincts around testing, code quality, API ergonomics, and maintainability with the judgment to balance shared abstractions against platform-native conventions.

 - Comfort using AI-assisted development tools to increase engineering velocity across iOS, Android, and shared C++ code.

 - Available for 4 days per week in our San Francisco office for the full 12-week internship.



Nice to Have

 - Hands-on experience with iOS (Xcode, Instruments) or Android (Android Studio, Android NDK) development environments.

 - Familiarity with spatial computing, augmented reality, computer vision, or localization (SLAM, VPS).

 - Experience with cross-platform build systems such as CMake or Bazel.

 - Prior exposure to SDK or library development, open-source contributions, or developer-facing APIs.



Compensation & Benefits

The expected hourly rate for this internship is $48 – $70/hour, based on assessed skills, experience, and relevant coursework. Housing assistance and relocation support available for candidates outside the Bay Area — details provided during the offer process.



Location & Work Model

This internship is based in our San Francisco, CA office. We work in a high-collaboration environment and ask interns to be on-site a minimum of 4 days per week. To make that easy, we provide lunch every day and snacks are always stocked.



Inclusive Application

We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we're looking for.



Equal Opportunity

jobs.title: Equipment Operator
jobs.description:
Shift: 4:00AM-12:30PM

Pay: $18.00 per hr

What's the Short Version?

The Equipment Operator safely and efficiently locates product by using a radio frequency (RF) unit, manually pulls product from locations, and transports product to various departments and/or locations. They process a portion of customer orders throughout the production day and restock product into bins.

What Will You Be Doing?

• Operate powered lift equipment to move product and materials as assigned using a radio frequency (RF) unit to scan movement of product, identify locations, etc.

• Load, unload, move, stack, and stage product.

• Restock, pick, and pack product for customer orders.

• Inspect assigned equipment daily at start of shift; is responsible for checking out equipment and returning in same condition on a daily basis.

• Follow procedures for proper care and use of equipment, to include keys.

• Adhere to all safety requirements and guidelines.

• Complete and maintain SanMar's Lift Operator Certification in compliance with OSHA guidelines every three years.

What Are We Looking For?

• High School Diploma or equivalent

• 1-3 years of lift operator experience

• Ability to read, write and have sufficient ability to identify colors, sizes, quantity, label and SKU information

• Basic math skills in counting and quantity required

• Demonstrates ability to follow directions and change priorities or job duties as business needs require; rotate to other production functions as needed

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work in fast-paced, high-volume environment while meeting deadlines

• Able to work both independently and within a team

• Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills

• Comprehend verbal and written instructions

• Essential days or overtime may be required

What's Our Offer?

Paid Time Off: You`ll accrue paid time off on a weekly basis based on hours worked up to 112 hours per year to start. Employees also receive 8 paid holidays and 1 paid family day off.

Additional Benefits:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits

• 401k plan and matches $1 for $1 up to 4% of earnings, matched & vested at every pay cycle

• Life insurance

• Short/long-term disability coverage

• Paid maternity/paternity leave

• Pet insurance

What Should You Expect?

DC Warehouse (Equipment): While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand, walk, talk and hear. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 60 pounds. The employee operates powered equipment requiring use of both hands as well as full range of motion of the neck, head and back. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may be required to wear a headset covering one or both ears. Employee will be required to wear Personal protective equipment such as a Protective harness while operating equipment. Basic English literacy is required for operation of machines and necessary daily paperwork. Work environment is moderately noisy. The employee is occasionally required to work near conveyor systems. There is exposure to dust and changes in weather conditions. Work is performed under typical warehouse conditions. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced.The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Service
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. But it didn’t stop there. They engineered Snowflake to power the Data Cloud, where thousands of organizations unlock the value of their data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. This is our vision: a world with endless insights to tackle the challenges and opportunities of today and reveal the possibilities of tomorrow.

Our product offering runs on multiple cloud providers, including Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Our infrastructure self-optimizes and provides high availability and data protection across cloud providers, so our users can focus on using their data, not managing it.

Our team is the Compute Service team. We build and operate the systems that schedule and run warehouse-backed work beyond a user’s interactive query: asynchronous and scheduled compute, elastic capacity for parts of live queries, and the scheduling control plane those workloads run on. We balance usability, performance, cost, and reliability for the teams and customers that depend on this compute.



We are actively hiring talented distributed systems developers. This role is an opportunity to shape the architecture and operation of core services that the rest of Snowflake runs on.


AS A SENIOR DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

 - Solve real business needs at large scale by applying software engineering and analytical problem solving.

 - Design and implement scalable distributed systems for scheduling, queueing, dispatch, and completion of warehouse-backed work.

 - Analyze fault tolerance, high availability, performance, and scale challenges, and solve them.

 - Build admission control, isolation, and capacity management so shared compute stays fair and predictable.

 - Lead cross-functional initiatives, and collaborate with engineers, product managers, and technical program managers across teams.

 - Judge trade-offs among consistency, durability, latency, and cost, and build systems that meet the demands of rapidly growing services.

 - Ensure operational readiness of the services, and meet commitments to customers on availability and performance.


OUR IDEAL DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 - Substantial industry experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.

 - Experience building large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant services and control planes, including compute placement, queueing, and monitoring.

 - A strong understanding of operating-system concepts, including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, performance, and scale.

 - Strong computer-science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

 - Systems programming skills, including multi-threading and concurrency. Fluency in Java is preferred.

 - A track record of identifying problems and implementing creative solutions.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

 - A BS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is a plus.


WHY JOIN THE ENGINEERING TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

 - Build an industry-leading cloud data platform.

 - Solve challenging technical problems in parallel and distributed systems, resource management, scheduling, and large-scale system operation.

 - Work closely with partner teams, understand their use cases and needs, and choose the right problem to solve at the right time.

 - Contribute to a highly scalable and reliable cloud platform that runs on a very large fleet of machines, and to the Java systems that schedule and execute work on it.

 - Join a world-class team of industry veterans and rising engineers.





Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
WHY NOW

2026 has been a breakout year for Doppler. We’ve helped over 78,000 startups and enterprises manage their secrets at scale, and landed our first million-dollar customer. We've shipped some of our most exciting features yet, expanded our customer base, and sharpened our focus like never before. With a strong foundation in community, we're scaling and monetizing with ambitious goals across product, growth, sales, and hiring. 



The rise of AI tooling has fundamentally expanded who and what has access to your secrets. The stakes have never been higher, and getting it wrong has real consequences. Doppler is the solution to fix this. Simple to adopt, easy to scale, and built for developers, by developers. The momentum is real, and we’re just getting started. 



About Doppler

Doppler's mission is to make it easy and secure for software developers of every experience level and teams of any size to manage their app configuration and secrets. But hasn't this been done?



Developers tend to be either struggling with the manual management of .env files https://www.doppler.com/blog/the-triumph-and-tragedy-of-env-files, or wrestling with an overly complex secrets manager https://www.doppler.com/blog/doppler-vs-hashicorp-vault that's not built for software development.



Our team is entrepreneurial, with a bias for action. We never back down from a spirited debate and believe we are all responsible for exploring the hard questions. We value self-awareness and meaningful impact. We are open to unconventional approaches and have learned not to judge a book by its cover. Your time is your most valuable resource, so you set your hours. We use Slack to communicate and default to zero meetings.  




WHO WE ARE

Doppler is a developer-first secrets management platform that enables engineers and security teams to securely store their secrets across any cloud infrastructure or deployment environment at scale.






THE ROLE

You will be the driving force of our customer adoption and revenue growth, serving as the primary contact for our mid-market and small-business/startup customers. Your role extends beyond traditional account management and customer success; you will lead and improve onboarding, implementation of Doppler, and growth of the Doppler platform. Collaborating with Sales, Support, Product, and Finance teams, you'll ensure a seamless customer experience, increasing adoption and delivering exceptional time-to-value. In this dynamic role, you’ll become the day-to-day liaison, building trusted relationships and playing a pivotal role in our customers’ success and Doppler’s revenue growth.



As a Technical Customer Success Account Manager, you'll oversee a diverse portfolio of customers at various stages of their Secrets Management journey. You'll have the opportunity to engage with every team and connect with all our awesome Dopplerites! 




ABOUT THE TEAM

We’re a security-first, developer-obsessed organization that genuinely cares about the quality of what we build and the success of our customers. We collaborate with as little ego as possible and constantly try to improve how we work and deliver software.



We understand that people are complex and unique. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals dedicated to providing outstanding customer experiences. This position offers a unique opportunity to build out the success motion at Doppler and you’ll have the opportunity to work with some of the most innovative companies.



What you’ll do:

 - Customer Onboarding: Lead the onboarding process for new customers and manage the post-sales experience end-to-end.

 - Account Management & Growth: Build "trusted advisor" relationships with technical users and decision-makers, from developers to CISOs. Expand Doppler usage within accounts by identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities. Lead the sales cycle for renewals and upgrades to drive retention and growth.

 - Product Expertise: Develop a deep understanding of Doppler’s capabilities and customer needs. Manage product requests and provide insights to product and engineering teams to help shape Doppler’s roadmap.

 - Training & Technical Education: Develop and lead enablement programs. Ensure customers are educated on product features, best practices, and security principles. You should be technical enough to walk people through troubleshooting or integrations.

 - Customer Advocacy: Gather and analyze customer feedback and develop case studies.



What you’ll bring to the table:

 - 3+ years of customer-facing experience in roles such as Technical Account Manager, Customer Success Manager, Customer Success Engineer for Developer, DevOps, DevSecOps, or Security products.

 - Technical acumen in understanding customer requirements, identifying blockers to adoption, and working cross-functionally to deliver success.

 - Proven track record in customer retention, and expansion, including leading implementations, QBRs, and contract renewals.

 - Excellent communication and storytelling skills to educate customers, drive adoption, and articulate value to both technical users and executives.

 - Self-starter mindset with a passion for startups, comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment and excited to make a meaningful impact as Doppler scales.

 - Humble approach to knowledge gaps, unafraid to say “I don’t know,” and embracing opportunities for growth and learning.



Bonus:

 - Experience working at a startup or being an early hire at a company is a plus.



What does growth look like:

 - In this role, you will have the opportunity to build and lead Doppler’s customer success strategy and operation.

 - You will have the opportunity to influence our product vision and roadmap by gathering, analyzing, and championing customer feedback.



Salary: 

$105k - $140k OTE (80-20 split)




BENEFITS 

 - Premium health insurance (medical, dental, vision)

 - Guilt-free Unlimited PTO - 3-week minimum strongly encouraged!

 - Upward Mobility

 - Learning and Development Stipend

 - Wealth Advisor

 - 401k

 - Pregnancy & Family Leave

 - Fertility & Adoption Benefits

 - Equal Compensation (regardless of gender or race)

For a full list of our benefits check our Perks Notion Page https://dopplerteam.notion.site/Perks-15eb027f917d4b3bac69d0186115d7de.




CLOSING 

We've built a great product our customers love. Our churn is low, and active usage continues to rise. We just need to amplify our reach to educate the market that secrets management can be fast, secure, and affordable for teams and organizations of any size. And most importantly, we need to continue encouraging Developers to stop adhering to archaic insecure standards such as manually managing .env file formats.



Are you passionate about developer-focused products and ready to join an amazing team? Then we want to hear from you!



A final note - we highly encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't feel entirely qualified, or entirely sure. You never know!

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Conversion is the agentic marketing automation platform for modern enterprises such as Plaid, ClickHouse, Webflow, and Productboard. Our platform lets growth teams run their entire go-to-market motion in one place, from acquisition through retention, with AI agents doing the work that legacy tools like Marketo, HubSpot, and Pardot can't.

We've raised $28M+ from Abstract Ventures, True Ventures, and HOF Capital. The team is based in San Francisco and includes engineers, designers, and operators from Airbnb, Palantir, Pinterest, IMC, Shopify, LinkedIn, and Microsoft.



About the Role

Hey there! James here 👋, co-founder and CTO at Conversion. Just wanted to share my thoughts on the perfect candidate we're looking to join our product team:

 - Product focused: There are a lot of features that go into a marketing automation platform, and we're looking for engineers who can own entire products and scope out, design, and build them end to end. We believe the best PMs are engineers who understand the pain point, since they can best evaluate both the benefit and the cost of building a feature.

 - Exceptional design taste: We believe great software should be as beautiful and intuitive as it is powerful. We're looking for engineers with an exceptional eye for design who care deeply about how a product looks, feels, and behaves. You'll have the freedom to shape the experience, not just implement someone else's designs.

 - Love building for / with customers: We're extremely close with our customers. Every customer gets their own Slack channel in our org, and we add every engineer to the channel to directly answer questions, fix bugs, and ship features. A key component of this role will be working with customers to understand pain points and then researching / designing the product features to solve them!

 - Detail oriented: Conversion's product is a deeply integrated platform where each feature must mesh seamlessly with many existing features and support an ambitious vision. A detail oriented approach is required to keep our high bar for craft while delivering complex features in a scalable way.



Concrete Responsibilities:

 - Design craft: Own the visual quality of Conversion's product, from typography and spacing to interactions, animations, and the small details that make an interface feel exceptional

 - Experience ownership: Translate the complexity of a marketing platform into intuitive, elegant experiences which make powerful features feel simple

 - Design to code: Own the entire process from exploring design concepts and prototyping interactions to shipping polished, production-ready React interfaces

This role is in-person 5 days/week in San Francisco.



You Might Be a Good Fit If You

 - Have 3+ years of industry experience shipping high quality product experiences

 - Have a startup mindset and want early ownership in a fast-paced environment

 - Are proficient in React, TypeScript, and CSS, and can turn a design idea into a polished, responsive, production-ready experience

 - Can take ambiguous product requirements and independently explore and prototype thoughtful UX solutions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You

 - Have worked at a Series A to C startup that scaled quickly

 - Enjoy experimenting with new interaction patterns, prototyping ambitious ideas, and novel UI paradigms

 - Are the kind of person who notices a slightly misaligned button or an awkward hover state and can't resist making it better

 - Have a strong track record of side projects, apps, or hackathons. Our engineers have built a live-streaming security system for their parents' new house, a database from scratch, a better Splitwise app, and hosted our Minecraft server, all while at Conversion

Our focus on family law allows us to make a meaningful impact by helping families navigate challenging and pivotal times in their lives.

Job Title: Family Law Paralegal

Location:  Peoria, AZ

Cordell & Cordell has the benefits you'd expect from a large national firm. We offer competitive compensation, exceptional health care benefits, and prioritize work-life balance to ensure the well-being and productivity of our employees. Our team of experienced family law attorneys and legal professionals is committed to providing exceptional service to our clients during critical moments in their lives.

What You’ll Do

• Draft pleadings, motions, discovery requests/responses, and other legal documents.

• Prepare documentation such as financial disclosures, child support worksheets, and parenting plans.

• Manage case calendars, track deadlines, and ensure timely filings.

• Communicate with clients, courts, and opposing counsel in a professional manner.

• Edit draft documents for client changes and prepare documents for signing.

• Handle sensitive client data with utmost discretion, care, and accuracy.

• Perform tasks as assigned with accuracy and promptness, meeting all agreed-upon deadlines.

Who You Are
We’re looking for someone who brings a blend of professionalism, reliability, and a commitment to quality client service. Ideal candidates will possess:

• Must have a minimum of 3+ years of family law paralegal or legal assistant experience

• Associate’s degree in paralegal studies or equivalent

• Excellent typing skills and computer literacy, including a solid understanding Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel

• Proficiency with legal software and case management systems (e.g., Smart Advocate, Clio, MyCase, or similar).

• Demonstrate proficiency to focus on details, handle multiple tasks, and remain highly organized

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a collaborative and approachable demeanor

• A professional presence and the ability to interact confidently with clients and colleagues

• Reliable transportation and the ability to be onsite Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

• A proactive mindset and willingness to go above and beyond on simple requests to make things easier for others

Why this Role Matters

As a Family Law Paralegal, you play a pivotal role in one of the most emotionally sensitive and impactful areas of legal practice. Your work ensures that each client feels supported, informed, and empowered during life-changing events like divorce, custody disputes, and child support matters. By providing critical case management, document preparation, and compassionate communication, you help streamline complex legal processes and uphold the integrity of our client experience. jobs.title: Registered Dietician - Part Time, Remote
jobs.description:
Clarity Pediatrics http://www.claritypediatrics.com is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. Nearly 10% of people in the US are diagnosed with ADHD, and for parents, it can feel impossible to find the right care. We are building a virtual pediatric ADHD clinic that delivers trusted care to all families. Our new clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and has the potential to deliver exceptional health outcomes to transform a child’s trajectory. In the future, our pediatric care platform will expand rapidly to other common chronic conditions like asthma, allergies, and obesity.



We are seeking a passionate and entrepreneurial Registered Dietitian to join our multi-disciplinary team as a part-time hourly W2. In this role, you will shape the nutrition and dietary programming at Clarity, lead group and/or individual sessions, and serve as an external ambassador for our growing platform.



WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE UNIQUE:



Develop Cutting-Edge Programming

Be the architect of Clarity’s nutrition and dietary curriculum. You will design evidence-based programming and protocols tailored to our families, drawing on the latest research in pediatric nutrition, family-based behavioral therapy, and motivational interviewing.



Direct Patient Impact

Lead group sessions and provide individualized dietary guidance to children and families. Work alongside a multi-disciplinary team of physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians to deliver integrated, coordinated care.



Ambassador for Clarity

Represent Clarity Pediatrics externally — at conferences, in community partnerships, on social media, and in other public forums — to grow awareness of our program and reach more families who need support.




RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Programming & Curriculum Development

 - Develop and continuously refine Clarity’s nutrition and diet programming (ages 5–17), with a special emphasis on creating a new group-based series and/or individualized content.

 - Create evidence-based educational materials, meal planning resources, and behavioral frameworks for patients and families.

 - Collaborate with the clinical team to align dietary recommendations with medical and behavioral health treatment plans.

 - Contribute to the development of clinical workflows, tools, and protocols related to nutrition care.



Group Sessions & Direct Patient Care

 - Plan and lead virtual group nutrition sessions for patients and/or caregivers.

 - Conduct individual dietary consultations as part of the integrated care model.

 - Monitor patient progress, adjust recommendations, and document clinical interactions accurately and in a timely manner.

 - Collaborate with medical and behavioral health providers to support coordinated, whole-child care.



External Ambassador

 - Represent Clarity Pediatrics at professional conferences, community events, and in media opportunities.

 - Build and maintain relationships with referring providers, schools, and community organizations.

 - Contribute to thought leadership through content creation (e.g., blog posts, webinars, social media) that elevates Clarity’s brand and mission.

 - Identify partnership opportunities to expand awareness of Clarity’s services among families and the broader healthcare community.




QUALIFICATIONS:

Hard Requirements

 - Active Registered Dietitian (RD) or Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) credential.

 - Licensed/certified to practice as a dietitian in California and/or Texas.

 - Enrollment in CA or TX Medicaid (or willingness to enroll)



Experience & Skills

 - At least 3 years of clinical or community nutrition experience, with a strong preference for pediatric or family-focused settings.

 - Experience with obesity, overweight, or metabolic health management.

 - Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver nutrition programming or educational curricula.

 - Comfort facilitating group sessions.

 - Confidence using electronic medical records (EMR) and telehealth platforms to deliver virtual care.

 - Experience working with families from diverse backgrounds and a commitment to culturally responsive, non-stigmatizing care.

 - Enthusiasm for a fast-growing startup environment and willingness to iterate on new care models.



Nice to have

 - Licensed in additional states or open to obtaining additional licenses through support from Clarity Pediatrics Medical Group

 - Spanish-speaking



Job Type: Part-time; specific hours flexible



Location: Remote



Compensation:

 - $55/hour



Operating Hours:

 - Monday through Friday (Pacific) 8am - 8pm PT

• Support RFP responses and help formulate strategic proposals that include insights, targeting tactics, and creative solutions

• Collaborate with sales on client engagements and co-present at meetings or on client calls

• Select appropriate products and approaches to use in achieving client KPIs

• Keep abreast of emerging behaviors, technologies, and companies that are impacting our clients' businesses

• Demonstrate expertise in a range of skills, such as creating client-facing collateral, market research, leveraging data for insights and strategies, and public speaking

• Use AI tools to support research, data synthesis, and development of strategic proposals and client-facing materials

• Collaborate with Measurement Account Management, Ad Operations and Data Insights Analysts to analyze campaign data

• Compile measurement performance metrics and insights

• Present campaign insights and measurement results to internal and external parties, ensuring message is clear and concise

• Contribute to Quarterly Business Review insights reports to identify macro trends and opportunities spanning multiple campaigns on key accounts

• Recommend deployable InMarket tactics and strategies that create value for our clients

• Continuously raise the bar for best-in-class delivery of insights and client value

Required Qualifications

• At least 3-5 years of Measurement, Insights, Media/Sales Planning, Client Success and/or Account Management experience

• Experience with digital media and sales or foot traffic measurement vendors

• Data driven, comfortable with quantitative analysis

• Ability to craft a compelling narrative from data — translating complex findings into clear, engaging stories for clients

• Familiarity using AI tools (e.g. Gemini, Claude) for research, analysis, or insights development

• Must be a team player with a positive attitude

• Must be able to operate in a fast-paced environment with strict deadlines

• Strong interpersonal skills, with an ability to collaborate effectively with all functions and levels

• Problem-solver, natural curiosity, ability to make decisions

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Strong proficiency in MS Office products (especially Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint)

• Familiarity with Looker dashboard or other data visualization tools

Benefits Summary

• Competitive salary, stock options, flexible vacation

• Medical, Dental and Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• Company Matched 401(k)

• Unlimited PTO (Within reason)

• Talented co-workers and management

• Agile Development Program (For continued learning/professional development)

• Paid Paternity & Maternity Leave

Start date: Immediate.

 

Engagement model: Multi-engagement delivery management role. Approximately 80% running several concurrent Oracle engagements — proofs of value, discovery and implementation work across E-Business Suite and Fusion — and 20% delivery standards, platform input and pre-sales support. Works with a daily overlap of US business hours alongside customers, Oracle architects and SMEs, Forward Deployed Engineers and the Principal Architects.

About Tessera Labs

Tessera is an AI-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI-native platform.

 

For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for Oracle and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI-powered, multi-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Oracle Technical Project Manager to run Oracle E-Business Suite and Oracle Fusion Cloud engagements — several at the same time — from kick-off to go-live. Our architects decide what the solution should be; you make sure it gets built, tested, converted and cut over on the date we committed to, and that the customer can see exactly where it stands at every point in between.

 

This is a technical project management role, and that is deliberate. You need to know Oracle delivery well enough to manage the deliverables themselves, not just the dates: the RICEFW inventory, functional and technical specifications, configuration moving between environments, data conversion mock cycles, integration builds, test cycles and the cutover runbook. A project manager who cannot tell whether a mock conversion actually reconciled, or why a Fusion quarterly update threatens the test plan, will report green until the week it turns red.

 

Most of our customers are not simply upgrading Oracle. They come from SAP ECC, JD Edwards, PeopleSoft, Infor or home-grown systems, and many run EBS and Fusion side by side. Our engagements are also shorter and sharper than a traditional system integrator’s: proofs of value measured in weeks, with success criteria agreed up front and evidence of value expected at the end.

 

You will run these engagements with Tessera’s AI agents as part of the team, and you need to be genuinely fluent in using AI. The platform produces a large share of the analysis, specifications, configuration, code and test material. Your job is to plan around that: build review and approval gates into the plan, know where AI output needs a domain expert’s eye, track the value it delivers against the manual baseline, and use AI tools yourself to plan, report and spot risk faster. What the platform cannot do is hold a steering committee to a decision or tell a customer that the date is at risk. That is the role.

 

Two outcomes define the job. The first is engagements that land: on the date, inside the scope, with the customer’s sign-off and a reference we can use. The second is that each one makes the next easier to run, because what you learn goes into our delivery standards and the platform rather than staying in your head.

Key Responsibilities

1. Engagement Planning and Governance (25%)

 - Own the plan on several concurrent Oracle engagements: scope, phases, milestones, dependencies, resourcing and the critical path — from discovery and fit-gap through build, testing, data conversion, cutover and hypercare.

 - Set up and run governance: weekly checkpoints, daily syncs during execution, steering committees, RAID logs and clear escalation paths — and report status the customer’s executives can trust.

 - Manage scope, budget and commercial terms: burn and forecast against fixed-fee and time-and-materials engagements, change requests and change orders, with no surprises for the client partner or the customer.

 - Agree success criteria for proofs of value up front and track them through to an evidence-based close-out.

2. Management of Technical Deliverables (35%)

 - Own the RICEFW inventory (reports, interfaces, conversions, extensions, forms and workflows) and drive each item through specification, build, review, test and sign-off.

 - Manage functional and technical specifications, code and configuration as deliverables — with review gates, quality criteria and traceability from requirement to test.

 - Plan and control environments and configuration movement: EBS instance strategy, cloning and patch windows (including R12.2 online patching); Fusion environment refreshes, Functional Setup Manager migrations and the quarterly update cycle.

 - Run data conversion as a managed workstream: mock conversion cycles, reconciliation sign-off, defect tracking and readiness criteria for each load.

 - Coordinate integration builds and third-party dependencies — banks, tax engines, payroll, EDI and legacy systems — and the testing between them.

 - Lead test management (CRPs, SIT, UAT, regression for Fusion quarterly updates) with entry and exit criteria, defect triage cadence and go/no-go evidence.

 - Plan and run cutover: an hour-by-hour runbook, rehearsals, go/no-go criteria, rollback and contingency plans, and hypercare.

3. AI-Enabled Delivery (20%)

 - Plan engagements around AI-generated work: where the Tessera platform produces analysis, specifications, configuration, code and test scripts, and where human review and approval gates sit in the schedule.

 - Work with Tessera’s Forward Deployed Engineers and domain SMEs to keep AI output grounded and validated, and escalate early when a deliverable needs expert attention.

 - Measure and report the value AI delivers — time and effort saved against the manual baseline, quality of output, and adoption by the customer’s team.

 - Use AI tools in your own work every day: drafting plans, status reports and meeting summaries, analysing risks and dependencies, and preparing steering committee material.

 - Apply sound judgment on data privacy and security when AI is used on customer data, in line with the customer’s policies and our agreements.

4. Client Leadership, Standards and Pre-Sales (20%)

 - Be the primary delivery counterpart for the customer’s program office and IT leadership, and build the trust that turns a proof of value into a follow-on engagement.

 - Manage organisational change and readiness with the customer: training, communication and business sign-offs, so go-live is adopted, not just executed.

 - Contribute to Tessera’s Oracle delivery standards — plan templates, RACI, governance packs, cutover runbooks and lessons learned — and feed field input to the platform team.

 - Support pre-sales with delivery plans, staffing models, timelines and risk assessments for proposals and statements of work.

Required Qualifications

 - 12+ years in project or program management, including at least three full-lifecycle Oracle ERP implementations as project manager — covering both Oracle E-Business Suite (R12.x) and Oracle Fusion Cloud, at least one of each.

 - At least one engagement where the customer moved to Oracle from a different ERP, such as SAP ECC, JD Edwards, PeopleSoft or Infor.

 - Hands-on experience managing technical deliverables on Oracle implementations: RICEFW inventories, functional and technical specifications, configuration migration, data conversion mock cycles, integrations, test cycles and cutover runbooks.

 - Working knowledge of Oracle delivery methods — Oracle Unified Method (OUM) for EBS and Oracle’s cloud implementation approach for Fusion — and of the Fusion quarterly update cycle and Oracle Support service request management.

 - Practical, everyday fluency with AI: using generative AI and agentic tools in your own work, and experience — or a clear point of view — on planning and governing delivery where AI produces part of the work.

 - Strong commercial and governance discipline: budgets, burn and forecast, change control, RAID management and steering committees.

 - Senior client-facing presence: able to hold a steering committee, deliver bad news early and keep the relationship.

 - Proven ability to run several engagements at once without losing control of any of them.

 - Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months.

 - Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences.

 - Experience leading distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline.

 - Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Who This Role Is Not For

If your project management stops at the plan and the status report, this is not the role — you will be expected to understand and manage the technical deliverables themselves. If you have run ERP programs but never an Oracle implementation through cutover, you will find the learning curve steep on our timelines. If you are sceptical of AI or prefer to keep it at arm’s length, you will struggle in a delivery model where AI agents produce a large share of the work. And if you want one long program with a scope someone else agreed, you will find several short, high-pressure engagements uncomfortable.

Preferred Qualifications

 - A technical or functional background in Oracle before moving into project management — for example as a developer, DBA, data conversion lead or module consultant.

 - Experience running proofs of value or pilot engagements with defined success criteria and measured outcomes.

 - Experience with AI or automation tooling in ERP delivery — code generation, test automation, data quality or documentation tools — and with measuring its impact.

 - Agile or hybrid delivery experience, and tooling such as Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project or Confluence.

 - PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP or SAFe certification.

 - Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation certification or Oracle Cloud Success Navigator experience.

 - Experience with large multi-country or multi-entity Oracle rollouts, and with system integrator and staffing partner management.

 - Experience running engagements for US or European customers from a near-shore or offshore location, with strong ownership despite the time-zone gap.

 - Spanish, Portuguese or German is a plus but not a must-have.

First-Year Measures of Success

 - Month 1: Fluent in the Tessera platform. Running at least one Oracle engagement with plan, governance, RAID log and success criteria agreed with the customer.

 - Month 3: Running at least two engagements on plan, with technical deliverables, AI review gates and value metrics tracked and reported, and a first set of Tessera Oracle delivery templates in use across the team.

 

No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.

jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer, Illustration & Graphic
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

We're looking for a Senior Brand Designer (Illustration & Graphic) to create rich, expressive artwork that brings characters, environments, and worlds to life. You'll own illustration from concept to final and help shape the visual quality bar for our team, as well as the vision for what illustration is at Roblox. You'll also work hands-on as a designer, applying your illustration craft to Roblox's identity system and marketing creative. You'll partner with art directors, designers, and product partners, and bring a strong point of view on color, light, and storytelling.

You Will:

• Create high-quality, polished illustrations for licensing, marketing, and product content

• Translate briefs, references, and creative direction into compelling finished artwork

• Develop characters, environments, and props with strong shape language, lighting, and atmosphere

• Maintain visual consistency across large sets of artwork while keeping each piece distinct

• Apply illustration within the Roblox brand identity system, designing on-brand marketing materials across surfaces with attention to typography, layout, and craft

• Contribute to brand and illustration style guides and visual standards, helping maintain design consistency

• Partner with brand designers, product designers, motion designers, and business partners to deliver work that is strategically aligned and visually compelling

• Present work-in-progress and communicate your thinking clearly to stakeholders

• Deliver production-ready files on schedule, with clean, organized layers and assets

• Give and receive constructive feedback, mentor teammates, and help raise the craft of the team

• Explore new techniques and workflows, including tools that speed up iteration without sacrificing quality

You Have:

• 8+ years of professional illustration and design experience, ideally in games, collectibles, entertainment, publishing, or brand/agency environments

• A portfolio demonstrating strong fundamentals (anatomy, perspective, composition, color, lighting, and environment) alongside strong graphic and visual design sensibility

• Mastery of rendering rich, painterly, polished illustration in a digital workflow

• Experience adapting to and matching an established art style or brand system

• Working knowledge of typography, layout, and identity design, and the ability to apply them to marketing and brand deliverables

• Ability to take a brief and run independently, from thumbnail to final

• Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting work-in-progress and managing stakeholders

• Ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Experience working with vendors, agencies, or production partners is a plus

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

jobs.title: Project Manager, Creative Production & Content Operations
jobs.description:
We have been alerted to the existence of a fraudster impersonating MANSCAPED as a hiring manager or HR representative. This impersonator is utilizing an email address with the domain manscapedjobs.com or manscapedcareers.com and is making fraudulent offers for our open jobs. Contact from MANSCAPED will only ever come from someone with a manscaped.com email address.

This is a scam targeting a number of companies, us included. If you receive any of these types of messages, we recommend that you don’t respond with any information and that you block and report those users.

• The MANSCAPED Team

Who We Are - MANSCAPED® is a leading men’s grooming and lifestyle consumer brand on a mission to introduce and elevate a whole new self-care routine for men. What began as the category creator of below-the-waist grooming has quickly evolved into a global omnichannel powerhouse available around the world on manscaped.com, Amazon, and in major retailers including Target®, Walmart, and Best Buy. As a company, we’re more than just ball jokes (though, rest assured, there’s plenty of those). We proudly uphold seven core values – accountability, authenticity, collaboration, fun, humility, inclusivity, and innovation – which define our brand identity and drive our success. As a people-centric employer brand, we are deeply committed to fostering the growth, happiness, and holistic well-being of each individual on our team.

Who We’re Looking For - Reporting to the Sr. Director, PMO, MANSCAPED® is seeking a Project Manager, Creative Operations & Content Operations to support the intake, prioritization, coordination, and execution of creative production workflows across digital design, content, video, retail, and campaign initiatives. This role will serve as a key operational partner across Creative, Brand, Marketing, Production, and external agency teams, ensuring projects move efficiently from intake through final delivery. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is highly organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about building scalable creative processes that improve team efficiency and output quality. This individual will manage digital and static design assets, content queues, creative production timelines, and agency coordination, while ensuring deliverables remain aligned with brand standards and business priorities.

The MANSCAPED® Way - At MANSCAPED®, what we do matters – but how we do it matters more. We take ownership of our work, showing up with accountability and a commitment to quality at every level. We work as one team, guided by a belief to unite, never divide, and to lead with empathy in how we support and challenge one another. The best ideas win, and they come from keeping our egos in check and our standards high. We stay humble, open to learning, and willing to grow. We bring fun to the journey, because great work shouldn’t come at the expense of enjoying what you do. We stay nimble and innovative, always looking for smarter and better ways to get things done. Ball work is honest work, and that mindset shows up in everything we do, including our proud partnership with the Testicular Cancer Society and our commitment to raising awareness of the ball-busting disease.

Responsibilities

• Manage intake, prioritization, and tracking of creative requests across digital design, video, content, retail, and campaign initiatives

• Partner with Creative, Brand, Marketing, Production, and PMO teams to ensure deliverables are completed on time and aligned with business priorities

• Maintain and improve project management workflows, intake systems, and templates within Asana for digital and static creative assets

• Facilitate timeline management, status tracking, and cross-functional communication across active workstreams

• Manage task intake, production, and delivery of digital, web, retail, video, photo and marketplace creative assets (digital and static ads, IG captions, GIFs, and email visual assets)

• Maintain organized documentation and asset tracking

• Support operational management of video production workflows including new video development, cuts and edits, end cards, UGC content, Tsunami deliverables, and campaign video assets

• Assist with building and maintaining timelines for photo shoots and video production

• Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth execution across content shoots and production timelines

• Coordinate and manage ways of working with external creative agencies

• Support execution of mid-tier activations and brand campaign initiatives

• Ensure cross-functional alignment between agencies, internal creative teams, and stakeholders

• Facilitate task kickoffs, status meetings, and follow-up communications

• Monitor task timelines and proactively surface risks, blockers, and shifting priorities

• Additional duties as required

Qualifications

• 4+years of experience in project management, creative operations, content production, marketing operations, or a related field

• Experience supporting creative production, digital marketing, content operations, or campaign workflows

• Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, Monday.com, Jira, or similar tools

• Understanding of digital creative workflows, asset management, and production timelines

• Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work cross-functionally across Creative, Brand, Production, and external agency teams

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects

• Detail-oriented with strong follow-through and accountability

• Comfortable managing fast-moving priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Interest in AI-enabled workflows, automation, and operational process improvement preferred

• Experience coordinating video production, photography, or content operations is a plus

• Experience within consumer products, retail, lifestyle, beauty, or eCommerce industries preferred

MANSCAPED® Benefits

• Take time to find balance and rejuvenate your senses. Enjoy a generous 20 accrued vacation days per year to relax, travel, and spend quality time with your loved ones. We value your need for a healthy work-life balance

• Health comes first, always. We provide 40 hours of paid sick leave annually, ensuring you can take the time you need to recover

• Your mental health matters. Take 3 paid mental health days to recharge and take care of your emotional well-being

• We offer 9 paid holidays throughout the year to give you the opportunity to celebrate important moments and take a break from work

• Some call it pet insurance, we call it Paws & Claws coverage. Our plan helps you take care of your furry family members, giving you peace of mind

• Our comprehensive life insurance, AD&D and long-term disability coverage provide financial security for you and your family in case of unexpected events

• Access comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, along with Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), ensuring you and your family are well-covered

• If you're facing life's challenges, our confidential Employee Assistance Program offers resources to help you navigate them

• Add a layer of protection from the unexpected costs of emergencies and unexpected illnesses. Enrollment in our accident and critical illness plans can provide financial support during the most difficult of times

• Let us take the guess work out of retirement planning with our employee 401(k) plan and company match

• We are a remote-first employer. You will receive a monthly utility allowance to help cover the costs of Wifi and phone usage

• Enjoy a generous discount on our products as part of our employee discount program, making holiday and birthday shopping a breeze

• Participate in our exciting wellness challenges designed to promote a healthy and active lifestyle. From step competitions to mindfulness sessions, join your colleagues in fun and motivating activities that boost your physical and mental well-being

• We support our families by offering paid parental leave to support you during a pivotal time in your life, adding to the family!

• We are a certified Great Place to Work, growing rapidly and offering incredible opportunities for advancement. Join us and be part of an exciting journey with a company that values its employees

jobs.title: Security Protective Operations Center Operator (Night Shift)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SECURITY PROTECTIVE OPERATIONS CENTER OPERATOR (NIGHT SHIFT)

SpaceX is looking for experienced operators for its SpaceX Protective Operations Center (SPOC), its global 24/7 monitoring and incident response coordination center. The selected candidate will be a dedicated security professional with a demonstrated ability to work both independently and as a member of a team in a fast-paced high-tech environment. As a SPOC Operator, you will coordinate day-to-day and incident response logistics, while providing support to security officers. SPOC operators will also act as a point-of-contact for matters relating to each area facility and, as such, must coordinate closely with all operational, management, and administrative sections for area office. Areas of responsibility include: event/incident monitoring, camera/security alarm monitoring, video review, dispatching, coordinating allocation of resources, and incident response management and communications.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Investigate incidents thoroughly, coordinate information gathering with responding security personnel, and create accurate and timely incident reports

• Notifying and coordinating with onsite first responders, stake holders and local law enforcement during any incident/emergency

• Monitor, analyze, and report on daily global incidents that may impact SpaceX employees or offices, and escalate accordingly to security management, and subsequently to other key stake holders within the company

• Responsible for monitoring access control alarms, video surveillance equipment, fire alarm systems, and dispatching resources to investigate any anomalous alarms and activity with security personnel, uniformed security officers, and other departments as appropriate

• Prioritize and process all incoming security reports and requests via radio, phone, and support ticket, and track all associated shift activity accordingly

• Identify and communicate critical incidents or events according to established notification procedures including senior leadership, internal stakeholders and external partners as appropriate, and coordinate incident response logistics, provide direction and response instructions to uniformed security forces, and create accurate and timely incident reports

• Assist with video surveillance system reviews for key stake holders and internal investigations

• Ensure thorough and current understanding of security operations center roles and responsibilities, applicable SpaceX policies/procedures, contract security policies/procedures and all applicable security work instructions

• Maintain a positive, professional environment in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies/procedures and act to ensure all SpaceX personnel understand and comply with all applicable security work instructions

• Perform additional duties as assigned or required by Security Leadership or SpaceX management

• Active monitoring and over watch of the Hawthorne headquarters and of satellite offices and facilities

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 2+ years of experience as a global security operations center (GSOC) operator or corporate security role; or 2+ years of law enforcement or military experience

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree

• Ability to communicate professionally and effectively via telephone and email and interact with all levels of employees and visitors

• Strong focus on attention to detail

• Work well in a fast-paced and multi-tasking team focused environment

• Learn, retain, and apply a variety of security related concepts, information and processes

• Understanding of security systems (access control, video surveillance, and fire systems)

• Ability to prioritize workload based on urgency; appropriately delegate and oversee tasks, and communicate to a range of audiences including to executive management

• Perform continuous follow-up on pending/open projects and tasks through completion

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

• Experience working closely with mass communication tools

• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, specifically data analysis and use of pivot tables using Excel

• Ability to assess, evaluate, and effectively escalate situations for proper resolution

• Active secret security clearance

• Experience with geospatial analysis software (ArcGIS, QGIS, Google Earth)

• Proficiency conducting open source intelligence (OSINT) research to identify threats to personnel, facilities, or information

• Superior report writing skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work the following shift: Night shift: (5PM - 5AM)

• Availability to work any schedule needed, including, but not limited to: overtime, nights, weekends and rotating schedules

• Position is subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing

• Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg

• Valid driver’s license

• Possess or be eligible for a valid state security officer license

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $28.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

Every go-to-market process at Cognite impacts another. The way we set up lead routing and assignment directly impacts pipeline growth. The way we manage the pipeline affects our forecasts and bookings. Bookings then affect compensation, revenue recognition, and resource planning. You're the architect of the system that brings all of this together.

The Revenue Operations team is at the nexus of the Revenue organization and every function that touches the customer. They are the team that connects Revenue to Marketing, Value Delivery (professional services and support), Finance, and all the other functions through the processes and systems that Revenue owns. You build the architecture that binds the teams together so that any new process, field, report, or automation you create will fit with what's already in place and every stage of the customer journey can be measured.

This is a high-visibility seat. You'll be working directly with leaders across Revenue, Marketing, Professional Services, Finance and Product. Your impact and the way you work with those teams will help determine how the commercial teams operate and deliver value to the customer.

The Impact you bring to Cognite

• Build the structure to measure our customer funnel from lead to cash to expansion. The stages, fields, data flows, and reporting across your GTM systems (Salesforce, Gainsight, Clari etc.) need to be structured in such a way that the metrics that the metrics leaders need can be reliably tracked.

• Connect the teams through the systems and processes that Revenue owns. Ensure that handoffs between Revenue, Marketing, Value Delivery and Finance are properly captured so that each team can see their own results and how they fit in the wider picture.

• Influence change across the various commercial functions. For any proposed process, field, or tool change, assess its impact on the rest of GTM. Flag any conflicts early, align the relevant teams, and help sequence the changes so they all go in at the same time.

• Collect field feedback and design solutions with GTM Systems. Gather the field input, identify the most important issues, and then work with GTM Systems to resolve them. Ensure that whatever solution you end up with (whether that's an AI agent or some form of automation) fits within the overall design.

• Govern the GTM data dictionary. Have one set of definitions for data and fields across our systems and define which fields are to be used to answer the questions of Revenue so that every leader and every automated tool is getting the same answers.

• Speed up analysis and reporting. Work with the VP on forecast, pipeline, and productivity analysis. Shorten the time from question to trusted answer, and replace manual reporting with reliable, self-serve alternatives.

How we measure success

• Forecast accuracy improves

• Reporting cycle time drops

• Improved data integrity across the funnel and customer-facing functions

• Cross-functional teams use the shared data to prioritize their own fixes and rate RevOps as reliable and easy to work with

What we are looking for

• 2-3 years at a top-tier consulting firm, or equivalent experience at a high-growth tech or industrial company

• Systems thinking. You see how a change in one process affects five others

• Cross-functional presence. You can align Revenue, Finance, and Marketing without managing their teams

• Comfort with data. You turn a vague process problem into something measurable and sized

• A habit of asking why a process exists and finding the evidence for a better one

• Ability to turn messy inputs into a clear, decision-ready point of view under time pressure

• Skill at turning ambiguous questions into reusable definitions that people and AI tools can both use

• Interest in learning Salesforce, Gainsight, Clari, and Vasco, and in working with AI tools

• Exposure to enterprise software, energy, or manufacturing is a plus

A snapshot of our many perks and benefits as a Cogniter

• Competitive compensation

• 401(k) with employer matching

• Competitive health, dental, vision & disability coverages for employees and all dependents
