jobs.title: Director of Subrogation
jobs.description:
Location: Remote
Reports to: Claims Operations
Employment type: Full-time

About Strala

Strala is building the world's first AI-native TPA. Insurance is core to the global economy, yet its foundation - claims - is still characterized by legacy tech and fragmented processes. We are changing that. Strala isn't just a software tool; we are a full-service, AI-powered partner rebuilding the mechanics of risk from the ground up. We are reimagining how claims get handled, using AI to make adjusters dramatically more effective and to scale claims capacity far beyond what legacy models allow. Backed by more than $50M, our team combines the elite technical pedigree of Palantir, Oxford AI labs, Geico, CCC, Hertz, and American National with the deep operational expertise of carriers like Travelers and Progressive. We are looking for a VP of Claims to lead this transformation and define what "modern claims" looks like for the world's largest carriers.

 

About the role

Strala is seeking a Director of Subrogation to lead and grow our recovery function. This leader will own subrogation strategy, team performance, and operational execution - from identifying recovery opportunities through negotiation, arbitration, litigation, and collection.

The Director will build a disciplined, scalable operation that increases net recoveries, shortens recovery timelines, and delivers clear results for clients. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong technical judgment, commercial awareness, and the ability to improve how people, processes, and technology work together.


Key responsibilities

Strategy and financial performance

 - Develop and execute the subrogation strategy and hit performance measures for gross and net recoveries, recovery yield, cycle time, aged inventory, and recovery expenses.

 - Forecast recovery results and explain performance, risks, and improvement opportunities to leadership and clients.

Recovery operations and technical oversight

 - Oversee the full recovery lifecycle, including intake, investigation, liability assessment, demand preparation, negotiation, escalation, and collection.

 - Set clear standards for file assignment, prioritization, documentation, settlement authority, and closure.

 - Provide technical direction on complex, high-value, disputed, and litigated recoveries.

 - Ensure evidence is preserved and critical deadlines are identified, tracked, and acted upon.

 - Evaluate pursuit strategies based on recovery potential, supporting evidence, expected expense, and likelihood of success.

 - Establish quality reviews and file audits to improve consistency and prevent recovery leakage.

Team leadership

 - Recruit, coach, and develop subrogation professionals and managers.

 - Set individual and team goals, balance workloads, and hold employees accountable for quality and results.

 - Build training programs that strengthen investigation, negotiation, arbitration, and recovery skills.

Clients, counsel, and recovery partners

 - Serve as the senior subrogation contact for clients, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

 - Lead recovery reviews and communicate strategies, outcomes, and material developments clearly.

 - Select and manage outside counsel, collection agencies, investigators, and other recovery partners.

 - Monitor vendor results, fees, service standards, and the financial value of outsourced work.

 - Partner with Claims, Legal, Finance, and Account Management to protect recovery opportunities throughout the claims lifecycle.

Technology and continuous improvement

 - Improve claims-system workflows, data quality, reporting, and recovery identification.

 - Partner with engineering teams to implement practical automation and analytics.
   

Required qualifications

 - 10+ years of progressive subrogation or claims recovery experience, including complex property and casualty recoveries.

 - 5+ years of leadership experience, with demonstrated success building or improving a recovery operation.

 - Strong automobile claims experience, including liability investigation, damage evaluation, and negotiation.

 - Working knowledge of multi-state subrogation practices, arbitration, and litigation management.

 - Demonstrated ability to improve net recoveries, operational efficiency, and team performance.

 - Experience managing vendors, budgets, performance reporting, and client relationships.

 - Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills.

 - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
   

Preferred qualifications

 - Experience in a third-party administrator, carrier, or claims services organization.

 - Experience with commercial auto, rental fleets, or self-insured programs.

 - Familiarity with Arbitration Forums, Inc.

 - Relevant professional designations, such as CSRP, CPCU, or AIC.

 - Experience implementing claims technology, analytics, or workflow automation.

jobs.description:

The Staff Attorney supports the Legal department of Body Contour Centers (Sono Bello), with a primary focus on defending medical malpractice claims in litigation and arbitration, as well as working with the Legal and Compliance teams on contract review, legal research, and tracking of changes in laws and regulations impacting the healthcare industry. The attorney manages claims from initial notice through resolution, partners with outside counsel, insurers, physicians, and internal teams, and advises leadership on case strategy, exposure, and opportunities to reduce risk. The role reports to the SVP of Legal and Regulatory and works with executive and medical leadership.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Manage medical malpractice claims, lawsuits, and arbitrations from initial notice and pre-suit evaluation through discovery, hearing or trial, settlement, and post-resolution matters.

• Develop and implement defense strategies with outside counsel; evaluate liability, causation, damages, procedural issues, and the enforceability and application of arbitration agreements.

• Investigate claims with physicians, clinical teams, and risk management; review medical records, interview witnesses, develop case chronologies, and identify relevant evidence and experts.

• Coordinate legal holds, evidence preservation, discovery, and document production; protect privileged communications, confidential patient information, and sensitive business records.

• Draft, review, and coordinate pleadings, motions, discovery responses, arbitration submissions, and settlement agreements; participate directly in proceedings as authorized and permitted by applicable practice rules.

• Oversee outside counsel, case budgets, deadlines, and reporting; coordinate timely claim notices, coverage issues, and defense and settlement requirements with insurers and brokers.

• Evaluate settlement opportunities and participate in mediations and negotiations within delegated authority; present case assessments and settlement recommendations to leadership for approval.

• Maintain accurate matter tracking and report case status, exposure, spending, and trends; monitor relevant legal developments and recommend improvements to consent, arbitration, documentation, and claims practices.

• Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, including vendor contracts, marketing agreements, clinical services agreements, NDAs, BAAs, and technology contracts.

• Maintain and improve contract templates, policies, and workflows for efficiency and consistency.

• Oversee compliance with applicable laws and regulations and conduct legal research and analysis to stay current on changes that may impact the company and its subsidiaries.

• Assist with corporate governance, entity management, and insurance matters as needed.

• Support litigation management, responding to subpoenas, and regulatory inquiries.

• Contribute to building scalable processes as the company continues to grow.

• Manage projects effectively and collaboratively.

• Collaborate with the Legal & Compliance teams to evaluate and communicate legal risks and develop creative solutions to bridge business priorities in a changing regulatory landscape.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED

• Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school.

• Active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction and good standing.

• Relevant experience defending medical malpractice claims in litigation and arbitration, including case assessment, discovery, depositions, motion practice, and settlement.

• Strong legal research, writing, advocacy, and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret medical records and communicate case strategy and legal exposure to clinical and business leaders.

• Experience handling confidential patient information and sensitive legal matters with sound judgment, discretion, and attention to privilege and privacy requirements.

• Ability to manage a multistate caseload, meet litigation and arbitration deadlines, and coordinate effectively with outside counsel, insurers, experts, and internal teams.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

PREFERRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer, Autonomy Platforms
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TEAM BRINGING AUTONOMY TO THE BUILT WORLD


At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and onto real job sites. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. We retrofit the heavy equipment contractors already own, starting with excavators, so experienced crews can safely take on more projects and deliver them more predictably.

In August 2026, Bedrock-equipped excavators began doing fully autonomous, paid work on live commercial job sites. We've more than doubled our customer base since 2025, and our machines now work with contractors across the West, South, and Midwest.

In October 2026, we raised a $600M Series C co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, bringing our total funding to nearly $1B. We're using it to put more autonomous machines to work, build the field and operations teams behind every deployment, and expand into new machine types and job-site tasks.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Hardware Engineer on the Autonomy Platforms team you will architect, source, build, and bring to life the key hardware systems that enable autonomy on our machines. You will work with a wide range of engineering teams within Bedrock (product, commercial, perception, behavior, controls, platform integration, supply chain, and more) to drive consensus on critical HW system functionality and decomposition. You will work alongside other HW engineers to bring about these components, ensuring the platform meets our high performance bars and works reliably in the harsh environments that we deploy into.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

The candidate will be responsible for designing, characterizing, integrating, and validating bedrock autonomy hardware.

 - Help define system and component level HW architecture for autonomous machines

 - Establish and lead relationships and programs with external vendors to deliver critical components and systems for our autonomous HW platforms

 - Work with other HW platform engineers to bring together a cohesive and high performance system that is flexible and modular

 - Work with safety team to establish requirements and performance metrics for components and systems

 - Write reusable, high quality, data analysis and test automation software (Python and/or C++/C/Rust)


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field

 - Hands on experience with design and testing of autonomy HW such as sensing, compute, HMI, connectivity, and machine control interfaces

 - Strong foundational knowledge in traditional HW engineering subjects such as electrical design, high and low speed communication protocols, power electronics, bring-up and testing, and deployment of hardware systems in rugged outdoor environments

 - Experience leading large HW development programs from ideation through proto, EVT, DVT, and production stages

 - Experience with some of the following:
   
   - High performance/power edge compute including multi-CPU platforms (x86, ARM) with significant GPU resources, including experience around power and cooling (air/liquid)
   
   - Common autonomous sensing technologies including lidar (spinning, flash), camera (visible, SWIR, NIR, etc…), radar, RTK GNSS, and IMU
   
   - Remote operator stations including ergonomic human interfaces, low latency information display, and safety critical design
   
   - HMI deployment in rugged (high shock/vibe and temp) environments including screens and/or tablets
   
   - Packaging and integration strategies for high performance HW systems in rugged environments including high shock/vibe, wide temp ranges, IP, and solar loading
   
   - High speed signaling including GSML, multi gigabit ethernet, RF

 - Proficiency in compiled (C/C++/Rust), shell (linux bash), or runtime (Python) languages with ability to prototype and debug software components of HW systems as well as run tests, data collection, analysis, and reporting

Preferred:

 - 6+ years of relevant industry experience preferred

 - Heavy machinery hydraulic systems including electronic control

 - High performance embedded compute, in particular Nvidia Jetson lineup

 - High and low speed communication protocols (GMSL, FPDlink, PCIe, multi GigE, A2B, CAN, UART, SPI, RS232/422/485, etc…)

 - Experience with system engineering requirements definition and V&V

 - High power LED lighting for scene illumination

 - Experience with common standards for HW deployment in construction
   
   - ISO26262, ISO16750, SAE J1455, etc…

 - Familiarity with large commercial construction equipment basic machine electrical and mechanical HW and interface

The coordinator also processes ownership changes for Cadwell products and manages demo, evaluation, loaner, and electrode sample requests, working closely with Sales, Finance, and Operations to deliver accurate, timely service to customers and internal teams.

Enter and process CadCare contract orders in Cadwell’s ERP and CRM systems with a high degree of accuracy and timeliness. Coordinate with Finance to ensure contracts are invoiced accurately and on schedule. Route customer requests for nonstandard contract terms to Legal for review. Maintain accurate contract and renewal records, ensuring data integrity across all systems. Report on expiring contracts, renewal status, and renewal rate to commercial leadership. Coordinate delivery of electrode and accessory samples, tracking requests and maintaining accurate records in Cadwell’s ERP and CRM systems. About Wonderschool

Wonderschool helps child care providers fill openings and run stronger businesses. Our marketplace connects providers with families, while our software supports enrollment, communication, payments, and daily operations. We sell SaaS products and usage-based marketplace solutions.

AI is becoming part of how providers run their businesses. We are building tools that help them respond to families, manage enrollment, and make better business decisions.

We are looking for a Head of Sales to hire and manage our provider sales team and grow revenue from child care providers. You will convert inbound interest, build new pipeline, and help the team sell across our marketplace and SaaS solutions.

You will be directly involved in the work. You will take provider calls, work alongside reps on important deals, and coach them through discovery, objections, follow-up, and closing. You will build the sales process in HubSpot and use AI to improve outbound, tracking, and team performance.

Grow revenue

• Use customer feedback and sales results to improve targeting, positioning, and the sales approach, and recommend changes to pricing and packaging.

Hire and lead the team

• Hire, manage, and develop provider salespeople.

• Take calls yourself and join important or difficult deals.

• Review calls and coach reps on discovery, deal strategy, objections, follow-up, and closing.

Build the sales system

• Own lead routing, pipeline stages, sequences, workflows, follow-up, forecasting, and reporting in HubSpot.

• Create playbooks for selling both SaaS and usage-based marketplace solutions.

• Use funnel data to identify where deals stall, test improvements, and share a reliable forecast with leadership.

• Partner with provider growth and customer success so sales commitments lead to successful adoption and continued use.

Make AI useful

• Use AI for prospect research, outbound outreach, call preparation, follow-up, and tracking.

• Measure whether AI improves qualified pipeline, conversion, and revenue.

• Help providers understand and use Wonderschool's AI tools to respond to families, manage enrollment, and run their businesses more effectively.

What Success Looks Like

• Revenue from child care providers grows across SaaS and usage-based marketplace solutions.

• More reps consistently meet their revenue targets as coaching and sales playbooks improve.

• New hires become effective through clear onboarding, coaching, and performance expectations.

• Providers activate the products they buy and continue using them, in partnership with provider growth and customer success.

Who You Are

• You have grown revenue selling SaaS, marketplace, or usage-based products to small businesses. You can explain your targets, results, and the decisions that improved performance.

• You have hired, coached, and managed salespeople. You can point to people you helped become better sellers and the results they achieved.

We offer highly competitive compensation, uncapped earning potential, equity, and benefits.

jobs.title: Security Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Security at that scale runs on data, and you'll be the engineer who owns it and the systems that produce it: component-level hardware inventory and chain of custody, fed by software that runs at our sites and on hosts, and continuous control monitoring, with the posture calculations that decide what each site is cleared to run.

You set the architecture, agree schemas and interfaces with the teams, operators and vendors that own the sources, build the pipelines, stores and tools, and run what you ship. The goal is security that runs itself: custody, access and evidence verified continuously from records, with tools and AI agents doing the reviews. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's compute and data center operations teams, and directly with data center operators, hardware vendors and logistics providers. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

Key responsibilities

• Hardware inventory and chain of custody: own the component-level record of what hardware exists, where it is and who has handled it: the data model, the pipelines that join inventory and custody events from many source systems, change history on every record, and the tamper-evident stores behind it

• Tools, automation and AI agents: build the tools and agents the team runs on this data: reconciliation, audit evidence exports, custody checks. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it

• Custody workflows and field software: build the workflows and the site and host software that capture custody events as they happen (a receipt, a move, a data wipe, a decommission) and enforce who is authorized to record them

• Continuous control monitoring and posture: own the pipelines that turn check outcomes, assessment results and findings into per-control and per-site measures over time, against the compliance frameworks we and our partners are assessed against, and the posture calculation that decides what a site is cleared to run

• Data quality: build coverage checks, reconciliation against sources and alerts on a silent or drifting feed, so a wrong or missing record is caught the same day; own retention and access controls on the records

• Integration and reporting: agree schemas and interfaces with the engineers who run the security monitoring platform, and build the query surfaces and reports the team, site leads and leadership use directly

Minimum qualifications

• Have designed and run production data systems (relational schemas, change data capture, batch or streaming pipelines and the services around them) and kept them correct: coverage measured, records reconciled against the source, alerts on silence, and a design that expects records to get corrupted or lost

• Have integrated with systems you did not control (inventory tools, ticketing systems, vendor APIs) and built data models that outlive any one source

• Have shipped software that runs outside a central service (host agents, site-local services, edge collectors) and kept it correct in the field, or built metrics a team made decisions on and defended them when challenged

• Have worked hands-on with data about physical assets or security controls: a hardware fleet, data center or supply chain inventory, asset custody, or the control and evidence data of a security or compliance program

• Read and review other people's code, and build with AI coding agents using Git and code review

• Own a domain end to end: set the approach, design and build it with the teams and vendors whose systems it depends on, and run it as something people use every day

• Write SQL and at least one general-purpose programming language well

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with asset management, supply chain or warehouse systems where serialized tracking and custody transfer are the core problem

• Experience building continuous control monitoring or metrics for a security or compliance program, or producing evidence an assessor accepted, for example against NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001 or SOC 2

• Experience with risk or posture scoring that combines control results, findings and other evidence into a measure people make decisions on

• Familiarity with data center hardware and its lifecycle from receipt to decommission, and with sites and parties you did not control: colocation, cloud or GPU cloud operators, hardware manufacturers, logistics providers

• Have run software on many hosts or at remote sites with versioned rollout and a way to know each copy is still reporting

• Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual work

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Senior External Development Manager
jobs.description:
WE ARE GAME MAKERS

Who We Are:

We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.

What We Need:

We are seeking a senior external development leader to own how 31st Union works with external partners: what we send out, who we send it to, how it comes back, and how good it is when it does. You will set our external development strategy in partnership with the Head of Operations and studio leadership, and then build the thing you designed, including the pipelines, trackers, briefs, review loops, and onboarding paths that our partnerships actually run on.

This role combines strategy ownership with hands-on production ownership. You are the person in the room when we decide what is viable to outsource on our AAA project. You are also the person who writes the tracker, fixes the brief template, and chases the access ticket. You will partner closely with Production to work out how we resource and schedule external work, and with Art Direction and our discipline leads to make sure the feedback reaching a vendor's team is specific, consistent, and actionable. This is a first-in-seat role. There is no external development team to inherit, and building one as our slate grows is part of the job.

What You'll Do:

• External Development Strategy: Partner with Head of Operations and studio leadership to set and evolve our external development strategy: which disciplines are viable to send out, which partnership model fits each (asset vendor, embedded team, full co-development), and what we deliberately keep in house. Draft the internal-versus-external business cases behind those calls rather than presenting them as instinct.

• Pipeline & Workflow Ownership: Design, implement, and maintain the tools, systems, workflows, and operational policies that external development runs on in partnership with our domain leaders, including brief and outsourcing pack templates, asset trackers, review protocols, acceptance criteria, onboarding documentation, and the reporting standards behind all of it.

• Partner Sourcing & Commercial Management: Lead the RFP process, vendor outreach, portfolio and evaluation, as well as partner selection. Negotiate scope, capacity, cost, and delivery expectations against project goals and budget. Own the lifecycle of each partnership in collaboration with internal stakeholders: contracts and amendments with Legal and Procurement, invoices, renewals and expirations, offboarding, and onboarding, including driving IT and information security escalations to resolution so partners are productive quickly and safely.

• Budget & Forecasting: Manage the studio's external development budget and forecast process in partnership with the Operations team. Model cost against capacity, identify where spend is buying us the most, review deliverables against contractual criteria before milestone payments release, and bring cost-efficiency options to leadership before you are asked for them.

• Production Partnership: Work with Production and discipline leads to determine how we actually produce external development: where the capacity gaps are, how external work is sequenced against internal milestones, and how workload is balanced across our internal teams and our external partners. Make sure external schedules and internal plans are aligned.

• Creative Partnership & Quality Oversight: Partner with Art Direction, craft owners, and discipline leads to define creative briefs, style guides, benchmark assets, and quality bars before production starts. Build and run the review cadence that gets vendor work in front of the right internal eyes on time, and make sure what goes back out is actionable direction. Protect our Art Directors' review time by establishing a technical and visual pre-screen process, and keep the loop tight enough that a partner's team improves over the course of an engagement.

• Delivery Oversight, Risk & Reporting: Build and manage vendor production schedules, monitor milestone health across the full slate of partnerships, and proactively mitigate risk from schedule, budget, or scope drift, bringing problems forward early with options attached rather than warnings. Own our external development database and reporting standards, and report vendor KPIs, capacity, spend, and delivery trends to studio leadership and publisher stakeholders in terms they can act on.

• Building The Function & The Bench: Grow external development from a function of one into a team as our slate requires it, including headcount recommendations, structure, and career pathing. Mentor and calibrate the team members managing our external engagements across our disciplines, whether or not they report to you.

Who You Are:

• A Strategist Who Still Builds: You can hold a multi-year view of our partner portfolio and open a spreadsheet the same afternoon. You are not looking for a role where the work arrives pre-scoped, and you are not looking for one where you only build other people's plans. You want both, and you know the difference between the two modes.

• An Operator With Commercial Teeth: You have run RFPs, negotiated SOWs and rates, and owned a budget rather than reported on one. You are comfortable saying no to a partner, and comfortable explaining to a lead why the cheaper bid is the more expensive decision.

• Grounded In The Craft: You may not be an artist, but you can tell the difference between a vendor skill gap, a brief gap, and a process gap, and you know which one you are looking at before you write the feedback. You understand what a style guide and a benchmark asset are for, and why a technical constraint agreed in week one saves a month in week twelve.

• A Collaborator, A Diplomat, And A Developer Of People: You are the bridge between internal leads who want it perfect, production who wants it on the date, and a partner team eleven time zones away who wants a clear answer. You convey complex creative feedback clearly and diplomatically, often to non-native English speakers, and you manage communication windows rather than complaining about them. You articulate not just the "what" but the "why," to your own team and to our partners, and you treat a vendor as capability to be grown rather than capacity to be bought.

• Comfortable In The "Gray" Areas: You are joining a function that does not fully exist yet. You are comfortable shaping new processes and adjusting them as the department evolves, and you would rather establish the standard than wait for one.

• Tooling: Strong working knowledge of Jira and ShotGrid/Flow, and enough spreadsheet and data fluency to build the reporting yourself. Familiarity with Perforce or equivalent source control, and with how assets get integrated into a live engine build.

• Level of Experience: 6 to 8+ years of external development or production experience in the video game industry, with a track record of running external development across multiple projects or a full franchise and real budget ownership.

Bonus Points:

• Experience standing up an external development or outsourcing function from scratch.

• Experience with global partners across multiple time zones and cultures, including studios in Eastern Europe, South America, or Asia.

• Familiarity with publisher-side production and cross-studio coordination.

• Hands-on background in one of the disciplines we outsource, whether art, animation, audio, engineering, or QA.

The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $103,700 and $153,500 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for employees in regular roles may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, provided that temporary or intern roles will not be eligible for many of these payments or benefits. Details of participation in compensation and benefit plans (if applicable) will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an ~at-will position~ and the company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

jobs.title: Customer Support Agent - (Ukrainian Speaking) (Bench Team)
jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Customer Support Agent with fluency in Ukrainian to join our Bench Team. In this individual-contributor role, you’ll provide fast, accurate, and personalized support to customers through research, investigation, troubleshooting, and effective resolution.

You’ll work within a fast-paced, structured support environment where clear communication, critical thinking, and consistent performance are essential. Your goal will be to resolve customer needs efficiently while meeting client expectations for service, quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do

• Deliver high-quality customer service by following established departmental policies, processes, and support standards.

• Work across multiple tools, systems, knowledge bases, and communication channels while applying available information to individual customer situations.

• Assist with creating and updating knowledge-base articles.

• Contribute to team development through active collaboration, knowledge sharing, and issue resolution.

• Coordinate with internal teams to provide feedback, identify trends, report recurring concerns, and resolve customer issues.

• Research and resolve escalated issues within the approved scope of the role.

• Serve as a point of escalation for customer inquiries when assigned.

• Monitor client-facing communication tools, including Mattermost, and remain current on client updates and directives.

• Respond to customer requests escalated by Tier 2 agents and address customer needs, complaints, and account-related concerns.

• Use critical thinking and sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps and support positive outcomes for the client and customer.

• Support managers with onboarding new and existing agents into the Escalated Accounts workflow when assigned.

• Demonstrate Blueprint’s values through daily interactions with customers, clients, and colleagues.

• Associate degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Strong written communication skills and the ability to provide clear, accurate, and professional customer responses.

• Experience using computers and working across multiple systems and support tools.

• Ability to perform initial troubleshooting of common computer and network issues.

• Ability to remain composed and professional when handling stressful or complex customer situations.

• Strong customer focus and a genuine interest in helping people resolve problems.

• Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and customer-service skills.

• Strong attention to detail and time-management skills.

• Ability to meet deadlines, client productivity standards, and service expectations.

• Strong critical-thinking, research, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to receive, apply, and grow from constructive feedback.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office or related productivity software.

• Ability to work independently, use sound judgment, and seek guidance when appropriate.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Knowledge of or interest in online gaming.

• Experience working with account-related support tickets.

• Ability to troubleshoot account-related ticket issues independently and collaboratively.

• Experience working with ticketing systems or customer-support platforms.

Schedule and Work Requirements

This role may require scheduled coverage during weekends and holidays based on business and customer-support needs.

Work schedules may change based on operational requirements.

Time-off availability may be limited during peak business periods to maintain appropriate customer coverage.

Compensation

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated compensation range is $23.00 to $25.50 USD per hour. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications.

Location and Work Arrangement

Bellevue, Washington

This is a hybrid role that generally requires two days per week in the Bellevue office, with additional flexibility based on Blueprint’s work-from-home policy and business needs.

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• 401(k) retirement plan

• Competitive paid time off

• Parental leave

• Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicant Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, AI
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager, AI Platform to own and scale Ask Teamworks and the shared platform behind AI experiences across our product suite. Teamworks builds the operating system for elite sports organizations. Every NFL, NHL and Premier League club uses it, along with 99% of NCAA Division I athletic departments. Across more than 20 products, we hold the data and workflows that matter most to coaches, scouts, GMs, athletic trainers, performance staff and operators.

This is a build-and-scale role with ownership of both the platform and the customer experience. Ask Teamworks is already in beta in two products with dozens of customers each. You'll help take those agents to general availability, enable product teams to build against shared standards, and turn cross-product data into trusted workflows. An agent orchestrating across our product suite can act on the following: “We’re deciding whether to extend John’s contract or to pursue the two portal targets at his position. Compare their on-field production and projected value, our player’s availability and load/injury history over the last two seasons, and how his role in our scheme has changed. Speak in $’s, not just words. Prepare the contract(s) for the recommended option, and any supporting evidence/reports for our head coach.”


THE ROLE

 - Lead the rollout and expansion of AI agents across Teamworks' product portfolio, partnering with product teams to move from beta to general availability and scale adoption across sports and global markets.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering to define shared platform capabilities, technical standards and integration requirements that enable teams to build consistent, reliable AI experiences.

 - Own the development of AI-powered workflows that connect data and actions across products, helping customers move from insights to action while maintaining appropriate permissions and user confirmation.

 - Define and manage AI quality standards, including evaluation datasets, success criteria and automated regression testing, to ensure new capabilities are ready for release and remain reliable as they evolve.

 - Expand agentic capabilities beyond conversational assistants into product-embedded agent actions, dashboards, integrations with customers' AI tools and proactive alerts, prioritizing opportunities that deliver meaningful customer value.

 - Collaborate with go-to-market teams to shape usage measurement, customer allowances and product packaging, and provide clear visibility into which AI capabilities are available to each customer.

 - Drive alignment across product, engineering and commercial teams without direct authority, balancing customer needs, technical dependencies and responsible handling of sensitive athlete data.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - 5+ years of software engineering or technical PM experience building production systems, before or alongside moving into product

 - A track record of shipping an LLM-based or agentic product to real users, with evidence of adoption or customer value

 - Product ownership experience in B2B SaaS, vertical AI, platform or developer products, with experience coordinating across products and functions

 - The technical fluency to influence architecture, data flows, retrieval, tool calling, permissions and production failure modes

 - Hands-on AI evaluation experience, including datasets, rubrics, regression testing, human review and release thresholds

 - Experience driving a shared platform or standard across teams without direct authority

 - The ability to connect customer workflows, technical decisions and product priorities, with a focus on making teams faster and building products customers trust enough to use every day


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You have three or more years of experience as a backend, platform, data or distributed-systems engineer

 - You've recently worked hands-on with MCP, agent frameworks such as Mastra, or prototypes you built yourself

 - You have experience with permissions for sensitive data, including health records, PII, or with usage-based pricing

 - You have subject-matter expertise in American football, soccer, hockey or basketball


WHY THIS ROLE

The challenge is making AI work across six-plus sports, three regions and both central and embedded product experiences. Each product team builds its own AI tools, while a small platform team owns the shared contracts and evaluation system that make those tools work together. You'll combine platform leadership with hands-on building within individual products, helping teams put the platform into practice.

You'll think like an engineer and decide like a product leader, moving from a coach's Monday workflow to a tool schema to a roadmap decision. The shared athlete identity and permission systems are being built now, so some ideas will need to wait. A wrong answer about an athlete's health has real consequences. This role calls for judgment about what to build, what to defer and when an experience is ready for customers to trust.



This role is not eligible for sponsorship at this time.



Please submit your application through this posting only. We're unable to review applications or resumes sent via email, LinkedIn, or other channels.



To all recruitment agencies: Teamworks does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Teamworks employees or any other organization location. Teamworks is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.



ABOUT TEAMWORKS

We're the Operating System for Sports™, powering 7,000+ organizations worldwide, from collegiate programs to every major pro league. Founded in 2006, we've evolved from a messaging tool for college football into the leading sports tech platform, with 600+ global teammates building the future of sports tech. Our solutions span Personnel, Coaching, Performance, Operations, and Intelligence - helping teams recruit smarter, train better, stay compliant, and win.

Teamworks is an equal opportunity employer - if you live our core values every day and are honest, hardworking, humble, committed, innovative, and an all-around exceptional person, you'll thrive at Teamworks. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and take affirmative action to not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics.  This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, promotion, termination, compensation, benefits, and training. Teamworks is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email talent@teamworks.com.

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.



We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.



Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Founding Product Manager to help shape the future of Infisical’s platform. jobs.title: Sr. Account Manager - Renewals/Expansion
jobs.description:
WHY NOW

2026 has been a breakout year for Doppler. We’ve helped over 78,000 startups and enterprises manage their secrets at scale, and landed our first million-dollar customer. We've shipped some of our most exciting features yet, expanded our customer base, and sharpened our focus like never before. With a strong foundation in community, we're scaling and monetizing with ambitious goals across product, growth, sales, and hiring. 



The rise of AI tooling has fundamentally expanded who and what has access to your secrets. The stakes have never been higher, and getting it wrong has real consequences. Doppler is the solution to fix this. Simple to adopt, easy to scale, and built for developers, by developers. The momentum is real, and we’re just getting started. 



About Doppler

Doppler's mission is to make it easy and secure for software developers of every experience level and teams of any size to manage their app configuration and secrets. But hasn't this been done?



Developers tend to be either struggling with the manual management of .env files https://www.doppler.com/blog/the-triumph-and-tragedy-of-env-files, or wrestling with an overly complex secrets manager https://www.doppler.com/blog/doppler-vs-hashicorp-vault that's not built for software development.



Our team is entrepreneurial, with a bias for action. We never back down from a spirited debate and believe we are all responsible for exploring the hard questions. We value self-awareness and meaningful impact. We are open to unconventional approaches and have learned not to judge a book by its cover. Your time is your most valuable resource, so you set your hours. We use Slack to communicate and default to zero meetings.  




WHO WE ARE

Doppler is a developer-first secrets management platform that enables engineers and security teams to securely store their secrets across any cloud infrastructure or deployment environment at scale.






THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Sr. Account Manager to own renewals and expansion across our existing managed sales customers. This is a sales role. You’ll retain and grow the accounts we’ve already won through multi-threaded selling, executive relationships, and a long-term plan for each customer. You’ll work alongside our new-business AEs, who land the accounts, and our Customer Success Manager, who handles the day-to-day relationship and adoption. Your job is the commercial side: the renewal, the expansion, and the number.

You’ll wear a few hats. You’ll work inside Doppler to improve our product and process, and outside with customers to understand what’s getting in their way and show them clearly what Doppler is worth to them. Along the way, you’ll help write the playbook for the people who join the team after you.

Most of your time will be spent talking to engineers, DevOps leads, platform teams, and the engineering leaders above them. Understanding what they do and why it matters is how you earn their trust and move deals forward.

If you like a fast-moving startup, enjoy selling, and want a role where your work has an outsized effect, this is it.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Managed sales at Doppler is a small department that runs with process discipline. MEDDPICC is formally trained and used in deal reviews, CRM hygiene is expected, and performance is tracked closely. The team is small enough that everyone’s contribution is visible and matters. We work with low ego and are always improving how we sell and how we partner with customers.

What you’ll do:

 - Own the number. You’re responsible for renewal and expansion revenue across your portfolio of existing customers, with quarterly and annual targets you’ll hit and beat. Most of the expansion will come from expanding across teams or subsidiaries and moving customers onto multi-year platform agreements.

 - Build the plan for every account. Develop multi-year account plans that map who has influence, find the white space, and quantify expansion potential across business units, geographies, and product areas. Then run those plans.

 - Make renewals predictable. Reinforce value, outcomes, and ROI well before contract milestones so renewals land on time. Watch account health and usage data to spot churn or contraction risk early, and own the fix, pulling in Customer Success, Support, and Product and escalating when you need to.

 - Build real relationships at the top. Become a trusted advisor to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Heads of DevOps, and the like across your accounts, including across business units. Stay close through onsite and virtual check-ins, QBRs, and executive business reviews.

 - Back up the account internally. Coordinate cross-functionally within Doppler so each customer gets a continuous, high-touch, multi-year growth strategy. Partner with Engineering on technical conversations and with Product and Marketing on go-to-market work and customer feedback.

 - Run a clean process. Apply MEDDPICC across your pipeline; it’s used in deal reviews and built into Salesforce. Keep Salesforce accurate, with clear next steps and honest forecasting, so leadership can see the pipeline and make decisions from real data. Use AI and sales tools to get smarter about accounts and faster at the work.

What you’ll bring to the table:

 - 3+ years in account management or software sales at a B2B software company, ideally carrying a renewal or expansion quota, with a track record of meeting or beating targets.

 - You’ve sold to technical buyers before. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you can sell to one, and you know your way around developer tools, DevOps, infrastructure, or security products.

 - Strong discovery skills. You ask questions that find real pain instead of running through a checklist, and you understand an engineering environment before you position a solution.

 - You’re good at the long game: mapping stakeholders, managing relationships, communicating at the executive level, and growing an account over a multi-year cycle.

 - You can give us an example of a customer who was hesitant about a product and how you turned that into a win.

 - Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and the discipline to apply it consistently.

 - Attention to detail. You track account health, renewal timelines, and follow-ups carefully, and you have a reliable system for staying organized while juggling a lot at once.

 - Ownership. You take responsibility for the full cycle, find blockers before they find you, and push deals forward without being asked.

 - Comfortable in a mid-market ACV motion where velocity and deal size both matter, and able to build expansion pipeline through outbound.

 - Comfortable with CRMs, email automation, and prospecting tools.

 - Willingness to travel for strategic customer visits.

 - Competitive, resilient, and positive when things don’t go your way. You bounce back from a lost deal and stay focused on the number.

 - Coachable, curious, and always looking to get a level better. Startup or high-growth experience helps.

Preferred experience:

 - Familiarity with tools like Apollo, Salesforce, Sales Navigator, or similar

 - Formal MEDDPICC training

 - Experience selling devtools, security, or cloud infrastructure

 - Experience working remotely

Salary: 

$140K–$175K OTE (60/40 split) 






BENEFITS 

 - Premium health insurance (medical, dental, vision)

 - Guilt-free Unlimited PTO - 3-week minimum strongly encouraged!

 - Upward Mobility

 - Learning and Development Stipend

 - Wealth Advisor

 - 401k

 - Pregnancy & Family Leave

 - Fertility & Adoption Benefits

 - Equal Compensation (regardless of gender or race)

For a full list of our benefits check our Perks Notion Page https://dopplerteam.notion.site/Perks-15eb027f917d4b3bac69d0186115d7de.




CLOSING 

We've built a great product our customers love. Our churn is low, and active usage continues to rise. We just need to amplify our reach to educate the market that secrets management can be fast, secure, and affordable for teams and organizations of any size. And most importantly, we need to continue encouraging Developers to stop adhering to archaic insecure standards such as manually managing .env file formats.



Are you passionate about developer-focused products and ready to join an amazing team? Then we want to hear from you!



A final note - we highly encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't feel entirely qualified, or entirely sure. You never know!

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer, LV Devices
jobs.description:
About Harbinger

Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger’s best-in-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first-of-its-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation.

What You'll Do

You’ll own the engineering design of complex Low Voltage Subsystems and Components through their entire lifecycle (e.g. Body or Vehicle Control Modules, User Interface Systems, Power Distribution Systems, etc) Your main crossfunctional interfaces will be with Electrical and Software Engineering, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, and Program Management.

• Concept & Requirements: Utilize vehicle and system requirements to establish your subsystem architecture and component requirements. Define critical interfaces with mechanical, electrical and software systems. Perform proof of concept studies and create prototypes to validate initial assumptions.

• Sourcing & Supplier Selection: Evaluate available industry components and suppliers to determine the appropriate sourcing strategy. Co-develop Request for Quote (RFQ) packages and Statements of Work (SOW) with Supply Chain colleagues. Support supplier assessment and sign off on supplier selection.

• Design, Development, & Validation: Lead technical development of your component utilizing both in-house capabilities and supplier resources. Guide the supplier through technical roadblocks to ensure functional and timing requirements are met. Ensure design iterations are appropriately documented and communicated via 3D CAD, electrical specifications, etc. Ensure the component schedule is accurate, flag lead-time risk early and keep supplier deliveries on track for prototype and production builds. Co-develop the Design Validation Plan (DVP) with the supplier and review test results to ensure product quality.

• Production Launch: Collect and maintain all necessary documentation to release your components within the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system. Support Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) and Start of Production (SOP) activities for your component.

• Sustaining Engineering: Drive continuous improvement to cost, quality, and functionality of your components. Lead root cause activities for plant and field issues, and support supplier quality issues. Initiate and manage Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) as necessary.

What You'll Need (Qualifications)

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Experience: 4+ years of experience in product engineering, electrical or electromechanical design, system engineering, or technical program management, specifically focused on automotive electromechanical control systems or wire harnesses.

• Software Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of 3D CAD tools (e.g. CATIA, Solidworks, NX, or similar) and PLM/BOM management systems (e.g., Teamcenter, Enovia, or similar). Experience with ECAD systems like Capital Networks or Zuken is a plus.

• Supplier Management and Quality: Experience writing component specifications or RFQs, comparing supplier proposals on technical merit and cost, and assessing supplier engineering, manufacturing and quality capability. Working knowledge of APQP and PPAP, and reviewing supplier DFMEAs and PFMEAs. Familiarity with automotive qualification standards such as AEC-Q, USCAR-2, ISO 16750 or CISPR 25 is a plus.

• Technical Acumen: Solid understanding of low voltage electrical principles, automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Automotive Ethernet), and familiarity with major automotive connector families (TE, Aptiv, Molex, etc.). Additionally must have a solid understanding of mechanical packaging concepts, enclosure design and fastening strategies for electrical devices and wire harnesses, and automotive durability factors (e.g. vibration profiles, environmental factors, material properties, etc)

• Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage multiple complex supplier relationships simultaneously, with a track record of holding stakeholders accountable to deadlines.

• Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of bridging the gap between hardware, software, and non-technical teams.

Bonus Points If You Have:

• Prior experience working at an early-stage electric vehicle startup.

• Direct experience bringing a major ECU from prototype phase into high-volume production.

• Comprehensive Health, Dental & Vision (HDV) – 100% employee covered

• Early-stage Stock Options

• Robust Retirement Savings (401k, HSA, FSA)

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) & Parental Leave

• Annual Vacation Bonus

• Wellness & Fertility Benefits

• Cell Phone Stipend

• Complimentary Meals & Stocked Kitchens

jobs.title: Mission Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Mission Operations Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own all aspects of operating our satellites—covering mission planning, onboard and ground-based automation, fault protection, anomaly response, and long-term mission success. You will work closely with both internal engineering teams and external customers to adapt our productized approach to each mission’s needs, while helping shape our processes, products, and spacecraft designs. This role requires strong technical depth in spacecraft systems and mission operations, as well as the ability to lead critical responses under pressure.



Responsibilities:

 - Develop, validate, and execute mission plans and operations products for flight vehicles. 

 - Own the roadmap, processes, and operations products for one of Apex’s satellite bus lines.

 - Lead spacecraft commissioning during launch and early operations.

 - Operate and monitor satellites in real time, including anomaly detection, safing, and recovery.

jobs.description:

As Senior Manager, Torch Relay Communications,  you define and lead the communications strategy for the LA28 Torch Relay from concept through execution. You are the trusted advisor guiding how the relay engages government, civic, and media stakeholders at every stop, while staying aligned with the International Olympic and Paralympic Committees. Leading crisis communications and rapid response, you keep a highly visible national event on message, coordinating daily across a large, diverse ecosystem of partners as the route takes shape across the country.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

jobs.title: Fiber Optical Repair Technician
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY:

EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.

We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Role Overview:

The Fiber Optical Repair Technician is responsible for the repair, restoration, and maintenance of fiber optic infrastructure, including splicing, testing, and troubleshooting of both single-mode and ribbon fiber cables. This role ensures the rapid restoration of network services and supports ongoing operational excellence in high-availability environments.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional technical competency, situational awareness in live network environments, and the ability to lead or coordinate complex restoration efforts under pressure.

Key Responsibilities

Fiber Repair & Restoration

• Perform fault isolation and repairs on fiber optic cables and connectors, from initial fault detection through to full service restoration.

• Conduct both emergency restorations and planned maintenance activities with strict adherence to SLAs.

• Conduct single and ribbon fiber splicing within Meet-Me Vaults (MMVs), splice cases, and central Optical Distribution Frames (ODFs).

• Perform full cable preparation: jacket stripping, buffer tube access, fiber cleaning, cleaving, splicing, and protection.

• Use precision tools (fusion splicer, VFL, fiber identifiers) and ensure high-quality workmanship throughout.

• Adhere to live traffic handling procedures and ensure minimal service disruption during repairs.

Testing & Troubleshooting

• Operate advanced fiber testing instruments (OTDR, OLTS, power meters, microscopes, and inspection scopes).

• Conduct post-repair verification, including loss testing, reflectance analysis, and trace review.

• Accurately interpret OTDR traces and locate break points, microbands, or connector faults.

• Perform in-depth root cause analysis on recurring or systemic network issues.

• Implement corrective and preventive measures to improve reliability and reduce fault recurrence.

Documentation & Compliance

• Maintain accurate records of repair activities, test results, and maintenance logs.

• Comply with relevant industry standards (ITU-T, FOA, BICSI, TIA/EIA, NEC) and local safety regulations.

• Support audits and quality assurance processes as required.

Collaboration & Leadership

• Work closely with field operations, network engineers, and project managers to coordinate repair activities.

• Provide guidance, mentorship, and on-the-job training to junior team members.

• Participate in on-call rotations and respond to network outages within defined SLAs (e.g., 4-hour response for emergencies).

• Communicate clearly with internal teams and clients during critical incidents, providing real-time updates and restoration progress reports.

Continuous Improvement

• Stay current with the latest fiber optic technologies, repair techniques, and industry best practices.

• Participate in technical training, cross-functional workshops, and skill enhancement initiatives.

• Contribute to the refinement of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and restoration workflows.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Expertise

• 5+ years’ experience in fiber optic repair, splicing, testing, and restoration — including live-network work.

• Proficient in using advanced test and repair equipment: OTDR, OLTS, power meter, fusion splicer, fiber identifier, and inspection scopes.

• Strong ability to interpret OTDR traces, event tables, and loss readings for accurate fault localization.

• Deep knowledge of fiber types, connector standards (LC, SC, MPO, MTP), and splice protection methods.

• Experience with both single-mode (OS1/OS2) and multi-mode (OM3/OM4/OM5) fibers.

• Familiarity with high-count and ribbon fiber systems (864+, 1728+, etc.) and mass fusion techniques.

• Skilled at working in both OSP (outside plant) and ISP (inside plant) conditions.

Network & Infrastructure Understanding

• Awareness of data center physical infrastructure, structured cabling systems, and routing standards.

• Understanding of Layer 1 principles, optical signal flow, and basic network architecture for troubleshooting.

• Experience restoring and maintaining backbone, metro, or enterprise optical networks.

Diagnostic & Analytical Skills

• Ability to perform detailed fault isolation under time pressure.

• Experience conducting root cause analysis and contributing to failure analysis reports.

• Capable of identifying environmental and mechanical stress factors affecting fiber reliability.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

• Comprehensive understanding of laser safety, confined space procedures, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and PPE usage.

• Proven commitment to safety-first practices, maintaining a zero-incident mindset.

• Demonstrated attention to workmanship quality, cleanliness, and handling of fiber materials.

Soft Skills & Behavioral Attributes

• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills under pressure.

• Clear and professional communication skills for incident coordination and client interaction.

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to lead or integrate into multidisciplinary field teams.

• Strong organizational skills, capable of documenting all activities accurately and consistently.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Computer Vision (Perception)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sieve is a multi-modal lab curating the world's highest-quality training datasets, spanning video, audio, images, text, and 3D. We combine exabyte-scale data infrastructure and novel multimodal understanding techniques that push the frontier of foundation models. Video alone makes up 80% of internet traffic, and across modalities, data has become the enabling medium powering creativity, communication, gaming, AR/VR, and robotics. Sieve exists to solve the biggest bottleneck in the growth of these applications: high-quality training data.

We partner with top AI labs and did $XXM last quarter alone, as a team of ~30 people. We also raised our Series A from Tier 1 firms such as Matrix Partners, Swift Ventures, Y Combinator, and AI Grant.



WHY NOW

Sieve is one of the most capital-efficient teams in AI, with roughly 30 people serving the world's leading AI labs across every major data modality. You'll join early, own problems end-to-end, and watch your work ship directly into the models defining the frontier.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Physical AI runs on data that captures how the real world looks, moves, and fits together in 3D. As a perception-focused Machine Learning Engineer at Sieve, you'll build the systems that turn raw egocentric, robot, and sensor footage into the training data that robotics and world-model teams depend on.

You'll bring the computer vision instincts of someone who has shipped perception for robots, devices, or autonomous vehicles, and apply them to datasets at a scale few teams ever touch. One week you might recover camera pose and scene geometry across thousands of hours of first-person video. The next, you might build a hand and object tracking pipeline, or design a benchmark that tells a lab whether their data actually improves manipulation policies.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build perception pipelines for depth, pose, tracking, segmentation, and 3D reconstruction over large video and multi-sensor datasets

 - Apply SLAM, visual odometry, and structure-from-motion to recover camera trajectories and scene geometry at scale

 - Fine-tune vision and vision-language models for embodied tasks like hand-object interaction, activity understanding, and scene understanding

 - Develop automated QA and filtering systems that catch calibration errors, sync drift, motion blur, and other data defects before they reach customers

 - Create benchmarks and evaluation frameworks that measure how much a dataset improves downstream robotics and world-model performance

 - Work directly with frontier labs and robotics teams to turn vague data requirements into production pipelines

 - Ship fast, measure results, and iterate based on how the data performs in the real world



REQUIREMENTS

 - 3+ years building production perception or computer vision systems for robotics, AR/VR devices, autonomous vehicles, or similar

 - Hands-on experience with SLAM, visual-inertial odometry, multi-view geometry, or 3D reconstruction

 - Strong Python skills and fluency with PyTorch; C++ is a plus

 - Comfortable with multi-sensor data such as camera intrinsics and extrinsics, IMU, depth, and time synchronization

 - Experience training, fine-tuning, or deploying modern deep learning models for vision

 - Sharp intuition for evaluation, edge cases, and what makes data actually useful for training

 - Comfortable owning a problem from the customer conversation to a deployed pipeline

 - Excited about Physical AI and the data that will power it

 - In person at our SF HQ



BONUS

 - Experience with neural scene representations such as NeRFs or Gaussian splatting

 - Background working with egocentric or teleoperation data

 - Publications or open-source work in perception, 3D vision, or robotics


All roles at Sieve require you to be onsite in San Francisco 5 days per week.
