jobs.title: Enterprise Architect, Financial Services - Toronto, Canada
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Toronto, Canada

About the Role

Canada's financial institutions are modernizing their customer applications, internal platforms, and security, while meeting strict regulatory, resilience, and audit expectations. Digital-native players are moving just as fast on AI-powered experiences, agentic commerce, and real-time payments. Both build much of their software in-house, and AI coding assistants and agents are accelerating how fast they build and ship.

Cloudflare is looking for an Enterprise Architect (Financial Services), to help them make that shift. You'll lead with AI and modern application architecture, open new conversations with developers, platform-engineering, and AI leaders, and turn them into new business. You'll work alongside the Account Executives and Customer Engineers who own each account.

What You'll Do

• Expand our footprint: Grow Cloudflare into new business units and engineering teams across our financial-services customers, leading with AI and modern application architecture, in partnership with the account team.

• Shape the long-term agenda: Advise C-suite, application, and platform leaders on their multi-year technology agendas. Run executive and architecture workshops that produce roadmaps, reference architectures, and business cases co-developed with their teams, positioning Cloudflare as a foundational platform, not a point solution.

• Lead on AI: Advise on how institutions build, secure, and govern AI applications, agents, and features, and how AI is changing developer productivity.

• Modernize applications and platforms: Help teams re-architect customer applications and internal developer platforms, from migration strategy to getting developers to adopt the new platform at scale.

• Design in security: Help architect applications, APIs, and AI workloads that are secure by design and meet financial-services risk and resilience expectations.

• Build to prove it: Create prototypes, demos, and reusable assets that show what's possible on Cloudflare, and share them so the whole team can use them.

• Be a voice in the industry: Represent Cloudflare at industry events, executive roundtables, and sector forums, publish architectural guidance on key transformation themes, and bring what you learn back to Product and Engineering.

What You'll Bring

• Experience: 10+ years in customer-facing technical roles, such as solutions architect, enterprise architect, field CTO, or technical consultant, working with large, complex organizations.

• Boardroom to whiteboard: Credible in a boardroom conversation about digital strategy, and able to go deep on architecture with engineering teams. You've led executive workshops or technology strategy sessions.

• A builder at heart: You've built and shipped an application, whether web, serverless, or AI-powered, professionally or on your own time.

• Software development and modern architecture: Deep understanding of microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, CI/CD, serverless, and edge compute.

• AI applications and agents: Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG, MCP, AI gateways, and AI security.

• Additional depth in at least two of the following, including one in security:

• Application and API security: WAF, bot management, DDoS, API protection

• Zero Trust and SASE: identity-based access, secure access to AI tools, data loss prevention

• Network services: network-level DDoS protection, connectivity, telco integration

• Application performance: caching, latency, scaling at the edge

• Data protection and sovereignty: data residency, encryption and key management, post-quantum readiness

Preferred Experience

• Financial services: Experience with banks, insurers, wealth managers, payments, or capital markets, and familiarity with Canadian regulatory expectations such as OSFI B-10, B-13, E-21, and E-23.

• Developer platforms at scale: Experience selling or rolling out developer tools, internal developer platforms, or AI coding assistants in large engineering organizations.

• Cloud platforms: Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

• Agentic commerce: Familiarity with agentic payments and protocols such as UCP, AP2, and x402.

• Thought leadership: Talks, blog posts, open-source contributions, or published architectural guidance.

• Cloudflare Experience: You've built something on Cloudflare Workers.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12 months, working in collaboration with the account team:

• You've become a trusted advisor to senior technical and business leaders in your assigned strategic accounts, and opened conversations with new developer, platform-engineering, and AI teams.

• You've designed and led 2–3 executive vision-setting or architecture workshops that resulted in documented multi-year roadmaps with Cloudflare as a core platform.

• You've helped land AI and developer-platform wins.

• You've built and shared at least one reusable asset, such as a prototype, demo, or reference architecture, that the team uses on its own.

• You've represented Cloudflare externally, at an industry event or through published guidance.

Travel

This role will require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and other in-person team meetings, within the assigned territory. For this reason, candidates must have reliable personal or local public transportation to complete all required travel. Required travel is reimbursable in accordance with the Company's Travel & Expense Policy, as it may be amended from time to time.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. jobs.title: Oracle Principal Pre-Sales & Delivery Architect
jobs.description:
Oracle Principal Pre-Sales & Delivery Architect

Center of Excellence | Working alongside Tessera AI Agents

 

Location: US-based.

 

Remote: Yes, within the US, with travel to customer and partner sites as needed.

 

Experience: 15+ years

 

Employment type: Full-time, permanent.

 

Positions: 1

 

Reports to: VP, Center of Excellence

 

Start date: Immediate.

 

Engagement model: Multi-engagement pre-sales and delivery architect role. Approximately 70% engagement work across several concurrent customer engagements, 30% pre-sales, go-to-market and product input. Works US business hours alongside customers, distributed delivery teams and go-to-market teams.

About Tessera Labs

Tessera is an AI-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI-native platform.

 

For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for Oracle and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI-powered, multi-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Oracle Principal Pre-Sales & Delivery Architect to hold the solution direction across several customer engagements at the same time, from the first customer conversation through delivery. This is not a project role, and it is not a consulting role: we are a software AI platform company.

 

Two outcomes define the job. The first is that the customer sees value, stated in their terms, agreed in writing, and tracked. The second is that the customer's own teams and users adopt the Tessera platform as their normal way of working, rather than working around it. The second is what makes the first durable, and it is the measure you will be held to.

 

The role also sits partly ahead of delivery in pre-sales. You will join early customer and partner conversations together with the Tessera client partner, because an architect who only sees signed work designs for the problem we solved last year. What you learn there is expected to change how you run the engagements you already hold, and what we ask Product to build next.

 

Oracle is one of the fastest-growing parts of our engagement portfolio, and deep Oracle judgment, particularly in Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, is what the role needs on day one. It is not where they stop. Our platform spans ERP, CRM, HCM and SCM, and integrations of orbital systems with Oracle and your design view is expected to widen with it.

This role owns the proposal definition, solution build and solution delivery with AI across several Oracle engagements/ accounts — how it is shaped in the sales cycle, how it is designed, and how it lands.

Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Direction Across Engagements (35%)

 - Own the functional and architectural direction on several concurrent engagements, including the trade-offs between what the customer asked for and what will actually create value.

 - Orchestrate the engagement team across functional, technical, data and other AI enabled workstreams — you are the person who holds the whole picture when nobody else does.

 - Translate customer business outcomes into a solution shape the Tessera AI platform can deliver — and say clearly, early, when it cannot. Provide feedback to the Tessera product platform team for new R&D initiatives.

 - Agree what "better" means with each customer before execution starts: measurable, written, and owned by a named person on their side.

 - Hold the line between business intent and technical design, working directly with Forward Deployed Engineers, Tessera AI agents and customer architects.

 - Act as the counterpart our Technical Program Managers come to first, and get a straight answer from.

2. Pre-Sales, Go-to-Market and Product Input (30%)

 - Lead the solution definition and approach in early customer and partner conversations. Shape opportunities before they are scoped — approach, effort and risk — and tell our go-to-market teams what is real and what is not.

 - Own the Oracle solution story in proposals and statements of work, alongside the sales team/client partner and the Forward Deployed Engineers who run platform demonstrations.

 - Bring the forward view back into live engagements and adjust how we run them.

 - Close the loop with Product: turn field findings into Tessera platform product input, so one fix and new features & functions serves many customers instead of one.

 - Contribute your Oracle domain know-how back into the Tessera platform, so the agents get better at this work with every engagement.

3. Customer Platform Adoption (25%)

 - Own customer platform adoption as a deliverable, not a hope. Make Tessera capabilities the default path for the customer's teams and retire the workarounds.

 - Define what adoption means on each engagement, measure it, and report it alongside delivery status.

 - Find where adoption stalls — process, skills, trust, or product gap — and fix the cause rather than the symptom.

 - Build the customer-side advocates who carry the platform after we step back.

4. Engagement Shaping and Workforce Rationalization (10%)

 - Decide what an engagement team actually needs: which skills, in what order, for how long.

 - Staff on evidence. Large teams are often assembled so that everything is covered by someone, which is expensive and rarely the fastest path.

 - Make the case, with data, when an engagement is carrying more people than the work requires — and when it is carrying too few.

 - Feed that view into Center of Excellence capacity planning, so our people are placed where they create the most value.

Required Qualifications

 - Demonstrated ownership of solutioning through leading roles during Oracle enterprise software and services engagement sales cycles — scope, approach, effort and risk, not product demonstrations — with a record of what you shaped converting and then delivering.

 - Proven ability to orchestrate delivery teams across functional, technical and data workstreams, on several engagements at the same time, without losing control of any of them.

 - Senior client-facing presence: able to hold a room of customer architects, business owners and finance stakeholders, and to say no to a customer in a way that keeps the relationship.

 - A record of driving adoption, not just go-live: evidence that the customer's teams kept using what you delivered.

 - 15+ years in enterprise transformation with an Oracle foundation (Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications and E-Business Suite or JD Edwards), spanning several process areas such as Financials and Supply Chain (SCM) rather than depth in only one — for example Oracle Fusion Financials (General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Cash Management), Procurement, Order Management, Inventory Management, Manufacturing and Project Portfolio Management (PPM). Enough judgment to design across finance, supply chain and order management, and to know when to bring in a specialist. Experience in several end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations across new implementation, E-Business Suite or JD Edwards migration and phased coexistence approaches, and very familiar with the key challenges and major activities for each transition path.

 - Solid technical architecture knowledge: integration patterns, data architecture, and how an Oracle Cloud landscape actually fits together, including Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Visual Builder and PaaS extensions, data conversion into Fusion Cloud (FBDI, HDL) and integration with non-Oracle systems. Have a good understanding of the Oracle AI roadmap for Fusion Cloud Applications, including embedded AI agents. You can hold your own in a room full of engineers.

 - The confidence to tell a program it is over-staffed, and the evidence to back it.

 - Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months.

 - Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences.

 - Demonstrated experience leading distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline.

 - Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Who This Role Is Not For

If your experience is deep configuration inside one or two process areas, this is not the role — we hire specialists for that work and you would be underused here. If your pre-sales experience is running the demo rather than owning the solution, the same applies. And if you prefer one engagement at a time with a clear scope agreed by someone else, you will find this uncomfortable. We are asking for a senior Oracle architect who is at ease holding several unfinished things at once in various stages of the sales cycle and delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience across more than one Oracle enterprise suite — ERP, CRM, HCM or SCM. Oracle is the entry point, not the whole picture.

 - Experience across more than one path to Oracle Fusion Cloud (from E-Business Suite, JD Edwards, or non-Oracle ERPs such as SAP).

 - Exposure to adjacent Oracle Fusion Cloud pillars such as Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), HCM and Fusion Data Intelligence / Analytics.

 - Prior experience partnering with AI, automation or RPA tooling inside an enterprise delivery context.

 - Experience working within the Oracle partner and co-sell ecosystem, including Oracle PartnerNetwork (OPN).

 - Oracle Unified Method (OUM) or equivalent implementation methodology experience across multiple full-lifecycle Oracle Fusion Cloud programs.

 - Oracle Cloud certifications, for example Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials, Procurement or SCM Implementation Professional.

 - Spanish, Portuguese or German is a plus but not a must-have.

First-Year Measures of Success

 - Month 3: Fluent in the Tessera platform. Holding at least two engagements. Trusted by the Technical Program Management and sales client partners on those accounts.

 - Month 6: Value targets agreed and tracked on every engagement you hold. Adoption measured and improving. A steady flow of field input reaching Tessera product platform R&D. Owning the solution on at least two new Oracle opportunities.

 - Month 12: Tessera AI Platform client user adoption on your accounts is the norm rather than the exception. Your engagement teams are sized on evidence. Your read of where customers are heading has changed at least one thing in how we deliver or what we build.

jobs.title: Travel Fiber Optic Splicing QA/QC Lead
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY:

EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.

We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

As a Fiber Optic Quality Assurance Specialist, you will ensure the quality, accuracy, and compliance of all fiber optic splicing, testing, and installation activities across the organization’s projects and maintenance operations. This role is critical to maintaining operational excellence, client satisfaction, and network reliability through rigorous auditing, testing verification, and continuous improvement. You will ensure all fiber infrastructure work meets industry standards, project specifications, and company benchmarks, supporting a culture of precision, accountability, and technical development.

This role requires 90% travel. Must be located near a major airport.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Quality Auditing & Inspection

• Conduct regular and ad-hoc quality audits of fiber optic splicing work (fusion and mechanical) to ensure adherence to design specifications, workmanship standards, and safety requirements.

• Inspect and evaluate the entire splicing process — including fiber preparation, stripping, cleaving, cleaning, termination, and enclosure assembly.

• Review splice trays, closures, and patch panels for correct fiber routing, bend radius, labeling, and protection.

• Audit mass fusion (ribbon) splicing and high-count cable work for consistency and alignment with accepted practices.

• Verify and interpret OTDR, OLTS, and power meter test results to confirm optical link performance.

• Conduct onsite inspections (scheduled and random) across data centers, OSP/ISP sites, and field projects to assess workmanship, compliance, and safety.

• Flag non-conformances, deviations, or workmanship deficiencies and provide detailed corrective action recommendations.

Documentation & Reporting

• Maintain comprehensive QA/QC records for all splicing audits, including site checklists, test result verifications, and photographic evidence.

• Produce structured audit reports, highlighting key findings, trends, and compliance status.

• Review and approve final as-built documentation, ensuring test results, splice maps, and labeling align with project deliverables.

• Monitor and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) related to splicing quality, turnaround, and defect rates.

• Provide feedback and insights to project managers, quality leads, and engineering teams to drive ongoing performance improvement.

Process Improvement & Compliance

• Identify recurring quality issues, workmanship variances, or systemic weaknesses and recommend corrective actions.

• Contribute to the development and revision of splicing standards, installation procedures, and QA/QC manuals.

• Support the creation and enforcement of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for splicing, testing, and documentation.

• Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to ensure design intent and field execution are fully aligned.

• Ensure full compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) regulations and company policies, promoting a culture of safe, high-quality work.

• Participate in pre- and post-project quality reviews, offering recommendations for continuous improvement.

Technical Support & Training

• Provide technical mentorship and guidance to splicing and testing teams on QA/QC best practices.

• Support onboarding and certification programs for new splicers, testers, and technicians.

• Conduct refresher sessions and toolbox talks on quality, documentation accuracy, and testing standards.

• Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) sessions for major network faults, contributing to lessons learned and preventive measures.

• Offer expert technical input during vendor qualification or contractor performance assessments.

ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:

Technical Proficiency

• Minimum 5+ years’ hands-on experience in fiber optic splicing, testing, and field quality assurance.

• Strong understanding of fusion and mechanical splicing methods, single-mode and multi-mode fiber characteristics, and high-count/ribbon fiber systems.

• Proficiency in using and interpreting data from OTDR, OLTS, power meters, visual inspection scopes, and fiber identifiers.

• Skilled at analyzing OTDR traces (including event tables, loss readings, and reflectance levels) to verify fiber link integrity and identify anomalies.

• Familiarity with connector types (LC, SC, MPO, MTP) and fiber protection systems (heat-shrink, mechanical sleeves, splice trays).

Quality & Compliance Expertise

• In-depth understanding of industry standards and frameworks: ITU-T G.652/G.657, FOA, BICSI, TIA/EIA, NEC, and relevant client-specific standards.

• Proven experience developing or enforcing QA/QC checklists, acceptance criteria, and audit methodologies.

• Experience in reviewing and validating as-built documentation, test certificates, and optical budgets.

• Demonstrated ability to perform objective quality evaluations and provide evidence-based recommendations.

• Understanding of ISO 9001 quality management systems or similar frameworks is advantageous.

Analytical & Reporting Skills

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex technical data, detect patterns, and identify root causes.

• Proficiency in generating clear, data-driven audit and performance reports.

• Accuracy and consistency in documenting findings and presenting actionable insights.

• Ability to translate technical quality findings into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

Soft Skills & Professional Attributes

• Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to precision in every aspect of quality assessment.

• Effective communication and collaboration with cross-functional teams — field technicians, engineers, and project managers.

• Confidence to challenge non-compliance diplomatically, maintaining professionalism and fostering improvement.

• Strong organizational skills for managing multiple audits and reporting cycles concurrently.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently across multiple sites.

Technical Tools & Systems

• Experience with digital QA/QC reporting platforms, fiber management databases, and document control systems.

• Competent with Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and data visualization/reporting tools.

• Familiarity with GIS, AutoCAD, or network mapping software is an advantage.

DESIRABLE CRITERIA:

• FOA CFOT, CFOS/T, BICSI Technician, or equivalent certification.

• OEM manufacturer training (e.g., Corning, AFL, Sumitomo).

• Experience auditing splicing or testing work within data centers, metro networks, or hyperscale infrastructure environments.

• Previous experience in a QA/QC, inspection, or auditing role within fiber, telecoms, or utilities sectors.

• Background in project coordination or technical supervision.

EOS BENEFITS:

At EOS IT Solutions, we are committed to supporting the well-being and success of our team. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

• Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance starting the 1st of the month after your start date.

• Travel pay: Compensation provided for any work-related travel outside of your assigned local area, in accordance with EOS travel policy

• Occasional overtime and bonus opportunities for hourly workers

• 10 Days of Paid Time Off (PTO) annually

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 6 Sick Days (available after 90 days of employment)

• 401(k) Retirement Plan with a $2,500 company match (available after 90 days of employment)

The EOS pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, market data, or other laws.

EOS is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at EOS regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status or other non-merit factor.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Plain is redefining customer support and customer success for the next generation of B2B companies. We’re building the fastest, most powerful platform to help companies move beyond reactive support and build meaningful customer relationships.

Some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies - like Cursor, Vercel, and Granola - trust Plain to unify all customer interactions, enable faster team collaboration, and supercharge their workflows with AI.

We have offices in SF and London. This role is hybrid with 3 days a week in our SF office. Because we work closely with our teammates in Europe, we start early, but you’ll find quiet afternoons for heads-down work.




WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

Our most strategic customers do not arrive through self-serve. They arrive with an existing support setup, a lot of context to migrate, and workflows that do not exist in Plain yet. Getting them live is genuine engineering work, and today that work lands on the core engineering team. It gets done, and it gets done well, but it moves the roadmap around more than we want it to.

That is the gap this role closes. You own that work end to end, which means customers get an engineer whose entire job is their problem, and the core team gets a clearer run at the product. The other half of the job is deciding which of that work should stop being bespoke and become product, so the same thing never gets built twice.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work directly with customers to diagnose the problem, scope the fix, and ship it end to end.

 - Own the system design for customer deployments, trading off correctness, scale, and speed as the situation demands.

 - Explain the plan and the tradeoffs to whoever is in the room, engineer or not.

 - Work with Sales, CX, Product, and core Engineering to get what you learn into the roadmap.

 - Help define how the Forward Deployed function runs as it grows.
   
   


THIS IS A GREAT FIT IF YOU…

 - Have built and shipped full-stack products end to end. You are at home in modern frontend (React and TypeScript) and you write backend that holds up in production.

 - Prototype quickly and learn from real usage. You would rather put something in front of a customer and change it than get the design right on paper first.

 - Communicate exceptionally well. You can run a customer call, turn a vague ask into concrete scope, and write it up so nobody has to ask what was agreed.

 - Have strong product sense. You can separate what a customer asked for from what they actually need, you know which one-off work should turn into product and which should stay one-off, and you have the taste to decide whether it is worth building at all.

 - Own the outcome without much scaffolding. This is an IC role in an early-stage, ambiguous environment, and you do not wait for clean requirements before unblocking someone.

 - Stay calm when things get tense. Delays, bugs, and de-scoping conversations come with the job, and you can say yes to the reasonable asks while pushing back on the rest.



OUR TECH STACK

We choose tools that empower both humans and AI:

 - Frontend: React and TypeScript

 - Backend: TypeScript and GraphQL

 - Cloud: AWS, Cloudflare, and multiple LLM providers

 - Tooling: GitHub Actions, Datadog, Terraform, and more

The stack keeps evolving with whatever works best.




THIS WON'T BE THE RIGHT ROLE IF YOU…

 - Want a heads-down role with no customer contact.

 - Have little patience for customer messiness.

 - Over-engineer, and chase perfection at the cost of speed.

 - Struggle to say no, or take every request at face value.

 - Only thrive with detailed specs and stable requirements.

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told in a way that feels grounded and human. • A field based scientific expert that strategically supports the research and business objectives of a designated therapeutic area across the product life cycle for a specific geography/territory
• The primary communicator of AbbVie science within a specific geography with healthcare professionals.
• Develops and maintains professional relationships with internal and external customers to provide comprehensive medical and scientific support to AbbVie initiatives in ovarian and gyn-oncology solid tumor areas.
• Viewed as a peer scientific expert in a designated therapeutic area/product.

Combined with strong strategic vision, market therapeutic area awareness, as well as clinical expertise, the MSL/Senior MSL serve as a conduit of information, education, and research activities for physicians and ancillary healthcare professionals regarding current and future therapies in development or commercialized by AbbVie.

The MSL/Senior MSL works closely with other AbbVie personnel to ensure information, education, and research needs of healthcare professionals are met and to ensure scientific and technical training needs of commercial organizations are identified and met.

Responsibilities:

• Identify, develop, and maintain professional relationships with thought leaders, academic centers, and researchers in assigned areas of therapeutic interest to ensure access to current medical and scientific information on the designated therapeutic/product area
• Present scientific information and education relative to disease state, therapeutic landscape, and AbbVie products across the product lifecycle to healthcare professionals including physicians, academic institutions, researchers, and other health care professionals.
• Support research initiatives as requested by AbbVie R&D, Clinical Operations, and Medical Affairs Departments and physician-initiated projects including, but not limited to, site evaluation and identification, recruitment, investigator meetings, external expert identification, and external collaboration management.
• Prepares marketplace in new therapeutic areas of interest, which includes creating awareness and relationships for AbbVie in the Medical community.
• Creates, maintains, and collaborates in relationships with internal cross-functional partnerships, Works with in-field commercial teams, as appropriate, to develop and execute Account plans designed to support and meet shared business objectives. Serves as a scientific resource to commercial partners, as appropriate, to support activities
• Serve as a medical/scientific resource to healthcare providers through answering unsolicited medical questions and addressing other clinically related medical information issues.
• Support and provide Conduct on-going training to medical affairs, field sales and other internal personnel as directed.
• Practices core capabilities in strategic segmentation, as well as optimal resource utilization.
• Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies and Procedure, including accurate and timely documentation as it relates to HCP (Healthcare Professionals) interactions. Responsible for maintaining annual expenses within assigned budget parameters.

• Advanced degree required (i.e., Pharm D, MD/DO, PhD, APP (i.e.: Physician Associate or Nurse Practitioner) in a relevant scientific discipline. Doctorate strongly preferred in a health science or clinical discipline.
• Senior MSL I: Minimum 2 years of relevant oncology experience; typically 3+ years of direct MSL experience
• MSL: Minimum of 0-2 years of relevant disease or therapeutic area experience
• Ability to reside in the assigned territory within 3 months of start date (relocation assistance is not provided)
• Must be willing to travel up to 75% of the time.
• Must be able to identify, analyze, and translate specific territory and corporate needs to support internal and external customers and achieve business and clinical objectives.
• Proficiency in Excel, Word, Power Point, and other software skills; Excellent written/verbal communication skills; ability to quickly adapt and learn new technology, including but not limited to artificial intelligence (AI).
• Strong interpersonal skills, presentation, and teaching skills; Ability to work independently and in a team structure; Ability to adjust effectively to work within new structures, processes, requirements, or cultures; Strong planning and organizational skills; team and leadership skills
• An essential requirement of the position is to meet health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to enter facilities and organizations in your assigned territory. These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, and proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases.
• Ability to learn and convey clinical and non-clinical technical information effectively
• Ability to engage the audience and help them understand and retain information

• Support leadership creation of PSP strategic & tactical planning by providing strategic lens

jobs.title: Senior SEM Specialist
jobs.description:
Where A-Players Thrive.

We’re an employee-owned, vertically-integrated builder of some of America’s most popular health & wellness brands. With over 1,000 team members across multiple companies, we create best-in-class products that help make the world healthier and happier. Our creative content educates the world on making smarter health choices, while the brands we own generate over $600 million of revenue annually. Learn more about our brands.

We’re Looking For A: Senior SEM Specialist

Location: Hybrid (Woodland Hills, CA)

What You’ll Be Doing: The mission for the Senior SEM Specialist role is to own and grow paid search and Google network performance for our direct response brands. You will lead brand search campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising and scale direct response acquisition across YouTube, Display, Demand Gen, and Performance Max. You will own the full campaign lifecycle, from setup and tracking to testing and optimization, using data and reliable measurement to drive profitable customer acquisition and revenue growth. This is your chance to be the go-to paid search expert for a fast-moving direct response business: someone who takes full ownership, spots opportunities before being asked, and proactively drives growth.

• Own end-to-end management of brand search campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising, from account structure and campaign setup through launch, bidding, and ongoing optimization.

• Protect and grow branded search by monitoring impression share, competitor and affiliate bidding, and brand query trends, and by managing negative keywords and search term mining.

• Plan, launch, and scale direct response YouTube campaigns focused on driving conversions at efficient CPA/ROAS.

• Manage and optimize campaigns across the full Google network, including Display, Video, Demand Gen, Performance Max, shopping.

• Own Google Merchant Center accounts and Shopping product feeds, keeping product data, pricing, and availability accurate and up to date; proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve feed errors, disapprovals, and account issues.

• Own conversion tracking and measurement: implement and QA pixel and Conversion API (CAPI)/server-side tracking, including Enhanced Conversions and offline conversion imports.

• Build and maintain tags, triggers, and variables in Google Tag Manager (GTM), and partner with development teams to troubleshoot tracking discrepancies.

• Establish and enforce UTM tracking standards and naming conventions to ensure clean, consistent attribution across platforms and analytics.

• Design and run structured split tests (ad copy, landing pages, bidding strategies, audiences, and creative) and turn results into scalable wins.

• Manage bidding strategies (tCPA, tROAS, Maximize Conversions), budgets, and pacing to hit efficiency and volume goals.

• Collaborate with CRO and landing page teams to improve post-click conversion rates.

• Analyze and report on key KPIs (CPA, ROAS, CVR, AOV, new customer volume) and deliver clear insights and recommendations to leadership.

• Proactively identify new growth opportunities, including new campaign types, keywords, audiences, and platform betas, and bring recommendations forward without waiting to be asked.

• Stay current on Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising platform changes, advertising policies, and industry best practices.

Qualifications (Note: We strongly encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick ALL of these boxes.):

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability for results.

• Proactive, self-starter mindset with a bias toward action and growth.

• Expert-level knowledge of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.

• Deep understanding of direct response marketing principles and performance KPIs.

• Technical proficiency with pixel and CAPI tracking, Google Tag Manager, and UTM tracking.

• Working knowledge of GA4 and multi-channel attribution.

• Strong mathematical and analytical skills; advanced Excel/Google Sheets.

• Test-and-learn mindset with a solid grasp of split-test design and statistical significance.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

• Bachelor’s Degree.

• 5+ years of hands-on paid search experience managing Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing) accounts.

• Proven experience running direct response YouTube campaigns.

• Hands-on experience across Display, Video, Demand Gen, and Performance Max.

• Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting pixel and CAPI tracking, GTM, and UTM tracking.

• Track record of owning campaigns from setup through optimization and scaling spend profitably.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field. (preferred)

• Experience in direct-to-consumer e-commerce, ideally health & wellness, beauty. (preferred)

• Experience managing high-spend, multi-brand accounts. (preferred)

• Familiarity with SQL or BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Looker Studio). (preferred)

• Working knowledge of Salesforce. (preferred)

• Google Ads certifications (Search, Video, Display) (preferred)

• Microsoft Advertising certification. (preferred)

Golden Perks & Benefits:

• Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage – We cover 100% of premiums for employee-only medical, dental, and vision plans.

• Bonus Opportunities – Earn more with both annual and monthly bonus programs tied to performance.

• Investing in Your Future – We match up to 3.5% of your 401(k) contributions and offer a company-sponsored Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), helping your retirement savings grow alongside the company. Learn more.

• Work-Life Balance – Start your first year accruing up to 15 days of vacation, plus 6 paid sick and mental health days.

• Well-Being Support – Take advantage of our Employee Assistance Program, company closure dates, free weekly yoga and meditation classes, and expanded mental health benefits—we take a holistic approach to your well-being.

• Career Growth – Grow with us through our mentorship program, continuous learning opportunities, and performance-based pay increases designed to help you advance.

• Make an Impact – Give back through our charity sponsorships. Together, we’ve donated over $9 million to communities worldwide.

• Additional Benefits - Cell/internet reimbursement, free employee products, annual events, and more!

To read more about our Perks & Benefits, click here.

The base salary range is $85,386.82-$99,284, plus annual & monthly KPI bonus potential.

jobs.title: Partner 16, Product Manager, Global Partnerships
jobs.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI, bio + healthcare, consumer, enterprise, fintech, frontier, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. We’ve invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.

The Role

a16z's Frontiers organization operates like an internal startup within the firm, building AI-native software that helps a16z discover, evaluate, and support the world's most ambitious founders. The Global Partnerships (GPX) team is dedicated to crafting an outstanding client experience for our trusted Limited Partners ("LPs"), and Frontiers is building the product foundation that makes that possible.

We're looking for a Product Manager to embed with GPX and own the product roadmap for the systems that power it, including LP reporting and communications, fundraising workflows, relationship and access management, and the data infrastructure that ties it all together. You'll work directly with GPX stakeholders and Frontiers engineering and design to turn LP needs into prioritized, shippable work. You'll be hands-on: scoping problems, shaping requirements, and shipping alongside engineers rather than handing off a spec and waiting.

This is a high-trust role. You'll work with sensitive LP data, partnering closely with GPX, Finance, Legal, and Frontiers leadership. You'll have real ownership from day one and a clear chance to shape how a best-in-class product function supports an investor relations team.

This role requires an in-office presence 2-3 days a week in our San Francisco, CA office.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

• Partner with GPX stakeholders to translate LP and firm needs into a clear, prioritized product roadmap

• Execute end to end on GPX products, from discovery and requirements through shipping and iteration alongside Frontiers engineers

• Improve the systems behind LP reporting, capital activity communications, and firm performance updates

• Shape workflows and tooling that support fundraising, LP relationship management, and access to firm content and events

• Handle sensitive LP and performance data with rigor and discretion, and bring a strong point of view on data governance

• Run user discovery and drive adoption within GPX, turning feedback into product decisions that hold up under scrutiny

• Represent GPX's needs in Frontiers's broader roadmap, and bring Frontiers's product practice to a relationship-driven, non-technical team

Minimum Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in product management or product engineering, ideally including AI-powered or data-intensive products

• Experience building internal tools or workflow software for a relationship-driven, non-technical stakeholder group

• Comfort working with sensitive or confidential data, with strong instincts for data governance and access control

• Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous workflows into clear requirements

• Track record of shipping product end to end in a fast-paced, resource-constrained environment

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust quickly across investing, GPX, and engineering

• Low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively with diverse teams

The anticipated salary range for this role is between $269,000 - $314,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope.

This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs, as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401(k) plan, vacation, and sick leave.

a16z culture

• We do only first class business and only in a first class way

• We take a long view of relationships, because we are in the relationship business

• We believe in the future and bet the firm that way

• We are all different, we recognize that, and we win

• We celebrate the good times

• We do it for the team

• We play to win

At a16z we are always looking to hire the absolute best talent and recognize that diversity in our experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. We hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. These differences are what enables us to work towards the future we envision for ourselves, our portfolio companies, and the World.

jobs.title: Senior Partner Account Manager, Southeast & MidAtlantic Region
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Open to any of the listed location(s):

• Florida: Miami (MIA), Tampa (TPA)

• Georgia: Atlanta (ATL)

• North Carolina: Charlotte (CLT), Raleigh (RDU)

• Tennessee: Nashville (BNA)

About the Department

Partner Account Managers, Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.

What you'll do

We are looking for a seasoned channel sales professional to help us build out the channel organization in the Southeast and MidAtlantic regions.

In this role, you’ll identify and operationalize varied types of partner organizations to help expand Cloudflare’s sales team reach within an assigned territory. You will build a regional partner business plan with quantified goals and milestones to achieve partner sourced revenue metrics to meet all quarterly sales requirements.

As a Partner Account Manager, you will work with a strategic group of partners in your territory and build a plan to drive alignment, enablement and pipeline generation efforts.   You will work with partner stakeholders to drive sales enablement and coordinate technical training of Cloudflare’s solutions, work with respective field teams on demand gen initiatives and campaigns, as well as working with direct sales on various Channel oriented opps.

Additional responsibilities will include:

• Lead business planning and execution with partners and internal sales teams (e.g., QBRs, health checks, annual planning).

• Conduct joint partner territory planning with aligned sales segments.

• Deliver internal partner training to direct sales teams to foster collaborative selling.

• Drive pipeline creation and revenue through creative joint GTM activity with our channel and direct sales teams.

• Build product and sales competency within core regional and national partners, influencing their GTM strategies to maximize partner-sourced pipeline.

• Leverage data analytics and AI tooling to optimize and scale partner growth.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• 5+ years in Software/SaaS/Security Sales & Channel management.

• 3+ years of proven success developing and scaling a partner ecosystem (VARs, SIs, MSPs/MSSPs) within a SaaS model.

• Understanding of cloud infrastructure ecosystem and cloud security is highly preferred.

• Direct experience in onboarding and enabling resellers/SI's.

• Experience working in a start-up environment.

• Ability to travel 30-50% of the time within the assigned territory.

• Technical competence strongly preferred.

Compensation

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

jobs.title: Campus Technology Assistant
jobs.description:
Training Tomorrow's Technicians to Become Skilled, Employable and Essential.

About Us  - Big Changes, Better Benefits - Join us today!

The Aviation Institute of Maintenance (AIM), established in 1969, is a premier institution dedicated to advancing the field of aviation maintenance through exceptional education and training. With 15 campuses nationwide, AIM is a cornerstone in the aviation industry, accounting for 20% of all students attending FAA-certified Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) schools across the country. Each year, AIM proudly contributes to the graduation of nearly one in four certified aircraft technicians in America.

At AIM, you'll become part of a dynamic team of educators and leaders, all united by a shared commitment to delivering top-notch training and ensuring student success. We are passionate about equipping the next generation of aircraft technicians with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in the aviation industry. If you are eager to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of aviation maintenance, AIM offers a rewarding environment where your contributions will truly matter.

Location: 7651 Airport Blvd, Houston, TX 77061
Schedule: Monday- Thursday: 9-6 or 10-7( Two evenings per week)   Friday: 8:00am - 5:00pm

Compensation: Up to $30/hr

Position Purpose:

The Campus Technology Assistant plays a key role in supporting the efficient operation of campus computing systems, telecommunication networks, and technology infrastructure. This position provides hands-on IT support, ensuring that company-issued devices, software, and hardware function properly. Additionally, the Technology Assistant supports end users with troubleshooting, maintenance, and technical assistance. As a Senior Technology Assistant, this role also includes serving as the primary test proctor, ensuring a secure and smooth testing environment for all users.

Key Duties

• Provide technical support for campus computing devices, including troubleshooting software, hardware, and connectivity issues.

• Assist faculty, staff, and students with the setup, maintenance, and operation of company-issued technology devices and equipment.

• Serve as the primary test proctor, ensuring all test materials are secure, administering tests in accordance with established protocols, and assisting test takers with any technology-related concerns.

Job Responsibilities

• Maintain campus digital infrastructure, including systems network, cloud/web-based systems, electronic data communication, and operational databases, per Corporate IT Policies and Procedures.

• Troubleshoot, repair, assemble, maintain, install, and perform testing activities on computer equipment, network systems, firewall, and data communication systems, using Technology Assistant proper standard interface protocols.

• Configure and set up servers to work with various programs.

• Ensure server backups and network user backups are performed regularly.

jobs.title: Principal Research Scientist
jobs.description:
About G2 - The Company


G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.



Now, we have joined forces with Capterra https://www.capterra.com/, SoftwareAdvice https://www.softwareadvice.com/, and GetApp https://www.getapp.com/ to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.



And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.



Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!



About G2 - Our People



At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our  PEAK values— (Performance + Entrepreneurship + Authenticity + Kindness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.



You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI https://company.g2.com/dei and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives https://company.g2.com/gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Buyers of business software increasingly need to know how well AI agents actually perform, not just what vendors claim. G2 is building independent, rigorous evaluations of AI agents on realistic business work, to help buyers choose with confidence and to set a trusted standard for the market.



This is the most senior applied research role on that work, and it is hands-on. You will own the research agenda for how agents get tested, make sure the results mean what we say they mean, and turn them into product features and insights G2 publishes. You will work side by side with engineers and product managers, and your work will go into what G2 ships today, not only into longer-term research.



You will also raise the bar around you. You will mentor engineers, data scientists and researchers working on evaluation, review their methodology, and make the standards you set repeatable by people who did not write them.



The field is unsettled. Methods from academia, frontier labs and industry are still being worked out. Part of the job is staying on top of that work and bringing the ideas that matter into the product. The approaches that last are the simple, general ones that still hold up as models change.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: 

 -  Own the evaluation methodology. Set the standard for how G2 evaluates AI agents, defend it to skeptical audiences inside and outside the company, and keep it current as models change.

 - Contribute to today's product. Work closely with engineers and product managers to build and improve the evaluations behind G2's current offerings. Help scope features, turn methods into production-ready components, and iterate on what customers and the business need.

 - Design realistic evaluations. Build environments and task sets that reflect the work businesses actually give AI agents, and that stay useful as models improve.

 - Develop sound measurement. Create scoring approaches, including automated checks, LLM-based judges and human review, that are accurate, reproducible and hard to game. Measure consistency and reliability, not just average performance.

 - Validate the evaluations themselves. Audit tasks and graders, quantify noise, and establish when differences between agents are real.

 - Represent the results. Present and defend evaluation findings to buyers, customers and partners, and to the research community. Be the credible voice behind the numbers when the audience has a stake in the outcome.

 - Mentor and multiply. Manage and guide researchers and engineers on evaluation design and measurement, review their work, and write the documentation and standards that let the team run evaluations without you in the room.

 - Set and pursue a research agenda. Choose which evaluation problems matter most and carry long-running projects through to something that works, favoring simple ideas that generalize over ones tuned to this year's models. Directions include simulated-user and environment-based evaluation in the tradition of benchmarks like τ-bench; realistic user and persona simulation; LLM-as-judge reliability; evaluation of voice and multimodal agents; assessing agents in open-ended, long-horizon workflows; and protecting test sets from contamination.

 - Stay current. Follow new benchmarks, papers and evaluation practices across the research community. Translate them into product and roadmap decisions, and communicate them clearly to the team.

 - Share and collaborate. Write methodology documentation and, where appropriate, papers and public posts. Partner with data and go-to-market teams on how results are presented and used.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

 - Experience working with evaluation design or dataset curation in multi-agentic systems

 -  5+ years building or evaluating ML systems, including hands-on work with LLMs or LLM-based agents.

 - 2+ years experience managing small to medium teams preferred.

 - A graduate degree (MS or PhD) in machine learning, NLP, computer science, statistics or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience.

 - A track record of original ideas in machine learning, or clear improvements on existing ones, shown through first-author publications or projects you led end-to-end.

 - The ability to own a research agenda: pick the problems worth solving, and carry long-running projects without being directed.

 - A track record of shipping ML work in a product setting, working closely with engineers and product managers.

 - Experience setting technical direction for others: mentoring researchers or engineers, reviewing methodology, and raising the quality of work you did not do yourself.

 - Familiarity with how AI systems are benchmarked, and a clear view of how benchmark scores can mislead.

 - Sound statistical judgment: experimental design, variance, significance and agreement between human and automated raters.

 - Good judgment about trade-offs, including when a practical solution now serves customers better than a more complete one later.

 - Clear writing, and the ability to explain methodology to non-specialists and to defend it to skeptical audiences.


WHAT CAN HELP YOUR APPLICATION STAND OUT:

 -  Research experience in agent evaluation, user simulation, or human and AI-based judging.

 - Experience with conversational, voice, retrieval-based or tool-using AI systems.

 - Contributions to open-source evaluation tools or public leaderboards.

 - Familiarity with business software workflows.

 - A considered view on the effects of AI technology on the people and markets it reaches.

 - Publications at ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, COLM or similar venues.



Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity



At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran, or physical or mental disability status. Learn more about our commitments here https://culture.g2.com/commitments.

How We Use AI Technology in Our Hiring Process

These tools may assist with initial application screening, skills assessment analysis, and identifying candidates whose qualifications align with specific role requirements. While AI technology supports our recruitment workflow, all final hiring decisions remain under human oversight and judgment.

Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

This is an On-site in Santa Clara, California or Remote (US role) role, reporting to the Sr. Manager, Applied AI Engineering in the IT/Data Strategy department. The Sr Staff Applied AI Engineer, GTM is a senior, hands-on AI builder embedded with our go-to-market organization who turns ambiguous, high-stakes ideas into secure, production-grade solutions that move revenue outcomes. Beyond engineering, you will act as a trusted transformation advisor to GTM leaders to run discovery, shape the GTM AI strategy and roadmap, and guide Build/Partner/Buy decisions where success is measured in business terms such as pipeline generated and seller productivity. In this role, you will also improve and expand the technical implementations, standards, and engineering playbooks the rest of the Applied AI team relies on, keeping our deliverables aligned with current best practices.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Set the standards that multiply the team, improving and expanding reusable building blocks like retrieval pipelines, reference architectures, GTM data connectors, and engineering playbooks while mentoring other engineers

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path as you walk it and seeing dynamic environments as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner, operating with high integrity and a strong bias for action while navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embracing ongoing candor, feedback, and mutual respect as the fastest ways to earn trust.

• You are driven by innovation, bringing a deep curiosity for solving complex technical challenges and a desire to build secure, scalable, and transformative systems.

• You are a pragmatic builder obsessed with creating, iterating, and shipping value to users quickly without sacrificing technical excellence.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

jobs.title: Patient Relations Liaison

Over the past 40 years, Chaparral Medical Group (CMG) has established itself as a leading primary and multi-specialty care provider for California’s Inland Empire. In 2022, CMG joined forces with Akido Labs, a tech-enabled healthcare company, to transform the healthcare experience from the ground up. This partnership joins CMG’s medical services with Akido’s innovative technology to relieve the frustrations felt by everyone involved in care delivery, from medical providers and their staff, to the patients and their families. Reporting to the Operations Manager of Patient Relations, you’ll be the face of the organization in the community, conducting patient outreach, building relationships with insurance brokers and community partners, and representing us at events and educational sessions. This role sits at the intersection of patient experience and organizational growth: your work directly drives membership growth and retention, improves access to care, and shapes how patients and the community see us. • Support patient communication campaigns, educational initiatives, and patient experience programs that strengthen patient relationships.

• Gather patient feedback and testimonials to identify opportunities for service enhancement and brand awareness.

• Monitor online patient feedback and reviews, supporting reputation management and escalating concerns as appropriate.

• Assist with regulatory audits and documentation reviews related to patient grievances and complaints.

• Participate in cross-functional projects focused on patient experience, growth strategies, and operational excellence while maintaining HIPAA and organizational privacy compliance.

jobs.title: Sr. Analytics Engineer/ Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Laurel is on a mission to return time. As the leading AI Time platform for professional services firms, we’re transforming how organizations capture, analyze, and optimize their most valuable resource: time. Our proprietary machine learning technology automates work time capture and connects time data to business outcomes, enabling firms to increase profitability, improve client delivery, and make data-driven strategic decisions. We serve many of the world's largest accounting and law firms, including EY, Aprio, Crowell & Moring, and Frost Brown Todd, and process over 1 billion work activities annually that have never been collected and aggregated before Laurel’s AI Time platform. 



Our team comprises top talent in AI, product development, and engineering—innovative, humble, and forward-thinking professionals committed to redefining productivity in the knowledge economy. We're building solutions that empower workers to deliver twice the value in half the time, giving people more time to be creative and impactful. If you're passionate about transforming how people work and building a lasting company that explores the essence of time itself, we'd love to meet you.



About the Role

As a Senior Analytics Engineer/Data Scientist at Laurel, you’ll turn product and business data into clear, trustworthy insights leaders can act on. You’ll own the analytics lifecycle—from ingestion and modeling to BI visualization and decision enablement. You’ll deliver self-serve insights using SQL/Python and embedded BI (e.g., ThoughtSpot). You will also help define the design patterns and data infrastructure to scale.

We’re especially interested in candidates who thrive in early-stage environments and pair analytical rigor with clear storytelling. You’ll partner closely with our CX team to quantify and communicate Laurel’s ROI, and you’ll join customer-facing presentations.     - Create scalable ETL pipelines to ingest, process, and organize data from diverse sources (PMS, Web Analytics, WebApp).
    
    - Deploy and maintain Business Intelligence tools to provide analytics and reporting capabilities.

You will be a great fit if you have

   - Proficiency in modern data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).
   
   - Familiarity with data modeling, warehousing principles, and BI tools (e.g., Thoughtspot, PowerBI, Tableau).

 - Experience With:
   
   - Cloud platform expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure).
   
   - Knowledge of dbt, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
   
   - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

 - Soft Skills:
   
   - Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
   
   - Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment and manage multiple priorities.

Nice to haves

 - Experience with knowledge worker productivity tools

 - Familiarity with modern data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js http://d3.js)

 - ML and AI: Prototype, build and test ML models to quickly validate hypotheses and generate insights that guide Laurel product features

Flexibility and Logistics

 - Location: This role will be hybrid based in our San Francisco office, 3 days per week. We will consider exceptionally qualified candidates based in other US-locations on a case by case basis.

 - Compensation: Competitive salary, generous equity, comprehensive medical/dental/vision coverage with covered  premiums, 401(k), additional benefits including wellness/commuter/FSA stipends. For candidates based in San Francisco the compensation range for this role is $205,000-$249,000 USD. Final compensation amounts will be determined based on several factors including candidate experience, qualifications and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed.

 - Visa Sponsorship: Unfortunately we are unable to provide Visa Sponsorship at this time.


WHY JOIN LAUREL:

 - To date, we've secured significant funding from renowned venture capitalists (Google Ventures, IVP, Anthos, Upfront Ventures), as well as notable individuals like Marc Benioff, Gokul Rajaram, Kevin Weil, and Alexis Ohanian

 - A smart, fun, collaborative, and inclusive team

 - Great employee benefits, including equity and 401K

 - Bi-annual, in-person company off-sites, in unique locations, to grow and share time with the team

We encourage diverse perspectives and rigorous thinkers who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo. Laurel is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are not able to support visa sponsorship or relocation assistance.
