Every day, we aim to build an environment that empowers us all to do the best work of our careers, and we can't wait to show you what we have to offer!

jobs.title: Robotics Intern, Trustworthy Learning under Uncertainty
jobs.description:
At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences.
This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role.
Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns!


The Team
Our Trustworthy Learning under Uncertainty (TLU) team in the Robotics division is looking for Research Interns for Summer 2027 in a variety of areas such as Policy Evaluation, Failure Detection and Mitigation, as well as (Inter)Active and Continual Learning in the context of World Foundation Models (WFM) for Robot Manipulation. Our topics of interest include but are not limited to: Multi-Modal Foundation Models, Generative Modeling, Imitation Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Planning & Control, Statistics, Uncertainty Estimation, Out-of-Distribution Detection, Safety-Aware & Robust ML, (Inter)Active Learning, and Online / Continual Learning. We are aiming to make progress on some of the hardest scientific challenges around the safe and effective usage and development of machine learning algorithms within Robotics. To this end, the research mission of the TLU team is to enable the robust and reliable deployment of embodied foundation models at scale in human environments, while allowing for efficient adaptation to novel settings.

The Internship
As a Research Intern, you will work with a multidisciplinary team proposing, conducting, and transferring pioneering research in Machine Learning for Robot Manipulation. You will use large amounts of sensory data and simulation to solve open problems, work towards publications at top academic venues,  and test your ideas in the real world, including on our robots, of course!

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
Infrastructure Engineer — Platform Team

Location: Washington, DC (hybrid; 3 days in office per week)

About Alphataraxia

Alphataraxia Management (ATX) is a fast-growing quantitative investment management group with offices in both Washington, DC and Culver City, Los Angeles, CA. We specialize in wholesale electricity markets, where extreme volatility is the norm and the marketplace is constantly evolving, presenting new opportunities for growth and insight. We are currently one of the top participants in the power markets and are looking for hard-working candidates with genuine enthusiasm for solving complex problems to join our collaborative and high-caliber team.

The role

Platform’s work focuses on three core responsibilities:

• Providing a scalable, reliable foundation for the firm’s most critical data and tools.

• Accelerating and scaling valuable prototypes into robust production solutions.

• Rapidly resolving technical barriers that slow teams down.

This role owns the Infrastructure area of responsibility within the Platform Team: AWS foundation and networking, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, the Dagster control plane, Snowflake infrastructure, security, identity and secrets, disaster recovery, cost and capacity planning, and remote access. You'll be the one person principally focused in this area, with the rest of Platform (four engineers focused mostly on the Data and Developer Platform) helping you ramp.

Reports to: Head of Platform

What you'll do

For the first several months, the Head of Platform will collaboratively set priorities with you while you learn the systems and the firm. After that, you own the roadmap for Infrastructure the way a product owner would — you bring them problems and a prioritized plan before starting execution. There's already a backlog of possible projects (tenant-level reliability of Snowflake, access hardening for AI enablement, resilience to GitHub outages, EKS upgrade cadence, a capacity planning process); part of the job is deciding which ones actually matter and when.

Some IT-adjacent work falls under Infrastructure too, mainly access provisioning and security. IT is a small share of the team's time overall, so expect it to be a very minor part of the role.

How we work

The Platform Team works together with the three other functions of the firm: Market Teams, Investment Engineering, and the Internal Team. Market teams analyze the power markets and build our bids based on our internal data and tooling, all built on Platform Team infrastructure. The Investment Engineering (IE) Team is scales investment prototypes and builds proprietary modeling tools — when IE needs to scale a system, they often hit a systems barrier that the Platform Team is best placed to remove. Our Internal Team uses applications and tools built by the Platform Team to scale their work and deliver greater leverage to the firm with fewer people.

Working with these teams, this role will build and execute the Infrastructure roadmap based on touchpoints with stakeholders across the firm, feedback from office hours, and anticipation of future scaling needs. Working with the rest of the Platform Team, this role will prioritize and synthesize the next steps of these projects, recommend approaches, and execute on the core technical work.

You'll join a five-person on-call rotation with the rest of the Platform Team. In practice, we see only a handful of outside-of-work-hours pages a year. The bulk of on-call is non-urgent — something failed overnight and you deal with it when you get in — and most of that is currently data-pipeline work, since we're currently working to modernize our data ingestion and transformation processes firm-wide. Some things are time-sensitive because of the nature of our markets (bid deadlines don't move). The rotation may change shape as our maintenance surface grows and the team becomes more specialized.

What we're looking for

The core requirement is ownership. We view the Infrastructure vertical as a product with a roadmap, and the person in this seat will be the one to drive it full-time. That expectation starts small and grows, but this is not a role with a well defined queue of tickets pre-scoped for execution.

Your users are internal. They're technical but they aren't infrastructure experts, so they will need to understand the rationale for any changes and improvements we’re making to our infrastructure. The people who will succeed here treats other engineers as customers while advocating for improvements to our infrastructure. They automate recurring work, maintain a high bar for reliability and security, and prioritize projects based on the needs of the firm. They'd rather ship the simple solution a 50-person firm needs than build for scale we don't have. They surface tradeoffs in their work, rather than sharing a solution absent the context that resulted in that recommendation.

Prior skills and experiences that matter for this role include designing, implementing, and maintaining the following services:

• Production Kubernetes (like EKS) and Terraform

• GitOps workflows (like Flux, Atlantis)

• Docker, deeply enough to debug a container problem down through the OS and network layers

• Cloud networking, secrets, certificates, and secure service-to-service connectivity

• Self-service tooling for other engineers

Nice to have:

• Workflow orchestration infrastructure

• Snowflake and RDS infrastructure

• Karpenter

• Python

• Multi-region or multi-provider disaster recovery design

• Managing externally-issued credentials and certificates

Benefits & Perks

We strive to offer best-in-class compensation and benefits alongside an unrivaled work-life balance.

• $180,000–$200,000 annual salary

• Annual discretionary bonus

• 18 paid vacation days + 7 paid federal holidays

• Excellent health, dental, and vision insurance (including HSA option) with no monthly premiums for best-in-class platinum individual plan

• 401k match -- 100% company matching on the first 4% of deferrals with immediate vesting

• Annual firmwide weeklong summit

• Hybrid remote work environment -- most of the year we are in the office Tuesday to Thursday with remote flexibility Monday and Friday

• Flexible remote work months -- fully remote option for the month of July and between Thanksgiving and New Years

• Casual environment (informal attire)

• Snacks and unlimited coffee in the office

• Firm-sponsored social events and activities including happy hours, lunches, book club, and more!

Application:

jobs.title: Director of Concierge Sales
jobs.description:
About Intellica

Intellica https://www.intellica.com/ triples SMS revenue for DTC brands like Cozy Earth, Travelpro and Collars & Co, with a Sales-as-a-Service offering, powered by real humans in the US.

Imagine you could go into a sales conversation knowing everything you could possibly know about the customer, product and brand.  That’s what we’ve built with AI: it’s like an Iron Man suit for sales that helps you convert more and sell faster.  It suggests tactics, answers questions and helps draft replies, but always keeps the human seller at the center of the conversation.

If you are a sales nerd this is a unique opportunity to help us automate sales with humans in the loop.



The Role

You will lead our team of human sales concierges and own our revenue number.  You will help them sell better, and most importantly own what "great" sounds like, so we can train our AI to help them sell better too.

The leads are already teed up because our team gets to text with visitors to our brands’ websites, while they shop on the site, make purchases, and abandon carts.  Based on your experience and taste you will define how we sell the brand’s products to those shoppers, to provide the best experience and maximize revenue.

This is bigger than closing sales. You will design the whole relationship a shopper has with a brand across channels. Every touchpoint should feel like one continuous, unmistakably world-class experience.

We don't expect you to arrive with all the answers. We expect you to go find them: run experiments, study the best sellers and brands in the world, test new ideas against real results, and turn what wins into the new standard.



What you'll do...

Own our revenue number

 - Have broad influence regarding our concierge sales strategy, team and AI

 - Operationally lead our concierge sales team to maximize their revenue

Set and enforce the quality bar

 - Define, in writing, what an excellent concierge experience looks like: tone, timing, discovery, recommendations, handling objections, closing, and knowing when not to push.

 - Run daily QA on live conversations. Score, flag and correct.

 - Turn recurring misses into clear rules and examples the human and AI teams can both follow.

Design the full customer lifecycle

 - Map every moment a brand should interact with a customer

 - Define what great looks like at each moment and how they connect, so a shopper experiences one relationship.

 - Work with the AI and customer success team to bring new lifecycle moments to life and measure how they move retention and repeat purchase.

Be an AI thought partner

 - Turn your taste into something the AI can learn from: concise definitions of what good is, the key pieces of great messages and conversations, and what to look for when reviewing. Review agent output at scale and tell engineers precisely what to change and why.

 - Help define the evaluation criteria we use to grade the agent against each brand's voice and goals.

Experiment and research

 - Treat the current sales playbook as a set of hypotheses. Design and run experiments.

 - Go out into the world for inspiration: top retail associates, personal shoppers, etc.

You’ll combine strong software engineering fundamentals with product judgment and an eye for intuitive user experiences. Working directly with engineers and design partners, you’ll identify valuable problems, prototype solutions, and develop them into reliable products.

What You'll Do:

Your main crossfunctional interfaces will be with Electrical and Software Engineering, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, and Program Management.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Learning & Enablement
jobs.description:
ABOUT RUNLAYER 


AI is transforming how every company operates, but most enterprises are stuck. They want to move fast with AI Agents, tools, and workflows, but they can't do it safely. We're fixing that.

 

Our team built AI Actions for OpenAI, shipped Zapier Agents to millions of users, and launched the first remote MCP server with Anthropic. We helped establish the protocol, and now we're building the platform enterprises need to actually put AI to work.

 

Runlayer is one platform for MCPs, Skills, and Agents: purpose-built security, fine-grained governance, and complete observability so organizations can go all-in on AI across the entire company without the risk. We just raised a $30M Series A led by Felicis, with participation from Khosla Ventures, bringing our total raised to $42M. Already trusted by Gusto, Instacart, Opendoor, dbt Labs, and Decagon.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager - Learning & Enablement, you'll own how new Runners get up to speed: the design, the build, and the execution of onboarding and enablement from end to end. You'll start where the need is sharpest, our scaling go-to-market team, with a mandate that grows across the company from there. Your job is to compress ramp time, and to do it the Runlayer way.

Here's what we mean. The old playbook is slide decks, thirty Zoom walkthroughs, and a feedback survey. We're not doing that. Our onboarding puts new hires inside the product on day one: they use it, feel where it breaks, and learn why we built what we built before anyone hands them a talk track. We've already built the v1 of this program, including an AI tutor agent that drills new hires, simulates customer objections, and reports on their progress. You'll take it over, run it, and make it world-class.




WHY YOU’LL THRIVE HERE

 - Impact: Every hire we make ramps through your program. As we scale GTM, the speed at which a new AE, SDR, or SE becomes productive is the speed at which the company grows.

 - Excellence: You'll work directly with our VP of Go-to-Market and Head of Operations, with a mandate to build the most elite onboarding program in enterprise software.

 - Ownership: This is a build role. You own the content, the calendar, the certification gates, the AI agents that power the program, and the results.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own onboarding end to end. Design, build, and run the program that takes a new hire from signed offer to certified and selling. You own ramp time as a number and are accountable for moving it down.

 - Evolve our onboarding program. We've taken the first cut: a structured first week built around hands-on labs, certification gates, and real product use. You'll pressure-test it, run it with every cohort, and rebuild it as the product and team grow.

 - Build AI-native enablement. Conceive and design interactive sessions and voice agents that simulate customer calls, test product knowledge, and pressure-test objection handling. You won't need to write the code yourself, but you'll shape what these agents do, calibrate them against real cohorts, and spot the gaps that keep them from teaching well.

 - Teach the product by feel, not by slides. New Runners should sell from experience: they've deployed the platform, broken it, governed it, and built with it. You'll keep that principle at the core of everything you ship.

 - Enable the field beyond week one. Ongoing readiness as we launch new products, enter new segments, and refine positioning. Onboarding is the start; keeping the team sharp is the job.

 - Grow the scope. GTM is the starting point, not the ceiling. Parts of the program already double as the company-wide layer for every new Runner, and as we scale, this role is positioned to own enablement across the company.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in enablement, sales, customer success, or another GTM role where you built programs that made other people better.

 - Enablement fundamentals. You've designed onboarding or training programs before and know what separates a program that certifies real skill from one that schedules meetings.

 - AI-native instincts. You use AI heavily in your own work and have a formed perspective on what enablement should look like in a world of agents. If we ask how you'd use AI to onboard a sales team, you have real answers.

 - First-principles builder. You don't start from the standard playbook. You start from "what does this person need to be able to do, and what's the fastest honest path there."

 - Time in the field. You've sold, supported, or sat close enough to revenue to have credibility with the people you're enabling.

 - Exceptionalism somewhere. Team captain, founder, athlete, world-class Rubik's cube solver. We don't care what it is. We care that you've pushed yourself to be excellent at something.




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS 

 - You carried a quota before moving into enablement.

 - You've been an early or first enablement hire and built the function from zero.

 - You've built or shipped something with AI agents, voice agents, or LLM tooling.

 - You're in NYC or want to be. We'd love this person in the office.




WHAT WE OFFER

We provide a competitive package designed to attract and retain top talent who can work effectively with enterprise customers.

 - Competitive salary and equity — compensation that reflects your expertise and customer-facing responsibilities.

 - Paid time off — paid vacation, paid sick leave, and paid parental leave.

 - Professional development — budget for conferences, courses, and certifications in AI, enterprise software, and customer success.

 - Top-tier equipment — your choice of laptop and accessories to create your ideal work environment.

 - Health benefits — comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Customer interaction opportunities — work directly with innovative companies and see the immediate impact of your work.

jobs.description:

TPG is a leading global alternative asset management firm, founded in San Francisco in 1992, with operational teams around the world. The quality of our investments and our ability to build great companies depend on the originality of our insights. Reaching our firm’s full potential means supporting every team member to bring the fullness of their unique perspective to their work and to our community. TPG is seeking an analytical, entrepreneurial, self-starter individual with passion for problem solving and critical thinking to join the Investment Operations team in New York as an Analyst or Associate. This person will work with a small team responsible for covering the firm’s credit strategies and gain exposure to multiple asset classes, including private credit. The candidate should be dedicated, capable of working both independently and within a team, and thrives in a sophisticated, fast-paced environment. Additionally, the candidate demonstrates the ability to highlight inefficiencies and areas of improvement to scale new and existing processes with the opportunity to work on larger initiatives outside of daily deliverables.

Process lifecycle activity for revolver-type facilities. Complete fundings under tight deadlines. Review borrowing bases, flow of funds and credit agreements.

Onboard new vendors, business partners and systems.

jobs.title: Associate Director, APS Enterprise Planning
jobs.description:
The Associate Director, Enterprise Planning, supports U.S. Patient Services (APS) by leading enterprise planning, portfolio governance, capacity planning, and organizational coordination. This role creates the frameworks, processes, and visibility needed to align strategic priorities with organizational capacity and enable effective decision-making across APS.

Serving as the operational leader for the APS ALIGN intake and planning process, the Associate Director provides end-to-end portfolio visibility, facilitates leadership governance and prioritization, and ensures initiatives are aligned with strategic objectives, available resources, and delivery capacity. The role partners extensively with APS leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to translate strategic direction into actionable priorities, manage dependencies and trade-offs, and drive execution of key commitments.

The Associate Director also advances APS portfolio management capabilities, maintains critical planning and reporting processes, and drives adoption of tools and ways of working that support transparency, accountability, and informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

• Enterprise Strategic Planning & Portfolio Governance: Lead the processes and governance mechanisms that enable APS to identify, prioritize, manage, and communicate enterprise initiatives.Strategic Planning: Facilitate annual and ongoing strategic planning processes, translating enterprise objectives into aligned organizational priorities and initiatives.Portfolio Intake & Governance: Establish and manage a standardized intake, evaluation, prioritization, and governance process for enterprise initiatives and emerging business needs.Portfolio Management: Maintain an integrated portfolio of enterprise priorities, including initiative ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, and progress against commitments.Enterprise Priorities Dashboard: Develop and maintain a centralized dashboard providing organizational transparency into strategic priorities, initiative status, key milestones, and decisions.Leadership Decision Support: Facilitate portfolio reviews and governance discussions, enabling leadership to evaluate trade-offs, resolve competing priorities, and make informed investment and sequencing decisions.

• Enterprise Capacity Planning & Coordination: Establish and facilitate an integrated approach to capacity planning across APS, ensuring organizational commitments are informed by functional resource availability and competing demands.

• Capacity Planning Framework: Develop standardized approaches, tools, and planning cadences that enable functional leaders to assess capacity against enterprise priorities.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Lead the coordination of capacity planning across functional leaders, integrating their assessments to identify organizational constraints, dependencies, and potential resource conflicts.
• Demand and Capacity Visibility: Consolidate functional capacity inputs to provide enterprise-level visibility into anticipated demand, available capacity, and potential execution risks.
• Scenario Planning: Support leadership in evaluating prioritization, timing, and sequencing alternatives when enterprise demand exceeds available capacity.
• Leadership Accountability: Facilitate capacity planning discussions and establish expectations for timely, accurate inputs while maintaining functional leaders' accountability for their own resource allocation and capacity management.

• Organizational Planning & Enablement: Lead organizational planning processes and coordination mechanisms that enable effective collaboration, communication, and operational continuity across APS.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

General qualifications and requirements

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

jobs.title: Sr. Transmission & Generation Planning Engineer (PE)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. TRANSMISSION & GENERATION PLANNING ENGINEER (PE)

SpaceX’s Starbase launch facilities are the center of SpaceX's plans to revolutionize space travel, serving as our primary site for Starship development and operations. We're seeking a licensed Professional Engineer with extensive experience on large EPC builds of both electrical transmission and generation infrastructure. In this role, you will own utility-scale power projects at Starbase — transmission lines, substations, and generation facilities — advising internal teams, engineering firms, and EPC contractors so designs are constructible, compliant, and ready on the timeline the site requires.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Act as the primary technical owner and reviewer for transmission and generation design packages — plans, specifications, and construction documents — produced by internal teams, engineering firms, and EPC contractors, and confirm they are ready to issue for procurement and construction

• Direct large EPC efforts covering high-voltage transmission (lines, structures, and rights-of-way), transmission substations and switchyards, and generation facilities (plant, balance of plant, and grid interconnection), from concept and studies through detailed design, procurement support, construction, and commissioning

• Develop standardized design criteria, specifications, drawing templates, and review checklists so engineers and consultants produce consistent, constructible, code-compliant documents

• Give project managers and leadership a clear readiness call on design maturity, long-lead equipment, permitting, constructibility, and construction sequencing, and surface schedule risk early

• Own the construction-phase technical interface: respond to RFIs, disposition field changes, direct contractors and vendors on technical issues, and support commissioning through turnover

• Interface with electric utilities, transmission providers, ERCOT processes as applicable, and authorities having jurisdiction on interconnection, routing, permitting, and compliance

• Resolve technical issues across civil, structural, electrical, protection and controls, and mechanical disciplines, and push designs that are safe, reliable, and fast to build

• Stay current on the NESC, NEC, IEEE, NFPA, and Texas utility practice; fold lessons from construction and commissioning back into standards; and mentor engineers while holding consultants and contractors to that same bar

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in electrical or other engineering discipline

• Active Professional Engineer (P.E.) license, with the ability to stamp and certify electrical plans

• 8+ years of experience in electric utility engineering, including technical leadership of design, specification development, and permitting or interconnection

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Extensive, hands-on experience on large EPC builds of both electrical transmission and electrical generation. Transmission experience must include lines and substations at transmission voltage. Generation experience must include utility-scale plant facilities and grid interconnection. Prior work should be at a scale comparable to multi-mile transmission, transmission-voltage substations, and utility-scale generation

• Record of taking those projects through detailed design, equipment specification and procurement support, construction support, and commissioning. Distribution-only work, studies without EPC delivery, or experience in only transmission or only generation does not meet this requirement

• Manager-level experience — for example as a design manager, engineering manager, or project engineering manager — at an engineering or EPC firm hired by electric utilities (investor-owned, municipal, cooperative, or independent power producers) to design and build large-scale transmission and generation systems

• Direct responsibility for transmission at 69 kV and above, including line design and substation or switchyard design (air-insulated and/or gas-insulated)

• Direct responsibility for utility-scale generation and balance of plant, such as simple-cycle or combined-cycle gas plants or other large generation, including interconnection to the transmission system

• ERCOT & MISO interconnection experience and familiarity with Texas and Louisiana coastal design conditions, including high wind, corrosion, and flooding

• Depth in protection and controls, grounding, and substation physical and electrical design, in addition to project leadership

• Proficiency with the tools used to produce and check this work, such as AutoCAD, PLS-CADD or an equivalent line-design package, substation physical design tools, and ETAP, SKM, ASPEN, or similar study software, plus document management systems

• Ability to thrive in ambiguous, high-tempo situations and make decisions with incomplete information while holding a rigorous technical standard

• Passion for space exploration and a willingness to relocate to work in Starbase, Texas, to be at the forefront of humanity's multiplanetary future

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• This is not a remote or hybrid position and will require relocation if not already local to the Brownsville, TX areas

• Position occasionally requires the ability to work extended hours or weekends when needed

• Ability to travel to various locations included but not limited to: Louisiana, Florida, California, Texas

• Ability to travel internationally if required

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Per Diem Family Medicine Physician (Casual Employee) - Cow Hollow
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

Employment type:

• “Casual Employee” (per diem, hourly clinician role)

• 8-23 patient care hours per week

What you'll be working on:

• Seeing patients with a broad array of patient needs; conducting a mix of acute, chronic, and well visits (not a panel-building role)

• Treating patients in-office as well as conducting occasional tele-health visits

• Ongoing collaboration with in-office teammates via daily huddles, as well as with virtual clinical teams

• Utilization of your specific clinical training and opportunities to perform in-office procedures

Education, licenses, and experiences required for this role:

• Enrolled in, or have completed, an accredited Family Medicine or Medicine/Pediatrics residency program

• Practiced at least 2 of the last 5 years in an outpatient primary care setting seeing all ages (0+)

• Board Certified in Family Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics. If not yet Board Certified, must presently be a Board Eligible Family Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics Resident, or have completed a Family Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics Residency Program within the last calendar year and scheduled to take the next available Board Exam

• State licensed in California, obtained before your One Medical start date

One Medical clinicians also demonstrate:

• A passion for human-centered primary care

• The ability to successfully communicate with and provide care to individuals of all backgrounds

• The ability to effectively use technology to deliver high quality care

• Clinical proficiency in evidence-based primary care

• The desire to be an integral part of a team dedicated to changing healthcare delivery

• An openness to feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into strengths and weaknesses

• The ability to confidently navigate uncertain situations with both patients and colleagues

• Readiness to adapt personal and interpersonal behavior to meet the needs of our patients

Casual/Per Diem clinicians receive:

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• One Medical Issued laptop (to allow for secure access to our EHR)

• Sick Time PTO eligible in accordance with local requirement

This is an hourly role in Cow Hollow and across multiple offices in San Francisco, CA.

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The hourly rate for this role is $177.00. Final determination of starting pay may vary based on factors such as practice experience and patient care schedule. Additional pay may be determined for those candidates that exceed these specified qualifications and requirements. The total compensation package for this position may also include benefits. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Account Management
jobs.description:
Schedule: Full Time

Job Type: Hybrid

Salary Type: Salary

Req #: 3432

About the Role:

A Sr. Manager sets the strategy across multiple accounts that are part of a Squad.  Working closely with the Director and senior leadership, they create alignment across functional teams and fully understand the levers that drive key performance metrics. They are expected to create operational efficiency amongst their team, drive adoption toward process improvement, and demonstrate strong management and team development capabilities. They are a visible leader with broad influence and relationships across the organization.

A Sr. Manager will manage a team consisting of operation coordinators, account managers, and associate account managers. At this level, they are expected to continually develop new operational execution strategies and improve the core efficiency of Uber Freight. They should be viewed as thought leaders, sought out by their peers for advice outside of their immediate scope. They should be mature managers, skilled at hiring and developing a high performance team. They should be comfortable presenting to senior executives, crafting strategy, driving deep accountability, and facilitating solution selling at some of UF's largest accounts.

What You’ll Do:

• Effectively translate business unit goals into an operational plan / roadmap for the team.

• Identify problems before they surface, and solve key pain points for Uber Freight customers and the Uber Freight internal org.

• Build and inspire a culture of high quality customer service across the Uber Freight organization.

• Estimate, seek out, and allocate team / cross-functional resources to meet objectives.

• Build a data-driven culture of continuous improvement, form creative strategic relationships across the organization, and use contextual awareness to make trade-offs and manage through conflict appropriately.

• Influence the broader organization on the importance of customer obsession and defect reduction.

• Understand trade-offs between CSAT and other key metrics and incorporate this awareness into strategy, stakeholder management, and process design.

• See and unlock new business opportunities with measured impact to company objectives

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelors degree and/or 4+ years of working experience

• 5+ years of experience in the Freight industry

• 2+ years of managerial experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Strong organizational skills

• A bias for using data to make informed decisions

• Deep experience working with cross-departmental stakeholders to accomplish business goals

• History of setting a vision for a team, especially through use of data

• Trusted advisor across their peer group

• Skilled at and committed to developing talent

Benefits & Compensation for U.S. Employees

Employees working more than 30 hours in the US at Uber Freight are eligible for benefits like a company sponsored health plan, dental and vision benefits, 401k match, financial and mental wellness benefits, parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage, life insurance and more.  US based employees may also be eligible for a performance or sales incentive bonus program, participation in Uber Freight equity awards, and other types of compensation depending upon the role.

Illinois: The salary range for this role is $97,200 to $120,000 a year. (The role will also have a sales incentive plan on top of base salary)

About Uber Freight

Uber Freight helps companies move goods more reliably and efficiently. We bring together the technology, people, and transportation capacity they need, using real‑time data from millions of shipments to guide smarter decisions. That helps customers spot issues early, avoid costly surprises, and deliver on time. Uber Freight works with 1 in 3 Fortune 500 shippers across North America and manages over $17B in freight. Learn more at www.uberfreight.com.

Uber Freight is committed to protecting the privacy of our candidates. We collect and process personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. For detailed information on how we handle candidate data, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, UI Tooling
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The UI Foundation team has a deep history at Airbnb, responsible for the design system, accessibility, motion, and the tooling that connects how Airbnb designs and builds products. Within UI Foundation, the UI Tooling team is the connective tissue between Airbnb's Design Language System and the day-to-day workflows of hundreds of designers, engineers, and product managers across the company.

UI Tooling owns the platforms, integrations, and tooling that power how designers, engineers, and product managers work - spanning design tooling, UI engineering workflow tooling, collaboration platforms, and increasingly, AI-powered workflows across all three. As AI enablement for designers and engineers accelerates, this team sits at the center of some of Airbnb's most strategic infrastructure investments.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Staff Software Engineer on the UI Tooling team, you will lead our prototyping and rapid deployment platform, Kyber. You will drive implementation, maintenance, and scaling of a system that supports thousands of internal projects and users and enables non-technical builders to express ideas across all of our product surface areas.

You will own the strategy and execution across 3 key areas:

• Rebuild Kyber onto our next-generation cloud platforms.

• Evolve Kyber capabilities to support product development process.

• Integrate Kyber into our ecosystem supporting prototyping workflows.

A Typical Day:

• Setting technical direction for the Kyber platform, making architectural decisions for the systems that enable rapid deployment of internal applications and product feature prototypes.

• Write and review code hands-on and with AI coding agents, establishing and demonstrating standards for quality, availability and system health across the platform.

• Partner with Infrastructure, Product, Security, and Design to translate cross-organizational objectives into platform capabilities.

• Advance the capabilities for Product Managers, Designers, and other non-technical builders to build rich product feature prototypes that translate to features in our production applications.

• Mentor engineers and act as a force multiplier, leveling up the team through design reviews, technical guidance, and a collaborative, inclusive culture.

Your Expertise:

• 9+ years of industry experience, ideally within fast-paced environments, with a track record of delivering large-scale service oriented systems.

• Broad full-stack engineering capability, with the confidence to work across backend, frontend, mobile, APIs and system architecture as technical challenges require.

• Proven experience building customer-facing products from zero to one, contributing to product definition, technical architecture, development and launch.

• End-to-end product ownership, with experience iterating on launched products, responding to customer feedback and improving adoption, usability and business outcomes.

• Strong architectural design skills, including high-scale distributed services, well-designed APIs, data pipelines, efficient algorithms and reliable integrations.

• Sound technical judgment, with the ability to balance speed of delivery, experimentation, scalability and long-term engineering quality.

• A product-first engineering mindset, with an understanding that technical decisions are in service of the products we provide to our customers.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience driving initiatives that span across teams, departments and leadership.

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. jobs.title: Associate Director, Placements
jobs.description:
About Vouch:

Vouch is the insurance broker that powers ambition.

We’re a tech-enabled insurance advisory and brokerage purpose-built for growing companies in technology, life sciences, and professional services. Our clients are ambitious leaders building complex businesses, and we help them manage risk with tailored advice, smart coverage, and responsive service.

Backed by over $200M from world-class investors, Vouch combines deep industry expertise with AI-powered tools to deliver a better insurance experience. Our digital workflows reduce friction, speed up decisions, and give our clients the confidence to move faster.

Why should you join our team and Vouch?

Not only is this an exciting and growing team where you can drive a real impact on our operational scalability, but Vouch is also the preferred insurance provider to customers of Y Combinator, Brex, Carta, and WeWork. We’re a quickly growing startup that believes in transparency and acknowledgment with our team members and cultivating a values-driven company. Our values are "Be Client Obsessed", "Own it together", "Act with integrity and empathy", "Stay Curious and Grow", and "Empower People."

What does a work environment look like at Vouch?

Vouch has employees located across the U.S., with offices in San Francisco, Chicago, and New York City. While this role has hybrid work flexibility, we require team members to be in the office at least three days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday) to foster close collaboration and team building.

Why this role matters:

As an Associate Director on our Placements team, you’ll sit at the heart of trust and execution: where clients rely on us to secure the coverage that protects their future, and carriers look to us to bring them the most innovative, high-potential companies in the market.

You will:

• Own complex placements — structuring and negotiating programs for Vouch’s most high-profile clients.
• Shape market strategy — building deep carrier relationships and influencing underwriting appetite across critical lines.
• Elevate our edge — driving adoption of brokerage tech and AI to set a new industry standard for speed and precision.

This is a senior seat with direct impact: you’ll make placements that change client trajectories, scale relationships that expand our market leverage, and mentor teammates as we grow.

What you’ll do:

• Lead placement strategy for high-value, multi-line accounts (Mgmt Liability, Cyber/Tech E&O, Professional, GL/Umbrella).
• Negotiate directly with carriers and wholesale partners to unlock optimal coverage, structure, and pricing.
• Serve as a trusted advisor to client managers and producers, guiding deal structuring and market positioning.
• Build and expand senior-level carrier partnerships, anticipating appetite shifts and introducing creative solutions.
• Translate emerging market and competitive trends into actionable strategies.
• Contribute to process, compliance, and tech innovations that scale our brokerage edge.
• Mentor and coach colleagues, helping grow the next generation of placement leaders at Vouch.

About you:

• 8+ years of commercial insurance experience with a track record of placing complex risks independently.
• Deep expertise in P&C with emphasis on Cyber, Professional, and Management Liability, with proven ability to influence carrier strategy and underwriting appetite.
• Executive presence and influence with both carrier partners and client stakeholders.
• Known for delivering high-quality results under pressure and balancing client advocacy with carrier realities.
• Tech-forward: eager to leverage and scale new tools (including AI) to improve speed, accuracy, and client outcomes.
• Strategic thinker who identifies new market opportunities and contributes to organizational goals.
• Actively contributes to team development, whether through mentoring peers, sharing expertise, or supporting recruitment.
• Licensed in Property & Casualty (P&C).

Nice to have:

• Fintech, Crypto, VC, LifeSciences, Consumer, Professional Services experience and interest.
• Experience working in a fast-paced brokerage environment.
• Exposure to and passion for early-stage startups and/or high-growth environments.

Vouch provides several benefits to help you bring your best self to work:

• 💰 Competitive compensation and equity packages
• ⚕️ Health, dental, and vision insurance
• 🍼 Parental leave
• 🌴 Flexible vacation time
• 🪷 Wellness allowance
• 🛜 Technology allowance
• 📚 Company-sponsored personal and professional development
• 🏫 L&D: Partnerships with Ethena and monthly Lunch & Learns
• 🧘 Wellbeing: access to many wellbeing perks, including Peloton, Fetch, OneMedical, Headspace care+, etc.
• 🤗 Caregiver Support: company seed into the dependent care FSA and company sponsored Care.com membership.
• 📊 Regular performance reviews: Vouch conducts regular performance discussions with all team members, offering goal setting and check-ins, development discussions, and promotion opportunities.

What to expect in a typical interview process:

(Please note these steps may vary slightly depending on the role)

• 30-minute phone call with our recruiting team
• 30-45 minute video interview with the hiring manager
• Case study/technical screen
• Meet the team! 30-45 min 1:1 video discussion with 3-4 team members you’d work closely with in the role

Compensation philosophy:
The base salary for this role varies by location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a variable annual bonus.

• San Francisco & New York: $150,000 - $180,000 + 20% variable annual bonus
• Chicago: $140,000 - $165,000 + 20% variable annual bonus

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry and are part of our total compensation package, which also includes benefits and other perks. We also include stock options in all compensation packages and believe all Vouch employees should have the opportunity to become owners in the company. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, location, and business need. Vouch believes in putting our people first, and building a diverse team is at the front of everything we do. We welcome people from different backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and ranges of abilities. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate the diversity of our growing team.

jobs.title: Robotics Intern, World Foundation Models
jobs.description:
At Toyota Research Institute (TRI), we’re on a mission to improve the quality of human life. We’re developing new tools and capabilities to amplify the human experience. To lead this transformative shift in mobility, we’ve built a world-class team advancing the state of the art in AI, robotics, driving, and material sciences.
This is a paid 12-week internship opportunity and is a hybrid, in-office role.
Here’s a glimpse into the Internship experience from some of our TRI interns!


The Team
The World Foundation Models (WFM) team in the Robotics division is looking for research interns for the summer of 2027 in a variety of areas such as Video Generation, World Modeling, World-Action Models, 4D Reconstruction, Learning from Egocentric Videos, Multi-Modal Foundation Models, Multi-View Geometry, and Data Augmentation, with a primary focus on on embodied applications. We are aiming to make progress on some of the hardest scientific challenges around the deployment of robots in unstructured environments, by leveraging data from different sources and modalities, and learning transferable priors grounded in physical properties found in the real-world. Our mission is to develop foundational models capable of understanding how the world works, and in doing so predict possible future states from available information and adapt to new environments and circumstances. 

The Internship
As a Research Intern, you will work with a multidisciplinary team proposing, conducting, and transferring pioneering research on the intersection between Computer Vision and Robotics. You will use large amounts of data from different sources and modalities, and train large-scale foundation models aimed at solving open problems, work towards publications at top academic venues,  and test your ideas in simulators as well as in the real world.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

• Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

• Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Data Analyst, Growth Marketing

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst, Growth Marketing to join our growing team. This role sits at the center of how Quince decides where to invest to acquire customers. You will own marketing analytics across growth channels and build the measurement frameworks, including attribution, incrementality, and channel performance, that show what is driving acquisition and where to invest next. You will partner closely with marketing leadership to surface insights, run experiments, and build scalable analytics tools as the team expands. Over time, you will become the go-to expert on growth data across the Quince platform.

In this role, you will help the team make faster, smarter investment decisions by turning channel data into clear, trusted answers about what is working and where to put the next dollar.

Responsibilities

• Own marketing attribution modeling and measurement frameworks across growth channels (search, social, etc.)

• Design, execute, and analyze incrementality tests (A/B tests) to measure causal impact

• Build and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly performance dashboards for the growth marketing team and Quince leadership; ensure data quality and reporting accuracy through automated monitoring

• Automate insights generation and increase speed of decision making

• Partner with marketing leadership to translate data into actionable channel and budget recommendations, including deep dive analysis to uncover growth opportunities and performance drivers

• Apply statistical and predictive modeling techniques to optimize marketing performance; experience with marketing mix modeling (MMM) preferred

• Preferred: experience with app measurement and mobile attribution

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics)

• 5+ years relevant experience in data analytics or data science, preferably with a focus on growth marketing, ecommerce, or performance marketing

• Hands-on experience building marketing attribution models and designing incrementality tests

• Proven track record of independently scoping and delivering complex analyses with measurable business impact

• Strong proficiency in SQL; proficiency in Python for data manipulation, modeling and analysis

• Familiarity with major media platforms and their measurement ecosystems (e.g. Meta, Google, TikTok)

• Strong proficiency with AI tools to increase productivity and surface data and insights

• Excellent written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate across business areas and with leadership

• Ability to prioritize and deliver across multiple threads of work in a fast paced environment

• Strong personal work ethic, including personal initiative and ownership

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range

$163,000—$188,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.

We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.

At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.



About the job

As Senior Project Manager, Strategic Implementation, you will lead the end-to-end execution of new market launches, new contract implementations, and other high-priority strategic initiatives that fuel Vynca's growth. This is a build role: you will design and implement the frameworks, governance, and tools, standing up a repeatable implementation function. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with leaders across the organization to move initiatives from signed contract to live, revenue-generating operations. Success in this role requires equal parts structure and adaptability: the discipline of formal project management combined with the resourcefulness to operate in a fast-moving healthcare startup.

What you'll do

 - Own end-to-end project management for new market entries, contract implementations or new lines of business, from kickoff through go-live and post-launch stabilization.

 - Build the project management function and infrastructure for the organization — including governance models, intake processes, status reporting cadences, and playbooks.

 - Translate signed contracts and new-market business cases into detailed implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, owners, and timelines.

 - Lead cross-functional project teams spanning operations, account management, sales, analytics, marketing, compliance, product, IT, RCM and finance, holding workstream owners accountable without direct authority.

 - Partner with and influence leaders at all levels of the organization, from front-line managers to the executive team, to align priorities and resolve roadblocks quickly.

 - Design and implement value-based care program operations, coordinating readiness across teams.

 - Identify risks and issues early, drive mitigation plans, and escalate proactively to leadership with clear options and recommendations.

 - Apply Lean and process-improvement principles to continuously simplify and scale implementation processes as the company grows.

 - Establish and track key implementation metrics (timeline adherence, milestone completion, launch readiness, post-launch performance) and report progress to executive leadership.

 - Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and change-management plans to support each new market or contract launch.

 - Ensure all implementation activities comply with applicable healthcare regulations and payer-specific requirements.

 - Continuously improve the implementation playbook based on lessons learned, building institutional knowledge that makes each subsequent launch faster and lower-risk.



Your experience and qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Operations, or a related field; advanced degree a plus, preferred.

 - Minimum of 5-8 years of project management experience, including leading complex, value-based initiatives in a health-tech start-up environment.

 - Demonstrated experience implementing new markets, new contracts, or new lines of business, ideally within a startup or high-growth environment.

 - Experience with or strong working knowledge of value-based care and value-based payment program design and operations.

 - Track record of building processes, structure, and tools from scratch rather than optimizing an existing, mature function.

 - Exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align leaders at all levels of an organization.

 - Strong executive presence and communication skills, including comfort presenting plans, risks, and results to senior leadership.

 - Comfort operating with ambiguity and shifting priorities typical of an early-to-growth-stage healthcare company.

 - PMP certification, required.

 - Lean, Six Sigma, or other process-improvement certification or working knowledge, preferred.

 - Knowledge of healthcare compliance requirements, including HIPAA and payer contracting standards, preferred.

California, Georgia, Texas, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Utah and Washington.

jobs.title: Industrial Maintenance Supervisor
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (NYSE: AESI) is a leading solutions provider to the energy industry. Atlas’ portfolio of offerings includes oilfield logistics, distributed power systems, and the largest proppant supply network in the Permian Basin. With a focus on leveraging technology, automation, and remote operations to enhance efficiencies, Atlas is centered around a core mission of improving human beings’ access to hydrocarbons that power our lives and, by doing so, maximizing value creation for our shareholders.

How You Will Make an Impact:

The Industrial Maintenance Supervisor provides technical support for the safe and efficient operation of terminal and logistics equipment with limited supervision. Duties include but are not limited to maintenance and repair of equipment such as bucket elevators, conveyors, pumps, and control devices. Troubleshoots issues, repairs failures of production and facilities equipment and ensures maximum efficiency and effectiveness of operations. Understands process flow and evaluates ways to increase operating efficiency.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Assist maintenance manager in planning, scheduling and execution of maintenance projects and programs.

• Responsible for leading all maintenance and electrical maintenance and repairs.

• Assist maintenance manager in performance discussions and corrective action.

• Work with Maintenance Planner and Scheduler to prioritize workload for the day and night shift.

• Gather technical information for maintenance crews to perform the jobs safely and efficiently.

• Develop SOP’s and procedures to improve employees’ skills.

• Work with maintenance team to help maintain plant cleanliness and appearance through general housekeeping, including washing and maintain company vehicles and tools.

• Make sure equipment repairs are being done properly and parts are being issued to the work orders, checks the status of equipment availability, and work with operation supervisors to coordinate downtime.

• Help develop tasks related to predictive and preventative maintenance programs to improve the operation of plant equipment.

• Be able to interrupt blueprints and equipment manuals.

• Work with Warehouse specialist to maintain critical spares for plant equipment.

• Contact and work with contractors/vendors on projects and to keep up with the latest technologies.

• Coordinate and plan down time efficiently to maximize uptime of production and communicating with operations when tasks are being scheduled.

• Knowledge of how equipment works, from gearboxes, conveyors, hydraulics, load out chutes, gas and diesel engines, vehicle and machine repairs, with the ability to troubleshoot and analyze equipment problems.

• Coordinate work with Planner/Scheduler and follow up on completed jobs.

• Work overtime as required to minimize plant downtime.

• Perform any other tasks asked of you by your supervisor.

• Always looking for new and better ways to improve plant processes and maintenance procedures.

Qualifications

• Can perform all tasks of Level 1, 2 and Senior mechanics

• Basic hand tool knowledge

• Safe work practices and procedures

• Methods, equipment and materials used in the mechanical trade

• Knowledge of health, safety and environmental regulations

• Applicable laws, codes, regulations, policies and procedures

• Working knowledge of blueprints, shop drawings and sketches

• Minimum High School Diploma or GED required

• Sufficient education to make appropriate arithmetic equations and complete written documentation and records; or an equivalent combination of experience, education and training that provides the desired knowledge, skills and characteristics. Must be able to read and interpret drawings, follow routers, use simple math, and use basic hand-held measuring tools

• Minimum five (5) plus years’ experience in Industrial and/or mining related fields is required and with a basic understanding of hydraulics, pneumatics, mechanical repairs. Must have experience in maintaining and repairing processing equipment and heavy equipment.

• Computer Skills: Basic computer skills required to use maintenance related software for writing work orders and troubleshooting. Proficiency with Microsoft word and Excel are required

Physical Requirements/Working Conditions:

• Regularly required to use dexterity to handle, reach, and feel.

• Required to stand; walk; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, sit and climb or balance.

• Must regularly lift and/or move up to ten pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to fifty pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move more than fifty (50) pounds.

• Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

• Capable of working extended hours when needed.

• Must be able to tolerate conditions associated with no air conditioning or heat.

Certifications& Licenses

• Courses and/or logged hours in the industrial maintenance field are recommended

• Knowledge in equipment reliability and preventative maintenance preferred

• Prior training and certification in the following areas highly desirable: welding certification, vibration analysis, electrical/mechanical, bearing training, conveyor systems, pumps, fans, screening equipment, and vibrating conveying systems.

What You’ll Love About Us:

• Best People and Great Places to Work, Hire Vets ,Top Place to Work For – Austin American Statesman

• Your Well-Being is a 100% covered Medical, Dental, and Vision

• Invest in Your 401K with company match, immediate vesting

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.
