jobs.title: Radiopharmaceutical Production Operator II
jobs.description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases. You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.

See Yourself at Telix

Performs routine radiochemical synthesis, purification, compounding, and quality control functions supporting PET biomarker production at a cyclotron facility, including set-up, operation, routine checks, and preventive maintenance of manufacturing equipment such as cyclotrons and automated chemistry modules. This non-exempt role performs and documents all quality control testing and plays a crucial part in ensuring that manufacturing and QC activities meet cGMP, radiation safety, and applicable State and Federal requirements.

This role is on-site 5 days a week at our Wilkes-Barre, PA location.

Key Accountabilities:

• Executes routine synthesis, dispensing and QC sampling steps independently and in sequence, while maintaining aseptic technique and contamination control discipline throughout.

• Ability to identify processes drifting from the defined window and escalates before proceeding

• Assist in process qualification and process improvement initiatives working with cross functions teams.

• Supports commissioning and equipment qualification activities.

• Executes quality control testing using analytical instrumentation (TLC, HPLC, GC); analyzes and interprets results against established specifications and documents outcomes in compliance with GxP requirements.

• Participates in inspections, maintenance, and troubleshooting to support manufacturing and testing processes and equipment.

• Implements approved SOP changes to production and quality control processes, helping drive continuous improvement.

• Performs daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly PM checks of cyclotrons, chemistry modules, and QC equipment per SOPs.

• Oversees routine logistics functions, including preparing product for shipment, coordinating courier schedules, and documenting as necessary.

• Identifies opportunities for efficiency in the production process.

• Maintains a clean, clutter-free facility and a well-organized production area and workflow.

• Train and mentor Radiopharmaceutical Production Operator I

• Provides exemplary customer support.

• Other tasks as assigned by supervisor.

Education and Experience:

• Associates degree or certifications in Chemistry, Radiochemistry, Biochemistry, or a related field required.

• 2+years of experience in a laboratory setting, preferably in radiopharmaceuticals, or a related industry.

• Knowledge of radiochemical synthesis, purification, and safe handling of radioactive materials required.

• Experience with precision measurement equipment.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and manufacturing work instructions

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to work in a team environment and communicate effectively with diverse groups.

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as GMP and radiation safety practices.

• Willingness to work with radioactive materials and follow strict safety protocols.

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

Working Conditions:

• Work is performed in a cGMP radiopharmaceutical production facility containing a cyclotron, hot cells, automated chemistry modules, and quality control laboratory instrumentation.

• Routine handling of radioactive materials is required. The incumbent must qualify and remain in good standing as an authorized radiation worker under the site's radioactive materials license, complete all required radiation safety training, wear assigned dosimetry, and participate in radiation exposure monitoring programs.

• Personal protective equipment, including lab coats, gloves, safety eyewear, and shielding, is required in all production and QC areas. Gowning for classified cleanroom areas is required as applicable.

• Production schedules are driven by the short half-lives of PET radioisotopes. This role requires early morning, overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts, as well as on-call coverage and overtime as needed to meet patient dose delivery schedules. As a non-exempt role, all overtime must be approved in advance in accordance with company policy.

• Work involves exposure to chemical reagents, compressed gases, cryogenic materials, and high-voltage equipment, with controls applied through established SOPs and safety procedures.

• Physical demands include prolonged standing, repetitive manual manipulation of small components behind shielding, and lifting or moving materials and shielded containers with mechanical assistance where provided.

• Occasional travel between production sites may be required.

Key Capabilities:

• Commitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you do

• Results-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable results

• Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges

• Strong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, using clear and concise language

• Collaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goals

• Resilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challenges

• Inclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected

• Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challenges

• Ethical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholders

• Continuous learning: Show a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development, continually seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills.

At Telix, we believe everyone counts, we strive to be extraordinary, and we pursue our goals with determination and integrity. You will be part of an engaged and supportive group of colleagues who all have a shared purpose: to help people with cancer and rare diseases live longer, better quality lives. Being a Telix employee means being a part of a unique, global, interdisciplinary team working to deliver what's next in precision medicine. We have hybrid and remote employees located all around the world.  We offer competitive salaries, annual performance-based bonuses, an equity-based incentive program, generous vacation, paid wellness days and support for learning and development.

Telix Pharmaceuticals is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director, Mid-Atlantic
jobs.description:
About Us

Prophet Security builds AI SOC agents designed to outwork modern attackers. Our agentic AI SOC platform works every alert end-to-end, hunts threats early, and tightens detections before gaps turn into incidents. Our founders bring decades of experience from companies including CrowdStrike, Mandiant, Palo Alto Networks, Expel, Red Canary, Abnormal Security and Symantec. Backed by Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Amex Ventures and Citi Ventures, our mission is to shift cybersecurity power dynamics to favor defenders.



What Our Platform Does

Specialized AI agents work together across investigation, threat hunting and detection engineering. They connect to a customer's existing tools through 200+ integrations, with no rip-and-replace.

 - AI SOC Analyst: Triages and investigates every alert at a senior-analyst level and takes scoped response actions, autonomously or with human sign-off.

 - AI Threat Hunter: Lets teams query their environment in plain language and runs hunts on emerging threats, on demand or on a schedule.

 - AI Detection Engineer: Maps real MITRE ATT&CK coverage and builds tuned, backtested detections to close gaps.

 - Prophet AI Watchtower: 24x7x365 human experts validate every malicious determination and escalate in under 30 minutes.

Enterprise-ready with single-tenant deployment, Prophet is trusted by Enterprises, nearly one-third in the F500 and growing by the day.  We deliver massive productivity gains - 5.3 minute median time to investigate, 99.8% accuracy rate, 10X faster median time to respond and 250% ROI.



The Impact You'll Have

You'll own new-logo growth in your region. You'll land customers on their most urgent use case, often alert triage and investigation, then expand into threat hunting and detection engineering as they see results. Your work will directly drive Prophet's revenue and help define the AI SOC category.



What You'll Do

 - Build and execute a territory plan to win net-new enterprise customers, with a clear land-and-expand strategy across Prophet's platform.

 - Build trusted relationships with CISOs and security leaders, and engage SOC, detection engineering, threat hunting and procurement teams in each deal.

 - Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through business case, proof of value (POV), security review, negotiation and close.

 - Run outcome-based POVs with Sales Engineering, using clear success criteria such as accuracy, analyst time saved and detection coverage.

 - Position Prophet against legacy SOAR, MDR/MSSP and emerging AI SOC competitors.

 - Co-sell with channel and technology partners to build pipeline and accelerate deals.

 - Partner with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Customer Success and Product, and maintain accurate forecasting in Salesforce.

 - Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual new-business revenue targets.



Qualifications

 - 5+ years of enterprise software sales, including 3+ years closing new logos in cybersecurity.

 - Strong knowledge of security operations buyers and technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR and MDR/MSSP.

 - Track record of selling platforms or multiple products, and of selling AI, automation or emerging-category solutions.

 - Established network of security leaders and channel partners in your region.

 - Consistent history of exceeding quota, with strong deal discipline (e.g., MEDDPICC) in complex, multi-stakeholder sales.

 - Credibility with both technical practitioners and executives, plus excellent communication and presentation skills.

 - A startup mindset and a passion for helping defenders win.



Our Culture

Our employees are recognized as our top asset and we provide great benefits, meaningful equity participation, as well as a fun and inspiring environment to create and collaborate.

 - Customer Centricity: Focus on exceeding customer expectations and placing them at the core of decisions

 - Practicality over Perfection: Emphasis on efficient solutions and agile decision-making

 - Strive for Excellence: Commitment to high standards and continuous improvement

 - Transparent Communication: Encouragement of open, honest dialogue and collaborative trust

 - Unwavering Resilience: Determination to overcome challenges and persist in achieving goals

 - Have Fun: Foster a positive work environment that balances hard work with enjoyment and creativity



Environment

Prophet Security takes pride in being an equal-opportunity employer. We value a diverse and global talent pool and the collaboration that results from having a diverse and inclusive team. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our hiring decisions are based exclusively on merit, qualifications, and business needs.



Compensation

Employee compensation will be determined based on interview performance, level of experience, specialization of skills, and market rate. During the offer discussion, your recruiter will review the finalized base salary, bonus (for applicable roles), benefits & perks, and stock options as they’ll be reflected in the offer letter.

jobs.title: People Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

• Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets, accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.

• Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

This role sits on the People Operations team and is the face of the team for many of the employees at Arc. From onboarding to programs and partnering with the people across the organization, you’ll have the opportunity to work as part of a high performing team and learn the full HR stack. You will own the new hire and departing employee experience, and support immigration and payroll operations. This position provides practical experience and is a training ground for many different types of roles in the people domain. This is 5 days a week onsite position in Palo Alto.

About you

You value providing great service experiences and strive to understand the needs of the people you’re supporting. You are highly detail oriented and eager to build new skills related to AI, data and project management. You enjoy working closely with colleagues and look for the best in others. You stay calm when schedules shift (start dates move, paperwork changes) and keep people informed without being asked.

In this position you will

• Be the first point of contact for employees and managers on benefits, payroll, systems, and programs, including requests through the People Nexus ticketing system and the People Ops alias.

• Be a welcoming front door to Arc and own new hire onboarding, from preboarding and paperwork (including I-9 review) through day-of hosting and swag, working with IT, Scientific Operations, and Facilities on badges, equipment, and off cycle starts.

• Own offboarding, including exit notices to Facilities, IT, and Accounting, last-day confirmation letters, and equipment return tracking.

• Maintain accurate employee records in our HRIS and related systems, and audit data with the People Operations team.

• Work with our Payroll and Benefits partners to manage benefits enrollment and changes in status, and support payroll operations, including non-exempt payroll prep and training tracking.

• Support immigration casework, including verification of employment (VOE) requests, E-Verify notices, and coordination with outside counsel.

• Support our program leaders in running people programs with scheduling, materials, and logistics.

Requirements

• 1+ year of experience as a coordinator or supporting people operations and/or human resources.

• Detail oriented, you’re able to consistently complete work with a high degree of accuracy.

• Strong communicator, you’re able to synthesize relevant information and effectively communicate in both written and verbal formats.

• Comfortable with new technology and open to AI innovation and efficiency to improve your work

• Service minded, you’re oriented towards creating a positive experience for the people you’re working with and supporting.

• Well organized, you have a system for staying organized and are always looking for ways to improve.

• Adaptive, you are open to change and adapting the way you work based on evolving needs.

• Focused on growth, you’re eager to learn from experience and take an active role in your development.

• Experience with an HRIS (HiBob a plus)

• Experience owning and contributing towards a new hire program

Preferred qualifications

• Familiarity with I-9 compliance and employment verification

• Exposure to immigration processes (H-1B, PERM, J-1)

• Experience with payroll systems (S1/Prism a plus)

• Experience in a biotech, research, or fast-growing environment

The base salary range for this position is $37.36 -  $41.49/hr. These amounts reflect the range of base salary that the Institute reasonably would expect to pay a new hire or internal candidate for this position. The actual base compensation paid to any individual for this position may vary depending on factors such as experience, market conditions, education/training, skill level, and whether the compensation is internally equitable, and does not include bonuses, commissions, differential pay, other forms of compensation, or benefits. This position is also eligible to receive an annual discretionary bonus, with the amount dependent on individual and institute performance factors.

In addition to the Base Salary and Annual Bonus above, you will be eligible to participate in the Institute’s Compound Cash Grant Program (the “CCGP”). The CCGP is a program designed to offer multi-year cash grants providing for a fixed dollar amount paid out in semi-annual installments to reward employees for staying and contributing to the Institute. As soon as reasonably practical after your start date, you will receive a grant letter describing the terms of your award under the CCGP.

jobs.title: Lead Data Consultant (Microsoft Fabric)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Trility Consulting®, we’ve built a strong, remote-work culture where people thrive, grow, and support each other – earning us Great Place to Work® Certification. Headquartered in Central Iowa, we embrace flexible schedules and collaboration across geographically distributed teams serving clients from all corners of the United States and globally.

We seek team members with the grit necessary to forge paths where none previously existed, to get back up when circumstances knock them down, to adapt to the changing needs of the client even when it is uncomfortable, and to deliver on our commitments. Candidates must respect and value people, recognize that over-communication is barely good enough, thrive on solving complex problems, have a passion for building teams, and know that delivering what a client actually values is more important than their own predispositions. They understand value proposition, love delivering value, and take pride in learning the expansive and ever-changing business of clients. Candidates are self-motivated and relentlessly working to become more today than they were yesterday.


What You Will Do & The Experience You Will Need
Trility Consulting is seeking an experienced Senior Data Consultant to support a client engagement focused on modernizing an existing Azure Synapse data platform and migrating prioritized workloads to Microsoft Fabric.
In this role, you'll partner with Trility consultants and client engineers to pressure-test and refine the Fabric architecture, build reusable, metadata-driven ingestion frameworks, and migrate data workloads into a modern lakehouse environment. You'll develop scalable data pipelines, implement validation processes to ensure migration accuracy, and establish automated CI/CD workflows that support reliable deployment from development through production.
This engagement follows Trility's collaborative Coach-and-Contribute delivery model. You'll work hands-on alongside client engineers, contribute to architectural decisions, and help establish repeatable patterns that enable the team to maintain and extend the platform independently. Experience using Claude Code as part of an AI-assisted development workflow is essential to this engagement.
This is a remote W2 or 1099 position. 
At this time, Trility is only able to hire W2 employees who reside in the following states: Alabama, Colorado, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, North Carolina, Ohio, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Wisconsin.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager (Clinical Workflows)
jobs.description:
Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to help us accomplish our mission to improve lives by learning from the experience of every cancer patient. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?

What You'll Do

The successful candidate will help the Flatiron HC (Healthcare) Product Management team to drive the evolution of our oncology workflow products that clinicians rely on every day to deliver safe and efficient cancer care. This is a unique opportunity to join a mission-driven company and make a meaningful impact on cancer care and research.

You will own the end to end strategic direction, roadmap, and development lifecycle across 3 teams supporting core clinical workflows across Flatiron’s industry leading oncology point of care solutions. The successful candidate has led teams of multiple Product Managers and will work closely with a cross-functional team of Software Engineers, Product Designers, Clinicians, and Data Scientists to build a vision, strategy and roadmap for their teams. Flatiron’s HC Product teams are deeply cross-functional given their focus on creating end to end solutions clinicians rely on every day to deliver safe and efficient cancer care —from diagnosis and staging through treatment planning, ordering, and delivery.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Owning the vision, roadmap, ROI, and investment allocations for your teams’ product ownership areas. Partner closely with your Product Managers who refine and execute product strategy across their scrum teams to deliver high impact solutions. Partner closely with the Head of Product to ensure portfolio-level product strategy is in alignment with broader Business Unit product strategy.

• Acting as both a player and a coach. You may own the product lifecycle for user-facing applications supporting clinical oncology workflows from concept through launch and iteration, involving complex, cross-team projects. You will also coach your team through this process, as they lead the design, development, and rollout of data-driven products that streamline clinical operations, and reinforce safe, high-quality care delivery.

• Evaluating, prototyping, and delivering new capabilities - Integrating AI into intelligent workflows to reduce cognitive burden and improve clinical efficiency, and establishing platform level capabilities that allow us to do this efficiently at scale.

• Leading your team in translating complex clinical context, technical constraints, and business goals into clear product requirements, making strategic tradeoffs at the portfolio level to deliver safe and delightful solutions. This may involve staffing decisions, budget considerations, and complex scenario planning.

• Acting as a subject matter expert on our roadmap and presenting to senior leadership at external customer partners. Effectively communicating your product vision, strategy, and roadmap to diverse stakeholders including internal teams, external customers, vendor partners.

• Establishing clear KPIs for clinical workflow efficiency, usability, and product adoption, holding your cross-functional organization accountable to measurable patient and business outcomes.

• Grow and develop your team of Product Managers through thoughtful coaching and management strategies, and contribute to broader product team culture and craft.

Who You Are

You're a product leader with 7+ years of experience with a track record of shipping products that users love, and have led complex, ambiguous projects end-to-end. You're excited by the prospect of rolling up your sleeves to tackle meaningful problems each and every day, while managing a team of stellar product managers. You’re a kind, passionate and collaborative problem-solver who seeks and gives candid feedback, and values the chance to make an important impact.

• You have a Bachelors or Masters degree in a business management or technology field or equivalent practical experience

• You have 7+ years of proven product management experience: independently scoping requirements, translating end-to-end user journeys into technical backlogs, and leading cross-functional teams from concept to launch.

• You are a proven team leader, with 3+ years of people management experience, who delegates, aligns, and holds team members accountable for results in a highly dynamic and fast-paced environment

• You are a proactive problem solver who thrives in ambiguity, bringing structure and clarity to unstructured, rapidly evolving challenges for both your team and stakeholders.

• You have strong project and financial management skills and can move fluidly between technical capabilities, partner needs, user experience, and the ability to go deep into the details.

• You have experience collaborating cross-functionally, such as with technical experts, clinicians, operations, and regulatory professionals

• You have a customer-centric B2B/Enterprise mindset with strong attention to detail and exceptional communication skills, capable of deeply understanding customer needs and translating them into clear product strategy.

• You have rigorous organizational, analytical and prioritization skills, with the ability to interpret data insights, navigate tradeoffs, and manage execution across competing priorities with high autonomy.

• You have strong technical curiosity and aptitude for AI/ML capabilities, with the drive to evaluate, scope, and identify where AI can solve complex data and workflow challenges.

Extra credit

• You have experience working in healthcare technology, clinical workflows, or directly with clinical users and stakeholders

• You have experience identifying, scoping, or shipping AI/ML capabilities within complex SaaS products.

• You have experience working in highly regulated or compliance-driven environments

Where You’ll Work

In this hybrid role, you’ll have a defined work location that includes work from home and 3 office days set by you and your team. For more information on our approach to hybrid work, please visit the how we work website.

Life at Flatiron

At Flatiron Health, we offer a full range of benefits to support you and your loved ones so you can focus your working hours on improving cancer care and accelerating cancer research, and your non-working hours on everything else life has to offer:

• Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive compensation package

• 401(k) contribution to help you reach your retirement planning goals

• Financial health resources including 1:1 financial advice

• Mental well-being tools and services

• Parental benefits and policies including family-building care and generous leave

• Path to parenthood programs supporting fertility, adoption and surrogacy

• Travel support for safe healthcare services

• Lifestyle spending account for perks that make sense for you and your family

In addition to our robust benefit offerings, visit our Life at Flatiron page to learn how we support continuous learning and celebrate inclusion and belonging in the workplace.

jobs.title: Country Growth Operations Lead
jobs.location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We’re hiring a Country Growth Operations Lead to drive growth in one of our early-stage West African markets. Based in-country, you’ll own the plan to take the market from launch to 1 million monthly active users. That means leading user acquisition and growth operations, and building and managing the agent network, including agent liquidity, that keeps the service running for customers.

In this role, you'll;

• Drive user growth by optimizing distribution strategies and leading user acquisition initiatives.

• Collaborate with leadership and country teams to ensure alignment and maximize growth opportunities.

• Enhance distribution processes through partnership with product and engineering teams, leveraging technology and data.

• Oversee agent network operations, including acquisition, setup, and liquidity management, to support distribution and meet user demand.

• Build and lead high-performing teams, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

• Manage business and financial KPIs in alignment with overall business objectives.

• Champion Wave's values, leading by example and embedding them within the team culture.

Key Details

• Location: At one of our early-stage countries in Africa, with a focus on West Africa. You must be willing to relocate to the primary growth country for up to one year, with periodic returns home after each trimester.

• Travel: Anticipated travel requirements of 60-80% within a designated, growth-focused market.

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.

• We support working parents - we offer 26 weeks of parental leave for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers, in addition to subsidized child care when they return to work.

• Airtime reimbursement.

Requirements

• 8+ years of senior leadership experience in user acquisition/agent operations and liquidity management within mobile money, finance, fintech, telecoms, or tech.

• Language: Bilingual proficiency is mandatory, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both English and French.

• Enhanced interpersonal skills in building and maintaining positive relationships, effective communication, active listening, and conflict resolution.

• Proven sales ability with a successful track record in sales, including identifying customer needs and connecting corridors.

You might be a good fit if you

jobs.description:

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. jobs.description:

jobs.title: Spatial Interior Designer (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SPATIAL INTERIOR DESIGNER (STARLINK)

As a designer on the Starlink team in Bastrop, you will shape the physical spaces of the fastest-growing offices and factories at SpaceX. You will design our offices, factories, campus, and Starlink retail environments. From wayfinding and signage that make advanced factories easy to navigate, to interiors that make our offices places people are proud to work, you will bring the Starlink brand and culture into every space on site. You will work closely with artists, architects, and construction teams to give the campus a distinct identity and support Starlink's growing campus and retail footprint, taking projects from first sketch through construction and installation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design the physical experience of Starlink's retail presence and customer-facing solutions, including endcaps, product displays, and brand elements on a global scale

• Design offices, lobbies, conference rooms, break areas, outdoor spaces, and common areas

• Develop wayfinding and signage systems for the Bastrop manufacturing campus, including building identification, directional graphics, tour experiences, and digital displays

• Build and maintain signage and environmental graphics standards that facilities and operations teams can execute consistently

• Create environmental graphics and art, including murals, wall art, and large-scale graphics

• Develop retail standards and a scalable kit of parts for new retail locations

• Produce mood boards, renderings, drawings, and specification packages for interior and graphics projects

• Produce print and dimensional graphics for physical spaces, including posters, event collateral, dimensional lettering, exhibits, and displays

• Partner with architects, general contractors, fabricators, sign vendors, and internal facilities, construction, operations, retail, and brand teams to deliver work on time and on budget

• Manage multiple concurrent projects, from quick-turn graphics to large buildouts

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in interior design, architecture, graphic design, environmental design, industrial design, or a other design field

• Professional experience in interior design, environmental graphic design, retail design, or exhibit design

• Experience with Adobe Creative Suite and design tools such as, Rhino, Revit, AutoCAD, Blender

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Strong understanding of materials, finishes, fabrication methods, lighting, and furniture specification

• Exceptional eye for typography, color, composition, and detail

• Experience in environmental graphic design, wayfinding, or signage design

• Experience designing retail stores, exhibits, or branded environments

• Experience commissioning or managing art, murals, or public art projects

• Ability to produce construction drawings and specifications that contractors and fabricators can build from

• Rendering experience in Blender , Enscape, V-Ray, or similar

• Experience building design standards or systems that other teams execute

• Hands-on fabrication skills or experience managing fabricators and sign shops

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present concepts to leadership and cross-functional teams

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and drive projects from concept to completion

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Portfolio demonstrating built work in both interior/spatial design and graphic design. Applications submitted without a portfolio will not be considered

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.description:
At NerdWallet, we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you thrive best. We invest in your well-being, development, and ability to make an impact because when one Nerd levels up, we all do.

The Consumer Banking org is responsible for owning the web shopping experiences for two of NerdWallet's largest and most mission-critical verticals. Our mission is to create best-in-class, data-driven financial marketplace experiences that help millions of users make smarter financial decisions. We build fast, intuitive, and highly optimized experiences that rank, perform, and scale, all while collaborating with business stakeholders, Paid Marketers and SEO strategists to drive measurable business impact. We use data to drive our decision making, running fast product-led experiments that deliver real business value, as well as contribute directly to the company’s strategic roadmap.

If you thrive on high-impact work, solving technical challenges, and shaping the future of financial shopping experiences on the web, this is the place for you.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a strong sense of product to join our team. You'll work across the stack, but your primary focus will be delivering modern, high-performance user experiences that balance speed, usability, and search visibility. You embrace AI development tools as part of your everyday workflow, using them to move faster without sacrificing quality.

You'll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to build scalable, engaging shopping flows, while also contributing to performance, observability, accessibility, and technical excellence. This is a hands-on engineering role, ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has a strong product mindset, and is motivated by seeing their work used by millions of users.




WHERE YOU CAN MAKE AN IMPACT:

 - Build, maintain, and evolve React/Next.js front-end applications that serve millions of monthly users.

 - Improve Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and technical SEO to drive discoverability and engagement.

 - Partner with product, SEO, and content teams to launch, test, and iterate on high-impact shopping experiences.

 - Design and implement backend APIs and services that power dynamic, personalized content, rapid experimentation and partner integrations.

 - Collaborate on platform-wide initiatives: performance, observability, A/B testing infrastructure, and front-end developer experience.

 - Contribute to shared UI components and design systems, helping scale high-quality UX across pages.

 - Use AI coding tools and spec-driven workflows as part of your day-to-day, contributing to the team's growing dev harness and automations.

 - Participate in code reviews, mentorship, and team technical discussions to help raise the engineering bar.

 - 6+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful contributions across both front-end and back-end systems.

 - Deep experience in TypeScript, React.js, and Next.js or a related isomorphic framework (Astro, Gatsby, etc.).

 - Strong product and UX sensibility with a keen eye for performance, usability, and responsive design.

 - Hands-on experience building and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs, integrating with databases (SQL/NoSQL), and writing full-stack features.

 - Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (e.g. Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) as part of your regular development workflow.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Background in FinTech, financial services, or other regulated industries.

 - Hands-on experience with web vitals, lazy loading, caching strategies, or third-party analytics tools.

 - A technical blog, open-source contributions, or portfolio site showcasing your work.




WHERE:

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.

The opportunity

TechnologyAdvice is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who can turn hiring needs into strong candidate pipelines and successful hires. You’ll recruit across business functions, partner directly with hiring managers, and take ownership of moving your searches forward.

This role is a good fit if you enjoy finding candidates who aren’t actively applying, learning what a team needs, and changing your approach when a search stalls. You’ll have support from the recruiting team, with the expectation that you bring recommendations and take action without waiting for someone to outline every next step.

Experience recruiting B2B sales professionals is especially valuable for this role.

Location: United States

What you'll do

• Own multiple searches from the hiring-manager intake through offer acceptance and the handoff to onboarding.

• Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, define what success looks like in each role, and agree on interview criteria and timelines.

• Build a sourcing plan for each opening and actively engage qualified candidates through LinkedIn, direct outreach, referrals, and relevant professional communities.

• Write personalized outreach that gives candidates a clear reason to consider TechnologyAdvice, and maintain relationships with promising candidates for future openings.

• Conduct structured phone and video screens, assess evidence against role requirements, and share clear recommendations with hiring managers.

• Keep interviews and assessments moving, follow up on feedback, and address delays before they put a candidate or hiring timeline at risk.

• Maintain accurate candidate records and next steps in Greenhouse, and provide useful updates on pipeline health, sourcing results, and blockers.

• Use recruiting data and hiring-manager feedback to adjust the search when the current approach is not producing qualified candidates.

• Guide candidates through the process with clear expectations and timely communication, including offer discussions and closing.

• Use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work such as outreach drafting, scheduling reminders, and reporting, while reviewing outputs and applying your own judgment to candidate assessments.

• Work with the recruiting team, HR, and hiring managers to improve workflows and make the transition from accepted offer to onboarding smooth.

Who you are

• At least two years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including in-house corporate recruitment and direct partnership with hiring managers.

• Experience recruiting professional roles across business functions, with the ability to adapt sourcing and screening approaches to different searches.

• A track record of finding and engaging passive candidates through personalized outreach, Boolean searches, and LinkedIn or similar tools.

• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, identify which searches need attention, and maintain momentum across multiple openings.

• Clear communication with candidates and hiring managers, including asking useful questions and providing specific recommendations supported by evidence.

• A proactive approach to difficult searches, consistent follow-through on commitments, and the ability to raise problems early with a proposed next step.

• Experience using an ATS to manage candidate pipelines and recruiting data; Greenhouse experience preferred.

• Proficiency with tools such as Google Workspace and Slack, with a willingness to learn AI and automation tools that improve recruiting workflows.

What success looks like

• Your searches have clear plans and active pipelines built through consistent, targeted sourcing.

• Qualified candidates move through the process promptly, with clear next steps and useful hiring-manager feedback.

• Hiring managers can rely on your updates and recommendations, and candidates receive a thoughtful, well-organized experience.

What we offer you

• Career Growth: Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives.

• Flex Fridays: Adjust your 40-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays.

• Remote-First Culture: Work from the comfort of your home.

• Flexible PTO: Take the time you need, when you need it.

• Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family.

• Insurance Protection: Life, AD&D, Short-Term, and Long-Term Disability coverage.

• 401K with Match: Secure your future with our company-matched retirement savings.

• Paid Parental Leave: Support for new parents during life’s special moments.

• Wellness Perks: Access Headspace and enjoy monthly fitness reimbursements.

• Pet Insurance: Care for your furry family members.

• Speaker Series Bonus: Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus.

• Book Reimbursement: Get up to 12 books reimbursed per year to fuel your learning.

• Bucket List Benefit: Celebrate milestones with annual contributions toward your dream adventures after 3 years.

• In-Office Perks: Enjoy catered lunches for our in-office team.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
The big picture: Axios is a respected media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format known as Smart Brevity™. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI security experience to lead our defensive posture, drive threat modeling and vulnerability management, and embed security controls - including AI-driven defense and monitoring - across our platform and automation pipelines.

Why it matters: As a Senior Security Engineer at Axios, you will architect and implement proactive security strategies to protect our audience, platform, and data assets against evolving threat vectors, including AI-driven attacks. In this role, you will define our security roadmap, leverage internal and third-party AI defense tools, and ensure our cloud systems remain resilient, secure by default, and capable of automated threat detection and response.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the architectural design and implementation of security controls across cloud infrastructure, platform services, and AI integrations.

• Drive vulnerability management, threat modeling, incident response, and proactive security assessments across AWS, Kubernetes, and AI application environments.

• Shape, maintain, and execute the company’s long-term security roadmap in close alignment with engineering and executive leadership.

• Embed automated security testing, SAST/DAST, and AI-driven compliance checks directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code workflows.

• Oversee identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption protocols, and zero-trust architecture standards.

• Evaluate, deploy, and maintain internal AI security tools and modern third-party defensive solutions to detect, mitigate, and respond to AI-driven threats and sophisticated attack vectors in real time.

• Promote a strong security culture across engineering by conducting threat modeling workshops and coaching teams on secure coding and infrastructure practices.

• Partner with product, infrastructure, data, and QE teams to ensure security is integrated seamlessly into every stage of the development lifecycle.

Skills:

• Deep expertise in cloud and application security, including threat modeling, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, IAM, secrets management, AI security, and compliance frameworks.

• Strong working knowledge of AWS infrastructure and security controls (IAM, KMS, EKS, RDS, S3).

• Experience hardening Kubernetes clusters, runtime security, container scanning, and network policy enforcement.

• Proficiency in integrating SAST/DAST and security automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).

• Solid scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, or Bash for security tooling and automated remediation.

• Hands-on experience with SIEM, security logging, automated threat intelligence, and AI-powered monitoring frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or modern SOC tooling).

• Demonstrated leadership in driving security initiatives, defining policy, and guiding engineering teams on security risk.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively balance security requirements and business agility.

What success looks like:

• Security & Compliance: Focused on proactive security initiatives, including automated vulnerability scans, implementation of controls, remediation, and contributions to the long-term security roadmap.

• Cloud Security Architecture: Hardened, reviewed, and optimized AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure security to meet strict compliance, resilience, and least-privilege access standards.

• DevSecOps & Automation: Integrated automated security scans, secret detection, and vulnerability gates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines without disrupting developer velocity.

• Security Tooling Adoption: Evaluated, piloted, and deployed advanced security and defensive AI tools that measurably enhanced threat detection speed and reduced exposure risk.

• Threat Detection & Response: Established robust security monitoring, SIEM alerting, and incident response playbooks to maintain real-time visibility and rapid response capabilities across all production platforms.

• Cross-Functional Security Leadership: Partnered with engineering, product, and QE teams to instill a security-first culture, conduct threat modeling workshops, and guide technical teams on risk mitigation.

• AI Defense & Security: Evaluated and deployed internal AI security tools and 3rd-party defensive solutions to proactively safeguard infrastructure, applications, and corporate assets against AI-driven threats and emerging attack vectors.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $150,000 - $180,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

• Access to the Axios Employee Support Fund, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies

• Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers

jobs.description:
Job Title: Specialty Pharmacy Technician

About Us

At West Cancer Center, we are dedicated to providing compassionate, patient-centered care while advancing groundbreaking research. Our team fosters collaboration, innovation, and professional growth, ensuring that every role contributes to making a difference in patients’ lives. Join us in our mission to provide comprehensive support to those navigating the challenges of cancer treatment.

Position Overview

The Specialty Pharmacy Technician works alongside pharmacists to ensure medications are safe, effective, and accurately prepared for patients. This role involves locating, dispensing, packing, and labeling prescribed medications, which are then reviewed by a pharmacist prior to dispensing. In addition to direct pharmacy support, the technician may assist with administrative tasks such as processing insurance claims, maintaining inventory, filing paperwork, and delivering excellent customer service. This position requires reliability, strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and proficiency with computers in a fast-paced healthcare setting.

Key Responsibilities

• Receive and check the validity of prescriptions.

• Process prescriptions electronically, ensuring accuracy and completeness of information.

• Locate, select, and measure appropriate medications and dosages.

• Maintain prescription records and file physician orders accurately.

• Sort, stock, and monitor pharmacy inventory.

• Answer patient and healthcare provider inquiries, referring complex issues to the pharmacist.

• Research and resolve claims issues while providing timely, accurate customer service.

• Comply with safety and regulatory requirements, maintaining a clean and safe pharmacy environment.

• Resolve issues such as rejected insurance claims.

• Provide courteous and prompt customer service by phone.

• Triage and prioritize requests effectively.

• Check medication expiration dates regularly.

• Attend staff meetings as scheduled.

• Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Required: High school diploma or equivalent.

• Required: 2–3 years of retail pharmacy experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Required: PTCB certification (or equivalent) and TN State Board of Pharmacy Registration.

Skills & Abilities

• Excellent organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency in computers, scanners, and pharmacy applications.

• Strong knowledge of medications, dosage measurement, pharmacy law, and medical terminology.

• Ability to perform basic math operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division).

• Strong attention to detail, reliability, and ability to work independently.

• Capacity to analyze situations, respond quickly, and work effectively in a team setting.

• Commitment to patient confidentiality, professionalism, and maintaining effective workplace relationships.

Why West Cancer Center is a Great Place to Work

• Meaningful Impact: Play a direct role in supporting patients through one of the most challenging times of their lives.

• Collaborative Culture: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of dedicated professionals committed to improving cancer care.

• Professional Development: Benefit from ongoing training, educational resources, and growth opportunities.

• Mission-Driven Environment: Be part of an organization guided by compassion, integrity, and innovation.

No nights, weekends, or holidays. Comprehensive benefits package.

Join Us

Take the next step in your career and become part of a team that is making a real difference. If you’re passionate about pharmacy care, patient support, and contributing to life-changing cancer treatment, apply now to join West Cancer Center as a Specialty Pharmacy Technician.

jobs.title: Senior Manager,  Success Advisor (Fintech)
jobs.description:
Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We also offer:

• A generous benefits program that supports the whole you with medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and 401(k)

• Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it paid time off

• Monthly tech reimbursements

• A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from

• Equity in a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier VCs

Role Overview

As a Senior Manager, Success Advisor, you are an experienced, commercially minded leader responsible for developing high-performing managers and team leads while driving exceptional customer experiences and measurable business outcomes. You oversee the execution of customer success initiatives, establish clear performance expectations, and create a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and professional growth.

You translate departmental priorities into actionable operating plans, using customer insights and cross-functional collaboration to improve engagement, product adoption, retention, and customer lifetime value. You leverage data analytics, AI, and innovative approaches to scale operations, improve team productivity, and drive measurable business results.

You bring a strong understanding of financial technology (fintech), payments, and financing solutions, enabling your teams to effectively position financial products that support the long-term success of small-business Pros. You balance commercial performance with responsible product recommendations, customer trust, and compliance expectations while partnering cross-functionally to improve financial product adoption and retention.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our service professionals (our Pros). Their success is our success.

• Translate departmental priorities into quarterly operating plans, weekly performance rhythms, and measurable team goals that support customer success and business objectives

• Scale team operations through effective hiring, onboarding, ramp programs, capacity planning, and standardized playbooks that support sustainable growth and high performance

Qualifications

• 4+ years of people management experience, including experience leading managers or team leads

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent work experience (MBA preferred)

• Demonstrated experience scaling customer-facing teams through hiring, onboarding, capacity planning, and performance management

• Proven track record of improving customer engagement, product adoption, retention, and measurable business outcomes

• Experience using customer relationship management (CRM), business intelligence, and analytics platforms (Salesforce, Snowflake, Omni) to monitor funnel performance, conversion, and adoption

• Proven experience driving team efficiency or output quality through the strategic use of AI tools and automation

• Experience in fintech, payments, financing, or financial product sales, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment serving SMBs

• Working knowledge of financial product disclosures, risk management practices, and applicable regulatory compliance requirements

What will help you succeed in this role

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex performance data into clear actions and measurable results

• Exceptional communication, coaching, and leadership skills with a passion for developing the next generation of leaders

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple organizational levels

• Strong commercial judgment with the ability to balance financial product adoption and revenue goals with responsible selling practices and long-term Pro success

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Healthcare is complex. We’re here to change that.

RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone.

Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other.

AT A GLANCE

As a Data Analyst for Optum Perks, you won’t be a ticket-taker waiting for sanitized specs or maintaining legacy dashboards. You will be an embedded analytical partner driving end-to-end strategic problem-solving within a high-growth, fast-evolving business unit. You’ll be surrounded by a high-performing team of data practitioners and cross-functional leaders, providing an environment rich with mentorship, technical challenge, and clear runway for long-term professional growth.

We believe the best analysts are entrepreneurial: you are given the strategic opportunity (the "what") and empowered with the autonomy to design, build, and execute the solution (the "how").

This role spans the entire analytical lifecycle. On one end, you will establish and maintain durable single-source-of-truth reporting suites, automate routine workflows, and engineer resilient data models (dbt/semantic layers). On the other, you’ll tackle high-leverage strategic problems—designing and implementing decision engines, evaluating on-site testing and experiments, unpacking complex customer unit economics (like LTV, retention, and churn), and optimizing commercial growth strategies.

Sitting directly between technical engineering and executive business leadership, you will instrument tracking upstream, leverage AI tooling to accelerate delivery, and turn complex behavioral data into actionable operational and product strategy.

Where You'll Be

Location: Charlotte Metro Area (Fort Mill, SC) | Hybrid

We believe great collaboration happens when we're together, solving problems, learning from each other, and connecting as a team. That's why we’re in our offices Tuesday through Thursday each week. You are welcome to work remotely Mondays and Fridays if you wish.

Office address: 1101 Red Ventures Dr Fort Mill, SC 29707

What You’ll Do

• Project Ownership & Autonomy: Lead end-to-end analytical projects: autonomously conduct requirement gathering with cross-functional stakeholders, define project milestones, and translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical roadmaps.

• Analytics & Context Engineering: Design, model, and maintain scalable datasets and semantic layers (e.g., via dbt, SQL) to establish trusted "single source of truth" tables for sustained reporting and agentic workflows.

• Ambiguity & Decision-Making: Navigate incomplete or messy datasets with strong critical thinking, forming grounded assumptions and delivering clear, actionable recommendations to business partners.

• Modern Tooling & AI: Leverage modern analytics tooling and AI coding assistants to accelerate development workflows, maintaining rigorous oversight, validation, and testing of all outputs.

• Stakeholder Partnership: Interface upstream with data/software engineers to communicate tracking and infrastructure requirements, and communicate downstream with business leaders to translate findings into executive-level narratives and actionable business steps.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., data science, statistics, computer science) or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience in data analysis, modeling, visualization, and reporting.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Omnichannel Analytics
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, US Commercial Analytics, the Associate Director, Omnichannel Analytics will own the measurement strategy and optimization agenda for how Revolution Medicines engages healthcare professionals across channels. As RevMed scales from a single approved medicine to a multi-brand portfolio spanning pancreatic and lung cancers, customer engagement is increasingly orchestrated across field, email, media, web, and other channels, and the analytical logic connecting those channels to commercial outcomes needs a dedicated owner.

This is a rare opportunity to define and build an omnichannel measurement capability during live launches. You will build the KPI frameworks, trigger and journey effectiveness methods, and experimentation agenda that determine how, when, and through which channel RevMed reaches its customers, and you will present those recommendations directly to Brand, Marketing, and Commercial leadership.

This role is ideal for a hands-on analytics leader who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and is passionate about using data to drive meaningful impact. This position is based out of our headquarters in Redwood City, CA.

Responsibilities

• Omnichannel measurement strategy. Own and evolve the omnichannel and non-personal promotion (NPP) measurement roadmap across the portfolio, including measurement frameworks, KPI definitions, and standardized performance readouts aligned to brand and marketing decision cycles.

• KPI frameworks and governance. Define journey progression, channel contribution, reach/frequency, and customer-experience measures; ensure definitions are governed, documented, and consistently applied across brands, channels, and dashboards.

• Journey and trigger effectiveness. Own the analytical evaluation of trigger logic - eligibility, suppression, lookback windows, signal volume, and downstream field or digital action - and recommend changes to journey design based on relevance, timeliness, and measured impact.

• Experimentation and test-and-learn. Build and run the portfolio experimentation agenda, including holdouts, frequency tests, and audience and content experiments; translate results into channel mix, cadence, and content recommendations.

• Cross-channel measurement. Provide an integrated view of the HCP journey across field, email, paid media, web, and peer channels, identifying over-, under-, and mis-sequenced engagement.

• Optimization and decision support. Serve as the subject-matter expert advising senior Commercial and Marketing leaders on performance interpretation and optimization opportunities; lead recurring omnichannel performance and optimization reviews.

• Cross-brand learning. Maintain a reusable learning repository so insights from the first launch inform subsequent launches.

• Partner management. Direct agency, publisher, and vendor analytics deliverables against defined scope, metric definitions, taxonomy, data feeds, and quality standards.

• Collaboration. Effectively partner with Brand Analytics, Advanced Analytics, Information Systems, and the Omnichannel portfolio and Marketing Teams

The government’s demand for AI is growing far faster than the systems required to support it. Fewer than 15% of federal AI programs have reached sustained production, despite billions of dollars invested. The models perform in testing, but they degrade in the real world. And when performance drops, trust goes with it.

Striveworks was built to solve that problem.

What you’ll build

Since 2018, we have delivered the most trusted AI systems operating in real-world use cases—providing a layer of assurance underneath hundreds of deployed models that monitors performance, manages drift, and sustains systems long after they leave the lab.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer–Field Engagement at Striveworks, you’ll work directly with our customers during trials and early deployments of Chariot, our AI product suite spanning Chariot Core (our AIOps platform), Forge (our agentic harness), and vertical solutions. You’ll own the technical journey from first log in to real value—building the integrations, pipelines, and configurations that help customers solve meaningful problems with Chariot. You’ll carry that technical context from pilot through post-sale, helping ensure that successful evaluations turn into lasting adoption.

Between customer engagements, you’ll have the freedom to invest in high-value work shaped by what you’ve learned in the field: polishing rough edges in the product, contributing to platform improvements, building better onboarding and technical resources, and writing technical blogs and papers about new and exciting applications of our products or research with them.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Security
jobs.description:
ABOUT KEYCARD

At Keycard, we're building identity and access infrastructure for the agent-native era, where software isn't static but a dynamic, constantly changing system of AI agents working on behalf of people and businesses. Keycard gives every agent a verified identity and issues short-lived, task-scoped credentials at runtime, so agents can only do what they were asked to do, and every action is fully auditable. We're backed by a16z, Boldstart, and Acrew, and our founding team built and scaled Snyk, Auth0, HashiCorp, and Heroku.


THE ROLE

We're hiring a staff-level Software Engineer, Security. This is a software engineering job: you'll write, review, and maintain production code in our token service, policy engine, and gateway. You'd be the first engineer whose whole job is security, working with engineers who already know the field. A full-time security seat matters because security is what we sell: a hole in our token exchange or policy checks hands a customer's agent access nobody granted. You find those holes first and fix them with the team.

Keycard is a control plane for agents: identity, credential exchange, delegation, policy, and audit. It has to hold even when the agent itself is compromised. Agents are part of how we build, and part of how you'll do this job.

You'll also secure Keycard itself: our cloud accounts, the cells we run in customers' accounts, our pipeline, and secrets. You set the controls and lead security response. Platform engineering runs the infrastructure; operations handles audits and customer reviews. When the two jobs compete, product security wins.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


SECURE THE PRODUCT

 - Threat modeling. Trace how an agent gets access, from token exchange through delegation to the per-tool check at our MCP gateway, then attack it: confused deputies, poisoned tool descriptions, prompt injection, issuer and audience mix-ups, token passthrough. Credentials shouldn't leak between hops, and delegated access should end when it expires or is revoked.

 - Assume compromise. Even a compromised agent should be stopped from escalating privileges or crossing tenants. Document what it can still do with its access.

 - Design review. Review designs and code across the token service, Cedar policy engine, MCP gateway, CLI, SDKs, and Console, mostly for who can do what and whether zones stay isolated.

 - Attack with agents. Run scoped agents against an isolated instance and chase the authorization failures they find. Confirmed failures become CI regressions for token exchange, impersonation, or per-tool policy. Example: a harness that follows a delegated credential end to end and checks it never gains scope or lifetime.

 - Customer reviews. Be the technical voice when customers' security teams review or pentest us; operations runs the process.


SECURE KEYCARD

 - Cloud guardrails. Set the rules for our cloud accounts, pipeline, and customer-hosted cells, down to cell isolation and audited break-glass access. Platform engineering builds them.

 - Our own credentials. Keep them short-lived and narrow. Design service identity and PKI, sign what we ship to customers, and manage dependency risk. You also use Keycard to scope what our own agents can reach.

 - Incident response. Investigate vulnerabilities and security events, coordinate fixes, and improve detection. You'll also work out with engineering how on-call works for security.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You've shipped and maintained production code, not only security tooling, and you've found and fixed vulnerabilities in applications or identity systems.

 - You can read unfamiliar code, build an exploit or reproduction, and ship the fix with a regression test.

 - You know OAuth 2.0 and 2.1, OIDC, and token exchange (RFC 8693), and can describe failures you've seen, like refresh-token misuse.

 - You can spot the problem in an IAM policy, a network path, or a cloud audit log, even if you've never run cloud infrastructure.

 - Good judgment about risk. You can explain an attack path, size it, and agree on a fix with the team.

 - Agents at work. You use agents for review, triage, or testing, and know how to check their output and limit their access.


STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE

 - Experience in identity infrastructure, developer tools, or multi-tenant SaaS.

 - Experience with DPoP, Cedar, or SPIFFE/SPIRE.

 - Hands-on AWS security: IAM, SCPs, logging, infrastructure as code.

 - Securing agents or MCP servers, including tool permissions and sandboxing.

 - A security tool you built that engineers adopted and that ended a class of bugs.

 - Public security work: CVEs, bug bounties, write-ups, or OAuth and MCP standards work.


YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

WHO WILL LOVE THIS JOB

WHAT WE OFFER

You’ll be given huge autonomy, the opportunity to gain mastery, and the chance to work in a team that holds each other accountable to succeed.

 - Truly Agent-Native Culture: At Keycard, we don’t just enable others to adopt agents — we use them ourselves to build. You’ll help shape an organization that embeds AI into its foundation as an enduring competitive advantage.

 - Compensation With Upside: Market-competitive salaries and generous equity packages (4-year vest, 1-year cliff) give you the security to focus on building — and the asymmetric upside of ownership in a company chasing a category-defining mission.

 - Comprehensive Benefits & Recharge: Health, dental, vision, and paramedical coverage for you and your family, plus 4 weeks vacation, 11 statutory holidays, and 1 volunteer day annually. We encourage at least 2 weeks off each year to fully recharge.

 - Tools That Keep You Ahead: A new MacBook Pro, a $500 stipend for peripherals, and the best AI tools available so you can work at the forefront of agent-native workflows.

 - Remote-First Flexibility: We are a remote-first team prioritizing asynchronous collaboration, with hiring focused in North and South America. Work where you’re strongest — we just want the best.

jobs.title: Staff Scientist - Quantum Applications (Defense)
jobs.description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Travel: 10% to customer sites

We are seeking two Staff Scientists – Quantum Applications (Defense) to be founding members of our newly established Customer Solutions team. As a Staff Scientist – Quantum Applications (Defense) you’ll be part of a cross-functional team to enable customers to solve the world’s most complex problems using the world’s best quantum computers.

You will work closely with customers across academia, enterprise, government and national labs to create quantum solutions that are tailored to the missions of the defense sector. As a technical leader, you will originate and deliver on new and surprising quantum applications, serving as a role model and go-to expert for a wide range of stakeholders. This is a hands-on, externally-facing position that puts the customer first. Classical and quantum coding evaluations will be a part of the interview process. US persons only.

Responsibilities:

• Develop impactful hybrid quantum applications that accelerate the adoption of quantum computing for defense-related missions. Partner directly with clients to identify, define, and solve problems using IonQ trapped-ion quantum computers.

Requirements:
