 - Own and lead high-priority cross-functional initiatives, from new product bets to operational improvements

 - Act as the connective layer between teams so priorities, timelines, and outcomes stay aligned

 - Write executive briefings, internal communications, and decision memos that make complex topics clear

 - Spot gaps, risks, and opportunities early, and drive solutions before they escalate

 - Strengthen the operating cadence (OKRs, metrics, exec meetings, planning) so the company scales well

 - Represent the CEO in meetings when appropriate, and follow through so decisions turn into action


WHO YOU ARE

 - Deep familiarity with investor processes, including financial modeling, data room construction, and fundraising support

 - Track record of leading change management in fast-growing organizations

 - Strategic thinker who turns vision into structure, execution, and results

 - Exceptional writer and communicator who can synthesize complex ideas clearly

 - Highly organized and detail-oriented across multiple high-stakes workstreams

 - Uses data and metrics to drive decisions and measure impact

 - Has led or supported company-wide initiatives with multiple senior stakeholders

 - Known for anticipating needs and acting before issues escalate


HOW YOU SHOW UP

 - We are customer champions. You put users at the center of your thinking, advocate for their needs, and design solutions that make their lives measurably better.

 - We are bold in action. You move with urgency and courage, unafraid to challenge convention and take smart risks in pursuit of meaningful outcomes.

 - We are data-driven and insight guided. You make thoughtful decisions grounded in evidence, combining data with intuition to guide strategy and execution.

 - We are stronger together. You bring others along, value diverse perspectives, and contribute to a culture of trust and shared ownership.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums covered for you, 80% for family

 - HSA and FSA plans available

 - Unlimited vacation and 100% paid parental leave

 - Free lunches, onsite gym, and commuter benefits for in-office employees

 - $1,000 home office stipend and $5,000/year for continuing education

 - Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful equity

 - ~130 people, built from zero in under three years — small enough that your work is visible, big enough to already be running at Dell- and Tripadvisor-scale

jobs.title: Founding Brand & Communications Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT MESHY

Meshy is building the generative AI layer for 3D. Developers, creators, game studios, and enterprise teams use Meshy to turn ideas into production-ready 3D assets in minutes instead of weeks. We’re a Silicon Valley company with a global team, growing fast, and now at the point where the category we’re creating needs a name, a story, and a voice.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Today, Meshy is known as a very good AI 3D tool. That’s not enough. The next phase requires Meshy to be understood as a company with a defined category position, a long-term vision, and real cultural weight in AI and creative software.

You’ll be the person who answers these questions and then makes the whole company answer them the same way:

 - What does Meshy stand for in AI, 3D, and creative tools?

 - Why should developers, creators, game companies, and enterprise buyers care about Meshy now?

 - What is the single story that connects our product, our founders, our customers, the press, and our industry partners?

This is a founding brand role. You will write, not just direct.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Company positioning, brand architecture, core messaging, and the long-term narrative.

 - Translating hard technical capability in AI and 3D into stories that are clear, credible, and memorable.

 - One consistent voice across the website, product launches, funding announcements, founder talks, employer brand, customer stories, and sales collateral.

 - Executive narrative with the founders and leadership team: keynotes, interviews, points of view, and industry agenda-setting.

 - Major product launches and brand campaigns, from creative concept through to shipped content.

 - A reusable messaging framework that Growth, Sales, BD, PR, and Product all actually use.

 - Proof of industry impact through customer, creator, studio, and partner stories.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8–15 years in brand strategy, brand marketing, corporate narrative, product marketing, or editorial/content strategy.

 - You have led a repositioning, category creation, or brand rebuild at a technology company—as the owner of it, not a contributor to it.

 - A portfolio we can read: website narrative, brand manifesto, a major launch, a founder keynote, or an integrated campaign.

 - You can tell a technical story to developers, creators, enterprise buyers, press, and investors—and change the register for each.

 - Exceptional English writing and editing. You personally write the things that matter most.

 - Demonstrated cross-functional influence: you’ve gotten founders, Product, Design, Marketing, and Sales to adopt one narrative and stay on it.

 - Comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor in an early-stage environment.


BONUS POINTS

 - Background in generative AI, creative tools, developer tools, gaming, 3D, design software, or high-growth B2B SaaS.

 - You’ve built a brand for a product whose category didn’t fully exist yet, rather than maintaining an established one.

 - You hold both technical credibility and cultural resonance—developers trust you, and the work still has emotional pull.

 - Experience taking a global or China-founded technology company into the U.S. market.

 - Founder brand, thought leadership, or executive communications experience.


THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF

 - Your work is primarily PR and media relations without positioning work behind it.

 - Your background is in content marketing, SEO, social media, or community management.

 - You’re a visual creative director who owns design systems and art direction.

 - You come from consumer or lifestyle brands and haven’t worked on technical products.


SALARY

The base salary range for this position is $120,000 – $250,000 per year. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and skills. This role may also be eligible for additional compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.title: Senior SRM Quality Engineer - Energetics
jobs.description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Overview

The Senior SRM Quality Engineer – Energetics owns product and process quality for solid rocket motor propellant manufacturing: ammonium perchlorate (AP) milling, propellant mixing, casting, and cure. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role embedded with our Manufacturing, Engineering, and Development teams, with a primary mission of ensuring process control and product integrity from raw energetic materials through a cured, inspected motor.

This engineer will also build out our in-house radiographic NDT capability, working alongside a Level 3 NDT technician. That means optimizing our existing X-ray system in the near term, then standing up additional radiography systems as program needs grow, and using radiographic findings to drive improvements back into the propellant processes. While the role supports broader SRM quality (insulation, liners, composites, FOD control) and compliance efforts, energetics process quality and radiography are its core.

This role reports into the Quality organization and is fully integrated with the SRM energetics, product, and manufacturing teams. It works closely with the Level 3 NDT technician, the site Radiation Safety Officer, EHS and process safety, propellant engineering, and the SRM-focused supply chain engineer.

Core Responsibilities

Energetics Process Quality

Own the quality of propellant manufacturing processes in close partnership with our design and energetics engineers, who set product and process requirements. Quality's role is to ensure those requirements are validated and consistently met in production for:

• AP milling and particle size measurements/morphology: particle size distribution verification, mill parameter control, moisture control, lot traceability, and blend ratios of coarse/fine fractions.

• Mixing: raw material acceptance and lot control, ingredient weigh-up verification, mix sequence and parameter control (time, temperature, vacuum, shear), and in-process sampling and testing (e.g., viscosity, pot life, end-of-mix properties).

• Casting: vacuum casting parameter control, pot life management, void prevention, flow and fill verification, and witness/test specimen generation.

• Cure: cure cycle verification and monitoring against engineering-defined profiles, oven and temperature uniformity verification, data recording and review, and post-cure property testing (e.g., hardness, mechanical properties, density).

Within these processes, the engineer will:

• Work with design and energetics engineers to identify critical process parameters and key characteristics, then implement the sampling plans, inspections, and reaction plans that verify them.

• Validate that engineering-defined propellant and ingredient acceptance criteria, specifications, and lot release requirements are met, and flag requirements that are unclear or can't be verified.

• Apply SPC and data-driven methods to monitor batch-to-batch consistency and detect process drift early.

• Facilitate process FMEAs and control plans with engineering for new and changing energetics processes.

• Lead process qualification and validation with engineering, defining when an energetics process is qualified and frozen, and own change control for qualified processes.

• Own review and release of energetics batch records (weigh-ups, mix parameters, cure profiles) and ensure data integrity.

• Work closely with the SRM-focused supply chain engineer on energetic raw material quality, including incoming acceptance and lot-to-lot variability.

• Ensure test equipment and instrumentation supporting energetics processes (balances, thermocouples, rheometers, particle size analyzers, ovens) are calibrated and fit for use, and lead MSA / gage R&R on critical test methods (e.g., viscosity, particle size, mechanical properties, density).

• Embed quality requirements within energetics safety constraints, working closely with EHS and process safety teams.

Radiographic NDT: Optimize and Build Out

Own our radiography capability for SRM inspection, first optimizing the existing system and then standing up new systems as needed. Responsibilities are split as follows: the Level 3 NDT technician owns technique development, procedures, and personnel certification; the site Radiation Safety Officer owns radiation safety and licensing; and this engineer owns inspection requirements, acceptance criteria, capital projects, and integration with production.

• Optimize the existing system: Assess current X-ray equipment against SRM inspection needs (motor size, defect types such as voids, cracks, and bondline separations, and required sensitivity). Drive the improvement roadmap for technique, fixturing, and image quality, and lead capability demonstrations on representative defect standards, with the Level 3 owning technique development and procedure qualification. Increase throughput and reliability while the system remains in production use.

• Stand up new systems: Define requirements for additional radiography systems (e.g., larger-format motors, real-time radiography, or CT) as program needs grow. Lead equipment evaluation, facility layout, and installation, and recommend capital investments for new systems. Coordinate with the site Radiation Safety Officer, who owns radiation safety and licensing. Qualify each new system and bring it into production use, accounting for explosives safety and siting constraints when imaging loaded motors.

• Across all systems: Partner with design engineering as they define radiographic acceptance criteria for propellant grains, bondlines, and case/insulation interfaces, and validate inspections against them. Support the Level 3's NDT personnel qualification and certification program (e.g., NAS 410 / SNT-TC-1A written practice) and integrate it into the QMS. Integrate radiography records with dispositions and MRB. Close the loop between inspection and process: trace radiographic indications (voids, cracks, bondline separations) back to mix, cast, and cure parameters, and drive corrective action with engineering.

Broader SRM Quality

• Serve as the quality point of contact across SRM development and production campaigns.

• Support quality control for related SRM processes, including insulation, liner, and inhibitor application; composites layup and cure; and case preparation and bonding.

• Drive FOD prevention and cleanliness control in energetics and motor assembly areas.

• Establish and maintain in-process inspection criteria, checkpoints, and traveler sign-offs.

• Lead root cause analysis, rapid containment, and corrective action for nonconformances; support MRB dispositions.

• Exercise authority to stop processing, place lots on hold, and reject product that does not meet requirements, and serve as a quality member of MRB.

• Develop clear, usable quality documentation, including inspection plans, control plans, and work instructions.

• Train and coach production personnel in quality standards and best practices.

• Support internal and external audits and AS9100 compliance.

• Champion a culture of quality, ownership, and continuous improvement on the production floor.

• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).

• 5+ years in a manufacturing quality engineering or process engineering role, ideally in aerospace, defense, or energetic materials.

• Hands-on experience with energetic materials or comparable hazardous batch chemical processes (mixing, casting, curing, or particle size reduction).

• Strong working knowledge of process-based quality tools: process validation, control plans, PFMEA, SPC, MSA / gage R&R, and root cause analysis.

• Experience owning an inspection capability or capital project from requirements through production use.

• Experience with AS9100 and/or ISO 9001 quality standards.

• Demonstrated ability to operate hands-on in fast-paced, safety-critical environments.

• Strong communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to obtain an ATF employee possessor license.

Preferred

• Direct experience with composite solid propellant (e.g., AP/HTPB) manufacturing, including AP grinding or milling.

• Experience improving, expanding, or qualifying an NDT capability, particularly radiography or computed tomography (CT) of SRMs.

• Familiarity with radiographic NDT principles and image quality requirements, NAS 410 / SNT-TC-1A, and ASTM radiographic standards.

• Experience with propellant characterization methods (rheology, mechanical properties, burn rate, particle size analysis).

• Familiarity with DoD energetics and explosives safety requirements (e.g., DESR 6055.09).

• Experience with insulation, liner, and composite case manufacturing.

• Experience in cleanroom or FOD-sensitive environments.

Colorado law requires us to tell you the base compensation range of this role, which is $107,000 - $133,000, determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. What we can’t quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

Classification: Full-time Exempt

Benefits Include: (Please note, Interns are not eligible for benefits)

Director, Benefit Consultant Relations 

Marvin is a company on a mission to end healthcare worker burnout. Marvin partners with many of the country's top hospitals, including Cedars-Sinai, Jefferson Health and Geisinger in Pennsylvania, and the Harvard Department of Psychiatry, to provide a proprietary mental health care platform for their physicians, nurses, and staff.

We are seeking a Director, Benefit Consultant Relations to build and own Marvin's relationships with the national and regional benefits consulting and brokerage firms who influence which behavioral health partner health systems bring to the table. Reporting to the VP of Sales and Partnerships, this individual will build trust with consultants and brokers at firms like Aon, Mercer/Marsh, WTW, Lockton, Alliant, and Gallagher, position Marvin as the credible, healthcare-specific behavioral health partner in RFPs and renewals, and convert consultant advocacy into qualified pipeline for the sales team. The ideal candidate will bring existing consultant and broker relationships, experience supporting RFP and finalist processes from the consultant side of the table, and comfort building a channel program without an established playbook.

We would prefer applicants from Denver, Los Angeles, or New York but will consider other highly qualified applicants from around the country. This position will require travel for consultant meetings, finalist presentations, and industry events (est. 30–40%).

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and formalize relationships with strategic consultants and brokers, with priority on named national and regional firms (Aon, Mercer/Marsh, WTW, Lockton, Alliant, Gallagher, and others).

 - Own consultant and broker education and enablement, ensuring partners understand Marvin's differentiation as healthcare-specific behavioral health infrastructure and can represent Marvin's proof points accurately to the market.

 - Coordinate RFP and finalist support with consultants, ensuring Marvin is included in relevant health system searches and that consultant-facing materials stay current and accurate.

 - Feed consultant and broker market intelligence back to sales, marketing, and product, surfacing competitive positioning, pricing benchmarks, and client feedback from the channel.

 - Build the enablement materials, relationship tracking, and reporting cadence for the consultant channel from the ground up.

 - Represent Marvin at consultant and broker regional and national events, office-based meetings, and industry conferences to build brand presence and expand influence.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10-15 years of experience in consultant relations or working at a consultancy, strategic alliances, or channel partnerships within health benefits, digital health, or behavioral health, with a minimum of 3 years and demonstrable named consultant or broker relationships.

 - Demonstrated relationships with several national or regional consulting/brokerage firms (Aon, Mercer/Marsh, WTW, Lockton, Alliant, Gallagher, or equivalent).

 - Experience supporting RFP, RFI, and finalist processes from the consultant/broker side of the table.

 - Experience building consultant-facing enablement materials, such as one-pagers, comparison guides, and finalist decks.

 - Proven ability to convert consultant and broker relationships into qualified, revenue-generating pipeline, not just relationship maintenance.

 - Experience selling or partnering with health system or large employer executives, and with benefits and risk management teams.

 - Comfort operating without an established playbook in an early-stage company.

 - Significant experience and comfort using AI tools.

 - Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build and maintain trust-based relationships at all levels of a consulting or brokerage firm.

 - Strong ethical and professional integrity, with a commitment to upholding the organization's values and standards.

COMPENSATION

The base salary for this role is $200,000. This role includes a generous base salary, with a bonus of $20,000 tied to consultant-sourced pipeline and bookings targets. Compensation also includes equity in the company, consistent with Director-level grants at Marvin. Actual base pay within the range will depend on the candidate's experience, skills, and qualifications. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, retirement savings, and paid time off.

jobs.title: Staff RF Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Avionics team is responsible for all aspects of the electrical design on the rocket, from electronics, interconnects, associated mechanical design, testing and initial production. This team's scope includes the flight computers, power systems, RF systems, PCB design, autonomous flight safety systems, and telemetry. This team works on complex electrical systems that require modularity and flexibility, and are critical to the successful launch of Terran R, and beyond!

About the Role:

Serve as a senior technical generalist and owner for Terran R vehicle RF systems, leading system-level trades and analyses driving the overall RF architecture. Develop and maintain end-to-end link budgets for telemetry, command, and video across all flight phases, and define the vehicle RF frequency plan. Lead antenna placement and coverage trades using installed-pattern simulation and trajectory-driven analysis. Support multiple radio and RF hardware developments including: requirement generation, design review, and leading integrated RF testing and anomaly investigations. Set analysis standards for the RF team and mentor junior RF engineers as they grow into independent owners.

About You:

• Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field

• 8+ years of RF systems engineering experience on launch vehicles, spacecraft, missiles, or comparable flight systems, including taking flight RF hardware such as antennas, harnessing, or radios from design through qualification

• Strong command of RF system fundamentals, including link budgets, antenna theory, interference, and EMI/EMC requirements (e.g., MIL-STD-461/464)

• Proven ability to lead technical work across disciplines and mentor other engineers

• Hands-on experience with RF test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, signal generators, and EMI receivers

• Proficiency with full-wave EM simulation tools such as HFSS, FEKO, or CST, and with Python or MATLAB for analysis and automation

Nice to haves, but not required:

• Experience with launch range RF interfaces and validating high-dynamics link performance

• Experience with telemetry standards such as IRIG-106

• Familiarity with spectrum management and frequency authorization processes (NTIA, FCC)

• Experience with STK or other trajectory-based coverage analysis tools

• Experience managing RF hardware suppliers through qualification and production

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

Hiring Range:

$175,000—$263,000 USD

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at accommodations@relativityspace.com.

Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.

jobs.description:
About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Ennoble Care believes giving care is an Honor

We are looking for a compassionate, dedicated part-time, Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA)/Certified Home Health Aide (CHHA) to join our growing Hospice Company for our Dayton, OH region.

Duties:

The caregiver (CNA/CHHA) will be responsible for:

• Care for census of 5-6 patients

• Provides or assists in ADL activities; personal hygiene, grooming, mouth, skin care and nails.

• Provides assistance in toileting, positioning and transfer activities, frequent turning and positioning of a bed bound resident/patient.

• Assists with the prescribed exercise and ROM activities which the resident/patient and Hospice aide have been taught by the Hospice Nurse.

• Assists with light housekeeping of individual's personal unit or room, including changing of bed linen and patient’s laundry.

• Feeds and assists with meals.

• Reports any changes in resident's/patient's condition to the Nurse

Qualifications:

• At least 18 years old.

• Meets training requirements of the State.

• Received a minimum of 75 hours of classroom and supervised practical training with at least 16 hours devoted to supervised practical training and with at least 16 hours of classroom instruction completed.

• Must have one year experience as a CNA, hospice aide or home health aide. (Hospice preferred.)

• Must be a licensed driver with an insured automobile in good working order and current auto insurance.

• The ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.

jobs.title: Manager, Venue Medical Operations-Athletic Trainer
jobs.description:
LA28 does not provide relocation assistance for any positions.

If you are based outside the Los Angeles area, we still welcome your application — we value talent from all geographic backgrounds and want to hear from you if you are able to work on-site in LA.

Role Purpose

You will make sure athletes, spectators and the Games workforce receive safe, dependable medical care at LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games venues. Working with Event Venue Management, local emergency medical services and hospital partners, you will turn strategic medical plans into practical venue operations, from medical stations and supplies to emergency response. In the years leading up to the Games, you will establish these operations from the ground up, then lead them through test events and Games time with integrity and sound judgment.

Key Responsibilities

·       Turn strategic medical plans into venue run sheets, layouts, and timelines for competition and non-competition sites.

·       Act as primary liaison to Event Venue Management, integrating International Federation guidelines and NOC/NPC medical requirements.

·       Run daily medical services, from athlete medical rooms and spectator first aid to field-of-play response and supplies.

·       Coordinate emergency response with local EMS, hospitals, and public safety partners, and help draft emergency action plans.

·       Keep venues compliant with IOC/IPC medical codes and support adoption of the Games Electronic Medical Record system.

Required Competencies

·       5+ years of experience in healthcare operations, emergency medical planning, clinical services management, or venue-based event operations.

·       Proven operational experience coordinating medical services for multi-day, large-scale events, including on-venue emergency response.

·       Demonstrated operational problem-solving, team coordination, and detail-oriented project management skills, with sound judgment under competing priorities.

·       Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) and familiarity with clinical tracking or EMR systems.

·       Bachelor's degree in athletic training or a related field; or 5 years of equivalent experience in healthcare operations or venue medical services.

Valued Experience

·       Major multi-sport or championship event experience.

·       Experience in sports or live event environments.

·       Familiarity with Southern California healthcare networks, EMS jurisdictions, and disaster preparedness frameworks.

·       Master's degree in sports medicine or a related field; or 5 years of equivalent experience in sports medicine, preferred.

What We Offer

·       Ownership of venue medical care as the Summer Games return to the U.S.

·       Close work with EMS, hospital, and public health partners across Los Angeles.

·       Hands-on leadership through test events and Games-time venue operations.

·       A team guided by optimism, integrity, excellence, inclusion, co-creation, and boldness.

What This Role Means for the Games

Every athlete and fan at your venues relies on medical care that works in the background, and your planning and leadership will help LA28 deliver safe, inclusive Games and leave a lasting legacy of preparedness in Los Angeles.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

·       Available to work onsite in our Downtown Los Angeles-based office.

·       The majority of work will be conducted in an office setting, requiring extended periods of time using computers, phones, and other office equipment.

·       The LA28 office is an open floorplan working environment; employees must be able to work efficiently in an open cubicle environment.

·       Hours of work may vary, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, especially during peak event periods.

·       Perform other duties as required; the role will evolve over time and may include operational responsibilities during the Olympic and Paralympic Games.

·       Expectation to be based in LA28 offices/venues in Los Angeles.

·       Ability to walk, stand, and traverse indoor/outdoor venue footprints for extended periods during site visits, test events, and Games operations.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position is $88,000 - $115,000. The pay scale provided is the range that LA28 reasonably expects to pay as starting base compensation for this role. All LA28 compensation remains subject to final determination based on individual candidate qualifications, experience, or other reasonable criteria consistent with LA28's operational business needs and applicable law.

Accommodation

LA28 is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require an accommodation at any stage, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Equal Opportunity

LA28 is committed to fair and unbiased recruitment procedures allowing all applicants an equal opportunity for employment, free from discrimination on the basis of religion, race, sex, age, sexual orientation, disability, color, ethnic or national origin, or any other classification as may be protected by applicable law. LA28 will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance and all applicable laws. We strive to build a team that is inclusive and encourage qualified candidates of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities to apply. We assess applications based on relevant skills, education, and experience a candidate can add to our team.

Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. jobs.title: Implementation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Expel, signing a new customer is just the beginning. The real magic happens when we turn that excitement into a seamless onboarding experience, working integrations, confident security teams, and a customer who's ready to get the most out of our platform.

That's where you come in.

As an Implementation Engineer, you'll own the first 30–60 days of the customer journey, taking customers from their initial sales handoff through technical implementation, enablement, and their first real value with Expel.

This isn't just about configuring tools or checking boxes. You'll be the person bringing everything together, helping customers navigate technical challenges, keeping implementations on track, and making sure they're set up for success long after onboarding is complete.

You'll work closely with customers, our Security Operations Center (SOC), Customer Success, and internal technical teams to deliver an onboarding experience that's thoughtful, efficient, and built around each customer's environment.

What Expel can do for you:

• Give you ownership of the customer onboarding experience, from initial handoff through successful implementation and transition to Customer Success.

• Provide opportunities to work with a variety of enterprise security environments, technologies, and customer challenges.

• Connect you with experienced security practitioners across our SOC, engineering, and customer-facing teams.

• Give you a voice in improving how we onboard customers, streamline processes, and deliver value faster.

• Help you continue developing your technical expertise across cybersecurity, cloud environments, and Expel's Workbench platform.

• Offer a remote work environment where you can collaborate across teams while taking ownership of your work.

What you can do for Expel:

• Own the customer onboarding journey. Manage a portfolio of 15–20+ implementations simultaneously, guiding customers from post-sale handoff through technical setup, enablement, and initial value.

• Bring customers live with confidence. Lead technical onboarding, including security integrations, configurations, Workbench training, custom setup, and incident simulations.

• Help customers get the most out of Expel. Partner with our SOC to validate customer configurations and ensure they're positioned to detect and respond to real threats.

• Keep implementations moving. Establish clear timelines, communicate expectations, manage milestones, and hold customers accountable while maintaining strong relationships.

• Get ahead of potential issues. Identify technical blockers, customer readiness gaps, and slipping timelines early, escalating when necessary to prevent onboarding delays and future retention risks.

• Make customer transitions seamless. Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure every handoff includes the technical context, customer expectations, and documentation needed for long-term success.

• Help us continuously improve. Identify recurring onboarding challenges, provide feedback to Product and internal teams, and recommend improvements that reduce friction and accelerate time-to-value.

• Support the broader team. Maintain accurate implementation documentation and provide technical guidance to associate-level teammates when needed.

What You Should Bring With You

• 2+ years of experience implementing SaaS solutions, security services, or IT services within enterprise environments.

• Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Implementation Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or Professional Services.

• Working knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, including EDR, SIEM, NDR, and CASB, and how these tools support enterprise security operations.

• A solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, DNS, firewalls, and proxies, particularly as they relate to security integrations and deployments.

• Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and their native security services.

• Understanding of enterprise security best practices and common compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA.

• The technical troubleshooting skills to trace data flows, identify integration issues, and work through challenges between a customer's environment and Expel's platform.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts for security practitioners, business stakeholders, and customers.

• Experience managing multiple customer implementations or technical projects simultaneously, keeping priorities organized and timelines on track.

• The confidence to set expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and hold customers accountable while maintaining positive relationships.

• Good judgment around when to troubleshoot independently, when to escalate, and how to adapt when a customer's environment doesn't fit the standard playbook.

• A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Notes

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 USD and $136,200 USD, with a target range of $104,000 to $126,500, plus bonus eligibility and equity.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

jobs.title: Uninsured Recovery Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Employment type: Full-time
Team: Recovery



About the Role

We’re looking for a Recovery Specialist to manage uninsured and contractual recovery claims, including motor vehicle accidents, unreturned rental vehicles, and related losses arising from rental agreements.

You’ll investigate the basis for recovery, review supporting documents, and work directly with responsible parties to resolve outstanding obligations. This role requires strong negotiation skills, sound judgment, and a respectful, practical approach to difficult conversations.

What you'll do

 - Manage uninsured and contractual recovery files, including accidents and unreturned rental vehicles, from initial review through resolution.

 - Review claim documents, rental agreements, vehicle return records, liability information, and loss amounts to establish a clear basis for recovery.

 - Locate and contact responsible parties, explain outstanding obligations, and address questions or disputes professionally.

 - Negotiate settlements and payment arrangements within your authority, considering individual circumstances and ability to pay.

 - Monitor payment plans, follow up on missed payments, and determine appropriate next steps.

 - Identify files requiring further investigation, management review, or referral to approved collection or legal partners.

 - Maintain accurate records of communications, negotiations, payments, and decisions.

 - Work closely with claims handlers, rental operations, and recovery teammates to confirm vehicle status, resolve missing information, and move files forward.

 - Meet recovery, service, quality, and productivity goals while following company policies and applicable requirements.

 - Share ideas that improve recovery processes and the experience of people interacting with our team.

What you'll bring

 - Experience in insurance claims, recoveries, subrogation, collections, or a related customer-facing negotiation role.

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to handle sensitive or difficult conversations calmly.

 - A practical approach to negotiation, balancing recovery opportunities with realistic outcomes.

 - Strong organization and follow-up skills, with experience managing multiple files and deadlines.

 - Attention to detail and confidence reviewing documents, calculating balances, and recording decisions.

 - Comfort working with claims systems, spreadsheets, and digital communication tools.

 - Integrity, empathy, and good judgment when handling personal and financial information.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with motor claims and uninsured motorist recoveries.

 - Familiarity with liability assessment, recovery documentation, and payment plan management.

 - Experience recognizing financial hardship and handling disputed claims.

What Success Looks Like

You build a well-managed portfolio, secure sustainable recovery outcomes, and keep clear, timely records. You communicate respectfully, exercise sound judgment, and know when to resolve a file independently or ask for support.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, West
jobs.description:
Obsidian Security is a global leader in cyber security protecting the SaaS and non-human identity layer modern enterprises run on — from Salesforce and Snowflake to the AI agents now deployed inside them. The Obsidian Security platform gives unified visibility into every human and machine identity, app, and integration across their SaaS estate, detects identity-based and supply chain attacks in real time, and enforces least-privilege access before it's exploited. Trusted by major Fortune 500 companies T-Mobile, Workday, Snowflake, and S&P Global, Obsidian ranked No. 95 on the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, growing nearly 1000% from 2021–2024 — helping CISOs turn an unmonitored attack surface into one they can govern with confidence. Obsidian has also been recognized by Forbes as America's Best Startup Employers in 2026.

In August 2026, Obsidian raised $85 million in Series D financing led by Crescent Cove Advisors, with participation from existing investors including Greylock Partners, Menlo Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, IVP, Wing Ventures, and GV — pushing Obsidian's valuation to $1.1 billion, crossing into unicorn status. Obsidian is using the funding to deepen its R&D in agentic AI security and extend its platform as the standard for governing what AI agents can access and do inside third-party applications.

With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and fresh capital from its Series D behind it, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

About the Role:

Obsidian Security is seeking a Field Marketing Manager to lead the strategy and execution of marketing activities across the West. We're looking for a passionate person who builds strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, understands how to drive early-stage pipeline, and builds programs that accelerate sales cycles and close business. You will work closely with the Enterprise and Commercial sales teams to build strategic campaigns for their ideal target customers.

We're looking for a strategic marketer with a strong track record of building and executing field marketing programs, and the ability to work in true partnership with sales — someone who can manage and nurture those relationships with a firm-but-fair approach, serving as a trusted advisor who can navigate competing priorities while keeping the regional business on track. You will develop a deep understanding of our product, our buyer personas, our target accounts, partners, customer advocates, and the value Obsidian brings to our customers and community — deep enough that you can think critically about how content and field programs align to the campaigns in flight. This high-visibility, high-impact role partners closely with the broader marketing, sales, and business development teams to drive awareness, demand, pipeline, and bookings.

The position will be remote-based and report to the Global Director - Field & Partner Marketing.

What you will do:

• Own and manage the field marketing relationship with your regional sales teams — be firm but fair, nurture those relationships over time, and navigate competing asks while advocating for what will actually move the business.

• Build and execute a proactive regional events strategy, planning 6–9 months in advance. Regional venues and sponsorships fill up quickly — you'll stay ahead of the calendar rather than reacting to it.

• Ensure every field activity ladders up to the marketing campaigns in flight. Happy hours and regional events are great, but you'll work closely with the campaigns team to make sure field programs are strategically aligned with current campaign themes, content, and messaging — not standalone moments.

• Develop a baseline understanding of our product and what we do, so you can think through where content and field marketing intersect and where the campaign alignment opportunities are.

• Build regional communities of customers and prospects — stay close to customers, deepen relationships, and use those communities to accelerate pipeline.

• Develop customer relationships to source customer speakers for regional and national events, and feed customer stories back to the marketing team so they can be developed into case studies and advocacy content.

• Report out not just on individual events, but on the health of your regional business at a high level — partnering with your RVPs to deliver that view together.

• Track, measure, and share the impact of every program, experiment, and failure (they happen!).

• Manage overall budget and spend to deliver a significant return on the $, while also capturing the anecdotes and engagements that we know close deals.

• Partner with sales leadership on territory planning, and ensure field marketing contributes productively to the quarterly business reviews of the sales teams you support.

• Be an advocate for the sales department and help the rest of the marketing department understand their priorities.

• Work closely with our partnerships team to build strong co-marketing relationships with our Technology and System Integrator partners.

• Leverage data to make intelligent, informed recommendations, decisions, and forecasts regarding our demand generation strategies, target account plans, and paid investments.

• Drive new levels of cross-channel and integrated marketing and ensure our marketing activities are aligned and planned well in advance.

What we are looking for:

• 5+ years of relevant Field and/or Partner Marketing experience. You've had an interesting career to date — you've worked for established companies and scrappy startups. You know what great looks like.

• 5–7 years of working in the B2B SaaS space.

• Experience working with and supporting international sales teams.

• Ability to develop close, trusting relationships with sales — firm but fair — as well as collaborate effectively with marketing and product. You know how to be a partner to sales, not just a service function.

• A strategic planner: you think 6–9 months ahead, understand how field programs connect to broader campaigns, and build toward long-term regional goals rather than one-off events.

• Experience building regional customer communities and developing customer relationships into speakers, references, and stories.

• You are outcome-driven, analytical, customer-first, and have a track record of executing creative, impactful field marketing programs for executive and practitioner audiences.

• You have a proven track record of working collaboratively with prospects, customers, sales, marketing, and the exec team to impact early and late stage pipeline.

• Comfortable reporting on the business, not just the event — you can partner with sales leadership (RVPs) to present a high-level view of your regional business.

• You set a high bar in everything you and your team do — quality, creativity, execution, productivity, and of course balance.

• You're extremely detail-oriented and organized, and able to meet deadlines.

• Experience supporting both direct sales and channel sales teams.

• A sense of humor, willingness to be your authentic self, and a deep belief in being human-first is a big plus.

Employee Benefits

jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

As Senior Director of Engineering for Proactive Offense, you’ll set the engineering direction and build the organization that turns offensive security research and capabilities into dependable, customer-facing NodeZero products. You’ll lead through engineering managers, technical leaders, and senior individual contributors across multiple teams, balancing technical judgment with organization-wide strategy and execution.

You’ll shape how NodeZero identifies, exploits, and validates vulnerabilities across complex environments, and guide offensive capabilities from research and proof of concept through scalable production delivery. You’ll partner closely with Product and leaders across Engineering, including Precision Defense and Platform, to align the Proactive Offense portfolio with customer needs and company priorities.

This is a highly visible leadership role central to Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai’s mission of delivering continuous, autonomous security testing at scale.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


ORGANIZATION LEADERSHIP & STRATEGY

 - Lead and scale the Proactive Offense engineering organization across teams responsible for offensive capabilities, exploit development, and attack automation within NodeZero.

 - Translate the organization’s charter into a clear technical strategy, operating model, and sequenced roadmap, balancing customer value, product priorities, and durable engineering foundations.

 - Build an effective leadership structure as the organization grows; hire, coach, and develop managers, technical leaders, and senior individual contributors with clear ownership and accountability.

 - Establish goals and operating mechanisms that make progress, quality, capacity, dependencies, and risks visible across teams.

 - Partner with technical leaders on architecture and design, bringing sufficient depth to evaluate tradeoffs, challenge assumptions, and ensure systems can evolve as the product and portfolio expand.




PRODUCT & PORTFOLIO EXECUTION

 - Partner with Product, Precision Defense, Platform, and customer-facing teams to prioritize work across offensive research, vulnerability exploitation, attack content, and automation.

 - Shape a coherent portfolio roadmap and translate ambiguous opportunities into focused plans with explicit scope, measurable outcomes, and well-managed cross-team dependencies.

 - Drive capabilities from proof of concept to production, ensuring research and innovation become reliable, scalable, supportable product features.

 - Ensure engineering investment advances customer outcomes while balancing technical quality, speed to market, operational needs, and responsible product behavior.

 - Surface tradeoffs early, communicate decisions clearly, and protect teams from competing priorities that would undermine delivery or quality.




DELIVERY & OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

 - Improve execution across multiple teams by establishing clear planning, decision-making, and delivery practices that support predictable progress without unnecessary process.

 - Hold the organization accountable for product quality, reliability, and maintainability throughout design, development, release, and ongoing operation.

 - Identify organizational and technical risks early, align owners on mitigation, and communicate material changes in scope, timing, or outcomes to stakeholders.

 - Use customer feedback, product performance, and engineering signals to evaluate results and continuously improve how the organization delivers.




TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & COLLABORATION

 - Maintain enough technical depth to guide consequential decisions and help leaders resolve complex architectural or delivery challenges without becoming the day-to-day decision bottleneck.

 - Mentor technical leaders in building modular, resilient systems that translate offensive tradecraft into scalable NodeZero capabilities.

 - Collaborate across Engineering, Product, and go-to-market teams to align offensive innovation with business priorities and the broader customer experience.

 - Foster a culture of collaboration, creativity, learning, and engineering excellence across disciplines and teams.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Significant experience leading and scaling software engineering organizations delivering SaaS or cybersecurity products, including leading through managers and senior technical leaders.

 - A track record of setting engineering strategy and delivering across multiple teams or product areas in a fast-moving environment.

 - Strong technical judgment in software architecture and offensive security domains such as exploit development, vulnerability research, attack automation, or red teaming.

 - Demonstrated success taking complex technical capabilities from concept through production launch and continued operation at scale.

 - Experience with distributed systems, cloud software, automation, and large-scale SaaS platforms, with the ability to guide architecture and design decisions.

 - A product-oriented mindset and sound judgment balancing technical excellence, customer impact, speed to market, and operational considerations.

 - Experience hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing teams and leaders, and establishing clear accountability across an organization.

 - Strong cross-functional partnership skills, including alignment with Product and stakeholders across Engineering and go-to-market teams.

 - Excellent analytical, written, verbal, and storytelling skills; able to translate complex engineering concepts into clear direction and decisions.

 - A high degree of initiative, ownership, and accountability.

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.




TECHNICAL & DOMAIN EXPERIENCE

 - Deep familiarity with offensive security techniques and practices, including vulnerability research, exploit development, attack automation, or red-team operations, and the ability to translate them into scalable product capabilities.

 - Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, Go, C++, or C#, with experience building or guiding the development of large-scale software systems.

 - Strong understanding of platform design, system architecture, and automation pipelines, including CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure as code, and observability practices.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure and services such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and with production SaaS or security platforms.

 - Familiarity with network protocols, multiple operating systems (including Windows and Linux), and common enterprise technologies.

 - Working knowledge of databases such as PostgreSQL, Neo4j, or similar, and data-flow design.

 - Awareness of cybersecurity industry standards and trends, with the ability to connect technical direction to customer and product needs.




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSED, or GPEN.

 - Experience mentoring teams on offensive tradecraft or developing proprietary offensive tooling.

 - Experience scaling an engineering organization through significant hiring, organizational change, or product growth.

 - Experience building B2B SaaS or security products in a startup or growth-stage company.




TRAVEL REQUIRED

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 10% travel to be successful.

 

Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $315,000 - $370,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 



Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Pulmonary Function Technician
jobs.description:
(ID: 2026-3846)

Axle is a bioscience and information technology company that offers advancements in translational research, biomedical informatics, and data science applications to research centers and healthcare organizations nationally and abroad. With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. We work with some of the top research organizations and facilities in the country including multiple institutes at the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

Axle is seeking a Pulmonary Function Technician  to join our vibrant team at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) supporting the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) located in Bethesda, MD.

Benefits We Offer:

• 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees

• Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

• 401K match up to 5%

• Educational Benefits for Career Growth

• Employee Referral Bonus

• Flexible Spending Accounts: Healthcare (FSA) Parking Reimbursement Account (PRK) Dependent Care Assistant Program (DCAP) Transportation Reimbursement Account (TRN)

Position Overview

The Pulmonary Function Technician will perform pulmonary function and exercise testing to generate physiological data for NHLBI research. The role involves working with adult and pediatric patients, monitoring patient responses, maintaining testing equipment, supporting quality assurance, and documenting clinical information.

Responsibilities

• Perform pulmonary function testing, including measurements of lung volumes and airway resistance by body plethysmography, impulse oscillometry, methacholine bronchoprovocation testing, and exhaled nitric oxide measurements.

• Conduct cardiopulmonary exercise tests and six-minute walk tests and collect arterial blood gases while supporting patient safety and comfort.

• Review testing orders and verify completion of pre-study administrative procedures.

• Monitor physiological responses during testing and therapy, consult a physician when adverse reactions occur, and provide first aid as needed.

• Assist in developing standard operating procedures for pulmonary function and exercise testing.

• Set up, calibrate, maintain, and troubleshoot diagnostic instruments and testing systems to support safe, reliable operation.

• Perform equipment quality checks, work with technical support to resolve issues, and assist with development and maintenance of a comprehensive quality assurance database.

• Train staff, trainees, and other healthcare personnel in testing procedures and the operation of laboratory instruments, equipment, and software.

• Document pertinent clinical information in patient electronic medical records and maintain accurate research and testing records.

• Analyze and interpret research data with laboratory staff and contribute to reports, presentations, posters, and manuscripts.

• Coordinate instrument scheduling and priorities with Principal Investigators and contribute to planning for laboratory resource needs.

• Mentor coworkers, identify training needs, and contribute to quality improvements in laboratory and clinical workflows.

• Protect confidential clinical information and research data in accordance with applicable privacy and data-safeguarding requirements.

• Maintain necessary licensure and current knowledge of relevant clinical policies and technologies.

Required Qualifications

• Master’s degree in biology.

• Valid Basic Life Support (BLS) provider card and either an Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) or Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) card.

• Demonstrated clinical skills in pulmonary function testing and working with adult and pediatric patients.

• Experience with quality assurance testing, data collection, and equipment troubleshooting and maintenance.

• Proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Outlook.

Deliverables

• Perform validation activities monthly.

• Inspect equipment as needed.

• Meet with laboratory members weekly to present updates.

This is not restricted as a complete list of all skills, responsibilities, duties, and/or assignments required. Individuals may be required to perform duties outside of their position, job description or responsibilities as needed.

We are firmly committed to providing equal opportunity in all aspects of employment and will not tolerate any illegal discrimination or harassment based on age, race, gender, religion, national origin, disability, marital status, covered veteran status, sexual orientation, status with respect to public assistance, and other characteristics protected under state, federal, or local law and to deter those who aid, abet, or induce discrimination or coerce others to discriminate.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager, Events
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The B2B Content team helps business and technical audiences understand what AI makes possible and how to put it to work. We turn product expertise, research and customer experience into useful stories, presentations and demonstrations, working closely with Product Marketing, Product, Events and Demo Studio.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Content Marketing Manager focused on first-party and third-party events (examples include OpenAI DevDay, AWS re:Invent and vertical summits). You’ll develop keynote and breakout presentations that give audiences a clear perspective, concrete examples and something useful to take back to their work.

You’ll work directly with speakers and subject-matter experts to uncover the substance of a talk, shape its narrative, and write the presentation and speaker materials. You’ll partner with PMM and Product to ensure the content is accurate and relevant, conduct research when a story needs stronger evidence, and work with Demo Studio to create engaging demonstrations and event activations. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with ownership of assigned talks from brief through delivery.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Develop keynote and breakout presentations for first-party and third-party events, from audience briefs and session abstracts through outlines, decks, scripts and speaker notes.

 - Partner with PMM and Product, and conduct research when needed, to make talks insightful, accurate and grounded in relevant product capabilities, customer examples and evidence.

 - Interview speakers and subject-matter experts to draw out their expertise and turn complex material into a clear story with useful audience takeaways.

 - Prepare speakers through content reviews and rehearsals, refining the presentation, pacing and delivery so they are ready for the stage.

 - Work with Demo Studio to develop engaging demos and event activations that support the story, with clear briefs, speaker transitions and rehearsal plans.

 - Own content workback plans for assigned sessions, coordinating contributors, reviews, approvals and rehearsals with Events and production partners, and raising risks early.

 - Adapt strong event material into reusable presentations, webinar content and follow-up assets, working with channel owners to extend its value beyond the live event.

 - Use audience questions, session feedback and speaker debriefs to improve future talks, and maintain reusable briefs, presentation templates and approved examples for the team.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE, IF YOU HAVE:

 - Experience in content marketing, editorial, product marketing or event content, with a portfolio of keynote or breakout presentations and a clear account of their contribution.

jobs.title: Senior Training Specialist
jobs.description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Training Specialist to join our Operations, Client Support team. This role would be responsible for developing and delivering impactful training programs that drive employee performance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across Client and Provider Support. We are looking for someone who is collaborative, adaptable, and passionate about learning and development, and is passionate about making a meaningful impact and bringing their talents into a “for purpose” space. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

• Instructional Design and Training Design, develop, and maintain training programs for Client Support and Provider Support, including new-hire onboarding, role-specific training, certifications, process and system training, and ongoing upskilling. Create engaging learning experiences across a variety of formats, including self-paced eLearning, instructor-led materials, job aids, tutorials, demonstrations, assessments, and interactive activities. Apply adult learning principles and instructional design best practices to ensure training is engaging, accessible, and aligned with defined learning and business outcomes. Continuously review and refresh curriculum based on learner feedback, performance data, process changes, and evolving business needs. Facilitate live and virtual training sessions, new-hire nesting, demonstrations, guided practice, and other learning experiences for Client Support and Provider Support.

• Training Administration and Learning Systems Manage training assignments, enrollments, completion tracking, attendance, and learner progress through the LMS and other internal systems. Coordinate training schedules and communicate training requirements and expectations to learners, Supervisors, and other stakeholders. Maintain accurate training documentation and provide completion and learner performance information to relevant stakeholders.

• Data Analysis & Performance Optimization Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, learner feedback, operational data, and other performance indicators. Use data to identify knowledge and skill gaps, recommend learning interventions, and continuously improve training programs. Maintain department skill assessments and skill matrices to support curriculum development, employee growth, and future training needs. Track and communicate training initiatives, outcomes, and opportunities for improvement to leadership and relevant stakeholders.

• Collaboration & Strategic Partnership Partner with Client Support and Provider Support leadership to identify learning opportunities and develop strategies that address knowledge and performance needs. Collaborate with SMEs and cross-functional partners to translate complex processes, workflows, systems, and business requirements into clear and effective learning experiences. Serve as a trusted training resource during organizational, process, and system changes, helping teams successfully adopt new expectations and workflows. Contribute to training standards, best practices, and broader learning initiatives across the organization. Perform other related duties as assigned.

About You

• Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communications, Learning & Development, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

• 3–5+ years of experience in instructional design, training, learning and development, or a related field.

• Experience designing and delivering training for adult learners, including self-paced eLearning and instructor-led training.

• Experience with eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate Rise, Storyline, Captivate, or similar platforms, as well as Learning Management Systems.

• Strong facilitation, communication, project management, and organizational skills.

• Ability to translate complex processes and information into clear, engaging learning experiences.

• Data-driven approach to evaluating training effectiveness and identifying opportunities for improvement.

Bonus Points

• Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, customer support, contact center, or operations environments preferred.

Benefits

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA

• 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%

• Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.

• Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care

• PTO and Remote First Environment

• Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events

• Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $70,000 - $80,000/yr. Within the range, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse  “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing.
