jobs.title: Product Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

We are seeking a Product Reliability Engineer to join our growing team. This role will play a critical part in ensuring the quality and reliability of our products and processes, working closely with cross-functional teams to develop innovative solutions for high-precision manufacturing. As a Product Reliability Engineer, you will lead quality control initiatives, implement continuous improvement processes, and help drive the highest standards in production to meet customer and industry expectations.

The Role

• Process Improvement and Defect Reduction Lead initiatives to improve process efficiency and reduce defects by analyzing quality and production data to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities. Implement robust process controls and standardize inspection procedures to enhance consistency, prevent recurring quality issues, and improve first-pass yield.

• Inspection Effectiveness and Quality Controls Optimize inspection strategies by leveraging advanced tools and techniques, including CMM programming, to balance precision with efficiency. Establish and maintain inspection criteria and acceptance standards aligned with customer requirements and industry best practices. Ensure inspection methods meet capability requirements through studies like Gage R&R and Cpk analyses.

• Customer Engagement and Quality Deliverables Quality liaison for customers, managing audits, addressing quality concerns, and ensuring timely resolution of issues. Prepare and deliver required quality documentation, including PPAP, FAIR, and other customer-specific deliverables, while facilitating customer reviews and audits. Collaborate with customers to clarify quality requirements and maintain alignment on deliverables and expectations.

• Nonconformance and Corrective Actions Manage nonconformance activities, including root cause analysis, corrective/preventive actions, and Material Review Board (MRB) processes. Track and analyze nonconformance trends to drive targeted quality improvements and reduce defect recurrence.

• Data Analysis and Reporting Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), such as yield, defect rates, and on-time delivery, to identify improvement areas. Develop dashboards and reports to provide real-time visibility into quality performance and share actionable insights with stakeholders.

• Quality Planning and Deployment Develop and implement scalable quality control plans and deploy new inspection technologies to align with company objectives and customer expectations. Support process validation for new or modified manufacturing processes, ensuring readiness and compliance.

• Cross-functional Collaboration and Leadership Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate quality requirements into product and process development and support new product introductions (NPI). Mentor quality team members on best practices for inspection, data analysis, and process control while driving cross-functional problem-solving initiatives. Perform any other support functions as directed by Quality Management

Basic Qualifications

• Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls

• Demonstrated experience in quality initiatives focused on process improvement, defect reduction, and inspection optimization in manufacturing environments.

• Proficiency in implementing and managing tools such as PPAP, FMEA, and root cause analysis (RCA) to resolve quality issues and improve processes.

• Knowledge of advanced inspection methods and tools, including CMM programming, Gage R&R, and sampling techniques, with a focus on effectiveness and efficiency.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and drive data-informed decisions to improve yield and reduce defects.

• Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, customers, and suppliers to ensure quality standards and customer expectations are met.

• Clear communication and documentation skills to effectively present quality metrics, deliverables, and insights to stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical, or related field) or equivalent experience in a quality-focused role.

• Experience in regulated industries such as automotive, aerospace, or defense with familiarity in standards like AS9100, ISO 9001, or IATF 16949.

• Hands-on experience with Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) documentation and customer engagement for quality deliverables.

• Experience in statistical process control (SPC) and process capability analysis (Cpk) for monitoring and improving production processes.

• Certification in Six Sigma (Green Belt or higher) or ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) is a plus

• Familiarity with advanced manufacturing technologies such as additive manufacturing or automated inspection systems is a plus.

Work Environment

• Onsite

Compensation

At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at levels E03 - E04 as evaluated through our interview process.

• Engineer I / E03: $96,350 - $132,480

• Engineer II / E04: $111,300 - $153,040

$96,350—$153,040 USD

What We Offer:

• Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.

• Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.

• Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.

• Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.

Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

jobs.title: Production Technician & Equipment Operator
jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.



With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

Overview
Xona is looking for a Production Technician & Equipment Operator to support the build, test, and integration of the Xona spacecraft. This role is focused on repeat production assembly, integration and test activities with a focus on operating the various machines and bespoke equipment. Specifically, vibe testing, environmental and thermal cycling testing workstations plus other specific equipment necessary for complete Satellite production.

This person will work directly with the production, manufacturing, quality, Inventory and engineering teams in the newly built satellite production facility.

This is a high impact role in the production team and is vital to the scale-up of repeatable, high quality, production satellites.

What You’ll Do

 - Set up tooling, fixtures and instrumentation and run repeatable production tests on dedicated equipment typically found in spacecraft production: (vibration tables, thermal chambers, TVAC chambers, deployment fixtures, etc.)

 - Assemble and integrate satellite components and subsystems, including electrical harnesses and mechanical structures, following digital work instructions and procedures.

 - Solder and perform PCB handling, incoming and in-process inspection to IPC J-STD-001 workmanship criteria, and functional/continuity testing

 - Measure, record, test and document specific data as part of the complex assembly process

 - Work directly with the Production Supervisor, Production Line Lead and support teams, such as manufacturing engineering, quality and Inventory

 - Support cable routing, thermal insulation application, and other spacecraft-level assembly tasks, such as soldering, bonding, torque-controlled fastener installation, testing, anomaly detection and repair/resolution

 - Provide feedback to the Manufacturing team on assembly and integration process instructions, identifying opportunities to improve clarity, quality, and build efficiency.

 - Adhere to all safety requirements and reinforce proper cleanroom, ESD, FOD, and contamination-control practices throughout satellite production activities.

 - Support the development and continuous improvement of standardized production processes as Xona transitions toward higher-volume, repeatable spacecraft manufacturing.

 - Maintain strong 5S and FOD standards while helping ensure production areas, equipment, tools, and workstations remain organized and production ready.

 - Identify and escalate safety, quality, material, tooling, process, and schedule issues that could impact production execution.



What You’ll Bring

 - Proficiency with hand tools, torque tools, and PCB test/inspection equipment; multimeters, ohmmeters, DC power supplies, oscilloscopes, and other lab test equipment

 - High level of teamwork, clear communication and collaboration. Able to work with a diverse, talented and multi-disciplinary team

 - Comfort working with sensitive electronics and small mechanical parts

 - Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving production environment where processes and systems continue to mature.

 - Strong attention to detail with a commitment to safety, quality, accountability, and disciplined execution.

 - Ability to work collaboratively across Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Production Planning, Inventory, and Engineering teams.



Required Qualification

 - High school diploma/GED

 - Minimum 2+ years of experience operating production, assembly, and test equipment in a manufacturing environment. Experience may include environmental or thermal chambers, mechanical deployment fixtures, complex lifting equipment, vibration and shock testing systems, thermal cycling equipment, 3D printers, or similar specialized production and test equipment.



Preferred

 - Previous spacecraft, satellite, aerospace, and other high-reliability electromechanical assembly experience.

 - Experience supporting production ramp-up, new product introduction (NPI), or the transition from prototype builds to repeatable manufacturing.



Bonus.

 - Current or past certification in IPC-A-610 and/or J-STD-001; IPC/WHMA-A-620 (harnessing)

 - Experience reading and interpreting schematics, mechanical drawings, and assembly instructions with basic GD&T understanding

For U.S. Roles: To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). 



For U.K. Roles: To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).



For Canada Roles: Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR. 



We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Administrator I
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Biofire Technologies is on a mission to give gun owners better tools for reducing preventable gun injuries and deaths, especially among children. We believe our technology, combined with a best-in-class customer experience, will define the future of firearms safety for the next generation. Our mission-driven approach has earned support from the firearm community, the tech world, and the media.

Biofire employees encompass a diverse range of talents, including world-class engineers who have designed and tested firearms, medical devices, robots, cars, satellites, rockets, and supersonic jets; expert technicians from aerospace, defense tech, special forces, and gunsmithing; and elite operators from high-tech, advanced manufacturing, and regulated industries. Whether building the product or powering the company behind it, every Biofire team member is united by an obsession with safety, reliability, and operational excellence.



OUR CULTURE

Reducing accidental firearm injuries and deaths requires original thinking and authentic collaboration, so we’re deeply invested in building a team and culture that can achieve our mission together. Team members enjoy autonomy and flexibility from day one, so expect to be immediately tasked with solving challenging problems and building new systems that work. We’ll hold you accountable for executing audacious goals, giving and receiving honest feedback, and helping your teammates succeed. You’ll receive respect, kindness, and support from every direction while you figure out how to get it all done.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Systems Administrator I at Biofire, you will run our identity, device, and SaaS systems day to day and help keep our core on-premises and cloud infrastructure reliable. You will implement improvements to access and endpoint management, automate routine work, and build passwordless access and recovery practices that scale with the company. You will work independently on routine changes and collaborate with TechOps leadership on changes with a wider impact.

Success in this role means extending our group-based access rollout, automating joiner, mover, and leaver workflows, completing the device policy cleanup, and documenting and testing recovery for critical services. You will split your time between planned projects and complex Help Desk escalations, improve the team’s ability to resolve recurring issues, and communicate risks and blockers early. If you’re excited about helping to solve mission-critical challenges, we encourage you to apply.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Day-to-day responsibilities of the role will include:

 - Run Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, groups, SSO, and SCIM, and implement role-based access across the company while documenting exceptions;

 - Automate joiner, mover, and leaver workflows with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Azure Automation, or similar tools, and report on access health;

 - Manage Windows, Mac, and iOS devices in Intune and Mosyle, including enrollment, compliance, apps, updates, and policy documentation;

 - Maintain TechOps-managed on-premises and cloud-hosted servers, networks, and production-floor IT systems, including scheduled patching, monitoring, and backups;

 - Document and test recovery runbooks for critical services; lead technical triage and restoration for TechOps incidents in line with the incident plan, including occasional urgent after-hours response;

 - Resolve Tier 2 Help Desk escalations and reduce recurring issues through root-cause fixes, runbooks, and training;

 - Balance scoped improvement projects with operational and incident work, assess dependencies and rollback plans before high-impact changes, and raise project risks early.



QUALIFICATIONS

We understand that not all applicants will possess skills that perfectly align with our job qualifications. At Biofire, we appreciate diverse experiences from various industries, and we encourage all individuals who meet the necessary qualifications to submit their applications. Equivalent experience is welcome.

 - At least 4 years in IT, including 2 years in a systems administration role in a business environment.

 - Hands-on Microsoft Entra ID or comparable identity administration (such as Okta), including group-based access, joiner/mover/leaver processes, and SSO/SCIM integrations.

 - Windows endpoint management in Intune (enrollment, compliance, apps, and updates) and Apple device administration in an MDM such as Mosyle or Jamf.

 - Administrative automation with PowerShell, Python, or APIs, plus clear documentation and the ability to help a Help Desk team learn.

 - Operating production server or cloud services, including patching, monitoring, backups, and tested restores, with working knowledge of networking fundamentals.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS, NOT REQUIRED

 - Microsoft certifications such as SC-300, MD-102 or AZ-104.

 - Passwordless sign-in with FIDO2 security keys or Windows Hello for Business.

 - Manufacturing or other regulated environments, including ISO 27001 controls.



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

In addition to competitive pay, as a full-time employee at Biofire you are eligible for:

 - Stock Options in Biofire, 401(k), HSA - and other financial benefits

 - Medical Insurance - including plan options with $0 payroll deduction

 - Dental, Vision and Life Insurance Plans - with $0 payroll deduction

 - 3 Weeks Vacation and Sick time (Flex Time for salary positions), and 13 Paid Holidays

 - Parental Leave - and other family-building, adoption and surrogacy benefits

The compensation range for this role is $110,000 - $130,000 /annual salary + stock options + benefits.

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.



LOCATION

This is a full-time, salaried role, based at our dog-friendly headquarters in Broomfield, Colorado. This role is onsite about four days a week and will include regular time at Armory 1, our new manufacturing facility, once it opens. There is no standing on-call rotation, but occasional urgent incidents may require after-hours response.

We expect you to bring your very best, and in return, we will provide the support necessary for you to excel. You'll collaborate with colleagues you appreciate, respect, and find inspiration from, and have access to all the technical resources needed.



DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

We’re bringing innovation to a technological problem that has persisted for decades, so we depend on diverse, inclusive, and collaborative teams to break new ground and do great work. We welcome people from all qualified backgrounds, and we don’t discriminate based on race, religion, color, political affiliation, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.



ELIGIBILITY

This role handles information subject to US Export Control Regulations. Applicants must be (a) a citizen of the United States; (b) a lawful permanent resident of the United States (“Green Card” holder); or (c) a person admitted into the United States as an asylee or refugee to be considered for the position.

jobs.title: Perception Engineer, Missile Defense
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

• Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

• Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

• Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

• And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

• Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

You will architect and deploy the perception systems that let space-based missile defense see, track and tell apart objects in space. Your algorithms will turn multi-band infrared and visible imagery into a physical understanding of each object. They will do it in sunlight and shadow, with Earth in the background. The tracking filters you design will hold custody of many closely spaced objects through occlusion and maneuvers. The physics you put into these algorithms, from radiometry and thermal behavior to optics and detector effects, is what makes the answer trustworthy. You will own the perception stack end to end: from phenomenology and algorithm design, through software- and hardware-in-the-loop validation, to flight software that runs on space-qualified processors under strict power and timing budgets. This is perception engineering where mistakes have consequences, where your code operates in vacuum, and where the systems you build defend the United States and its Allies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Drive the architecture for the image processing, multi-object tracking and discrimination pipelines for space-based missile defense

• Design and implement multi-band EO/IR image processing in C++: non-uniformity correction, radiometric calibration, band registration, frame stacking, adaptive detection and PSF photometry

• Develop physics-based features from first principles, from the thermal and optical signatures of each object

• Model the phenomenology that drives the signatures: solar and Earth illumination, thermal response through sunlight and eclipse, viewing geometry, glints, and optics and detector effects

• Design robust tracking for many closely spaced objects

• Perform statistical analysis to characterize and verify algorithm performance, including Monte Carlo campaigns and error budgets

• Test and verify your algorithms in software- and hardware-in-the-loop simulation with high-fidelity scene generation

• Work with the software team to integrate your algorithms into flight software

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in physics, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, computer science, or a similar discipline

• Experienced with C/C++ and Python

• 2+ years of experience implementing image processing, detection and tracking algorithms deployed in real-world systems

• Working knowledge of radiometry and infrared phenomenology

• Demonstrated ability to work in a multidisciplinary team and solve complex problems with first principles approaches

• Passion for spaceflight and advancing capabilities related to missile defense and space security

• U.S. Citizen and eligible for DoD Secret or TS/SCI clearance

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Master's or PhD in physics, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a similar discipline

• Experience with missile defense or EO/IR sensor programs

• Deep technical expertise in one or more of the following: EO/IR phenomenology and signature modeling, radiometric calibration, thermal modeling, focal-plane array characterization (NUC, noise, bad pixels), nonlinear filtering and multi-object tracking (JPDA, MHT, IMM)

• Experience with IR scene generation and sensor simulation, and validating algorithms against measured data

• 2+ years of professional experience writing high-reliability, production C/C++ code

COMPENSATION

• Base Salary: $125,000 - $270,000

• Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Work Location— This is an onsite role, we are seeking only candidates based near Denver, CO or Long Beach, CA.

• Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.

• Physical demands—the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below.
#LI-Onsite

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

To protect candidates and our company from application fraud and impersonation, we use third-party tools to verify applicant identity and detect fraudulent applications. Learn more in our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Video Platform
jobs.description:
Patreon is a media and community platform where over 300,000 creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive work and experiences. We offer creators a variety of ways to engage with their fans and build a lasting business including: paid memberships, free memberships, community chats, live video, and selling to fans directly with one-time purchases.

 

Ultimately our goal is simple: fund the creative class. And we're leaders in that space, with:

 - $10 billion+ generated by creators since Patreon's inception

 - 100 million+ free memberships for fans who may not be ready to pay just yet, and

 - 25 million+ paid memberships on Patreon today.

 

We're continuing to invest heavily in building the best creator platform with the best team in the creator economy and are looking for a Staff Software Engineer, Backend Platform to support our mission.

 

This role can be based in San Francisco or New York and open to those who are able to be in-office 3 days per week on a hybrid work model.

 

About the Team

The Backend Platform team builds the foundational systems and infrastructure that power Patreon's creator platform. We're responsible for the core backend services, APIs, databases,  infrastructure, and developer tooling that enable product teams across the company to ship quickly, reliably, and at scale. This team is growing and investing in foundational platform capabilities that will support Patreon's next phase of scale and product expansion.



About the Role

As Patreon's first dedicated video engineer, you’ll shape the live video platform that connects creators with their communities. You’ll combine strong backend engineering with deep streaming expertise to build reliable, high-quality live experiences at scale.

 - Lead the architecture and delivery of live video systems spanning ingest, transcoding, packaging, delivery, and playback.

 - Build scalable backend services and APIs that power live video experiences across web and mobile.

 - Improve end-to-end streaming latency, video quality, and reliability across devices and network conditions.

 - Drive video vendor evaluation, integration, and build-versus-buy decisions, balancing capabilities, cost, scale, and long-term flexibility.

 - Establish observability, quality metrics, service-level objectives, and load testing practices to prepare for major creator live events.

 - Own production reliability through incident response, debugging, capacity planning, and lasting improvements to system resilience.

 - Partner with product, infrastructure, web, and mobile engineers to shape a multi-quarter video roadmap that balances creator needs with architectural health.

 - Mentor engineers through hands-on collaboration and design reviews, growing video expertise within the team.

What you'll need

 - Significant experience building and operating large-scale backend systems, with demonstrated technical leadership across teams.

 - Experience architecting and delivering live video systems supporting large audiences, ideally 100,000+ concurrent viewers.

 - Deep knowledge of live streaming technologies, including HLS, low-latency HLS, and WebRTC, and the trade-offs between latency, quality, reliability, and cost.

 - Experience diagnosing and improving streaming behavior, including buffering, adaptive bitrate delivery, stream failures, and the impact of packet loss.

 - Experience delivering broadcast and playback capabilities across web, iOS, and Android in partnership with client engineering teams.

 - Strong foundations in distributed systems, APIs, data storage, caching, queues, and event-driven architectures.

 - Experience evaluating and integrating video vendors, including understanding SDK limitations, quotas, scaling constraints, and pricing models.

 - A strong operational mindset, with experience defining video quality metrics, running load tests, debugging production issues, and supporting on-call coverage for live systems and major events.

 - Experience operating cloud-native systems using technologies such as AWS and Kubernetes.

 - Proficiency in Python, Go, or a similar backend language, with a commitment to hands-on engineering.

 - Ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly, guide cross-functional decisions, and translate ambiguous needs into a technical roadmap.

 - Experience mentoring engineers and establishing technical standards that improve system quality and team effectiveness.

We hire talented and passionate people from different backgrounds because workplace diversity and inclusion is critical to our ability to serve creators worldwide. If you're excited about a role but your past experience doesn't match every bullet point outlined above, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. If you're a creator at heart, are energized by our mission, and share our company values, we'd love to hear from you.



About Patreon

Patreon powers creators to do what they love and get paid by the people who love what they do. Our team is passionate about making this mission and our core values come to life every day in our work. Through this work, our Patronauts:

 

 - Put Creators First | They're the reason we're here. When creators win, we win.

 - Build with Craft | We sign our name to every deliverable, just like the creators we serve.

 - Make it Happen | We don't quit. We learn and deliver.

 - Win Together | We grow as individuals. We win as a team.

 

Patreon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the interview process, please let us know via email at accommodations@patreon.

 

Patreon offers a competitive benefits package including and not limited to salary, equity plans, healthcare, flexible time off, company holidays and recharge days, commuter benefits, lifestyle stipends, learning and development stipends, patronage, parental leave, and 401k plan with matching.

 

Patreon operates under a hybrid work model, where employees based in office locations are expected to come into the office two days per week, excluding sick time and paid leave. The goal of this policy is to be intentional about the in-person time we spend together to strengthen the feeling of community at Patreon. Candidates hired into remote-eligible roles are not expected to meet the same requirements.

 

At Patreon, we believe in fair and transparent pay. In compliance with New York and California pay transparency laws, we are sharing the expected salary range for this role.

 

The posted salary range is dependent on the location and the level. This range may encompass multiple levels within the role's job family. The final offer will be based on candidate's experience, skills, competencies, and geographic location, aligning with the appropriate job level within Patreon leveling framework. For remote employees located outside CA and NY, salary may vary based on location and local market conditions.

 

Patreon reserves the right to modify or update compensation and benefits at any time.

jobs.title: Internal Audit -  Manager

At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it.  - Support purchase order issuance and changes, invoice questions, vendor follow-up, and invoice reconciliation in coordination with Finance and Accounts Payable.

 - Develop and maintain process maps, queue trackers, handoff documentation, backlog-cleanup plans, and organized records of key deadlines, high-risk or high-value items, signature authorities, open vendor issues, and internal contacts.

jobs.description:

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh. 


THE ROLE

As a Finance & Strategy Lead, you’ll have a unique opportunity to play a pivotal part in our financial management and strategic planning process. The role will be integral in driving our company's financial health and visibility, and offers a chance to work at the cutting edge of AI technology and healthcare. We are seeking an individual who is passionate about their work, eager to engage in dynamic financial planning, and ready to contribute significantly to our company's success.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

You will principally be responsible for driving our financial planning process, inclusive of: budgeting, scaling processes & tooling, and cross functional communication / thought partnership. Specific responsibilities will include:

 - Financial Close Coordination: Implement scalable practices in financial close and accounting processes, partnering with our Financial Operations team to install and document accounting workflows / best practices.

jobs.title: Principal Manufacturing Engineer (Thermal Protection Systems)
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

As the Principal Manufacturing Engineer - Thermal Protection System (TPS) at Varda, you will own the manufacturing processes for the ablative and insulative materials that protect our reentry capsules during the most demanding phase of the mission- reentry. TPS manufacturing is one of the most technically specialized disciplines in aerospace, requiring deep expertise in ablative material processing, bonding, tiling, and surface preparation. You will develop and maintain the processes that ensure every capsule's heatshield is built to survive reentry conditions, working at the frontier of materials science and production engineering. This is a rare opportunity to own a critical, high-visibility manufacturing domain at a company that is already demonstrating reentry capability on orbit. This role is open at the L2 and Senior level, with levels determined based on candidate experience.

Responsibilities

• Own manufacturing processes for thermal protection system production: ablative tile/panel preparation, bonding, densification, and closeout operations

• Develop and maintain detailed work instructions, process travelers, and process specifications for all TPS fabrication and installation operations

• Implement surface preparation, adhesive application, and cure cycle procedures that meet TPS bond strength and thermal performance requirements

• Collaborate with TPS design engineers to provide DFM feedback on tile geometry, bond joint design, and tooling access for installation

• Define inspection and verification methods for TPS bonds, surface finish, and dimensional conformance; integrate quality gates into production workflows

• Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for TPS non-conformances, including bond voids, tile cracking, and surface contamination findings

• Develop and control environmental conditioning requirements (temperature, humidity) for TPS materials storage and processing areas

• Assess and procure TPS-specific tooling: bonding fixtures, tile templates, surface preparation tooling, and handling equipment

Basic Qualifications

• B.S. in Materials Science, Mechanical, Aerospace, Chemical, or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline, with consideration given to equivalent professional experience (typically 6–10+ years)

• 6+ years of manufacturing experience with thermal protection systems, composite materials, or advanced material bonding in aerospace or defense

• Hands-on experience with ablative or reusable TPS materials: PICA, AVCOAT, SLA-561, cork composites, ceramic tiles, or equivalent

• Experience with adhesive bonding processes, surface preparation methods, and cure cycle control for structural or TPS bonds

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and TPS assembly models; familiarity with GD&T as applied to complex surface geometries

• Experience writing and maintaining manufacturing process documentation for specialized materials operations

• Must be physically able to regularly lift 25 lbs., bend, stoop, and stand for extended periods while working directly with hardware

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Direct experience manufacturing TPS for reentry vehicles, hypersonic glide vehicles, or planetary entry capsules

• Familiarity with TPS inspection methods: visual inspection, tap testing, NDE methods applicable to bonded ceramic or ablative tiles

• Knowledge of TPS material properties — ablation rates, density gradients, outgassing behavior — and their manufacturing implications

• Experience with environmental controls and material handling requirements for moisture-sensitive TPS materials

• Background in transitioning TPS manufacturing from bespoke development builds to repeatable, documented production processes

• Experience with robotic or semi-automated TPS tile application processes is a strong plus

• Familiarity with reentry thermal analysis and how TPS design margins translate into manufacturing quality requirements

• Prior work at a company with demonstrated reentry or hypersonic vehicle flight heritage

Pay Range

• Salary Range: $181,913 - $262,763/per year

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance

• You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

jobs.title: Android Engineer, Identity
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Before Stripe, every growing internet platform needed a payments team. Today, every growing internet platform needs a way to establish trust in its users.

Identity verification is a core piece of economic infrastructure for online businesses. Stripe Identity enables businesses to digitally verify their users through identity documents and other signals for fraud prevention, regulatory, and trust and safety use cases. We are building the future of identity verification and trust in the digital economy.

The Identity Product Experience team owns Stripe Identity’s mobile SDKs for iOS, Android, and React Native. These SDKs enable businesses to embed secure, high-quality identity-verification experiences directly in their mobile applications. Our work spans mobile user experience, reusable SDK architecture, camera and document-capture experiences, developer experience, security, accessibility, reliability, and integration with Stripe’s backend systems.

Why Stripe Identity?

• Build mobile experiences that help establish trust between businesses and their users.

• Solve challenging product and technical problems involving mobile platforms, sensitive data, fraud prevention, and global scale.

• Create SDKs used by developers across industries, including fintech, marketplaces, and online platforms.

• Help shape the future of digital identity and make verification easier, safer, and more accessible.

Our vision is to build the world’s most trusted store of verified identities, enabling frictionless identity verification across Stripe and beyond.

We’re looking for engineers who care deeply about mobile craft and the entire user journey. You should enjoy translating complex technical and regulatory requirements into simple, polished experiences; working through ambiguity; and learning new technologies and systems.

Join us to build mobile identity-verification experiences that businesses can integrate easily and that their users can trust.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

As an Android engineer on the Identity team, you will:

• Design, build, and maintain Stripe Identity’s mobile SDKs and verification experiences across iOS, Android, and React Native.

• Create intuitive, polished experiences for complex flows such as identity-document and selfie capture, while accounting for accessibility, device capabilities, and varied real-world conditions.

• Build reliable and extensible SDK APIs and reusable components that make it easy for developers to integrate Stripe Identity into their applications.

• Work across mobile clients, supporting APIs, and services to deliver features end to end rather than treating the mobile application as an isolated layer.

• Improve SDK performance, reliability, observability, testing, release processes, and backward compatibility.

• Make thoughtful architectural decisions that balance user experience, developer experience, security, privacy, and long-term maintainability.

• Partner closely with product managers, designers, machine-learning engineers, backend engineers, user researchers, and other mobile teams.

• Work with Stripe users and field teams to understand integration challenges and turn their feedback into product and platform improvements.

• Help establish and evolve mobile-engineering practices across Identity and Stripe.

• Operate and maintain the systems and SDKs the team owns, including diagnosing production issues and improving them based on what we learn.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 3+ years of professional software-development experience, including meaningful experience building and shipping mobile applications or SDKs.

• Experience developing for at least one major mobile platform using technologies such as Kotlin or Java for Android.

• Strong software-design fundamentals and experience creating maintainable APIs, components, or frameworks.

• Experience delivering mobile functionality beyond an isolated UI layer for example, integrating with APIs and services, handling local state, or working with device capabilities.

• Experience testing, debugging, monitoring, and improving mobile software in production.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, design, and other technical and non-technical partners.

• A demonstrated commitment to building high-quality user and developer experiences.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building mobile SDKs, shared libraries, or developer-facing APIs used outside your immediate team.

• Experience with both iOS and Android, or with cross-platform technologies such as React Native or Kotlin Multiplatform.

• Experience with camera, image-processing, document-capture, biometrics, or other device-integrated mobile experiences.

• Experience designing mobile software that handles sensitive data and applies security and privacy principles by default.

• Familiarity with accessibility, internationalization, mobile performance, and unreliable network conditions.

• Experience with mobile CI, automated testing, release automation, observability, or developer-productivity tooling.

• Experience contributing to backend APIs or services that support mobile products.

• Ability to simplify complex requirements and favor durable, scalable solutions.

• Comfort reasoning clearly and moving with urgency in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

• Familiarity with Stripe’s products, ideally through integrating Stripe APIs or SDKs into another application.

jobs.title: Manager, Energy Design Engineering
jobs.description:
LA28 does not provide relocation assistance for any positions. If you are based outside the Los Angeles area, we still welcome your application — we value talent from all geographic backgrounds and want to hear from you if you are able to work on-site in LA.

Role Purpose

You will build the electrical design foundation that powers every LA28 venue, shaping temporary power overlays on existing infrastructure from the ground up. As Manager, Energy Design Engineering, you will lead the electrical studies, capacity analysis and risk assessments that translate venue requirements into reliable, resilient and sustainable power. Working with Venue Infrastructure, Technology, Broadcast and external delivery partners, you will convert evolving venue designs into coordinated, data-driven energy plans and gain career-defining exposure to delivering the Olympic and Paralympic Games in Los Angeles.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead electrical studies and energy capacity analysis that determine load requirements, identify supply gaps and drive data-driven masterplan optimization.

• Analyze energy-related risks to venue power supply and recommend solutions meeting loading, reliability and resiliency needs.

• Evaluate how Venue Management design revisions affect temporary power overlays on existing HV/MV/LV infrastructure and equipment.

• Integrate internal stakeholders with temporary power providers, design engineers and overlay resources through a coordinated review and approval process.

• Align Energy design with Venue Infrastructure, Technology, Broadcast, Energy Program Management and the International Olympic and Paralympic Committees.

Required Competencies

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience with electrical infrastructure and/or temporary electrical infrastructure design and delivery, preferably in the sport or live event industry.

• Direct experience managing electrical design development, from load studies and energy capacity analysis through design revisions, reviews and stakeholder approvals.

• Experience implementing sustainable energy solutions into electrical design, balancing sustainability goals with loading, reliability and resiliency needs.

• Demonstrated commitment to co-creation and collaborative decision-making.

• Experience working with a diverse range of stakeholders and proven success at building excellent working relationships with internal teams and external partners.

Valued Experience

• Familiarity with AutoCAD, Revit and BIM360.

• Fluency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and the Office suite.

• Presenting concisely to executive leadership, external contractors and governmental agencies.

• Exceptional attention to detail, organization and problem-solving skills.

• Experience managing change and mitigating project risk.

What We Offer

• Ownership of the energy designs powering Olympic and Paralympic venues across Los Angeles.

• Career-defining exposure to temporary power delivery at an unmatched global scale.

• Close collaboration with Olympic and Paralympic partners and cross-functional specialist teams.

• A high-performance culture guided by optimism, integrity, excellence, inclusion, co-creation and boldness.

What This Role Means for the Games

Every competition, broadcast and fan experience at the LA28 Games depends on dependable power. Your designs will ensure each venue receives safe, resilient and sustainable energy, contributing to a lasting legacy for Los Angeles and the Olympic and Paralympic Movement.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

• Available to work onsite in our Downtown Los Angeles-based office.

• The majority of work will be conducted in an office setting, requiring extended periods of time using computers, phones, and other office equipment.

• The LA28 office is an open floorplan working environment; employees must be able to work efficiently in an open cubicle environment.

• Hours of work may vary, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, especially during peak event periods.

• Perform other duties as required; the role will evolve over time and may include operational responsibilities during the Olympic and Paralympic Games.

• Travel as needed to external stakeholder offices, government agencies, and Games venues and facilities.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.



As a member of the Teleport Customer Solutions Team, you will own the full post-sales lifecycle for a portfolio of strategic customers: implementation, technical support, ongoing business reviews, and identifying expansion opportunities. You will be responsible for implementing, supporting, evangelizing, and expanding Teleport at our top customers, and dedicated to proactively driving adoption so that they achieve the maximum value from all Teleport products and solutions.

This is a deeply technical role. Many of our customers run Teleport on Kubernetes, and you will be expected to operate comfortably at the cluster level: designing and deploying Teleport in customer environments, troubleshooting failing workloads, and debugging access, networking, and certificate issues alongside customer engineers.

You will work directly with customers to design solution architecture, deploy and configure Teleport hands-on, share implementation best practices, triage and debug technical issues, develop and maintain training programs, evangelize the solution to a wider customer organization, and plan and assist with enterprise-wide rollouts. You will act as a customer champion within Teleport and help prioritize product feedback by working with the Product team. As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary lead for identifying and providing initial triage of technical blockers via shared chat, ticket, and meetings.

As our company grows and we launch new offerings, the requirements of this position may shift. You should be comfortable with change and have an interest in continually learning and advancing your skillset.

What you’ll bring

 - Deep, hands-on Kubernetes experience. You have built clusters with kubeadm (not just managed services), configured RBAC and certificate-based user access, and debugged failing workloads, networking, and control-plane issues. CKA certification is strongly preferred; CKAD is a plus.

 - Experience with cert-manager and TLS certificate management, Helm, and GitOps tooling (ArgoCD or Flux)

 - Demonstrable experience with the following security principles and technologies: SSH, PKI, 2FA, SSO (SAML, OIDC), and RBAC

 - Linux administration skills

 - Hands-on experience with one of the major public cloud providers: AWS, GCP, or Azure (certifications are a plus)

 - 8+ years of experience in customer-facing software onboarding, software services, solution architecting, or system administration roles

 - Exceptional hands-on troubleshooting, testing, and debugging skills, with the tenacity to identify and resolve technical issues as they arise

 - Outstanding soft skills and excellent verbal and written communication

 - Project management experience and the ability to handle multiple clients simultaneously

What you’ll be doing

 - Design solution architecture for Teleport in customer environments

 - Deploy and configure Teleport in customer environments, including Kubernetes-based deployments, and communicate implementation best practices to the customer

 - Act as the point person for technical issues, troubleshooting Kubernetes-based customer environments (cluster, networking, certificate, and access issues) and escalating high-complexity cases to Engineering

 - Work closely with Sales and Product to identify customer needs tied to tangible upsell and cross-sell opportunities

 - Plan and deliver Quarterly Business Reviews for customers, drive adoption within the customer organization, and plan and assist with enterprise-wide rollouts of Teleport

 - Develop, maintain, and deliver customized training, and evangelize the solution to a wider customer organization

 - Maintain strong working relationships with key client stakeholders and expand those relationships into other parts of the organization

 - Document each customer’s business goals and challenges to align Teleport with the most value possible

 - Serve as a subject matter expert on existing and upcoming Teleport solutions for customers and teammates, staying up to date on the latest releases

 - Collaborate with Sales and Product to provide valuable feedback for product improvement

 - Support our broader customer base seeking new solutions and best practice recommendations

Our interview process

Our interview process includes a hands-on technical assessment. You will build a kubeadm Kubernetes cluster, configure RBAC with certificate-based user access, deploy an application, present your design and its tradeoffs, and work through live Kubernetes troubleshooting scenarios. Candidates should be comfortable operating Kubernetes at this level without relying on managed-service abstractions. You are welcome to use AI tools for the take-home portion, with full disclosure of how they were used.



Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.



The Benefits

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Extensive health coverage

- Annual expense budget

- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

- Investment in your future with retirement savings plans

- Professional development opportunities



Teleport is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classifications protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Visual Designer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

OKX is one of the world's leading crypto platforms — a regulated exchange, a self-custody wallet, and a growing ecosystem of decentralized applications used by millions globally. We move fast, ship constantly, and operate across trading, DeFi, payments, and social products — each with distinct users and design challenges.

Our design organization is in the middle of a meaningful transformation: raising craft standards, building tighter brand-to-product coherence, and embedding AI into how we work. We're backed by our core principles — We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done — and we take those seriously in how we hire, build, and ship.

About the Opportunity

This is a hybrid onsite position. Candidates must be in the Bay Area, CA.

We’re looking for a Senior Visual Designer to join the Visual System Team, the team responsible for how OKX looks and feels across every product surface, including mobile and web. You’ll work at the intersection of brand expression and product design, crafting the visual layer that makes OKX products feel distinctive, coherent, and trusted.

This isn’t a role where you receive a finalized wireframe and simply apply a visual layer. You’ll be involved early, shaping how features are visually conceived, how brand moments are integrated into product flows, and how visual systems scale across an ecosystem of products used by millions.

You’ll work within OKX’s Visual Systems infrastructure alongside the Design System and Content System teams, contributing to scalable visual frameworks including illustration guidelines, motion principles, iconography standards, and brand-in-product patterns that raise quality across the entire product.

What You'll Be Doing

• Design product visual experiences. Create high-quality visual and UI designs for OKX products across trading, wallet, payments, and social features. Own the visual execution of key product surfaces, from concept through to pixel-perfect delivery. Balance beauty with clarity in a domain where trust and usability are non-negotiable.

• Contribute to visual systems. Work within and contribute to OKX’s visual systems, including shared illustration styles, motion tokens, color systems, iconography, layout patterns, UI components, and design tokens. Your work should strengthen the system, not create one-off exceptions. Think in terms of reusable, scalable assets and patterns, not just individual

• Bridge brand and product. Translate brand direction into in-product visual experiences. Work with the Brand Design team to ensure that visual identity is consistent from marketing to core product, while adapting it thoughtfully to product goals, user needs, and performance metrics. You’ll help create room for the product’s own visual expression without going off-brand.

• Design product campaigns and key moments. Create engaging visual experiences for in-product campaigns, launches, and feature moments. These should feel distinctive and expressive while remaining native to the product experience and aligned with the broader brand.

• Use AI tools in your design workflow. Actively integrate AI into your daily practice using generative tools for ideation, exploration, variation, prototyping, and asset production. You’re expected to experiment with AI-assisted workflows and bring what works back to the team. This is a core part of how we work, not an optional extra.

• Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner with product designers, engineers, and product managers to ensure visual design decisions are grounded in user needs and technically feasible. Participate in design reviews, give and receive critique constructively, and communicate your rationale clearly.

• Pitch and present. Propose creative concepts to team leads and stakeholders. Articulate the reasoning behind visual choices, not just what you designed, but why it is the right solution for the user and the brand.

What We Look For In You

• 4–6 years of experience in visual design, UI design, a digital-focused role within a brand team, or a related discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong craft, modern taste, and attention to detail.

• Experience taking product experiences from wireframes to polished, production-ready UI. You understand how visual design supports usability, hierarchy, trust, product goals, and measurable outcomes, not just aesthetics.

• Strong UI and digital design fundamentals across product, responsive web, and mobile experiences. Mobile-first experience is essential.

• Exceptional visual craft across typography, color, composition, layout, interaction, and detail. You have a clear point of view, make thoughtful design decisions, and care about the polish that separates good from great.

• Experience creating or contributing to scalable design systems. You understand tokens, components, patterns, and how to create a coherent visual language across a product.

• Comfortable working at the intersection of brand and product. You can translate brand direction into product experiences that meet user and business needs while leaving room for distinctive product expression.

• AI-forward in your practice. You actively use generative tools for ideation, exploration, prototyping, and production, and are excited to experiment with new workflows. You use AI with strong creative judgment, refining outputs rather than relying on unedited generated assets, and look for ways to make visual work more scalable.

• A clear, collaborative communicator who can articulate design rationale and work effectively with product designers, engineers, product managers, and Brand Design.

• Proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools, with the ability to communicate interaction and motion intent through high-fidelity prototypes.

• Experience creating light animation is a strong plus. Experience with 3D software or a genuine willingness to learn is also highly valued.

What Sets You Apart

• Experience designing for fintech, crypto, or trading platforms — you understand the visual language of trust, precision, and data density.

• Strong visual. illustration and interaction idea skills — you can create original visual assets, not just compose them.

• An exceptional eye for layout, composition, and hierarchy. You can turn ideas into clear, high-quality visual solutions quickly and decisively.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, balancing speed with a high bar for craft and attention to detail.

• Experience working with globally distributed teams across offices and time zones.

• Familiarity with how visual design integrates with front-end implementation. You understand CSS, design tokens, and component architecture well enough to collaborate effectively with engineers.

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs and education subsidy for professional growth

• Team building programs and company events

• Wellness and meal allowances

• Comprehensive healthcare for employees and dependents

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:
About Epic

Epic is a digital reading platform for kids, giving children instant access to thousands of high-quality books, audiobooks, and learning videos. Teachers and librarians across the country use Epic School Plus to build reading habits in their classrooms. Our mission is to spark curiosity and a lifelong love of reading in every child.

Position Overview

The Integration Specialist is responsible for the successful implementation, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance of Epic School Plus integrations with third-party platforms, including Clever, ClassLink, and SchoolDay.

The Integration Specialist works directly with school and district technology administrators and collaborates with Partner Success, Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, Sales, and external integration partners to resolve technical issues and improve the overall customer experience.

The ideal candidate combines technical troubleshooting skills with strong communication, organization, and customer service abilities. They can investigate complex data and access issues, explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and take ownership of issues through resolution.

What you'll do

• Set up, configure, and launch Clever and ClassLink integrations (rostering and SSO) for new and renewing school and district customers.

• Serve as the technical point of contact for district IT admins during onboarding, from data-sharing approval to first successful sync.

• Troubleshoot sync and login issues: missing students, duplicate accounts, incorrect class or teacher associations, and SSO errors.

• Monitor integration health across accounts and proactively fix sync failures before they affect classrooms.

• Manage the Epic apps in the Clever and ClassLink partner portals, including app settings, data-sharing scopes, and district requests.

• Partner with Engineering to reproduce bugs, write clear tickets, and test fixes and new integration features.

• Coach Customer Success, Support, and Sales on how integrations work and how to set expectations with customers.

• Build and maintain help-center articles, internal runbooks, and setup guides for admins and teachers.

• Track integration metrics (time to launch, sync error rates, ticket volume) and recommend process improvements.

• Support back-to-school peaks, when rostering volume is highest.

What you bring

• 2+ years in a technical support, implementation, or integration role, ideally in K–12 edtech.

• Hands-on experience administering or supporting Clever and/or ClassLink (rostering, SSO, or both).

• Solid understanding of K–12 rostering data: students, teachers, sections, schools, and how a student information system (SIS) feeds them.

• Working knowledge of SSO concepts (OAuth, SAML) and identity providers like Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID.

• Comfort working with CSVs, spreadsheets, and API responses to diagnose data issues.

• Clear, patient communication with both non-technical teachers and district IT staff.

• Strong organization: you can run many district setups in parallel and keep each one moving.

• Familiarity with student data privacy requirements (FERPA, COPPA, state privacy agreements).

Nice to have

• Clever or ClassLink certification, or prior work at either company or a district using them.

• Experience with other rostering standards and tools: OneRoster, Google Classroom, Microsoft Teams for Education, or SIS platforms like PowerSchool and Infinite Campus.

• Basic SQL or scripting (Python, JavaScript) for data checks.

• Experience with Zendesk, Salesforce, Jira, or similar tools.

• Background as a teacher, school technology coordinator, or district IT admin.

Compensation: $35–$40 per hour, up to 30 hours per week.

jobs.title: AI Residency Program, Physical Sciences
jobs.description:
Your Impact at LILA

The Lila Sciences AI Residency is a full-time research program at the intersection of artificial intelligence and materials science. Residents join a cohort of researchers tackling open-ended scientific challenges alongside Lila's scientists and engineers, with the option to focus on fundamental or applied research.

Residencies run 6 to 12 months, with extension possible. First residencies begin in spring 2027, with rolling applications and additional intakes in fall 2027. Residents are paired with technical mentors, receive feedback from cross-functional teams, and work with proprietary datasets, high-performance compute, and Lila's research infrastructure. Publishing is encouraged but not required. What matters most is pushing the frontier of scientific discovery.

Priority research areas for the 2027 cohort span four domains:

• Soft matter and formulation intelligence: composition-process-property modeling, representation learning for mixtures and formulations, physics-informed and simulation-augmented predictive models, and generative models for 3D soft-material structures at the mesoscale and microscale (colloidal assemblies, phase-separated domains, particle networks, film and bulk morphologies)

• Physics-based simulation and in silico discovery: agentic frameworks for physics-based and multiphysics or multiscale simulations, and methods that orchestrate and bridge across simulation scales

• Chemistry-aware AI and molecular design: molecular representations (graphs, protein-ligand structures, MD trajectories), chemistry-reasoning agents, predictive models for synthesis, analysis, and purification, and experimental decision-making under uncertainty and operational constraints

• Foundational AI for materials science: sequential decision-making under real-world constraints, multimodal learning, reasoning and benchmarking, generative models and representation learning, and scientific machine learning

Applications require a resume and a research proposal of up to three pages (unlimited references) outlining the project you would pursue during your residency. Submit the research proposal as your cover letter. Applications without both documents will not be considered. Optional supporting materials such as recommendation letters, publications, or research artifacts are welcome.

What You'll Be Building

• Pursue work in one or more of the 2027 priority research areas

• Collaborate with Lila scientists and engineers on open-science initiatives

• Co-develop novel approaches to scientific discovery with the wider team

• Use Lila's datasets, compute, and infrastructure to test ambitious hypotheses

• Share findings internally and externally; publication is welcome, not mandatory

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Experience working with large-scale datasets or simulations

About LILA
