jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Webapp & AI Attack
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

As Director of Engineering for Webapp and AI Attack, you’ll set direction and lead the teams that turn Webapp and AI related offensive security expertise into dependable, customer-facing NodeZero capabilities. You’ll own the strategy, execution, and organizational health of this portfolio, partnering with engineering managers, technical leaders, Product, Platform, and customer-facing teams.

You’ll guide capabilities from discovery and research through productization and ongoing operation. That includes improving how NodeZero maps and tests modern web applications, and building responsible, repeatable ways to assess AI-enabled and agentic systems. This is a people and portfolio leadership role: you’ll maintain enough technical depth to shape decisions and raise the quality bar while enabling teams and technical leaders to own implementation.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


ORGANIZATION LEADERSHIP & STRATEGY

 - Lead and develop the Webapp and AI Attack engineering teams, setting clear ownership, goals, and expectations across the portfolio.

 - Define a coherent strategy and roadmap that connect customer needs, product priorities, offensive research, and durable engineering investments.

 - Build an effective leadership structure as the organization grows; hire, coach, and develop engineering managers, technical leaders, and senior individual contributors.

 - Set operating mechanisms that make outcomes, progress, capacity, quality, dependencies, and risks visible without adding unnecessary process.

 - Own the health and performance of the organization, including talent planning, career development, timely feedback, accountability, and succession planning.

 - Foster an inclusive, psychologically safe environment where teams can raise risks, learn from failures, and do their best work.


WEBAPP ATTACK CAPABILITIES

 - Set direction for NodeZero’s web application attack portfolio, spanning application discovery, crawling and browser automation, authentication and session handling, attack coverage, and the feedback between discovery and testing.

 - Ensure the platform can reliably map pages, forms, APIs, parameters, and authentication surfaces across modern applications—including JavaScript-heavy single-page applications and complex user flows.

 - Partner with technical leaders to improve attack coverage, framework breadth, and the quality of the application context available to downstream testing.

 - Establish benchmarks, regression practices, and production signals that reveal coverage gaps and prevent quality from silently degrading as applications and frameworks evolve.

 - Use customer feedback, production behavior, and missed opportunities to prioritize improvements and close the loop between discovery, testing, and customer outcomes.


AI ATTACK CAPABILITIES

 - Set the strategy for turning AI/LLM and agentic-system security research into safe, reliable, repeatable attack capabilities in NodeZero—not one-off demonstrations or manual-only workflows.

 - Guide teams in assessing AI applications and infrastructure, including trust boundaries, permissions, tool use, data sources, model-serving and retrieval architectures, and enterprise deployment patterns.

 - Help teams evaluate and productize relevant attack classes, such as prompt injection, unsafe tool use, and AI supply-chain or deployment risks, with appropriate safeguards and clear customer value.

 - Establish quality standards for testing, evaluation, reliability, observability, cost management, and operational readiness in AI-powered offensive workflows.

 - Maintain a strong connection to the evolving AI security landscape and help the organization distinguish durable customer needs from short-lived trends.


PRODUCT, DELIVERY & TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP

 - Partner with Product and leaders across Engineering, Platform, and customer-facing functions to translate ambiguous opportunities into sequenced plans with explicit outcomes and ownership.

 - Make and communicate tradeoffs across customer impact, speed, coverage, reliability, safety, cost, and long-term maintainability.

 - Drive complex, cross-team initiatives from planning through production, identifying dependencies and risks early and aligning stakeholders on decisions and changes.

 - Maintain sufficient technical depth to evaluate architecture, system health, and engineering quality; partner with senior ICs rather than becoming a day-to-day decision bottleneck.

 - Ensure strong engineering practices across design, implementation, testing, release, monitoring, incident response, and learning from production issues.

 - Use customer feedback and product and engineering signals to assess results and continuously improve how the organization delivers.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Significant experience leading software engineering teams that build customer-facing products, ideally in cybersecurity, security testing, or another technically complex SaaS domain.

 - Experience leading multiple teams and developing managers and senior technical leaders, with a track record of building accountable, high-performing organizations.

 - Demonstrated ability to set strategy and deliver across multiple teams, translating business and customer priorities into focused roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

 - Strong technical judgment in software architecture, automation, distributed systems, and production operations; able to engage credibly with engineers and technical leaders.

 - Experience taking complex capabilities from early research or concept through reliable production delivery and ongoing improvement.

 - A customer-oriented product mindset and sound judgment balancing innovation, coverage, reliability, safety, delivery speed, and maintainability.

 - Ability to build effective partnerships across Engineering, Product, and customer-facing teams, resolve misalignment, and communicate decisions and risks clearly.

 - A demonstrated commitment to coaching, clear performance feedback, inclusive leadership, and healthy team culture.

 - Excellent written, verbal, and analytical communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical choices to varied audiences.

 - A high degree of initiative, ownership, and accountability; comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with ambiguity.

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.




TECHNICAL & DOMAIN EXPERIENCE

 - Familiarity with offensive security, web application penetration testing, vulnerability research, attack automation, or building security products.

 - Working knowledge of modern web application architecture, HTTP, authentication and session flows, APIs, browser automation, and the challenges of testing real-world applications at scale.

 - Familiarity with AI/LLM and agentic-system security, including trust boundaries, tool-use risks, and approaches to evaluating AI-enabled systems.

 - Experience with cloud software and production platforms, and fluency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, TypeScript, Go, or a comparable language.

 - Understanding of engineering practices such as CI/CD, automated testing, observability, incident response, and operational readiness.




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Direct leadership experience across both web application security and AI/LLM security; deep expertise in one area paired with the ability to build strong technical leadership in the other is also valuable.

 - Experience with web crawling, spidering, browser automation, application discovery, or authentication technologies such as SSO, SAML, or OIDC.

 - Experience shipping AI/LLM security capabilities, building agentic workflows, or applying frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS.

 - Contributions to security research, open-source tooling, technical publications, conference talks, or other work that advances the field.

 - Experience with cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; graph or relational databases such as Neo4j or PostgreSQL; or offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, or OSWE.




TRAVEL REQUIRED

We are a remote-first company, and this role may require up to 15% travel to be successful.




Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - The base salary range for this position is $290,000-$340,000. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 



Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
If you’re good at what you do, you can work anywhere. If you’re the best at what you do, come work for Doma Technology.

About Us

Doma Technology LLC offers solutions for lenders, real estate professionals, title agents, and homeowners that make closings vastly simpler and more efficient, reducing cost and increasing customer satisfaction.

Our Values

• Obsessively Entrepreneurial - We encourage calculated risk-taking, and we know that some of our best learning happens by making mistakes along the way.

• People First - We communicate with honesty and respect to our customers, colleagues, and partners.

• Better Together - We believe diversity, equity and inclusion creates value through the differences in our backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

• Act with Integrity - We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards in all of our business practices.

Doma is seeking a Lead Product Manager as we build the technology that makes real estate closings faster, smarter, and more certain. This individual will be tasked with growing Doma’s revenue and operating leverage by building customer experience and automation solutions to reduce the friction of several steps in the closing process. As a Lead Product Manager, you will help drive strategy across several growth focused metrics, feature development and prioritization of the product roadmap, and alignment across engineering, data science, operations, sales, and marketing and other partners.

You will focus on a durable capability area (intelligent title search) as well as discrete business outcomes related to that area (continued development of the refinance model linked to company OKRs). In this role you will play a key role in problem-solving across functions, and in shaping the vision, values, and culture of Doma’s Product Team.

What You’ll Do:

Product Execution & Delivery

• Own day to day product execution and the roadmap for our only-of-its kind refinance title decisioning platform

• Start with the outcome: define the customer, the value, and the measurable result for each initiative before designing the solution

• Translate product strategy into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria

• Manage and prioritize roadmap deliverables and milestones across multiple workstreams and teams, making clear trade-offs against company OKRs and capacity

• Partner closely with engineering, data science, and platform through the entire life cycle to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions

• Use domain expertise, reporting and analytics, and customer feedback to improve how our automation and AI capabilities perform

Metrics, Monitoring & Product Health

• Define and track key product and operational metrics, and own the results against company OKRs

• Own the health of your capability area, including accuracy, cost, service levels, and reuse across products

• Monitor trends and proactively identify risks, anomalies, or performance issues

• Partner with engineering and operations to investigate issues and drive resolution

• Create dashboards and reporting that improve transparency and accountability

Partner & Stakeholder Management

• Act as the product point of contact for internal teams and external partners

• Bring a point of view to roadmap reviews and leadership: come with a recommendation, communicate what matters, and use debate to sharpen the thinking

• Partner with business development teams in support of new customer onboarding and implementation, as well as monitor the ongoing detection of pain points and opportunities that can be addressed by our products

• Make sure dependencies are well understood and documented

Workflow & Continuous Improvement

• Collaborate across functions to identify pain points and opportunities for automation, efficiency, and error reduction

• Establish feedback loops to continuously improve our products, systems, and processes

Desired Skills & Experience:

• Experience: 6+ years of relevant product management experience, including leading cross-functional initiatives for B2B, platform, data, or AI/ML-enabled products

• Impact: A prior focus on delivering impactful enterprise workflow, automation, and/or machine-learning or AI products that positively benefit key customer and business goals.

• Strategy: Business acumen and a strong data-driven and judgment-driven decision-making skillset. The ability to convert this into a high-ROI roadmap and to make and explain trade-offs between competing priorities.

• Creativity and Design Thinking: Fearlessly innovative in undeveloped space, with independent identification of differentiated, powerful, and user delightful solutions.

• Execution: Strong executional abilities to help engineering, data science and others have the necessary context, understanding of goals, and clarity of acceptance criteria. Being able to identify risks proactively and problem-solve to mitigate them.

• Technical Fluency: Comfort with APIs, data pipelines, and the machine-learning lifecycle (training data, evaluation, monitoring, and retraining), and the ability to evaluate data quality, accuracy, and cost with engineering and data science partners.

• Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with an emphasis on communicating technical requirements and solutions to internal and external audiences, including bringing clear recommendations to senior leaders.

• Collaboration: Ability to drive successful alignment across different internal and external stakeholders and leadership.

• Autonomy: The ability to work autonomously and constantly being able to convert ambiguity into clarity.

• Domain (Extra Credit): Experience in title, escrow, mortgage, real estate, or another regulated financial-services workflow, or a demonstrated ability to learn a complex, regulated domain quickly.

jobs.title: Engineering Technician (Process development/CMP/Production
jobs.description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

Process Technician – ALD Applications & Process Development

Job Description

At ASM, we are advancing semiconductor manufacturing through innovation in Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) and enabling our customers to develop the next generation of memory, logic, and specialty semiconductor devices. We are seeking a highly motivated Process Technician to join our Applications and Process Development team in a fast-paced laboratory environment supporting leading-edge semiconductor technologies.

As a member of the team, you will support process development, customer demonstrations, tool operations, and laboratory activities associated with advanced ALD technologies. The ideal candidate is hands-on, detail-oriented, safety-focused, and thrives in a collaborative environment where priorities can change quickly.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Operate and maintain advanced ALD, CMP, Metrology production systems supporting process development, customer demonstrations, and technology qualification activities.

• Perform wafer handling, sample preparation, process execution, and post-process metrology activities.

• Execute process experiments, collect process data, and maintain accurate experimental records.

• Monitor tool performance and assist in routine preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, and recovery activities.

• Support chamber qualification, process characterization, and tool matching activities.

• Participate in tool ownership activities, Best Known Method (BKM) development, laboratory sustaining, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Ensure adherence to all safety protocols involving semiconductor process equipment, chemicals, gases, and facility systems.

• Participate in cross-training across multiple process modules and characterization techniques.

The Ideal Candidate Will Demonstrate

• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality execution.

• Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

• Willingness to interface with engineers, technicians, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strong safety mindset and commitment to laboratory best practices.

• Continuous learning mindset and interest in advanced semiconductor technologies.

Minimum Qualifications

• High School diploma; OR Associate degree, technical certification, military technical training, or equivalent experience in Engineering Technology, Electronics, Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Ability to follow detailed procedures, experimental plans, and safety protocols.

Preferred Qualifications

• 2+ years of hands-on experience in semiconductor manufacturing, semiconductor equipment, process development laboratories, or a related high-technology environment.

• Experience operating semiconductor process equipment in a production, engineering, or R&D setting.

• Basic understanding of semiconductor wafer processing and contamination control practices.

• Previous experience with tool ownership, process transfer, equipment qualification, or process sustainment activities.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Marketing
jobs.description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

SambaNova is looking for a Head of Corporate Marketing (Senior Director or VP-level) to build and lead the corporate marketing function within a broader marketing organization led by the CMO. This is a rare opportunity to shape the brand, creative, web, content, and event presence of one of the most important independent players in AI infrastructure — at a moment when the market is actively re-evaluating what comes after GPUs.

You will own corporate brand identity, website and digital presence, content creation, creative services, and large-scale corporate and industry events, while partnering closely with product marketing, demand generation, developer relations, and the CMO to make sure every external touchpoint — website, events, content, creative, executive platform — reinforces a single, sharp story about why SambaNova and our AI inference architecture matter.

The right candidate has run corporate or brand marketing at some scale inside a fast-moving tech company, is comfortable being the connective tissue between the CMO's vision and the company's go-to-market motion, and knows how to build a team and function from a solid but still-forming base.

Responsibilities

• Own SambaNova's overall brand strategy, brand identity, and positioning across all external channels.

• Own all creative services, ensuring visual and verbal consistency across web, events, campaigns, and content.

• Own SambaNova's website and web presence, including SEO/AEO strategy, to strengthen discoverability and digital credibility.

• Own content creation and production — including thought leadership, POV/POC content, and the company blog — executing against direction set by the CMO to reinforce a single, sharp narrative.

• Own corporate and large-scale third-party industry events, setting the strategy and ensuring flawless execution for major launches, conferences, and keynotes.

• Serve as a close partner to the CMO, translating brand and content strategy into flawless execution across all channels.

• Lead integrated brand marketing campaigns that tie together brand, product launches, events, and demand generation into one coherent story.

• Build, mentor, and scale a corporate marketing team, while working cross-functionally with product marketing, DevRel, Sales, and field teams.

• Manage relationships with outside creative and event agencies to keep execution high-quality and on-brand.

• Bring structure and rigor to marketing operations — planning, budgeting, and measuring the impact of brand, creative, and content investment.

• Represent the company externally as a credible technical and business spokesperson when needed.

What We're Looking For

• 8+ years in corporate marketing, brand, or creative leadership, with at least 2-3 years in a senior leadership role (Senior Director, Head of, or VP level).

• Direct experience building or scaling a marketing function inside a high-growth technology company — infrastructure, semiconductors, cloud, or enterprise AI strongly preferred.

• Track record of shaping company narrative and brand at an inflection point (new category, major launch, funding milestone, or public-market transition).

• Strong executive presence and experience acting as a strategic partner to a CMO or senior marketing leader.

• Deep familiarity with what it takes to build brand credibility and trust in a technical, skeptical market.

• Hands-on experience owning a website, SEO/AEO, and digital brand presence.

• Proven people-leadership skills — has built and run teams, not just functions.

• Comfortable operating with startup speed and ambiguity while still bringing enterprise-grade marketing discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience marketing chips, accelerators, datacenter hardware, or AI/ML infrastructure.

• Experience owning or elevating a company's presence at major industry events (e.g., Nvidia GTC, AWS re:Invent, Web Summit).

• Experience directing content strategy — thought leadership, POV/POC content, and blog — in a technical category.

• Experience marketing through a major company milestone (IPO, large funding round, high-profile acquisition, category creation).

• Public-facing credibility of their own (interviews, panels, bylines, podcast appearances).

• Bay Area-based or willing to work closely and in-person with the CMO and marketing leadership team.

Base Salary Range:

Base Pay Range

$270,000—$330,000 USD

Submission Guidelines
Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.

SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. jobs.title: Non-CDL Delivery Driver
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Non-CDL Delivery Driver

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Non-CDL Delivery Driver at our rental facility in Atlanta, GA, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. The Non-CDL Driver will safely and efficiently deliver equipment, products, and materials to customers in a timely and professional manner.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and offers overtime pay after working 40 hours. (This role is subject to on-call scheduling with additional compensation provided)

Primary Responsibilities

We don’t just deliver equipment - we deliver innovation. At EquipmentShare, our technology ensures that our drivers work efficiently and effectively by providing real-time access to fleet locations, work orders, and delivery details.

• Operates vehicles according to applicable state and federal transportation laws.

• Transport loads safely and in a timely manner over required routes, obeying all traffic laws and observing all safety regulations.

• Deftly maneuvers truck and trailer into loading and unloading areas; follows loading crew signals.

• Assists with loading of or loads and unloads goods and materials, using specialized equipment when warranted; unloads empty skids and returns all equipment to designated area.

• Maintains signed invoices, shipping bills of lading, and other required paperwork; delivers documentation to shipping office or other appropriate staff when delivery route is complete.

• Facilitates routine service on trucks, which may include checking oil, water, gasoline, and air; reports maintenance malfunctions to Shipping Supervisor.

• Arranges trailers in shipping yards for optimum loading patterns.

• Performs other related duties as assigned.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Tool and boot reimbursements (role dependent)

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events, food truck nights, and monthly dinner nights

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

Required Skills/Abilities:

• Strong interpersonal and customer service skills with the ability to speak professionally and courteously with customers and staff at delivery points.

• Ability to remain focused in a busy environment.

• Delivery Drivers may be required to be clean shaven in order to enter worksites for EquipmentShare customers who have this requirement

Education and Experience:

• Must hold either a commercial drivers license or chauffeur’s license depending on state, appropriate for weight of vehicle to be operated.

jobs.title: System Security Engineer, Space
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Space team is dedicated to expanding our AI-powered capabilities into the final frontier, enhancing Space Domain Awareness, Space Control, and Command and Control for U.S. military and allied partners. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested warfighting domain.

ABOUT THE JOB

We're hiring a Systems Security Engineer to own that architecture. You'll be the technical security authority on one or more space programs. You'll work directly with subsystem Responsible Engineers (REs) across flight software, avionics, RF/comms, and ground, and with Government customers, to make sure each system holds up against real threats and can prove it at every milestone.

This is an engineering role, not a compliance role. You won't run RMF paperwork or administer accreditation packages; we have ISSOs and ISSMs for that, and you'll partner with them closely. Your job is to make the system secure. Theirs is to show it.

You'll take a program from customer need to on-orbit operations. You'll turn threat intelligence and mission requirements into a security architecture, break that architecture down into requirements each subsystem team can build to, and verify that what gets built matches what was designed. Your work covers the whole system: the spacecraft bus, the payload, the command and telemetry links, the ground segment, and the supply chain behind all of them.
You'll have real ownership and a direct line to program leadership and the customer. When a trade comes up between security, schedule, mass, power, or cost, you'll be in the room making the call.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own the end-to-end security architecture for assigned space systems, across the space, ground, link, and user segments

• Derive security requirements from customer needs, threat assessments, and applicable space security policy, then flow them down to subsystem specifications

• Design protections for command and telemetry links, including authentication, encryption, anti-replay, and key management approaches

• Define the onboard security foundation: secure boot, hardware root of trust, firmware and software integrity, memory protection, and secure update paths for systems that can't be physically touched after launch

• Build and maintain threat models and attack trees for the full mission, and use them to drive design decisions

• Partner with flight software, avionics, RF, and ground REs to turn security requirements into working implementations, then review designs and code against them

• Develop and run security verification at every integration level: unit, subsystem, flatsat, spacecraft, and end-to-end with the ground segment

• Work with internal and external red teams and assessment teams to find weaknesses in our products and integrated third-party components, then drive fixes to closure

• Assess supplier hardware and software for supply chain risk and set the security requirements we put on vendors

• Own the security content at major milestones: SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and PSR

• Brief security architectures to Government customers, program leadership, and technical reviewers, adjusting the depth for each audience

• Partner with ISSOs and ISSMs so design decisions support accreditation instead of fighting it late in the program

• Help build out reusable security patterns, reference architectures, and tooling across Anduril's space programs

REQUIREMENTS

• Experience designing security architectures for complex, multi-segment systems (spacecraft bus, payload, ground segment, RF/comms links)

• Ability to decompose system-level security architecture into subsystem-level requirements that engineering teams can actually build and test against

• Hands-on understanding of threat modeling and the ability to translate threat intelligence into concrete design decisions

• Experience working across disciplines — flight software, avionics, RF/comms, ground systems — and enough technical depth in each to hold your own with the subsystem REs

• Familiarity with the full system lifecycle from requirements through verification and on-orbit operations

• Experience with supply chain security as it applies to space or defense systems

• Ability to make and defend engineering trade-offs where security competes with schedule, mass, power, or cost

• Direct experience working with U.S. Government customers on classified or sensitive programs

• Active security clearance (almost certainly TS/SCI given the "space programs" and government customer context, though the posting doesn't say explicitly)

• Strong communication skills — you're the security voice in the room with program leadership and the customer, not writing reports from a back office

• CCNP certification or equivalent advanced networking credential

US Salary Range

$183,000—$243,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

You will support the day-to-day work of the Auth0 Design team. You will coordinate design craft logistics, help designers get the most from their tools, run team programs and rituals, and organize activities that support team culture. - Gather feedback on team activities, share themes with leaders, and help put agreed improvements into practice.

Design team operations and metrics

- Manage incoming Design Ops requests and keep team calendars and process documentation current.

- Track measures related to Design Ops work, such as onboarding progress, tool access requests, participation in team programs, AI usage, and the regularity of craft sessions.

Northpoint Recovery Holdings, LLC began 2009 as Ashwood Outpatient and officially launched the Northpoint platform in 2015. Now celebrating 10 years of growth in 2025, Northpoint is a leading behavioral healthcare provider offering evidence-based treatment for adults with substance use and co-occurring disorders through the Northpoint Recovery brand, and mental health treatment for adolescents through Imagine by Northpoint. Operating under an in-network, commercial insurance model, Northpoint has grown exclusively through de novo expansion—from two facilities to twenty across the Western U.S.—with more planned in both existing and new markets. We’re guided by core values of humility, heart, inspiration, and conviction. Our mission is simple: saving lives and restoring relationships by helping people get their lives back, and treating every individual with empathy and respect.

POSITION SUMMARY:

As a key member of the Northpoint clinical team, the Medical Assistant – Clinical Support will provide direct clinical and operational support to the nursing and medical teams in the care of patients receiving residential substance use disorder treatment. The Medical Assistant will assist with the collection of patient information, vital signs, laboratory specimens, EKGs, medication-related duties as permitted by applicable law and certification, inventory management, and other clinical support activities. This position will work closely with Registered Nurses, Advanced Practice Providers, physicians, therapists, case managers, and other members of the multidisciplinary treatment team to promote safe, efficient, compassionate, and high-quality patient care. The Medical Assistant will support the nursing team by completing delegated clinical tasks within the individual's education, training, certification, competency, and applicable scope of practice. The Medical Assistant will promptly communicate changes in patient condition, abnormal findings, patient concerns, and other clinically significant observations to the appropriate licensed clinical staff.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES INCLUDE:

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Counsel - North America
jobs.description:
POWER A WORLD OF TRUST

Incode is the leading provider of world-class identity solutions that is reinventing the way humans authenticate and verify their identities online to power a world of digital trust.

Through our revolutionary identity solutions, we are unleashing the business potential of universal industries including finance, government, retail, hospitality, gaming, and more, by reducing fraud and transforming human interactions with data, products, and services.

We’re in the process of rapidly scaling our diverse global team and we’re looking for entrepreneurial individuals and leaders who are curious, driven, and excited by ownership to join a Unicorn-status scale-up!

About Incode

Incode is a Series B unicorn ($1.25 B valuation) rewriting how the world proves identity. Our AI-powered platform lets leading banks, fintechs, marketplaces, and governments deliver friction-free experiences while defeating fraud and safeguarding privacy. Customers such as Citi, AirBnB, Block, Chime, Sixt, and TikTok rely on Incode to power their identity verification and security. Recently named a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Identity Verification, we’re scaling fast—and we need a product-marketing leader who can turn breakthrough technology into a category-defining narrative.

The Impact You'll Have

As our Senior Commercial Counsel, North America, you will own customer-facing commercial contracting across the U.S. and Canada taking deals from inception to signature. You will be the legal partner our Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success teams turn to for fast, commercially minded, risk-balanced negotiation of Proof of Concept (POC) Agreements, Master Services Agreements (MSAs), Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), order forms, renewals, and amendments.

This is a hands-on, high-volume role for a senior commercial lawyer who is energized by closing deals, comfortable as the single point of accountability for a contract, and fluent in the data privacy and regulatory issues that come with selling identity, biometric, and fraud-prevention technology into highly regulated industries. You will work daily with business stakeholders and counterparties, and partner with our Privacy, InfoSec, and Product teams to land agreements that protect Incode while keeping deals moving. Beyond the deal table, you'll counsel Product and Engineering on new products and features and go-to-market, keeping Incode's launches and customer commitments aligned.

What You’ll Own & Drive

Product & Go-To-Market (GTM)

• Advise Product and Engineering teams on new products and features, from design stage through launch and across the full product lifecycle.

• Identify and mitigate legal and regulatory risk across new and existing products and features.

• Monitor evolving privacy, biometric, and AI-related legal and regulatory developments across the U.S. and Canada and proactively flag changes that affect Incode's products or contracting positions.

• Review and approve product-related marketing and external communications, with a focus on consumer protection, unfair/deceptive practices, and privacy posture.

• Act as the trusted, responsive legal partner to Sales, Account Management, and Customer Success setting expectations, communicating ETAs, and unblocking deals against quarter-end and go-live timelines.

• Translate complex legal and privacy concepts into practical guidance business teams can act on and escalate novel or high-risk issues to the General Counsel with a clear recommendation.

• Integrate emerging AI governance and AI-ethics frameworks into responsible product development.

• Develop deep fluency in Incode's proprietary technology and product architecture to provide grounded, practical advice.

Commercial Negotiations

• Own end-to-end drafting, review, and negotiation of the full range of customer commercial agreements across the North America market in addition to POCs, MSAs, and DPAs, you will negotiate OEM and reseller/partner agreements, NDAs/MNDAs, and amendments.

• Serve as the single accountable owner (“hold the pen”) for assigned deals, driving them from first review through redlines, issue resolution, and final execution.

• Review and negotiate third-party (customer) paper, quickly identifying material risks, deviations from Incode's positions, and the handful of points truly worth negotiating.

• Lead customer-facing calls and direct negotiations, advising the business on key commercial terms — limitation of liability, indemnification, term and renewal, SLAs, fees and pricing interplay, IP and trademark use, and termination.

• Provide clear, documented sign-off for signature and partner with Legal Operations on Salesforce and legal software intake workflows.

Your Background

• D. (or equivalent) and admission to, and good standing in, at least one U.S. state bar.

• 7+ years of relevant experience as a commercial/technology transactions lawyer, ideally a mix of top law firm and in-house experience at a fast-paced technology company.

• Demonstrated track record negotiating and closing complex customer agreements end-to-end, including on customer paper.

• Strong, working knowledge of data privacy law applicable to North America (e.g., U.S. state privacy laws, biometric privacy statutes such as BIPA, and Canadian frameworks including PIPEDA and Québec's Law 25), and the ability to apply it in a commercial contracting context with the support of the Privacy Legal Team.

• Experience supporting customers in highly regulated environments financial services and banking, government/public sector, gaming, gambling, adult entertainment, medical/healthcare, or similar and comfort with the heightened diligence those deals require across the U.S. and Canada.

• Excellent drafting, negotiation, and judgment; able to distinguish must-have protections from nice-to-haves and to take clear positions under deal pressure.

• Highly responsive, organized, and able to manage a high volume of simultaneous deals and stakeholders in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

The Qualities That Set You Apart

• Qualification to practice law in Canada.

• Experience with CLM tooling and Salesforce.

• Familiarity with identity, biometrics, or fraud-prevention technology.

Aspects of our Culture:

• High performance

• Freedom & responsibility

• Context, not control

• Highly aligned, loosely coupled

• Continuous Feedback

• Promotions & Development

• Learn more about Life at Incode!

Benefits & Perks:

• Flexible Working Hours & Workplace

• Open Vacation Policy

Incode is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. We take great pride in having an inclusive, diverse, and global team, and we are always looking for talented and passionate individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. As part of our commitment to inclusion, we ensure that reasonable accommodations are available throughout the hiring process. If you require any accommodation due to a disability or specific need, please let our Talent Acquisition team know—we’ll do our best to support you.

We will only use your personal information concerning Incode’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes.
