As a One Medical Phlebotomist/Administrative Assistant (internally known as Lab Services Specialist/Member Support Specialist) at one of our offices, you’ll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers. Our Float Lab Services Specialist/Member Support Specialist support multiple offices in a Market.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you’ll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions, both clinical and administrative, and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• Provide best in class venipuncture services on a population ranging from pediatrics to geriatrics, depending on the office location

• Perform and assist with extended scope duties such as, but not limited to non-blood specimen collection, EKGs/ECGs, vitals, ear lavages, vaccines, PPD tests, and swabs

• Maintain high standards of in-office care through proper specimen labeling, handling and processing, inventory upkeep, and tool sterilization

• Continue to care for our members beyond the lab room by answering patient messages, following up on lab cases and assisting our providers and virtual medical team with clerical duties such as, but not limited to biometric screening forms, medical record and consult review, billing inquiries, and DOH reporting

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

• Master our technology suite including, but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, Circulation, RingCentral, and our Electronic Medical Record System, in order to interact with team members and complete daily work

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 6 months of relevant experience as a Medical Assistant or Phlebotomist outside of a training/externship environment

• Strong customer service skills, including ability to establish and maintain effective customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, bilingual applicants encouraged to apply

• A High School Diploma or equivalent

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse, multi-disciplinary teams (additional experience with remote teams a plus)

• A proven ability to display confidence and instill trust during the collection process while delivering individualized, human-centered, customer-focused care

• A proven track record of persisting through change, consistently stepping up to take action on challenges, and learning quickly and effectively when faced with new situations or tasks

This is a full time role (40 hours/week) with 8 hour shifts generally taking place between Monday-Friday 7:00am-6:00pm. The role is based in the Congress office in Austin, TX. Float Lab Services Specialists/Member Support Specialists lend support to multiple One Medical locations in a market and location and schedule are subject to change.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

jobs.title: Director, Facilities
jobs.description:
Position: Director, Facilities

Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Department: Operations

Location: Boulder, CO (onsite)

Experience: 10+ years of relevant industry experience, including 5+ years in facilities leadership roles

Position Summary

Watchmaker Genomics is seeking a seasoned Facilities Director to lead our facilities operations and strategy at our Boulder, CO headquarters. This senior leadership role reports to the Vice President, Operations and is responsible for the long-term planning, development, compliance, and optimization of all facilities-related functions. The Director will oversee the physical infrastructure that supports our critical R&D, manufacturing, and office operations, ensuring alignment with strategic business goals and regulatory standards.

The ideal candidate is an experienced facilities leader who excels in strategic planning, cross-functional collaboration, and operational excellence within regulated life science or advanced manufacturing environments. You will play a pivotal role in shaping a safe, compliant, and scalable operational environment that supports Watchmaker’s continued growth.

Responsibilities

Strategic Facilities Leadership

• Develop and execute a long-term facilities strategy that supports company growth, scientific innovation, and operational efficiency.

• Lead space planning initiatives including laboratory expansions, equipment commissioning, office renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.

• Collaborate with executive leadership to align facilities planning with company-wide strategic goals.

Facilities Operations Management

• Oversee the operation, maintenance, and optimization of all building systems including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, office, and critical manufacturing infrastructure.

• Establish and enforce best-in-class preventive maintenance programs and vendor management protocols.

• Ensure uninterrupted operations through robust risk management, business continuity, and emergency response plans.

Capital Projects & Budget Oversight

• Manage facilities-related capital projects from design through execution, including scope, budget, and timeline.

• Develop and manage the annual facilities operating and capital expenditure budgets.

• Lead contractor negotiations and vendor relationships to ensure cost-effective and high-quality service delivery.

Compliance & Documentation

• Ensure facilities and equipment comply with local, state, and federal regulations, including ISO and OSHA standards.

• Oversee and maintain documentation for audits, inspections, and regulatory submissions. Act as a point of contact during audits and inspections and lead the implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).

Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S)

• Serve as the executive sponsor of the company’s EH&S program; ensure compliance with all safety protocols, policies, and training requirements.

• Lead the EH&S committee and ensure a culture of safety across all functions.

• Stay current on evolving safety regulations and industry standards.

Team Leadership and Development

• Build and manage a high-performing facilities and EH&S team, including facilities technicians, contractors, and safety personnel.

• Provide mentorship, professional development, and clear performance expectations for team members.

• Foster a collaborative and accountable culture within the operations department.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify and lead initiatives to improve energy efficiency, space utilization, sustainability, and cost management.

• Evaluate and implement new technologies to enhance facility performance and monitoring capabilities.

• Stay abreast of industry trends and recommend strategic improvements accordingly.

Skills and Requirements

Technical Expertise

• In-depth knowledge of complex building systems, laboratory infrastructure, and manufacturing environments.

• Strong understanding of facilities operations in regulated life science or pharmaceutical settings.

• Experience in capital project management, EH&S leadership, and regulatory compliance.

Leadership & Communication

• Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage external stakeholders, including contractors, auditors, and regulatory bodies.

• Exceptional planning, organizational, and decision-making skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills across technical and executive audiences.

Education and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, facilities management, operations, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years of industry experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership capacity. Demonstrated success managing complex facilities operations in a fast-paced, growth-stage biotech or life sciences environment.

Compensation

The base compensation for the Facilities Director role starts at $140,000 - $160,000 + bonus + equity; actual pay will be adjusted based on skills and experience. Employees are eligible for Flexible Time Off, Holidays, employer covers 75% of base medical plan with buy-up options, EAP (employee assistance program), employer paid dental with a buy-up option, employer paid vision, employer paid $25,000 life/AD&D policy, paid parental leave, and a 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% match.

Application Requirements

To apply for the position, please submit the following in a PDF format on watchmakergenomics.com:

• Letter of motivation (upload where it says cover letter)

• Resume or Curriculum vitae, highlighting relevant qualifications and experience

Applications without a Letter of Motivation will not be considered. Local candidates preferred.

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis and the position will remain open until filled; however, early submission is encouraged as review will begin immediately.

If selected to participate in the interview process, the names and contact information of three professional references who are able to assess your suitability for the position in terms of the specified requirements will be requested.

*** NO RECRUITMENT AGENCIES PLEASE

We are only accepting direct applications for this position. We are not working with external recruiters or agencies at this time. Unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from third-party recruiters will not be considered and will be deemed the property of Watchmaker Genomics.

*** WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY/AFFIRMATIVE ACTION EMPLOYER

Watchmaker Genomics is committed to being an equal opportunity employer and creating a culturally diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, or veteran status or any other characteristics as protected by applicable law.

All applicants will be asked if currently eligible to work in the United States of America; and if now or in the future will require visa sponsorship to continue working in the United States.

This position may be subject to pre-employment checks, including driving history check, drug screening and a background check for any convictions directly related to its duties and responsibilities. All pre-employment checks will comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Portal Application
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Are you ready to make a real impact on people's lives and be a part of a rapidly-growing team? Natera is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help design, develop, and maintain our web portal application serving providers. As a member of our engineering team, you will play a key role in improving the user experience and functionality, ultimately helping to positively impact patient outcomes. Join us in our mission to change the way cancer is managed, and be a part of a team of dedicated professionals who are passionate about making a difference.

Senior Software Engineer - Portal Application is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of microservices for our provider-facing web portal. The role requires working with a mix of modern and legacy technologies in a rapidly changing environment and the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and systems. Together with the talented Engineering Team, Product Managers and Designers, you will work on new and exciting experiences for our customers.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Participate in design and technical implementation decisions and help guide key stakeholders on the team, such as product managers, UI/UX designers, to ensure that design and technical decisions meet a high standard of excellence.

• Work closely with Product Managers to gather requirements, walk through the design with stakeholders, and support software all the way from initial ideation to release, operation, and maintenance.

• Participate in designing, building, and maintaining highly available systems to support our business applications, users, providers, and patients.

• Perform code reviews and mentor the development team with best practices.

• Continue improving process and procedure and evangelizing best practices.

• Support QA activities in conjunction with our QA engineering teams.

• Be a contributing team member to the end-to-end execution of compliance initiatives.

• This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and have access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job.

• Must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.

• Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

• BS degree in computer science, comparable program, or equivalent.

• 6+ years of overall software development experience, preferably secure, scalable web applications with NodeJS, TypeScript, React, and other web technologies.

• Experience with front-end development.

• Experience with software development lifecycle process from build, software configuration, change control, release and deployment activities.

• Extensive knowledge and experience with Test-Driven Development and/or Domain-Driven Development Experience with service-oriented and microservice architecture.

• Experience building, maintaining, troubleshooting, and expanding software within the AWS ecosystem: EC2, ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, S3, etc.

• Experience with GraphQL and REST API design and event-driven architecture using distributed event stores (such as Kafka).

• Experience with micro-service enterprise architecture, cross-platform integration, and building scalable applications in heterogeneous environments.

• Strong relational database skills including database design and optimization.

• Demonstrated teamwork skills with a solid analytical background.

• Excellent organizational, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

• Linux Fundamentals

• Object Oriented Programming

• Relational Database and SQL Programming, prefer MySQL or PostgreSQL

• JavaScript Programming

• Java Programming is nice to have

• SQL and NoSQL database experience including MySQL, ElasticSearch, and DynamoDB

• AWS Services, such as EC2, Lambdas, Step Functions, SQS, S3, and SNS

• Build infrastructure as code with Terraform and Cloud Formation

• Docker or container-oriented technologies

• GraphQL and REST APIS

• Event-Driven Microservice Architecture

• Experience with front-end technologies such as NextJS, React, Sass, Material, HTML, CSS, Javascript, NodeJS.

• CI / CD (Gitlab)

• Quality Assurance Mindset

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$125,600—$157,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

For more information:
- BBB announcement on job scams
- FBI Cyber Crime resource page

jobs.title: Junior IT Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Junior IT Support Engineer to independently handle day-to-day employee IT in a highly technical robotics and AI environment. You will support Mac, Linux, and Windows machines, networking, identity and access, and office technology for teams that build and test robots every day. Working closely our IT & Security Lead, you will own the IT ticket queue and run onboarding and off-boarding end to end. This is a hands-on role with the opportunity to build the run books and repeatable processes that help IT scale as Skild AI grows.

Responsibilities

• Provision, configure, inventory, and retire Mac laptops through Iru (formerly Kandji).

• Build and image Linux laptops and desktops for engineering teams, and support Windows machines where needed.

• Troubleshoot hardware and OS issues, and manage repairs, loaners, and vendor RMAs.

• Troubleshoot wired, Wi-Fi, VPN, and connectivity issues for employees and lab equipment.

• Support office network changes, including patching, port assignments, and device onboarding.

• Run new-hire setup end to end, from accounts, devices, and access to a first-day walkthrough, and run offboarding, including device recovery, access removal, and data handoff.

• Handle SSO and MFA enrollment, resets, and basic access requests, and support day-to-day Google Workspace and Slack administration.

• Maintain conference rooms, A/V, printers, and other onsite technology.

• Work the IT ticket queue, meet response targets, and keep tickets clean and up to date.

• Write run books and build repeatable processes so common requests get faster over time.

Preferred Qualifications

• 2–4 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, help desk, or IT operations.

• Strong macOS support skills, and comfortable supporting Linux and Windows.

• Hands-on experience installing and configuring Linux (e.g., Ubuntu) on laptops and desktops.

• Experience with Iru/Kandji, Jamf, or a similar endpoint management tool.

• Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including DHCP, DNS, VLANs, and Wi-Fi and VPN troubleshooting.

• Experience running employee onboarding and offboarding, and with basic SSO and MFA administration (Okta or similar).

• Ticket-queue discipline, clear written documentation, and a strong service orientation with both technical and non-technical teams.

• Scripting in Bash, Python, or zsh to automate setup tasks is a plus.

• Experience with broader SaaS administration, enterprise network gear (e.g., Arista, Palo Alto), RADIUS-based Wi-Fi, or conference room systems (Google Meet or Zoom Rooms) is a plus.

• Experience at a fast-growing startup, or in AI, robotics, hardware, or engineering-heavy environments, is a plus.

• Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Linux+, or Apple ACSP are a plus.

• Builder mindset; comfortable working independently in a small, fast-moving, in-person team.

Location

This is a full-time, fully onsite role in San Mateo, CA, and requires the ability to lift and move hardware.

jobs.title: Senior Workday Payroll Architect
jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.



If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.



Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco or San Jose office location 4 days per week; Lambda's designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.



Business Technology at Lambda builds and scales the internal systems that power our business. We partner across the company with Finance, GTM, Engineering, and People to implement tools, automate workflows, and ensure data flows securely and accurately. Our scope spans enterprise applications, integrations, data platform and analytics, compliance automation, and all things IT.



People Technology is the pillar that owns the systems every Lambda employee touches. We are in the middle of moving Lambda from Rippling to Workday as our HRIS, and payroll, time tracking, and absence are the workstreams where getting the details right matters most: every employee feels it on payday. We are hiring a Workday Payroll, Time tracking & Absence Lead to own these modules end to end, from implementation design through go-live and into steady-state operations. You will be our resident expert on how Workday calculates, accrues, and pays, for US employees running on Workday Payroll and for our international workforce running through Workday and our global payroll providers.



This is a hands-on configuration role for someone who knows Workday Payroll, Time Tracking, and Absence deeply, understands the compliance stakes across multiple jurisdictions, and is comfortable being the person People, Finance, and Payroll Operations call when a calculation looks wrong.



What You'll Do

 - Implementation: Serve as the functional lead for Payroll, Time Tracking, and Absence in our Workday implementation: drive design sessions, own configuration decisions, build and test the tenant alongside our implementation partner, and sign off on readiness for cutover, parallel testing, and hypercare.

 - US Payroll Configuration: Configure and maintain Workday Payroll for US & Canada employees: pay groups, earnings and deductions, pay component groups, federal, state, and local tax setup, garnishments, payroll accounting, and period-end and year-end processing (W-2s, quarterly filings) with our tax filing provider.

 - International Payroll: Design and operate the flow between Workday and our international payroll providers (Workday Global Payroll Connect or PECI/PICOF-based integrations): payroll input files, results return, GL posting, and reconciliation for each country we operate in.

 - Time Tracking: Configure Time Tracking for hourly and non-exempt populations, including work schedules, time entry codes, time calculations (overtime, meal and rest break compliance, shift differentials), approvals, and state-specific rules.

 - Absence: Build and maintain Absence plans across US and international populations: flexible PTO, sick leave accruals by jurisdiction, statutory leave, and leave-of-absence types with the right eligibility, accrual, carryover, and payout rules.

 - Integrations & Data: Own the payroll-adjacent integration footprint (benefits carriers, 401k, tax filing, equity compensation, GL to NetSuite) and the data validation that keeps Workday, payroll results, and the general ledger in agreement.

 - Payroll Operations Partnership: Partner with Payroll Operations and Accounting on every payroll cycle: retro calculations, off-cycle payments, pre- and post-payroll audits, and root-cause analysis when results don't match expectations.

 - Compliance & Controls: Design payroll processes and Workday security so they satisfy SOX ITGC and payroll control requirements: segregation of duties, approval workflows, audit trails, and evidence capture. Support internal and external audit requests.

 - Releases & Roadmap: Stay current on Workday's semi-annual releases, assess impact on Payroll, Time tracking, and Absence, run regression testing, and adopt new functionality that removes manual work.

 - Enablement: Write the documentation, train HR, managers, and Payroll on how these modules work, and build the reports and dashboards that let the business self-serve.

You

 - Experience: 10+ years in HRIS or payroll systems, with at least 6+ years hands-on configuring Workday Payroll, Time Tracking, and Absence. You have taken at least one Workday Payroll implementation live as the functional lead, ideally with Time Tracking and Absence in the same phase.

 - Workday Depth: Fluent in payroll business processes, the calculation engine (calculated fields, pay component logic, custom reports), tax configuration, retro processing, and payroll accounting. Workday Payroll, Time Tracking, or Absence certification (or equivalent partner experience) strongly preferred.

 - Global Payroll: Have run or integrated international payroll through Workday, whether via Global Payroll Connect partners or custom integrations, and understand the data, timing, and reconciliation challenges that come with multiple countries and providers.

 - Payroll Knowledge: Know US payroll fundamentals cold: multi-state taxation, FLSA, wage and hour rules (especially California), garnishments, imputed income, equity compensation and RSU withholding, and year-end.

 - Compliance & Controls: Have operated in a SOX or audit-facing environment and understand why segregation of duties, approvals, and evidence matter in payroll.

 - Operating Rigor: You test thoroughly, document what you build, and never move a payroll change into production without a parallel run or reconciliation behind it.

 - Cross-functional Partnership: Comfortable translating between Payroll, People, Accounting, and Engineering. You can explain a retro calculation to a controller and a tax setup to a recruiter.

 - Adaptability: Comfortable with ambiguity and velocity at a pre-IPO company. Requirements change, headcount grows fast, new countries open, and you re-plan without drama.

 - Attitude: An enthusiastic, go-for-it attitude. When something looks off in a payroll result, you can't leave it alone until you find the root cause.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with configurations in Workday’s HCM, Benefit and compensation

 - Experience migrating from Rippling or another all-in-one HR/payroll platform to Workday.

 - Workday Pro certifications in Payroll, Time Tracking, Absence, or Integrations.

 - Experience with international payroll providers (for example ADP Celergo, CloudPay, Papaya Global, Deel) and employer-of-record arrangements.

 - Familiarity with the rest of our stack: NetSuite, Okta, Lumos, Workato, BigQuery.

 - IPO readiness experience, including payroll control design and equity compensation processing.

 - Experience using AI tooling to accelerate testing, documentation, or reconciliation.

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.





About Lambda

 - Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

 - Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

 - We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG

 - Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers

 - We offer generous cash & equity compensation

 - Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

 - Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles

 - 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)

 - Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

Equal Opportunity Employer

Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

jobs.title: Sr Fullstack Engineer - Growth
jobs.description:
THE MISSION 💪

Our mission is to ensure that no one in the world has to suffer from a treatable skin disease because of an access issue ever again.




ABOUT HONEYDEW 👋

Honeydew is building a platform for hundreds of millions of people globally to access expertise and science-backed skin treatments, from prescription to retail. Our tech-forward dermatology experience helps people with chronic skin conditions access licensed specialists, FDA-approved treatment, and ongoing support in record time. Honeydew is the future of skin health — digitally native, scientifically rooted, integrated end-to-end, and powered by AI.




THE OPPORTUNITY 📈

Our Growth Engineering and Patient Experience team has more growth and retention opportunities than it can act on at once. As Senior Software Engineer, you add the throughput: building the features and experiments across our TypeScript backend and React front end that help more patients start treatment, stay with it, and have an experience they'd recommend. You'll ship, measure, and learn alongside a product manager and designer, so the team can run more initiatives in parallel and improve the patient journey faster.




WHAT YOU'LL BUILD (YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS) 🛠

 - Growth and retention features: by day 60, at least two features or experiments in the patient journey shipped behind feature flags, with success metrics defined before launch; by day 180, at least six, contributing to a measurable improvement in at least one conversion or retention metric agreed with product

 - A patient journey you can measure: by day 60, an instrumentation audit of at least one key journey, such as onboarding, with the gaps closed; by day 180, every feature and experiment you ship launches with complete instrumentation and a results readout shared with product

 - A faster, more accessible front end: by day 60, performance and accessibility baselined on the core patient pages your team owns and the top three issues fixed; by day 180, those pages within agreed performance targets, with no P1 or P2 incidents caused by features you shipped


HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

Build growth features end to end. You'll work with the engineering lead, product manager, and designer to plan growth and retention initiatives, then build features across our TypeScript backend and React front end using agentic engineering methods.

Run experiments. You'll instrument features and experiments, ship them behind feature flags, and analyze results with product to decide what to build next.

Own the patient experience. You'll review other engineers' code, and investigate and fix incidents in the patient experience areas you own.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The Non-Negotiables:

 - Full-stack TypeScript — production experience building backend APIs in TypeScript on AWS (Lambda or ECS) and front-end features in React, ideally with MUI and Vite, and comfortable owning a feature from API to UI

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Build & Release
jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.



With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

Overview

We are looking for a Sr. Build & Release Software Engineer to join our team, focusing on the application software powering our satellite systems. In this role, you will take ownership of our compilation infrastructure, continuous integration pipelines, and dependency management across large-scale C++ codebases running in Embedded Linux environments.

You will operate at the intersection of software engineering and developer infrastructure, helping improve developer velocity, reduce build and test times, and maintain stable, repeatable releases across both simulated and hardware-integrated systems.

What You'll Do

 - Design, maintain, and optimize cross-platform build systems using tools such as CMake and Bazel.

 - Manage and upgrade compiler toolchains (GCC, Clang, etc.) while handling complex dependency graphs, third-party libraries, and internal package management.

 - Own, scale, and secure Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) workflows tailored for large-scale C++ applications.

 - Diagnose and optimize compilation and linking bottlenecks through caching, parallelization, and distributed build strategies.

 - Ensure seamless cross-compilation across multiple architectures including x86 and ARM.

 - Support testing in containerized and emulated environments using technologies such as Docker and QEMU.

 - Write robust tooling and automation scripts in Python and Bash for environment provisioning, static analysis, and artifact generation.

 - Partner closely with core C++ developers to improve modular architecture, dependency management, and overall build reliability.

 - Build reproducible and deterministic build and release environments across local development, CI, and hardware-integrated systems.

Required Qualifications

 - 3 - 5+ years of experience focused on Build/Release Engineering, Developer Infrastructure, or DevOps supporting complex C++ codebases.

 - Advanced proficiency with CMake and GNU Make/Ninja.

 - Strong Linux shell and scripting skills, including Bash.

 - Strong understanding of the C++ build, compilation, and linking lifecycle.

 - Familiarity with modern C++ standards (C++17/20/23).

 - Experience managing transitive dependencies and modular build targets.

 - Experience working within Linux-based development environments.

Desired Qualifications

 - Experience with Embedded Linux build systems such as Yocto or Buildroot.

 - Experience with hardware emulation tools such as QEMU and containerization platforms such as Docker.

 - Familiarity with GitLab CI workflows.

 - Background in embedded software development and/or aerospace systems.

 - Experience with distributed build systems such as Bazel remote execution.

 - Knowledge of linker internals, symbol visibility, and binary analysis tools such as ldd, nm, objdump, and readelf.

 - Familiarity with static and dynamic analysis tooling including Clang-Tidy, AddressSanitizer (ASan), and SonarQube.

For U.S. Roles: To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). 



For U.K. Roles: To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).



For Canada Roles: Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR. 



We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.description:

The Role

You will join Everpure’s Datastore team to design, develop, and validate embedded firmware for our DirectFlash™ modules. In this role, you will work across firmware and hardware boundaries to build reliable, high-performance storage solutions, while also developing virtual platforms and tooling that accelerate development, debugging, and validation. • Creating accurate, high-fidelity hardware models to abstract controller logic, communication interfaces (PCIe, NVMe), and NAND media behaviors within Pure Storage’s DirectFlash™ SSD Modules.

• Designing and implementing instrumentation tools to profile performance and analyze failures within the simulated environment.

• Automating CI/CD pipelines to seamlessly integrate simulation and virtual platforms into our firmware release and validation processes.

• Partnering closely with ASIC vendors to validate firmware behaviors against RTL and digital logic designs before physical silicon is available.

• 5+ years of experience building and scaling complex embedded, firmware, or hardware-software systems.

• Expert-level proficiency in C/C++ (object oriented design and C++ 11 and onwards) and strong Python skills for both firmware and modeling development.

• Deep understanding of firmware-hardware interaction, including the ability to translate complex schematics and data sheets into abstract software models.

• Solid Linux (kernel, bootloaders) understanding and ability to root‑cause across HW/FW boundaries.

• Strong knowledge of high-performance storage protocols such as PCIe and NVMe.

jobs.title: Principal Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imagine Pediatrics is a tech enabled, pediatrician led medical group reimagining care for children with special health care needs. We deliver 24/7 virtual first and in home medical, behavioral, and social care, working alongside families, providers, and health plans to break down barriers to quality care. We do not replace existing care teams; we enhance them, providing an extra layer of support with compassion, creativity, and an unwavering commitment to children with medical complexity.

What You’ll Do

As Principal Security Engineer with Imagine Pediatrics, you will set the technical vision for how we protect our systems, our data, and the children and families who trust us with their care. You will serve as a trusted security advisor to the VP, Information Security and work across the business to make secure the default way we build and run  technology, partnering closely with Engineering on DevSecOps strategy and architectural improvements.. You will stay hands-on with our hardest problems while raising the bar for the security team and the engineers around it.

You will:

• Set the technical vision for the security stack, including endpoint, email, data loss prevention, vulnerability management and penetration testing, network, application, and data security, and ensure it aligns with business and clinical strategy

• Define long-term cloud and identity security strategy across Microsoft Azure/EntraID and Amazon Web Services (AWS), including privileged access, phishing-resistant MFA, and governance of non-human identities such as AI agents, service accounts, and API keys, shaping secure infrastructure design patterns that influence company-wide technical decisions

• Lead security architecture review and threat modeling for Care Hub and connected services, including Medplum application-layer controls (FHIR access policies, SMART scopes, Bots, and custom code) and data platforms such as Snowflake

• Define DevSecOps strategy and standardize security gates across the SDLC and CI/CD pipeline, building on GitHub Advanced Security, OWASP Top 10 practices, software bills of materials, and prioritization of CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

• Serve as the senior technical escalation point (including in the on-call rotation) for the most complex and highest-stakes security events and strengthen incident playbooks, ransomware and critical-SaaS exercises, and restoration testing against recovery targets

• Monitor and advise on the evolving threat landscape facing healthcare including AI-enabled and agentic attacks and its implications for business strategy

• Ensure the organization can accurately demonstrate its security posture to payors, regulators, auditors, and other third parties, building documentation and evidence pipelines, including AI-assisted ones, that scale with our HITRUST, HIPAA, and NIST compliance requirements.

• Frame ambiguous, high-stakes security questions for the organization and drive them to well-reasoned, defensible answers delivering decision-ready recommendations, risk rankings, and documented resolution pathways.

• Ensure precision at the program level by driving guardrails such as automated configuration checks and drift detection, so misconfigurations are prevented systemically rather than caught individually

• Shape the technical sequencing of our multi-year security roadmap, contribute to quarterly engineering planning, and ensure the security program’s execution aligns with company strategy and the timelines that matter to the business

• Explore early-stage ideas and proofs of concept to de-risk future security initiatives before they are staffed or scoped

• Champion thoughtful AI adoption within security to reduce manual effort, and guide how AI tools and AI-enabled products are adopted securely across the company

• Partner with engineering, product, IT, and clinical stakeholders to embed security into how we design, build, and operate our digital products, translating complex security concepts for non-technical audiences

• Mentor the security engineering team, coach engineers across technology on security craftsmanship, and shape the team’s learning culture

• Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, advocating for security engineers while aligning security decisions with business priorities, and demonstrate executive-level composure in high-stakes, ambiguous situations

• Apply professional discretion and judgement when viewing sensitive and personal data or information in the process of conducting work

• Other duties as assigned

What You Bring & How You Qualify

First and foremost, you’re passionate and committed to reimagining pediatric health care and creating a world where every child with complex medical conditions gets the care and support they deserve. You will need:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Business, Management, or a related field is desired; advanced degree a plus

• Relevant license or certification(s): CISSP, CCSP, CISM, GIAC (e.g., GCIH, GCLD, GSEC), AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert preferred

• 10+ years of experience as a Security Engineer, Principal Security Engineer, Security Architect, or similar role(s), with at least 5 years of experience within the healthcare industry.

• A track record of setting security technical strategy and driving alignment across security, IT, and engineering teams

• Deep expertise in cloud and identity security architecture across AWS and Microsoft Azure/EntraID

• Hands-on application and product security experience, including threat modeling, secure SDLC and CI/CD design, and securing healthcare APIs (FHIR, SMART on FHIR); experience with Medplum is a plus

• Experience leading detection and response programs, including partnering with MDR providers and leading the technical response to serious security incidents and data breaches

• Extensive experience translating HITRUST and HIPAA Security Rule requirements into technical controls and supporting engagements with auditors, payors, and regulators

• Experience using Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a transformative technology to enhance and automate security processes, and an understanding of the security risks AI systems introduce

• Knowledge of IT systems such as AWS, Microsoft Intune, EntraID, CrowdStrike Falcon (EDR/SIEM), GitHub Advanced Security, Snowflake, JAMF, Meraki, and JIRA Service Management

• Strong collaboration and coaching skills, with demonstrated success developing senior engineers

• Comfort operating autonomously in ambiguity, exploring early-stage ideas without well-defined requirements

• Experience working in a fast-paced, hypergrowth, collaborative environment

• Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation

• Contributions to the broader security community, such as conference talks, publications, or industry threat intelligence sharing, are a plus

What We Offer (Benefits + Perks)

The role offers a base salary range of $195,000-$225,000 in addition to annual bonus incentive, competitive company benefits package, and eligibility to participate in an employee equity purchase program (as applicable). When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors including job-related knowledge, skills and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary.

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA; Company-funded HSA

• 401(k) with 4% match, vested 100% from day one

• Employer-paid short and long-term disability

• Life insurance at 1x annual salary

• 20 days PTO + 10 Company Holidays & 2 Floating Holidays

• Paid new parent leave

• Additional benefits to be detailed in offer

What We Live By

We’re guided by our five core values:

Our Values:

• Children First. We put the best interests of children above all. We know that the right decision is always the one that creates more safe days at home for the children we serve today and in the future.

• Earn Trust. We listen first, speak second. We build lasting relationships by creating shared understanding and consistently following through on our commitments.

• Innovate Today. We believe that small improvements lead to big impact. We stay curious by asking questions and leveraging new ideas to learn and scale.

• Embrace Humanity. We lead with empathy and authenticity, presuming competence and good intentions. When we stumble, we use the opportunity to grow and understand how we can improve.

jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

HR Generalist (People Experience Consultant)

San Mateo, CA (hybrid in office 2x a week)

We’re looking for an experienced Senior HR Generalist (People Experience Consultant) to join our People Experience (PX) team. This position will provide high-touch operational and strategic support to People & Places Business Partners and their client groups, with particular emphasis on Business and Product, Legal and Finance, AMER populations. The successful candidate will manage complex employee lifecycle activity, serve as a trusted escalation point, coordinate cross-functional programs, and translate business needs into accurate, well-controlled execution across Workday, ServiceNow, and partner teams. The role requires strong judgment, urgency, data discipline, and the ability to lead sensitive work through clear ownership, documentation, and follow-through.

Principal Duties/Responsibilities:

• Deliver HR services as an extension of the HRBP team and as part of the core PX service model, building strong relationships with business leaders and understanding the distinct needs of each client group.

• Support HRBPs with workforce planning, organizational design, talent and performance cycles, compensation planning, engagement activity, manager coaching, and other priority initiatives.

• Act as a Tier 2 escalation point for employee and manager questions, owning issues through resolution and coordinating with Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, Mobility, Employee Relations & Legal, and other COEs.

• Manage complex employee lifecycle activity, including job and organization changes, international transfers, relocations, performance processes, terminations, severance and post-exit questions, and related Workday transactions and approvals.

• Partner with Employee Relations and Legal on performance concerns, business cases, role eliminations, restructures, involuntary terminations, mutual separations, and other sensitive matters, applying sound judgment on cases that require escalation or handoff.

• Coordinate multi-region workforce change projects, including impact-data ownership, project plans, manager materials, employee communications, exit documentation, quality assurance, notification-day execution, and post-event follow-up.

• Own and maintain accurate trackers, impact sheets, coverage maps, process documentation, and shared repositories; establish a reliable source of truth and prevent duplicate or conflicting records.

• Support annual and mid-year talent, performance, promotion, and compensation processes, including manager guidance, data audits, exception management, access mapping, and issue resolution for populations outside standard system workflows.

• Maintain employee data and execute or coordinate Workday transactions with strong attention to confidentiality, approval controls, audit requirements, and timely completion.

• Manage ServiceNow cases assigned to the PX Consultant team, monitor aging and handoffs, and provide clear, responsive updates to employees, managers, and partner teams.

• Use data and dashboards to identify trends, strengthen controls, improve service delivery, and provide actionable insights to HRBPs and PX leadership.

• Drive continuous improvement by documenting repeatable workflows, defining roles and handoffs, creating manager and employee guidance, and using digital tools and AI to improve quality, speed, and consistency.

Required Knowledge / Skills:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 7+ years of progressive HR generalist, HR operations, or HRBP-support experience in a fast-paced, high-tech, creative, or entertainment environment.

• Proven success partnering with senior HR and business leaders and coordinating work across HRBPs, Employee Relations, Legal, Payroll, Compensation, Benefits, Mobility, Talent, and HR Technology.

• Strong business/commercial acumen, curiosity and high learning agility.

• Demonstrated experience managing sensitive employee matters, performance concerns, workforce changes, terminations, and post-exit issues with discretion and sound judgment.

• Working knowledge of U.S. employment laws and federal and state regulations; experience supporting Canada, Latin America, EMEA, or other international populations is strongly valued.

• Strong Workday capability, including employee data changes, organizational transactions, approvals, reporting, and audit-minded quality control.

• Strong AI skills, developing and deploying tools to assist personally and with the PXC team.

• Experience with ServiceNow or another HR case-management platform, including case ownership, escalation, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

• Advanced organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple confidential workstreams, deadlines, trackers, and stakeholders without losing accuracy or follow-through.

• Highly data literate, with experience auditing information, maintaining a source of truth, producing reports or dashboards, and translating data into decisions and process improvements.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear manager guidance, process documentation, employee communications, and executive-ready updates.

• Comfort operating in a global, matrixed environment and taking initiative where ownership, process, or handoffs are not yet fully defined.

• Strong Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel skills, with practical experience using AI and digital tools to improve HR service delivery.

Bonus

• PHR, SHRM-CP, or equivalent professional HR certification.

• Experience in the games, technology, media, or entertainment industry.

• Experience supporting engineering, product, finance, legal, or other complex client groups.

• Experience coordinating reductions in force, restructuring activity, global performance and compensation cycles, or international employee processes.

• Experience developing SOPs, dashboards, AI-enabled tools, or other scalable HR solutions.

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

$154,100—$231,100 USD

jobs.title: AI Administrator, Business Applications
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product,  the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.



What You’ll Do

We are seeking an AI Admin to administer and govern the AI tooling that Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai employees use for their work. The Business Applications (BizApps) team is the operational backbone for organizational collaboration, system connectivity, and process automation at Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai. We partner with every department to provide the platforms, guardrails, and integrations that eliminate manual toil safely and efficiently. We own and administer Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), Confluence, Rovo, Loom, Glean, and our citizen development platform, Workato. We hold ourselves to least-privilege access, data privacy, and auditable data flows in everything we build.

In this role, you will administer Glean and Rovo, and support configuration and access for work done in BizApps specific Claude, Gemini, and AWS Bedrock resources. You will manage access, connectors, and settings, and set up Projects, Skills, Gems, and agents of moderate complexity. You will help ensure AI tools reach only the data each person is entitled to see. You will scope and complete moderately complex projects with little direction.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Business Applications. You will work with the Senior Engineer on complex agent and automation builds, and with the IT Admins on shared platforms. The path from Admin to Senior Engineer is a defined growth route on this team.



This role will be responsible for:

 - Administer Glean, including data source connectors, user access, permissions, configuration, and usage monitoring

 - Administer Rovo, including agent availability, access, and settings within our Atlassian environment

 - Configure and support Projects, Skills, Gems, and agents in Claude, Gemini, and AWS Bedrock, including access groups and workspace settings related to BizApps assets and resources

 - Manage provisioning, deprovisioning, and licensing for AI platforms using role-based access control (RBAC)

 - Build and maintain lower-complexity agents, Projects, Skills, and Gems for business teams, and escalate complex builds to the Senior Engineer

 - Gather use case, data source, and access details from AI enablement requests and route them to the right platform and owner

 - Implement access controls and data handling standards for AI deployments with Security and IT Engineering, applying least-privilege access and checking connector permissions against source system permissions

 - Monitor AI tool usage for misuse, permission drift, and unexpected data exposure, and escalate concerns to Security and the Senior Manager

 - Maintain a current record of AI tools, connectors, and deployed agents, including owner, purpose, data access, and review date, to support audits

 - Track platform releases and changes, assess their impact on access and data handling, and communicate them to the team

 - Write user guidance and enablement content that helps employees use approved AI tools correctly

 - Report on adoption, license utilization, and platform health to the Senior Manager

 - Demonstrate a commitment to integrity, process improvement, and customer satisfaction




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Must have hands-on experience administering at least one enterprise AI, enterprise search, or comparable SaaS platform, including users, roles, permissions, and integrations

 - Must have hands-on experience configuring Projects, Skills, Gems, agents, or similar on at least one of Claude, Gemini, Glean, Rovo, or AWS Bedrock

 - Must have an understanding of RBAC, least-privilege access, and how source system permissions affect what an AI tool can retrieve or expose

 - Must have experience troubleshooting connector, access, and configuration problems and escalating them with clear diagnostic detail

 - Must be able to scope, plan, and complete moderately complex projects with little direction from a manager

 - Must be able to write clear guidance and documentation for technical and non-technical employees

 - Must be able to follow data handling and security requirements when working with AI tools that access company data


MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

 - Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 - 3+ years of experience in IT, business systems administration, or SaaS platform administration, including hands-on work with AI or enterprise search platforms

 - Experience supporting a distributed or remote-first workforce



Required Tech Stack Experience

 - AI platforms: Glean, Rovo, Claude, Gemini, and/or AWS Bedrock (experience with at least one required)

 - Working knowledge of Jira and Confluence

 - SSO and identity provider concepts as they relate to application access

 - Basic familiarity with APIs and connector-based integrations



What Sets You Apart?

 - You have deployed or administered an enterprise AI or search platform across a company and measured its adoption

 - You have built agents, Projects, Skills, or Gems that teams use in daily work

 - You have reviewed AI tool access against data classification or compliance requirements such as SOC 2

 - You have scripting skills (for example Python or JavaScript) that you use to automate admin work

 - You are interested in growing toward integration and solution engineering

 - Relevant certifications such as AWS, Atlassian, or similar

 - Experience in high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity companies



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $115,000- $151,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



Perks of Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.



Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Services Engineer I
jobs.description:
Proconex is the exclusive Emerson Impact Partner for Emerson Automation Solutions in the Mid-Atlantic region. We provide a full portfolio of Process Automation Control Systems, Valves and Control Devices, and related technologies and services to a range of customers—in the Life Sciences, Chemical, Power, Refining, Oil & Gas, Food & Beverage, Paper, Metals, and other industries, as well as commercial enterprises and campus facilities. With three strategically located offices, Proconex maintains a deep dedication to its 200+ employees, a sharp focus on safety and quality, and the drive to deliver.

Job Title

Lifecycle Services Engineer I

Job Overview

The Lifecycle Services Engineer I provides field-based engineering services to support the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, lifecycle management, and optimization of industrial automation systems. This role performs preventative maintenance, software installations, system upgrades, troubleshooting, and commissioning support while developing technical expertise under the guidance of more experienced engineers. The position requires strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and a commitment to delivering safe, high-quality customer service.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a primary or secondary customer contact during field service engagements, building positive customer relationships through professional communication and follow-through.

• Perform preventative maintenance activities and system health assessments on industrial automation systems to support reliability and lifecycle objectives.

• Troubleshoot routine automation, hardware, software, instrumentation, and network issues, escalating complex problems as needed.

• Execute software installations, upgrades, patches, and system configuration activities in accordance with established engineering standards and procedures.

• Support system migrations, version upgrades, and deployment activities across physical and virtual environments.

• Assist with project execution activities, including system setup, testing, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and startup support.

• Support lifecycle planning efforts by identifying aging hardware, software, and infrastructure risks and assisting with corrective action plans.

• Prepare service reports, technical documentation, redlines, and project records in accordance with company and customer standards.

• Adhere to customer site procedures, quality requirements, cybersecurity standards, and company operating procedures.

• Participate in emergency service and on-call support activities as required.

• Identify and communicate safety, quality, cybersecurity, and project risks while supporting a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.

• Maintain required technical training, certifications, and professional development activities.

This role requires regular travel to customer sites and the ability to support field-based service activities as business needs require.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Experience supporting industrial automation systems, instrumentation, controls, field service operations, or related technical environments.
