jobs.title: Phlebotomist/Administrative Assistant (French Creek)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a One Medical Phlebotomist/Administrative Assistant (internally known as Lab Services Specialist/Member Support Specialist) at one of our offices, you’ll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you’ll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions, both clinical and administrative, and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• Provide best in class venipuncture services on a population ranging from pediatrics to geriatrics, depending on the office location

• Perform and assist with extended scope duties such as, but not limited to non-blood specimen collection, EKGs/ECGs, vitals, ear lavages, vaccines, PPD tests, and swabs

• Maintain high standards of in-office care through proper specimen labeling, handling and processing, inventory upkeep, and tool sterilization

• Continue to care for our members beyond the lab room by answering patient messages, following up on lab cases and assisting our providers and virtual medical team with clerical duties such as, but not limited to biometric screening forms, medical record and consult review, billing inquiries, and DOH reporting

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

• Master our technology suite including, but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, Circulation, RingCentral, and our Electronic Medical Record System, in order to interact with team members and complete daily work

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 6 months of relevant experience as a Medical Assistant or Phlebotomist outside of a training/externship environment

• Strong customer service skills, including ability to establish and maintain effective customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• A High School Diploma or equivalent

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse, multi-disciplinary teams (additional experience with remote teams a plus)

• A proven ability to display confidence and instill trust during the collection process while delivering individualized, human-centered, customer-focused care

• A proven track record of persisting through change, consistently stepping up to take action on challenges, and learning quickly and effectively when faced with new situations or tasks

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The range for this role is $19.00 to $21.00 per hour based on a standard full-time schedule. Total compensation packages may be based on factors unique to particular candidates, such as skill sets, depth of experience, and work location. The total compensation package for this position may also include benefits. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

This is a full time role (40 hours/week) with 8 hour shifts generally taking place between Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm. The role is based at our French Creek office in Avon, OH.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

jobs.description:
Senior Manager, 1:Many Account-Based Marketing

Rubrik  |  Marketing — Demand Generation & ABM  |  Full-time

About Rubrik

Rubrik is a cybersecurity company on a mission to secure the world's data. We pioneered Zero Trust Data Security to help organizations achieve business resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. As data grows across enterprise, cloud, and SaaS environments, Rubrik delivers automated protection, rapid recovery, and continuous data risk visibility to thousands of customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Senior Manager, 1:Many ABM to build and scale Rubrik's scaled account-based marketing engine. This role owns the programmatic tier of our ABM strategy reaching hundreds of named accounts with the relevance of a 1:1 program and the efficiency of demand generation.

This is also a builder role for our Marketing AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE). You will design, test, and operationalize the AI skills, agents, and workflows that turn account signals into action - then package them so that field marketers, sellers, and the broader marketing organization can run them without you in the room. If you are energized by the intersection of ABM strategy, data, and applied AI, this role was written for you.

What You'll Do:

• Own the 1:Many ABM strategy, execution, and performance for Rubrik's 1:Many ABM programs across AMER, EMEA, and APJ, in partnership with regional field marketing.

• Build and maintain account tiering beyond segmentation, develop coverage models that map named accounts to the right play at the right intensity globally.

• Develop and run vertical programming within the 1:Many motion, with Financial Services (FSI) as a flagship vertical — tailoring messaging, content, and plays to industry-specific buying triggers and compliance/risk drivers.

• Work cross-functionally with marketing partners to orchestrate multi-channel plays — paid media, digital advertising, email nurture, web personalization, and events

• Partner with Sales Development and Sales to define account routing, follow-up SLAs, and closed-loop feedback on play quality.

• Own the program budget, forecast pipeline contribution, and report on influenced and sourced revenue.

• Build the AI Center of Excellence Internationally - Design, build, and maintain reusable AI skills and agentic workflows — account research briefs, next-best-action recommendations, intent summarization, campaign QA, competitive and persona insight generation.

• Translate raw account signal (6sense, Bombora, Salesforce, web, product) into actionable, plain-language recommendations the field can act on

• Develop scalable ABM tactics and plays for other ABMers and field marketers to ensure impact and pipeline.

• Create a repeatable operating rhythm with field marketing and sales leadership — quarterly account planning, monthly signal reviews, and in-quarter course correction.

• Instrument everything: define the metrics that prove scaled ABM and AI-assisted insight move engagement, pipeline, and win rate.

What We're Looking For

• 8+ years in B2B marketing, with 4+ years in account-based marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaigns at a technology company. Enterprise or cybersecurity experience is a plus.

• Demonstrated ownership of scaled or 1:Many ABM programs with measurable pipeline impact

• Hands-on fluency with the modern ABM and martech stack: 6sense or Demandbase, Salesforce, and Tableau

• Practical, hands-on experience applying generative AI to marketing work — prompt design, agent or skill building, or AI-assisted analysis. You have shipped something, not just attended the demo.

• Strong analytical instincts. Comfortable working in data, building models, and defending a number in front of leadership.

• Excellent written and verbal communication. You can make a complex signal story land with a seller in ninety seconds.

• A bias for action, a high tolerance for ambiguity, and genuine enthusiasm for teaching others what you have figured out.

Nice to Have

• Experience standing up a center of excellence, enablement function, or internal community of practice.

• Familiarity with AI agent platforms and workflow tooling

• Experience researching, launching, and developing go-to-market strategy for vertical segments (e.g., FSI, healthcare, public sector).

• Experience marketing to security, infrastructure, or IT operations buyers.

Why This Role Matters

Scaled ABM is how Rubrik covers the market efficiently. AI is how we make that coverage smart. This role sits at the seam between the two — and the person in it will define how Rubrik's go-to-market teams work with AI for years to come.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
About Campus

Campus https://campus.edu/ is on a mission to accelerate the talent of tomorrow and reimagine what college can (and should) be. The problem is clear: college costs have skyrocketed, but outcomes haven’t. Traditional college hasn’t kept up with the aspirations of today’s students—and they can’t afford to wait.



At Campus, we’ve built a two-year, accredited college where students learn from top professors at universities like Princeton, Stanford, and Howard, in live, online classes. Our students graduate with in-demand business and AI skills—ready to launch their careers or transfer to top four-year universities. Our unique approach is grounded in a pioneering technology platform and a heavily-researched student success model that offers students dedicated advisors and on-demand tutoring and coaching. We were also named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies of 2024 https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4289374-1&h=905796532&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4174213-1%26h%3D410953500%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.fastcompany.com%252F91036638%252Fcampus-most-innovative-companies-2024%26a%3DMost%2BInnovative%2BCompanies%2Bof%2B2024&a=Most+Innovative+Companies+of+2024.



We’re backed by an exceptional investor team that believes deeply in our vision for the future of education, including General Catalyst, Founders Fund, Bloomberg Beta, 8VC, Rethink Education, Sam Altman, Jason Citron, Shaquille O’Neal, and others.



The world has changed. Higher ed needs to catch up, and we’re leading the way - come join us!

 

About the team

The Finance & Accounting team safeguards Campus’s financial accuracy and integrity as the company grows.  We partner across the business to deliver reliable reporting, manage the complexity of tuition and student financing, and build controls and systems that support a regulated education institution.  We value accountability, collaboration, and a deep sense of responsibility to the students we serve.

About the role

Campus is seeking a hands-on Controller to lead its accounting function, manage and develop the accounting team, and own close, financial reporting, audits, controls, and accounting systems.  Reporting directly to the CFO, you will turn growing transaction volume and complex student-finance activity into accurate, timely financials that leadership, the Board, investors, and regulators can trust.

Your immediate priorities are to improve on a reliable, five-business-day monthly close, help lead the transition from QuickBooks to Campfire, and build the team, documentation, and systems needed to support continued growth.  You will combine strong technical accounting judgment with the willingness to investigate discrepancies, improve workflows, and resolve issues directly.

Key Responsibilities

Financial close and reporting

 - Own monthly, quarterly, and annual close, with a target of five business days or less for monthly close; establish a close calendar, clear ownership, reconciliations, and review standards that sustain speed and accuracy.

 - Deliver complete, accurate US GAAP financial statements and supporting schedules, including balance sheet reconciliations, consolidation, intercompany activity, and explanations of significant variances.

 - Own accounting for tuition, deferred revenue, scholarships and discounts, refunds, student receivables, installment and financing arrangements, and partner revenue or expense sharing.

 - Maintain accounting policies and technical analyses under ASC 606, ASC 718, and ASC 842; oversee equity accounting and its reconciliation to Carta, including options, grants, exercises, and stock-based compensation.

 - Partner with FP&A to align actuals with forecasts, maintain useful reporting by program and funding source, and produce defensible Board, investor, lender, and diligence materials.

Audit controls and regulatory partnership

 - Lead annual financial statement audits from planning through completion, own auditor relationships and supporting schedules, and resolve technical questions and findings proactively.

 - Design and document practical controls over cash, restricted funds, revenue, disbursements, payroll, journal entries, and system access; establish appropriate approvals and segregation of duties.

 - Partner with Financial Aid, Student Finance, Legal, and Compliance on Title IV and other education-related reviews; ensure student-account activity, financial aid receipts, refunds, and returns reconcile to the general ledger.

 - Support financial responsibility and composite score calculations, 90/10 reporting, lender covenant reporting, and regulatory financial submissions with accurate schedules and documented methodologies.

 - Coordinate tax and other statutory filings with external advisors and proactively identify and address accounting, audit, and compliance risks.

Accounting systems and scalable processes

 - Help lead the QuickBooks-to-Campfire migration, including chart of accounts and reporting dimensions, data cleanup and conversion, opening balance validation, integrations, testing, and cutover controls.

 - Own accounting data integrity across Campfire, Carta, Ramp, Rippling, billing and payment tools, and student systems; improve reconciliations and reduce manual work through controlled automation.

Team leadership

 - Manage and develop the accounting team, establish clear responsibilities and documentation, and build capacity as Campus grows.

 - Set high standards while keeping workloads sustainable; communicate issues early and build effective partnerships with FP&A, Student Finance, Financial Aid, Operations, HR, Legal, and external advisors.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

 - Build the accounting function at a growing education and technology company where your work directly supports access to affordable college.

 - Partner closely with the CFO and senior leadership, with meaningful ownership of the financial reporting, systems, and team that will support Campus’s next stage of growth.

 - Support an ERP transition, improve the close, and establish processes that make the numbers reliable and the team more effective.

We’re excited about you because…

You take ownership of outcomes and follow through. You can explain complex accounting to non-finance partners, make sound decisions under tight timelines or ambiguity, and remain calm during audits and regulatory reviews.  You balance attention to detail with business context, develop people, and earn trust through transparency, consistency, and early action on emerging risks.

You’ll be a great fit if you have…

 - CPA and a bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.

 - 12 or more years of progressive accounting experience, including at least five years in high-growth, venture-backed environments and experience managing and developing accounting teams.

 - Expert knowledge of US GAAP, including complex revenue recognition, stock-based compensation, and lease accounting under ASC 606, ASC 718, and ASC 842.

 - Demonstrated ownership of monthly, quarterly, and annual close, financial statement audits, and internal control design and documentation.

 - Hands-on experience implementing or substantially improving an ERP, managing accounting data integrity, and accounting for deferred revenue, financing or installment arrangements, and partner economics.

Preferred

 - Big 4 or top-tier national accounting firm background, or experience at a late Series B, Series C, or later-stage company.

 - Experience in education, fintech, lending, healthcare, insurance, or another regulated environment; familiarity with Title IV, financial responsibility, or 90/10 reporting is a plus.

 - Campfire implementation or optimization experience; familiarity with Carta, Ramp, Rippling, and multi-entity, multi-state, or multi-currency accounting.

What you’ll get:

 - A compensation package that includes a base salary ($180,000 - $230,000) + equity grant

 - Medical Insurance + Vision Insurance

 - 401(k) match

 - Fertility benefits via Carrot

 - Flexible working hours & a hybrid work schedule (Mon & Fri remote; Tues-Thurs in-office)

 - Flexible Time Away + paid holidays

 - In-office lunches

 - Social events - happy hours, birthday celebrations, holiday parties, & more!

 - Opportunity to make an impact – you’ll be an integral player in bringing our vision to life

Where we’re located: New York City

At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Candidates must have current and ongoing authorization to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.description:
Bethesda Brings out the Best in Talented, Caring People!

At Bethesda, more than 1,200 employees dedicate their careers to improving the lives of others.

As a team member at Bethesda, you'll enjoy great benefits such as: 403b, daily pay, bonuses, career advancement opportunities, and holiday pay.

Medical, dental, vision, prescription, and life insurance available for regular status full and part time employees.

Summary

Provides basic nursing care by assisting in the assessment of the resident on admission and on an ongoing basis. Remains knowledgeable about and communicates to the appropriate interdisciplinary team (IDT) member any significant change in condition. Accurately documents all assessments. Seeks guidance if unsure of any assessment findings. Participates in the care planning process for the resident. Updates the care plan when specific interventions indicate the need for revision. Communicates the plan to the appropriate IDT members along with the residents and their families. Implements necessary and appropriate nursing interventions relevant to the plan of care which includes nursing orders, physician orders, residents/families educational and environmental needs. Ensures interventions such as medication administration and treatments are accomplished in a safe and timely manner. Administers IV fluid only if IV certified. Documents interventions accurately and timely. Uses critical thinking skills when dealing with residents' changes in condition. Notifies the physician timely using the SBARR as the communication tool. Maintains composure during any crisis situation such as family dissatisfaction, staff disputes, or inclement weather in a calm and professional manner. Monitors the care of the residents closely to see that the care plan is being delivered effectively. Identifies problem areas and uses the QAPI process to actively address the situation for immediate problem resolution. Remains aware of the status of the residents to quickly identify behavioral changes or other untoward signs or symptoms. Answers call lights and/or assists with residents' ADLs as needed. Completes, at a minimum, twelve hours of offerings related to nursing related continuing education. Has a commitment to keep current with best nursing practices through knowledge of Bethesda's policies and self-study. May be assigned other duties as appropriate.

Qualifications

• Education from an accredited school of nursing that results in becoming a Licensed Practical Nurse

• Current LPN license in the state you will be working

• CPR and AED certification required, or willing to obtain within six months of employment

• IV certification required, or willing to obtain within six months of employment

• Long-term care experience preferred

• Must be able to assess the basic nursing care needs of the geriatric resident

• Must possess excellent communication skills to interact with residents, visitors and staff

• Time management and organizational skills required

• Ability to stand and walk for long periods of time

• Ability to lift heavy objects using proper lifting techniques and with assistance when necessary

• Ability to transfer and move patients who vary with ability to assist weighing 200+lbs using proper lifting techniques and with assistance when necessary

• Ability to push and pull equipment weighing in excess of 40lbs using proper techniques and with assistance when necessary

• Manual dexterity, coordination and skillful use of hands when working with patients and equipment

• Visual acuity with the ability to distinguish color

• Ability to physically perform necessary documentation electronically and in writing

Pay range: $26.96- $43.25 per hour

Category: LPN

jobs.title: Maintenance and Reliability Systems Lead
jobs.location: Coopersville, Michigan, United States; Webster, New York, United States
jobs.description:
fairlife, LLC is a Chicago-based nutrition company that creates great-tasting, nutrition-rich and dairy products to nourish consumers.

With over $3B in annual retail sales, fairlife’s portfolio of delicious, lactose-free, real dairy products includes: fairlife® ultra-filtered milk; Core Power® High Protein Shakes, a sports nutrition drink to support post-workout recovery; fairlife® nutrition plan™, a nutrition shake to support the journey to better health.

A wholly owned subsidiary of The Coca-Cola company, fairlife, LLC has been recognized by both Fast Company and Nielsen for its industry leading innovation.

To learn more about fairlife and its complete line of products, please visit fairlife.com.

job purpose

The Maintenance & Reliability Systems Lead leads the development, deployment, and standardization of reliability and Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) across fairlife's manufacturing network. The role's first priority is leading the CMMS implementation for a major capital project, so that asset data, equipment hierarchies, BOMs, spare parts, preventive maintenance programs, reporting, and user training are fully in place before startup. Working with Maintenance, Engineering, Reliability, Operations, and Supply Chain, this role will establish a standardized maintenance management framework and data governance processes that drive consistent asset management, work management, and system use across all sites. Aligned with ISO 55000 principles, the position will build scalable standards that support asset lifecycle management, maintenance excellence, and future CMMS deployments.

responsibilities

• Serve as the CMMS SME and lead system development and deployment, including asset hierarchy, equipment master data, BOMs, Item Master, PM programs, and maintenance workflows.

• Partner with OEMs, engineering firms, contractors, and project teams to collect, validate, and organize equipment specifications, drawings, and maintenance requirements.

• Establish data governance processes, and guide the teams responsible for collecting, cleansing, validating, and loading equipment, spare parts, and maintenance data.

• Standardize asset structures, criticality rankings, maintenance plans, spare parts strategies, reliability practices, and PM/PdM programs, utilizing best practices from across the network. Build scalable processes that can be repeated for future implementations, expansions, and upgrades.

• Work with Maintenance, Operations, Reliability, Engineering, and Supply Chain to develop site maintenance strategies aligned with corporate maintenance excellence standards.

• Monitor and improve planning, scheduling, execution, backlog management, and PM optimization. Partner with maintenance leadership on the CMMS KPIs, dashboards, and reports that drive performance.

• Develop training, SOPs, and work instructions, and coach planners, mechanics, supervisors, and site leadership so CMMS processes are adopted consistently.

• Ensure maintenance activities, procedures, and system configurations comply with safety, regulatory, and environmental requirements, including LOTO.

skills/qualifications required:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related discipline

• 5+ years of experience in Maintenance & CMMS master data and deploying the platform on large greenfield or brownfield projects in manufacturing (food and dairy preferred).

• Strong knowledge of ISO 55000 and related asset management standards.

• Project management and work management skills, including planning, scheduling, and backlog management, leading meetings, and reporting results to stakeholders.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with project managers, OEMs, contractors, mechanics, and leadership, and to assess training needs for mechanics and operators.

• Experience & knowledge on CMMS Systems such as MVPOne, D365 Dynoway, SAP - Preferred

• Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude.

• Working knowledge of core reliability strategies, including asset criticality, preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance, RCM/FMEA, and PM optimization.

• Experience with failure analysis and spares strategy, including failure coding, bad actor analysis, root cause analysis, and critical spares planning.

• Ability to work with databases and build digital reports on reliability KPIs (MTBF, MTTR, PM compliance), parts usage, and spare parts inventories.

• Adaptable in a fast-changing environment, balancing shifting priorities by business impact.

position location: Coopersville, MI or Webster, NY

reports to: Sr Director of Plant Capital Engineering

travel requirements: 25-30%

exempt/nonexempt: Exempt

*Base pay offered may vary depending on geography, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. A full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered.

$120,000—$130,000 USD

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
🌐 WHO WE ARE

Bankjoy is a Y Combinator and Bessemer Venture Partner backed FinTech startup. We are changing the way community banks and credit unions do business, enabling them to become tech-driven and digital first. Bankjoy provides modern digital banking products including mobile banking, online banking, online account opening, loan origination, and conversational AI. Our mission is to revolutionize banking tech infrastructure by leading digital transformation at financial institutions — big and small.



Position Overview

We are looking for a Client Success Manager to join our growing CSM team as we scale our client base across credit unions and community banks nationwide.

You will own a portfolio of clients end-to-end — driving product adoption, leading executive business reviews, managing renewals, identifying upsell opportunities, and serving as the primary relationship owner for your accounts. You'll work closely with our Director of Client Success, Implementation, Tech Support, and Product teams to ensure every client gets maximum value from Bankjoy's platform.

The ideal candidate is proactive, relationship-driven, and commercially minded — someone who genuinely cares about client outcomes, knows how to navigate complex organizations, is comfortable engaging executive stakeholders, and can balance a high volume of accounts while taking a strategic approach to long-term client success.

 

Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

 - Own a portfolio of credit union and community bank clients, serving as their primary point of contact at Bankjoy

 - Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with client stakeholders, from day-to-day administrators to executive sponsors

 - Become a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders by providing strategic recommendations that align Bankjoy solutions with each client's business objectives

 - Conduct regular business reviews and executive meetings to review platform performance, discuss future goals and priorities, identify opportunities for additional value, and align on long-term success

 - Lead onsite client engagements, including preparing executive presentations, facilitating strategic discussions, documenting action items, and ensuring follow-through

 - Serve as the voice of the client internally — ensuring client needs and feedback are surfaced to Product, Engineering, and leadership

Product Adoption & Client Growth

 - Drive product adoption across your portfolio by proactively educating clients on features, best practices, and new releases

 - Develop and execute strategic success plans aligned with each client's business objectives, helping them maximize the value of their Bankjoy investment

 - Identify and lead expansion opportunities within your portfolio by aligning Bankjoy solutions to client business goals and strategic initiatives

 - Track and report on adoption metrics, engagement scores, and account health across your book of business

Renewals & Retention

 - Lead the renewal process for your portfolio, including managing timelines, preparing renewal proposals, presenting pricing recommendations, and negotiating agreements in partnership with the Director of Client Success

 - Proactively identify at-risk accounts and develop mitigation plans before issues escalate

 - Maintain a high client retention rate by ensuring clients consistently see value in Bankjoy's platform

 - Develop and execute account strategies that strengthen executive relationships, improve product adoption, and identify opportunities for long-term growth

Escalation & Issue Resolution

 - Serve as the first line of response for client escalations within your portfolio, triaging issues, coordinating with Tech Support, Product, and Engineering, and providing proactive communication to clients throughout resolution

 - Escalate to the Director of Client Success when situations require senior involvement, providing a clear summary of the issue, actions taken, and recommended next steps

 - Follow up after resolution to ensure client satisfaction, identify opportunities to improve the client experience, and document learnings for future prevention

Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Partner with Implementation throughout the onboarding process by participating in kickoff meetings and key project milestones to ensure a smooth transition into Customer Success

 - Work closely with Tech Support to ensure timely resolution of client issues and proactive communication during outages or incidents

 - Collaborate with Product to surface recurring client feedback, enhancement requests, and product opportunities that help influence the roadmap

 - Support Marketing with client case studies, testimonials, and advocacy opportunities

 

What You Bring

 - 5+ years of Client Success, Account Management, or Customer Experience in B2B fintech, banking technology, or enterprise SaaS. Experience supporting financial institutions is strongly preferred.

 - Experience managing a portfolio of 20–30+ accounts simultaneously with a high standard of responsiveness and follow-through

 - Excellent presentation and communication skills with experience leading executive business reviews, onsite meetings, and strategic planning discussions with senior stakeholders

 - Demonstrated track record of driving product adoption, renewals, and expansion opportunities within an assigned book of business

 - Strong relationship management skills with the ability to build trust and credibility across both operational and executive stakeholders

 - Ability to navigate complex client organizations and build relationships across multiple stakeholder levels

 - Comfortable with escalations — you stay calm under pressure, communicate clearly, and drive resolution with urgency

 - Strong organizational skills — you can manage multiple priorities and client needs simultaneously without losing attention to detail

 - Experience working with credit unions, community banks, or digital banking platforms is a strong plus

 

Nice to Have

 - Familiarity with core banking systems (Corelation, Jack Henry Symitar, Fiserv Portico, CU Answers, or similar)

 - Experience with digital banking platforms or financial technology products

 - Experience using CRM and CS tools (Salesforce, Gainsight, ChurnZero, or similar)

 - Experience supporting clients through platform migrations or major product launches

 






🎁 WHAT YOU GET

 - A fast-paced and collaborative environment 

 - Competitive compensation

 - Stock options at a well-funded startup

 - We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for individuals on our base plan, with significant contributions toward all other plan options (USA). 

 - We cover 100% of extended medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your family under our single, comprehensive plan (Canada).

 - Retirement plan with 4% company matching 

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave for birthing parents, 4 weeks for non-birthing

 - 3-5 weeks PTO depending on tenure

 - 5 health days

 - 15 holidays

 - End of year shutdown

 - Performance-based bonuses 

 - Remote first culture
   
    


⚖️ EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITIES AT BANKJOY

Bankjoy is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds for all of its tech, non-tech, and leadership roles. Bankjoy provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

jobs.description:
About the Role

As an Industrial Builds Project Manager on the Design & Construction team, you will support OpenAI’s research, scaling and manufacturing activities by providing project management and leadership on mission critical construction projects with complex engineering design and extensive interfaces. This role owns technical coordination across MEP, civil/structural, and architectural scopes, and is accountable for on-time, on-budget delivery of complex build-outs.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, but you will be expected to travel to project sites  regularly, aligned with project requirements. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead full lifecycle execution of a range of infrastructure and facilities build-out projects simultaneously, including advanced compute facilities, labs, testing environments, and production spaces.

 - Own detailed project estimating, budgeting, and financial analysis to ensure fiscal responsibility and efficiency. This includes securing capital funding

 - Engage, contract and drive external partners (architects, contractors, construction managers and other consultants) to deliver mission-critical projects on accelerated timelines

 - Collaborate closely on projects with internal teams like Real Estate, Operations, Corporate Security, IT/AV, EH&S, stakeholder team and Finance

 - Partner closely with Leasing on site selection, providing due diligence and cost forecasting to support site acquisition

 - Own the relationship with internal clients and executives, driving engagement, alignment, and decision-making.

 - Develop and oversee technical due diligence efforts for each project, which may include technical assessments, AHJ coordination, utility requirements and feasibility studies.

 - Develop and review concept designs, which will define programming that is aligned with all stakeholders and guide design development.

 - Review and contribute to design drawings, mechanical and electrical layouts, utility diagrams, specifications, and technical documentation.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 8+ years of experience delivering infrastructure projects in a fast-paced, hyper-scaling environment

 - Bring a background in architecture, interior design, construction project management and Experience collaborating with engineering disciplines (MEP, structural, building systems)

 - Possess deep expertise in construction budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis, with the ability to communicate cost drivers to non-technical stakeholders.

 - Excel at building and leveraging relationships with external vendors, consultants, GCs, and internal teams, and can drive accountability across disciplines.

 - Demonstrate strong leadership, ownership, and collaboration skills, with the ability to align diverse teams toward a unified project vision.

 - Bring a collaborative and motivating approach to finding solutions rapidly.

jobs.title: SSO/Special Security Officer – Corporate Physical Security
jobs.location: El Segundo, CA; Long Beach, CA
jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

About the Role

The SSO / Special Security Officer is responsible for administering Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) security programs and SCIF operations that enable classified aerospace and defense work in compliance with government and customer requirements.

The position reports to the Senior Director, Security and is part of the Security team based in El Segundo California. This role will initially require onsite at our El Segundo, California, and will require work location change to our Long Beach, California within a year.

In this role, the essential functions are:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for SCI security matters, administering SCIF policies and procedures in accordance with ICD 703, ICD 705, and applicable program security guides.

• Manage SCIF accreditation and re-accreditation, including construction security plans, fixed facility checklists, and coordination.

• Process and track SCI indoctrinations, debriefings, visit certifications/requests, and access approvals through government and customer channels.

• Coordinate personnel security actions, including clearance submissions, periodic reinvestigations, continuous vetting, and foreign travel and contact reporting.

• Oversee the control, handling, transmission, storage, and destruction of SCI material, and support accreditation of SCI-level information systems with the ISSM/ISSO.

• Conduct security inspections, self-inspections, and audits, and drive corrective actions to closure.

• Investigate and report security incidents, infractions, and violations, and recommend preventive measures.

• Deliver security briefings and training and advise program leadership on security requirements while serving as liaison to DCSA, Cognizant Security Authorities, and government customers.

• Provide support to classified contracts and proposal efforts.

• Provide corporate security support, to include access control and visitor management at the El Segundo office.

• Act as a backup to our FSO as needed

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in security management, criminal justice, business, or a related field with 5 years of experience in SCI security administration OR Master's degree in a related field with 3 years of experience OR 9 years of experience in SCI security administration in lieu of a degree OR High School Diploma or Equivalent

• Active U.S. Government TS security clearance with SCI eligibility

• Hands-on experience managing SCIFs, including accreditation actions

• Working knowledge of ICD 703, ICD 705, and NISPOM (32 CFR Part 117)

• Experience supporting classified programs in the aerospace or defense industry

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief leadership and government customers.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previously held SCI with CI Poly

• Previous special access program experience

• Experience with Intelligence Community Customers.

• Experience supporting FSO functions

Travel, Physical and/or Government Mandated Requirements

• Travel up to 10%, including occasional travel between our El Segundo, Long Beach. Folsom, CA locations.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain access to SCI facilities.

• Must be able to sometimes bend, stoop, or stand on ladders to facilitate physical security inspections and operations.

Compensation

The good faith base salary range for this role is $120,000–$170,000 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

jobs.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT POLYGON LABS

Polygon Labs is a global blockchain payments company building and operating infrastructure to move money instantly, reliably, and at internet scale, with the mission to move all money onchain. It is building the Polygon Open Money Stack, an open and integrated stack of services and technologies to instantly and reliably move money anywhere, and put it to work. Its infrastructure has facilitated trillions of dollars in onchain value transfer and supported millions of transactions daily for some of the globe's largest banks, fintechs, enterprises, and consumer applications.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As fintechs and financial institutions integrate the Polygon Open Money Stack, the quality of the integration experience increasingly shapes how quickly partners reach production. Polygon operates as a US-regulated payments platform, licensed in 48 states through 37 money transmitter licenses and 11 exemptions, and our partner base is growing.

Today, many partner integration questions are routed to Engineering. This slows product development and leads to the same questions being answered repeatedly. The Technical Solutions Engineer will own the technical experience of building on Polygon: API and integration documentation, the integration path, technical support during the sales process, and bringing signed partners to production.

Our standard is a best-in-class developer experience in payments, where a capable developer, including one working with AI coding tools, can integrate with minimal direct support.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Account Management & Support.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - API and integration documentation: Own the accuracy, completeness, and clarity of Polygon’s API and integration documentation, and keep it current as the platform evolves.

 - Self-serve integration: Build quickstarts, sample code, and reference architectures that enable developers, including those using AI coding tools, to integrate independently.

 - Technical expertise: Serve as the primary technical resource in sales conversations alongside Business Development and throughout partner integrations, then document solutions so they’re reusable.

 - Partner go-live: Lead signed partners through requirements intake, provisioning following KYB and KYC approval, sandbox testing, webhook configuration, and go-live validation, in partnership with Integration Delivery.

 - Platform knowledge: Develop deep expertise across ramps and bank rails, wallets and accounts, custodial and non-custodial flows, virtual accounts, deposit addresses, cross-chain movement, and webhooks.

 - Demos and enablement: Build sample applications and demo environments that support Business Development and Sales.

 - Product feedback: Identify gaps in the API and integration experience, and turn them into clear, prioritized recommendations for Product and Engineering.

 - Automation: Use AI and internal tooling to streamline onboarding, provisioning, and frontline support.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Hands-on experience with US payments, including ACH, RTP, wire transfers, card networks, or equivalent rails, and a working understanding of settlement and reconciliation.

 - Experience in one of the following:
   
   - Leading customer API integrations from kickoff to production at a payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure company
   
   - Owning API documentation, SDKs, or developer support at an API-first payments company

 - Strong API and troubleshooting skills, including reading logs, debugging webhooks, and reasoning through authentication and retry behavior, with tools such as Postman, Bruno, or Datadog

 - Excellent technical writing, with the ability to document complex systems clearly for external developers

 - Regular use of AI tools to build, document, and automate work

 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the platform and documentation are actively evolving


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with stablecoins or digital assets, particularly wallets and onchain settlement

 - Experience at an early-stage company, building processes or programs from the ground up

 - Enough coding ability to build demo applications

 - Experience with documentation platforms such as Mintlify

 - Familiarity with KYB and KYC tooling


WHY JOIN

Cross-border payments remain slow, expensive, and opaque. Polygon is bringing regulated fiat access, wallets, and onchain settlement together into one integrated stack, and partners are building on it today. In this role, you’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Business Development leadership and set the standard for how partners integrate with Polygon.

jobs.title: Paramedic (Urgent Care Tech) - Urgent Care
jobs.description:
At ConvenientMD, we’re on a mission to make good health more convenient for all – working to improve how patients and providers experience healthcare in New England. To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

ConvenientMD is seeking a dedicated Paramedic, who is a nationally registered EMT to join our team as an Urgent Care Technician. As a vital clinical team member, you will play an integral role in providing high-quality care to our patients, working alongside medical providers, and contributing to a supportive, collaborative environment. If you are a skilled paramedic looking for an opportunity to grow your career in a fast-paced setting, this position could be a great fit for you.

Your Impact

• Patient Care & Triage: Conduct comprehensive patient triage by taking vital signs, documenting medical history, and performing observational examinations to identify immediate healthcare needs. Assist with patient exams, ensuring all necessary equipment and documentation are prepared, while supporting providers during testing and procedures.

• Clinical Procedures: Perform diagnostic and testing procedures, including vision, hearing, drug screens, breath alcohol testing, spirometry, and more. Execute point-of-care testing such as strep, flu, RSV, SARS-CoV-2, glucose, lipid panel, and urinalysis. Provide cardiac and airway management, including ECGs, AED use, nebulizer treatments, and oxygen administration. Deliver wound care assessments, immunizations, and medication administration per federal and state regulations.

• Patient Engagement & Documentation: Assist with patient inquiries, communicate test results, and explain medication or therapy plans. Maintain accurate electronic medical records, documenting patient histories and treatment details. Observe and report changes in patients' conditions, taking necessary action as needed.

• Clinic Operations: Ensure medical instruments and equipment are clean, sterilized, and maintained per organizational policies. Maintain a stocked and sterile workspace, supporting smooth clinic operations.

• Collaboration with Clinical Team: Work closely with other members of the clinical team to ensure seamless coordination of patient care. Communicate effectively and efficiently with providers and other healthcare professionals to relay patient information and updates. Welcome and support the training of new team clinic team members.

Required Availability

• Must be able to work 12-hour shifts in consecutive and or non-consecutive days: For full-time: Must be able to work three (3) 12-hour shifts a week with at least four (4) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday. For part-time: Must be able to work two (2) 12-hour shifts per week with at least two (2) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday. For per diem: Must be able to work four (4) 12-hour shifts per month, ideally working one (1) shift each week.

• Flexibility to work nights, weekends, holidays.

• If needed, must be able to work at a minimum of three (3) other ConvenientMD locations within a one (1) hour travel distance from your primary clinic.

• Required to travel for training shifts which may occur outside of your primary clinic within a one (1) hour commute.

Who You Are

• Education: High school diploma or GED required.

• Certification and demonstrated prior experience: Licensed paramedic (preferably nationally certified) with prior experience placing and monitoring IVs.

• Basic Life Support (BLS) certification: American Heart Association or American Red Cross BLS certification. We do not accept CPR, ACLS certifications, or online only classes.

• Compassionate, authentic, and patient focused: Supports patients through kindness; demonstrating understanding for others and contributing to the creating a community of belonging.

• Proactive and confident communicator (written and verbal): Foreshadows and elevates concerns as they arise, unafraid of professional directness both with colleagues and patients.

• Trustworthy: Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle all patient information in accordance with HIPAA regulations.

• Effective communicator and cross collaborator: Ability to establish and maintain positive relationships with patients, team members, and stakeholders across the organization.

• Excellent team player: Enjoys collaborating with others and being a part of a strong team dynamic.

• Technically savvy: Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software, experience with or ability to learn Experity as well as other business systems.

Bonus Qualifications

• 1-2 years of patient triage experience in an urgent care or emergency department preferred.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth

• Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families

• Extensive benefit offerings including health, dental, and vision coverage, company paid short-term disability, and optional pet insurance

• 401k match after one year of service

• Access to our primary care (depending on location)

• Educational Alliance with Purdue University Global and reduced tuition rates for team members and their families

• Employer rewards and access to discounts offered on services and products such as hotels, travel, entertainment, restaurants, and more

There's a job and then there's purposeful, transformative work. Our aim is to create a workplace where you can learn, grow, and continuously refine your skills. jobs.title: People Operations and Compliance Generalist
jobs.description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.



At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.



The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.



We're looking for an organized, detail-oriented People Operations and Compliance Generalist to join our team.

In this role, you'll keep the administration and compliance of our people operations function running smoothly. You'll be the go-to person for benefits and administrative questions, and you'll make sure payroll compliance requirements and state filings are completed accurately and on time. You'll work closely with our external benefits broker, payroll provider, insurance companies, payroll compliance vendors, and government agencies to keep operations efficient and give every teammate a great employee experience.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in getting the details right, handles sensitive information with discretion, and looks for ways to automate the repetitive parts of the job. You'll work independently while partnering with teammates and outside partners across the business.




SOME OF THE WORK YOU'LL OWN:

💬 Be the go-to for benefits questions.
Give employees timely, accurate answers on health, dental, vision, retirement, and other benefit programs. Coordinate enrollments, life event changes, 401(k) plans through Betterment, COBRA, and annual open enrollment. Be the starting point for all benefits questions from employees.

🤝 Partner with our benefits broker.
Serve as the primary point of contact for Sequoia, our benefits broker. Work with Sequoia to administer benefit plans and ensure Assured is compliant with all Federal, state and local benefits-related regulations including ACA filings, non-discrimination testing and any required notices.

🏛️ Keep payroll compliance and state compliance airtight.
Monitor and maintain compliance with state and local employment requirements including state withholding and unemployment registrations, state and local account maintenance, paid family leave and disability programs, keeping our workers compensation up to date, and responding to all notices from states and local jurisdictions.

📬 Own AbstractOps, CT Corp, and the mailroom.
Own AbstractOps (our multi-state business compliance tool) including reviewing mail received in AbstractOps and mail forwarded from our Executive Assistant(s). Manage incoming company mail, distribute correspondence, and respond to routine inquiries. Own relationship with CT Corporation, our registered agent in all the states where we operate.

🗂️ Run core people processes in Rippling (Assured’s HRIS).
Own HRIS updates, benefits administration, and leave coordination (FMLA, parental etc.), and enter all changes in Rippling.

🧾 Keep the paper trail audit-ready.
Support audits by gathering requested documentation and keeping records organized. Maintain proper documentation, required notices, and records for legal purposes to reduce compliance and operational risk.

📘 Own the handbook, policies, and employee communications.
Manage and update the employee handbook and company policies, keeping them current and compliant. Distribute employee communications on benefits and policy updates.

🌱 Make Lattice our home for employee documentation.
Administer lattice, train employees on using it, check and follow-up with managers that regular 1:1s are happening and documented across the org, and help administer annual reviews (once an all-company review cycle is in place). Show employees how to get the most out of the tool, including the Slack integration, the AI agent in 1:1s, and the MCP connection with Claude.

📊 Turn people data into useful reporting.
Produce up-to-date headcount, turnover, and hiring reports.

⚙️ Automate the repeatable.
Work with the IT department to set up auto-replies and playbooks to answer common employee questions on benefits, PTO, and other employee handbook topics (using Console or another ITSM vendor). The goal is for employees to get a fast, correct answer, even outside business hours, and for you to get time back for higher-value work.

Please note: This list of duties and responsibilities is not exhaustive. Ad hoc requests and additional tasks may come up as the role evolves.




HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT:

🛡️ Keep Assured compliant and audit-ready.
Accurate filings, current notices, and well-organized records reduce risk and make audits straightforward.

⚡ Use automation and AI to move faster.
Set up auto-replies for common questions and help the team get more out of Lattice's AI features, so repetitive work doesn't take over the week.

📈 Build a foundation that scales.
Documented processes, clean systems of record, and reliable reporting give People Ops a base that holds up as Assured grows.

😊 Give every teammate a great employee experience.
Clear, accurate, and timely answers on benefits and policies mean people can spend their energy on their work instead of chasing down HR questions.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

🎓 Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent work experience will be considered.

🗓️ 2–5 years of experience in benefits administration and multi-state payroll tax compliance.

📋 Knowledge of benefits administration and employment compliance.

💻 Experience with Rippling (Assured’s HRIS and payroll systems) is preferred.




YOU'LL PROBABLY THRIVE HERE IF YOU:

🔍 Have an exceptional eye for detail.
You're strongly organized, and you catch the small stuff before it becomes a filing error or an audit finding.

⏱️ Juggle priorities and meet deadlines.
You can keep several workstreams moving at once and hit the deadlines that payroll and compliance don't move.

✍️ Communicate clearly.
You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and can explain benefits and policy updates in plain language.

🙋 Lead with service.
You bring a strong customer service orientation and interpersonal skills, and you treat every teammate question as worth a real answer.

🔒 Handle sensitive information with discretion.
Confidentiality is second nature to you.

🧭 Work independently and collaborate well.
You can run with your own work while partnering effectively with internal teams and external partners.



Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together
