jobs.title: Senior Channel Field Marketing, South Central
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a Senior Channel Field Marketing Manager to own co-marketing strategy and execution with Horizon3's channel partners in the South Central region. You will drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline through high-signal field programs, working alongside Horizon3's Partner Business Managers to build account coverage, accelerate deals in market, and hold every program to a CPO and ROI threshold.

You will be the senior marketing partner to Horizon3's VAR, reseller, alliance, and distribution partners in the region, and to the Partner Business Managers who cover them. You own the co-marketing motion end to end: which partners get investment, joint program design, MDF management, execution, follow-up, and pipeline attribution.

Channel is a critical growth lever for Horizon3, and partner-driven pipeline needs an owner who understands both the field motion and the partner ecosystem. If you have spent your career running co-marketing programs with one eye on the partner relationship and the other on pipeline ROI, this role was built for you.



This role will be responsible for…..



Channel Co-Marketing Strategy and Planning

 - Own the South Central channel field marketing strategy, covering the region's partners and partner events, and a co-marketing portfolio built to generate net-new partner-sourced pipeline and accelerate partner-influenced deals already in motion.

 - Decide where co-marketing investment goes. Prioritize partners and programs by pipeline opportunity, not by who asks for budget.

 - Own the channel marketing calendar, aligned to partner priorities, regional sales plays, and company campaign themes, so partner programs ladder up to integrated demand gen motions.

 -  Define and enforce pipeline ROI standards as the gate for all channel field investment. Every program needs a pipeline hypothesis going in and a pipeline outcome coming out.



Partner Programs and MDF

 - Design and execute joint field programs with VARs, resellers, alliance partners, and distributors: co-hosted events, partner-led roundtables, joint conference activations, roadshows, and CISO-focused experiences.

 - Own MDF end to end: allocation strategy, partner alignment, execution oversight, budget tracking, and attribution reporting. MDF is an investment with an expected return, not a partner benefit to be dispersed.

 - Build repeatable co-marketing playbooks that scale across partners without rebuilding each program from scratch.

 -  Coordinate SDR, Partner Business Manager, and partner seller follow-up for every program, with defined SLAs.



Partner and Sales Alignment

 - Serve as the senior marketing counterpart to the region's Partner Business Managers and partner marketing contacts, and run joint planning and business reviews with priority partners.

 - Work with regional field marketers so partner programs and direct programs cover the same accounts without colliding.

 - Partner with partner marketing and product marketing on joint messaging and proof points.



Pipeline Accountability and Reporting

 - Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline reporting: meetings booked, pipeline created, stage progression, and ROI by partner and by program.

 - Partner with marketing operations to keep partner attribution clean in Salesforce.

 - Report to field marketing and channel leadership on a regular cadence, with clear recommendations on which partners and programs to scale and which to cut.

 - Mentor Channel Field Marketing Managers and Specialists. This role has no direct reports.



What You’ll Bring

 - 6+ years of B2B channel or field marketing experience, with ownership of partner co-marketing programs and measurable pipeline contribution.

 - Proven track record building and executing co-marketing programs with VARs, resellers, alliance partners, or distributors, with the pipeline data to back it up.

 - Experience owning MDF budgets, including allocation decisions, partner alignment, and ROI reporting.

 - Strong understanding of the B2B technology channel ecosystem: how partners sell, what motivates them, and how to design programs that drive joint pipeline rather than just partner satisfaction.

 - Financial fluency: comfortable building CPO and ROI cases and recommending investment trade-offs to leadership.

 - Proficiency with Salesforce for pipeline tracking, partner attribution, and co-marketing performance reporting.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Partner Business Managers, channel sales, direct field marketing, demand gen, digital, ABM, and product marketing.

 - Highly organized, able to manage multiple partner relationships, programs, and timelines at once without losing accountability or momentum.



What Sets You Apart?

 -  Experience in cybersecurity, DevSecOps, or adjacent B2B security markets.

 - Familiarity with Federal or Public Sector channel marketing, including distribution ecosystems like Carahsoft and compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP and CMMC.

 - Familiarity with intent data and ABM tools such as ZoomInfo or Reachdesk in support of partner-led account coverage.

 - Familiarity with Pardot, Marketo, or HubSpot for co-marketing campaign setup and attribution.



Travel Required

This role requires applicants to be based in the South Central region of the United States and willing to travel up to 40%.

 

Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $145,000 - $165,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 



Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Project Manager (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
Join the Team!

Is technology your passion? Do you want to work with smart, forward-thinking individuals? Do you want to grow in a career you love?

At Align, our professionals are the key to our success. We don’t just hire talent, we invest in exceptional people who are forward-thinking, results-driven, and passionate about what they do. We’re a group of tech-savvy professionals who are motivated by making an impact. Our culture is one of unbounded opportunity that celebrates the passions, skills and ideas of our team—work hard, play hard, be smart!

We believe great communities lead to great companies. That’s why we offer a dynamic workplace where you feel inspired, engaged and innovative. We offer professionals opportunities to train in the leading technologies, make an impact within the industry and acquire valuable new skills whether on client sites or in one of our regional offices.

Position Overview

Align seeks a Project Manager to oversee second-shift construction activities for hyperscale data center white space fit-outs within colocation environments. This role is responsible for managing onsite execution during the second shift, including coordination of trades, sequencing of work, quality control, and progress against the project schedule.

The Project Manager will serve as Align’s onsite point of contact during the second shift, working closely with contractors, client representatives, and the daytime project team to keep construction activities moving and ensure a clear handoff between shifts.

The ideal candidate has construction management experience and an understanding of infrastructure such as containment systems, overhead conveyance including ladder racks and cable trays structural supports, electrical distribution, and cooling components. Candidates with experience in commercial, industrial, electrical, or low-voltage construction are encouraged to apply. Previous data center experience is preferred but is not required.

• This is a full-time salaried position offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, paid training, and performance-based bonuses.

• This position is based in the Detroit metro area and requires working onsite during the second shift, approximately 4:00 p.m. to midnight.

• Approximately 50% travel outside the Ann Arbor area should be expected at times, depending on project needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead second-shift onsite construction activities for data center white space fit-out projects

• Coordinate with the daytime project team before each shift to review priorities, scheduled work, contractor coverage, and outstanding issues

• Oversee installation of: Structural hot aisle / cold aisle containment systems Overhead cable tray systems and ladder racks Structural supports for cabinets, racks, cable trays, and electrical power distribution infrastructure Cooling infrastructure, including HVAC units Power distribution from PDU to cabinet level

• Manage trade contractors and coordinate work sequencing to maintain the schedule and avoid conflicts between installation activities

• Serve as the primary onsite contact during the second shift for general contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and client stakeholders

• Enforce quality control processes to ensure installations meet approved drawings, specifications, load requirements, and applicable standards

• Monitor progress against the project schedule, identify delays or field issues, and coordinate resolutions with the project team

• Track labor, materials, and potential scope changes affecting assigned work; communicate budget impacts to project leadership

• Ensure compliance with safety requirements and site protocols throughout the shift

• Review construction drawings, submittals, RFIs, and shop drawings to address installation questions and coordinate required clarifications

• Coordinate field checks of installation tolerances, anchoring, and overhead support systems against approved requirements

• Maintain daily reports, progress photos, issue logs, and punch lists

• Support inspections, commissioning, and turnover activities

• Provide a documented handoff to the daytime team covering completed work, schedule updates, unresolved issues, and upcoming priorities

Required Qualifications

• Construction project management or field leadership experience, including responsibility for onsite contractor coordination and work execution

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple contractors, coordinate trades, and maintain construction schedules

• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and installation details

• Working knowledge of construction sequencing, quality control, and jobsite safety practices

• Project management skills, including scheduling, progress tracking, documentation, and cost awareness

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to resolve field issues and escalate matters requiring additional approval

• Strong communication skills and experience working with contractors, clients, and project stakeholders

• Ability to work onsite consistently during the second shift, approximately 4:00 p.m. to midnight, and travel as required

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in data center, commercial, industrial, electrical, mechanical, or low-voltage construction

• Familiarity with white space fit-outs, containment, overhead conveyance, structural supports, electrical distribution, or cooling infrastructure

• Familiarity with structured cabling and fiber optic infrastructure

• Procore experience is strongly preferred

• Experience supporting commissioning and turnover of construction projects

To support a fair, consistent, and high-quality hiring experience, some interviews may be recorded. These recordings help our team focus fully on the conversation at hand, rather than note-taking, and allow us to better evaluate and improve our recruitment process. Recordings are used solely for internal purposes such as training, quality assurance, and process improvement. Candidates will be informed in advance and asked to provide consent before any recording takes place.

Tier 2

PM26

Benefits and Perks:

At Align, we believe that supporting our employees both personally and professionally is key to our success. We offer a competitive benefits package designed to promote health, wellness, financial security, and work-life balance, including:

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

• Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options 401(k) plan with a dollar-for-dollar company match at 3% up to an annual maximum of $5k.

• Complimentary ClassPass membership to support your health and wellness goals

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Company-paid holidays

• Cellphone Reimbursement Program

• Floating Holiday to celebrate a day that is meaningful to you

• Pre-tax commuter benefits, where applicable

• Employee wellness programs, events, and team-building activities

• Employee referral program

Align is a premier global provider of technology infrastructure solutions.

Align specializes in designing and deploying technology infrastructure solutions from the data center to the desktop as well as providing managed IT services for clients.

Our professional services team, which includes Data Center Solutions, provide strategic consulting, design, project management, engineering, implementation and support. Our best-in-class Managed Services team provides IT services and cybersecurity advisory for clients within the Alternative Investment industry. Align is a Microsoft Tier 1 Cloud Solutions Provider (CSP) and Gold Partner.

Our client centric approach and passion for driving IT innovation has enabled us to provide tailored solutions and business transformations for over three decades. Leading firms have relied on Align to provide forward-thinking technology strategies that support their current and future business needs.

Our teams have flawless track records of delivering technical solutions and have established long-standing relationships with an impressive client list of both Global 1000 and SMB clients. We work across a diverse list of industries including financial services, life sciences (pharmaceutical and health care), retail, technology, media and telecommunications.

For more information, visit: www.align.com

jobs.title: Director, BioPharma Business Development - US East
jobs.description:
At Alamar, we are passionate about enabling our customers to make scientific discoveries that translate into clinical outcomes and benefit patients. Our team is growing quickly as we develop innovative approaches to measure critical protein biomarkers from liquid samples that can enable the earliest possible detection of disease. We believe the next frontier in biology is enabled by measuring proteins at higher sensitivity in highly multiplexed assays at the push of a button, which is something only Alamar can do. As we build our team, we seek collaborative, driven, intellectually curious people committed to solving complex challenges. Our culture rewards accountability and cross functional teamwork because we believe this enables the kind of breakthrough thinking that will accelerate our mission.

The Director, BioPharma Business Development will lead strategic partnerships and commercial initiatives within large pharmaceutical companies, biotech and Contract Research Organizations to increase adoption and utilization of Alamar’s ultra-sensitive proteomics platform. This role bridges science and business, driving growth through collaborations with biopharma, biotechnology companies, and clinical research organizations.  The successful candidate will have a strong track record in sales and a deep understanding of protein science, disease biomarkers, drug development and the regulatory landscape. They will also be exceptional at identifying, negotiating, and managing commercial opportunities with pharma, biotech, and CRO companies.

Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Partnerships: Identify, negotiate, and manage commercial opportunities in the BioPharma and CRO market segment

• Market Expansion: Develop and execute strategies to expand Alamar’s presence in drug discovery and translational research.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with R&D, regulatory, and commercial teams to align product development with market needs.

• Customer Engagement: Build relationships with key opinion leaders, clinical researchers, and decision-makers in BioPharma and CROs.

• Regulatory Insight: Provide input on clinical validation strategies and regulatory pathways (e.g., FDA, CE-IVD).

• Revenue Growth: Drive revenue through commercial partnerships and strategic deals.

Qualifications

• Advanced degree (PhD, MD, or MBA) in life sciences or related field.

• 10+ years in sales or business development, preferably in proteomics, diagnostics, or biotech.

• Customer centric approach and understanding client needs to translate them into product or partnership opportunities.

• Proven track record of closing strategic deals and managing complex partnerships.

• Deep understanding of drug development, clinical trial design, biomarker validation, and regulatory frameworks.

• Innovative thinking to identify novel opportunities for technology application and growth

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.

Travel:

Up to 50% domestic and international travel may be required.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $210,000 - $230,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Analytics
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

Join Crusoe as a Data Scientist, a dedicated hire on our central Data Science and Engineering team. This full-time position offers you the opportunity to own the data and analytics function for key parts of the business, starting with the Data Center Infrastructure Group (DIG) -- the arm of Crusoe that builds and operates data centers, spanning real estate, energy, construction, and parts lifecycle management. As part of a central team, you will also have the opportunity to partner with other groups across the company as needs arise.

You will partner directly with business stakeholders, translate their needs into analytical work, and own the reporting and data quality that leadership depends on for high-stakes decisions.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Own Reporting & Dashboards: Build and maintain the weekly and monthly reports and dashboards that business leaders rely on for operational decision-making. You are the DRI for accuracy and timeliness.

 - Drive New Data Integrations: Work with data engineering to identify and onboard data from third-party enterprise systems (ERP, procurement, asset management, etc.) into the data lake, defining requirements and validating data quality as new sources come online.

 - Track Complex Projects: The infrastructure side of Crusoe runs large, multi-year construction projects with long lead times and many vendors. You will build and maintain tracking for project progress, cost burn-down, timelines, and financial performance.

 - Translate Business to Technical: Take business requirements and produce technical or techno-functional specifications that data engineers can execute on. Bridge the gap between what the business needs and how the data platform delivers it.

 - Support Master Data Management: As the company matures its MDM and ERP practices, you will help ensure master data (vendors, parts, projects, cost centers, sites) is consistent and accurate across systems.

 - Champion Data Quality: Identify gaps and inconsistencies in data, investigate root causes, and work with data engineers to implement fixes. When a number is wrong, you own the resolution.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - Business Acumen: You understand why you are building something, not just what. You ask questions until the business context is clear and you can explain your work to non-technical stakeholders.

 - Technical Fluency: Possess strong SQL skills -- you will query BigQuery daily. Comfort working with large, complex datasets across multiple source systems.

 - Modern Data Stack Experience: Experience with a modern data stack (BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, or equivalents).

 - Reporting Expertise: Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports for operational use. Familiarity with BI tools (e.g., Sigma, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).

 - Stakeholder Management: Proven experience working directly with business partners to gather requirements and deliver data products. You are credible in a room with construction project managers and equally comfortable reviewing a data model with an engineer.

 - Ownership: Track record of being the go-to person for "is this number right?" You take accountability for data accuracy and do not wait to be told when something is off.



Bonus Points

Our Data Stack

jobs.description:
Overview

Do you want to join a team of dynamic and detail-oriented engineers building capabilities that apply AI to simplify and automate enterprise system observability. In this role, you will help define how observability solutions add telemetry and monitor health, performance, and usage of ArcGIS systems.

By observing and analyzing both traditional and cloud infrastructure, software components, and operational metrics, our observability platform helps organizations understand system behavior, detect anomalies, optimize performance, and plan for future capacity across complex ArcGIS deployments.

We are evolving these capabilities to incorporate AI-assisted and agentic operations, enabling administrators to interact with system telemetry using natural language. These capabilities will support system health inquiries, capacity forecasting, root cause analysis, operational planning for maintenance events, and AI-assisted troubleshooting and remediation for enterprise ArcGIS environments.

Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the Redlands, CA area for this position.

Responsibilities

• Work with software developers to design, build, test, and release high quality software

• Author and execute test plans; build and manage testing datasets for N-path, acceptance, and regression testing

• Research industry standards and specifications to translate requirements into software design

• Author Scrum user stories that define new feature capabilities to guide the software development process

• Communicate with product users to identify product requirements and advocate for their needs throughout the software development lifecycle

• Collaborate with product UI/UX designers to create mockups of rich user experiences for new capabilities

• Help define user workflows that integrate AI-assisted operations and natural language system interactions for observability and system management

• Evaluate and validate AI-assisted features that support root cause analysis, system diagnostics, performance troubleshooting, and operational recommendations

• Design and test scenarios that simulate real-world enterprise ArcGIS deployments to validate system insights and recommendations

• Help define safe operational boundaries and human-in-the-loop workflows for AI-assisted system operations and automation

• Author user guide documentation and provide technical review of user guide documentation for accuracy, completeness, and usability

• Provide best practices, user documentation, demonstrations, and technical assistance for the product

• Work with automation engineers to design UI automation

jobs.title: Float Medical Receptionist (Skokie/Old Orchard)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a Medical Receptionist, internally known as a Member Support Specialist, you will be an ambassador for patients in office, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for patient feedback, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or in office providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you'll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Master our technology suite including but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, and our Electronic Medical Record System 1Life in order to interact with team members and patients and complete daily work

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification.  They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification.  Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 1 year of experience in high touch customer or patient facing roles

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse and feedback-driven multi-disciplinary teams

• A proven track record of persisting through change, demonstrating a forward thinking perspective when under pressure, and consistently stepping up to take action on challenges

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

Competitive salary: the base pay for this position is $21.50 per hour based on a full time schedule

This is a full time role (40 hours/week) with 8 hour shifts generally taking place between Monday-Friday 8:00am-7:00pm based in person at our Skokie office in Chicago, IL. This role will also flex to provide as needed to support to the Oak Brook office.

Physical Demands: Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to ten pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
COMPANY 

Credit Genie is a mobile-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long-term financial stability.


Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki https://www.linkedin.com/in/ed-harycki/, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017 https://techcrunch.com/2017/08/10/paypal-acquires-swift-financial/). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting-edge technology and customer-centric solutions.

Overview

Credit Genie is hiring a People Business Partner to shape how we evaluate performance, develop talent, and reward meaningful results. Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you will advise leaders on critical people decisions and build the programs and agentic workflows that support them.

Your primary focus will be helping leaders evaluate contribution, develop their teams, and reward meaningful results. You will carry the same approach across the employee experience, building agentic AI workflows into the programs and processes you own. This is an individual contributor role with responsibility for both advising leaders and turning improvements into reliable ways of working.

Responsibilities

 - Partner with leaders to set clear performance expectations, strengthen management practices, and connect talent and reward decisions to business priorities. Use reliable people data and AI-assisted analysis to identify gaps and inform recommendations.

 - Design and run performance reviews, calibration, and promotion processes, building agentic workflows that collect and validate inputs, prepare decision materials, coordinate approvals, and follow through on outcomes.

 - Shape and deliver salary, bonus, equity, and recognition programs with the Chief People Officer and Finance. Connect market data, individual contribution, internal consistency, and company priorities, using automation to support analysis, scenario modeling, and the implementation of approved decisions.

 - Coach managers through feedback, development, and underperformance, turning insights from performance and reward cycles into clear actions and following through on progress.

 - Own benefits administration and immigration coordination, using agentic workflows to automate routine work and partnering with providers and counsel on complex cases.

 - Connect onboarding, offboarding, and payroll to accurate employee records, automating approved data changes, validation, and reconciliation. Test and monitor workflows, protect sensitive information, and resolve exceptions, measuring improvements in accuracy, turnaround time, and manual effort.

Qualifications

 - Experience in People business partnering, operations, or program leadership, with direct ownership of performance and rewards programs in a growing business.

 - Strong business judgment and credibility with leaders, including experience coaching managers through performance, compensation, organizational, and sensitive employee decisions.

 - Demonstrated ability to build and operate agentic AI workflows. You can explain the problem you addressed, what you implemented, where human judgment remained necessary, and the results.

 - Analytical and technical fluency across compensation data, spreadsheets, HR systems, and integrations. Experience with low-code tools, APIs, SQL, or scripting is useful.

 - Clear communication, deliberate prioritization, and ownership from problem definition through adoption and improvement. You handle sensitive information with discretion and work effectively with Finance, IT, service providers, and counsel.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

Our goal is to provide a comprehensive offering of benefits and perks that promote better financial, mental, and physical wellness.



We believe working alongside each other in person is the best way to build a great product and foster a strong company culture. Our expectation is that employees are in the office five days a week, allowing for optimal collaboration, inclusivity, and productivity. At the same time, we understand that life happens and recognize the importance of flexibility. We are committed to supporting our employees when circumstances arise that require remote work or adjusted schedules. Our goal is to ensure everyone can effectively balance personal and professional responsibilities while maintaining our collaborative and productive environment.



Here are some highlights of our benefits and perks offerings, feel free to ask your recruiting partner for more details on our comprehensive offering for employees.

 - 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents on your first day of employment. 

 - Receive up to $100 per month in fitness reimbursement or enjoy a complimentary full membership to LifeTime Fitness or Equinox.

 - 401(k) with a 3.5% match and immediate vesting 

 - Meal program available for both lunch and dinner

 - Pre-tax benefits, including a $1,000 HSA match

 - Life and accidental insurance

 - Flexible PTO
   
   

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total compensation and rewards package at Credit Genie. You may also be eligible to participate in the bonus and equity programs. You will also have access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, short & long term disability insurance, life insurance, and flexible PTO along with many other benefits and perks.



Credit Genie is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer where we welcome and celebrate differences. We are committed to providing a workspace that is safe and inclusive, where everyone feels supported, connected, and inspired to do their best work. If you require any accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, please inform us of your needs when we contact you to schedule an interview.

TripleLift is the Creative SSP powered by TL Spark, our agentic intelligence layer. We orchestrate creative, supply, audience, and measurement into a single outcome-driven system across the open internet, retail media, and CTV. Our platform enables brands and agencies to drive measurable performance while helping publishers maximize yield and preserve high-quality user experiences.

Overview

TripleLift delivers measurable outcomes through orchestration of creative, supply, audience, and intelligence. To turn that strategy into results, we are seeking a Chief of Staff to serve as a strategic thought partner to the CEO and a force multiplier for the executive team.

The Chief of Staff plays a critical role in how TripleLift shapes, executes, and communicates its most important strategic initiatives. In this position, you will partner closely with the CEO, executive leadership, and our private equity sponsor to pressure-test plans, drive cross-functional execution, and keep priorities from being diluted as they move through the organization. This is not an administrative role. It is an opportunity for someone who wants to help create and execute strategy, and who is comfortable moving between high-level thinking and hands-on work. The role is a stepping stone to a senior strategy, operations or P&L leadership position. This is a hybrid position based in our New York City office, with an expectation of working in the office three days per week.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a thought partner to the CEO and executive team on strategic questions, building and interpreting the KPIs that tie directly to the company’s strategic mission.

• Sit on the exec team as a direct report to the CEO.

• Help create and drive cross-functional strategic initiatives across finance, operations, and go-to-market, including margin improvement, cost takeout, growth programs, and transformation work.

• Pressure-test plans for feasibility before rollout and give candid, data-backed feedback to leadership.

• Run or support 100-day plans, synergy tracking, and carve-out or integration workstreams for mergers and acquisitions.

• Communicate strategy and outcomes to varied audiences, including employees, the board of directors, and financial sponsors, and prepare board and sponsor materials.

• Own the CEO’s executive operating rhythm, including reporting cadences, executive team and board preparation, follow-through on commitments, and cross-functional coordination.

• Act as a trusted liaison between the C-suite and the broader organization, influencing without authority to keep initiatives on track.

Education & Requirements

• MBA or post-undergraduate master’s degree is a plus.

• A minimum of 4 years of experience at a top strategy consulting firm, ideally with exposure to corporate strategy, operations, or private equity portfolio work.

• Direct experience working inside private equity portfolio companies (as an embedded resource, EIR, or through a PE operating group) on margin improvement, driving operating leverage, or growth initiatives is a plus.

• Experience running or supporting 100-day plans, M&A, synergy tracking, or carve-out and integration workstreams, ideally across tech, finance, operations, and go-to-market functions.

• Comfort moving between high-level strategy and day-to-day execution, reporting cadences, and cross-functional coordination.

• Discreet, low-ego, high-output, with strong relationship skills and the ability to act as a force multiplier for a CEO and executive team without needing the spotlight.

• Military background is a plus: former operational commissioned officer (Army, Navy, Marine Corps, or Air Force), ideally with experience leading teams under operational pressure and tight timelines.

jobs.title: Production Line Lead
jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.



With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

What You’ll Do



The Production Line Lead will serve as a go-to technical leader on the production floor, with a primary focus on hands-on spacecraft assembly, integration, testing, and build execution. Working closely with the Production Supervisor, they will help coordinate daily production activities to meet schedule, quality, and safety requirements while supporting the successful execution of spacecraft builds.



This is a front line and hands-on leadership role. The Line Lead will work alongside Production Technicians while assisting with coordinating day-to-day activities and providing technical guidance, supporting cross-training, reinforcing production standards, and identifying and escalating issues that could impact safety, quality, or delivery. The Line Lead will set the standard for production performance through strong technical execution, accountability, teamwork, and leading by example. They will collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Production, Production Planning, Inventory, and other Engineering teams within Xona’s satellite production facility.



This is a highly visible, high-impact opportunity to help shape how Xona builds spacecrafts on at scale. The Production Line Lead will help establish and reinforce disciplined production practices while supporting the consistent delivery of high-quality spacecraft as manufacturing operations continue to grow.



Key Responsibilities

 - Perform hands-on assembly, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and rework of spacecraft components and subsystems while supporting and guiding Production Technicians during daily build activities.

 - Serve as the first line of support for Production Technicians

 - Coordinate closely with the Production Supervisor and Production Planner to execute daily priorities, maintain schedule alignment, and identify potential production constraints or risks.

 - Update the Production Supervisor on current line status

 - Adhere to all safety requirements and reinforce proper cleanroom, ESD, FOD, and contamination-control practices throughout satellite production activities.

 - Assemble and integrate electrical and mechanical spacecraft components and subsystems, including electrical harnesses, mechanical structures, and related hardware, in accordance with approved digital work instructions, drawings, and procedures.

 - Perform spacecraft-level assembly activities including cable routing, thermal insulation installation, soldering, bonding, torque-controlled fastener installation, testing, anomaly identification, troubleshooting, and repair or resolution.

 - Accurately measure, record, test, and document required data throughout complex assembly and integration processes to maintain quality and traceability.

 - Solder and perform PCB handling and in-process inspections in accordance with applicable IPC J-STD-001 workmanship criteria, as well as functional and continuity testing when required.

 - Operate, maintain, and support production equipment, tooling, QA test benches, holding fixtures, and other manufacturing systems used during spacecraft assembly and testing.

 - Maintain strong 5S and FOD standards while helping ensure production areas, equipment, tools, and workstations remain organized and production ready.

 - Provide technical guidance to Production Technicians, support cross-training initiatives, and help develop consistent assembly practices across the production team.

 - Identify and escalate safety, quality, material, tooling, process, and schedule issues that could impact production execution.

 - Partner with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to troubleshoot build issues and support timely resolution of production anomalies.

 - Assist with improving and clarifying assembly, integration, and test instructions to increase build quality, repeatability, efficiency, and technician usability.

 - Support the development and continuous improvement of standardized production processes as Xona transitions toward higher-volume, repeatable spacecraft manufacturing.



What You'll Bring:

 - Demonstrated ability to lead by example while remaining actively engaged in hands-on production work.

 - Proficiency using hand tools, precision measurement equipment, torque-controlled tooling

 - Experience using electrical test equipment such as multimeters, ohmmeters, DC power supplies, oscilloscopes, and other laboratories or production test equipment.

 - Experience operating production and test equipment such as environmental chambers, mechanical deployment fixtures, complex lifting equipment, vibration and shock test systems, thermal cycling equipment, 3D printers, and other manufacturing or qualification equipment.

 - Comfortable handling sensitive electronics, flight hardware, and small mechanical components requiring precision and attention to detail.

 - Strong organizational, communication, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.

 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving production environment where processes and systems continue to mature.

 - Strong attention to detail with a commitment to safety, quality, accountability, and disciplined execution.

 - Ability to work collaboratively across Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Supply Chain, Inventory, and Engineering teams.



Required Qualification

 - High school diploma/GED

 - Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience performing mechanical and/or electrical assembly in a production or manufacturing environment.

 - Minimum of 2 years of experience in a formal lead role, or demonstrated experience performing equivalent lead-level responsibilities, including coordinating production activities, providing technical guidance, supporting cross-training, and serving as a key point of contact for hands-on assembly, integration, and testing activities.

 - Certified IPC-JSTD-001 Specialist (CIS)



Preferred

 - Previous spacecraft, satellite, aerospace, and other high-reliability electromechanical assembly experience.

 - Experience supporting production ramp-up, new product introduction (NPI), or the transition from prototype builds to repeatable manufacturing.

 - Experience training and mentoring Production Technicians on complex assembly and test processes.



Bonus

 - Experience reading and interpreting electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, assembly instructions, and technical documentation, with a basic understanding of GD&T.

 - WHMA/IPC-A-620 Certification

 - IPC-A-610 Certification

For U.S. Roles: To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). 



For U.K. Roles: To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).



For Canada Roles: Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR. 



We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Envision spending your summer working with energetic colleagues and inspirational leaders, all while gaining world-class experience in one of the most dynamic organizations in the pharmaceutical industry. This is a reality for AbbVie Interns.

We are seeking a motivated summer intern with experience in analytical chemistry to develop new analytical methods for late-stage and commercial small-molecule assets. This role will center on using analytical technologies including high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), rapid spectroscopy (NIR/Raman), mass spectrometry (MS, MS/MS) and peptide mapping. The intern will work on method development, instrument setup, sample preparation, data collection, and method optimization using a vast array of modern analytical instruments and analysis platforms.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in analytical chemistry, spectroscopy, chromatography, mass spectrometry, and modern analytical techniques and data analysis.

Key responsibilities include:

• Developing novel analytical methods and evaluating method accuracy, precision sensitivity, robustness, etc.; Comparing methods across multiple instruments and platforms to determine the best fit for the intended application

• Interpreting mass spectral data using appropriate software and data analysis workflows; Building chemometrics calibration model as appropriate

• Supporting development of platform methods for peptide mapping and MS/MS based quantitative analysis of biologics and peptide-based drugs

Minimum Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in university, pursuing a BS in chemistry or other related field

• Must be enrolled in university for at least one semester following the internship

• Expected graduation date between December 2027 – June 2028.

• Hands-on wet lab experience is required

• Experience with common analytical techniques, including IR/Raman spectroscopy, HPLC, Mass Spectrometry, etc.

• Strong writing and communication skills

jobs.title: Product Engineer II - ArcGIS Monitor
jobs.description:
Overview

Do you want to join a team of dynamic and detail-oriented engineers building capabilities that apply AI to simplify and automate enterprise system observability. In this role, you will help define how observability solutions add telemetry and monitor health, performance, and usage of ArcGIS systems.

By observing and analyzing both traditional and cloud infrastructure, software components, and operational metrics, our observability platform helps organizations understand system behavior, detect anomalies, optimize performance, and plan for future capacity across complex ArcGIS deployments.

We are evolving these capabilities to incorporate AI-assisted and agentic operations, enabling administrators to interact with system telemetry using natural language. These capabilities will support system health inquiries, capacity forecasting, root cause analysis, operational planning for maintenance events, and AI-assisted troubleshooting and remediation for enterprise ArcGIS environments.

Responsibilities

• Work with software developers to design, build, test, and release high quality software

• Author and execute test plans; build and manage testing datasets for N-path, acceptance, and regression testing

• Research industry standards and specifications to translate requirements into software design

• Author Scrum user stories that define new feature capabilities to guide the software development process

• Communicate with product users to identify product requirements and advocate for their needs throughout the software development lifecycle

• Collaborate with product UI/UX designers to create mockups of rich user experiences for new capabilities

• Help define user workflows that integrate AI-assisted operations and natural language system interactions for observability and system management

• Evaluate and validate AI-assisted features that support root cause analysis, system diagnostics, performance troubleshooting, and operational recommendations

• Help design and test scenarios that simulate real-world enterprise ArcGIS deployments to validate system insights and recommendations

• Help define safe operational boundaries and human-in-the-loop workflows for AI-assisted system operations and automation

• Author user guide documentation and provide technical review of user guide documentation for accuracy, completeness, and usability

• Provide best practices, user documentation, demonstrations, and technical assistance for the product

• Work with automation engineers to design UI automation

• Experience deploying and/or administering ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, or other comparable IT systems (web / application servers

• Familiarity with traditional RDBMS systems (preferably PostgreSQL), including common SQL commands and concepts

• Familiarity with general server administration on Windows or Linux

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, working in a cross-functional environment

• Excellent problem solving and analytical skills

Recommended Qualifications

• Masters in Information Systems (IS), Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, or STEM related field

• Strong testing and QA experience with software products

• Experience maintaining and troubleshooting complex enterprise systems

• Experience with observability systems and performance monitoring concepts (ArcGIS Monitor, Prometheus, Datadog, OpenTelemetry)

• Working knowledge of at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Shell, PowerShell, JavaScript)

• Experience in the SCRUM process and its application to the software development lifecycle

• Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and their use in developer tools, operational platforms, or observability systems

• Experience with prompt engineering or designing workflows that leverage natural language interfaces

• Understanding of LLM limitations, including hallucinations, context limitations, and reliability challenges

• Interest in building AI-assisted operational systems that help automate diagnostics, troubleshooting, and infrastructure optimization

• Exposure to AI-assisted observability or AIOps concepts

• Experience with software control systems (GIT) and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) concepts

jobs.title: Machine Operator
jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Title: Machine Operator
Starting Pay Rate: $19.00/hr
Location:  Buckeye Lake, OH
Job Type: Full Time | Non-Exempt
Shift: Monday - Friday | 7:30am - 4:00pm  (NOTE: start and end times may vary based on business needs)

Who You Are:

You’re someone who takes pride in doing things the right way — with consistency, care, and attention to detail. In this role, you’ll be responsible for operating and maintaining the equipment used to fill and package our finished cannabis products, including vaporizers, pre-rolls, and flower pre-packs. You understand how to keep production running smoothly, troubleshoot issues when they arise, and maintain a clean and safe work environment.

You communicate well, stay organized, and can work independently while knowing when to loop in your team. You take ownership of your work, support your teammates, and stay focused on production goals without cutting corners on quality or safety.

What You’ll Do:

As a Machine Operator Technician at Curaleaf, you will operate, maintain, and troubleshoot production equipment to support the efficient, safe, and consistent filling and packaging of finished products. You’ll work hands-on to monitor performance, communicate equipment needs, and uphold production and safety standards. In this role, you will:

• Operate, clean, change-over, and maintain production equipment while monitoring performance and documenting issues

• Troubleshoot equipment malfunctions, reduce downtime, and coordinate repairs with maintenance and vendors

• Maintain tools and spare parts, support preventative maintenance schedules, and ensure equipment readiness

• Uphold safety, sanitation, and compliance standards while supporting continuous improvement efforts, including 5S and waste reduction

• Communicate effectively with team members and leads, adapt to production priorities, and assist in training new operators

• Perform required physical tasks, including climbing, lifting, and working in confined spaces

What You’ll Bring:

• Experience operating and maintaining manufacturing or production equipment

• Strong mechanical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and make minor repairs

• Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow standard operating procedures

• Clear and professional communication skills across teams and levels

• Commitment to maintaining a safe, clean, and compliant work environment

• Physical ability to lift, climb, and work in confined or elevated spaces as needed

• Reliability, strong work ethic, organization, and attention to detail

• Basic understanding of weights, measurements, and documentation accuracy

• Customer- and quality-focused mindset, with dedication to operational excellence

• Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) certification or willingness to obtain within 90 days of hire

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand, walk, sit, bend, squat, and reach repetitively for extended periods (8–10 hour shifts)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs routinely, with occasional heavier lifting using assistance

• Ability to climb ladders and work in low or confined spaces when needed

• Ability to work at a computer or screen for extended periods and maintain close vision for reading small print

• Ability to use all required PPE, including masks, hair nets, beard covers, respirators, boot covers, scrubs, non-slip shoes, and Tyvek suits as necessary

Environmental Conditions

• Exposure to environments with high humidity, varying temperatures, and strong odors (such as cannabis)

• Exposure to soil, water, fertilizer, dust, pollen and plant pathogens

• Exposure to cleaning solvents, such as high volumes of isopropyl alcohol

• Exposure to loud noises, including but not limited to air compressors, packaging equipment, and alarms

• Exposure to CO2 manufacturing procedures at OSHA approved CO2 levels

Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT HYPERBOUND

Sales runs on conversations. At Hyperbound, we’re building the AI Agent that turns those conversations into action, helping sales teams sharpen their skills, make better decisions, and move deals forward.

Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform: an agentic OS for sales that connects what happens to what should happen next.

We came out of YC S23 and went viral with Voice Agents that reps could call to put their skills to the test. Today, we’re building AI that understands sales conversations, coaches in real time, reasons across deals, and takes action to move them forward.

We are trusted by companies like LinkedIn, Amazon, Intel, Notion, and Vanta. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, grew ARR 5× over the past year, and are growing nearly 20% month over month.


THE TEAM YOU'LL BUILD WITH

We’re assembling a team of builders and operators who do their best work together. You’ll work alongside people who’ve built companies, scaled teams, and joined Hyperbound after experiencing the product as customers. We value curiosity, strong opinions, and a shared commitment to solving customer problems.

We pair ownership with close collaboration. You’ll have room to shape your approach, with the expectation that you share your reasoning, discuss tradeoffs, and align with teammates before moving forward. We want people who bring recommendations, invite feedback, and understand how their decisions affect the broader team.

We have each other’s backs. We share context, give direct feedback, and work through disagreements openly. When something goes wrong, we take responsibility, solve it together, and use what we learn to improve.

We move quickly through clear priorities and coordinated action. We take ambitious swings, stay close to customers, and change direction when the evidence calls for it.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll turn Hyperbound’s marketing priorities into campaigns that build awareness, generate qualified demand, and grow pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines paid advertising expertise with sound judgment, brings clear recommendations, and works closely with the team to turn plans into measurable results.


WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

 - Growth experience: You bring 4+ years of marketing experience at a Series A–C startup, including hands-on B2B SaaS demand generation and paid advertising experience.

 - Paid advertising expertise: You have directly managed Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, owning campaign setup, audience targeting, budget allocation, creative testing, conversion tracking, and ongoing optimization against CAC, ROAS, and qualified pipeline.

 - Content and conversion: You partner with Product Marketing on SEO/AEO and website optimization strategies, create and update ads, articles, landing pages, and customer stories, and build campaigns around agreed messaging and audience priorities.

 - Campaign collaboration: You work with Sales, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, and executive leadership to turn business priorities into targeted campaigns, with clear plans for promotion, lead capture, and follow-up.

 - Measurement and execution: You use CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, lead quality, and pipeline contribution to improve performance, explain your recommendations, and align with teammates before launching or making material changes.


HIGHLY PREFERRED

 - B2B SaaS experience: We strongly prefer someone who has built and optimized growth campaigns in a B2B SaaS company, with experience navigating complex buying journeys, multiple stakeholders, and longer sales cycles.

 - Integrated campaigns: Experience connecting paid advertising, content, field activations, and executive programs to qualified pipeline, with close collaboration across Product Marketing and Sales.


WHAT YOUR REGULAR THURSDAY LOOKS LIKE:

 - Dig into Google and LinkedIn performance, trace a drop in demo conversions, and check lead quality and pipeline impact. Bring a recommendation on budget or targeting changes, align with the team, and put the next creative test live.

 - Work through an upcoming campaign with Marketing leadership, aligning on the audience, offer, messaging, channel mix, and launch timing. Build the ads, emails, and landing page, keeping the team informed as the campaign takes shape.

 - Prepare promotion and lead capture for a field activation or executive program. Coordinate target accounts and meeting goals with Sales and Field Marketing, test the registration and booking flows, and have follow-up ready before launch.

 - Review search and website performance with Product Marketing, refresh content for SEO/AEO, and check forms, tracking, and conversion paths. Close the loop with Sales on recent leads, share what’s driving pipeline, and recommend what to improve next.


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - A remote role. You’ll work from our San Francisco office five days a week.

 - A strategy-only position. You’ll build, launch, and optimize paid campaigns yourself and execute the work in house.

 - A role measured only by lead volume. You’ll stay close to lead quality, Sales follow-up, and pipeline contribution across paid advertising, content, field activations, and executive programs.
