jobs.title: Senior GTM Engineering Analyst
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



At 1Password, we believe everyone deserves to be safe online. As a Senior GTM Engineering Analyst, you’ll build artificial intelligence (AI) agents, data products, and analysis workflows that help global go-to-market teams work faster and make better decisions.



You’ll connect information across business systems, automate repetitive processes, and create reliable insights for leaders across Sales, Solutions, Customer Experience, and Channel. Your work will help make security simpler and more human-centric for the millions of people and thousands of businesses that rely on 1Password. This role reports to the Director, GTM Engineering (Revenue Operations)



How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.



What we're looking for:

 - Bring 4+ years of experience in analytics, revenue operations, sales operations, data analysis, or a related field.

 - Have experience building AI agents or workflows powered by large language models (LLMs) that have been used in real business work.

 - Experience building and maintaining decision-ready dashboards, reports, and data products in Power BI or comparable business intelligence tools, including data modeling, visualization, metric definition, and ongoing maintenance for GTM stakeholders

 - Work confidently with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.

 - Use Structured Query Language (SQL) effectively and apply working knowledge of statistics to distinguish meaningful results from noise.

 - Document and improve business processes with a focus on reducing manual work and improving decision-making.



Bonus points for:

 - Have experience with Python for building automations, working with application programming interfaces (APIs), and connecting systems, along with go-to-market tools such as Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, or business intelligence platforms.

 - Have supported channel or partner sales motions, worked across multiple regions, or studied a quantitative discipline such as science, engineering, statistics, or mathematics.



What you can expect:

 - Rebuild sales and revenue operations processes to reduce manual work.

 - Build and maintain AI agents that prepare call and deal briefs, draft customer follow-ups, rank target accounts, and flag deals that need attention.

 - Build and maintain data tables and scheduled analysis jobs that combine information from Salesforce, Gong, and other go-to-market systems.

 - Create reports, alerts, and weekly manager briefs used by sales leadership.

 -  Partner with Sales, Solutions, Customer Experience, Channel, and Revenue Operations teams to understand business needs and define clear technical requirements.

 - Map existing go-to-market processes, identify opportunities to improve data quality and efficiency, and help teams make better decisions.

 - Evaluate AI-generated outputs for quality, accuracy, privacy, data access, and appropriate safeguards; measure adoption and effectiveness, then improve workflows based on feedback and results.



USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $113,000 USD and $146,000 USD.  This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $105,000 CAD and $136,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. 


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.



You belong here.



1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.



Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.



Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.



Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

jobs.description:

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

Think, be and do you.
At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.

Fulfil is redefining the grocery supply chain through advanced robotics and automation. Backed by world-class investors and led by a seasoned team, we are hiring a Site Automation Lead to provide operational coverage for our automated high speed grocery fulfillment system. In this role, you’ll serve as the bridge between partner operations, maintenance, and Fulfil engineering — ensuring safe, reliable, high-performance system operation.

Unique opportunity: Pre-launch, take part in site deployment, from bring-up and commissioning, through partner handover and site acceptance testing, into full production.

System Monitoring & First-Level Diagnostics

• Perform Tier-1 troubleshooting; triage issues, complete minor interventions (e.g., sensor checks, part swaps, clearing obstructions), and support investigations and post-mortems.

Support maintenance by documenting issues clearly and handing off higher-complexity work.

Operational Leadership

• Act as the on-call technical and operational escalation point for partner teams.

• Make real-time decisions that balance system uptime, safety, and production needs.

• Track and report reliability metrics to contribute toward achieving uptime goals.

• Ensure a safe operating environment through routine audits and adherence to procedures.

• Provide the second level of escalation, ability to step into the Site Lead Position if needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Communicate system behaviors and findings to robotics, firmware, software, and product engineering teams.

• Participate in structured testing, validation, and rollout of new features and hardware.

• Contribute to root-cause investigations and provide actionable feedback to engineering.

• Help refine operating procedures and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Partner Support & Training

• Provide steady, high-confidence technical support to onsite partner operators.

• Train partner team members on best practices for system interaction, recoveries, and safety.

Ensure partners feel supported, informed, and empowered in daily operations.

What We’re Looking For

Experience in robotics, automation, industrial equipment, technical field support, or similar environments.

• Strong mechanical/electrical aptitude and comfort working hands-on with hardware.

• Safety first mentality, adhering to OSHA guidelines while prioritizing a safe work environment.

• Clear communicator with ability to explain complex system behavior simply.

• Calm, detail-oriented decision-maker who performs well under pressure.

• Comfortable using dashboards, logs, and diagnostic tools.

• Reliable, self-motivated, and able to operate with a high degree of ownership.

• Flexible schedule — preference for candidates with open availability.

Bonus Experience (Not Required)

• Exposure to warehouse automation, robotics platforms, PLCs, or industrial systems.

• Familiarity with Linux, telemetry tools, firmware process flows, or diagnostics.

• Experience supporting deployments, pilots, commissioning, or on-call rotations.

• Experience with tools like Slack, Jira, Excel, or digital workflow platforms.

What You’ll Get

• Early-stage exposure to a fast-scaling robotics company.

• Salary + equity in a mission-driven organization.

• Full medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) benefits.

• A supportive, high-ownership operational culture.

• Opportunities to work closely with engineering and help shape a live automation system.

Company Overview 

Red 6 is an innovative Augmented Reality (AR) technology startup leading the way in synthetic air combat training. Our primary technology, supporting our ATARS product, enables pilots to simulate the cognitive challenges of flying while accessing realistic, scalable training in dynamic outdoor environments.

Mechanical Engineer

Job Summary

In this role, you will translate high-level product needs into actionable mechanical design solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define requirements, align on technical approaches, and develop the documentation needed to support implementation, verification, and production, including bills of materials (BOMs), assembly instructions, design specifications, test plans, schedules, and issue-tracking records.

Key Responsibilities

 - Design mechanical components and assemblies within a cross-functional team environment.

 - Develop mechanical drawings and specifications; review vendor design proposals for technical compliance.

 - Gather and define component-level design requirements and specifications with stakeholders across disciplines.

 - Conduct research and development to identify optimal technologies within product cost constraints.

 - Provide system-level mechanical design support for products in development.

 - Partner with discipline leads to establish guidelines and requirements for system-level and component-level specifications.

 - Apply sound engineering principles and precision-tolerance techniques to the design of optical and mechanical systems.

 - Lead engineering design reviews.

 - Drive design improvements that address customer-reported reliability and usability issues.

 - Collaborate across disciplines to deliver new products.

 - Mature early prototypes through increasing levels of fidelity and translate preliminary concepts into production-ready products.

 - Deliver to program schedules, collaborating with Program Managers to keep design & development activities on track.

 - Plan and execute simulation, modeling, design, and test activities throughout the product-development lifecycle.

 - Troubleshoot system-level issues and develop and implement verification tests.

 - Provide technical guidance to team members in issue resolution and product development.

 - Create development test plans to ensure compliance with applicable industry standards.

 - Perform system- and subsystem-level design, modeling, and prototyping.

 - Conduct structural analysis using hand calculations and finite element analysis (FEA).

 - Apply design-for-manufacturability and design-for-production principles.

 - Create production drawings and apply and interpret Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).

 - Provide status reports and supporting technical documentation.

 - Research and apply advanced materials and manufacturing processes for cross-disciplinary mechanical, optical, and electrical system components.

Experience, Skills, and Required Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 2-5+ years of hands-on product design and prototyping experience, with demonstrated work in precision mechanisms, electromechanical systems, and/or optical systems.

 - 2-5+ years of experience in a multidisciplinary engineering or design role supporting consumer-electronics or comparable product-development programs.

 - Experience collaborating with Industrial Design, Engineering, Research, and cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex product-design and user-experience challenges.

 - Strong knowledge of 3D mathematics, numerical methods, modeling, and simulation.

 - Knowledge of manufacturing methods and rapid-prototyping processes.

 - Experience creating mechanical test procedures and supporting product verification activities.

 - Experience applying finite element analysis (FEA), computational fluid dynamics (CFD), and related engineering-analysis tools.

 - Experience designing for environmental durability, including high levels of dust and water ingress protection.

 - Experience translating Industrial Design intent into manufacturable mechanical design solutions.

 - Ability to commute to or relocate to Louisville, Colorado.

Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.



To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers http://www.industriousoffice.com/careers.




ABOUT THE ROLE



As a Senior Design Manager, you will serve a critical role in delivering outstanding environments for our customers and innovating on the physical products we provide. You will work closely with other Design Managers, Product Development, as well as cross-functional Real Estate, Construction, Operations, and Launch teams to support the company's growth and development goals for new locations.



We're looking for a creative self-starter who works comfortably in ambiguous circumstances, proactively seeks solutions to issues, and is excited to have a voice in design and product conversations across the organization.



This role may be based in any US Industrious Hub Market (New York City, Boston, Washington DC, Chicago, Atlanta, Tampa, or Austin).




WHAT MIGHT YOUR DAY LOOK LIKE



Your day might start reviewing a test fit and blocking plan with Real Estate and Operations for a site in the pipeline. From there, you shift to overseeing construction documents and coordinating with external architects, engineers, and vendors to keep a project on budget and schedule. Part of the afternoon might go to specifying FF&E, artwork, and greenery for an upcoming launch, or coaching a Design Manager through a project decision. By the end of the day, you're looking at ways to improve your team's design workflows, or thinking through how an emerging design trend could shape future product standards.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN



 - Project Leadership: Oversee select projects through all phases of design, including Test Fit, SD, DD, CD, Construction Administration, and launch. Ensure that Industrious product standards and guidelines are followed in design decision-making, advocating for both our brand and design vision to landlord partners, while managing the quality of vendor outputs.

 - Strategic Planning: Collaborate with Real Estate, Operations, and Construction on programming, blocking plans, and test fits.

 - FF&E Oversight: Specify furniture, accessories, artwork, and greenery.

 - Cross-Functional Coordination: Work collaboratively with Construction, Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, Operations, and Facilities, as well as external consultants and vendors.

 - Process Improvements: Identify and implement opportunities to enhance design workflows and efficiency.

 - Design Innovation: Identify design ideas, trends, and new product specifications to evolve our design standards and innovate our physical workplace products.

 - Team Building: Build a positive culture on our growing team and have significant input to our design vision, strategy, and execution.

 - People Management: Coach Design Managers and manage performance.
   
   


YOU WILL LOVE THIS ROLE IF…



 - You are a creative self-starter who works comfortably in ambiguous circumstances.

 - You proactively seek solutions to issues and want a real voice in design and product conversations across the organization.

 - You enjoy managing multiple concurrent projects and prioritizing effectively under competing deadlines.
   
   


THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF…



 - You need a large internal team of junior designers to collaborate with and delegate day to day production to.

 - You prefer working on a single, predictable project type rather than a varied portfolio across different sites and programs.
   
   


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



 - Experience: 8 to 10 years leading design, working with end users, with a Bachelor's degree in Architecture or Interior Design.

 - Expertise: Proven track record in workplace design. Experience with hospitality, mixed use or residential design, highly preferred. Experience and knowledge of the construction process as it relates to design, both in terms of relative cost and constructability.

 - Technical Skills: Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam; strong grasp of building codes, MEP design, construction documentation.

 - Communication: Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate design ideas.

 - Time Management: Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects and deadlines.

 - Collaboration: Comfortable working in a virtual, distributed team environment.

 - Values: Commitment to integrity, teamwork, and ownership.

 - Travel: Willingness to travel within the US for site visits, project launches and team events up to 1 to 2 times per month.
   
   


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



The base salary for this role is $125,000 to $135,000, depending on experience, skills, and role alignment. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus and participation in our long term incentive program.

jobs.description:

Full-Time, Salaried | $22-$25/hourly  + Equity

Fulfil is redefining the grocery supply chain through advanced robotics and automation. Backed by world-class investors and led by a seasoned team, we are hiring a Site Automation Lead to provide operational coverage for our automated high speed grocery fulfillment system. In this role, you’ll serve as the bridge between partner operations, maintenance, and Fulfil engineering — ensuring safe, reliable, high-performance system operation.

Unique opportunity: Pre-launch, take part in site deployment, from bring-up and commissioning, through partner handover and site acceptance testing, into full production.

System Monitoring & First-Level Diagnostics

• Perform Tier-1 troubleshooting; triage issues, complete minor interventions (e.g., sensor checks, part swaps, clearing obstructions), and support investigations and post-mortems.

Support maintenance by documenting issues clearly and handing off higher-complexity work.

Operational Leadership

• Track and report reliability metrics to contribute toward achieving uptime goals.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Communicate system behaviors and findings to robotics, firmware, software, and product engineering teams.

• Participate in structured testing, validation, and rollout of new features and hardware.

• Contribute to root-cause investigations and provide actionable feedback to engineering.

• Help refine operating procedures and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Partner Support & Training

• Provide steady, high-confidence technical support to onsite partner operators.

• Train partner team members on best practices for system interaction, recoveries, and safety.

Ensure partners feel supported, informed, and empowered in daily operations.

What We’re Looking For

Passion for robotics, automation, industrial equipment, technical field support, or similar environments.

• Safety first mentality, adhering to OSHA guidelines while prioritizing a safe work environment.

• Clear communicator with ability to explain complex system behavior simply.

• Calm, detail-oriented decision-maker who performs well under pressure.

• Comfortable using dashboards, logs, and diagnostic tools.

• Reliable, self-motivated, and able to operate with a high degree of ownership.

• Flexible schedule — preference for candidates with open availability.

Bonus Experience (Not Required)

• Exposure to warehouse automation, robotics platforms, PLCs, or industrial systems.

• Familiarity with Linux, telemetry tools, firmware process flows, or diagnostics.

• Experience supporting deployments, pilots, commissioning, or on-call rotations.

• Experience with tools like Slack, Jira, Excel, or digital workflow platforms.

What You’ll Get

• Early-stage exposure to a fast-scaling robotics company.

• Salary + equity in a mission-driven organization.

• Full medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) benefits.

• A supportive, high-ownership operational culture.

• Opportunities to work closely with engineering and help shape a live automation system.

jobs.title: Pipeline Designer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atwell, LLC is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!

Atwell, LLC is a proud recipient of the following 2025 awards:

• Ten consecutive years in a row as a “Best Place to Work” by Zweig Group (#11)

• Recognized as #70 in the ENR Top 500 Design Firms, ranked in every region

• Recognized in Crain's “Fast 50” as one of the fastest-growing companies (#14)

• Recognized as the 2025 ENR Design Firm of the year for the Southeastern US

Position Overview

Atwell is seeking an experienced Piping Designer to support our growing Oil & Gas (Hydrocarbons) team, with a focus on midstream pipeline and facility design.

In this role, you will support the design and development of oil and natural gas infrastructure, including compressor stations, pump stations, meter and regulator stations, pipeline interconnects, terminals, and other associated facilities. Additional projects may include CO₂, hydrogen, and renewable natural gas (RNG) infrastructure.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in 3D piping design, equipment layouts, and construction documentation, with direct experience supporting midstream oil and gas projects. You will work closely with mechanical, process, civil, structural, and electrical engineering teams to develop accurate, constructible designs from initial concepts through issued-for-construction deliverables.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of piping design experience, preferably within the oil and gas midstream sector.

• Direct experience designing piping systems for midstream facilities such as compressor stations, pump stations, meter stations, terminals, or pipeline interconnect facilities.

• Proficiency in CADWorx and AutoCAD for 3D piping modeling, equipment layouts, and construction drawing development.

• Experience with Plant 3D, Navisworks, Inventor, or similar design software is a plus.

• Strong understanding of piping components, valves, fittings, flanges, pipe supports, and equipment connections.

• Experience developing piping isometrics, general arrangements, piping plans, sections, and bills of materials.

• Ability to interpret P&IDs, process flow diagrams (PFDs), equipment specifications, and engineering design documents.

• Ability to coordinate design activities across multiple engineering disciplines and manage competing project deadlines.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

• Develop detailed 3D piping models and construction drawings for midstream oil and gas pipelines and facilities, primarily utilizing CADWorx and AutoCAD.

• Design piping arrangements and equipment layouts for compressor stations, pump stations, meter stations, pipeline interconnects, and other midstream facilities.

• Prepare piping plans, elevations, sections, isometric drawings, general arrangement drawings, and material takeoffs.

• Translate P&IDs and engineering specifications into accurate piping models and construction-ready deliverables.

• Coordinate piping designs around compressors, pumps, vessels, separators, filtration equipment, valves, and other mechanical equipment.

• Incorporate pipe supports, equipment clearances, accessibility, maintenance requirements, and constructability considerations into facility designs.

• Collaborate with process, mechanical, civil, structural, and electrical/instrumentation engineering teams to identify and resolve design conflicts.

• Support 3D model reviews, interdisciplinary coordination, and quality control efforts throughout the design process.

• Incorporate engineering redlines, field measurements, vendor drawings, and client comments into design packages.

• Prepare and update piping bills of materials, drawing packages, and associated project documentation.

• Assist with field verification, as-built drawings, and modifications to existing facilities when required.

• Work with project managers and design leads to meet project schedules, budgets, and technical requirements while maintaining Atwell's quality standards.

Disclaimer

While AI tools may support your application process, this role is built on human talent. Your judgment, experience, and character matter most, so we encourage you to showcase what makes you uniquely you.

Atwell does not accept unsolicited resumes from any 3rd party agencies. No fee will be paid to 3rd parties who submit unsolicited resumes to any Atwell employee. Resumes from approved vendors must be specifically requested by Atwell and approved by the Atwell Talent Acquisition Team.

Senior Cloud Software Engineer

Information processing systems are the lifeblood of national security efforts, facilitating an understanding of the global situation, strategic planning, and tactical execution.  The reliability, accessibility, and sophistication of these systems can determine the outcomes of conflicts before they begin.  STR’s Systems Development Division (SDD) focuses on developing actionable, advanced technology solutions to provide asymmetric advantages within the information domain. SDD considers the entire lifecycle of the solution, from conceptualization and architecting, through development, to deployment, while leveraging novel technologies to deliver first-of-a-kind systems.  Current efforts include programs for airborne and space RF as well as advanced testing enabled by multi-function, multi-modal capabilities.

As a, you will work with the software team on implementation of Continuous Integration/ Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for software integrating complex embedded RF systems, signal processing, and radar, with a primary focus on Air-to-Air applications.

What you will do:

• Perform DevSecOps pipeline implementation including development, deployment, maintenance, optimization and operation of all phases of the DevSecOps process and tool chain

• Support DevSecOps pipelines in unclassified and classified environments using a variety of code quality tools

• Configure and maintain multiple development and DevOps environments at different classification levels, focusing on developer productivity, application performance, security monitoring, and alerting

• Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure team infrastructure toolsets are configured, maintained, and reliable, in compliance with program requirements and Department of Defense standards

• Coach team members on DevSecOps best practices while continuously helping to improve and automate processes

• Identify areas for improvement and implement enhancements

• Document the pipeline architecture, tools and user processes to modify and update pipelines

• Evangelize DevOps and DevSecOps and support the software team on tooling, environments, debugging and testing.

Who You Are:

• Must be a U.S. citizen

• Ability to obtain a Top-Secret Security Clearance

• BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field

• Demonstrated experience working with DevSecOps pipelines, preferably on a DoD development effort

• Experience with cloud service providers such as AWS or Azure in an IL4/IL5/IL6 environment

• Proficiency with build, continuous integration, and continuous deployment tools such as Bazel, CMake, GCC, GitLab, Jenkins, GTest, GCov, clang-tools and more

• Comfortable in Linux and Windows environments

• Experience with containerization technologies such as docker, WSL, podman, and container orchestration tools like Kubernetes, Swarm, and Rancher

• Familiarity with security scanning tools such as SonarQube, Coverity, Syft, Grype, Artifactory Xray with advanced Security, Semgrep, and Anchore and best practices for secure design, coding, and analysis

• Familiarity with IT configuration and deployment management tools like Ansible, Chef, or Terraform

• Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (e.g. Grafana, ELK Stack, or Splunk)

• General understanding of networking concepts and security protocols, and ability to configure and manage network security measures for development environments and tooling

• Strong scripting skills to write, maintain, and document automation and integrate tooling

• Knowledge of automation frameworks and tools to streamline repetitive tasks and manage complex workflows

• Familiarity with Atlassian Confluence and Jira, and MS Office 365

Even Better:

• Active Security Clearance

• Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field

• Domain expertise in one or more of the following areas: Electronic Warfare, Antenna Apertures, Sensor Resource Management, Large-Scale Platform Test Systems, Cyber Physical Systems, Open System Architectures (UCI, OMS, COARPS)

• Demonstrated expertise in C++, C++/Cuda, Python, Java

• Experience utilizing the following:

• Object-Oriented Programming principles

• Agile software lifecycle methodologies and tools

• Test-driven development methodologies

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $138,000 - $185,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

jobs.title: Director, CMC Regulatory
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Director, CMC Regulatory is responsible for developing, driving, and executing CMC regulatory strategies for products advancing through clinical development and marketing authorization. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on submission delivery to support global clinical trial applications, registration, commercial readiness, and lifecycle management.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as the CMC Regulatory program lead to develop and execute global CMC regulatory strategies from clinical development through marketing authorization and lifecycle management, aligning regulatory activities and submission plans with program milestones and business objectives.

• Lead the preparation, review, and maintenance of scientifically sound, high-quality global CMC dossiers across all development stages, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and timely submissions.

• Participate in CMC-related Health Authority interactions, including developing meeting strategies, preparing briefing documents, and responding to Agency queries. Collaborate with CMC and Quality teams to support inspection readiness and fulfill regulatory commitments.

• Support post-approval CMC regulatory activities, including assessing CMC changes, determining reporting requirements and supporting data needs, and developing and executing submission strategies.

• Provide CMC regulatory assessments for change controls, deviations, and investigations, and track regulatory commitments and submission obligations.

• Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs colleagues, technical SMEs, and external partners to address regional requirements, support regulatory submissions, and maintain consistency of approved CMC content.

• Mentor team members, provide guidance to regulatory resources, and contribute to improving CMC regulatory processes and submission standards.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Pharmaceutical Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or closely related scientific discipline.

• Minimum of 15 years of experience in pharmaceutical/biotech drug development, including at least 5 years of hands-on global CMC regulatory affairs experience.

• Deep expertise in CMC development for new chemical entities (NCEs), with proven ability to manage complex technical content.

• Experience in leading CMC-related global submissions (IND, IMPD/CTA, NDA, MAA, post approval variations, etc.).

• Strong knowledge of US and international GMP regulations, current industry practices, with a demonstrated ability to interpret and apply requirements across the entire product lifecycle.

• Strong project and team leadership capabilities, with the ability to prioritize effectively, manage multiple complex programs, and foster cross-functional collaboration.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills.

• A collaborative, high-energy team player who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and embraces innovation and continuous improvement.

Preferred Skills:

• Advanced degree (MS or Ph.D) in Pharmaceutical Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or closely related field.

• Prior experience in oncology product commercialization is a plus.

Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The Game Engine team at Roblox works on the systems that power the experiences at the heart of the metaverse. Our code is the technical foundation in our client, editor, and our simulation servers.

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

• Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.

• Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.

• Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. A single well-designed primitive or optimization here makes hundreds of internal engineers more productive and millions of player sessions smoother.

You Will:

• Take ownership of part of the engine's Concurrency system — the task scheduler, fiber runtime, and async APIs that every other engine team builds on.

• Research and implement performance improvements that unblock platform initiatives – unlocking higher fidelity and richer experiences.

• Serve as a point of contact for concurrency across the org: design reviews, hard parallelism bugs, and asks from other engine teams.

• Improve the ergonomics, testability, and debuggability of concurrent code across PC, Mac, mobile, and console.

You Have:

• Strong modern C++ (C++17 or newer) in a large, complex production codebase

• Deep multithreading/concurrency experience — schedulers, thread pools, lock-free programming, atomics, memory models

• Comfort profiling and reasoning about performance at the OS/CPU level

Nice to Have:

• Game engine or real-time systems experience

• Fiber/coroutine runtimes, work-stealing or job-system schedulers

• Cross-platform low-level development (Android, iOS, console)

• Track record as the go-to expert other teams consult on a system

jobs.title: Vice President, Corporate Development with PHG
jobs.description:
Collaborative Strategies, Inc. (CSI) is conducting a search on behalf of PHG, a family-owned holding group with three generations of business-building experience dating to 1979. PHG partners with founder and family-owned businesses as a long-term owner, investing its own capital to build stronger businesses while preserving what makes each company unique.
 
THE OPPORTUNITY
PHG is seeking a Vice President, Corporate Development to lead growth through acquisition and help unlock new opportunities across its existing portfolio. Reporting to the CEO and based in St. Louis, this role combines the strategic discipline of private equity with the entrepreneurial mindset of an operator and the long-term perspective of an owner.
This is a newly created role that will not only shape how PHG approaches M&A but will also catalyze growth across the portfolio businesses — from sourcing and closing acquisitions to partnering with company leaders to invest in new capabilities that build lasting value. With the backing of a family enterprise and the latitude to pursue opportunities within a clear strategic framework, the VP will have real ownership of the results.
 
WHAT YOU’LL DO
SHAPE GROWTH STRATEGY: Partner with the CEO, CFO, Board, and operating-company leaders to define acquisition priorities, develop target theses, and identify opportunities to expand existing businesses and build new platforms.
SOURCE & EXECUTE ACQUISITIONS: Build proprietary deal flow through direct outreach, industry relationships, and intermediaries; lead evaluation, financial modeling, valuation, due diligence, negotiation, and transaction execution from origination through close.
EVALUATE OPPORTUNITIES BEYOND THE NUMBERS: Assess strategic fit, leadership, culture, risk, and long-term potential to ensure investments align with PHG’s ownership philosophy and create sustainable value.
BUILD VALUE ACROSS THE PORTFOLIO: Work alongside operating-company presidents to identify growth opportunities, evaluate strategic investments, and explore new capabilities, markets, and business lines that strengthen existing companies.
LEAD POST-ACQUISITION INTEGRATION: Serve as PHG’s senior representative to newly acquired businesses, guiding onboarding, first-100-day priorities, governance, and performance tracking while respecting leadership autonomy and preserving each company’s unique culture.
BUILD A REPEATABLE GROWTH ENGINE: Establish disciplined acquisition processes, pipeline management, diligence frameworks, and post-close feedback loops that strengthen PHG’s approach to investing and building businesses over time.

jobs.title: Head of Legal
jobs.description:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 2.5 million patients!

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Location: Menlo Park or San Francisco, on site 3 days a week. Reports to: CEO.

We're hiring our first in-house lawyer. Develop Health sits in the middle of PBMs, providers, pharma manufacturers, payers and the patients they all serve, and each of them relies on us to treat them fairly. Your job is to keep it that way: every contract we sign, every feature we ship and every service we offer pharma has to keep us a neutral party all sides can trust.

You'll report to our CEO and own legal end to end as a hands-on practitioner. For at least the first year you're the only lawyer, working with outside counsel on specialist matters.

Three things define success in this role:

The contracts fit together. You know our stakeholder agreements side by side, and nothing we agree with one party creates exposure with another.

Product ships fast and stays compliant. You work alongside product and engineering, find the version of an idea that works, and explain the one constraint that actually matters.

Legal scales without you in every deal. Templates, fallback positions and playbooks let sales and partnerships close standard deals on their own, and they know exactly when to bring you in.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Review our stakeholder agreements side by side, then fix the inconsistencies and older exposure you find.

 - Take over review and redlining of contracts in flight, and set turnaround times and escalation rules.

 - Build our contract templates, playbooks and fallback positions in Ironclad.

 - Lead negotiations as we add new stakeholders.

 - Choose and manage outside counsel for corporate, regulatory, IP and employment work, and lead the legal side of our next financing.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING ON DAY 1

 - You've been the lawyer a business relied on. You've owned commercial contracts end to end, in-house or as a company's go-to counsel.

 - You see systems, not clauses. You notice how a term in one deal changes what's possible in another.

 - You find the yes. When something is risky, you propose the version that works instead of stopping at no.

 - You build so you're not the bottleneck. Templates, triage and self-serve tools come naturally to you.

 - You learn fast. You've picked up an unfamiliar regulatory framework or business model quickly and put it to work.

 - Clear writing. Your memos and redlines are short, plain and easy to act on.

 - Admission to practice law in at least one US state.

You don't need a healthcare background. Referral-fee rules, platform neutrality and data rights show up in many industries, and we care more about how quickly you learn than what you already know.


BONUS POINTS

 - Healthcare regulatory experience: fraud and abuse, HIPAA, or pharmacy and PBM regulation.

 - Legal work at a marketplace or platform company with many types of customers.

 - You've been a company's first legal hire before.


THIS MIGHT NOT BE THE RIGHT FIT IF

 - You want to build a team right away. This is an individual-contributor role for at least the first 12 months.

 - You want to litigate. If we're sued, we hire litigators. We need your judgment on when and how to escalate.

 - You want to specialize. Tax, securities and patent work go to outside specialists; you manage those relationships.

 - You need a lot of structure. There isn't much yet, and building it is the job.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary ($308,000–$342,000) plus meaningful early-stage equity.

 - A direct line to the CEO and ownership of a function from day one.

 - Work that directly speeds up access to medication for hundreds of thousands of patients.

If you want to build the legal foundation of a company that's changing how patients get their medications, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Python
jobs.description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

We're looking for a senior engineer who lives at the seam between software, operations and AI. You've built systems where an order POST doesn't end at a database row — it ends at a carrier activating a real phone number in another country, subject to that country's rules. And increasingly, it ends with an AI agent deciding — reliably, auditable, in milliseconds — whether that order flows straight through or needs a human.

You'll join the team that owns Telnyx's phone-number inventory and the entire ordering pipeline behind it. The stack is Python, the domain is global telephony, and the roadmap is near-total automation: if a step in the pipeline is done by a human today, we're building the system that takes that step away.

What You'll Own

• **The ordering pipeline** — async Python services that turn a search-and-order API call into a provisioned, billable phone number: job queues, retries, rollbacks on partial failure, SLA clocks, and backorder (advanced order) fulfillment where lead-time promises have contractual weight. Tens of thousands of orders a week run through this today.

• **Vendor & carrier integrations** — dozens of them, from US Tier-1 wholesale carriers to international carriers and regulated-market vendors. Each integration is its own Snowflake — idiosyncratic APIs, failure modes, and regulatory constraints. You'll make them behave like one system.

• **The AI order-review layer** — a production LLM service that reads orders and customer-submitted regulatory documents and auto-approves by country, number type, and carrier, governed by allowlists, score thresholds, and full audit logs. You'll own expanding its coverage safely: evals, guardrails, regression suites, and clean handoffs to humans when the machine isn't sure.

• **Regulatory automation** — per-country identity/documentation checks ("requirement groups"), external document-verification vendors, expiry and re-verification flows — automated end-to-end in 45+ countries we hold carrier licences in.

• **The data layer** — a large Postgres-based warehouse and Metabase analytics serving stock, SLA, and order-lifecycle dashboards used daily by ops and leadership, across a 30+ microservice estate; alerting on stock risk, vendor SLA breaches, and pipeline health.

Tech stack (what you'll actually touch)

• Python 3 (asyncio, FastAPI/aiohttp, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, pydantic), pytest, mypy/ruff

• LLM tooling: model APIs, structured output, agent orchestration, prompt/scoring configuration, offline eval harnesses

• PostgreSQL at scale: schema design, migrations on live systems, query tuning, warehouse SQL

• RabbitMQ/Kafka, Consul, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Docker/OCI, GitHub Actions

• Metabase, and TypeScript/Next.js for internal dashboards (not required — the backend is yours)

What we're looking for

• 5+ years of backend engineering, with strong production async Python.

• You've owned systems that talk to many external services and lived with the async-job, retry, rollback, and eventual-consistency problems that creates.

• You can make an LLM trustworthy in a real flow: validation, scoring thresholds, evals, audit, and human-in-the-escalation. You know where AI is reliable and where it's theater.

• Postgres beyond ORM basics — you can read a plan, write a migration on a live system, and know why SKIP LOCKED matters.

• You're a pragmatist about process automation — a workflow isn't done when the ticket closes, it's done when the human step is gone and the numbers prove it.

• Strong written communication across a distributed team (EMEA + Americas).

Bonus points for

• Telecom/CPaaS background: DID inventory, ordering, porting (NPAC), carrier provisioning, regulatory/KYC familiarity.

• Experience with document/KYC verification vendors (Onfido, Sumsub, Jumio) or OCR pipelines.

• Building with agents beyond work: MCP servers, tool-calling frameworks, open-source agent runtimes.

• Warehouse/analytics engineering; internal-dashboard work in TypeScript.

What this role is not

• Not a pure CRUD role. Every row in this system is a real phone number somewhere — on a carrier, under a regulator, promised to a customer, watched by an SLA.

• Not an ML research role. You'll build applied AI that approves real transactions — no notebooks in production, no fine-tuning required.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT CROSBY

Crosby is built on a simple conviction: a great legal system is the watermark of a great society — and the best legal work comes from combining human expertise with the right technology, not replacing one with the other.

Crosby is the first AI-native law firm, helping ambitious companies like Cursor, Ramp, and Cognition sign commercial contracts faster.

Legal work is both art and science, and we're mapping the frontier between the two — codifying what can be systematized, amplifying human judgment where it matters most. That's why the right way to bring AI into law isn't to sell software and walk away. It's to own the outcome together: higher-quality work, delivered faster. We build proprietary tools and human-in-the-loop workflows that change what's possible for corporate legal teams.

Crosby was founded by Ryan (Stanford Law, Cooley, startup GC) and John (Penn, first 15 engineers at Ramp).  Help us transform one of society's most important industries.


About the role

Build the systems behind Crosby’s next stage of growth.

You’ll own the processes, data, and tools that help us turn demand into lasting client relationships. Working closely with the COO and leaders across Sales, Growth, Finance, and Legal Operations, you’ll bring clarity to how we acquire clients, convert pilots, grow accounts, and plan for what comes next.

Our business requires understanding both what clients commit to and how they actually use Crosby. You’ll connect pipeline, commercial terms, client activity, and revenue so we can make better decisions about where to invest and how to scale.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You should be equally comfortable building a forecast, configuring a CRM workflow, and helping a sales leader understand why conversion changed.

What you’ll do

 - Own our commercial systems: Build and maintain the CRM, integrations, and workflows our teams rely on. Establish clear account ownership, pipeline stages, lead routing, and data standards—and make the systems easy to use.

 - Make revenue performance clear: Build reporting that connects pipeline, pilot conversion, signed commitments, client usage, retention, and expansion. Partner with Finance to keep bookings, billed revenue, and collections clearly defined and reconciled.

 - Run forecasting and pipeline reviews: Establish a consistent cadence with Sales and Finance. Pressure-test assumptions, identify stalled deals and risks, and turn the forecast into specific actions.

 - Help scale the sales team: Build capacity and hiring models, account assignments, quota recommendations, and ramp reporting. Partner with leadership and Finance on compensation plans and accurate commission calculations.

 - Improve conversion across the client journey: Find where prospects and clients get stuck—from initial inquiry through pilot, onboarding, and expansion. Work with the relevant teams to fix those gaps and measure whether the changes work.

 - Connect the sale to delivery: Make sure pricing, commitments, and client expectations transfer cleanly into onboarding and billing. Give Legal Operations visibility into expected demand so we can plan capacity as we grow.

 - Automate repetitive work: Use AI, integrations, and practical tooling to reduce manual updates, improve data quality, and give the team more time with clients. Own adoption and reliability after launch.

Who you are

 - You’ve built before: You have 5–8 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a closely related function, including meaningful ownership at a fast-growing B2B company.

 - You get into the systems yourself: You’ve configured a CRM, built workflows and integrations, and resolved the data issues behind unreliable reporting. Experience with Attio, Salesforce, or HubSpot is relevant.

 - You’re analytically strong: You can build a forecast, capacity model, or cohort analysis yourself and explain what it means. You’re excellent in spreadsheets; SQL and experience with BI tools are a plus.

 - You understand commercial nuance: You can distinguish a signed commitment from realized revenue and translate pilots, variable usage, and expansion into useful reporting and planning.

 - You make teams more effective: You earn trust with salespeople, introduce processes people actually follow, and hold a high standard for accuracy and accountability.

 - You have strong judgment: You know when to build something durable and when a simple solution will get the team moving. You can prioritize a broad mandate without waiting for a detailed roadmap.

 - You’re curious and resourceful: You actively use AI and automation in your work, learn unfamiliar tools quickly, and take responsibility for seeing projects through.

What success looks like

Leadership has a clear, trusted view of pipeline and revenue. Salespeople spend less time on administrative work. Pilots, onboarding, and expansion have clear owners and measurable outcomes. Hiring and capacity decisions are grounded in data. The systems you build help Crosby grow while keeping the team fast.

Benefits & Perks

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Lunch & dinner in the office every day

 - Medical insurance (multiple plan options through Anthem & Cigna)

 - HSA or FSA, depending on your plan choice

 - Dental insurance

 - Vision insurance

 - One Medical membership

 - 401(k) match

 - In-office desk setup stipend


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Crosby is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the New York City Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Civil Superintendent
jobs.description:
Job Title: Civil Superintendent
Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Underground Maintenance & Installation (UMI)
Location: Leander, TX
Reports To: UMI Manager
Employment Type: Full Time
FLSA Classification: Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach, and every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don't just offer jobs, we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps build and maintain the critical infrastructure that supports communities across the nation.

Job Summary

The Civil Superintendent is responsible for the overall planning, coordination, execution, and supervision of civil construction projects, including site development, earthwork, grading, excavation, underground utilities, drainage systems, concrete structures, and related infrastructure. This position provides direct leadership to field personnel, subcontractors, and equipment operators while ensuring projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with project specifications and quality standards.

The Civil Superintendent works closely with Project Managers, clients, engineers, and foremen to coordinate resources, monitor production, and drive project success from mobilization through completion.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Read, interpret, and implement project drawings, specifications, contracts, and civil construction plans.

• Direct and supervise daily field operations for civil construction projects.

• Coordinate crews, subcontractors, equipment, materials, and vendors to ensure efficient project execution.

• Develop, maintain, and manage three-week and six-week look-ahead schedules.

• Monitor project production rates and implement corrective actions to maintain schedule and budget objectives.

• Lead earthwork, grading, excavation, trenching, underground utility installation, storm drainage, paving preparation, and concrete activities.

• Conduct site inspections to verify quality standards, project specifications, and safety requirements are being met.

• Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations as well as company safety policies.

• Lead daily planning meetings, safety meetings, and toolbox talks.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on manpower forecasting, scheduling, procurement, and project reporting.

• Support estimating and preconstruction efforts through constructability reviews, production analysis, equipment recommendations, and cost evaluations.

• Monitor project costs and productivity while identifying opportunities for improved efficiency.

• Train, mentor, and develop foremen, operators, and craft personnel.

• Maintain positive relationships with customers, inspectors, utility providers, engineers, and other stakeholders.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to expand business relationships and generate future work.

• Perform all other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Required

• Minimum 5 years of Superintendent experience managing civil construction projects.

• Minimum 8 years of experience in heavy civil, sitework, earthwork, utility, or infrastructure construction.

• Proven experience leading multiple crews, subcontractors, and field personnel.

• Strong knowledge of grading, excavation, trenching, underground utility installation, stormwater systems, and civil site development.

• Experience coordinating heavy equipment including excavators, dozers, graders, loaders, compactors, and related construction equipment.

• Ability to read and interpret civil plans, profiles, specifications, and utility drawings.

• Working knowledge of civil construction methods, means, and sequencing.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and construction scheduling software.

• OSHA 30 certification or equivalent safety training.

• Trench Safety and Competent Person certification preferred.

• Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

Preferred

• Experience supporting industrial, energy, data center, utility, or large commercial projects.

• Knowledge of GPS machine control, survey layouts, and grade control systems.

• Experience managing self-perform civil crews.

• Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Strong leadership and team-building abilities.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong organizational and planning skills.

• Ability to analyze project risks and implement proactive solutions.

• Thorough understanding of construction safety requirements and best practices.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.

• Ability to effectively manage project schedules, budgets, and field productivity.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment

• Outdoor construction environments.

• Exposure to varying weather conditions, including extreme heat and cold.

• Active construction sites with heavy equipment and moving machinery.

• Exposure to dust, mud, noise levels exceeding 85 decibels, and uneven terrain.

• Frequent walking on construction sites.

• Ability to enter excavations and trenches when required.

• Climbing ladders, embankments, and construction equipment.

• Frequent standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and lifting up to 50 pounds.

• Operation of company vehicles when required.

• Valid driver's license and proof of insurability required. All drivers are subject to DMV background record review.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Our Core Values (LEAD)

At Loenbro, we are guided by our core values:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

If you're ready to join a company committed to building exceptional projects, developing outstanding people, and delivering excellence every day, we want to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Treasury Manager
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About This Role:

Reporting to the Treasury Senior Manager, the Treasury Manager will serve as a senior leader within the Treasury function, owning critical work streams across investment portfolio management, interest rate risk, debt compliance, and liquidity — while managing relationships with external investment advisors and supporting the broader Treasury team. This role is ideal for a deeply analytical finance professional who brings hands-on expertise in investment oversight and interest rate hedging, and who can operate both strategically and tactically in a fast-growing, complex environment. As a high-visibility member of the Treasury leadership team, you will drive process discipline, cross-functional collaboration, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.



What You’ll Be Working On:

 - Drive the build-out and oversight of banking and investment infrastructure required to support the execution of multi-billion-dollar projects

 - Oversee the company's investment portfolio, including day-to-day monitoring and management of external investment advisor relationships; ensure alignment with the Investment Policy Statement (IPS)

 - Analyze interest rate market conditions and risk exposure to inform hedging strategy; support the evaluation, recommendation, and execution of derivative transactions, and ensure strict compliance with lender-mandated hedging requirements.

 - Own lender debt covenant compliance across multiple SPVs and legal entities—including monitoring, reporting, and lender communications—and proactively manage covenant headroom across the company's growing credit facility portfolio.

 - Design and implement a robust reporting and monitoring framework for all existing and future debt facilities, ensuring operational feasibility and risk mitigation as the debt portfolio expands.

 - Support liquidity forecasting efforts in partnership with Finance and key business stakeholders, ensuring capital allocation decisions are informed by rigorous and forward-looking analysis

 - Lead strategic analytical support for key initiatives across the organization, ensuring capital is deployed efficiently and risk is managed proactively

 - Support Treasury cash management team activities, ensuring optimal positioning of global cash balances and the seamless execution of high-value transactions

 - Build and maintain executive-level reporting packages, dashboards, and ad-hoc analyses for senior leadership using Excel and PowerPoint



What You’ll Bring to the Team:

 - 7+ years’ experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Investment Management in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field

 - Highly advanced quantitative and analytical skills

 - Exceptional Excel modeling skills, with the ability to create detailed and complex financial models from scratch for a variety of purposes

 - Strong command of financial theory (economics, capital structure, WACC, derivatives, portfolio management, company valuations, etc.) and its practical applications

 - Detail-oriented, with a focus on accuracy and precision in financial analysis and reporting

 - Ability to analyze legal documents and understand the technical and accounting implications of complex transactions

 - Demonstrated experience overseeing investment portfolios and managing external investment advisor relationships, with strong working knowledge of fixed income

 - Hands-on experience with interest rate derivatives, hedging strategy development and execution, and ongoing effectiveness monitoring

 - Track record of successfully leading complex, cross-functional workstreams and delivering results through direct management and organizational influence

 - Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to distill complex topics into manageable recommendations

 - Self-starter who can multitask and deliver in a dynamic environment under tight timelines, iterative fact-sets, and changing priorities; must be “hands-on"

 - Positive attitude and a solutions-focused approach



Bonus Points:

 - CFA Charterholder, or progress toward

 - MBA, Master of Finance, or equivalent experience

 - Knowledge of Bloomberg modeling tools and API syntax



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $110,000 - $140,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.description:

Who We Are

We are pioneering modular motion technologies to power the next generation of innovation for Industrial, Aerospace and Defense. If you're excited about disrupting legacy industries, and passionate about building the financial infrastructure behind cutting-edge hardware, let's chat!

We are at the forefront of innovation, crafting exclusive motion control components that propel the industrial, aerospace, and defense sectors into the future.
