jobs.description:
Erasca is a clinical-stage precision oncology company focused on discovering, developing and commercializing medicines for the benefit of patients with cancer. Our programs take novel approaches to shutting down one of cancer’s most commonly mutated signaling cascades, the RAS/MAPK pathway, which affects approximately 5.5 million lives each year worldwide. The name “Erasca” has an important embedded meaning: it is a contraction of our audacious hope to “erase cancer” that drives our mission and everything that we do on behalf of patients with cancer.

Position Summary:

Reporting to the Executive Director Pharmaceutical Development, the Director of Pharmaceutical Development provides technical oversight of contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) for small molecule programs ranging from research phase to clinical development and eventually commercial production. This person will be a liaison for the manufacture of Erasca’s small molecule development drug products (DPs) at external contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) and will work on cross functional teams with colleagues from process development, analytical, formulation development, supply chain, QA, and regulatory CMC to plan, coordinate, and execute internal and external DP development and manufacturing activities. The Director of Pharmaceutical Development will also take a drug substance lead role on one or more programs and manage projects independently.

Note that this position is based in San Diego, CA – the ideal candidate is in San Diego or willing and able to travel to San Diego on a regular basis.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Provide scientific, technical, and strategic direction to the design, development, and manufacture of investigational drug products from pre-clinical and clinical to commercial stage.

• Manage activities and contractual relationship with contract manufacturers and laboratories performing product and formulation development, manufacturing, analytical development and testing, stability, and validation services.

• Lead and collaborate with cross functional project team members to meet CMC goals.

• Represent CMC DP and provide strategic recommendations and status reporting to cross-functional program team.

• Author, review, and/or approve development reports, regulatory submissions (e.g., IND, IMPD, NDA, MAA), and SOPs.

• Act as Subject Matter Expert for knowledge of GMP regulations, ICH guidance, and current regulatory expectations regarding DP manufacture and process control.

• Function as a highly effective communicator and team player in a dynamic team culture.

• Up to 25% travel will be needed, to San Diego or South San Francisco for internal meetings and collaboration, and nationally and internationally for external activities.

• Perform all duties in keeping with the Company’s core values, policies and all applicable regulations.

Required Education, Experience and Attributes:

• Advanced degree in Pharmaceutics, Chemistry or related field is highly preferred, equivalent work experience and scientific credibility may be considered.

• 10 to 12+ years of progressive experience in the Biotech or Pharmaceutical industry focused on small molecule drug product development and manufacturing, experience in enabling technologies and solid oral dosage form manufacturing preferred.

• Experience managing relationships with contract manufacturing organizations including knowledge of small molecule drug product validation and experience with regulatory submissions.

• Familiarity with ICH guidelines and regulatory expectations relevant to drug development and cGMPs including regulations in multiple countries.

• A strong track record of scientific achievement.

• Demonstrated ability to influence without direct control.

• Ability to build strong relationships with co-workers of various backgrounds and expertise.

• Ability to function at a high level in a team setting whether as manager, lead scientist, or individual contributor.

• Demonstrated ability to achieve high performance goals and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Effective interpersonal and communication skills; a collaborative team player with a can-do attitude and the ability to identify and implement creative solutions to complex technical problems.

• Strong learning orientation, curiosity, and passion for science and patients.

In addition to base salary, the hired applicant will be eligible to receive an annual bonus and an equity grant at hire and annually in the form of the option to purchase stock in the future for a specified price.

jobs.title: Principal Scientist, Permanent Magnets
jobs.description:
ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.


THE OPPORTUNITY


Introduction to the team: The Magnets team is one of several key research verticals within SandboxAQ’s broader Chemical Simulation group, which uses advanced computational methods, physics-based simulation, and AI to discover and develop novel materials. This group is focused on solving critical materials challenges that matter to U.S. semiconductor manufacturing and industrial resilience.

Within that larger effort, this group is focused on one of the most strategically important materials problems: developing high-performance permanent magnets that reduce or eliminate reliance on neodymium and other rare earth elements and can be produced in the United States. The goal is to create novel magnet formulations that can be manufactured using existing industry processes and equipment, while matching or exceeding the performance of today’s leading NdFeB magnets in demanding applications such as semiconductor equipment, vacuum systems, precision motion devices, and defense technologies.

Introduction to the role: We are looking for a Principal Scientist to lead the scientific direction of the Magnets vertical. This person will define the research strategy and technical roadmap, build and lead a top-tier scientific team, and help shape how computational materials discovery, simulation, and AI are applied to accelerate magnet development.

This leader will work at the intersection of domain science and platform innovation. You will help shape the magnetism-aware LQM and multi-scale modeling strategy in close partnership with our AI simulation platform teams, while also guiding dataset strategy, modeling priorities, and experimental validation to turn cutting-edge research into practical, manufacturable magnet technologies.

You will also serve as a key external scientific representative for the program, working with national labs, manufacturing partners, defense organizations, and equipment companies.

See how SandboxAQ is helping build America's semiconductor supply chain from the materials up. https://www.sandboxaq.com/post/sandboxaq-helping-build-americas-semiconductor-supply-chain




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the scientific charter and technical roadmap for the Magnets vertical, including phase stability, magnetocrystalline anisotropy, finite-temperature coercivity, and microstructure engineering across Fe- and Co-based intermetallic systems with U.S.-accessible alloying elements.

 - IP Engine Management: Oversee the translation of generative design outputs into a robust IP portfolio, ensuring the team owns the most valuable "white space" in substrate chemistry and structural design.

 - Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of research scientists, computational/ML scientists, and postdocs; set the scientific bar, run technical reviews, and develop talent toward NewCo readiness.

 - Specify and prioritize the magnetism-aware LQM, datageneration, and multi-scale modeling capabilities required from the AISim platform; serve as the senior scientific counterpart to Platform Engineering and DataGen Research for this vertical.

 - Lead scientific engagement with national lab and industrial partners (e.g., NHMFL, domestic magnet producers, ASML, defense primes), translating partner constraints into well-posed scientific problems and delivering partner-grade results.

 - Architect the feedback loops between computational modeling and experimental lab validation to accelerate the Design-Build-Test-Learn (DBTL) cycle.

 - Work closely with the commercial team to identify buyers for our novel IP, structuring high-value licensing agreements and co-development partnerships.

 - Author the external scientific narrative of the vertical for quarterly updates, peer-reviewed publications, conferences, and prospective NewCo investors; protect scientific rigor and IP integrity throughout.




ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - PhD in Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, or a related discipline, with deep specialization in magnetism, intermetallics, or hard magnetic materials.

 - 7+ years of post-PhD experience leading scientific programs in magnetic materials, including significant industrial or national-lab leadership at the principal scientist, fellow, or director level.

 - Demonstrated ability to translate first-principles, multi-scale, and ML-driven modeling into manufacturable magnet formulations, including coupling to powder metallurgy, sintering, and heat-treatment processes.

 - Track record of building and leading multidisciplinary scientific teams and shaping research roadmaps that deliver against external commitments (industrial, government, or both).

 - Outstanding external scientific presence: publication and patent record, ability to represent the work to senior government, defense, and industrial audiences.




HIGHLY DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Hands-on experience with Fe-N, Mn-based, Sm-Co, or other rare-earth-lean permanent magnet systems and their bulk processing challenges.

 - Familiarity with applications in lithography stages, vacuum pumps, precision actuators, or defense platforms (fighter jets, drones, submarines).

 - Experience operating within CHIPS Act, DOD, DOE, or other federally funded R&D programs, including export-control and IP considerations.

 - Prior involvement in NewCo formation, IP licensing, or scaling research IP into commercial manufacturing operations.

 - Demonstrated track record of taking permanent magnet materials from concept through scale-up, qualification, and transfer into pilot or commercial manufacturing environments.

 - Proven ability to translate system-level application requirements such as force density, thermal operating envelope, demagnetization margin, vacuum compatibility, and reliability into composition, processing, and microstructure targets for simulation platform.




WHY JOIN US?

We offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth.

 - Compensation: Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus equity and performance-based incentives.

 - Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; generous parental leave.

 - Work-Life Balance: Flexible hybrid work arrangements, generous PTO, and a culture that respects focus time and recovery.

 - Career Development: Direct exposure to CHIPS Act-funded programs, senior scientific and executive leadership, mentorship, and dedicated learning budgets to support continued growth.

jobs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer, B2B eCommerce
jobs.description:
Principal Full Stack Engineer, B2B eCommerce

Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid)
Reports to: Team Lead, eCommerce
Role type: Full-time, individual contributor

About Fusion Worldwide
Fusion Worldwide is the preeminent open market distributor of electronic components and products. Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Portsmouth, NH, with offices and quality centers around the world, Fusion sources, inspects, tests and delivers components to OEMs, CMs and ODMs across a wide range of industries. Learn more at fusionww.com.

The Role
You will be a senior technical owner of Fusion's B2B eCommerce platform, which includes fusionww.com, our GraphQL and REST APIs, the internal admin portal, and the event pipeline behind them. You will design and ship customer-facing and internal commerce features end to end, run the services on Azure, and build AI agents that make our sales and operations teams faster. Our audience is entirely business buyers, including OEMs, CMs and ODMs. Even our smaller transactions are typically for business use, not personal consumption.

Our Palantir Foundry platform is the data layer behind customer intelligence and sales workflows. You will consume it through its APIs and SDKs rather than build inside it. Foundry engineers own the data, and you turn it into great commerce experiences.

We are an AI-first team. Claude Code is part of everyone's daily workflow, AI code review is required on every pull request, and Claude-powered agents run in production.

Expect your time to split roughly 80% application development, 10% AI agents and LLM features, and 10% infrastructure and DevOps.

What You'll Do

Commerce and platform development:
•    Design and deliver features across the customer site (Next.js, React, TypeScript), the GraphQL backend (Python, FastAPI, Strawberry, SQLAlchemy), and REST services.
•    Own core commerce flows such as search and discovery, catalog and pricing display, quoting and RFQ, cart and checkout, and order status.
•    Build internal tools in the admin portal (Next.js, tRPC, Zod) used by sales, marketing, operations and compliance.
•    Work across Azure SQL/SQL Server, Redis, Algolia, and event-driven processing with Celery and Azure Service Bus.
•    Integrate with HubSpot, Amplitude, Contentful and Fusion's ERP through its API layer.
•    Consume Foundry data (Ontology objects, OSDK, APIs) to power customer intelligence and sales workflows, and partner with the data team on contracts and requirements.
AI agents and LLM features:
•    Build and improve production agents and LLM features on the Claude API, Claude Agent SDK and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
•    Manage cost, token usage and output quality, and add evals and guardrails so agent behavior can be trusted.
•    Use Claude Code as a primary development tool, with human judgment on every merge.
Infrastructure and DevOps:
•    Operate and extend services on Azure: Container Apps and Jobs, Azure SQL, Front Door and WAF, Key Vault, Service Bus, API Management, Application Insights and Log Analytics.
•    Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform and CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Azure Container Registry across dev, test, pre-release and production, including an active/active second region.
•    Improve observability and alerting and troubleshoot production issues by tracing real data.
•    Apply secure-by-default engineering: Key Vault secrets, least privilege, safe error handling and dependency hygiene.
Engineering ownership:
•    Write well-tested code at every layer and keep it passing in CI.
•    Own the quality of your own work: test and verify that your code meets requirements before release. This is a developer-level QA, not a QA function.
•    Serve as the technical expert for the eCommerce application and development team, as a hands-on individual contributor.
•    Triage and resolve user-reported issues and fix bugs across the customer site, admin portal, and APIs.
•    Make and document architecture decisions, favoring the existing platform over new parallel infrastructure.
•    Partner with business stakeholders to assess feasibility and shape requirements.
•    Document what you learn so the next engineer, and the next AI session, don't have to rediscover it.

What You Bring
Required:
•    10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time building or running B2B eCommerce or other commercial systems (catalog, pricing, quoting, orders, checkout, or ERP integration).
•    Expert-level relational database skills, including schema design, query tuning, and concurrency (SQL Server preferred).
•    Hands-on experience with Azure or an equivalent cloud, including containerized services and infrastructure as code with Terraform.
•    Experience building with LLMs or agents, and daily practical use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, with sound judgment about verifying their output.
•    Experience with Git and GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira and Agile/Kanban delivery.
•    Clear written communication and the ability to explain tradeoffs to business stakeholders.
Nice to have:
•    Distribution or marketplace commerce experience, especially with complex pricing, quoting, or inventory.
•    Experience with Algolia, HubSpot or event-driven architecture.
•    Electronic components or supply chain domain knowledge.

What Success Looks Like
•    First 30 days: Ship a production feature end to end and take ownership of a core commerce flow.
•    3 months: Lead a major commerce initiative and ship at least one production agent or AI feature.
•    12 months: Be the go-to technical owner for eCommerce architecture, with measurable gains in [conversion / quote cycle time / reliability].

jobs.title: Sr. Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical Senior Distribution Analyst to serve as the primary owner for customer-facing distribution execution and outbound operations across key US distribution centers.

This role will support the US Distribution Manager by leading day-to-day outbound execution across the distribution network, including delivery monitoring, open delivery review, delivery block resolution, delivery push requests, zero-pick investigations, warehouse cancellations, export coordination, LTL and partial shipment management, HVR/LVR management, VAS support, product complaint returns/OZ requests, outbound IDOC monitoring and resolution, distribution process optimization, logistics data analysis, and investigation of shipment delays, damages, discrepancies, and other operational inefficiencies. The Senior Distribution Analyst will partner closely with distribution centers, Customer Service, Quality, BTS, Transportation, Trade Compliance, Planning, and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive timely issue resolution, improve operational flow, strengthen warehousing and delivery performance, and ensure service commitments are met for customers and patients.

Working Hours: Monday, Thursday, and Friday: 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.; Tuesday and Wednesday: 10:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.

Position Responsibilities:

• Own day-to-day outbound operational support across all US/PR distribution centers, ensuring consistent execution of order fulfillment, shipment readiness, dock activity, carrier handoffs, and issue escalation in alignment with service, compliance, and customer commitments.

• Experience with fulfillment services, warehouse operations, warehouse design, and system configuration support

jobs.title: AI Deployment Engineer/Manager
jobs.description:
About Safari AI

Safari AI's vision is to Automate Action of the leading companies in the physical economy, from Entertainment, Live Venues, QSR's, Retail and beyond. The company uses computer vision AI to Measure, Alert and provide AI-generated Recommendations at the operations of leading enterprises such as Merlin/Legoland, 7-11, Tanger Outlets, Charlotte Hornets, Tennessee Titans, and more.

Leadership & Culture

Safari AI is founded by Ali Vahabzadeh, who has a meaningful exit under his belt and has managed large, high-performing Go To Market and Engineering teams. The company is headquartered in Miami with the Engineering team co-located in Vancouver.

About You And How You Succeed At Safari AI

You're excited to build a product and invent a market that hasn't existed before. You read documentation first and are not afraid to ask for help when uncertain. You're looking to take ownership/run a singular project and take advantage of the freedom and culture an early stage startup can provide. You are looking to see through the fluff of the modern AI landscape and explore new ways of achieving measurable ROI. Enjoy a small team size ~10, project team of 1-3.

About the Role

We're hiring an AI Deployment Engineer/Manager to bring Safari AI's computer vision system to life at theme parks, stadiums, retail stores and live venues. You'll report to the Deployment lead and work alongside our ML and Engineering teams. This is forward-deployed work: cameras, edge computers, networks and servers, from the first site survey to a live, monitored system.

You'll get real ownership quickly. In your first 90 days you'll run parts of deployments with support from the team. By month six you'll own smaller deployments and pilot kits yourself. After about 12 months, a successful hire can grow into a senior Deployment Engineer, Solutions Engineering or Client Success role.

This role is remote within the U.S., with regular travel to customer sites.

What You Will Be Doing

• Hardware Provisioning & Linux Administration: Set up and configure edge computers (x86 GPU servers and NVIDIA Jetson), cameras, network switches and 5G/LTE modems before they ship. Maintain, patch and troubleshoot Linux systems in the field, and improve our install scripts and Ansible playbooks.

• On-Site Deployment & Implementation: Travel to customer sites to install and connect cameras and edge devices, verify camera streams and angles, and bring systems online. Work with installation contractors and customer IT teams to keep rollouts on schedule.

• Solution Design (with the Deployment lead): Run pre-deployment assessments covering camera inventory, network layout, bandwidth sizing, redundancy and rack space. Help spec ML/GPU hardware and design site-to-site and VPN connections.

• Project Coordination: Track hardware inventory, order from preferred vendors, coordinate shipping, and keep checklists, timelines and status reports current.

• Customer Support & Monitoring: Be a technical point of contact for customers during and after deployment. Respond to alerts such as an offline camera or edge device, and resolve or escalate issues with clear notes.

• Documentation & Automation: Write installation guides, SOPs and handoff documents, and use AI tools and scripts to automate repetitive deployment and support work.

What We're Looking For

• A degree in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience

• 0–3 years of experience in IT, system administration, network support, field engineering or a similar role (internships, co-ops and homelab projects count)

• Comfortable on the Linux command line: SSH, permissions, services, logs and basic shell scripting

• Basic networking: IP addressing, subnets, DHCP, DNS, switches and PoE

• Comfortable with physical hardware: racking a server, running and testing cable, mounting and aiming a camera, working on a ladder

• Strong troubleshooting habits: you narrow a problem down step by step and write down what you tried

• Clear written and verbal communication with teammates, contractors and customer IT staff

• Organized, detail-oriented and a fast learner in new technical environments

Bonus Points

• Experience with IP cameras, NVR/VMS systems or RTSP streams (Axis, Hanwha, Hikvision and similar)

• Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, GPUs or other edge AI hardware

• Ansible, Docker, OpenVPN/WireGuard or other automation and remote-access tools

• CompTIA Network+, CCNA or a homelab you can tell us about

• Consulting, robotics or computer vision experience

• You've built or used an AI agent to automate your own work

Additional Requirements

• Must be permanently authorized to work in the U.S. (e.g., U.S. citizen or green card holder). We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of work visas, now or in the future.

• Able to travel regularly to customer sites, sometimes on short notice

• Willing to work evenings and weekends when sites are closed to guests, and to respond to emergencies on priority projects

• Able to lift and carry up to 50 lb of equipment

Why bet on Computer Vision and Safari AI?

• Huge opportunity hiding in plain sight: leveraging already-installed cameras to automate and real-time action on operational data

• Already the market leader in enterprise CV by working with industry leaders with billions in revenue

• Large chasm between customer knowledge and market availability, i.e. customers don't know what is available in the market...yet.

• Early leader in computer vision; everyone is small and unbranded (i.e. no Amazon or Google in the room to compete with)

• Very modular, allowing Safari AI and its customers to invent whole new use cases on a regular basis

• Developed the tech and data pipelines over three years and invested several million dollars and is now ready to scale

jobs.title: Scientist II / Senior Scientist I, tLNP Process Development
jobs.description:
Targeted lipid nanoparticles (tLNPs) represent a key new modality to enable effective delivery of mRNA. The tLNP chemistry, manufacturing, and control (CMC) team (TCT) is a newly formed group under Biologics CMC, Development Sciences, R&D. TCT focuses on process development for tLNPs, including mRNA process development, tLNP process development, and formulation development.

The tLNP Process Development team is seeking a highly motivated, talented, and innovative scientist with expertise in mRNA-LNP process development and an interest in laboratory automation. This team is responsible for the end-to-end manufacturing process from purified mRNA to purified tLNP bulk drug product, including encapsulating mRNA with lipid components to form LNPs, conjugating LNPs with a targeting moiety, and purifying the final tLNPs via tangential flow filtration (TFF).

The successful candidate will help advance fundamental understanding of tLNP unit operations, such as mRNA encapsulation, bioconjugation, and TFF, as well as scaling up lab processes into pre-clinical, clinical, and commercial scale manufacturing processes. The candidate will also apply automation expertise to integrate off-the-shelf and custom-built hardware, software, and data workflows into flexible experimental platforms that increase throughput, reproducibility, and process understanding.

The end goal for tLNP Process Development team is to deliver a robust manufacturing process at commercial scale. This includes science-based, hands-on approaches in the lab to optimize process parameters and understand the impact of process parameters on critical quality attributes. First-principle-based and statistical modeling will be applied where appropriate. Along the pharmaceutical development life cycle, the team will be responsible for successful production of non-GMP pre-clinical safety study supplies and GMP clinical study supplies from a manufacturing plant on site or at third party manufacturers. The team will also lead the tech transfer of commercial processes into a commercial facility. Additionally, the team reviews appropriate sections of Common Technical Document (CTD) for regulatory submissions.

Success in this role depends on close collaboration with the mRNA process development, drug product development, and analytical development, digital and automation partners, as well as cross-functional partners across Biologics CMC and Synthetic Molecule CMC. The work directly advances cutting-edge mRNA-based therapeutics.

Responsibilities

• Independently design, execute and interpret critical experiments to understand unit operations such as mRNA encapsulation, bioconjugation, and tangential flow filtration, and scale up these unit operations to commercial manufacturing batch size.
• Highly autonomous and productive in performing laboratory research or method development, requiring minimal direction from supervisor.
• May initiate new areas of investigation that are scientifically meaningful, reliable, and can be incorporated directly into a research or development program.
• Demonstrates high proficiency across a wide range of technologies relevant to tLNP process development.
• Formulate conclusions and design follow-on experiments based on multidisciplinary data.
• Primary author of publications, presentations, regulatory documents and/or primary inventor of patents.
• Proactively develop and implement innovative automation solutions (custom and off-the-shelf equipment).
• Apply AI tools for structured data capture, analysis, and predictive modeling.
• Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding code of conduct, safety, appropriate handling of materials, and GMP compliance.
• Direct mentorship of others.

• BS, MS, or PhD degree in Chemistry, Material Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Bioengineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent.
• Senior Scientist I: BS with 10+ years', MS with 8+ years', and PhD with 0+ years' industry experience.
• Scientist II: BS with 7+ years', MS with 5+ years' industry experience.
• Experience with LNP mixing technology in an academic lab, or industry experience with LNP drug product process development. For mRNA encapsulation, experience with systems such as impinging jet, coaxial jet, or multi-inlet vortex mixer is required.
• Possess thorough theoretical and practical understanding of mRNA encapsulation.
• Experience with bioconjugation is required.
• Demonstrated ability to independently design, execute, and interpret critical experiments to answer scientific questions.
• Demonstrated ability to learn, understand, and master new experimental techniques.
• Ability to multitask and work within timelines.
• Demonstrated scientific writing skills and strong verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

• Experience scaling up LNP processes to gram-scale mRNA or above.
• Prior experience with automating existing experimental setups as well as new automation equipment and ecosystems, such as Ignition.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRIBE AI

Tribe AI helps companies build and ship real AI solutions. We bring together a network of top AI practitioners with a delivery team that turns AI strategy into production systems for our clients. Our go-to-market team is growing fast, and we need someone to make our revenue engine run on data, not intuition.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for our first person to own revenue operations. You'll be the only person in the function and work directly with Head of GTM. This is a hands-on role: you'll do the analysis yourself, and your analysis will shape decisions.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own forecast operations

 - Build and run the forecast and bookings roll-up end to end.

 - Add the judgment on top of the numbers. Flag when a rep is behind, sandbagging or overcommitted, or when a deal is slipping, and raise it before the forecast call rather than in it.

 - Get to one bookings number the whole room trusts.

Build our core GTM metrics and reporting

 - Stand up the metrics we're missing today: time to close, days in stage, loss rate and partner funnel. Partners feed our sales pipeline, so this covers more than direct sales.

 - Refresh them on a regular cadence so that a sales-metrics question gets a real answer the same day.

 - Where the data underneath isn't clean, fix it. Set and enforce stage definitions and pipeline hygiene.

Run the weekly GTM operating rhythm

 - Own prep for the weekly GTM meeting: the data pull, the analysis and choosing which topics need attention.

Own deal desk and commissions

 - Run commissions for 60+ sellers on an ongoing basis.

 - Own our commissions platform (Spiff), which is being implemented now, and the comp plan templates behind it.

 - Administer next year's sales comp plans, covering plan mechanics, accelerators, draws and clawbacks, and partner with GTM leadership on plan design.

Build AI-powered tools for the GTM team

 - Build Claude skills and automations that improve how the GTM team works, such as proposal building and project plans.

 - Build the back-end infrastructure behind our GTM operations with AI, rather than managing it by hand.

Support finance and planning

 - Answer ad-hoc GTM and sales-metrics questions from our strategic finance team, and supply the forecast they use for business planning.

 - Support territory planning and GTM org design as needs come up.

What this role isn't: delivery or project metrics, margins, accounting, or financial planning. Those sit with our delivery and strategic finance teams. You'll be the source of GTM truth that feeds them.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

 - GTM leadership walks into forecast calls having read your analysis instead of building one, and anomalies are flagged in advance.

 - Time to close, days in stage, loss rate and partner funnel exist, refresh on a cadence and are trusted.

 - Commissions run through Spiff, not Excel.

 - Next year's comp plans are drafted and ready to administer.

 - Weekly GTM call prep is fully yours.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-haves

 - You're AI-native. You build real infrastructure with AI (Claude, agents, skills, automations), not just use it to write emails. An engineering background is a strong signal.

 - Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Operations or GTM Systems inside a B2B revenue organization. Depth matters more than years: we need someone who understands go-to-market, not a generalist analyst.

 - Hands-on sales commissions experience at scale. You've run comp for a sizable sales team, not just reported on it, and you understand plan mechanics, draws, accelerators and clawbacks.

 - You've built forecasts and pipeline metrics yourself, end to end, often from imperfect data.

 - Strong GTM judgment. You've sat in real pipeline reviews and can explain why a rep's forecast looks wrong, not just that it differs from plan.

 - A real preference for hands-on work. You want to be the person building the analysis, not directing an analyst, and you're comfortable being a team of one.

 - Strong opinions on stage definitions and forecast hygiene, and experience enforcing them with sellers.

Nice-to-haves

 - Experience at a services, consulting or professional-services company. SOW-based bookings behave differently from recurring subscription revenue.

 - Experience implementing or administering a commissions platform (Spiff, CaptivateIQ, Xactly or similar).

 - Deal desk experience: pricing approvals, deal structuring, contract review with sales.

 - Partner or channel funnel analytics.

 - A background in software engineering or Salesforce consulting.


WHY JOIN

 - Real impact from day one. You're building the function, not maintaining someone else's.

 - Direct access to leadership. You'll work side by side with the GTM leader, and your analysis drives the conversation.

 - Breadth. Forecasting, analytics, deal desk and comp all sit in one seat, at a company at the center of applied AI.

jobs.description:
Advance AbbVie's pipeline by striving for excellence in clinical research, turning science into medicine for our patients and leveraging new advanced capabilities to drive industry leading performance.

Partners with the investigator and site staff for meaningful and effective engagements positioning AbbVie as the choice in clinical trials.

Focus on site clinical research that ensures appropriate conduct of the trial while driving improvement in data integrity, compliance, overall study performance and customer experience.

Responsibilities

• Considered as the primary point of contact for the investigative site, provides contextual information on the clinical trials, connects stakeholder to the investigative sites and strengthens AbbVie’s positioning.
• Aligns, trains and motivates the site staff and principal investigator under supervision on the goals of the clinical trial program, protocol, and patient treatment principles for the trial ensuring a trusted partnership.
• Conducts site evaluation, site training, routine, and site closure monitoring activities under supervision, in compliance to the protocol and monitoring plans and accordance with applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), ICH Guidelines, AbbVie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and to quality standards in conducting clinical research, ensuring safety and protection of study subjects.
• Customize site engagement strategy for assigned study(ies) under supervision. Gather local/site insights and utilize site engagement tools such as the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool, to report/track progress and measure impact of that strategy.
• Fundamental level of competency connecting the study protocol, scientific principles and clinical trial requirements to the day-to-day clinical trial execution activities. Evaluate and ensure effective recruitment and retention techniques/plans based on the patient disease journey. Develop solid knowledge of therapeutic area, asset and clinical landscape / patient journey to enable successful patient recruitment and overall protocol compliance.
• Responsible for continuous risk-assessment proactively, and in collaboration with Central Monitoring team, monitor activities conducted by clinical sites to detect early overall study performance or patient safety issues. Ability to think critically to resolve site risk signals while having robust understanding of site processes to drive study execution.
• Ensures preventative and corrective action plans are put into place, as needed, to mitigate risk and promote compliance using a customer centric approach.
• Identifies, evaluates and recommends new/potential investigators/sites under supervision and support from more experienced CRAs.
• Ensures quality of data submitted from study sites and assures timely submission of data, including appropriate reporting and follow-up for all safety events by site personnel.
• Ensures audit and regulatory inspection readiness at assigned clinical site at all times. Manages investigator payments as per executed contract obligations, as applicable.

• Appropriate tertiary qualification in health related disciplines (Medical, Scientific, Nursing) preferred or experience or equivalent work experience.
• Clinically related experience, preferably in clinical research coordinating or data management.
• Knowledge of appropriate therapeutic area indications is preferred with the ability to understand and apply scientific concepts as they relate to the conduct of clinical trials.
• Knowledge on existing and emerging local regulatory and legal requirements, ICH/GCP Guidelines and applicable policies.
• Able to work collaboratively and cross functionally to develop and sustain working relationships. Demonstrate planning and organizational skills and the ability to work effectively and efficiently in a dynamic environment with competing projects and deadlines
• Ability to leverage technology, tools and resources to provide customer centric support based on the health of the site. Ability to use functional expertise with appropriate guidance, leverage critical thinking skills and apply good judgement to address clinical site issues.
• Interpersonal skills with strong written, verbal, active listening and presentation skills, with ability to establish and leverage site relationships and trusted partnerships through engagement, motivation, and training.
• Acts with integrity in accordance with AbbVie code of business conduct and leadership values. Self-motivated individual focused on delivering timely and quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Intercom Calling
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

Intercom is one of the fastest-growing and most-loved product lines at Verkada, in a $1B+ market we've only begun to tap. At its core, the intercom connects people with the businesses and organizations they're visiting through a call. Whether you need to get into a building, drop off a package, ask about store hours or get help in an emergency, the intercom is how you reach a person who can help.

Calling is at the heart of the Intercom experience, and we need a product manager to own it end to end: every call, from the moment someone presses the button to the moment someone answers and helps them.

You'll own the underlying calling pipeline, enterprise-grade call routing, the context and controls that help people answering make better decisions, and the AI that automates call responses. Your job is to make every call reliable, productive and delightful.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

What You’ll Own

Calling stack: make every call great

• Define the roadmap for our signaling and media paths, across first- and third-party and online and offline pipelines

• Deliver a consistent answering experience on every endpoint: iOS, Android, web browsers, PSTN and VoIP

• Track the metrics that matter: ring rate, connection success rate, dropped calls and audio/video quality (load time, latency, packet loss, jitter, MOS)

• Address failure modes on real-world networks, including weak cellular links, restrictive enterprise firewalls and NAT traversal

• Manage relationships with subprocessors and technology partners, including corporate phone and communications platforms

Call routing: get every call to the best person available

• Add intelligence to routing based on audio and video triggers, building state (such as after hours or lockdown), schedules and staff availability

• Define what the caller experiences while their call is being routed

• Design strategies for concurrent calls: ring strategies (simultaneous, sequential, round robin), triage, queuing, forwarding and failover

• Build tools that let admins configure, test and manage routing at scale across many sites, users, and devices (including receiver groups, SCIM syncing)

Call context and controls: give the person answering superpowers

• Enrich calls with context for better decisions, such as live captions, nearby security camera feeds, visitor history and access logs

• Build advanced controls that put fast, powerful options at the answerer's fingertips, such as real-time voice translation, security escalation and multi-door unlocking

• Drive sophisticated video features such as two-way video, auto-framing and AI filters that improve the calling experience

AI receivers: use voice AI to streamline responses

Today, conversational AI handles low-risk tasks like sharing basic information about a business and its policies (Info Desk) and finding the right tenant to call (Voice Directory). We see many more interactions it can automate, including wayfinding, appointment management and granting building entry.

• Define human escalation rules, clean handoffs and firm guardrails for AI conversations, especially anything safety-related Build frameworks to measure quality, including escalation rate, accuracy, latency, system observability and model evals Identify, prototype and launch new voice AI use cases with the goal of finding product-market fit

How You'll Work

• Own customer discovery: talk to customers, go on site walks and see pain points firsthand in the field

• Set product strategy and prioritize the roadmap, balancing tradeoffs between reliability, new capabilities and customer needs

• Partner closely with engineering and design, bringing both technical depth and design sense

• Drive execution from spec to launch with obsessive attention to detail

• Craft the product pitch with marketing and sales

• Stay on top of the competitive landscape and market trends

What You'll Bring

• 8+ years of product management experience

• A track record of building and scaling complex enterprise software products

• An undergraduate degree in computer science, electrical engineering or a similar quantitative field. An MS, MBA or equivalent experience is a plus but not required

• Comfort going deep with engineers on architecture and tradeoffs, then explaining them clearly to customers and executives

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• You enjoy envisioning the big picture and managing the details

• You like getting your hands dirty and getting out in the field to understand customer pain points

• Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week

Nice to Have

• Technical knowledge of SIP and/or WebRTC: signaling vs. media, codecs, STUN/TURN and NAT traversal, SFUs, and what actually causes a call to fail or degrade

• Technical knowledge of audio processing and acoustics, such as audio DSPs, microphone selection and design, beamforming and noise cancellation

• A track record of improving reliability and quality with data: you've defined quality metrics, built the dashboards and moved the numbers

• Experience shipping voice AI or conversational agents, including speech recognition, text-to-speech and real-time speech-to-speech models

• A background in physical security, access control, video surveillance, emergency dispatch (PSAP/911/CAD) systems or IoT hardware

US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

• Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee’s 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

• Expanded mental health support

• Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

• Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

• Professional development stipend

• Wellness/fitness benefits

• Healthy lunches provided daily

• Commuter benefits

Additional Information

• We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

Below is the annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position, comprised of base compensation and commissions (if applicable).

Estimated Annual Pay Range

$205,000—$240,000 USD

Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

Your application will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Marketing Automation (SFMC) Engineer
jobs.description:
Come to work each day with an inclusive and collaborative Business technology team! As a Marketing Automation Platform Engineer in AbbVie Business Technology Solutions (BTS), you will have opportunities to contribute to the digital transformation of a leading biopharma company, helping to create solutions that impact patients and their communities for the better.

Technical expert that will independently identify, engineer, and optimize new data, software, or technology solutions that address critical business needs. Continuously seek to improve existing methods and processes. Read and adapt literature and publicly available information to accomplish assignments. Demonstrate proficiency in a broad range of techniques and methods for information technology engineering, including software development, data warehousing, statistics, machine learning, and/or technology infrastructure (including servers, storage, network connectivity, and virtualization/cloud environments). Technology Engineers will be aligned to a specific area: Information, Software, Data, or Infrastructure.

This role will work hybrid and will require 3 days in the Mettawa,IL office. Candidates who are not local or within a commutable distance would be expected to relocate.

Responsibilities:

• Demonstrate high proficiency in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) platform administration and data operations, ensuring continuous platform and capability availability and ongoing monitoring of issues.
• Release and maintain high quality SFMC capabilities/solutions aligned to business and platform projects and priorities leveraging platform SDKs, development tools, APIs, etc., monitoring in-market capabilities and resolving issues.
• Manage and resolve platform issues, collaborating with the platform teams, platform operations partners, and Salesforce Signature Support as needed, to resolve tickets per priority and SLA.
• Ensure high quality, on-time implementation and testing of assigned platform and data enablement activities within SFMC. Adhere to software development lifecycle processes to ensure accuracy and completeness of documentation and implementation.
• Collaborate with various internal / external stakeholders and partners to refine requirements for platform enablement activities and resolve platform operations issues.
• Provide rapid ad hoc campaign technical support to stakeholders building campaigns on SFMC.
• Execute ongoing platform governance, administration, and maintenance activities on the connected marketing activation platform.
• Proactively recommend process improvements to optimize platform development and operations processes
• Demonstrate strong client service and task management skills; communicate with both business and technical individuals effectively.

Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree with 5 years’ experience; Master’s Degree with 4 years’ experience.
• 3+ years of hands-on experience with development on Marketing Automation Platforms (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or equivalent) with deep knowledge across their studios/modules
• Strong experience integrating Marketing Automation Platforms with relevant CRM, marketing, and data platforms, including experience with SOAP and REST based APIs
• Strong Client Facing Experience with proven success managing technical deliverables and communications

Preferred:

• At least one Salesforce Marketing Cloud Certification
• Experience with data profiling, data integration and data visualization processes, languages, and tools i.e., SQL, SNF
• Experience in CRM/Marketing campaign development and deployments.
• Intermediate/Advanced understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, AMPscript, SSJS, and SQL and its utilization in SFMC.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Sports
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager, Sports + Entertainment

This role is based in Soho, New York City and expected to be in office at least 4 days a week.

Flowcode

Flowcode is the leading offline-to-online conversion platform, helping the world's biggest brands drive direct connections with their audiences. We combine data-driven design with next-gen QR tech to power instant, privacy-compliant engagement at scale. Over 75% of the Fortune 500 (including the top names in sports and entertainment) trust Flowcode to turn physical moments into digital actions, fast.

The Role: Customer Success Manager, Sports + Entertainment

We're hiring a CSM focused on our sports and entertainment vertical, supporting clients like TKO, NHL, NBA, NFL, Premier League, and more. You'll own relationships with leagues, teams, properties, venues, and live event organizers, driving adoption, attribution, and expansion. This is a hybrid role that blends technical fluency with commercial instincts and a relentless focus on delivering measurable outcomes.

You'll thrive in this role if you:

• Have 2-3+ years in customer success, account management, or partnerships, ideally at a league, team, sports property, or with a book of sports clients

• Understand the sports business ecosystem: fan engagement, ticketing, sponsorship and partnerships, broadcast, in-venue, and merch

• Know how sports orgs are structured and can navigate from an individual champion in marketing or digital to the right budget owner in partnerships, ticketing, or revenue fast

• Can confidently connect Flowcode to sports KPIs: fan data capture, sponsor activation value, ticket and merch conversion, in-venue and broadcast engagement

• Plan around the calendar: seasons, tentpole events, PPVs, and off-season, and know how to keep accounts engaged when games aren't on

• Spot churn signals early and act. You've turned at-risk accounts into renewals and have the receipts

• Move fast on account challenges. You are highly proactive, resourceful, and sharp under pressure, including on live event days

• Can synthesize complex client challenges into clear executive narratives and recommendations

• Take ownership of your accounts and beyond to improve systems, processes, or team performance

• Know how to uncover expansion with new activation use cases, sponsor integrations, sister properties, and budget pockets

• Build trust across sports orgs: marketing, digital, partnerships, ticketing, broadcast, event ops, and data teams

• Have experience coordinating platform migrations or complex onboarding alongside implementation teams

• Are comfortable in HubSpot (or can ramp fast) and use systems to scale client engagement

What You'll Own:

• NRR targets across your portfolio: drive usage, adoption, renewal, and expansion. You own the number of your portfolio.

• Health score monitoring: proactively flag at-risk signals, build recovery plans, and move before accounts slip, with seasonality factored in.

• Executive engagement, Strategic QBRs, Event and Season Reviews: multi-thread across client teams and build relationships with executives, budget holders, and senior stakeholders.

• Risk mitigation and problem-solving: turn insights into action fast. You don't wait for escalation.

• Live activation readiness: partner with our team to make sure codes, Hubs, and FlowURLs perform on game day, fight night, and event day.

• Cross-functional influence: drive alignment across Sales, Product, and GTM to unlock product growth and services opportunities to drive revenue.

• Platform migration coordination: manage client-side timelines, expectations, and cross-functional dependencies alongside our implementation team.

• Sales partnership: identify and close upsell opportunities, including new properties, sponsors, and events.

• Workflow alignment: build rhythms that match season calendars, event schedules, sponsor deliverables, and renewal cycles.

• NYC presence: deepen sports relationships by showing up on-site, at live events, and as a strategic partner.

Requirements:

• 2-3+ years in CSM, Account Management, Partnerships, or similar client-facing roles

• Experience in the sports industry or managing sports clients strongly preferred

• Proven track record managing at-risk accounts, driving renewals, and hitting NRR or retention targets

• Experience supporting live events or time-sensitive activations

• Exposure to platform migrations or complex product transitions for enterprise clients is a plus

• Strong understanding of fan engagement, attribution, and analytics

• Experience using CRM and CS platforms like HubSpot; health score tooling experience is a major plus

• Clear, concise communicator, comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and comfortable pushing back when needed

• Ability to operate independently and deliver in a fast-paced, high-growth startup

• Flexibility to support occasional nights and weekends around key live events

A successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on the role, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions.  The current range for this role is $100-$115k OTE plus equity.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
WE'RE BUILDING A NEW HEALTHCARE CLEARINGHOUSE

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp https://ramp.com/data/top-saas-vendors-on-ramp-march-2026 as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.



Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.



To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MxyCUNAr9Y8. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IO6sR-i5rSs.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re hiring an Accounting Manager to own Stedi’s monthly close and day-to-day accounting operations as the business continues to scale. You will report directly to the Controller and be responsible for general ledger accuracy, timely financial reporting, and the accounting processes and controls that support them.



Stedi’s accounting function is already built around integrated systems, automation, and AI. A major part of this role is building on that foundation as the business and team grow. You will standardize and document workflows, establish clear responsibilities and review procedures, and strengthen controls so accounting processes remain reliable and repeatable as transaction volume and complexity increase.



We expect you to understand how transactions flow through our systems, from underlying data through final reporting. jobs.title: Principal Research Scientist - Risk
jobs.description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.



We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.



By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.



Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.



Principal Research Scientist - Risk

We are seeking an experienced research scientist to contribute to Neara’s internal research group in topics of system resilience, reliability, and policy. In this role, you will define a research agenda, develop rigorous statistical and decision models, and translate findings into tools and recommendations for utilities managing billions of dollars in capital expenditure.



Neara provides network-scale structural, loading, and contextual data across complete overhead electrical systems. As a Principal Research Scientist - Risk, you will use this information to build generalizable models of asset failure and determine the value of additional data, inspections, and interventions.



What You Will Do:

 - Contribute to Neara’s applied research function for infrastructure risk and resilience.

 - Establish rigorous standards for risk modeling, uncertainty quantification, and decision-making.

 - Develop predictive models for equipment damage, vegetation failure, outage likelihood and duration, and wildfire-related risk.

 - Design decision models that quantify the operational and economic consequences of resilience and reliability investments, including asset replacement, vegetation management, and network redesign.

 - Quantify the value of data including pole loading analysis, visual inspections, and the installation of new devices and remote sensing capabilities, both empirically and by analytical methods.
   
   

Who You Are:

 - A PhD in statistics, applied mathematics, physics, computer science, operations research, engineering, or a comparable record of original research and applied technical work.

 - Proven track record of independently defining, driving, and executing a substantial research agenda as a senior individual contributor or industry principal, demonstrated through influential publications, patents, or production systems.

 - Recognized subject matter expert with deep technical authority and a history of setting research direction without needing direct management oversight.

 - Extensive experience in probabilistic modeling, uncertainty quantification, model validation, scientific computing capabilities and decision-making under incomplete information.

 - Substantial experience modeling operational systems. Particularly relevant topics include insurance or catastrophe modeling; weather prediction and climate hazard; outages in power systems; and reliability engineering.
   
   

What We Offer:

 - A highly competitive compensation package including an equity component to ensure you directly benefit from Neara’s sustained success and impact on critical infrastructure.

 - The opportunity to work on a cutting-edge, 3D physics-enabled platform used to anticipate the impact of extreme events, reduce infrastructure failure, and direct investment. Access to unique network-scale utility data unavailable in other industrial research settings.

 - The opportunity to help develop and build Neara’s research modeling function, establishing the agenda, identifying preferred methods and working on novel under-specified problems.

 - A central role in shaping Neara’s long-term product roadmap, analytical standards and customer advisory services.

 - Flexible hours and working arrangements designed to help you do your best work from where you work best.

jobs.description:
Envision working with energetic colleagues and inspirational leaders, all while gaining world-class experience in one of the most dynamic organizations in the pharmaceutical industry. This is a reality for AbbVie’s Co-Ops.  This is a work experience and is not intended to support a thesis.

Product Development Science and Technology (PDS&T): Designs, delivers, and supports biologics manufacturing processes for AbbVie’s pipeline and partnered products through clinical development and commercial life cycle. The department advances targeted product quality, CMC acceleration, people development, and efficient workflows, bringing together expertise across Cell Line Development, Cell Culture Process Development, Purification Process Development, Scale-Up Lab, and Analytical Development.

We are seeking an exceptional graduate co-op student to join our Cell Culture Development and Automation team for an innovative, hands-on project at the intersection of optical spectroscopy, cell culture science, laboratory robotics, and data analytics. In this role, you will help integrate spectroscopy with automated liquid-handling robotics to enable rapid, at-line characterization of cell-culture product quality and metabolites. You will have the opportunity to build novel hardware, develop automated analytical workflows, and apply chemometric and data-science modeling to production-relevant datasets, helping transform how process development teams learn from experiments.

Key responsibilities include:

• Supporting integration of spectroscopy systems with an automated liquid-handling platform for high-throughput, at-line spectral acquisition from cell culture samples.

• Designing and 3D printing custom labware and sampling components to support automated sample transfer and spectral measurement.

• Developing and troubleshoot automated liquid-handler methods for sample acquisition, flow-cell delivery, and system wash and cleaning cycles.

• Performing aseptic cell culture techniques, including thawing, passaging, and banking of mammalian (CHO) cell lines, to support experimental studies.

• Collecting, processing, and analyzing Raman spectral and process data; apply chemometric and data-science techniques to build predictive models for metabolites and product quality attributes.

• Collaborating cross-functionally with scientists in cell culture development, automation engineering, and analytical development to refine workflows using experimental results and team feedback.

• Documenting experimental methods, data, and results clearly; contribute to a final presentation and/or manuscript-quality summary suitable for internal or external scientific communication.

Minimum Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in university, pursuing a Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Chemistry or a related field.

• Must be enrolled in university at the time of the Co-Op.

• Expected graduation date between May 2028 – Dec 2028

• Proficient in aseptic techniques, including thawing, passaging, and banking mammalian cell lines in a biosafety cabinet.

• Knowledge of optical spectroscopy techniques, including Raman, fluorescence, and absorbance.

• Knowledge of biology and biochemistry, cell metabolism, and protein characterization as applied to CHO cell culture development.

• Must be able to commit to a 6-month program at AbbVie’s site located in Worcester, MA (June - December).

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex laboratory robotics and instrumentation challenges.

• Ability to design and create custom labware using 3D printing.

• Ability to execute, troubleshoot, and interpret complex experimental data to determine thoughtful next steps.

• Working knowledge of programming or scripting languages such as Python, Visual Basic and C/C++.

ABOUT 7AI

7AI is the foundational AI security company. Founded in 2024 by Cybereason co-founders Lior Div and Yonatan Striem-Amit, we came out of stealth in February 2025 to take on the non-human work of the SOC. Our platform pairs a federated SIEM with AI agents that detect, investigate, respond, and hunt, plus dedicated threat hunting and threat intelligence, with humans on the loop.

Backed by $166 million in total funding from investors including Index Ventures and Blackstone, we're building the AI foundation for security operations in the agentic era, and we're still early. That's the appeal: you'll join at a pivotal stage where your work shapes what 7AI becomes, alongside security veterans who've built this before. Our culture runs on respect, collaboration, and a shared bar for excellence, all pointed at one goal, delivering real outcomes for the customers who trust us to defend them.




OVERVIEW

As our GRC Engineer  you'll keep 7AI audit-ready and make security assurance easy for our customers. You'll run our compliance program day to day, work directly with customers and vendors on their security questions, and keep internal teams current on where every initiative stands.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage and maintain our compliance program through our compliance automation platform. Keeping controls, evidence, and integrations current.

 - Prepare for and support SOC 2, ISO, and FedRAMP audits, as well as assessments supporting other regulatory frameworks, as required by the business and our customers.

 - Keep policies, control descriptions, and risk records accurate as frameworks and our business change.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in GRC, compliance, or security risk.

 - Hands-on experience supporting SOC 2 audits, and working knowledge of ISO 27001, ISO 42001 and FedRAMP.

 - Experience running third-party risk management, including vendor assessments.

 - Experience with a compliance automation platform such as Scytale, Vanta, or Drata.

 - Experience running internal audits or control testing.

 - Comfort talking with customers and vendors about security, in plain language.

 - Strong project tracking habits, and a track record of keeping stakeholders informed.

 - Practical experience using AI tools to speed up your own work, and curiosity about what else can be automated.

 - A doer's mindset. You spot what needs to happen and start, without waiting to be asked.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Hands-on experience with SaaS compliance automation platforms.

 - Experience in a security vendor or fast-growing startup, especially in customer-facing security assurance.

 - Exposure to AI governance, such as ISO 42001 or the NIST AI RMF.

 - Scripting skills, such as Python or SQL, to automate evidence collection and reporting.

 - Certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer.
