jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Staff Supply Chain Manager to lead our global sourcing activities for Thermal systems. This senior role requires a unique blend of strategic vision and hands-on execution. You will be responsible for developing the global commodity strategy while also personally leading the most critical commercial activities, including RFQs and negotiations for key suppliers. As the primary interface for Engineering, Finance, and Manufacturing, you will ensure the successful delivery of world-class products, balancing innovation, cost, and supply chain resilience.

You Will:

• Strategy & Execution Ownership: Develop and execute the global commodity strategy for Thermal systems. You will be personally accountable for the commercial success and health of your supply base.

• End-to-End Sourcing Leadership: Lead the entire sourcing process for strategic components—from initial supplier identification and leading the RFQ process, to conducting deep-dive cost analysis, and negotiating and executing complex contracts and statements of work.

• Supplier Relationship Management: Serve as the primary commercial contact for strategic suppliers. Manage overall supplier relationships, performance, and development timelines, resolving critical issues that arise.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with Engineering and Supplier Quality to identify and qualify suppliers that meet our technical, quality, and program timing goals.

• Cost & Value Leadership: Utilize expert knowledge of manufacturing processes (e.g., aluminum casting/forging, stamping, plastics, thermal assembly) to build robust cost models, drive should-cost analyses, and secure best-in-class pricing and terms.

• Program Management: Manage supplier development and parts availability for prototype builds and production ramp, ensuring on-time delivery and resolving any supply constraints.

• Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior supply chain team members, elevating the team's overall commercial acumen.

You Bring:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related field. An advanced degree (e.g., MBA) is preferred.

• 8-15 years of progressive, hands-on experience in Purchasing or Supply Chain, with deep expertise in Thermal Management systems (e.g., Battery Cooling, HVAC, FECM, Fluid Transfer Systems).

• Proven track record of developing commodity strategies and personally leading complex, high-value RFQs and negotiations.

• Expert knowledge of component manufacturing processes and sophisticated cost-modeling techniques.

• Extensive experience with automotive part launches and serial production, with a strong understanding of product development and quality processes (APQP, PPAP).

• Exceptional negotiation, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both internal stakeholders and external supplier leadership.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and ERP systems (e.g., SAP).

• Willingness to travel 15-25% domestic and internationally.

jobs.title: Service Manager, Dealership Operations
jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars—but we’re not car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own mom. Period. That’s why every vehicle goes through Carvana’s process, where it’s inspected, perfected, and prepared to meet our high standards before it ever reaches you. And now, we’re bringing those same values to our new car dealerships—delivering quality, trust, and care you’d be proud to share with Mom.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

About the Role

As Service Manager, you'll keep our service shop running smoothly every day. You own the open repair order queue and work with the Associate General Manager and Foreman on dispatch, matching incoming work to technician and bay capacity so every vehicle is ready when we promised. You'll lead our Service Advisor team and keep the front and back of the house working as one. You'll report to the Associate General Manager and work side by side with the shop Foreman and Parts Lead.

What you'll be doing

• Work with the AGM and Foreman on daily dispatch, helping assign work by technician skill, repair type, and bay availability

• Own the open RO queue and flag priority changes during the day so jobs finish on time

• Spot stalled or delayed jobs early and work with the shop to clear them before they slow things down

• Lead, schedule, and coach Service Advisors on accurate repair orders and clear, proactive customer communication

• Make sure warranty repair orders meet OEM documentation standards from the start

• Coordinate with parts, technicians, and our scheduling team to keep work moving and cut down on rework

• Report results and set priorities in the daily production meeting

How you'll be measured

Shop throughput, technician and bay utilization, RO cycle time, rework rate, RO accuracy, and customer wait time.

What you should have

• 5+ years in automotive service as a service advisor, service lead, or dispatcher, including time leading a team

• Experience working on dispatch or production scheduling in a high-volume shop

• Working knowledge of a dealer management system (Tekion is a plus)

• Familiarity with OEM warranty documentation (Stellantis is a plus)

• Strong judgment when setting priorities under pressure, plus clear communication

• A valid driver's license and a clean driving record

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Position with a competitive wage

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401K with company match

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally

• Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English

• Must be at least 18 years of age

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE.

Reality Defender is an award-winning cybersecurity company helping enterprises and governments detect deepfakes and AI-generated media. Utilizing a patented multi-model approach, Reality Defender is robust against the bleeding edge of generative platforms producing video, audio, imagery, and text media. Reality Defender's API-first deepfake detection platform empowers teams and developers alike to identify fraud, disinformation campaigns, and harmful deepfakes in real time.

Backed by world class investors including DCVC, Illuminate Financial, Y Combinator, Booz Allen Hamilton, IBM, Accenture, Rackhouse, and Argon VC, Reality Defender works with leading enterprise clients, financial institutions, and governments in order to ensure AI-generated media is not used for malicious purposes.

Youtube: Reality Defender Wins RSA Most Innovative Startup


THE SOLUTIONS ENGINEER ROLE.

Deepfake detection is a new category, and most buyers are evaluating it for the first time. They need someone who can show them, on their own media and inside their own workflows, what our platform catches and how it fits their stack. As a Solutions Engineer, you'll be that person: the technical lead on deals with banks, government agencies, and enterprise security teams, from first discovery call through a working integration. This is a full-time role based in NYC or can be full-time remote, reporting to our CRO. Responsibilities include:

 - Lead technical discovery and run proofs of concept that test our detection models against the customer's own audio, video, image, and text samples, with success criteria agreed up front with the account executive and the customer.

 - Build and deliver demos tailored to each buyer's use case (contact center fraud, executive impersonation, KYC and onboarding, media verification), not a standard feature tour.

 - Explain detection results in plain terms: what a score means, how thresholds trade false positives against missed fakes, and how to tune them for the customer's risk tolerance.

 - Guide customers through integrating our API and SDKs into their existing systems, including contact center, video conferencing, identity verification, and case management tools.

 - Own the technical side of security reviews, questionnaires, and RFPs, especially for financial institutions and government buyers with strict procurement requirements.

 - Turn what you hear in the field into clear, prioritized feedback for Product, Engineering, and our research team.

 - Build reusable demo environments, scripts, talk tracks, and integration guides so every deal doesn't start from zero.

 - Know where your job ends: bring in Engineering or research when a question goes beyond what the platform does today, rather than over-promising.

 - Represent Reality Defender at customer meetings, industry events, and conferences as needed.


WHO YOU ARE.

 - 3+ years as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or in a similar customer-facing technical role, ideally selling cybersecurity, fraud prevention, identity, or AI/ML products to enterprise buyers.

 - A track record of running proofs of concept that convert: you set clear success criteria, keep evaluations on schedule, and can show deals you helped close.

 - Hands-on with APIs and integrations, with enough Python or JavaScript to build a demo, read a customer's code, and troubleshoot an integration. Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP.

 - Comfortable explaining probabilistic results (confidence scores, false positive and false negative rates) to both a fraud analyst and a CISO.

 - Strong communicator who can hold a room with technical and executive audiences, and who tells customers honestly what the product does and doesn't do.

 - Experience selling into financial services, government, defense, or other regulated buyers, including security reviews and compliance requirements (SOC 2, FedRAMP, or similar). (nice to have)

 - Familiarity with contact center (e.g., Genesys, Five9, Amazon Connect), video conferencing, or identity verification platforms. (nice to have)

 - Active or prior U.S. security clearance, or exposure to digital forensics, synthetic media, or adversarial ML. (nice to have)


WITHIN 12 MONTHS, YOU'LL…

 - Be recognized internally and by customers as a go-to expert on deepfake detection deployments in your segment.

 - Have built a library of demos, integration guides, and POC frameworks that shortens the sales cycle for the whole team.

 - Be shaping how we sell into new use cases or verticals as the market matures.

 - Be onboarding and coaching new Solutions Engineers as the team grows.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Air & Missile Defense Radar team develops cutting-edge tracking algorithms and software systems that detect, track, and characterize airborne threats in real-time. Working in small, focused teams, our software engineers design and implement sophisticated tracking solutions that protect lives and critical assets. Our work spans the full spectrum—from developing novel multi-target tracking algorithms to building high-performance distributed systems that process massive amounts of sensor data in milliseconds

We don't just publish papers; we deploy production-grade systems that our government and industry customers depend on for mission-critical operations. If you're passionate about applying mathematics, software engineering, and signal processing to solve complex real-world problems, we want to hear from you.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Build and leverage modeling & simulation environments to validate tracking performance, quantify system capabilities, and identify areas for improvement

• Participate in customer demonstrations and field tests to ensure successful deployment and operational effectiveness

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Solid foundation in mathematics: linear algebra, probability, statistics, and/or differential equations

• Understanding of software engineering fundamentals: design patterns, testing, version control, and debugging

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with tracking, estimation, or filtering algorithms (Kalman filters, particle filters, multiple hypothesis tracking, etc.)

• Background in controls, estimation theory, or digital signal processing

• Familiarity with radar systems or sensor fusion

• Experience with high-performance computing (multithreading, GPU acceleration, distributed systems)

• Knowledge of machine learning techniques for classification, clustering, or data association

• Proficiency with database technologies (SQL, NoSQL, time-series databases)

• Experience with web development technologies (JavaScript, React, Node.js) for building visualization and analysis tools

• Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools (MATLAB, Simulink, or custom frameworks)

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Agentic Quoting Tools
jobs.description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to own that experience end to end. You sit between Sales and the quoting teams and you serve the customers who matter most to Xometry. Your job is to rethink how a request becomes a priced quote: every channel it can arrive through, every hand-off between a person and a system, and every step that does not need a human at all. You will design the agents that read the request, build the quote, and propose the price, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations that let those agents work across our quoting systems and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform, and the staff tools where people review what the agents did and decide what they should not. The measure is simple: how fast, how accurately, and with how little effort our best customers get a quote they can act on.

This role sits in the Pricing and Manufacturability (P&M) group alongside the product managers for cost prediction, pricing, and Design for Manufacturability (DFM), and reports to the head of P&M product.

You will be given a metric and a problem space, not a fully scoped backlog. Comfort defining your own roadmap from ambiguous signals is a requirement, not a bonus.

This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our Waltham, MA or North Bethesda, MD office location.

How You'll Contribute

• Own the request-to-quote experience for our most important customers. Map every path a quote request takes today, from the moment a customer emails, texts, uploads, or sends an agent, through Sales, quoting, pricing review, and back to the customer. Know the behind-the-scenes steps better than anyone outside the teams that run them. Remove the steps that do not need to exist. Your scorecard: quote turnaround time, cost per quote, quote accuracy, and quote-to-order conversion on the human-assisted path.

• Redesign the funnel, not just the tools. Treat each intake channel as a pathway with its own drop-offs and its own fix. Decide where a request should be read by an agent, where it should be routed to a person, and where the customer should be able to self-serve without either. Build the pathways so a request arrives structured, complete, and already half-priced by the time a human sees it.

• Make agents do the work people should not have to. Own the roadmap for agentic quoting: agents that read a request and its files and build the quote, assistants that propose margin and lead time, and automation that promotes human-priced parts into the instant-pricing engine over time. Decide what the agent does, what the human confirms, and what stays human. Define "good" and "failure" for every AI feature before engineering starts, and hold that bar through launch and after.

• Connect the agents to the business through MCP and the ERP. Own the integration layer that lets agents and people exchange work across Salesforce, our quoting systems, file storage, and the ERP: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool definitions, permissions, and the audit trail that shows who (or what) changed a quote and why. The exchange between humans and agents is a product surface; design it like one.

• Build the staff tools the quoting and sales teams actually use. Own the internal quote review, pricing, and quote summary tools. Treat adoption as the product metric: a tool the team routes around has failed, regardless of what shipped.

• Instrument everything. Every human pricing decision (override, margin change, lead-time adjustment) becomes structured data that improves the next prediction and the next agent run. Write your own queries, build your own dashboards, and put the events you need into the requirements document, not into an analyst request.

• Run discovery continuously, not on a research calendar. Sit with quoters and account managers. Read the inbound email and text queues. Watch session recordings. Synthesize the signal with AI tools and validate it against live customer and staff conversations before acting on it. A working prototype, tested with the people who will use it, is your default artifact for a build decision.

• Set product strategy and secure buy-in. Define a 6 to 12 month roadmap for agentic quoting, sequence it by customer impact and speed, and align Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Quoting Operations, and Finance behind it. Present progress against named outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Build and ship with AI agents. Operate spec-first. Read the relevant systems with agentic tools, ask sharper feasibility questions as a result, and write specs that an engineer can hand to a coding agent. Prototype in Cursor, Claude, and Figma Make before you write requirements.

• Raise the bar for peers. Share the AI workflows that worked and the ones that failed. Your patterns should show up in other product managers' artifacts.

What You'll Bring to Xometry

You would be a good fit with:

• 8+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of a workflow or operations product that sits between a sales or service organization and the customers it serves, in a B2B, marketplace, or enterprise context.

• Evidence of shipping AI or automation into an expert human workflow with guardrails, and of knowing when not to automate.

• Experience integrating products across systems of record (CRM, ERP, file storage, messaging), and a working understanding of how agents connect to those systems through tool protocols such as MCP.

• Multi-channel thinking: you have redesigned how requests enter a business (email, text, forms, APIs, agents) and can show the drop-off you removed.

• AI-native practice, not just AI tool use: you can show where AI changed a decision your team made, not only where it saved you time. Hands-on fluency with Cursor, Claude, or equivalent agentic tools, and a point of view on evaluating large language model (LLM) features before and after launch.

• Strong analytical fluency: you write your own SQL, you have built your own dashboard, and you have caught a broken metric before it misled a decision.

• Operational curiosity: you learn how a process actually runs by sitting with the people who run it, and you earn their trust before you change their tools.

• Exceptional written communication: your documents let an operations lead, an engineer, and an executive act on the same page.

• Comfort making decisions under ambiguity, translating a loosely defined problem into a testable hypothesis and a plan.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Signals we look for

• You can walk through a specific request-to-fulfillment funnel you redesigned across a sales team, a service team, and their customers: the channels involved, the steps you removed, the before and after numbers, and how adoption went.

• You have built or owned an integration between an AI agent and a system of record, and you can explain what the agent was allowed to do, what it had to ask a human for, and how you knew when it was wrong.

• You have shipped an AI or machine learning (ML) feature into a human-in-the-loop process and can describe its evaluation criteria, its failure modes, and what you monitored after launch.

• You can point to a case where your team decided differently because of an AI-driven workflow you built (continuous customer signal, prototype-first decisions, evaluation criteria written before build).

• You have worked in manufacturing, supply chain, pricing, or quoting, or you can show how you learn an unfamiliar operational domain fast.

Pace

This is a startup pace inside a public company. You will be given a metric and an open problem, not a scoped project plan, and you will be expected to move quickly from hypothesis to shipped test. If you do your best work with a clear brief and a stable backlog, this is not the right role.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.



We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.



Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an exceptional Senior Engineering Manager to lead 10–12 engineers across our Secrets Management https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/getting-started/choose-a-product/secrets-management/overview and Certificate Management https://infisical.com/platform/certificate-management teams. Secrets Management delivers over 10 billion secrets monthly, while Certificate Management supports PKI, certificate lifecycle automation, and signing release artifacts and binaries. Both products support cloud and self-hosted deployments, including on-premises and air-gapped environments.



You'll be responsible for developing a high-performing engineering team, driving execution across both products, and ensuring our infrastructure remains secure and reliable. You'll work closely with our CTO and Tech Leads, staying deeply technical while empowering engineers to own their work.



You'll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to:

 - Own engineering delivery: Drive execution across both teams, establish clear commitments, manage competing priorities, and ensure the team consistently delivers high-quality work.

 - Hire and develop engineers: Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development. Build a high-performing team and develop strong Tech Leads.

 - Shape engineering priorities: Balance customer needs and product development with investments in security, reliability, and developer velocity.

 - Own reliability and engineering quality: Establish reliability targets and drive improvements in observability, incident response, and operational quality.

 - Stay technically involved: Know when to zoom out and when to dive deep. Review code and technical designs, and work with Tech Leads to guide important architectural decisions and resolve difficult engineering challenges.

 - Work directly with customers: Understand their workflows and technical requirements, and translate those insights into engineering priorities.

 - Improve how the team operates: Establish lightweight processes that keep execution fast, predictable, and accountable.
   
   


REQUIREMENTS

 - 6+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineers, ideally in developer tooling, infrastructure security, or other high-stakes developer software.

 - A strong track record of building and developing high-performing teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and developing technical leaders.

 - Experience leading multiple engineering workstreams and driving execution through others.

 - Strong hands-on engineering background. You're comfortable reviewing production code and technical designs.

 - Strong engineering fundamentals and sound judgment around system architecture, reliability, and technical tradeoffs.

 - Excellent communication skills, including the ability to work directly with customers.

 - A bias toward action, with the ability to make decisions with incomplete information and maintain high standards while moving quickly.

 - Based in the US or Canada (NYC preferred).
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience working in security infrastructure or developer tools.

 - Experience leading teams developing distributed systems.

 - A track record of using AI tools to increase engineering output while maintaining production security, availability and reliability commitments.
   
   


TEAM, VALUES & BENEFITS

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available, with more details on our careers page https://infisical.com/careers.

jobs.title: (2027 Graduates) Senior Associate - Management Advisory (Energy Practice)

jobs.description:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

CRA’s Energy Practice helps clients address the decisions shaping the future of the energy industry: how to meet growing electricity demand, invest in infrastructure, maintain reliable and affordable service, and respond to changes in markets, regulation, and technology. We work with utilities, investors, developers, large energy users, regulators, and other industry participants, combining commercial insight with economic analysis and technical expertise.

Our engagements span business strategy, resource and infrastructure planning, regulatory policy, market analysis, mergers and acquisitions, and litigation. We help clients evaluate growth opportunities, prioritize capital investments, improve operations, and manage risk. This includes advising on the expansion of data centers and other large energy users, investment in generation and networks, and the implications of emerging technologies for energy businesses and their customers.

Position Overview

Senior Associates in our Energy Practice work on teams that help clients make major strategic, investment, and operational decisions. They structure complex problems, conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses, and translate findings into clear recommendations for executives and other decision-makers.

The role offers exposure to diverse clients and challenges across the energy industry, with opportunities to take ownership of workstreams, contribute to client discussions, and work closely with senior experts. Successful candidates bring intellectual curiosity, strong analytical and communication skills, and an interest in understanding how energy businesses operate, compete, and invest.

Primary responsibilities for Senior Associates include:

• Contribute across all phases of client engagements, from defining key questions and conducting strategic, financial, market, and organizational analyses to developing recommendations and supporting implementation;

• Evaluate complex business challenges facing energy clients, translating data and research into clear insights and practical recommendations;

• Manage project workstreams, including work planning, coordination of junior team members, and delivery of high-quality analyses and client materials;

• Present findings and recommendations to mid- and senior-level clients, helping build consensus and inform decisions;

• Lead and coach junior consultants, providing direction, feedback, and opportunities to develop their skills;

• Support business development through proposal preparation and identification of opportunities to address client needs; and

• Contribute to practice development through thought leadership, development of analytical tools and methods, training, and recruiting.

Desired Qualifications

We welcome candidates with different combinations of academic training and professional experience. Strong candidates will bring analytical ability, sound judgment, and demonstrated energy industry experience.

• Currently pursuing an MBA, master’s degree, or PhD, with graduation expected in 2027. Relevant academic backgrounds include economics, engineering, finance, accounting, operations research, data science, and power systems;

• Typically three to five years of relevant professional experience before graduate study, or substantial applied research experience relevant to the energy industry;

• Demonstrated energy industry experience through professional roles, client engagements, or substantial applied research. Candidates should understand energy businesses, markets, infrastructure, or regulation and be able to connect that experience to the challenges our clients face;

• Ability to structure ambiguous problems, assess evidence, evaluate trade-offs, and develop practical recommendations;

• Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, including the ability to interpret data, critically assess assumptions, and connect findings to business decisions;

• Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex ideas to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge;

• Ability to take ownership of a workstream, exercise independent judgment, and manage priorities and deadlines; and

• A collaborative approach and the ability to guide junior colleagues, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to their development.

Additional experience in business strategy, performance improvement, investment analysis, transactions, regulatory proceedings, financial or power system modeling, optimization, data analytics, or programming is valuable. We assess these capabilities in the context of each candidate’s background and potential contribution to the team; modeling or programming experience is not required for every candidate.

To Apply

To be considered for a position in the United States, we require the following:

• Resume – please include personal email and telephone number;

• Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

If you are interested in applying for a position in Canada, please visit our Careers site to view and apply for available jobs.

Career Growth and Benefits

• CRA’s robust skills development programs, including both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with research and analysis skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.

• We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is fair, transparent, and people-focused.  While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience.  As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers.  To learn more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA, please read here.

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Salary and other compensation

A good-faith estimate of the annual base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $152,500. Starting salary within this range may vary based on factors such as education level, experience, skills, geographic location, market conditions, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position may be eligible for additional bonus incentive compensation.

CRA offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to eligibility requirements, which includes: medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; life and disability insurance; paid time off (vacation, sick leave, holidays); paid parental leave; wellness programs and employee assistance resources; and commuter benefits.

THE ROLE

As a Supply-Demand Planner at Pure Storage, you will orchestrate the end-to-end demand signal that powers our industry-leading enterprise data storage platforms. In close partnership with Product Management, Sales, Finance, and premier global manufacturing partners, you will transform volatile market dynamics into resilient supply strategies. Your ownership ensures our cutting-edge flash and compute hardware reaches customers seamlessly while driving operational agility, mitigating inventory exposure, and directly enabling Pure’s continued global expansion.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Demand Forecasting & Signal Integration: Synthesize multi-channel demand streams across Sales, Product Management, Finance, and key customer accounts to build an accurate master demand signal that directly steers procurement, builds schedules, and maximizes product availability.

• Supply Risk Mitigation & Lifecycle Strategy: Architect and execute inventory strategies to eliminate component shortages and prevent Excess & Obsolescence (E&O) exposure, leading smooth transitions across product lifecycles and critical component generations.

• Global Supplier Co-Planning & S&OP Leadership: Partner with key component suppliers, flash drive manufacturers, and server contract manufacturers on request-commit processes to secure supply commitments, while delivering executive-level forecast intelligence across monthly and quarterly Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) forums.

• Process Evolution & Scalability: Champion the adoption and optimization of advanced demand planning tools, data models, and automated workflows, scaling team planning capabilities and elevating forecasting precision as Pure expands.

• Hyperscale Hardware & Commodity Acumen: Deep technical and commercial understanding of hardware architectures and global commodity supply dynamics, including compute, storage, networking, and critical sub-assemblies (such as CPUs, NAND, DRAM, and PCIe/HBA cards).

• Advanced Data Modeling & Systems Proficiency: Demonstrated expertise utilizing enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, dedicated demand management platforms, and advanced analytical tools to translate complex datasets into actionable inventory strategies and reliable statistical forecasts.

• Cross-Functional Influence & Communication: Exceptional ability to align diverse cross-functional teams—including Sales, Finance, Product Management, and external executive vendor partners—translating complex supply chain data into clear business narratives and decisive S&OP recommendations.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

You'll turn buying signals into pipeline, replace manual work with automation, and build repeatable systems that drive revenue.


ABOUT STRELLA

Strella is reimagining market research with AI. Our platform conducts in-depth, AI-moderated interviews and transforms customer conversations into actionable insights in a fraction of the time of traditional research.

We’re building a new model for market research that combines the speed and scale of AI with the strategic expertise of world-class researchers. Our mission is to make high-quality customer understanding faster, more accessible, and more impactful for every business.

WHAT YOU’LL DO


BUILD SYSTEMS THAT TURN SIGNALS INTO PIPELINE

 - Automate prospecting: Build workflows for account enrichment, contact sourcing, scoring, and personalized outreach.

USE AI TO CREATE LEVERAGE ACROSS THE REVENUE LIFECYCLE

WHO YOU ARE

 - AI-native: You already use LLMs to automate your own work and are excited about what they can do for GTM.

 - A systems thinker: You turn messy, manual processes into clean, scalable workflows.

 - Fast-moving: You thrive in a startup where the motion is evolving in real time and are excited about building the plane as you fly it.

NICE TO HAVE

WHY STRELLA

jobs.title: Chief Program Officer at Schilit Hillel at University of Florida
jobs.description:
Chief Program Officer

Schilit Hillel at University of Florida

Role Overview

Transform student life for one of the largest campus Jewish communities in the country as the Chief Program Officer of Schilit Hillel at University of Florida.  The opportunities for Jewish life at the University of Florida are limitless, and you will play a central role in propelling Schilit Hillel forward. Driven by your dedication to excellence, passion for Jewish life, and commitment to developing talent, you will lead people and create opportunities that enrich lives and shape the future.

The University of Florida is a big place with big dreams, a sense of community that spans the globe and unites generations. At UF, our common bond has always been more than a rallying cry. It comes from a steadfast commitment to excellence, and the Jewish Gator Nation will look to you to develop strategies that inspire every Jewish student at the University of Florida to make an enduring commitment to Jewish life. You will articulate a compelling vision for Jewish engagement, implement a data-driven approach to maximize Schilit Hillel’s reach and impact, and ensure operational excellence across the organization. Engaging every Jewish student will become your mantra as you build and support a team of excellent, mission-driven professionals and passionate students to ensure vibrant, diverse Jewish life at the University of Florida.

What You’ll Do

• With the Executive Director and other senior staff, design and execute an engagement strategy to expand Hillel’s reach within the UF community and connect Jewish students to Hillel’s mission.

• Develop student leadership to ensure diverse opportunities, including community building, Jewish learning, Shabbat and holiday celebrations, social justice, Israel education, and engagement and advocacy.

• Supervise, mentor, and support the growth of 6 full-time professionals.

On a day to day basis you will

• Develop intentional relationships with students that help strengthen their Jewish identity and connection to Jewish life on campus

• Oversee a data-driven student engagement strategy to identify students, ensure timely and appropriate ongoing relationship building, and foster a culture of accountability

• Be a thought partner with the Executive Director, senior staff, and campus partners

• Build student leadership by identifying and cultivating student leaders, providing them with ongoing mentorship and support

• Design and implement curriculum for cohort fellowships, such as our First Year Fellowship

• Guide Schilit Hillel’s Israel education, engagement, and advocacy efforts, including one of the largest campus-based Israel travel programs in North America. Staff Israel travel programs and craft effective participant follow-through

• Lead weekly staff meetings and plan quarterly retreats in collaboration with senior leadership

• Manage the hiring and training of a growing team of program and engagement professionals

What You’ve Accomplished

• 7+ years in Jewish, experiential, or higher education. Bachelor’s degree required. Masters degree preferred

• Experience as a professional in a Jewish nonprofit organization is preferred

• Excellent supervision skills and ability to coach others to achieve outcomes, with experience hiring and managing a team

• Success creating structures and opportunities that assist and empower students to take initiative and ownership for their communities

• Developed and/or implemented a strategic plan, including reporting and tracking data

• Record of accomplishment managing multiple projects while maintaining exceptionally high quality and outcomes

What You’ll Bring to the Job

• Comfort in managing teams, as well as working independently and collaboratively

• Knowledge of what makes people tick - you can connect people’s passions and interests to Hillel’s mission

• An entrepreneurial spirit - things may not always go according to plan, but you understand that ambiguity is part of developing great new opportunities and are constantly striving to for excellence

• A commitment to pluralism and comfort with your Jewish identity so you may act as a role model and mentor for emerging Jewish adults

• Owning your unique Jewish knowledge and experiences and inspiring others to be on a Jewish journey

• Strong written and verbal skills, effective at communicating with a variety of stakeholders, including students, parents, alumnae/i, and university partners

• Attention to detail while managing multiple on-going projects

What You’ll Receive

• Competitive salary in the nonprofit marketplace. The salary range for this role is $90,000 - $110,000

• A comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plan, Life, AD&D and Long Term Disability (LTD) insurances, Flexible Spending accounts, generous vacation/sick time, and parental leave.

• Great professional development, mentoring, and skill building opportunities

• Travel regionally and abroad, particularly to Israel

About Schilit Hillel at University of Florida

With one of the largest Jewish student populations in the country, the opportunities for Jewish life at UF are nearly limitless, and Schilit Hillel at University of Florida strives to operate on a scale capable of meeting this challenge. Hillel provides Jewish students with community and connection through a relationship-focused approach that seeks to ensure every Jewish Gator feels welcome and celebrated. We work to build community and help students explore their identities.

Gainesville is a great place to live with all the offerings of a vibrant college town, including an excellent arts scene, first-class medical care and academic health system, SEC sports, and inspired local restaurants. Here, culture meets nature with eight state parks, featuring more than 100 miles of trails for biking and hiking, plus crystal-blue freshwater springs. The wide range of offerings, extremely high quality of life, and relatively low cost of living have made Gainesville an increasingly popular destination to live for people of all ages.

Schilit Hillel at University of Florida is affiliated with Hillel International. Hillel International enriches the lives of Jewish students so they may enrich the Jewish people and the world, and envisions a world where every student is inspired to make an enduring commitment to Jewish life, learning and Israel.

About Hillel International

In 1923, Rabbi Benjamin Frankel started Hillel with humble means, a noble mission and a breathtaking vision: to convey Jewish civilization to a new generation. Today, Hillel International continues to enrich the lives of Jewish students and is the largest Jewish campus organization in the world at nearly 1,000 colleges and universities across North America and around the world. As Hillel evolves as an organization, the mission remains steadfast: to create lasting connections with every Jewish student that foster an enduring commitment to Jewish life, learning, and Israel and train them to become the next Jewish leaders.

Hillel is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an accepting and inclusive environment for all.

jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Information Security team builds and operates the capabilities that protect our systems and data while enabling engineering teams to move quickly and responsibly. The team partners across Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Legal, IT, and Cloud Platform to reduce security risk, strengthen regulatory readiness, and make secure development easier to adopt at scale.

You’ll translate user, security, business, and regulatory needs into products that engineers choose to adopt and that deliver measurable improvements in security risk.

How you’ll make an impact

• Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for critical security capabilities, prioritizing investments based on user needs, risk impact, business value, and regulatory requirements.

• Partner with security engineers and engineering teams to translate pain points into clear requirements, scope MVPs, sequence releases, and make thoughtful build, buy, and retire decisions.

• Drive adoption of security products and workflows that fit naturally into how engineering teams work, using feedback, usage, accuracy, and risk-reduction metrics to measure success.

• Shape a connected AI-powered security platform spanning capabilities such as security reviews, continuous testing, vulnerability remediation, risk scoring, and reporting.

• Build regulatory and audit requirements into product design, including evidence, audit trails, metrics, and controls that support ongoing readiness.

• Communicate product strategy, investment tradeoffs, adoption, and measurable security outcomes to Information Security leadership and senior stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, plus 7 years of product management experience, including at least 3 years owning security, risk, developer-facing, or platform products.

• Experience owning complex technical products from product vision and roadmap development through requirements, launch, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.

• Experience partnering with engineering teams to define technical requirements, scope MVPs, prioritize roadmaps, and make build-versus-buy decisions.

• Experience with security domains such as vulnerability management, application security, cloud security, security automation, or remediation workflows.

• Experience defining and measuring product success using adoption, usage, quality, risk, or other quantitative product metrics.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building AI-powered products, AI-enabled developer tools, or products involving AI governance and model evaluation.

• Experience with developer tools, security platforms, or internal platform products used by engineering teams.

• Experience building products in banking, financial services, or another regulated environment, including support for regulatory examinations or audits.

• Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, SOC 2, or PCI DSS.Familiarity with security tooling such as ArmorCode, Wiz, Semgrep, SIEM platforms, or similar technologies.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

jobs.title: Principal Customer Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This position requires a hybrid work schedule with regular in-person attendance at our Menlo Park.

WHO WE ARE

Snowflake delivers the AI Data Cloud, a global network where thousands of organizations mobilize data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. Inside the AI Data Cloud, organizations unite their siloed data, easily discover and securely share governed data, and execute diverse analytic workloads. Wherever data or users live, Snowflake delivers a single and seamless experience across multiple public clouds. Snowflake's platform is the engine that powers and provides access to the AI Data Cloud, creating a solution for data warehousing, data lakes, data engineering, data science, data application development, and data sharing. Join Snowflake customers, partners, and data providers already taking their businesses to new frontiers in the AI Data Cloud. snowflake.com http://snowflake.com\


WHO YOU ARE
Snowflake is seeking a strategic, customer-obsessed Senior Manager, Customer Advocacy Programs to lead and scale Snowflake's flagship global advocacy programs, turning our most valued customers into powerful brand champions on the world's biggest stages.

You are the architect of Snowflake's most visible customer programs: iconic billboard campaigns, customer activations around LA28, our executive Customer Advisory Board (the Black Diamond Council), and Alpine Club, our premier co-marketing program for Snowflake's most strategic customers. At the same time, you are grounded in the fundamentals of customer marketing: identifying, recruiting, and nurturing the right customer voices, building durable advocacy, and translating customer outcomes into stories that create mutual value across the customer lifecycle. You see customer advocacy as a growth lever, not just a program, a way to deepen trust with strategic accounts, inform business and product strategy, and act as a true partner to Sales.

You thrive at the intersection of executive relationship management, program strategy, and creative ambition. You know how to earn the trust of a Fortune 500 CDO, design experiences executives want to be part of, navigate complex brand and legal approvals, and orchestrate a cross-functional team from concept through launch. You are equally comfortable facilitating a room of senior technology leaders and in a working session with a creative agency, and you operate with a bias toward bold ideas, a high tolerance for ambiguity, and a deep commitment to making the customer the hero.

This role reports to the Director of Customer Marketing and partners closely with Brand, Creative, Media, Events, PR, Product Marketing, Social, Web, and Sales teams, as well as Snowflake's external agency partners.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the strategy and end-to-end execution of Snowflake's customer advocacy programs, including billboard activations, LA28 customer activation, the Black Diamond Council, and Alpine Club

 - Lead billboard strategy and activation, identifying customer stories through creative development, customer approvals, media placement, launch, and amplification

 - Develop and execute Snowflake's LA28 customer activation strategy, designing differentiated experiences and storytelling moments that engage strategic customers and showcase their innovation

 - Lead engagement and strategic programming for the Black Diamond Council, Snowflake's executive-level Customer Advisory Board, including in-person meetings, virtual sessions, member communications, and recruitment

 - Translate Black Diamond Council insights into actionable recommendations that inform Snowflake's business, product, and marketing strategy

 - Oversee Alpine Club strategy, planning, and execution, recognizing and elevating Snowflake's most strategic customers through long-term, multi-faceted brand partnerships

 - Build program frameworks, activation calendars, and repeatable processes that ensure consistency, quality, and impact across all advocacy programs and regions

 - Put the customer first by building trusted, long-term relationships with senior executives at Snowflake's top customers and creating experiences and stories that deliver mutual value

 - Serve as a strategic partner to Sales, using high-visibility programs and executive engagement to strengthen relationships with strategic accounts and support retention, expansion, and growth

 - Serve as the central orchestrator across Brand, Creative, Media, Events, PR, Product Marketing, Social, and Web, owning timelines, dependencies, budgets, and launch readiness

 - Track, analyze, and report on program performance and impact; deliver regular program updates to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
   
   

WHAT YOU’LL HAVE

 - A customer-obsessed mindset with an instinct for the stories and experiences that move markets - and the patience and persistence to bring them to life

 - Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior executives, including CIOs, CDOs, and communications leads, at enterprise-scale organizations

 - Strong understanding of the customer lifecycle and the role customer marketing and advocacy play across acquisition, expansion, and retention

 - Deep experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder advocacy programs, executive programs, or integrated campaigns from strategy through launch

 - Exceptional program and project management skills, with the ability to run multiple high-visibility programs and orchestrate cross-functional teams simultaneously

 - Strong strategic judgment - you know which customers, stories, and moments are ready to go big, and you know how to get them there

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to executives both internally and externally

 - Experience managing agency and vendor relationships and budgets, and translating creative feedback effectively

 - Highly organized, self-directed, and effective operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
   
   

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EDUCATION

 - 8+ years of experience in customer marketing, customer advocacy, executive programs, or integrated campaign management in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology

 - Experience building and running a Customer Advisory Board or executive community program for senior technology leaders

 - A track record of delivering high-profile brand moments, such as billboard and out-of-home campaigns, major sporting event or sponsorship activations, and marquee event programs featuring recognizable customer brands

 - Familiarity with corporate communications dynamics and the sensitivities of co-marketing with publicly traded or privacy-conscious enterprise brands

 - Ability to influence senior stakeholders with confidence and credibility

 - Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field

 - Experience with Google Suite, Salesforce, Tableau, and Wrike



LET’S DO THIS!

The Snowflake Customer Marketing team is a small, tight-knit, dynamic group responsible for building and maintaining customer relationships to drive retention, loyalty, and advocacy. These programs represent the pinnacle of that work - putting Snowflake's most strategic customers at the center of our most iconic moments, from billboards to LA28 to the executive boardroom. We're looking for someone who wants to build something, not just manage it. If you want to shape the stories that define how the world sees the AI Data Cloud, we want to hear from you.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee’s duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.

As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

Please note: the level of the role will be determined by Nava leadership based on experience and skillset.

Position summary

Nava is at the forefront of reimagining how our government serves its people, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive our vision forward.

You'll help us execute our mission of reimagining the digital services our government provides. Working directly with government partners and across Nava’s engineering, design, and business teams, you’ll create experiences that improve the lives of millions of Americans. You care deeply about end users and are passionate about crafting simple and usable solutions.

You'll work with government partners and cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, and project managers to set direction, scope product features, remove obstacles and barriers, and assess the business impact on a government contract.

You will be uniquely positioned and empowered to make a huge impact on Nava's mission to reimagine how our government serves its people.

You think holistically and take pride in working through highly ambiguous situations to deliver value to users. You have a strong bias towards action when faced with incomplete information and communicate transparently to build consensus internally and externally.

What you'll do

• Define the vision, goals, and measures of success for the products and services you manage

• Work with designers, business analysts, and technical leads to discover and synthesize market research, user needs, business requirements, and technical approaches

• Define the direction, scope, and priority of projects, from high-level initiatives to specific features, user stories, and business metrics

• Work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and ship projects

• Proactively socialize, iterate on, and build buy-in for product initiatives with the team, government partners, and other contractors

• Collaborate with the project management team to prioritize roadmaps and inbound units of work

• Represent Nava’s outcome-centric and user-centric approach in discovery meetings with agencies and contractors

• Understand and communicate the needs of end users and population segments we serve and government partners we work with

• Measure product progress toward business goals or user needs and translate data insights into action

• Make tactical decisions to improve the design, define requirements, and generate stakeholder buy-in for our desired path forward

Required skills

• At least 10 years of experience as a Product Manager of a cross-functional team

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

• Experience running and/or shipping consumer web applications

• Ability to generate very strong product plans and build buy-in across the team, our government partners, and other contractors

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical, user experience, and project management trade-offs; enthusiastic communicator

• Strong bias towards action; ability to step up into team gaps and ambiguous situations to structure the team’s action plan

• Ability to execute with incomplete information; great product instincts and an ability to create order from divergent needs

• Ability to define a product objective and logically reverse engineer the path and communications to achieve the objective

• Ability to identify market trends and shifts that will affect product direction and update plans based on future expectations

• An adaptive, empathetic, collaborative, and positive mindset

Compensation

$98,000—$153,000 USD

Other requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:

Legal authorization to work in the United States

Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired

Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future

May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

Perks working with Nava

Health coverage — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your overall health needs

Insurance coverage — Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost

Time off — vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge

Company holidays — enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO

Annual bonus — when Nava meets its goals, eligible employees receive a performance-based annual bonus

Parental leave — paid time off for new parents, plus weekly meals delivered to your home

Wellness program — full platform offering physical, mental, & emotional health resources & support tools

Virtual care — see doctors online with no copay through a virtual visit program (depending on available providers)

Sabbatical leave — earn extended unpaid leave after continuous service for personal growth or rest

401(k) match — Nava matches 4% of your salary to support your retirement savings plan

Flexible work — remote-first environment with flexibility built around your schedule and responsibilities

Home office setup — company laptop & setup assistance provided via Staples for remote work needs

Utility support — monthly reimbursement to help offset eligible home office utility expenses

Learning opportunities — internal training programs and resources to help grow your professional skills

Development opportunities — LinkedIn Learning access & an annual allowance for courses, tuition, & certs

Referral bonus — get rewarded when you refer great people who join the Nava team

Commuter benefits — pre-tax commuter programs to support in-office travel when applicable

Supportive culture — A collaborative and remote-friendly team environment where people genuinely care

Location

We have fully remote options if you reside in one of the following states:

Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, DC, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin

*If you are not living in one of the states listed above, unfortunately, you will not be considered for a position at this time.

Stay in touch

Sign up for our newsletter to find out about career opportunities, new partnerships, and news from the broader civic tech community.

Please contact the recruiting team at recruiting@navapbc.com if you would like to request any form of reasonable accommodation during the application or interviewing process.

We participate in E-Verify. Upon hire, we will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. This role requires you to work from the contiguous United States.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Nava is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, gender and/or gender identity or expression, color, creed, religion, religious creed, age, national origin, ethnicity, disability, veteran or military status, sex, sexual orientation, reproductive health autonomy, pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth, genetic information, domestic violence victim status, marital status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Nava prohibits any such discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all employees, applicants, contractors, and temporary workers of Nava.
