jobs.title: Deal Desk Analyst
jobs.description:
Alloy is where you belong!

Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces, Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers, Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker, year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here.

About the team

Revenue Operations is a small team with outsized reach. Deal Desk is the part of RevOps closest to the deal: we help reps structure pricing, build quotes, and move contracts through approval so they can close faster without giving away margin. As Alloy sells into more banks, credit unions, fintechs, and channel partners, more deals come through the desk every quarter, and they're getting more varied. This role reports to the Senior Revenue Operations Manager, Deal Desk, and will be the second person on the desk.

Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.

What you'll be doing

You'll be the first stop for reps working through the mechanics of a deal: building and checking quotes, keeping the approval queue moving, and making sure what gets signed is what gets booked and billed. It's a high-volume, detail-heavy seat with a front-row view of how Alloy prices, packages, and contracts, and a lot of room to make the process better as you learn it.

• Build and review quotes from Salesforce CPQ all the way through the Ironclad workflow process, checking that products, pricing, terms, and opportunity setup (new business, renewal, amendment, upsell, channel) are correct before they move forward.

• Work the twice-daily Ironclad approval queue alongside Legal and Accounting, reviewing order forms against our standard terms and Deal Desk Levers and flagging anything non-standard.

• Support the triage of incoming requests in Deal Desk, Ironclad, and the Rev Ops Help queues, confirm each one has the context needed for review, and route it to the right person.

• Manage first-pass pricing using our pricing calculator and guidelines, so senior Deal Desk time goes to large and novel deals.

• Partner with our Systems and Salesforce admins to improve CPQ and quoting workflows: flag where reps get stuck, document requirements for fixes and enhancements, test changes before they go live, and update guides once they ship.

• Review closed-won contracts for booking accuracy (ACV, CARR, term, billing frequency, uplifts) and keep the bookings tracker current.

• Pull weekly reporting on deals in flight, request volume, turnaround time, and discount and approval trends.

• Help maintain CPQ, Ironclad, and Deal Desk process, and turn repeat questions into documentation (CPQ Handbook)

Who we’re looking for

Must-haves:

• 1-3 years in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Order Management, or a similar analytical role supporting a sales team.

• Hands on Salesforce experience with opportunities, quotes, and reports.

• Salesforce CPQ (or similar) experience.

• Interest in automating manual deal desk work.

• Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

• Sharp attention to detail, with a habit of catching the wrong date or mismatched number before it reaches a customer.

• Comfort working a queue: many requests at once, prioritized by deadline, with people kept informed along the way.

• Clear, direct written communication, including explaining a policy to a rep or saying "not yet" without creating friction.

• Curiosity about how deals work, from pricing and contract terms to how they flow into bookings and billing.

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience with Ironclad or another contract lifecycle management tool.

• Experience gathering requirements or testing changes for a CRM or quoting tool.

• Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or financial services.

• Familiarity with SaaS metrics and deal terms such as ARR, CARR, usage-based pricing, ramps, and multi-year uplifts.

• Exposure to order forms, billing, or revenue recognition basics (ASC 606).

• Familiarity with SQL.

Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!

This position has a salary range of $80,000 to $100,000.

Benefits and Perks

• Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy

• Employee stock options

• Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options

• 401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation

• Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave

• Home office stipend for new employees

• Annual Learning & Development annual stipend

• Well-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, UrbanSitter, and Spring Health

• Hybrid work environment: employees are expected to work Tuesdays through Thursdays from our HQ in Union Square, Manhattan. Tasty lunches catered from a variety of local restaurants and frequent employee-organized cultural events contribute to our positive office energy. On Monday/Friday most employees Zoom into work from home while some take advantage of the quieter office.

How to apply

Apply right here! You've found the application!

Alloy is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and employer. We’re committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience and provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with visible and invisible disabilities. We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.

All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an alloy.com email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you’re ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.

jobs.title: Transportation Engineer - Traffic & Technology
jobs.description:
Company Description

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description

Olsson’s Traffic & Technology team offers comprehensive traffic services, including traffic operation studies, pedestrian circulation studies, and intersection improvement/design projects. We specialize in traffic signal design and timing, pavement marking design, street lighting analysis, and Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS). Our expertise also extends to complex projects like citywide safety studies and signal system improvements. Through our work, we enhance transportation infrastructure and positively impact the communities we serve.

As a Traffic Engineer, you will perform traffic studies, prepare design plans, and contribute to the delivery of a wide variety of transportation projects. We are open to professionals at multiple experience levels and are specifically targeting candidates with approximately 3 to 8 years of relevant experience. The responsibilities and level of ownership for this position will be tailored based on the selected candidate’s experience and expertise.

You will design traffic signals, roundabouts, pavement markings, signing, temporary traffic control, and facilities for vehicular and multimodal users. Additionally, you will evaluate the safety and operational performance of transportation systems, analyze traffic data, and develop recommendations that enhance mobility and roadway safety.

In this role, you will collaborate with project managers, clients, and multidisciplinary teams while taking on increasing ownership of project tasks, technical analyses, and design decisions based on your experience level. You will apply sound engineering judgment and continue developing your expertise in traffic operations, safety, transportation technology, and Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS).

We have one current opening and will consider candidates interested in being located out of our Lincoln, NE or Omaha, NE office locations.

Qualifications

You are passionate about:

• Working collaboratively with others.

• Having ownership in the work you do.

• Using your talents to positively affect communities.

You bring to the team:

• Strong communication skills.

• Ability to contribute and work effectively as part of a team.

• Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering.

• 3–8 years of experience in traffic and/or transportation engineering.

• Successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam and Engineer Intern (EI/EIT) certification required.

• Professional Engineer (PE) licensure is welcomed but not required.

• Proficiency with AutoCAD or similar design software.

• Familiarity with Synchro preferred, but not required.

• Working knowledge of the Highway Capacity Manual (HCM) and its application to traffic operations and capacity analyses.

#LI-IC1

Additional Information

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

As an Olsson employee, you will:

• Receive a competitive 401(k) match

• Be empowered to build your career with tailored development paths

• Have the possibility for flexible work arrangements

• Engage in work that has a positive impact on communities

• Participate in a wellness program promoting balanced lifestyles

In addition, full-time employees will receive our traditional benefits package (health care, vision, dental, paid time off, etc.) and the opportunity to participate in a bonus system that rewards performance.

Olsson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage qualified minority, female, veteran, and disabled candidates to apply and be considered for open positions. We do not discriminate against any applicant for employment or any employee because of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender, disability, age, military status, or other protected status.

Olsson understands the importance of privacy and is committed to protecting job applicants’ personal information. Pursuant to the California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (collectively, the “CCPA”), this notice explains Olsson’s practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information for job applicants residing in California. Please read this Notice carefully to understand our privacy practices.

For more information about the types of information we collect and how we use it in connection with your general access and use of our website, please review our general California Privacy Notice here.

jobs.title: Driver, 2nd Shift, Site 3
jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

This position is based in our satellite production facility in Midland, TX.

AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

AST SpaceMobile is seeking a Driver to support manufacturing and warehouse operations by safely receiving, transporting, storing, staging, and delivering materials throughout the production environment. This position is responsible for maintaining material flow, inventory accuracy, and warehouse organization to ensure uninterrupted production operations. The Driver works closely with Production Control, Warehouse, Inventory Control, and Production teams to ensure materials are available where and when needed.

Base Pay is $20

Shift Schedules

• 1st Shift – Days: Monday–Thursday, 7:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. (4x10 schedule)

What You'll Do:

• Safely operate a company box truck to transport materials, parts, and equipment between facilities, warehouses, and production areas.

• Perform pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections, including checking fluid levels, tire condition, lights, and overall vehicle readiness.

• Report vehicle issues, safety concerns, accidents, or maintenance needs promptly to management.

• Load, unload, secure, and transport materials safely to prevent damage during transit.

• Verify shipments, delivery documentation, quantities, and material identification for accuracy.

• Receive, store, stage, and deliver materials to designated warehouse and production locations.

• Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment safely and efficiently.

• Accurately identify materials, part numbers, lot numbers, and inventory locations.

• Perform material transfers and inventory transactions using warehouse and inventory management systems.

• Support production operations by ensuring materials are delivered according to production schedules and priorities.

• Coordinate with Warehouse, Production Control, Shipping, and Receiving teams regarding material needs and delivery schedules.

• Communicate delivery status, delays, shortages, damaged materials, or other concerns to supervisors.

• Assist with receiving, shipping, packaging, kitting, and general warehouse operations as needed.

• Perform cycle counts and support inventory audits to maintain inventory accuracy.

• Maintain vehicle cleanliness and ensure assigned equipment remains in safe operating condition.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

• Follow all company policies, quality requirements, DOT regulations (as applicable), and safety procedures.

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Minimum of one (1) year of experience operating box trucks, delivery vehicles, warehouse equipment, or material handling equipment preferred.

• Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record required.

• Forklift certification required or ability to obtain certification.

• Experience loading, unloading, securing, and transporting materials safely.

• Ability to perform vehicle inspections and monitor basic fluid levels and vehicle condition.

• Basic understanding of commercial vehicle operations; familiarity with vehicle maintenance concepts is a plus.

• Experience operating forklifts, pallet jacks, or other warehouse equipment.

• Basic computer skills and experience with inventory, warehouse, ERP, or scanning systems preferred.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivery and inventory accuracy.

• Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.

• Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.

• Ability to safely lift and move materials as required.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Must be authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Previous experience as a box truck driver, delivery driver, material handler, warehouse associate, or logistics team member.

• Experience in manufacturing, aerospace, warehouse, shipping and receiving, or logistics environments.

• Experience using ERP, WMS, MRP, or inventory control systems.

• Knowledge of inventory control, warehouse operations, and material flow best practices.

• Experience supporting production or manufacturing operations.

• DOT compliance and safe driving experience preferred.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment:

• Ability to work in a manufacturing and warehouse environment with frequent standing, walking, and movement throughout the shift.

• Ability to sit, stand, and/or walk for extended periods of time.

• Ability to use hands and fingers to perform repetitive tasks, data entry, and computer work.

• Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, squat, climb, reach, and balance as required to perform job duties.

• Ability to lift, push, pull, and/or carry items weighing up to 35 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

• Ability to work in, on, around, and in proximity to machinery, equipment, material handling devices, and production tooling.

• Ability to work near moving mechanical parts and equipment.

• Ability to visually inspect materials, inventory labels, documentation, and production information.

• Ability to communicate effectively, including talking and hearing.

• Ability to work in environments that may include exposure to noise, dust, fumes, airborne particles, and varying temperatures.

• Ability to follow all company safety procedures and wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).

If you are open to relocating to Midland, this can be a career changing, and life changing, move into the high-tech aerospace world offering a new skill set and job security in a very similar environment that will soon feel like home. We encourage you to apply to learn more about AST SpaceMobile and what Midland has to offer.

This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands.

AST SpaceMobile is an Equal Opportunity, at will Employer; employment is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
jobs.description:
Come Join Us!

From apartments in New York to hospitals and stadiums in Dallas, libraries at prestigious universities to creating modern retail experiences, our teams contribute architectural glass and building products to projects that shape the way people live, work, heal, learn, and play. At OBE, the work of our employees truly matters. With over 6,500 employees, we operate more than 80 manufacturing and distribution facilities in five countries. You can see some of our favorite projects here.

Start your journey with OBE and help us build the future.

Senior Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Position Summary

We are seeking a strategic and analytical Senior Manager, FP&A to lead financial planning, forecasting, and business performance analysis across the organization. This role serves as a key business partner to operational and executive leadership, providing data-driven insights that support decision-making, profitability improvement, and long-term strategic initiatives.

The ideal candidate will possess strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities, experience supporting manufacturing and distribution operations, and a proven ability to influence business decisions through financial leadership. This position will play a critical role in budgeting, forecasting, reporting, capital planning, and evaluating growth opportunities across a multi-site environment.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

• Lead the annual budgeting process and periodic forecasting cycles across multiple business units and operating locations.

• Develop and maintain financial models to support business planning, investment decisions, capital allocation, and strategic initiatives.

• Analyze financial performance and provide actionable recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.

• Drive long-range planning activities and support organizational growth objectives.

Financial Analysis & Reporting

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial analyses, including variance reporting and trend analysis.

• Develop and maintain executive dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and management reporting packages.

• Monitor business performance and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and emerging trends.

• Partner with senior leadership to evaluate financial results and support decision-making.

Business Partnership

• Collaborate with operational leaders to understand business drivers and provide financial guidance.

• Support pricing, margin enhancement, productivity, and cost-reduction initiatives.

• Present financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

• Serve as a trusted advisor by translating complex financial information into meaningful business recommendations.

Strategic Initiatives

• Support acquisition due diligence, integration activities, and post-acquisition performance analysis.

• Conduct scenario analyses and business case development for strategic investments and growth initiatives.

• Participate in special projects that support organizational priorities and continuous improvement efforts.

Systems & Process Improvement

• Support financial systems, reporting tools, and ERP optimization initiatives.

• Identify opportunities to improve forecasting accuracy, reporting efficiency, and planning processes.

• Assist in the development and implementation of best practices across FP&A functions.

• Ensure compliance with GAAP, financial policies, and internal controls.

Qualifications

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field required.

• MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant professional designation preferred.

Experience

• 8-12 years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, or related financial leadership roles.

• Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial, building products, or wholesale distribution environments strongly preferred.

• Proven experience leading budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and business analysis activities.

• Experience supporting multi-site operations and partnering directly with operational leadership preferred.

• Experience with mergers and acquisitions, business integration, and strategic planning is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and performance measurement.

• Ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.

• Expertise in variance analysis, KPI development, profitability analysis, and executive reporting.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial planning tools.

• Experience working with ERP systems and business intelligence/reporting platforms.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence both financial and non-financial stakeholders.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated leadership, collaboration, and problem-solving capabilities.

What OBE Offers You

• Benefits that benefit you – industry competitive benefits at the lowest cost to the employee

• Work-life balance – PTO and holidays, including floating holidays you can choose

• Compensation that rewards your hard work – A pay-for-performance culture with potential for annual raises and bonuses

• Training – We will equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed

OBE Privacy Policy

OBE will not discharge or discriminate against employees or applicants for discussing, disclosing, or inquiring about their own or others' pay.

Job Description:

Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal, reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões.

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

Por que essa vaga é afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência?

O Grupo QuintoAndar está comprometido com a promoção da Inclusão Social e um dos pilares é a representatividade em nossos times. Acreditamos que através da geração de mais oportunidades e de ações intencionais, avançaremos na construção e fortalecimento da inclusão social em nosso ambiente.

Vale ressaltar que para essa vaga o nosso processo seletivo não sofreu alterações de etapas ou formas de avaliação. Entendemos que o recrutamento é uma porta de entrada para a diversidade, sempre atentos ao que nos torna plurais.

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

• 100% Remoto Nosso time de Supply Photos atua no modelo 100% remoto, com a flexibilidade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do país (visitas pontuais ao escritório de São Paulo para residentes na região).

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

O time de Supply Photos é responsável por garantir a eficiência e conversão escalável do funil nacional de suprimentos fotográficos, gerenciando entre 25.000 e 30.000 oportunidades por mês, cerca de 500 fotógrafos parceiros (PJ) e 60 terceirizados de BPO. Drug Substance Engineering Internship Overview

Envision spending your summer working with energetic colleagues and inspirational leaders, all while gaining world-class experience in one of the most dynamic organizations in the pharmaceutical industry. This is a reality for AbbVie Interns.

Micronization of drug substance is a critical process in API manufacturing for ensuring downstream critical quality attributes. Micronization processes such as pin milling and jet milling leverage feed rate control to optimize the process performance, and while feed rate is well understood for many powder systems there is a gap in understanding the feed rate control of poorly flowing materials in micronization techniques.

The Drug Substance Engineering Intern within Product Development, Science, and Technology (PDS&T) will help establish a systematic approach to understand how the physical properties of powder systems impact their feeding performance in micronization processes.

Key responsibilities include:

• Experimental studies to understand and characterize powder properties
• Evaluate performance of micronization techniques (i.e. jet mill, pin mill) with various feed mechanisms
• Analyze data and trends to identify signatures for process performance
• Develop and verify computational models

jobs.title: Market Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.




ROLE PURPOSE

Neko is opening clinics at pace: from a handful of US sites today to a 2028 cohort in the dozens and a portfolio in the hundreds by 2030. We are looking for a flexible, quantitative analyst to build the market intelligence behind that growth, using GIS, data, and analytics to decide where we open next, why, and how many clinics a market can support. The work runs from market sizing and member analytics through to site, market, and portfolio performance.

This is a build role. Neko is appointment-based, not footfall-driven, so the standard retail playbook does not transfer, and working out what predicts a successful clinic is the core problem. There is no framework to inherit: you will build the models and processes from scratch, and what you build in year one is what the whole portfolio runs on.

You will report to the Head of US Real Estate and work closely with the Transaction Managers, the Real Estate Associates, and our data analytics and engineering teams, in a small team where you help set the standard.




WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER IN THE FIRST 6-12 MONTHS

 - Market sizing: size the addressable member base by market and trade area, and translate it into how many clinics a market can support and in what order we should enter. This is the first priority of the role.

 - Site selection support: give Real Estate the analysis to justify new markets and infill locations, and to decide clinic sizing and spacing, including overlap and cannibalization as density increases.

 - Member data foundation: work with the internal data analytics and engineering teams to set up the full chain, from data collection to aggregation to analysis. Define our ideal member profile, find where those members live and work, and keep refining it as first-party data accumulates.

 - GIS platform, tool agnostic: use GrowthFactor today and own the catchment definitions, data layers, and scoring logic. Document the logic independently of the tool so it moves with us, and help evaluate and onboard the next platform when the time comes. Make the tool usable by Transaction Managers, not only by you.

 - Scoring and forecasting models: maintain a repeatable, defensible site scoring model and demand forecasts built to be re-run. A reforecast after a slipped opening or a shifted plan should be a scenario switch, not a rebuild.

 - Portfolio, market, and site performance: as clinics open, track and review performance at the portfolio, market, and site level. Compare forecast to actual, separate a bad site from a bad market from a bad launch, surface underperformers early, and document what each opening teaches us. Turn those learnings into updated site selection criteria, scoring weights, and sizing and spacing rules, so every new clinic is chosen with better information than the last.

 - Approval memos and cross-functional support: help produce LOI and Lease Approval Memos by coordinating inputs from Real Estate, Design, Construction, and Legal into a clear, one-page recommendation that leadership can decide from.

 - Process design and redesign: own the evaluation processes the team runs on, and version them. Retire what stops working, rebuild what needs it, and write it down so others can run it without you.

 - AI across the Real Estate team: use Claude and custom agents to eliminate your own manual work, then go further. Identify where AI can save broader team time (market research, data pulls, memo drafting, lease and LOI summaries, pipeline reporting), build reusable prompts, skills, and agents, train teammates to use them, and track the time saved. Be honest about where AI output needs human review.

 - Market packs and benchmarks: produce market entry recommendations, ranked pipeline views, and site-level briefs, backed by per-site cost and occupancy benchmarks by market so deal comparison sits on real data.
   
   


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3 to 6 years in market analytics, site selection, location intelligence, data science, or strategy, ideally supporting multi-site physical expansion.

 - Hands-on GIS experience with GrowthFactor, Esri ArcGIS, Kalibrate, Buxton, SiteZeus, Placer, or similar. We care more that you understand catchment and scoring logic than that you know any one tool, because the tool will change.

 - Strong market sizing and quantitative skills: penetration and capture modeling, regression or other predictive approaches, and scenario and sensitivity analysis. Excel to a high standard.

 - Comfort with census, consumer spend, mobility, and first-party data, and honesty about the limits of each.

 - Financial literacy: you can build a basic site pro forma, calculate payback and break-even, and connect a demand forecast to a real estate decision.

 - Flexibility. You can tear down your own model without ego, rebuild it when the facts change, and stay organized while priorities shift.

 - Clear communication and intellectual honesty. You can defend an assumption to a skeptical executive in two minutes, name the two things most likely to be wrong, and say early when the data does not support the answer people want.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - SQL or Python, which helps you work alongside engineers.

 - Specific, demonstrable use of AI to speed up analytical work, and real interest in teaching others to do the same.

 - Exposure to healthcare or regulated markets, or to European or multi-region expansion.

jobs.title: Director, Commercialization
jobs.description:
Our Story

Launched in 2015, Sol de Janeiro is a globally recognized, award-winning beauty brand, drawing inspiration from Brazil’s beauty rituals, warmth, and spirit. Sol de Janeiro delivers a sensory experience beloved by multi-generational consumers worldwide, with clinically proven results, transformative textures, and transportive fragrances.

Headquartered in New York and launched as a digitally native brand, we have expanded globally with teams in Paris, London, and Germany. Our commitment to excellence has earned high-profile honors, including being named one of TIME100’s 2024 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s 2024 World's Most Innovative Companies, and WWD Beauty Inc’s Power Brands of 2024, underscoring its leadership in the beauty industry and outstanding workplace. These accolades highlight our dedication to being a leading brand in the beauty industry and an exceptional workplace.

What You’ll Do

The Director of Commercialization is responsible for leading commercialization strategy, governance, and cross-functional execution for the portfolio.

This role serves as the central business and operational leader across Product & Innovation, Marketing, Product Development, Packaging Engineering, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Commercial, and market teams.

The Director ensures initiatives move from concept through commercialization readiness with clear priorities, timelines,  decision-making, risk management, and cross-functional accountability. The role balances speed, technical and operational complexity, resource capacity, regulatory requirements, and business priorities across a dynamic portfolio.

This position reports into the Supply Chain organization and plays a key role in strengthening scalable commercialization capabilities as the business continues to grow.

What You’ll Be Working On

Portfolio Leadership

• Lead commercialization strategy and execution for the portfolio, including new product launches, product extensions, reformulations, renovations, and other portfolio initiatives.

• Own portfolio-level visibility across priorities, timing, risks, resource requirements, dependencies, and critical business decisions.

• Ensure projects are aligned with established business objectives, launch expectations, and operational realities.

• Provide strategic direction to project teams and ensure clear ownership, accountability, and follow-through.

• Anticipate and partner with supply teams to resolve risks that may affect launch timing, production, inventory availability, retailer commitments, cost, or revenue.

• Partner with leadership on portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, and business trade-off decisions.

Global Leadership

• Lead commercialization planning and governance for new market and regional expansion initiatives.

• Coordinate cross-functional readiness across Regulatory, Product Development, Packaging Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Finance, Commercial, and regional teams.

• Ensure market-specific requirements, operational dependencies, localization needs, regulatory options, and supply considerations are reflected in project plans and decisions.

• Establish clear timelines, milestones, ownership, and escalation paths for market entry programs.

• Maintain visibility to market entry risks, dependencies, decisions, and readiness status.

• Drive alignment between global launch priorities and regional market requirements.

Commercialization Governance & Stage Gates

• Lead commercialization governance from concept through Commercialization Readiness.

• Own and facilitate strategic launch meetings, portfolio reviews, stage gates, and readiness reviews for the assigned portfolio.

• Ensure stage-gate criteria, approvals, and business decisions are clearly defined, documented, and completed before projects progress.

• Establish clear governance around risks, assumptions, dependencies, mitigation plans, and unresolved decisions.

• Drive timely issue resolution through stakeholder alignment, action ownership, and appropriate escalation.

• Ensure consistent execution of commercialization standards and governance processes across all portfolio initiatives.

Integrated Portfolio & Timeline Management

• Oversee integrated cross-functional commercialization timelines for multiple concurrent initiatives.

• Ensure timelines accurately reflect technical development, regulatory, sourcing, manufacturing, financial, and regional market requirements.

• Maintain visibility to critical-path activities, milestones, project interdependencies, and portfolio-level risks.

• Create clear communication and reporting that provide leadership with an accurate view of timing, readiness, and required decisions.

• Hold teams accountable for commitments while proactively addressing changing priorities, project redirects, and emerging risks.

• Ensure business priorities and resource capacity remain aligned across the portfolio.

Commercialization Readiness & Operational Handoff

• Lead cross-functional readiness activities through Commercialization Readiness and applicable launch authorization reviews.

• Ensure technical, operational, regulatory, sourcing, and financial requirements are achieved before projects progress.

• Confirm commercialization deliverables, approvals, and prerequisites are complete before operational ownership transitions to Supply Planning.

• Partner with Supply Planning and Manufacturing to ensure capacity, lead times, production requirements, and operational constraints are reflected in commercialization decisions.

• Maintain visibility and communication continuity through operational execution and launch stabilization.

• Escalate readiness gaps that may place launch timing, service, inventory, or commercial commitments at risk.

Continuous Improvement & Capability Building

• Lead continuous improvement across commercialization governance, tools, processes, reporting, and cross-functional ways of working.

• Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve execution speed, and remove unnecessary complexity.

• Strengthen stage-gate requirements, readiness criteria, portfolio reporting, and decision-making frameworks.

• Establish consistent commercialization methodologies, templates, and standards.

• Improve transparency, accountability, and communication across cross-functional teams.

• Use portfolio insights, recurring risks, and lessons learned to identify systemic improvement opportunities.

• Partner with functional leaders to implement sustainable solutions rather than project-by-project workarounds.

• Build scalable commercialization capabilities that support business growth and increasing portfolio complexity.

• Drive adoption of new processes and ensure improvements are embedded into day-to-day ways of working.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Serve as the senior commercialization partner for all portfolio initiatives.

• Build strong partnerships across Marketing, Product Development, Packaging Engineering, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Commercial, and regional teams.

• Align stakeholders around shared priorities, execution plans, and business outcomes.

• Influence decisions across multiple organizational levels without relying solely on direct authority.

• Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, operational rigor, and proactive risk management.

• Provide leadership and guidance to project managers supporting the assigned portfolio.

Must Haves

• 10+ years of experience in commercialization, new product development, program management, project management, product innovation, supply chain, or a related cross-functional leadership role.

• Significant experience leading complex product commercialization programs within beauty, cosmetics, personal care, consumer products, or a related industry.

• Demonstrated experience managing a significant portfolio of concurrent global initiatives.

• Strong understanding of the end-to-end product lifecycle, from concept through commercialization readiness, operational execution, and launch stabilization.

• Experience leading commercialization governance, integrated timelines, stage gates, and readiness reviews.

• Demonstrated experience with global market expansion and coordination across international or regional stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of product development, regulatory, sourcing, manufacturing, supply chain, and commercialization dependencies.

• Proven experience driving process improvement, organizational change, and scalable ways of working.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to assess operational, financial, and strategic trade-offs.

• Strong executive communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

• Demonstrated ability to anticipate risks, navigate ambiguity, and drive decisions in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to balance strategic portfolio leadership with detailed operational execution.

• Strong proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and web-based project or portfolio management tools.

#LI-hybrid

Salary Range

$150,000—$175,000 USD

Why Sol de Janeiro?

• Competitive salary and bonus program for full-time team members

• Flexible hybrid work environment with opportunities for collaboration and growth

• Inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and celebrates individuality

• The chance to be part of a fast-growing, award-winning global beauty brand

jobs.description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

Read our blog to learn more.

About the role...

We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Lead to own paid user growth at Duolingo. You’ll help lead the strategy and team that bring new learners to Duolingo across 100+ markets and multiple products, including language, chess, and math. You’ll be accountable for growing high quality new users efficiently and proving the impact of that spend. You’ll partner with the Performance Marketing leadership team to shape where we invest next.

🧠  You will...

• Own Duolingo’s paid user growth goals, setting the strategy for acquiring new users who stay and learn.

• Lead and develop a team of performance marketers, setting a high bar for craft, rigor, and ownership.

• Run user acquisition across platforms such as Google UAC, Meta, TikTok, AppLovin, and programmatic partners, plus channels in China. You’ll decide where to scale, hold, or pull back as efficiency changes.

• Measure what user growth spend actually drives, using incrementality testing, saturation analysis, and new user quality metrics such as retention.

• Build creative testing at scale with agency, creator, UGC, and in house partners, and use results to shape what gets made next.

• Manage and hold agency and ad tech partners accountable for goals, pacing, and quality of execution.

• Flex spend with the organic calendar, partnering with Social, Brand, and Country Marketing around product launches, seasonal swings, and viral moments.

• Partner with Product and Engineering on measurement infrastructure, onboarding for paid users, and tests that connect acquisition to retention.

• Turn performance into clear recommendations for marketing leadership, including what isn’t working.

✅  You have...

• 8+ years of experience in performance marketing or paid user acquisition, with a focus on large scale, global mobile acquisition campaigns.

• 3+ years leading teams of performance marketers.

• A track record of owning a large, multichannel performance budget and taking channels from test to scale.

• Hands on experience with incrementality tests, saturation analysis, and LTV and ROAS models.

• Deep knowledge of the mobile user acquisition ecosystem, including attribution technologies and iOS privacy frameworks such as SKAN.

• Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams on performance marketing.

• The judgment to recommend cutting or reallocating spend when returns don’t support it.

• Clear, concise written communication, from channel detail to leadership level recommendations.

⭐  Exceptional candidates will have...

• Experience leading user acquisition for a top subscription based mobile app or a high engagement consumer app with millions of daily users.

• Experience running acquisition in China or other markets with distinct ad ecosystems.

• Experience growing users across multiple products or apps.

• Experience scaling creative through UGC agencies, creator marketplaces, or creator networks.

• A passion for Duolingo’s mission to make education universally accessible.

jobs.title: AVP, Programming Producer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SOTHEBY'S

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

THE ROLE

The Programming Producer creates, manages and executes key engagement initiatives across Sotheby’s flagship locations, focusing on programming concepts, production and delivery in New York. Working closely with the VP, Global Programming, the Producer manages in-person programming and experiential marketing for audiences across Global Fine Art, Luxury, and non-auction initiatives.

This role contributes to the creative direction and strategy of audience engagement at Sotheby’s, ensuring that events and experiences reflect the brand’s standards and ambition. As a connector across departments and external stakeholders, the Programming Producer brings vision and structure to complex programming. In New York, the role oversees public-facing event delivery, with responsibility for creative concept, resources, talent, staffing, technical production, and security.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Manage execution of the monthly, annual, and bespoke New York engagement program calendar, including conferences and panels, Lates, Kids & Family, and exhibition education

• Design and deliver compelling programming to grow and retain audiences, celebrating Sotheby’s expertise, facilitating knowledge exchange and securing noteworthy guests

• Coordinate across internal teams such as Marketing, Events, Global Fine Art, and Luxury to deliver cross departmental audience initiatives

• Work closely with Front of House, Security and Facilities to create a seamless and consistent client journey, with the ability to fulfill client facing duties

• Lead on-site delivery of all New York programming and events, directing internal teams, external staff, suppliers, catering, and AV to ensure smooth execution

• Develop and maintain production schedules, run-of-show documents, staffing plans, technical briefs, and other event documentation in collaboration with the Events team

• On occasion contribute to consigner pitches with unique programming opportunities

• Improve departmental consistency by maintaining standard operating procedures, templates, and best practices, and applying lessons from event debriefs to future delivery

• Monitor milestones, budgets, and project readiness; maintain clear ownership of actions and deadlines; and support regular project meetings and accurate monthly performance reporting

• Support the Programming Operations Manager for In Residence and private exhibitions during peak season, including on-site coordination, logistics, and marketing

IDEAL EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES

• 8+ years of experience in cultural programming, project management, and event delivery

• Established network across the arts and culture sector

• Strong creative and strategic thinking, with experience developing innovative programming concepts

• Apply a proactive, solutions-focused approach to designing programming and audience experiences

• Excellent presentation and public speaking skills, with experience delivering internal and external pitches

• Results-oriented, with experience measuring ROI and improving processes

• Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines

• Team player with a keen interest to support their departments growth

• Demonstrated interest in the arts and active engagement with cultural events and exhibitions is preferred

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, Arts Education, Cultural Institutions, or a related field preferred

The proposed base salary for this position ranges from $90,000-$120,000. In addition to base salary successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus, as well as a competitive benefits package. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. jobs.title: Portfolio Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Juicebox

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams win the talent war.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside 5,000+ customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR with 20%+ monthly growth, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over $116M in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B https://juicebox.ai/blog/series-b here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.



Customer Success at Juicebox sits at the intersection of commercial ownership, AI workflow enablement, and customer strategy. CSMs own the full customer relationship—from onboarding and adoption to expansion and renewal—while serving as trusted advisors and AI workflow experts.

Our customers range from enterprise talent teams to startup founders, staffing firms, and VC talent partners. As a PLG business, customers start small and scale quickly, so you'll often be managing onboarding, expansion, and renewal motions simultaneously.

You'll help define what Customer Success looks like in an AI-first world at a hypergrowth company shaping a new category. Our customers love the product, embrace innovation, and genuinely enjoy partnering with us. You'll do it alongside a low-ego, collaborative team.

You Will

 - Be excited about being on the founding Portfolio CSM team at Juicebox and build a scalable team-based model for our SMB customers

 - Own onboarding, adoption, and retention for a portfolio of SMB accounts

 - Run and improve one-to-many enablement: kickoff and training sessions, office hours, and webinars

 - Use usage data and customer signals to spot risk and expansion early and act on it

 - Work with a portfolio of customers and drive measurable outcomes across onboarding, adoption, expansion, and renewal.

 - Drive adoption of AI-native workflows, guide change management, and help customers reach their first “aha” moment and beyond.

 - Own commercial conversations, including renewals and expansions

 - Build trusted relationships with end users, champions, TA Ops leaders, and hiring managers.

 - Lead ROI discussions and QBRs that demonstrate impact and strengthen partnerships.

 - Help define and improve the portfolio Customer Success playbook by identifying gaps, solving problems, and scaling best practices.

You Have

 - 2+ years in Customer Success or Account Management with ownership of a revenue target and a portfolio of 150-200+ accounts.

 - Experience working in a digital, scale, pool model directly working with customers

 - A track record of exceeding goals and driving customer growth.

 - The ability to manage multiple customer conversations and priorities simultaneously.

 - A builder mindset and comfort operating in ambiguity before a playbook exists.

 - Experience in SaaS, consulting, HR tech, or talent tech; recruiting industry experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Perks & Benefits for all Full Time Employees

 - Top-of-market compensation with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success.

 - Daily meals provided: breakfast catering, lunch order via DoorDash corporate, and for those who like to work late, dinner if staying after 7pm

For US Employees:

 - Comprehensive healthcare with 100% employer-paid medical coverage for employees (PPO Platinum plan with $0 deductible). 90% employer contribution for dependents. Dental & Vision: 90% employer covered; 85% for dependents.

 - $2,000 annual wellness stipend to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

 - $300/month commuting stipend to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

For UK Employees:

 - Comprehensive private medical insurance with £0 excess, full outpatient cover, comprehensive cancer care, mental health treatment, and 24/7 GP access.

 - £1,500 annual wellness stipend to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being

 - £3,500/year commuting stipend to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

jobs.title: Creative Designer, Growth
jobs.description:
At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone. Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability—working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. Whether solving big challenges, delivering outstanding results, or celebrating wins, we approach every day with purpose and passion. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

Why this role

Evolve is on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone, and that starts with the homeowners who trust us with their properties. For most of them, the first thing they see from us is an ad on search or social media, or a referral from another owner. As our Creative Designer, you'll own the strategy behind what we show potential customers across our ads, landing pages and mail pieces. You will work closely with product marketing and our paid marketing teams to test, learn and iterate, and put more of our budget behind what actually brings in qualified owners. This is an individual-contributor role on a small, flat, high-ownership team, with a direct line from your work to the company's growth.

The team

Growth owns Evolve's owner-acquisition funnel, from first impression through qualified lead and signup, and all of our marketing. It's a small team by design, which means less process, more surface area, and a lot of creative freedom inside a clear brand.

What you’ll do

• Paid Creative

• Design static, motion and short-form video ads for Meta, Reddit, display and new test channels, with multiple versions of each concept across formats and sizes

• Ship new variants every week with our performance marketers, built around clear hypotheses — hooks, messages, formats, audiences

• Read the results with the team, and turn what you learn into the next round rather than starting from scratch

• Landing Pages, Mail & Brand

• Design landing page visuals, direct mail pieces and lifecycle email creative, so the experience matches from ad to page to mailbox

• Work with our brand and product marketing team to keep everything on-brand while still testing boldly

• Systems & Speed

• Build templates, asset libraries and a creative learnings log so production scales without losing quality

• Use AI tools to raise output and speed up iteration, and help the team get better at it

What makes you a great fit

• 3+ years designing performance or direct-response creative — paid social ads, display, landing pages — for a consumer, marketplace or lead-generation business

• A portfolio that shows high-volume ad work and how it was tested and iterated, not just final hero pieces

• Strong in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud; comfortable with motion and basic video editing (After Effects, Premiere or similar)

• You think in tests: you can explain why a variant won, and you use performance data to decide what to make next

• Fast, organized and comfortable with feedback and short turnaround

• AI-native working style — you already use AI tools to generate, iterate and resize creative; this is a baseline here, not a differentiator

• Nice to have: experience designing for print or direct mail and working with print vendors, reading Meta Ads Manager or channel dashboards yourself, and copywriting instincts for headlines and hooks

Compensation

Our base salary is $110,000- $135,000 depending on experience.

Location

All Evolve team members must live in one of our approved locations by their first day. We can hire from anywhere in the U.S. except D.C. and Hawaii. Some positions may also have restrictions based on compensation in the following states: California, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Washington. If you live in Colorado, you can work remotely anywhere in the state, at our downtown Denver office, or a hybrid of both! If you're planning to move soon, please let us know, and we'll be happy to review your application again.

California Applicant Privacy Policy | Evolve

How we reward Evolvers

We’re intentional about offering benefits that empower every Evolver to thrive both professionally and personally because they’re more than perks—they’re investments in our customer-obsessed, high-performing team.

We believe in treating others as they want to be treated, providing benefits that deliver real value, and challenging the status quo to meet the diverse needs of our team. Whether it’s helping you take care of your health, plan for the future, or celebrate life’s milestones, our offerings are designed to support you every step of the way.

• Financial Wellness: Industry-competitive pay, equity in the company, and a 401(k) with a 4% immediate vesting match.

• Family Support: 16-18 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 10 weeks for non-birthing parents, plus infertility coverage.

• Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, with 100% employer-paid dental and vision for individual coverage, a low-cost medical option, 10 free mental health visits, and pet insurance.

• Time to Recharge: Generous PTO, RTO (for full-time exempt employees), sick leave, holidays, and a personal holiday to celebrate what matters most to you.

• Travel Perks: Annual Evolve travel credit after one year and discounts on stays at all Evolve properties.

• Growth Opportunities: World-class onboarding programs, learning, and development resources to help you grow your impact.

• Connection: Employee Resource Groups celebrating our diverse communities at Evolve.

How we work together

With our core values as our guide, every Evolver helps shape the company we want to work for and the people we want to be. We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, care, and responsibility that we can all be proud of, and we’re excited to see what you’ll bring as your authentic self.

Still curious about who we are and what we do? Read more about our business and our culture at evolve.com.

EEO

At Evolve, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified candidates will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military service or veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. jobs.location: CA - San Francisco HQ; NY - New York City
jobs.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role:

The CTO Business Operations team enables SoFi’s Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) organization to execute with operational rigor, financial discipline, and organizational clarity. We build and run the people-data pipelines, internal org tooling, and operating cadences that turn complex workforce and resource data into clear operational systems for the CTO and EPD leadership.

As a Data Analyst, you will own the data engineering, transforms, and reporting systems behind EPD headcount, organizational mapping, and org-wide resource reporting (~2,000+ people across Technology and Product). We are looking for a builder with strong data engineering foundations who wants to apply technical rigor to business operations: automating Workday people-data pipelines, evolving our resource reporting tools toward live API integration and self-serve leader workflows, running operating calendars, and supporting resource planning and software capitalization.

What you’ll do:

• People Data Pipelines & Resource Reporting

• Own and evolve our internal org and squad resource reporting (~2,000+ people across Engineering, Product, and Design), driving reliable biweekly refreshes and high data integrity.

• Partner on the next evolution of our resource reporting tooling, moving from manual spreadsheet round-trips toward automated Workday API ingestion and interactive drag-and-drop seat management for engineering leaders.

• Build and maintain automated people-data pipelines, Workday report transforms, and cross-system reconciliations across HRIS (Workday), Talent Acquisition, FP&A, and EPD rosters.

• Maintain accurate org mapping across divisions, groups, and squads, tracking hiring progress, backfills, contingent workers, team movements, and capacity impacts.

• Data Engineering, Automation & AI-Enabled Analytics

• Take messy, multi-source operational datasets and build clean, repeatable data models, scripts, and validation checks that eliminate manual spreadsheet toil.

• Use modern AI coding and analysis tools alongside SQL, Python (or equivalent scripting), and Google Sheets to rapidly prototype tooling, automate recurring reporting, and audit data quality.

• Ensure strong data governance, schema consistency, and clear documentation across CTO Business Operations datasets and tools.

• Operating Rhythms, Resource Planning & Capitalization

• Manage and consolidate EPD operating calendars, leadership forum rhythms, and recurring readiness milestones across Technology and Product.

• Support quarterly and annual headcount, contingent-worker, and resource planning cycles with clean baseline data, scenario models, and variance analysis.

• Support the quarterly software development capitalization and labor allocation process in partnership with Finance, Accounting, and engineering leaders.

• Perform ad-hoc analyses on organizational structure, squad composition, and workforce deployment to inform CTO leadership decisions.

• Cross-Functional Partnership

• Partner closely with CTO Business Operations, EPD leaders, People Partners, HRIS, Talent Acquisition, and Strategic Finance to keep staffing, org structure, and capacity data aligned.

• Translate complex engineering and workforce inputs into structured metrics, clear narratives, and actionable recommendations.

• Support executive-level summaries, dashboards, and operating materials for CTO leadership.

What You’ll Need:

• 4 to 7+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, technical business operations, or data analysis (targeting Staff level, or a strong Senior level with demonstrated technical depth).

• Strong data engineering foundations: proven ability to ingest, clean, transform, and reconcile messy, multi-source datasets using SQL, Python (or Apps Script / TypeScript), and advanced Google Sheets / Excel.

• Hands-on experience with Workday people data, custom reports, org hierarchies, and HRIS-to-planning reconciliations, with the ability to work toward API-driven data integrations.

• Fluency with modern AI coding and data tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, Copilot, LLM workflows) to accelerate pipeline development, data cleaning, and tooling, paired with strong judgment on output accuracy.

• Track record of building and maintaining reliable internal tools, automated workflows, or operational dashboards for technical and executive stakeholders.

• High attention to detail, operational rigor, and ownership mindset: you spot reconciliation gaps before leaders do and drive them to zero.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, Economics, or equivalent practical technical experience.

• Bonus Points:

• Prior background as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or HRIS / People Data Systems Engineer looking to build business and executive operations acumen.

• Experience with Snowflake, Jira, and connecting project or engineering telemetry with workforce and resource data.

• Experience building lightweight web interfaces, Apps Script automations, or interactive internal tools.

• Familiarity with engineering org structures (squads, pillars), contingent workforce operations, or software development capitalization.

Compensation and Benefits

The base pay range for this role is listed below. Final base pay offer will be determined based on individual factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, and location.

To view all of our comprehensive and competitive benefits, visit our Benefits at SoFi page!

jobs.description:
About the Team

DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality.

About the Role

In this role, you’ll work within a 5-15k sq ft distribution center, will assist in leading the local warehouse operating team, and in some locations, includes preparing food in a light-prep kitchen, and help the Site Manager ensure we maintain high quality for our customers.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Lead: You’ll demonstrate compassion and commitment to inclusivity as you lead a team of hourly Operations Associates and Shift Leads. You’ll hire, coach and develop high-performing team members, while building a safety-first culture where employees are excited to drive success, personally and for the team. You’ll serve as a leading change agent for your site, helping your team to navigate new initiatives and growth projects. You’ll tackle onsite escalations, including coordination with cross-functional partners.

• Operate: With your thumb on the pulse of all outcomes for your team, you will be directly responsible for driving results in one or more specific focus areas or a specific shift for your site. To achieve your performance targets, you’ll drive success through effective scheduling and by executing inventory management processes and deploying best practices from across the network. You’ll engage cross-functional partners as needed for support.

• Strategize: Within the focus area(s) assigned by your Site Manager, you’ll analyze data and make strategic recommendations and execute actions regarding resource allocation, workflow, warehouse organization and when to engage cross-functional partners. You may also lead some process improvement projects.

• Delight: We are customer-obsessed. You’ll coach and empower your team to provide a highly quality customer experience with every order. Quality metrics such as order accuracy and fulfillment speed will be key measurements of success for your team. You’ll also work cross-functionally with central teams from our inventory to training teams to ensure your team has the tools and resources they’ll need to deliver.

We’re excited about you because…

• You’re a proven leader. You have managed high-performance teams of 5+ employees with successful performance and employee development outcomes.

• You relish ownership. You’re excited to have ownership in a new and rapidly growing business. No problem is too big or too small for you, and you’re ready to show up however needed for your team.

• You solve problems from first principles. You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.

• You’re unafraid of ambiguity. Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environments.

• You’re analytical. You let data win arguments. You are a data-first problem solver and you have experience using Excel or Google Sheets to analyze data, including using basic formulas and creating pivot tables.

• You have 3+ years’ experience: In Operations, Warehouse Logistics, Customer Service, Retail Management, Fulfillment, or related field

• You have 1+ years of experience managing a team

• You have flexibility in your schedule. As the leader of the site, you will need to ensure your team and the site is fully supported, which will include regularly scheduled late-night and weekend hours.

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Data Analyst focused on Cloud Financial Data to join our Data Team. The ideal candidate is curious, passionate, data-driven, and believes in Planet’s mission and values. You will gain first-hand experience in enterprise data modeling and analysis. You’ll build data products and solutions such as dashboards, self-service tooling, and data pipelines for consumers across Planet, leveraging tools including git, dbt, python, SQL and Omni.
