jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description:
Join our team at Core One! Our mission is to be at the forefront of devising analytical, operational and technical solutions to our Nation's most complex national security challenges. In order to achieve our mission, Core One values people first! We are committed to recruiting, nurturing, and retaining top talent! We offer a competitive total compensation package that sets us apart from our competition. Core One is a team-oriented, dynamic, and growing company that values exceptional performance!

Core One seeks a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead the day-to-day operations of an energetic and motivated recruiting team that directly impacts the growth and success of our organization. Reporting to the Director of Talent Acquisition, the Talent Acquisition Manager will oversee a team of recruiters and recruiting associates, setting priorities and assignments across open requisitions, proposals, and growth efforts so the team’s capacity goes where the business needs it most. While the role is primarily focused on team leadership and workload management, the Talent Acquisition Manager will also carry a select number of requisitions and remain hands-on in sourcing and recruiting cleared talent.

This is an opportunity to shape how a growing recruiting function operates in a fast-growth GovCon environment, supporting a wide range of government clients across the defense and intelligence communities.

*This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret Clearance*

Responsibilities:

• Manage recruiter assignments and priorities across requisitions, programs, and proposals, adjusting focus as hiring demand, awards, and timelines shift

• Track team workload and capacity, and identify when priorities need to be rebalanced or escalated to the Director

• Lead regular pipeline reviews with recruiters to monitor progress, remove obstacles, and keep hiring goals on track

• Coach, train, and develop recruiters and recruiting associates, including onboarding new team members to our processes, contracts, and clearance requirements

• Partner with P&L leaders, Capture Leads, and hiring authorities to understand hiring needs, set expectations, and communicate status

• Carry a select requisition load, conducting full life-cycle recruiting from sourcing through offer acceptance

• Use recruiting data and metrics to report on team performance, identify trends, and recommend process improvements

• Ensure accurate, consistent use of the applicant tracking system and recruiting tools across the team

• Support proposal staffing efforts, including resume review against LCATs and building pipelines ahead of awards

• Maintain a high level of confidentiality and professionalism in all aspects of the role

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree and at least 5 years of recruiting experience, including at least 2 years in government contracting

• Experience recruiting for cleared contracts, including TS/SCI and Full Scope Poly candidates

• Experience managing both proposal and capture recruiting and traditional P&L recruiting, including balancing pipeline-building for pursuits with filling open requisitions on active contracts

• Previous experience as a recruiting manager or team lead, with direct responsibility for recruiters’ priorities, development, and performance

• Hands-on experience sourcing on cleared recruiting platforms such as ClearanceJobs, along with an applicant tracking system, including using recruiting data for reporting

• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities across multiple programs and pursuits

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with people at all levels of leadership

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment

• Must be a US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance

Desired Qualifications:

• Active Top Secret clearance

• Experience with Greenhouse

• Experience with a recruiting CRM (e.g., Gem)

• Experience supporting intelligence community programs

Security Clearance:

Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret Clearance

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Majors sales team is responsible for revenue growth in new and existing customers that represent the largest prospective accounts for Samsara by total addressable opportunity.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and requires living in the CST timezones.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

• Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts

• Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close

• Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales processes in complex sales campaigns

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role with Enterprise customers

• Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $500k+ ARR transactions

• Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships

• Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting

• Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience working with a line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)

• Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)

• Passion for the world of operations!

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) for full-time employees for this position is below. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary

$350,000—$350,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
Join the Team!

Is technology your passion? Do you want to work with smart, forward-thinking individuals? Do you want to grow in a career you love?

At Align, our professionals are the key to our success. We don’t just hire talent, we invest in exceptional people who are forward-thinking, results-driven, and passionate about what they do. We’re a group of tech-savvy professionals who are motivated by making an impact. Our culture is one of unbounded opportunity that celebrates the passions, skills and ideas of our team—work hard, play hard, be smart!

We believe great communities lead to great companies. That’s why we offer a dynamic workplace where you feel inspired, engaged and innovative. We offer professionals opportunities to train in the leading technologies, make an impact within the industry and acquire valuable new skills whether on client sites or in one of our regional offices.

Position Overview

Align seeks an Assistant Project Manager to support second-shift construction activities for a data center build-out in the Ann Arbor area. This is a field-facing opportunity for someone with construction experience who is ready to take on more responsibility coordinating contractors, tracking progress, and keeping work moving onsite.

Working closely with the lead Project Manager and daytime team, this person will serve as Align’s onsite point of contact during the second shift. The role requires someone who is comfortable walking the jobsite, communicating with contractors and clients, and addressing issues as they arise.

Candidates with experience in assistant project management, project engineering, field coordination, or construction supervision are encouraged to apply. A background in commercial, industrial, electrical, or low-voltage construction is preferred. Previous data center experience is a plus but is not required.

• This position requires working onsite during the second shift, approximately 4:00 p.m. to midnight.

• This is a full-time position offering full benefits, paid training, and opportunities for career growth.

Responsibilities

• Coordinate second-shift construction activities with the lead Project Manager, contractors, vendors, and client representatives

• Review the planned work with the daytime team and confirm priorities, work areas, material needs, and outstanding issues before the shift begins

• Walk the jobsite regularly to track progress, identify installation issues, and confirm work follows project drawings, specifications, and site requirements

• Help coordinate data center fit-out activities, which may include cabinets, containment, cable pathways, structured cabling, and associated power and cooling work

• Monitor contractor progress against the daily plan and communicate delays, access restrictions, material shortages, or conflicts that could affect the schedule

• Reinforce site safety requirements and promptly escalate unsafe conditions or work outside the approved scope

• Maintain daily reports, progress photos, issue logs, and punch lists. Help document field questions and potential changes for the project team’s review

• Provide a clear handoff to the daytime team covering completed work, open items, and priorities for the following shift

• Support inspections, testing, punch-list completion, and project turnover as needed

Qualifications

• Previous experience supporting or supervising onsite construction activities, including coordinating contractors and tracking work in the field

• Ability to read construction drawings and understand installation requirements, work sequencing, and jobsite safety expectations

• Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to follow through on open items and keep the project team informed

• Comfortable taking ownership of assigned work, addressing routine field issues, and recognizing when to involve the lead Project Manager

• Previous data center construction experience or experience in commercial or industrial construction, electrical installations, structured cabling, or other critical facilities will be considered

• Familiarity with Microsoft Office and construction documentation tools such as Bluebeam or Procore is helpful

• Ability to work onsite consistently during the required second-shift hours

To support a fair, consistent, and high-quality hiring experience, some interviews may be recorded. These recordings help our team focus fully on the conversation at hand, rather than note-taking, and allow us to better evaluate and improve our recruitment process. Recordings are used solely for internal purposes such as training, quality assurance, and process improvement. Candidates will be informed in advance and asked to provide consent before any recording takes place.

Tier 2

PM26

Benefits and Perks:

At Align, we believe that supporting our employees both personally and professionally is key to our success. We offer a competitive benefits package designed to promote health, wellness, financial security, and work-life balance, including:

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

• Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options 401(k) plan with a dollar-for-dollar company match at 3% up to an annual maximum of $5k.

• Complimentary ClassPass membership to support your health and wellness goals

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Company-paid holidays

• Cellphone Reimbursement Program

• Floating Holiday to celebrate a day that is meaningful to you

• Pre-tax commuter benefits, where applicable

• Employee wellness programs, events, and team-building activities

• Employee referral program

Align is a premier global provider of technology infrastructure solutions.

Align specializes in designing and deploying technology infrastructure solutions from the data center to the desktop as well as providing managed IT services for clients.

Our professional services team, which includes Data Center Solutions, provide strategic consulting, design, project management, engineering, implementation and support. Our best-in-class Managed Services team provides IT services and cybersecurity advisory for clients within the Alternative Investment industry. Align is a Microsoft Tier 1 Cloud Solutions Provider (CSP) and Gold Partner.

Our client centric approach and passion for driving IT innovation has enabled us to provide tailored solutions and business transformations for over three decades. Leading firms have relied on Align to provide forward-thinking technology strategies that support their current and future business needs.

Our teams have flawless track records of delivering technical solutions and have established long-standing relationships with an impressive client list of both Global 1000 and SMB clients. We work across a diverse list of industries including financial services, life sciences (pharmaceutical and health care), retail, technology, media and telecommunications.

For more information, visit: www.align.com

jobs.title: Account Executive, Expansion
jobs.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry.  In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

As an Account Executive on our customer expansion team, you’ll help existing Steer customers get more value from our platform. This is a full-cycle sales role: you’ll identify opportunities in your book of customers, make outbound calls, learn how each shop operates, demonstrate the right solution, handle objections, and close upgrades to Steer CRM or our phones product.

You’ll work with repair shop owners and managers who already know Steer, but you’ll need to earn each conversation and make a clear case for why an additional product fits their business. We’re looking for someone who enjoys prospecting, takes ownership of their pipeline, and can build trust with small business owners.

The role is remote.
Compensation: $60,000 base salary; $120,000 on-target earnings (OTE), including commission.

What You’ll Do

• Proactively call and follow up with existing Steer customers to uncover opportunities for CRM and phones upgrades.

• Manage the entire sales cycle, from first outreach through discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.

• Learn each shop’s goals and current workflow, then explain how the right Steer product could help.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through consistent outreach and thoughtful follow-up.

• Keep customer conversations, opportunities, and forecasts accurate in the CRM.

• Partner with customer-facing teams to understand account history and support a smooth transition after the sale.

• Meet or exceed revenue and activity goals while providing a good experience for customers.

What You Bring

Required

• Experience owning and closing sales opportunities, ideally in a full-cycle or expansion sales role.

• Confidence making outbound calls and creating opportunities rather than relying only on inbound leads.

• Strong discovery, presentation, objection-handling, and closing skills.

• The ability to explain software in practical terms to busy small business owners.

• Organized pipeline management and consistent follow-through.

• A coachable, self-directed approach and comfort working toward a quota.

Nice to Have

• Experience selling SaaS, CRM, communications, or phone products.

• Experience growing revenue within an existing customer base.

• Familiarity with automotive repair shops or other service businesses.

Interview Process

• Initial screen — 30 minutes with Lead Recruiter

• Executive Interview — 30 minutes with Head of Sales

• Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes with Sr. Sales Manager

• Problem Solving Interview - 60 minutes with Director of People

• Reference checks

Benefits

• 100% remote

• 100% employer-paid medical insurance

• Flexible PTO with a 15-day minimum

• Generous parental leave

• FSA and HSA

• Employee Assistance Program

• 401(k)

• Learning stipend

• Work-from-home equipment

• Opportunities for career growth and development

Why Join Steer?

At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

We’re hiring full-time, part-time, and PRN Physical Therapists — including new grads — who want competitive pay, strong mentorship, and a clear path to professional growth that flexes with every stage of your career.

• Achievable monthly clinical bonus program, over 90% of clinicians qualify

A Better Place to Build Your PT Career

With a network of over 1,200 clinics coast-to-coast across 26 brand partners, we lead the industry in quality outcomes, leveraging data, technology, and innovation to reduce paperwork and give you more time for care.

You’ll be part of a fantastic group of clinicians who shape our culture, create a positive work environment, and know how to have fun along the way. It’s easy to see why so many Physical Therapists choose to grow their careers with Upstream.

jobs.title: Client Accounting Lead
jobs.description:
Client Accounting Lead

Location: Columbus, GA (Hybrid: 3 days onsite, 2 days remote)

Type: Full-time

About Us

At TogetherWork, we empower mission-driven organizations with innovative software solutions that help them operate more efficiently and achieve their goals. Our portfolio of technology solutions supports organizations across a variety of industries, including nonprofits, associations, and higher education.

LegFi, a TogetherWork company, provides financial management technology and services designed to support Greek life organizations and their unique operational needs. Through LegFi Pro, we help clients manage complex accounting responsibilities, maintain accurate financial records, and gain greater visibility into their financial health.

We're passionate about combining technology, accounting expertise, and exceptional client service to help the organizations we serve succeed.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Client Accounting Lead to help deliver accurate, timely, and high-quality accounting services to our LegFi Pro clients while providing day-to-day leadership and support to our Client Accounting team.

This is a hands-on, client-facing leadership role that combines advanced accounting expertise, client relationship management, and team mentorship. You'll serve as a trusted resource for clients, helping them understand their financial statements, navigate accounting challenges, and make informed financial decisions.

You'll also act as a key partner to the Sr. Manager, Client Accounting, providing technical guidance, reviewing financial deliverables, supporting client escalations, and helping fellow accountants work more efficiently and effectively.

The role is a blend of two responsibilities: supporting and guiding the Client Accounting team and managing a limited portfolio of clients. The majority of your time will focus on helping the broader team deliver accurate financial information, resolve complex accounting issues, and maintain strong client relationships.

This is a leadership position without direct people-management responsibility. You'll influence team performance through coaching, collaboration, technical expertise, and accountability rather than formal supervisory authority.

The ideal candidate is a strong accountant who is equally comfortable analyzing financial statements, communicating with clients, and helping colleagues navigate complex accounting challenges.

What You'll Do

• Serve as a primary day-to-day resource for Client Accountants, providing guidance on complex accounting questions, financial reporting, reconciliations, and client-specific requirements.

• Review and support the preparation of accurate monthly financial statements, general ledger activity, journal entries, bank reconciliations, and month-end close deliverables.

• Act as a trusted accounting resource for clients, helping them understand financial results, identify budget variances, and make informed financial decisions.

• Support client escalations and participate in business reviews, providing clear explanations of financial information and recommendations for improvement.

• Coach, mentor, and train Client Accountants, helping strengthen technical accounting skills, improve workflows, and maintain consistent service quality.

• Partner closely with the Sr. Manager, Client Accounting, to monitor team workloads, identify operational challenges, and support timely completion of client deliverables.

• Help lead team meetings, coordinate priorities, and provide day-to-day guidance to improve collaboration and team effectiveness.

• Review accounting work completed by Internal Operations, identify discrepancies, and provide constructive feedback to ensure accuracy and consistency.

• Coordinate with Internal Operations on billing, budgeting, bank reconciliations, and other accounting activities performed on behalf of clients.

• Maintain and improve standard accounting procedures, internal controls, and client-specific documentation to support accurate and consistent financial reporting.

• Identify recurring accounting issues, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to streamline workflows and improve operational performance.

• Manage a limited portfolio of assigned LegFi Pro clients, including financial reporting, reconciliations, month-end close, and ongoing accounting support.

• Maintain strong client relationships by providing responsive communication, resolving concerns, and ensuring financial information is delivered accurately and on time.

• Support the onboarding and training of new Client Accountants, helping them become familiar with accounting procedures, systems, and client expectations.

• Adapt to evolving accounting systems, technology, and workflows while supporting process improvements across the team.

• Maintain confidentiality, exercise sound professional judgment, and ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting.

• 3–5 years of professional accounting experience, with strong expertise in financial reporting, general ledger accounting, journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end close.

• Demonstrated experience preparing, reviewing, and taking responsibility for accurate financial statements and accounting deliverables.

• Experience working directly with clients to explain financial results, discuss budget variances, and provide accounting recommendations.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting practices, internal controls, and reconciliation processes.

• Experience managing accounting responsibilities for multiple clients, accounts, or complex financial operations.

• Ability to analyze financial statements, identify discrepancies, and communicate findings clearly to both accounting and non-accounting audiences.

• Strong client relationship management skills, including the ability to navigate challenging conversations and resolve complex accounting concerns.

• Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including the ability to coach colleagues, provide constructive feedback, and support team success without direct management authority.

• Experience working with accounting or enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and adapting to evolving technology and processes.

• Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial information clearly and professionally.

• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

• Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain high-quality work in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.

• A collaborative, service-oriented mindset with a genuine interest in helping clients and colleagues succeed.

Bonus Points For

• Experience in public accounting, outsourced accounting, or a professional services environment supporting multiple clients.

• Previous experience as a Senior Accountant, Accounting Lead, or similar role involving team mentorship or technical oversight.

• Experience coaching, training, or supporting the development of other accounting professionals.

• Background in nonprofit accounting, including familiarity with nonprofit financial reporting, tax considerations, and Form 990.

• Experience serving Greek life organizations, fraternities, sororities, or the higher education market.

• Familiarity with Sage accounting systems, including Sage MAS 500, or comparable ERP platforms.

• Hands-on experience with Monday.com or similar workflow and project management tools.

• Experience improving accounting processes, documenting standard procedures, or supporting accounting system transitions.

The Company offers a comprehensive employee benefits program, including:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance options

• 100% employer-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance

• 100% employer-paid basic life and AD&D insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with a 100% company match up to 4%

• Flexible paid personal/vacation time built on mutual trust and accountability

• 10 sick days annually

• 10 company-paid holidays

• 12 weeks paid parental leave

Salary Range Disclosure

The base range represents the low and high end of the TogetherWork salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on factors including, but not limited to, location, experience, and performance.

The range listed is just one component of TogetherWork's total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include discretionary bonuses, long-term incentives, a flexible paid vacation/personal time policy, parental leave, and more.

Inclusion and Diversity

TogetherWork is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We are a company where diverse backgrounds, experiences, and viewpoints are valued.

TogetherWork does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, age, ethnic or national origin, or any other basis protected by all local, state, or federal laws.

Interview Process & Expectations

Our interviews are designed to be interactive and conversational. Candidates are expected to respond based on their own experience and thinking during live interviews.

To ensure a fair and consistent interview experience, the use of real-time AI tools or other external assistance to generate or guide interview responses is not permitted. Interviews are intended to reflect an individual's judgment, problem-solving approach, and communication.

jobs.title: Core AE Southeast [FY27][Pipeline]
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Core AE, you will be helping our largest and most strategic enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US in the following states: Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, and West Virginia.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

• Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts

• Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close

• Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role

• Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $100k+ ARR transactions

• Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships

• Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting

• Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast paced environment

• Willing and comfortable traveling to meet customers on a monthly basis

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)

• Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)

• Passion for the world of operations!

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary

$222,400—$278,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

jobs.title: Research Associate II, Microbiology
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Kingdom is the world’s first AI-native ingredients company.  We create Superculture® ingredients from natural microbes to improve the health of pets and people. Brands use our ingredients because they deliver industry-leading efficacy and health benefits that consumers notice in just days.

AI powers how we develop, clinically validate, and manufacture our ingredients, enabling us to bring them to market faster and at lower cost.  Developing a new ingredient has traditionally taken more than five years and tens of millions of dollars.  Our small team is launching one clinically validated ingredient a year, at a small fraction of that cost.

Kingdom has clear product-market fit, with accelerating customer demand:

 - After just a year in market, our ingredients are already in dozens of products from household pet brands. And 95% of our first-time customers are launching additional products with us.

 - Each ingredient improves our discovery platform, clinical engine, and manufacturing expertise, so we can develop the next one faster and at lower cost.

 - We’ve raised nearly $40M from leading investors to bring our ingredients to more brands and markets around the world.

Our number one priority is turning proven ingredient performance and early commercial traction into repeatable growth across customers and markets. We’re looking for highly resourceful, high-throughput individuals who solve problems from first principles, make sound decisions, communicate clearly, and move quickly.

More than $300B is spent every year on pet and human health products.  Our ambition is to make clinical efficacy the standard across that entire market.

All full-time roles are in person at our Brooklyn Navy Yard headquarters and lab.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Kingdom is at an inflection point. Demand for our Superculture® pet ingredients is accelerating, and we are preparing to commercialize our first human ingredient. Every one of those ingredients starts in the same place: our biobank. Growing and maintaining that collection of microbes, and generating the sequencing data that tells us what we have, is foundational to everything we build.

The Research Associate II, Microbiology is at the center of that work. You will join our lab team to own day-to-day biobanking and sequencing operations, from processing new sources and isolating novel strains, to keeping our existing collection healthy, to running PCR, library prep, and sequencing.

If you’re an early-career scientist looking to deepen your experience in microbiology and molecular biology, take ownership of a range of workstreams, and grow with a fast-moving biotech, we want to hear from you.




IF YOU JOIN, YOU WILL:

 - Grow and maintain Kingdom’s biobank by obtaining, processing, and organizing sources, isolating new strains, regenerating older strains, and making and cataloging strain stocks

 - Culture and isolate microbes using rigorous aseptic technique, working with BSL-1 and BSL-2 strains and with anaerobes in our anaerobic chambers

 - Obtain pure isolates and prepare screening plates to support new projects

 - Run PCR and gel purification for Sanger sequencing needs

 - Own DNA extraction and library preparation for 16S/ITS and whole genome sequencing

 - Run qPCR assays and process the resulting data

 - Use liquid handlers to scale high-throughput methods, and troubleshoot and improve protocols along the way

 - Execute on in vitro cell-based models

 - Support experimental characterization of Superculture® ingredients




WE’RE LOOKING FOR YOU IF YOU HAVE:

 - A BS or MS in microbiology, molecular biology, or a related life-sciences field

 - 1–2 years of hands-on experience in a microbiology or molecular biology lab, in academia or industry

 - Strong aseptic technique and direct experience isolating and culturing microbes, including preparing culture media

 - Hands-on experience with DNA extraction, PCR, gel electrophoresis, and sequencing library preparation

 - Meticulous execution and documentation habits, with bench work that others can trace and reproduce

 - Experience with lab automation, including liquid handlers

 - Strong organization, with the ability to juggle requests from multiple teams and meet turnaround commitments

 - A troubleshooting mindset and the drive to find and fix problems without waiting to be asked




WORKING WITH US

Kingdom is based in the Brooklyn Navy Yard, with our full team working out of a 9,000 sq-ft headquarters and lab space.  We operate in a high-trust, high-autonomy environment, which requires that everyone uphold our core values:

 - Solve from first principles. We have a deep-seated curiosity about the most important problems facing the business. Our nature is to dig deeply into their details, question assumptions, understand the smallest details, and drive towards the best possible solution using these insights. This makes us very effective in crafting new solutions and operating in ambiguous circumstances.

 - Collaborate with kindness. We are very low ego, and treat each other with respect, compassion, and humility. We hold one another to high standards, but do so while being deeply committed to each other's wellbeing. We invest in each other's growth, and are willing to engage in difficult conversations and deliver direct, constructive feedback when necessary.

 - Be resourceful and resilient. We figure out how to make things work, and how to accomplish our goals regardless of what stands in the way. We're keen to confront challenges together through proactive planning and scrappy methods. When things go wrong, we learn quickly from our missteps, adapt our approach, and push forward.



We provide competitive compensation with generous equity.  Everyone who joins Kingdom will be a major contributor to our success, which we reflect in our approach to ownership and compensation.  The cash salary range for this role is $80-85K, with the final starting salary being determined by qualifications, experience, skill set, and internal equity.  Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company’s size and industry, and are one part of a total compensation package that also includes benefits (more below) and equity (to be discussed more during the interview process).



We also provide a rich benefits package to support our team:

 - Fully covered, best-in-class medical, vision, and dental insurance

 - Free memberships to One Medical, Teladoc, and Talkspace

 - Flexible PTO, in addition to 13 paid company holidays (including a weeklong winter closure from Christmas Eve through New Year's Day)

 - 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, with the option to extend up to 24 weeks total

 - 401(k) plan, FSA option, and commuter benefit of your choice

 - Fully stocked kitchen with fruits, snacks, coffee, and tea, plus weekly team lunches



Kingdom is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

jobs.title: Core AE Midwest [FY27][Pipeline]
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Core AE, you will be helping our largest and most strategic enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US in the following states: Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota, and Wisconsin.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

• Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts

• Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close

• Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role

• Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $100k+ ARR transactions

• Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships

• Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting

• Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast paced environment

• Willing and comfortable traveling to meet customers on a monthly basis

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)

• Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)

• Passion for the world of operations!

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary

$222,400—$278,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.location: Remote Office; Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Legato Security is an information security firm founded upon the belief that every organization has the right to keep its data private and secure. Our mission is to build close partnerships with our clients, serving them not as just a vendor, but as trusted advisors helping to build effective, proactive plans. Our focus is always on both the technical and human elements within an organization. We believe in comprehensive strategies designed to harden networks, deflect attackers, and rapidly recover from any accidents. As technology progresses, so do our tactics, ensuring our experts are always prepared to serve forward-looking leaders eager to stay ahead of emerging threats.

Position Overview

Legato Security is hiring a Security Engineer to own endpoint detection and response across our managed security customers. You'll be our subject matter expert to help deploy, tune, and run CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Carbon Black, and SentinelOne in customer environments, as well as managing the SIEM pipelines that keep telemetry healthy.

You’ll work with in-house teams (including other Security Engineers on our team, and SOC Analysts) to identify the right mix of tools, techniques, and procedures to translate our customer’s needs and future goals into a plan that will enable secure and effective solutions. In determining the best solutions, you will investigate new techniques, break free from the legacy model, and help customers exceed industry standards. As a team, we’ll take a critical approach to solution design, identifying gaps, providing alternatives, and customizing solutions to maintain a balance of security and business needs. This position is open to remote personnel anywhere within the U.S.

Specific Job Responsibilities

• Administer multi-tenant consoles (Falcon Flight Control parent/child CIDs, Defender multi-tenant management, SentinelOne sites and groups), including RBAC, policy inheritance, and sensor update rings

• Tune prevention and detection policies to cut noise without opening gaps

• Track sensor health and coverage: Unmanaged hosts, reduced-functionality mode, stale sensors, and version drift

• Administer EDR-to-SIEM pipelines into Sumo Logic Cloud SIEM, Microsoft Sentinel, and Stellar Cyber

• Build and maintain API integrations between EDR platforms, SOAR, ticketing, and threat intel

• Plan and run EDR deployments and migrations for new customers: Sensor rollout through Intune, SCCM, GPO, or Jamf; policy design; exclusions

Required Qualifications

• 2+ years deploying or administering an enterprise EDR (CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, or comparable) in production, plus 2+ years of systems administration

• At least one EDR deployment or migration you ran end to end: Rollout, policy, exclusions, and handoff to operations

• Experience with Windows internals and macOS/Linux administration to troubleshoot sensor problems, such as service failures, system extensions, eBPF, AV conflicts, proxies, and TLS inspection

• Active experience with SIEM work, e.g. onboarding of log sources, event parsing, field extractions, and query creation across a variety of tools

• PowerShell plus Python or Go, including scripting API access and endpoint deployment scripts

• Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and how attacker techniques show up in endpoint telemetry

• Excellent writing skills for creating runbooks, incident summaries, and configuration guides

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years focused on CrowdStrike Falcon or SentinelOne, or production experience with more than one of the following EDR products: Falcon, Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne

• MSSP or other multi-tenant operations experience

• Sysmon deployment and configuration tuning, for customers without a commercial EDR or as extra visibility alongside one

• Experience supporting federal or public-sector environments: NIST SP 800-53 controls, the Risk Management Framework, FedRAMP, and federal security authorization and assessment processes

Perks

• Start-up company in a growth phase with opportunity for advancement based on performance

• Start-up culture with an office in downtown Salt Lake City, UT

• Competitive medical and dental benefits for employee and family members

• Other company-provided benefits such as short-term disability, basic life insurance, children’s orthodontia, with additional voluntary benefits available, and 401K match

• Flexible Paid Time Off policy

• Professional Development opportunities specific to role

Embark on a journey where your skills are valued, your growth is fostered, and your voice is heard. At Legato Security, we understand that diversity is the key to innovation. Our hiring process is designed to provide a transparent, consistent, and uniform experience for all applicants, mitigating unconscious bias every step of the way. We foster a culture of belonging, where each team member is an integral part of the Legato community.

Legato Security is an equal-opportunity employer

jobs.title: Website Producer
jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Brand & Creative team shapes how people discover, understand, and experience Upstart. Our web team brings together design, SEO, content, and production to create useful, engaging experiences that support our brand and business goals.

As the Senior Web Producer at Upstart, you’ll manage web requests across products and stakeholders, turn priorities into production plans, and build and publish pages in WordPress and Instapage. You’ll partner with our Lead Web Designer, SEO / Web Lead, channel owners, and Engineering to keep work moving and balance business impact within the limitations of team capacity. You’ll also coordinate and execute a quarterly landing page testing roadmap in partnership with channel owners and Analytics, developing hypotheses, launching experiments, and sharing insights that improve web performance.

How you’ll make an impact

• Manage web intake and prioritization. Clarify goals and requirements across products and stakeholders. Partner with Design, our SEO / Web Lead, and Engineering to assess impact, scope effort, and negotiate priorities, timelines, and tradeoffs.

• Build quarterly web production roadmaps. Translate agreed priorities into actionable plans, coordinate dependencies and approvals, and communicate progress, risks, and changes to stakeholders.

• Own day-to-day platform operations. Administer WordPress and Instapage and maintain documentation, naming conventions, and access permissions. Provide first-line issue triage, escalate bugs, surface feature requests to Engineering, and validate fixes.

• Build and publish web experiences. Create and maintain pages using approved designs and reusable components. Partner with Design and Engineering to maintain page templates and perform QA across browsers and devices before and after publishing.

• Own landing page testing execution. Partner with channel owners to develop and prioritize hypotheses, align on success metrics with Analytics, build in-platform variants, launch tests, monitor performance, and recommend improvements based on results.

• Turn results into shared learnings. Analyze test results with relevant partners, communicate findings and recommended next steps, and publish winning experiences. Maintain a record of learnings to inform future tests across products and channels.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in web production, website management, or marketing web operations.

• Hands-on experience building, updating, and publishing pages in WordPress, Instapage, or comparable CMS and self-serve landing page platforms.

• Experience managing web projects from request intake through launch, including production schedules, cross-functional dependencies, and approvals.

• Hands-on experience configuring and launching website or landing page A/B tests.

• Experience using web analytics or experimentation tools to analyze page performance or test results and produce reports.

Preferred Qualifications

• Ability to navigate competing stakeholder needs, explain tradeoffs, and negotiate scope and timing diplomatically.

• Knowledge of conversion optimization and experience translating audience insights, channel goals, or performance data into testable hypotheses.

• Working knowledge of responsive design, accessibility, SEO fundamentals, and web QA.

• Familiarity with Figma, basic HTML/CSS, and headless CMS workflows.

• Experience improving publishing processes, documenting workflows, and managing platform access and governance.

Position location Remote

Time zone requirements The team operates on the West coast time zones.

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

#LI-REMOTE

#LI-Associate

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.  The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote -  Anticipated Base Salary Range

$109,000—$160,000 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

• Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly

• Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)

• Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.

• Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)

• Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security

• Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements

• Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)

• Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources

• Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)

• Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you

• Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from

• Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
